queryResults.querySql:
WITH 
last_delivered_cte AS
(
  SELECT MAX(log_del.contact_deleted_dt) AS last_del FROM PDP_UG.log__acs_contact_deletions AS log_del -- get the date when the deletions are last send to ACS
) 

SELECT
    CAST(ead.<ES Partner ID> AS varchar(64)) AS es_partner_id,
    CAST(ead.<ACS Contact ID> AS varchar(50)) AS acs_contact_id
FROM <[Acquia].[exp__acquia_deletions].{fulfillment}> as ead
CROSS JOIN last_delivered_cte
WHERE CASE WHEN last_delivered_cte.last_del IS NULL THEN 1=1 -- If we are sending deletions to ACS for the first time, then no filter condition
	  ELSE ead.<Contact Deleted Dt> > last_delivered_cte.last_del -- Else, filter for fullfilment results happened ater the date we previously send to ACS
	END

queryResults.querySql:
WITH acs_contacts as (
    SELECT
        CAST(acs_con.<EAB Contact ID> AS varchar(50)) AS eab_contact_id,
        CAST(acs_con.<ACS Contact ID> AS int) AS acs_contact_id,
        CAST(acs_con.<Email> AS varchar(64)) AS email,
        TRY_CAST(acs_con.<First Name> AS varchar(64)) AS first_name,
        CAST(acs_con.<Last Name> AS varchar(64)) AS last_name,
        CAST(acs_con.<Is Deleted> AS boolean) AS is_deleted,
        CAST(acs_con.<Is Deleted Dt> AS timestamp) AS is_deleted_dt,
        CAST(acs_con.<Is Deleted Reason> AS varchar(64)) AS is_deleted_reason
    FROM <[Acquia].[acs_contacts_bulk].{fulfillment}> AS acs_con
    WHERE (acs_con.is_deleted = true AND acs_con.is_deleted_reason = 'GDPR') -- record is already set to is_deleted = true
),

tenant_guid_cte AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        log_del.tenant_guid
    FROM  <[PDP_UG].[log__deletion_request_identifiers].{fulfillment}> AS log_del
)
SELECT
    tgc.tenant_guid AS es_partner_id,
    ac.acs_contact_id
FROM acs_contacts AS ac
INNER JOIN es_pdp_common.common.REF__DELETION_REQUESTS AS del_req
        ON del_req.contact_identifier_hash = MD5(LOWER(CONCAT(COALESCE(CAST(ac.email AS VARCHAR),''), COALESCE(CAST(ac.first_name AS VARCHAR),''), COALESCE(CAST(ac.last_name AS VARCHAR),''))))
       AND LOWER(del_req.mes_business_line) = 'e360'
       AND (del_req.voided_dt IS NULL AND del_req.voided_by IS NULL AND del_req.void_source IS NULL) -- GDPR request for the contact_identifier_hash is not reverted/voided
       -- AND (CURRENT_DATE() - CAST(ac.is_deleted_dt AS DATE)) > 14
	   AND (DATEDIFF(day,CAST(ac.is_deleted_dt AS DATE),CURRENT_DATE()) >= 14 AND (MOD(DATEDIFF(day,CAST(ac.is_deleted_dt AS DATE),CURRENT_DATE()),14) = 0))	
CROSS JOIN tenant_guid_cte AS tgc

queryResults.sqlPreview: /* This bound query delivers to the exp__acquia_gdpr_soft_delete_requests entity in Acquia domain Once the record is GDPRd, we no longer identify it in PDP and …
queryResults.querySql:
/*
This bound query delivers to the exp__acquia_gdpr_soft_delete_requests entity in Acquia domain
Once the record is GDPRd, we no longer identify it in PDP and before permanently deleting that record in Acquia, we have to set it for soft delete i.e., is_deleted = 1
So this BQ identifies the GDPRd records that are still in the files recevived back from replication and set them for soft deletion.
If the record is already marked is_deleted = 1, we no longer send it to Acquia
*/

WITH
-- The first 2 CTESs will get the acs_replication_date
rec_added_modified_dt_cte AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CAST(acs_con.<Date Added> AS timestamp)) AS rec_added_dt, 
        MAX(CAST(acs_con.<Date Modified> AS timestamp)) AS rec_modified_dt 
    FROM <[Acquia].[acs_contacts_bulk].{fulfillment}> AS acs_con
),
replication_dt AS (
    SELECT
        GREATEST(ramc.rec_added_dt, COALESCE(ramc.rec_modified_dt,ramc.rec_added_dt)) AS acs_replication_date
    FROM rec_added_modified_dt_cte AS ramc
),
-- Get all the contacts which aren't soft deleted yet
acs_contacts AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(acs_con.<EAB Contact ID> AS varchar(50)) AS eab_contact_id,
        CAST(acs_con.<ACS Contact ID> AS int) AS acs_contact_id,
        CAST(acs_con.<Email> AS varchar(64)) AS email,
        TRY_CAST(acs_con.<First Name> AS varchar(64)) AS first_name,
        CAST(acs_con.<Last Name> AS varchar(64)) AS last_name,
        CAST(acs_con.<Is Deleted> AS boolean) AS is_deleted,
		CAST(acs_con.<Date Added> AS timestamp) AS rec_added_dt
    FROM <[Acquia].[acs_contacts_bulk].{fulfillment}> AS acs_con
	WHERE (acs_con.is_deleted IS NULL OR acs_con.is_deleted = false OR (acs_con.is_deleted = true AND (acs_con.is_deleted_reason IS NULL OR acs_con.is_deleted_reason <> 'GDPR'))) -- record is not yet set to is_deleted = true

),
-- Get the tenant_guid
tenant_guid_cte AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        log_del.tenant_guid
    FROM  <[PDP_UG].[log__deletion_request_identifiers].{fulfillment}> AS log_del
)

SELECT
    tgc.tenant_guid AS es_partner_id,
    ac.eab_contact_id,
    ac.email,
    TO_VARCHAR(CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(replication_dt.acs_replication_date AS STRING),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF'),' ','T'),'.',0),'+00:00')) AS acs_replication_date,
    '1' AS is_deleted,
    TO_VARCHAR(CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('America/New_York', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()),' ','T'),'.',0),'+00:00')) AS is_deleted_dt,
    'GDPR' AS is_deleted_reason
FROM acs_contacts AS ac
INNER JOIN es_pdp_common.common.REF__DELETION_REQUESTS AS del_req
        ON del_req.contact_identifier_hash = MD5(LOWER(CONCAT(COALESCE(CAST(ac.email AS VARCHAR),''), COALESCE(CAST(ac.first_name AS VARCHAR),''), COALESCE(CAST(ac.last_name AS VARCHAR),''))))
       AND LOWER(del_req.mes_business_line) = 'e360'
       AND (del_req.voided_dt IS NULL AND del_req.voided_by IS NULL AND del_req.void_source IS NULL) -- GDPR request for the contact_identifier_hash is not reverted/voided
	   AND DATE(del_req.CREATE_DT) >= CURRENT_DATE - 30
	   AND DATE(del_req.CREATE_DT) > ac.rec_added_dt -- Set as soft delete only if the contact in ACS is created before we had the GDPR request
CROSS JOIN replication_dt
CROSS JOIN tenant_guid_cte AS tgc

 CTS.sourcecontact_id ,

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
select distinct  
	NULLIF(TRIM(Con.first_name), '')   as   firstname ,  
	NULLIF(TRIM(Con.last_name), '')   as   lastname ,  
	TRIM(Con.email_address)   as   email ,
	case when Lower(SCCA.country) = 'united states' AND scca.cass_success_ind = true AND
	(
	  CONCAT
		(
		COALESCE(Con.first_name,''),
		COALESCE(Con.last_name,''),
		COALESCE(SCCA.addr_1,''),
		COALESCE(SCCA.addr_2,''),
		COALESCE(SCCA.city,''),
		COALESCE(state_translation.eabstandard_value,''),
		COALESCE(SCCA.country,''),
		COALESCE(SCCA.ZIP5,''),
		COALESCE(SCCA.zip4,''),
		COALESCE(CAST(Con.phone_number as varchar),'')
		) REGEXP '.*[^[:ascii:]].*') = FALSE
	then scca.addr_1 else null end   as   address1,
	--case when Lower(SCCA.country) = 'united states' then NULLIF(TRIM(SCCA.ADDR_1), '') else null end   as   address1 ,  
	case when Lower(SCCA.country) = 'united states' then NULLIF(TRIM(SCCA.ADDR_2), '') else null end   as   address2 ,  
	case when Lower(SCCA.country) = 'united states' then NULLIF(TRIM(SCCA.city), '') else null end   as   city ,  
	case when Lower(SCCA.country) = 'united states' then NULLIF(TRIM(state_translation.eabstandard_value), '') else null end   as   state ,  
	TRIM(case when INITCAP(SCCA.country) = 'Unknown' or lower(SCCA.country) = 'unmapped value' then null else SCCA.country end)   as   country ,  
	CASE 
		WHEN NULLIF(SCCA.zip5,'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(SCCA.zip4,'') IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(CONCAT(SCCA.zip5,'-' ,SCCA.zip4) AS varchar(64))
		WHEN NULLIF(SCCA.zip5,'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(SCCA.zip4,'') IS NULL THEN CAST(SCCA.zip5 as varchar(64))
    	ELSE CAST(SCCA.POSTAL_CD as varchar(64))
	END AS zipcode,
	--TRIM(case when Lower(SCCA.country) = 'united states' then SCCA.ZIP5 else null end)   as   zipcode ,  
	TRIM(SCCA.CREATE_DT)   as   CREATE_DTS ,  
	TRIM(Con.phone_number)   as   mobile ,  
	TRIM(Con.distance_from_campus)   as   dist_from_campus_calc ,  
	TRIM(AC.is_deleted)   as   is_deleted ,  
	TRIM(race_stdz.race)   as   race_stdzd ,  
	TRIM(Con.ethnicity)   as   ethnicity_stdzd ,

/*	CASE WHEN AC.ACS_REPLICATION_DATE IS NULL THEN NULL
		ELSE TRIM(ac_blnd.academic_interest_blnd)  
	END as   academic_field_intrst_bln , 
*/
	NULL as academic_field_intrst_bln, --Nulling to unblock invalid academic interests
	TRIM(Con.contact_key)   as   eab_contact_id ,  
	NULLIF(TRIM(Con.contact_type_calc), '')   as   eab_contact_type ,  
	INITCAP(NULLIF(TRIM(Con.funnel_status_calc), ''))   as   funnel_stage_calc ,  
	TRIM(AC.student_application_status)   as   student_app_status ,  
	TRIM(AC.form_student_first_name)   as   form_student_first_name ,  
	TRIM(AC.form_student_last_name)   as   form_student_last_name ,  
	TRIM(AC.form_parent_first_name)   as   form_parent_first_name ,  
	TRIM(AC.form_parent_last_name)   as   form_parent_last_name ,  
	TRIM(AC.form_parent_email)   as   form_parent_email ,  
	TRIM(AC.form_referred_by_EAB_ID)   as   form_referred_by_EAB_ID ,  
	TRIM(label.source_label)   as   og_contact_source_calc ,  
	TRIM(all_source.all_sources_blnd)   as   all_sources_blnd ,  
	TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_NAME)   as   form_h_school_name ,  
	TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_ADDR)   as   form_h_school_addr ,  
	TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_CITY)   as   form_h_school_city ,  
	TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_STATEPROV)   as   form_h_school_stateprov ,  
	TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_POST_CODE)   as   form_h_school_post_code ,  
	TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_COUNTRY)   as   form_h_school_country ,  
	TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_GRAD_YEAR)   as   form_h_school_grad_year ,

	TRIM(max_values.psat_max)   as   max_psat_score_rng_calc ,  
	TRIM(max_values.preact_max)   as   max_preact_score_rng_calc ,  
	null   as   fafsa_submit_date_partner ,

	TRIM(xwalk.print_display_id)   as   print_display_id ,

	TRIM(AC.Form_Student_City)   as   FORM_STUDENT_CITY ,  
	TRIM(AC.Form_Student_Stateprov)   as   form_student_stateprov ,  
	TRIM(AC.Form_Student_Post_Code)   as   form_student_post_code ,  
	TRIM(AC.Form_Student_Country)   as   form_student_country ,  
	TRIM(AC.Form_Sms_Opt_In)   as   form_sms_opt_in ,  
	TRIM(AC.Engaged_Inq_Cmpgn_Acsl)   as   engaged_inq_cmpgn_acsl ,  
	TRIM(AC.Engaged_Reeng_Cmpgn_Acsl)   as   engaged_reeng_cmpgn_acsl ,  
	TRIM(parent.FIRST_NAME)   as   child_first_name_calc ,  
	TRIM(parent.LAST_NAME)   as   child_last_name_calc ,  
	TRIM(case when Con.suppress_mail_ind = 1 then 'Y' else 'N' end)   as   do_not_direct_mail_calc ,  
	case when lower(optin_sms_indicator) = 'false' then 'false' when lower(optin_sms_indicator) = 'true' then 'true' else null end   as   sms_opt_in_calc ,  
	TRIM(case when Con.suppress_email_ind = 1 then 'TRUE' else 'FALSE' end)   as   dnc_email ,  
	null   as   dnc_email_comment ,  
	PHN.optin_sms_indicator ,  
	case when Con.contact_type_calc = 'Parent/Guardian' then parent.stu_hs_grade_level_calc else Con.current_grade_level end   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  
	TRIM(Con.grad_year)   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,  
	null   as   student_funnel_stage_calc ,  
	INITCAP(NULLIF(TRIM(parent.student_funnel_stage_calc), ''))   as   stu_funnel_stage_calc ,  
	TRIM(AC.student_application_status)   as   stu_eab_app_status ,  
/*
	CASE WHEN AC.ACS_REPLICATION_DATE IS NULL THEN NULL 
		ELSE TRIM(ac_blnd.academic_interest_blnd)
	END as   stu_aca_field_intrst_blnd , 
*/
	NULL AS stu_aca_field_intrst_blnd,
	TRIM(race_stdz.race)   as   stu_race_stdzd ,
	TRIM(Con.ethnicity)   as   stu_ethnicity_stdzd ,

	case when Con.contact_type_calc = 'Parent/Guardian' then parent.high_school_grad_year_calculated else Con.grad_year end   as   stu_hs_grad_year_calc ,  
	ac.eng_app_par_gen_acsl   as   eng_app_par_gen_acsl ,

	ac.eng_cul_par_nur_acsl   as   eng_cul_par_nur_acsl ,  
	ac.eng_cul_stu_inq_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_inq_acsl ,  
	ac.eng_cul_stu_paper_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_paper_acsl ,  
	ac.eng_cul_stu_nur_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_nur_acsl ,  
	ac.eng_cul_stu_reen_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_reen_acsl ,  
	ac.eng_cul_stu_j_reen_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_j_reen_acsl ,  
	ac.eng_cul_stu_sms_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_sms_acsl ,  
	ac.st_dt_app_par_gen_acsl   as   st_dt_app_par_gen_acsl ,  
	ac.st_dt_app_stu_gen_acsl   as   st_dt_app_stu_gen_acsl ,  
	ac.st_dt_app_stu_paper_acsl   as   st_dt_app_stu_paper_acsl ,  
	ac.st_dt_cul_par_inq_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_par_inq_acsl ,  
	ac.st_dt_cul_par_nur_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_par_nur_acsl ,  
	ac.st_dt_cul_stu_inq_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_stu_inq_acsl ,

left join PDP.add__sourcecontact_clean_addr as SCCA on Con.CLEAN_ADDR_KEY = SCCA.CLEAN_ADDR_KEY

	where  Lower(a.attribute_type) = 'academic_interest'
	group by   a.contact_key 
) as ac_blnd 
	on Con.contact_key = ac_blnd.contact_key 
left join (
	select   
		a.contact_key ,  
		a.sourcecontact_id ,  
		LISTAGG(a.eab_std_value, '|')   as   race 
	from   
	(
		select  distinct  
			b.contact_key ,  
			b.sourcecontact_id ,  
			b.eab_std_value ,  
			b.attribute_type 
		from   PDP.con__contact_attributes_combined as b 
	) as a 
	where  Lower(a.attribute_type) = 'race'
	group by   a.contact_key, a.sourcecontact_id 
) as race_stdz 
	on Con.contact_key = race_stdz.contact_key 
	and Con.active_sourcecontact_id = race_stdz.sourcecontact_id 
left join (
	select   
		list_sources.contact_key ,  
		LISTAGG(list_sources.all_source_bln_list_agg, '|')   as   all_sources_blnd 
	from   
	(
		select   
			contact_key ,  
			case when lower(intake_type_label) = 'prenames' then 'Migrated Contact' else null end   as   all_source_bln_list_agg 
		from   PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts as CSCS 
		left join pdp.crf__intake_type as intake 
			on CSCS.source_type_key = intake.intake_type_key 
		where  LOWER(CSCS.active_ind) = 'true' and lower(intake_type_label) = 'prenames'
 
		UNION 

		select  distinct  
			contact_key ,  source_label   as   all_source_bln_list_agg 
		from   PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts as CSCS 
		inner join pdp.crf__source as srctype 
			on CSCS.source_key = srctype.source_key 
		where  LOWER(CSCS.active_ind) = 'true'
	) as list_sources 
	group by   list_sources.contact_key 
) as all_source 
	on Con.contact_key = all_source.contact_key 
left join (
	select   
		con3.first_name ,  
		con3.last_name ,  
		con3.parent_contact_key ,  
		con3.student_contact_key ,  
		con3.stu_hs_grade_level_calc   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  
		con3.high_school_grad_year_calculated   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,  
		con3.student_funnel_stage_calc   as   student_funnel_stage_calc 
	from   (
	
		select  distinct  
			con2.first_name ,  
			con2.last_name ,  
			con2.parent_contact_key ,  
			con2.student_contact_key ,  
			con2.stu_hs_grade_level_calc   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  
			con2.high_school_grad_year_calculated   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,  
			con2.student_funnel_stage_calc   as   student_funnel_stage_calc ,  
			row_number() over (partition by con2.parent_contact_key order by  con2.sourcecontact_intake_dt   ASC )   as   rankid2 
		from   (
			select  distinct  
				rel.parent_contact_key ,  
				rel.student_contact_key ,  
				scst.create_date   as   sourcecontact_intake_dt ,  
				con1.current_grade_level   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  
				con1.grad_year   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,  
				con1.first_name ,  
				con1.last_name ,  
				con1.funnel_status_calc   as   student_funnel_stage_calc ,  
				row_number() over (partition by rel.parent_contact_key order by  int.INTAKE_PRIORITY   ASC )   as   rankid 
			from   PDP.con__contact_assigned as con 
			inner join PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts as src 
				on con.contact_key = src.contact_key 
			inner join pdp.crf__intake_type as int 
				on int.intake_type_key = src.source_type_key 
			inner join  <[Partner_Data_Platform].[SourceContact SourceType]>  as scst 
				on src.sourcecontact_id = scst.source_contact_id 
			left join PDP.con__contact_relations as rel 
				on rel.parent_contact_key = con.contact_key 
			left join PDP.con__contact_assigned as con1 
				on rel.student_contact_key = con1.contact_key 
			where  con.contact_type_calc = 'Parent/Guardian'
		) as con2 
		where  rankid = 1
	) as con3 
	where  rankid2 = 1
) as parent 
	on Con.contact_key = parent.parent_contact_key 
left join 
(
	select   
		sub_1.contact_key ,  
		sub_1.source_label   as   source_label 
	from   (
		select   
			ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by contact_key order by  CSCTS.create_dt   ASC )   as   row_id ,  
			CSCTS.contact_key ,  
			srctype.source_label 
		from   PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts as CSCTS 
		inner join pdp.crf__source as srctype 
			on CSCTS.source_key = srctype.source_key 
	) as sub_1 
	where  row_id = 1
) as label 
	on Con.contact_key = label.contact_key 
inner join PDP.prc__partner_details as PD  
where  (NULLIF(TRIM(Con.contact_type_calc), '') in ('Student', 'Parent/Guardian', 'Ride Along', 'Deliverability Seed') 
and ((TRIM(label.source_label) is not null and TRIM(all_source.all_sources_blnd) is not null)) 
and lower(Con.email_address) not like '%test.eab.com') 
and Con.email_address not in ('naina.dhawan.449@k12.friscoisd.org', 'alyssa.viteri11@gmail.com', 'vicagomez13@gmail.com','aliaalrusan@gmail.com') 
or (
	NULLIF(TRIM(Con.contact_type_calc), '') in ('Deliverability Seed', 'Ride Along') 
	and TRIM(all_source.all_sources_blnd) is null 
	and lower(Con.email_address) not like '%test.eab.com'
)

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

select  distinct  rel.parent_contact_key ,  rel.student_contact_key ,  scst.create_date   as   sourcecontact_intake_dt ,  con1.current_grade_level   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  con1. grad_year   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,  
con1. first_name ,  con1.last_name ,  con1. funnel_status_calc   as   student_funnel_stage_calc ,  row_number() over (partition by rel.parent_contact_key order by  int.INTAKE_PRIORITY   ASC )   as   rankid 
 from    PDP.con__contact_assigned  as con inner join  PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts  as src on con.contact_key  = src.contact_key  inner join pdp.crf__intake_type as int on int.intake_type_key = src.source_type_key inner join  <[Partner_Data_Platform].[SourceContact SourceType]>  as scst on src.sourcecontact_id = scst.source_contact_id  left join  PDP.con__contact_relations  as rel on rel.parent_contact_key = con.contact_key left join  PDP.con__contact_assigned  as con1 on rel.student_contact_key = con1.contact_key

) as con2

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

from    PDP.con__contact_assigned  as Con left join   PDP.add__sourcecontact_clean_addr as SCCA on Con.CLEAN_ADDR_KEY = SCCA.CLEAN_ADDR_KEY left join  PDP.prc__contact_acquia_xwalk  as CAC on Con. contact_key = CAC. contact_key  left join   PDP.acs__contacts  as AC on CAC.acs_contact_id = AC.acs_contact_id left join  <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Phone]>  as PHN on PHN.phone_number = Con.phone_number  left join (
select   Con.FIRST_NAME ,  Con.LAST_NAME ,  Con.CONTACT_KEY
from    PDP.con__contact_assigned  as Con left join  PDP.con__contact_relations  as d on Con.CONTACT_KEY = d.student_contact_key
where  initcap(Con.contact_type_calc ) = 'Parent/Guardian'
) as child_names on child_names.CONTACT_KEY = Con.CONTACT_KEY left join (
select   CTS_PIVOT.contact_key   as   contact_key ,
CTS_PIVOT.sourcecontact_id   as   sourcecontact_id ,
max(sat_max)   as   sat_max ,  max(act_max)   as   act_max ,  max(psat_max)   as   psat_max ,  max(preact_max)   as   preact_max
from   (

select   CTS. contact_key   as   contact_key ,
 CTS.sourcecontact_id ,
 case when UPPER(CTS. test_type) = 'SAT' then CTS. score_range_max  else null end   as   sat_max ,
 case when UPPER(CTS. test_type) = 'ACT' then CTS. score_range_max else null end   as   act_max ,  case when UPPER(CTS. test_type) = 'PSAT' then CTS. score_range_max  else null end   as   psat_max ,  case when UPPER(CTS. test_type) = 'PREACT' then CTS. score_range_max  else null end   as   preact_max
from    PDP.con__contact_test_scores  as CTS
) as CTS_PIVOT
group by   CTS_PIVOT.contact_key,
CTS_PIVOT.sourcecontact_id
) as max_values on Con.contact_key = max_values.contact_key
and Con.active_sourcecontact_id = max_values.sourcecontact_id
left join  <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Sourcecontact Sourcetype]>  as srccontact_srctype on srccontact_srctype. <Source Contact ID>  = Con.active_sourcecontact_id left join pdp.crf__intake_type as srctype on srccontact_srctype. <Source Type Key>  = srctype.intake_type_key left outer join es_pdp_common.common.common_source_standard_mappings as state_translation on UPPER(state_translation.source_type) = 'GENERAL' and Upper(state_translation.Category) = 'STATE' and Lower(state_translation.SOURCE_FIELD_NAME) = 'state' and lower(state_translation.eabstandard_value) = lower(SCCA.state ) /*and lower(state_translation.source_description) = lower(SCCA.country )*/ left join (
select   a.contact_key ,  LISTAGG(a.eab_std_value , '|')   as   academic_interest_blnd
from   (
select  distinct  b.contact_key ,  b.eab_std_value ,  b.attribute_type
from   PDP.con__contact_attributes_combined  as b
) as a
where  Lower(a.attribute_type) = 'academic_interest'
group by   a.contact_key
) as ac_blnd on Con.contact_key  = ac_blnd.contact_key left join (
select   a.contact_key ,  a.sourcecontact_id ,  LISTAGG(a.eab_std_value , '|')   as   race
from   (
select  distinct  b.contact_key ,  b.sourcecontact_id ,  b.eab_std_value,  b.attribute_type
from    PDP.con__contact_attributes_combined  as b
) as a
where  Lower(a.attribute_type) = 'race'
group by   a.contact_key, a.sourcecontact_id
) as race_stdz on Con.contact_key  = race_stdz.contact_key and Con.active_sourcecontact_id = race_stdz.sourcecontact_id left join (
select   list_sources.contact_key ,  LISTAGG(list_sources.all_source_bln_list_agg, '|')   as   all_sources_blnd
from   (
select   contact_key ,  case when lower(intake_type_label) = 'prenames' then 'Migrated Contact' else null end   as   all_source_bln_list_agg
from    PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts  as CSCS left join pdp.crf__intake_type as intake on CSCS.source_type_key = intake.intake_type_key
where  LOWER(CSCS.active_ind) = 'true' and lower(intake_type_label) = 'prenames'

 UNION
select  distinct  contact_key ,  source_label   as   all_source_bln_list_agg
from    PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts  as CSCS inner join pdp.crf__source as srctype on CSCS.source_key  = srctype.source_key
where  LOWER(CSCS.active_ind) = 'true'
) as list_sources
group by   list_sources.contact_key
) as all_source on Con.contact_key  = all_source.contact_key left join (
select   con3.first_name ,  con3.last_name ,  con3.parent_contact_key ,  con3.student_contact_key ,  con3.stu_hs_grade_level_calc   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  con3.high_school_grad_year_calculated   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,  con3.student_funnel_stage_calc   as   student_funnel_stage_calc
from   (
select  distinct  con2.first_name ,  con2.last_name ,  con2.parent_contact_key ,  con2.student_contact_key ,  con2.stu_hs_grade_level_calc   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  con2.high_school_grad_year_calculated   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,  con2.student_funnel_stage_calc   as   student_funnel_stage_calc ,  row_number() over (partition by con2.parent_contact_key order by  con2.sourcecontact_intake_dt   ASC )   as   rankid2
from   (
select  distinct  rel.parent_contact_key ,  rel.student_contact_key ,  scst.create_date   as   sourcecontact_intake_dt ,  con1.current_grade_level   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  con1. grad_year   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,
con1. first_name ,  con1.last_name ,  con1. funnel_status_calc   as   student_funnel_stage_calc ,  row_number() over (partition by rel.parent_contact_key order by  int.INTAKE_PRIORITY   ASC )   as   rankid
 from    PDP.con__contact_assigned  as con inner join  PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts  as src on con.contact_key  = src.contact_key  inner join pdp.crf__intake_type as int on int.intake_type_key = src.source_type_key inner join  <[Partner_Data_Platform].[SourceContact SourceType]>  as scst on src.sourcecontact_id = scst.source_contact_id  left join  PDP.con__contact_relations  as rel on rel.parent_contact_key = con.contact_key left join  PDP.con__contact_assigned  as con1 on rel.student_contact_key = con1.contact_key
where  con.contact_type_calc = 'Parent/Guardian'
) as con2
where  rankid = 1
) as con3
where  rankid2 = 1
) as parent on Con.contact_key  = parent.parent_contact_key left join (
select   sub_1.contact_key ,  sub_1.source_label   as   source_label
from   (
select   ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by contact_key order by  CSCTS.create_dt   ASC )   as   row_id ,  CSCTS.contact_key ,  srctype.source_label
from    PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts  as CSCTS inner join pdp.crf__source as srctype on CSCTS.source_key  = srctype.source_key
) as sub_1
where  row_id = 1
) as label on Con.contact_key = label.contact_key inner join  PDP.prc__partner_details  as PD

 where (
   NULLIF(TRIM(Con.contact_type_calc ), '')   in  ('Student','Parent/Guardian', 'Ride Along','Deliverability Seed')
   and ((TRIM(label.source_label) is not null and TRIM(all_source.all_sources_blnd) is not null)) 
   and lower(Con.email_address ) not like '%test.eab.com'  and lower(Con.email_address ) not in ('walthallayaan@gmail.com', 'vicagomez13@gmail.com'
,'charyshmaree254@gmail.com') and Con.contact_key not in ('b3988cb8-c6cf-49cc-8a24-174c3427ad6d',
'427c21ba-0f7d-48df-a4b3-5beaa4e875a1')	) or (NULLIF(TRIM(Con.contact_type_calc ), '') in ('Deliverability Seed', 'Ride Along') 
																	and TRIM(all_source.all_sources_blnd) is null and lower(Con.email_address ) not like '%test.eab.com')

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

) as race_stdz on Con.contact_key  = race_stdz.contact_key and Con.active_sourcecontact_id = race_stdz.sourcecontact_id left join (
select   list_sources.contact_key ,  LISTAGG(list_sources.all_source_bln_list_agg, '|')   as   all_sources_blnd
from   (

 UNION

from   (
select  distinct  rel.parent_contact_key ,  rel.student_contact_key ,  scst.create_date   as   sourcecontact_intake_dt ,  con1.current_grade_level   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  con1. grad_year   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,
con1. first_name ,  con1.last_name ,  con1. funnel_status_calc   as   student_funnel_stage_calc ,  row_number() over (partition by rel.parent_contact_key order by  int.INTAKE_PRIORITY   ASC )   as   rankid
 from    PDP.con__contact_assigned  as con inner join  PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts  as src on con.contact_key  = src.contact_key  inner join pdp.crf__intake_type as int on int.intake_type_key = src.source_type_key inner join  <[Partner_Data_Platform].[SourceContact SourceType]>  as scst on src.sourcecontact_id = scst.source_contact_id  left join  PDP.con__contact_relations  as rel on rel.parent_contact_key = con.contact_key left join  PDP.con__contact_assigned  as con1 on rel.student_contact_key = con1.contact_key
where  con.contact_type_calc = 'Parent/Guardian'
) as con2
where  rankid = 1

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
/*Changes made by Shruti-
Adding filter for contact_type, fix for missing state values and missing stu_hs_grad_level calc and stu_hs_grad_year values and making it swap compliant
ESDP 746, 747, 692 , 757
-- made changes to populate partner_id from school_panto_id to school_panto_guid
-- Made changes to Null out the international addresses
*/



select  distinct  
NULLIF(TRIM(Con.first_name), '')   as   firstname ,  
NULLIF(TRIM(Con.last_name), '')   as   lastname ,  
TRIM(Con.email_address )   as   email ,
case when Lower(SCCA.country) = 'united states' AND scca.cass_success_ind = true AND
(
	CONCAT(
	  COALESCE(Con.first_name,''),
	  COALESCE(Con.last_name,''),
	  COALESCE(SCCA.addr_1,''),
	  COALESCE(SCCA.addr_2,''),
	  COALESCE(SCCA.city,''),
	  COALESCE(state_translation.eabstandard_value,''),
	  COALESCE(SCCA.country,''),
	  COALESCE(SCCA.ZIP5,''),
	  COALESCE(SCCA.zip4,''),
	  COALESCE(CAST(Con.phone_number as varchar),'')
	  ) REGEXP '.*[^[:ascii:]].*') = FALSE
then scca.addr_1 else null end   as   address1,
--Case When Lower(SCCA.country ) = 'united states' Then NULLIF(TRIM(SCCA.ADDR_1), '') Else Null End as   address1 ,
Case When Lower(SCCA.country ) = 'united states'
     Then NULLIF(TRIM(SCCA.ADDR_2), '') 
	 Else Null
	 End as   address2 , 
Case When Lower(SCCA.country ) = 'united states'
     Then NULLIF(TRIM(SCCA. city ), '') 
	 Else Null
	 End as   city ,  
Case When Lower(SCCA.country ) = 'united states'
     Then NULLIF(TRIM(state_translation.eabstandard_value), '')  
	 Else Null
	 End as   state ,
 TRIM(case when INITCAP(SCCA.country ) = 'Unknown' or lower(SCCA.country ) = 'unmapped value' then null else SCCA.country  end)   as   country ,
 CASE 
		WHEN NULLIF(SCCA.zip5,'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(SCCA.zip4,'') IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(CONCAT(SCCA.zip5,'-' ,SCCA.zip4) AS varchar(64))
		WHEN NULLIF(SCCA.zip5,'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(SCCA.zip4,'') IS NULL THEN CAST(SCCA.zip5 as varchar(64))
    	ELSE CAST(SCCA.POSTAL_CD as varchar(64))
 END AS zipcode,
 --TRIM(case when Lower(SCCA.country ) = 'united states' then SCCA.ZIP5 else null end)   as   zipcode ,  
 TRIM(SCCA.CREATE_DT)   as   CREATE_DTS ,
 TRIM(Con.phone_number )   as   mobile ,  TRIM(Con.distance_from_campus)   as   dist_from_campus_calc ,  TRIM(AC.is_deleted) as is_deleted ,  TRIM(race_stdz.race)   as   race_stdzd
 ,  TRIM(Con.ethnicity )   as   ethnicity_stdzd ,  null   as   religion_partner ,  TRIM(ac_blnd.academic_interest_blnd)   as   academic_field_intrst_bln ,
 TRIM(Con. contact_key)   as   eab_contact_id ,  NULLIF(TRIM(Con.contact_type_calc ), '')   as   eab_contact_type ,  INITCAP(NULLIF(TRIM(Con.funnel_status_calc ), ''))
 as   funnel_stage_calc ,  TRIM(AC.student_application_status )   as   student_app_status ,  TRIM(AC.form_student_first_name )   as   form_student_first_name ,
 TRIM(AC. form_student_last_name )   as   form_student_last_name ,  TRIM(AC.form_parent_first_name )   as   form_parent_first_name ,  TRIM(AC. form_parent_last_name)
 as   form_parent_last_name ,  TRIM(AC.form_parent_email)   as   form_parent_email ,  TRIM(AC.form_referred_by_EAB_ID )   as   form_referred_by_EAB_ID ,  TRIM(label.source_label)   as   og_contact_source_calc ,  TRIM(all_source.all_sources_blnd)   as   all_sources_blnd ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_NAME)   as   form_h_school_name ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_ADDR)   as   form_h_school_addr ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_CITY)   as   form_h_school_city ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_STATEPROV)   as   form_h_school_stateprov ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_POST_CODE)   as   form_h_school_post_code ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_COUNTRY)   as   form_h_school_country ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_GRAD_YEAR)   as   form_h_school_grad_year ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_ENTRY_YEAR)   as   form_entry_year ,  TRIM(Con.current_grade_level)   as   h_school_grade_level_calc ,  TRIM(Con.grad_year)   as   h_school_grad_year_calc ,  TRIM(max_values.sat_max)   as   max_sat_score_rng_calc ,  CTS.sourcecontact_id ,

from   (
select  distinct  b.contact_key ,  b.eab_std_value ,  b.attribute_type
from   PDP.con__contact_attributes_combined  as b

group by   a.contact_key
) as ac_blnd on Con.contact_key  = ac_blnd.contact_key left join (

from    PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts  as CSCS left join pdp.crf__intake_type as intake on CSCS.source_type_key = intake.intake_type_key
where  LOWER(CSCS.active_ind) = 'true' and lower(intake_type_label) = 'prenames'

 UNION

) as list_sources

) as all_source on Con.contact_key  = all_source.contact_key left join (
select   con3.first_name ,  con3.last_name ,  con3.parent_contact_key ,  con3.student_contact_key ,  con3.stu_hs_grade_level_calc   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  con3.high_school_grad_year_calculated   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,  con3.student_funnel_stage_calc   as   student_funnel_stage_calc
from   (
select  distinct  con2.first_name ,  con2.last_name ,  con2.parent_contact_key ,  con2.student_contact_key ,  con2.stu_hs_grade_level_calc   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  con2.high_school_grad_year_calculated   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,  con2.student_funnel_stage_calc   as   student_funnel_stage_calc ,  row_number() over (partition by con2.parent_contact_key order by  con2.sourcecontact_intake_dt   ASC )   as   rankid2
from   (
select  distinct  rel.parent_contact_key ,  rel.student_contact_key ,  scst.create_date   as   sourcecontact_intake_dt ,  con1.current_grade_level   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  con1. grad_year   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,
con1. first_name ,  con1.last_name ,  con1. funnel_status_calc   as   student_funnel_stage_calc ,  row_number() over (partition by rel.parent_contact_key order by  int.INTAKE_PRIORITY   ASC )   as   rankid
 from    PDP.con__contact_assigned  as con inner join  PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts  as src on con.contact_key  = src.contact_key  inner join pdp.crf__intake_type as int on int.intake_type_key = src.source_type_key inner join  <[Partner_Data_Platform].[SourceContact SourceType]>  as scst on src.sourcecontact_id = scst.source_contact_id  left join  PDP.con__contact_relations  as rel on rel.parent_contact_key = con.contact_key left join  PDP.con__contact_assigned  as con1 on rel.student_contact_key = con1.contact_key
where  con.contact_type_calc = 'Parent/Guardian'
) as con2
where  rankid = 1
) as con3
where  rankid2 = 1
) as parent on Con.contact_key  = parent.parent_contact_key left join (

from    PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts  as CSCTS inner join pdp.crf__source as srctype on CSCTS.source_key  = srctype.source_key
) as sub_1

) as label on Con.contact_key = label.contact_key inner join  PDP.prc__partner_details  as PD

 where (NULLIF(TRIM(Con.contact_type_calc ), '')   in  ('Student','Parent/Guardian', 'Ride Along','Deliverability Seed')and ((TRIM(label.source_label) is not null and TRIM(all_source.all_sources_blnd) is not null)) and lower(Con.email_address ) not like '%test.eab.com') and Con.email_address not in ('emilyalejandro10@gmail.com', '...@gmail.com') or (NULLIF(TRIM(Con.contact_type_calc ), '') in ('Deliverability Seed', 'Ride Along') and TRIM(all_source.all_sources_blnd) is null and lower(Con.email_address ) not like '%test.eab.com')

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
with results as
(
select t.* ,row_number() over(partition by t.firstname order by t.firstname) rn from (
  
  select distinct
NULLIF(TRIM(Con.<First Name>), '') as firstname,
NULLIF(TRIM(Con.<Last Name>), '') as lastname,
TRIM(Con.<Email Address>) as email,
NULLIF(TRIM(SCCA.ADDR_1), '') as address1,
NULLIF(TRIM(SCCA.ADDR_2), '') as address2,
NULLIF(TRIM(SCCA.<City>), '') as city,
NULLIF(TRIM(state_translation.eabstandard_value), '') as state, 
TRIM(replace (Case when SCCA.<Country>='Unknown' then NULL else SCCA.<Country> end , char(10),'')) as country,
TRIM(Case when Lower(SCCA.<Country>)='united states' then SCCA.ZIP5 else NULL end) as zipcode,
TRIM(SCCA.CREATE_DT) as CREATE_DTS,
TRIM(Con.<Phone Number>) as mobile, 
TRIM(Con.<Distance from Campus>) as dist_from_campus_calc,
TRIM(AC.<Is Deleted>) as is_deleted,
TRIM(race_stdz.race) as race_stdzd,
TRIM(Con.<Ethnicity>) as ethnicity_stdzd,
TRIM(Con.<Religion>) as religion_partner,
TRIM(ac_blnd.academic_interest_blnd) as academic_field_intrst_blnd, 
TRIM(Con.<Contact Key>) as eab_contact_id,
NULLIF(TRIM(Con.<Contact Type>), '')  as  eab_contact_type,
NULLIF(TRIM(Con.<Funnel Status Calc>), '') as funnel_stage_calc,
TRIM(AC.<Student Application Status>) as student_application_status,
TRIM(AC.<Form Student First Name>) as form_student_first_name,
TRIM(AC.<Form Student Last Name>) as form_student_last_name,
TRIM(AC.<Form Parent First Name>) as form_parent_first_name,
TRIM(AC.<Form Parent Last Name>) as form_parent_last_name,
TRIM(AC.<Form Parent Email>) as form_parent_email,
TRIM(AC.<Form Referred By EAB ID>) as form_referred_by_EAB_ID,
TRIM(label.source_type_label)  as first_source_calc, 
TRIM(all_source.all_sources_blnd) as all_sources_blnd, 
TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_NAME) as form_h_school_name,
TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_ADDR) as form_h_school_addr,
TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_CITY) as form_h_school_city,
TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_STATEPROV) as form_h_school_stateprov,
TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_POST_CODE) as form_h_school_post_code,
TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_COUNTRY) as form_h_school_country,
TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_GRAD_YEAR	) as form_h_school_grad_year,
TRIM(AC.FORM_ENTRY_YEAR) as form_entry_year,
NULL grade_level, -- current_grade_level from contact
TRIM(Con.graduation_year) as h_school_grad_year_calc, 
TRIM(max_values.sat_max) as max_sat_score_calc,
TRIM(max_values.act_max) as max_act_score_calc,
TRIM(max_values.psat_max) as max_psat_score_calc,
TRIM(max_values.preact_max) as max_preact_score_calc,
TRIM(Con.<Fafsa Submitted Dt>) as fafsa_submit_date_partner,
TRIM(con.concontact_rand) as random_number,
TRIM(AC.FORM_BOT_HONEYPOT) as form_bot_honeypot,
TRIM(AC.ACS_REPLICATION_DT) as acs_replication_dt,
TRIM(CAC.<Print Display ID>) as print_display_id,
TRIM(PD.school_panto_id ) as es_partner_id 

from
<[Partner_Data_Platform].[Contact]> as Con 
 Left join  <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Contact Address Clean]> as SCCA 
 on con.CLEAN_ADDR_KEY=SCCA.CLEAN_ADDR_KEY
--AND SCCA.ADDR_TYPE='Mailing'--<Address Type>
 Left join <[Partner_Data_Platform].[ACS Contacts]> as AC 
 on con.active_source_contact_id = AC.SOURCECONTACT_ID
Left join <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Contact Acquia Crosswalk]> CAC
on con.<Contact Key> = CAC.<Contact Key>
left join (select CTS_PIVOT.contact_key as contact_key, CTS_PIVOT.sourcecontact_id as sourcecontact_id, max(CTS_PIVOT.sat_max) as sat_max,
max(CTS_PIVOT.act_max) as act_max,
max(CTS_PIVOT.psat_max) as psat_max,
max(CTS_PIVOT.preact_max) as preact_max
from (
select CTS.<Contact Key> as contact_key,CTS.<Source Contact ID> as sourcecontact_id,
case when UPPER(CTS.<Test Type>)='SAT' then CTS.<Score Range Maximum>  else null  end as sat_max, 
case when UPPER(CTS.<Test Type>)='ACT' then CTS.<Score Range Maximum>  else null end as act_max,
case when UPPER(CTS.<Test Type>)='PSAT' then CTS.<Score Range Maximum>  else null  end as psat_max, 
case when UPPER(CTS.<Test Type>)='PREACT' then CTS.<Score Range Maximum>  else null end as preact_max
from <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Contact Test Scores]> as CTS ) as CTS_PIVOT
group by CTS_PIVOT.contact_key,CTS_PIVOT.sourcecontact_id) max_values
on con.<Contact Key> = max_values.contact_key
and con.active_source_contact_id=max_values.sourcecontact_id
left join <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Sourcecontact Sourcetype]> AS srccontact_srctype
ON srccontact_srctype.<Source Contact ID> = con.active_source_contact_id
left JOIN <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Source Type]> AS srctype
ON srccontact_srctype.<Source Type Key> = srctype.<Source Type Key>

LEFT OUTER JOIN es_pdp_common.common.common_source_standard_mappings AS state_translation
ON srctype.<Source Type Label> = state_translation.source_type
AND Upper(state_translation.Category) = 'STATE'
AND Lower(state_translation.SOURCE_FIELD_NAME) = 'state'
AND	state_translation.source_code = SCCA.<State> 

Left join (SELECT  a.contact_key, LISTAGG(a.<EAB standard Value>, '|') as academic_interest_blnd
from ( select distinct b.contact_key, b.<EAB standard Value>,b.attribute_type from <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Contact Attributes Combined]> b 
) a
  where Lower(a.attribute_type) = 'academic_interest'
group by a.contact_key ) ac_blnd
on con.<Contact Key>=ac_blnd.contact_key 

Left join 

(SELECT  a.contact_key, a.source_contact_id, LISTAGG(a.<EAB standard Value>, '|') as race
from ( select distinct b.contact_key, b.source_contact_id,b.<EAB standard Value>,b.attribute_type from <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Contact Attributes Combined]> b 
) a
  where Lower(a.attribute_type) = 'race'
group by a.contact_key, a.source_contact_id ) race_stdz
on con.<Contact Key>=race_stdz.contact_key 
and con.active_source_contact_id=race_stdz.source_contact_id


Left join 

(SELECT a.contact_key , a.source_contact_id ,LISTAGG(a.SOURCE_TYPE_LABEL, '|') as all_sources_blnd,a.ACTIVE_INDICATOR   
 from  (
 SELECT distinct CSCS.contact_key , CSCS.source_contact_id ,srctype.SOURCE_TYPE_LABEL ,CSCS.ACTIVE_INDICATOR 
 from 
 <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Contact Sourcecontacts]> as  CSCS
INNER JOIN <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Source Type]> AS srctype
ON CSCS.<Source Type Key> = srctype.<Source Type Key> ) a
group by a.contact_key, a.source_contact_id,a.SOURCE_TYPE_LABEL,a.ACTIVE_INDICATOR) all_source
on con.<Contact Key>=all_source.contact_key 
and con.active_source_contact_id=all_source.source_contact_id
and Lower(all_source.ACTIVE_INDICATOR)='true' 
LEFT JOIN 
(SELECT 
sub_1.contact_key,
sub_1.source_type_label
FROM

(
	SELECT
	ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY contact_key ORDER BY CSCTS.<Create Date>) as row_id,
	CSCTS.contact_key,
	srctype.source_type_label
	 from 
 <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Contact Sourcecontacts]> as  CSCTS
INNER JOIN <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Source Type]> AS srctype
ON CSCTS.<Source Type Key> = srctype.<Source Type Key> 
) as sub_1
WHERE row_id = 1) label
ON con.<Contact Key>=label.contact_key
inner join <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Partner Details]> as PD  ) as  t ) 
select * from results where results.rn=1

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

	 END)  as dnc_sms_comment,

			  FROM (
					  SELECT  a.<Contact Key> Contact_key, a.<Dummy Email> dummy_email,

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

				  WHERE LOWER(CSCS.active_indicator)= 'true'

			GROUP BY list_sources.contact_key) as all_source
		 
	on Con.<Contact Key>=all_source.contact_key

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
/*Changes made by Shruti-
Adding filter for contact_type, fix for missing state values and missing stu_hs_grad_level calc and stu_hs_grad_year values and making it swap compliant
ESDP 746, 747, 692 , 757
-- Made changes to populate partner_id from school_panto_id to school_panto_guid
-- Made changes to null out addresses for international addresses
*/

select  distinct  NULLIF(TRIM(Con.first_name), '')   as   firstname ,  NULLIF(TRIM(Con.last_name), '')   as   lastname ,  TRIM(Con.email_address )   as   email ,
Case When Lower(SCCA.country ) = 'united states' 
	 Then NULLIF(TRIM(SCCA.ADDR_1), '') 
	 Else Null 
	 End as   address1 ,
Case When Lower(SCCA.country ) = 'united states'
     Then NULLIF(TRIM(SCCA.ADDR_2), '') 
	 Else Null
	 End as   address2 , 
Case When Lower(SCCA.country ) = 'united states'
     Then NULLIF(TRIM(SCCA. city ), '') 
	 Else Null
	 End as   city ,  
Case When Lower(SCCA.country ) = 'united states'
     Then NULLIF(TRIM(state_translation.eabstandard_value), '')  
	 Else Null
	 End as   state ,
 TRIM(case when INITCAP(SCCA.country ) = 'Unknown' or lower(SCCA.country ) = 'unmapped value' then null else SCCA.country  end)   as   country ,
 TRIM(case when Lower(SCCA.country ) = 'united states' then SCCA.ZIP5 else null end)   as   zipcode ,  TRIM(SCCA.CREATE_DT)   as   CREATE_DTS ,
 TRIM(Con.phone_number )   as   mobile ,  TRIM(Con.distance_from_campus)   as   dist_from_campus_calc ,  TRIM(AC.is_deleted) as is_deleted ,  TRIM(race_stdz.race)   as   race_stdzd
 ,  TRIM(Con.ethnicity )   as   ethnicity_stdzd ,  null   as   religion_partner ,  TRIM(ac_blnd.academic_interest_blnd)   as   academic_field_intrst_bln ,
 TRIM(Con. contact_key)   as   eab_contact_id ,  NULLIF(TRIM(Con.contact_type_calc ), '')   as   eab_contact_type ,  INITCAP(NULLIF(TRIM(Con.funnel_status_calc ), ''))
 as   funnel_stage_calc ,  TRIM(AC.student_application_status )   as   student_app_status ,  TRIM(AC.form_student_first_name )   as   form_student_first_name ,
 TRIM(AC. form_student_last_name )   as   form_student_last_name ,  TRIM(AC.form_parent_first_name )   as   form_parent_first_name ,  TRIM(AC. form_parent_last_name)
 as   form_parent_last_name ,  TRIM(AC.form_parent_email)   as   form_parent_email ,  TRIM(AC.form_referred_by_EAB_ID )   as   form_referred_by_EAB_ID ,  TRIM(label.source_label)   as   og_contact_source_calc ,  TRIM(all_source.all_sources_blnd)   as   all_sources_blnd ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_NAME)   as   form_h_school_name ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_ADDR)   as   form_h_school_addr ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_CITY)   as   form_h_school_city ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_STATEPROV)   as   form_h_school_stateprov ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_POST_CODE)   as   form_h_school_post_code ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_COUNTRY)   as   form_h_school_country ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_GRAD_YEAR)   as   form_h_school_grad_year ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_ENTRY_YEAR)   as   form_entry_year ,  TRIM(Con.current_grade_level)   as   h_school_grade_level_calc ,  TRIM(Con.grad_year)   as   h_school_grad_year_calc ,  TRIM(max_values.sat_max)   as   max_sat_score_rng_calc ,  TRIM(max_values.act_max)   as   max_act_score_rng_calc ,  TRIM(max_values.psat_max)   as   max_psat_score_rng_calc ,  TRIM(max_values.preact_max)   as   max_preact_score_rng_calc ,  null   as   fafsa_submit_date_partner ,  TRIM(Con.contact_rand)   as   random_number ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_BOT_HONEYPOT)   as   form_bot_honeypot ,  case when AC.ACS_REPLICATION_DATE IS NOT NULL then CONCAT(LEFT(REPLACE(TRIM(AC.ACS_REPLICATION_DATE), ' ', 'T'), 19), '+00:00') else null end   as   acs_replication_date ,  TRIM(CAC.print_display_id )   as   print_display_id ,  TRIM(PD.PANTO_SCHOOL_GUID)   as   es_partner_id ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_ACADEMIC_FIELD_INTRS)   as   Form_Academic_Field_Intrs ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_EMAIL_UPDATE_CONTACT_KEY)   as   FORM_EMAIL_UPDATED_EAB_ID ,  TRIM(AC.Form_Student_Addr)   as   FORM_STUDENT_ADDR ,  TRIM(AC.Form_Student_City)   as   FORM_STUDENT_CITY ,  TRIM(AC.Form_Student_Stateprov)   as   form_student_stateprov ,  TRIM(AC.Form_Student_Post_Code)   as   form_student_post_code ,  TRIM(AC.Form_Student_Country)   as   form_student_country ,  TRIM(AC.Form_Sms_Opt_In)   as   form_sms_opt_in ,  TRIM(AC.Engaged_Inq_Cmpgn_Acsl)   as   engaged_inq_cmpgn_acsl ,  TRIM(AC.Engaged_Reeng_Cmpgn_Acsl)   as   engaged_reeng_cmpgn_acsl ,  TRIM(parent.FIRST_NAME)   as   child_first_name_calc ,  TRIM(parent.LAST_NAME)   as   child_last_name_calc ,  TRIM(case when Con.suppress_mail_ind = 1 then 'Y' else 'N' end)   as   do_not_direct_mail_calc ,  case when lower(optin_sms_indicator) = 'false' then 'false' when lower(optin_sms_indicator) = 'true' then 'true' else null end   as   sms_opt_in_calc ,  TRIM(case when Con.suppress_email_ind = 1 then 'TRUE' else 'FALSE' end)   as   dnc_email ,  null   as   dnc_email_comment ,  PHN.optin_sms_indicator ,
CASE WHEN Con.contact_type_calc ='Parent/Guardian'	THEN  parent.stu_hs_grade_level_calc
ELSE Con.current_grade_level
END AS stu_hs_grade_level_calc,
TRIM(Con.grad_year)   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,  null   as   student_funnel_stage_calc ,  INITCAP(NULLIF(TRIM(parent.student_funnel_stage_calc), ''))   as   stu_funnel_stage_calc ,  TRIM(AC.student_application_status )   as   stu_eab_app_status ,  TRIM(ac_blnd.academic_interest_blnd)   as   stu_aca_field_intrst_blnd ,  TRIM(race_stdz.race)   as   stu_race_stdzd ,  TRIM(Con.ethnicity )   as   stu_ethnicity_stdzd ,  null   as   stu_religion_partner ,
CASE WHEN Con.contact_type_calc ='Parent/Guardian'	THEN  parent.high_school_grad_year_calculated
ELSE Con.grad_year
END AS stu_hs_grad_year_calc,
																													   ac.eng_app_par_gen_acsl   as   eng_app_par_gen_acsl ,  ac.eng_app_stu_gen_acsl   as   eng_app_stu_gen_acsl ,  ac.eng_app_stu_paper_acsl   as   eng_app_stu_paper_acsl ,  ac.eng_app_stu_sub_acsl   as   eng_app_stu_sub_acsl ,  ac.eng_cul_par_inq_acsl   as   eng_cul_par_inq_acsl ,  ac.eng_cul_par_nur_acsl   as   eng_cul_par_nur_acsl ,  ac.eng_cul_stu_inq_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_inq_acsl ,  ac.eng_cul_stu_paper_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_paper_acsl ,  ac.eng_cul_stu_nur_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_nur_acsl ,  ac.eng_cul_stu_reen_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_reen_acsl ,  ac.eng_cul_stu_j_reen_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_j_reen_acsl ,  ac.eng_cul_stu_sms_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_sms_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_app_par_gen_acsl   as   st_dt_app_par_gen_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_app_stu_gen_acsl   as   st_dt_app_stu_gen_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_app_stu_paper_acsl   as   st_dt_app_stu_paper_acsl ,
-- ac.st_dt_app_stu_sub_acsl   as   st_dt_app_stu_sub_acsl ,
ac.st_dt_cul_par_inq_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_par_inq_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_cul_par_nur_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_par_nur_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_cul_stu_inq_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_stu_inq_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_cul_stu_paper_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_stu_paper_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_cul_stu_nur_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_stu_nur_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_cul_stu_j_reen_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_stu_j_reen_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_cul_stu_reen_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_stu_reen_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_cul_stu_sms_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_stu_sms_acsl

from    PDP.con__contact_assigned  as Con left join   PDP.add__sourcecontact_clean_addr as SCCA on Con.CLEAN_ADDR_KEY = SCCA.CLEAN_ADDR_KEY left join  PDP.prc__contact_acquia_xwalk  as CAC on Con. contact_key = CAC. contact_key  left join   PDP.acs__contacts  as AC on CAC.acs_contact_id = AC.acs_contact_id left join  <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Phone]>  as PHN on PHN.phone_number = Con.phone_number  left join (
select   Con.FIRST_NAME ,  Con.LAST_NAME ,  Con.CONTACT_KEY
from    PDP.con__contact_assigned  as Con left join  PDP.con__contact_relations  as d on Con.CONTACT_KEY = d.student_contact_key
where  initcap(Con.contact_type_calc ) = 'Parent/Guardian'
) as child_names on child_names.CONTACT_KEY = Con.CONTACT_KEY left join (
select   CTS_PIVOT.contact_key   as   contact_key ,
CTS_PIVOT.sourcecontact_id   as   sourcecontact_id ,
max(sat_max)   as   sat_max ,  max(act_max)   as   act_max ,  max(psat_max)   as   psat_max ,  max(preact_max)   as   preact_max
from   (

select   CTS. contact_key   as   contact_key ,
 CTS.sourcecontact_id ,
 case when UPPER(CTS. test_type) = 'SAT' then CTS. score_range_max  else null end   as   sat_max ,
 case when UPPER(CTS. test_type) = 'ACT' then CTS. score_range_max else null end   as   act_max ,  case when UPPER(CTS. test_type) = 'PSAT' then CTS. score_range_max  else null end   as   psat_max ,  case when UPPER(CTS. test_type) = 'PREACT' then CTS. score_range_max  else null end   as   preact_max
from    PDP.con__contact_test_scores  as CTS
) as CTS_PIVOT
group by   CTS_PIVOT.contact_key,
CTS_PIVOT.sourcecontact_id
) as max_values on Con.contact_key = max_values.contact_key
and Con.active_sourcecontact_id = max_values.sourcecontact_id
left join  <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Sourcecontact Sourcetype]>  as srccontact_srctype on srccontact_srctype. <Source Contact ID>  = Con.active_sourcecontact_id left join pdp.crf__intake_type as srctype on srccontact_srctype. <Source Type Key>  = srctype.intake_type_key left outer join es_pdp_common.common.common_source_standard_mappings as state_translation on UPPER(state_translation.source_type) = 'GENERAL' and Upper(state_translation.Category) = 'STATE' and Lower(state_translation.SOURCE_FIELD_NAME) = 'state' and lower(state_translation.eabstandard_value) = lower(SCCA.state ) /*and lower(state_translation.source_description) = lower(SCCA.country )*/ left join (
select   a.contact_key ,  LISTAGG(a.eab_std_value , '|')   as   academic_interest_blnd
from   (
select  distinct  b.contact_key ,  b.eab_std_value ,  b.attribute_type
from   PDP.con__contact_attributes_combined  as b
) as a
where  Lower(a.attribute_type) = 'academic_interest'
group by   a.contact_key
) as ac_blnd on Con.contact_key  = ac_blnd.contact_key left join (
select   a.contact_key ,  a.sourcecontact_id ,  LISTAGG(a.eab_std_value , '|')   as   race
from   (
select  distinct  b.contact_key ,  b.sourcecontact_id ,  b.eab_std_value,  b.attribute_type
from    PDP.con__contact_attributes_combined  as b
) as a
where  Lower(a.attribute_type) = 'race'
group by   a.contact_key, a.sourcecontact_id
) as race_stdz on Con.contact_key  = race_stdz.contact_key and Con.active_sourcecontact_id = race_stdz.sourcecontact_id left join (
select   list_sources.contact_key ,  LISTAGG(list_sources.all_source_bln_list_agg, '|')   as   all_sources_blnd
from   (
select   contact_key ,  case when lower(intake_type_label) = 'prenames' then 'Migrated Contact' else null end   as   all_source_bln_list_agg
from    PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts  as CSCS left join pdp.crf__intake_type as intake on CSCS.source_type_key = intake.intake_type_key
where  LOWER(CSCS.active_ind) = 'true' and lower(intake_type_label) = 'prenames'

 UNION
select  distinct  contact_key ,  source_label   as   all_source_bln_list_agg
from    PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts  as CSCS inner join pdp.crf__source as srctype on CSCS.source_key  = srctype.source_key
where  LOWER(CSCS.active_ind) = 'true'
) as list_sources
group by   list_sources.contact_key
) as all_source on Con.contact_key  = all_source.contact_key left join (
select   con3.first_name ,  con3.last_name ,  con3.parent_contact_key ,  con3.student_contact_key ,  con3.stu_hs_grade_level_calc   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  con3.high_school_grad_year_calculated   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,  con3.student_funnel_stage_calc   as   student_funnel_stage_calc
from   (
select  distinct  con2.first_name ,  con2.last_name ,  con2.parent_contact_key ,  con2.student_contact_key ,  con2.stu_hs_grade_level_calc   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  con2.high_school_grad_year_calculated   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,  con2.student_funnel_stage_calc   as   student_funnel_stage_calc ,  row_number() over (partition by con2.parent_contact_key order by  con2.sourcecontact_intake_dt   ASC )   as   rankid2
from   (
select  distinct  rel.parent_contact_key ,  rel.student_contact_key ,  scst.create_date   as   sourcecontact_intake_dt ,  con1.current_grade_level   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  con1. grad_year   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,
con1. first_name ,  con1.last_name ,  con1. funnel_status_calc   as   student_funnel_stage_calc ,  row_number() over (partition by rel.parent_contact_key order by  int.INTAKE_PRIORITY   ASC )   as   rankid
 from    PDP.con__contact_assigned  as con inner join  PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts  as src on con.contact_key  = src.contact_key  inner join pdp.crf__intake_type as int on int.intake_type_key = src.source_type_key inner join  <[Partner_Data_Platform].[SourceContact SourceType]>  as scst on src.sourcecontact_id = scst.source_contact_id  left join  PDP.con__contact_relations  as rel on rel.parent_contact_key = con.contact_key left join  PDP.con__contact_assigned  as con1 on rel.student_contact_key = con1.contact_key
where  con.contact_type_calc = 'Parent/Guardian'
) as con2
where  rankid = 1
) as con3
where  rankid2 = 1
) as parent on Con.contact_key  = parent.parent_contact_key left join (
select   sub_1.contact_key ,  sub_1.source_label   as   source_label
from   (
select   ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by contact_key order by  CSCTS.create_dt   ASC )   as   row_id ,  CSCTS.contact_key ,  srctype.source_label
from    PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts  as CSCTS inner join pdp.crf__source as srctype on CSCTS.source_key  = srctype.source_key
) as sub_1
where  row_id = 1
) as label on Con.contact_key = label.contact_key inner join  PDP.prc__partner_details  as PD

 where (NULLIF(TRIM(Con.contact_type_calc ), '')   in  ('Student','Parent/Guardian', 'Ride Along','Deliverability Seed')and ((TRIM(label.source_label) is not null and TRIM(all_source.all_sources_blnd) is not null)) and lower(Con.email_address ) not like '%test.eab.com') or (NULLIF(TRIM(Con.contact_type_calc ), '') in ('Deliverability Seed', 'Ride Along') and TRIM(all_source.all_sources_blnd) is null and lower(Con.email_address ) not like '%test.eab.com')

Adding filter for contact_type, fix for missing state values and missing stu_hs_grad_level calc and stu_hs_grad_year values and making it swap compliant
ESDP 746, 747, 692 , 757
-- made changes to populate partner_id from school_panto_id to school_panto_guid
-- Made changes to Null out the international addresses
*/

select  distinct  NULLIF(TRIM(Con.first_name), '')   as   firstname ,  NULLIF(TRIM(Con.last_name), '')   as   lastname ,  TRIM(Con.email_address )   as   email ,  Case When Lower(SCCA.country ) = 'united states' 
	 Then NULLIF(TRIM(SCCA.ADDR_1), '') 
	 Else Null 
	 End as   address1 ,
Case When Lower(SCCA.country ) = 'united states'
     Then NULLIF(TRIM(SCCA.ADDR_2), '') 
	 Else Null
	 End as   address2 , 
Case When Lower(SCCA.country ) = 'united states'
     Then NULLIF(TRIM(SCCA. city ), '') 
	 Else Null
	 End as   city ,  
Case When Lower(SCCA.country ) = 'united states'
     Then NULLIF(TRIM(state_translation.eabstandard_value), '')  
	 Else Null
	 End as   state ,
 TRIM(case when INITCAP(SCCA.country ) = 'Unknown' or lower(SCCA.country ) = 'unmapped value' then null else SCCA.country  end)   as   country ,
 TRIM(case when Lower(SCCA.country ) = 'united states' then SCCA.ZIP5 else null end)   as   zipcode ,  TRIM(SCCA.CREATE_DT)   as   CREATE_DTS ,
 TRIM(Con.phone_number )   as   mobile ,  TRIM(Con.distance_from_campus)   as   dist_from_campus_calc ,  TRIM(AC.is_deleted) as is_deleted ,  TRIM(race_stdz.race)   as   race_stdzd
 ,  TRIM(Con.ethnicity )   as   ethnicity_stdzd ,  null   as   religion_partner ,  TRIM(ac_blnd.academic_interest_blnd)   as   academic_field_intrst_bln ,
 TRIM(Con. contact_key)   as   eab_contact_id ,  NULLIF(TRIM(Con.contact_type_calc ), '')   as   eab_contact_type ,  INITCAP(NULLIF(TRIM(Con.funnel_status_calc ), ''))
 as   funnel_stage_calc ,  TRIM(AC.student_application_status )   as   student_app_status ,  TRIM(AC.form_student_first_name )   as   form_student_first_name ,
 TRIM(AC. form_student_last_name )   as   form_student_last_name ,  TRIM(AC.form_parent_first_name )   as   form_parent_first_name ,  TRIM(AC. form_parent_last_name)
 as   form_parent_last_name ,  TRIM(AC.form_parent_email)   as   form_parent_email ,  TRIM(AC.form_referred_by_EAB_ID )   as   form_referred_by_EAB_ID ,  TRIM(label.source_label)   as   og_contact_source_calc ,  TRIM(all_source.all_sources_blnd)   as   all_sources_blnd ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_NAME)   as   form_h_school_name ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_ADDR)   as   form_h_school_addr ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_CITY)   as   form_h_school_city ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_STATEPROV)   as   form_h_school_stateprov ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_POST_CODE)   as   form_h_school_post_code ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_COUNTRY)   as   form_h_school_country ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_H_SCHOOL_GRAD_YEAR)   as   form_h_school_grad_year ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_ENTRY_YEAR)   as   form_entry_year ,  TRIM(Con.current_grade_level)   as   h_school_grade_level_calc ,  TRIM(Con.grad_year)   as   h_school_grad_year_calc ,  TRIM(max_values.sat_max)   as   max_sat_score_rng_calc ,  TRIM(max_values.act_max)   as   max_act_score_rng_calc ,  TRIM(max_values.psat_max)   as   max_psat_score_rng_calc ,  TRIM(max_values.preact_max)   as   max_preact_score_rng_calc ,  null   as   fafsa_submit_date_partner ,  TRIM(Con.contact_rand)   as   random_number ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_BOT_HONEYPOT)   as   form_bot_honeypot ,  case when AC.ACS_REPLICATION_DATE IS NOT NULL then CONCAT(LEFT(REPLACE(TRIM(AC.ACS_REPLICATION_DATE), ' ', 'T'), 19), '+00:00') else null end   as   acs_replication_date ,  TRIM(CAC.print_display_id )   as   print_display_id ,  TRIM(PD.PANTO_SCHOOL_GUID)   as   es_partner_id ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_ACADEMIC_FIELD_INTRS)   as   Form_Academic_Field_Intrs ,  TRIM(AC.FORM_EMAIL_UPDATE_CONTACT_KEY)   as   FORM_EMAIL_UPDATED_EAB_ID ,  TRIM(AC.Form_Student_Addr)   as   FORM_STUDENT_ADDR ,  TRIM(AC.Form_Student_City)   as   FORM_STUDENT_CITY ,  TRIM(AC.Form_Student_Stateprov)   as   form_student_stateprov ,  TRIM(AC.Form_Student_Post_Code)   as   form_student_post_code ,  TRIM(AC.Form_Student_Country)   as   form_student_country ,  TRIM(AC.Form_Sms_Opt_In)   as   form_sms_opt_in ,  TRIM(AC.Engaged_Inq_Cmpgn_Acsl)   as   engaged_inq_cmpgn_acsl ,  TRIM(AC.Engaged_Reeng_Cmpgn_Acsl)   as   engaged_reeng_cmpgn_acsl ,  TRIM(parent.FIRST_NAME)   as   child_first_name_calc ,  TRIM(parent.LAST_NAME)   as   child_last_name_calc ,  TRIM(case when Con.suppress_mail_ind = 1 then 'Y' else 'N' end)   as   do_not_direct_mail_calc ,  case when lower(optin_sms_indicator) = 'false' then 'false' when lower(optin_sms_indicator) = 'true' then 'true' else null end   as   sms_opt_in_calc ,  TRIM(case when Con.suppress_email_ind = 1 then 'TRUE' else 'FALSE' end)   as   dnc_email ,  null   as   dnc_email_comment ,  PHN.optin_sms_indicator ,
CASE WHEN Con.contact_type_calc ='Parent/Guardian'	THEN  parent.stu_hs_grade_level_calc
ELSE Con.current_grade_level
END AS stu_hs_grade_level_calc,
TRIM(Con.grad_year)   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,  null   as   student_funnel_stage_calc ,  INITCAP(NULLIF(TRIM(parent.student_funnel_stage_calc), ''))   as   stu_funnel_stage_calc ,  TRIM(AC.student_application_status )   as   stu_eab_app_status ,  TRIM(ac_blnd.academic_interest_blnd)   as   stu_aca_field_intrst_blnd ,  TRIM(race_stdz.race)   as   stu_race_stdzd ,  TRIM(Con.ethnicity )   as   stu_ethnicity_stdzd ,  null   as   stu_religion_partner ,
CASE WHEN Con.contact_type_calc ='Parent/Guardian'	THEN  parent.high_school_grad_year_calculated
ELSE Con.grad_year
END AS stu_hs_grad_year_calc,
																													   ac.eng_app_par_gen_acsl   as   eng_app_par_gen_acsl ,  ac.eng_app_stu_gen_acsl   as   eng_app_stu_gen_acsl ,  ac.eng_app_stu_paper_acsl   as   eng_app_stu_paper_acsl ,  ac.eng_app_stu_sub_acsl   as   eng_app_stu_sub_acsl ,  ac.eng_cul_par_inq_acsl   as   eng_cul_par_inq_acsl ,  ac.eng_cul_par_nur_acsl   as   eng_cul_par_nur_acsl ,  ac.eng_cul_stu_inq_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_inq_acsl ,  ac.eng_cul_stu_paper_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_paper_acsl ,  ac.eng_cul_stu_nur_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_nur_acsl ,  ac.eng_cul_stu_reen_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_reen_acsl ,  ac.eng_cul_stu_j_reen_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_j_reen_acsl ,  ac.eng_cul_stu_sms_acsl   as   eng_cul_stu_sms_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_app_par_gen_acsl   as   st_dt_app_par_gen_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_app_stu_gen_acsl   as   st_dt_app_stu_gen_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_app_stu_paper_acsl   as   st_dt_app_stu_paper_acsl ,
-- ac.st_dt_app_stu_sub_acsl   as   st_dt_app_stu_sub_acsl ,
ac.st_dt_cul_par_inq_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_par_inq_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_cul_par_nur_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_par_nur_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_cul_stu_inq_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_stu_inq_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_cul_stu_paper_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_stu_paper_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_cul_stu_nur_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_stu_nur_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_cul_stu_j_reen_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_stu_j_reen_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_cul_stu_reen_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_stu_reen_acsl ,  ac.st_dt_cul_stu_sms_acsl   as   st_dt_cul_stu_sms_acsl

from    PDP.con__contact_assigned  as Con left join   PDP.add__sourcecontact_clean_addr as SCCA on Con.CLEAN_ADDR_KEY = SCCA.CLEAN_ADDR_KEY left join  PDP.prc__contact_acquia_xwalk  as CAC on Con. contact_key = CAC. contact_key  left join   PDP.acs__contacts  as AC on CAC.acs_contact_id = AC.acs_contact_id left join  <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Phone]>  as PHN on PHN.phone_number = Con.phone_number  left join (
select   Con.FIRST_NAME ,  Con.LAST_NAME ,  Con.CONTACT_KEY
from    PDP.con__contact_assigned  as Con left join  PDP.con__contact_relations  as d on Con.CONTACT_KEY = d.student_contact_key
where  initcap(Con.contact_type_calc ) = 'Parent/Guardian'
) as child_names on child_names.CONTACT_KEY = Con.CONTACT_KEY left join (
select   CTS_PIVOT.contact_key   as   contact_key ,
CTS_PIVOT.sourcecontact_id   as   sourcecontact_id ,
max(sat_max)   as   sat_max ,  max(act_max)   as   act_max ,  max(psat_max)   as   psat_max ,  max(preact_max)   as   preact_max
from   (

select   CTS. contact_key   as   contact_key ,
 CTS.sourcecontact_id ,
 case when UPPER(CTS. test_type) = 'SAT' then CTS. score_range_max  else null end   as   sat_max ,
 case when UPPER(CTS. test_type) = 'ACT' then CTS. score_range_max else null end   as   act_max ,  case when UPPER(CTS. test_type) = 'PSAT' then CTS. score_range_max  else null end   as   psat_max ,  case when UPPER(CTS. test_type) = 'PREACT' then CTS. score_range_max  else null end   as   preact_max
from    PDP.con__contact_test_scores  as CTS
) as CTS_PIVOT
group by   CTS_PIVOT.contact_key,
CTS_PIVOT.sourcecontact_id
) as max_values on Con.contact_key = max_values.contact_key
and Con.active_sourcecontact_id = max_values.sourcecontact_id
left join  <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Sourcecontact Sourcetype]>  as srccontact_srctype on srccontact_srctype. <Source Contact ID>  = Con.active_sourcecontact_id left join pdp.crf__intake_type as srctype on srccontact_srctype. <Source Type Key>  = srctype.intake_type_key left outer join es_pdp_common.common.common_source_standard_mappings as state_translation on UPPER(state_translation.source_type) = 'GENERAL' and Upper(state_translation.Category) = 'STATE' and Lower(state_translation.SOURCE_FIELD_NAME) = 'state' and lower(state_translation.eabstandard_value) = lower(SCCA.state ) /*and lower(state_translation.source_description) = lower(SCCA.country )*/ left join (
select   a.contact_key ,  LISTAGG(a.eab_std_value , '|')   as   academic_interest_blnd
from   (
select  distinct  b.contact_key ,  b.eab_std_value ,  b.attribute_type
from   PDP.con__contact_attributes_combined  as b
) as a
where  Lower(a.attribute_type) = 'academic_interest'
group by   a.contact_key
) as ac_blnd on Con.contact_key  = ac_blnd.contact_key left join (
select   a.contact_key ,  a.sourcecontact_id ,  LISTAGG(a.eab_std_value , '|')   as   race
from   (
select  distinct  b.contact_key ,  b.sourcecontact_id ,  b.eab_std_value,  b.attribute_type
from    PDP.con__contact_attributes_combined  as b
) as a
where  Lower(a.attribute_type) = 'race'
group by   a.contact_key, a.sourcecontact_id
) as race_stdz on Con.contact_key  = race_stdz.contact_key and Con.active_sourcecontact_id = race_stdz.sourcecontact_id left join (
select   list_sources.contact_key ,  LISTAGG(list_sources.all_source_bln_list_agg, '|')   as   all_sources_blnd
from   (
select   contact_key ,  case when lower(intake_type_label) = 'prenames' then 'Migrated Contact' else null end   as   all_source_bln_list_agg
from    PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts  as CSCS left join pdp.crf__intake_type as intake on CSCS.source_type_key = intake.intake_type_key
where  LOWER(CSCS.active_ind) = 'true' and lower(intake_type_label) = 'prenames'

 UNION
select  distinct  contact_key ,  source_label   as   all_source_bln_list_agg
from    PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts  as CSCS inner join pdp.crf__source as srctype on CSCS.source_key  = srctype.source_key
where  LOWER(CSCS.active_ind) = 'true'
) as list_sources
group by   list_sources.contact_key
) as all_source on Con.contact_key  = all_source.contact_key left join (
select   con3.first_name ,  con3.last_name ,  con3.parent_contact_key ,  con3.student_contact_key ,  con3.stu_hs_grade_level_calc   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  con3.high_school_grad_year_calculated   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,  con3.student_funnel_stage_calc   as   student_funnel_stage_calc
from   (
select  distinct  con2.first_name ,  con2.last_name ,  con2.parent_contact_key ,  con2.student_contact_key ,  con2.stu_hs_grade_level_calc   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  con2.high_school_grad_year_calculated   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,  con2.student_funnel_stage_calc   as   student_funnel_stage_calc ,  row_number() over (partition by con2.parent_contact_key order by  con2.sourcecontact_intake_dt   ASC )   as   rankid2
from   (
select  distinct  rel.parent_contact_key ,  rel.student_contact_key ,  scst.create_date   as   sourcecontact_intake_dt ,  con1.current_grade_level   as   stu_hs_grade_level_calc ,  con1. grad_year   as   high_school_grad_year_calculated ,
con1. first_name ,  con1.last_name ,  con1. funnel_status_calc   as   student_funnel_stage_calc ,  row_number() over (partition by rel.parent_contact_key order by  int.INTAKE_PRIORITY   ASC )   as   rankid
 from    PDP.con__contact_assigned  as con inner join  PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts  as src on con.contact_key  = src.contact_key  inner join pdp.crf__intake_type as int on int.intake_type_key = src.source_type_key inner join  <[Partner_Data_Platform].[SourceContact SourceType]>  as scst on src.sourcecontact_id = scst.source_contact_id  left join  PDP.con__contact_relations  as rel on rel.parent_contact_key = con.contact_key left join  PDP.con__contact_assigned  as con1 on rel.student_contact_key = con1.contact_key
where  con.contact_type_calc = 'Parent/Guardian'
) as con2
where  rankid = 1
) as con3
where  rankid2 = 1
) as parent on Con.contact_key  = parent.parent_contact_key left join (
select   sub_1.contact_key ,  sub_1.source_label   as   source_label
from   (
select   ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by contact_key order by  CSCTS.create_dt   ASC )   as   row_id ,  CSCTS.contact_key ,  srctype.source_label
from    PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts  as CSCTS inner join pdp.crf__source as srctype on CSCTS.source_key  = srctype.source_key
) as sub_1
where  row_id = 1
) as label on Con.contact_key = label.contact_key inner join  PDP.prc__partner_details  as PD

 where (NULLIF(TRIM(Con.contact_type_calc ), '')   in  ('Student','Parent/Guardian', 'Ride Along','Deliverability Seed')and ((TRIM(label.source_label) is not null and TRIM(all_source.all_sources_blnd) is not null)) and lower(Con.email_address ) not like '%test.eab.com') or (NULLIF(TRIM(Con.contact_type_calc ), '') in ('Deliverability Seed', 'Ride Along') and TRIM(all_source.all_sources_blnd) is null and lower(Con.email_address ) not like '%test.eab.com')

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.
