setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
with race_data as (
 select * from ( 
select distinct
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_race.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as primary_student_id,
stud_race.race,
  
case when pcm_race.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then 'Unknown'
else pcm_race.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race,
  
case when pcm_race_amer_indian.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_amer_indian.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_amer_indian,

case when pcm_race_asian.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_asian.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_asian,

case when pcm_race_black.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_black.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_black,

case when pcm_race_native_hawaiian.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_native_hawaiian.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_native_hawaiian,

case when pcm_race_white.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_white.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_white,

case when pcm_race_middle_eastern.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_middle_eastern.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_middle_eastern,

case when pcm_race_multiracial.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_multiracial.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_multiracial,
  
case when pcm_race_other.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_other.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_other,

case when pcm_race_prefer_not_respond.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_prefer_not_respond.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_prefer_not_respond,

case when pcm_race_unknown.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_unknown.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_unknown

from <[ALR].[Student Race].{fulfillment}> as stud_race
join <[ALR].[Student Program].{fulfillment}> sp
on stud_race.primary_student_id = sp.primary_student_id
and sp.student_type = 'Adult learner seeking undergrad degree/certificate'
left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race
on (pcm_race.field_name = 'eab_race'
and coalesce(stud_race.race,'') = coalesce(pcm_race.partner_value,''))
  
left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_amer_indian
on (pcm_race_amer_indian.field_name = 'eab_race_amer_indian'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_1,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_amer_indian.partner_value,''))
  
left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_asian
on (pcm_race_asian.field_name = 'eab_race_asian'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_2,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_asian.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_black
on (pcm_race_black.field_name = 'eab_race_black'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_3,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_black.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_native_hawaiian
on (pcm_race_native_hawaiian.field_name = 'eab_race_native_hawaiian'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_4,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_native_hawaiian.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_white
on (pcm_race_white.field_name = 'eab_race_white'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_5,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_white.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_middle_eastern
on (pcm_race_middle_eastern.field_name = 'eab_race_middle_eastern'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_6,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_middle_eastern.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_multiracial
on (pcm_race_multiracial.field_name = 'eab_race_multiracial'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_7,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_multiracial.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_other
on (pcm_race_other.field_name = 'eab_race_other'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_8,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_other.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_prefer_not_respond
on (pcm_race_prefer_not_respond.field_name = 'eab_race_prefer_not_respond'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_9,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_prefer_not_respond.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_unknown
on (pcm_race_unknown.field_name = 'eab_race_unknown'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_10,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_unknown.partner_value,''))
														  
where <where_statement>		
) agg
where coalesce(agg.primary_student_id,'') <> ''
)

select distinct primary_student_id,
race,
eab_race
from (

select primary_student_id
, race
, case 
	when eab_race = 'Asian/Asian American' then 'Asian'
	else eab_race
	end as eab_race
from race_data
where coalesce(eab_race,'') not in ('Unknown','Unmapped Value','') and race <> ''
	
union all

select primary_student_id
, EAB_RACE_AMER_INDIAN
, EAB_RACE_AMER_INDIAN
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_AMER_INDIAN is not null
	
union all

select primary_student_id
, EAB_RACE_ASIAN
--, 'Asian'
, case 
    when EAB_RACE_ASIAN in ('Asian/Asian American','Asian') then 'Asian'
    else null
    end as EAB_RACE_ASIAN
 from race_data
where EAB_RACE_ASIAN is not null
	
union all

select primary_student_id
, EAB_RACE_BLACK
, EAB_RACE_BLACK
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_BLACK is not null

union all

select primary_student_id
, EAB_RACE_NATIVE_HAWAIIAN
, EAB_RACE_NATIVE_HAWAIIAN
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_NATIVE_HAWAIIAN is not null

union all

select primary_student_id
, EAB_RACE_WHITE
, EAB_RACE_WHITE
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_WHITE is not null

union all

select primary_student_id
, EAB_RACE_MIDDLE_EASTERN
, EAB_RACE_MIDDLE_EASTERN
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_MIDDLE_EASTERN is not null

union all

select primary_student_id
, EAB_RACE_MULTIRACIAL
, EAB_RACE_MULTIRACIAL
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_MULTIRACIAL is not null

union all

select primary_student_id
, EAB_RACE_OTHER
, EAB_RACE_OTHER
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_OTHER is not null

union all

select primary_student_id
, EAB_RACE_PREFER_NOT_RESPOND
, EAB_RACE_PREFER_NOT_RESPOND
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_PREFER_NOT_RESPOND is not null

union all

select primary_student_id
, EAB_RACE_UNKNOWN
, EAB_RACE_UNKNOWN
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_UNKNOWN is not null
  
) agg
where coalesce(agg.primary_student_id,'') <> ''

queryResults.querySql:
with race_data as (
select distinct
stud_race.primary_student_id as primary_student_id,
stud_race.race,
  
case when pcm_race.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then 'Unknown'
else pcm_race.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race,
  
case when pcm_race_amer_indian.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_amer_indian.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_amer_indian,

case when pcm_race_asian.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_asian.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_asian,

case when pcm_race_black.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_black.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_black,

case when pcm_race_native_hawaiian.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_native_hawaiian.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_native_hawaiian,

case when pcm_race_white.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_white.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_white,

case when pcm_race_middle_eastern.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_middle_eastern.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_middle_eastern,

case when pcm_race_multiracial.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_multiracial.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_multiracial,
  
case when pcm_race_other.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_other.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_other,

case when pcm_race_prefer_not_respond.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_prefer_not_respond.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_prefer_not_respond,

case when pcm_race_unknown.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_race_unknown.eab_standard_value
end as eab_race_unknown

from <[ALR].[Student Race].{fulfillment}> as stud_race
join <[ALR].[Student Program].{fulfillment}> sp
on stud_race.primary_student_id = sp.primary_student_id
and sp.program = '0014W00002cyHRHQA2'
left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race
on (pcm_race.field_name = 'eab_race'
and coalesce(stud_race.race,'') = coalesce(pcm_race.partner_value,''))
  
left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_amer_indian
on (pcm_race_amer_indian.field_name = 'eab_race_amer_indian'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_1,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_amer_indian.partner_value,''))
  
left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_asian
on (pcm_race_asian.field_name = 'eab_race_asian'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_2,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_asian.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_black
on (pcm_race_black.field_name = 'eab_race_black'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_3,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_black.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_native_hawaiian
on (pcm_race_native_hawaiian.field_name = 'eab_race_native_hawaiian'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_4,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_native_hawaiian.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_white
on (pcm_race_white.field_name = 'eab_race_white'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_5,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_white.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_middle_eastern
on (pcm_race_middle_eastern.field_name = 'eab_race_middle_eastern'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_6,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_middle_eastern.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_multiracial
on (pcm_race_multiracial.field_name = 'eab_race_multiracial'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_7,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_multiracial.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_other
on (pcm_race_other.field_name = 'eab_race_other'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_8,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_other.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_prefer_not_respond
on (pcm_race_prefer_not_respond.field_name = 'eab_race_prefer_not_respond'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_9,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_prefer_not_respond.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_race_unknown
on (pcm_race_unknown.field_name = 'eab_race_unknown'
and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_10,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_unknown.partner_value,''))
														  
where <where_statement>		

)

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

/*try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.application_started_date,1,19)) as app_start_dt,
  try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.application_incomplete_date,1,19)) as app_submit_dt,

 */

when position(' ', application_started_date) > 0 AND left(right(application_started_date, 3), 1) = '/' THEN try_to_timestamp(TRIM(substring(application_started_date, 1, position(' ', application_started_date))),'MM/DD/YY')

when position(' ', application_incomplete_date) > 0 AND left(right(application_incomplete_date, 3), 1) != '/' THEN try_to_timestamp(TRIM(substring(application_incomplete_date, 1, position(' ', application_incomplete_date))),'MM/DD/YYYY')

case
when position(' ', admit_date) <= 0 AND left(right(admit_date, 3), 1) = '/' THEN try_to_timestamp(admit_date,'MM/DD/YY') 
when position(' ', admit_date) <= 0 AND left(right(admit_date, 3), 1) != '/' THEN try_to_timestamp(admit_date,'MM/DD/YYYY') 
when position(' ', admit_date) > 0 AND left(right(admit_date, 3), 1) = '/' THEN try_to_timestamp(TRIM(substring(admit_date, 1, position(' ', admit_date))),'MM/DD/YY')

else admit_date

case
when position(' ', deferral_date) <= 0 AND left(right(deferral_date, 3), 1) = '/' THEN try_to_timestamp(deferral_date,'MM/DD/YY') 
when position(' ', deferral_date) <= 0 AND left(right(deferral_date, 3), 1) != '/' THEN try_to_timestamp(deferral_date,'MM/DD/YYYY')

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. queryResults.querySql:
select * from (
SELECT
    CASE
    WHEN TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          (
              TRY_TO_DATE(CASE WHEN app.status IN ('Accepted','Deposited','Confirmed') THEN app.updated_at ELSE appd.admit_dt END) IS NOT NULL
              AND TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) > TRY_TO_DATE(CASE WHEN app.status IN ('Accepted','Deposited','Confirmed') THEN app.updated_at ELSE appd.admit_dt END)
          )
          OR (
              TRY_TO_DATE(appd.cond_admit_dt) IS NOT NULL
              AND TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) > TRY_TO_DATE(appd.cond_admit_dt)
          )
      )
    THEN NULL
    ELSE CASE WHEN app.status IN ('Accepted','Deposited','Confirmed') THEN app.updated_at ELSE appd.admit_dt END
END as ADMIT_DATE,
    CASE
    WHEN TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          (
              TRY_TO_DATE(CASE WHEN app.status IN ('Accepted','Deposited','Confirmed') THEN app.updated_at ELSE appd.admit_dt END) IS NOT NULL
              AND TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) > TRY_TO_DATE(CASE WHEN app.status IN ('Accepted','Deposited','Confirmed') THEN app.updated_at ELSE appd.admit_dt END)
          )
          OR (
              TRY_TO_DATE(appd.cond_admit_dt) IS NOT NULL
              AND TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) > TRY_TO_DATE(appd.cond_admit_dt)
          )
      )
    THEN NULL
    ELSE CASE
        WHEN appd.admit_ind = '1' THEN appd.admit_ind
        WHEN aapp.deposit_ind = '1' THEN aapp.deposit_ind
        WHEN aapp.enroll_ind = '1' THEN aapp.enroll_ind
        WHEN app.status IN ('Accepted','Deposited','Confirmed') THEN '1'
        ELSE NULL
    END
END as ADMIT_INDICATOR,
    null as ADMIT_INDICATOR_EAB,
    appd.admit_notify_dt as ADMIT_NOTIFY_DATE,
    TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.app_completion_dt)), '')) as APPLICATION_COMPLETED_DATE,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.app_complete_ind)), '') as APPLICATION_COMPLETED_INDICATOR,
    null as APPLICATION_COMPLETED_INDICATOR_EAB,
    null as APPLICATION_DECISION_TYPE_CODE,
    null as APPLICATION_DECISION_TYPE_EAB,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.id)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.external_id)), '')) as APPLICATION_ID,
    TRY_TO_DATE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.app_submission_date_time)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.submitted_at)), ''))) as APPLICATION_INCOMPLETE_DATE,

    null as APPLICATION_INCOMPLETE_INDICATOR_EAB,
    TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.created_at)), '')) as APPLICATION_STARTED_DATE,
    IFF(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.created_at)), '') IS NOT NULL, 'TRUE', NULL) as APPLICATION_STARTED_INDICATOR,
    null as APPLICATION_STARTED_INDICATOR_EAB,
    'Navigate' as APPLICATION_TYPE,
    null as APPLICATION_TYPE_EAB,
    TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.app_withdrawal_dt)), '')) as APPLICATION_WITHDRAWAL_DATE,

    NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TO_VARCHAR(app.campus_location), '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', '')), '') as CAMPUS_LOCATION,
    CASE
        WHEN TRY_TO_BOOLEAN(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.commuter_indicator)), '')) = TRUE THEN 'Commuter'

END as CONDITIONAL_ADMIT_DATE,
    CASE

    case when appd.admit_dt > appd.deny_dt then null else appd.deny_dt end as DENY_DATE,
    case when appd.admit_dt > appd.deny_dt then null else appd.deny_ind end as DENY_INDICATOR,
    null as DENY_INDICATOR_EAB,
    aapp.deposit_dt as DEPOSIT_CONFIRMED_DATE,
    aapp.deposit_ind as DEPOSIT_CONFIRMED_INDICATOR,
    null as DEPOSIT_CONFIRMED_INDICATOR_EAB,
    case when COALESCE(TRY_TO_DATE(aapp.withdrawal_dt),TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.app_withdrawal_dt)), '')), TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.cancel_dt)), ''))) is not null then null else aapp.enroll_dt end as ENROLLMENT_DATE,

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

case

substring(split_part(student_test_scores.other_exam_score,'.',1),1,5) as other_exam_score,
substring(split_part(student_test_scores.mcat_comp_score,'.',1),1,5) as mcat_comp_score,
substring(split_part(student_test_scores.pcat_comp_score,'.',1),1,5) as pcat_comp_score,
try_to_date(student_test_scores.gmat_test_dt,'MM/dd/yyyy') as gmat_test_dt,
try_to_date(student_test_scores.lsat_exam_dt,'MM/dd/yyyy') as lsat_exam_dt,
try_to_date(student_test_scores.pcat_exam_dt,'MM/dd/yyyy') as pcat_exam_dt,

NULL as ceeb_cd,
NULL as years_employed,

case when student_term_application.submitted_application_ind = 'true' then '1' when student_program.audience_code = 'PAPPL' then '1' else '0' end  as submitted_application_ind,
case when student_term_application.completed_application_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end  as completed_application_ind,
case when student_term_application.admit_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end  as admit_ind,
case when student_term_application.denied_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end  as denied_ind,

substring(student_term_application.deposit_2_dt,1,19) as deposit_2_dt,
case when student_term_application.deposit_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end as deposit_ind,
substring(student_term_application.deposit_dt,1,19) as deposit_dt,
substring(student_term_application.enroll_dt,1,19) as enroll_dt,
substring(student_term_application.withdraw_dt,1,19) as withdraw_dt,
substring(student_term_application.eab_app_type,1,50) as application_type,
substring(student_term_application.application_type,1,50) as application_type_src,
NULL as decision_type,
substring(student_term_application.campus,1,100) as campus,
coalesce(student_term_application.eab_campus_type,student_program.eab_campus_type) as campus_type,

coalesce(student_term_application.curr_entry_term,student_program.curr_entry_term) as entry_term_src,
substring(student_term_application.cohort_desc,1,50) as cohort_desc,
coalesce(substring(upper(student_term_application.eab_student_type),1,1),substring(upper(student_program.eab_student_type),1,1)) as student_type,
coalesce(substring(student_term_application.student_type,1,50),substring(student_program.student_type,1,50)) as student_type_src,
substring(coalesce(upper(student_term_application.degree_type),upper(student_program.degree_type)),1,50) as degree_type_src,
coalesce(substring(upper(student_term_application.eab_degree_type),1,2),substring(upper(student_program.eab_degree_type),1,2)) as degree_type,

substring(student_term_application.school_of_study,1,50) as school_of_study,
'0' as previous_enrolled_ind,

NULL as gre_major,
NULL as lsat_account_id,
NULL as other_exam_id,
NULL as pcat_account_id,
NULL as mcat_account_id,
NULL as income,
NULL as previous_hs_gpa,
NULL as lead_eligible_for_marketing_export_ind,
NULL as lead_eligible_for_partner_analysis_ind,
student_program.audience_code as audience_cd,
substring(student_race.ethnicity,1,50) as ethnicity,
coalesce(student_race.ethnicity_2,'0') as ethnicity_2,
coalesce(student_race.ethnicity_3,'0') as ethnicity_3,
coalesce(student_race.ethnicity_4,'0') as ethnicity_4,
coalesce(student_race.ethnicity_5,'0') as ethnicity_5,
coalesce(student_race.ethnicity_6,'0') as ethnicity_6,
case when race_multiracial.primary_student_id is not null then 'M' 
when student_race.ethnicity_2 = '1' then 'A' 
when student_race.ethnicity_3 = '1' then 'B' 
when student_race.ethnicity_4 = '1' then 'C' 
when student_race.ethnicity_5 = '1' then 'B' 
when student_race.ethnicity_6 = '1' then 'E' 		 
else 'U' end as ethnicity_rollup,
NULL as parent_first_name,
NULL as parent_last_name,
NULL as parent_email,
NULL as file_received_from_partner_dt,
substring(student_program.analysis_custom_field_1,1,100) as analysis_custom_field1,
substring(student_program.analysis_custom_field_2,1,100) as analysis_custom_field2,
substring(student_program.analysis_custom_field_3,1,100) as analysis_custom_field3,
substring(student_program.analysis_custom_field_4,1,100) as analysis_custom_field4,
substring(student_program.analysis_custom_field_5,1,100) as analysis_custom_field5,
NULL as custom_segment_1,
NULL as custom_segment_2,
NULL as custom_segment_3,
NULL as custom_segment_4
from <[ALR].[Student Program].{final}> as student_program
left join
<student_address> as student_address
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_address.primary_student_id
left join
<[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{Countries}> as countries
on student_address.country_name = countries.eab_common_country_name		 
left join
<student_email> as student_email
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_email.primary_student_id
left join
<student_phone> as student_phone
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_phone.primary_student_id
left join
<student_prior_college> as student_prior_college
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_prior_college.primary_student_id
left join
<student_test_scores> as student_test_scores
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_test_scores.primary_student_id
left join
<student_term_application> as student_term_application
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_term_application.primary_student_id
and student_program.program = student_term_application.school_program		 
left join
<student_race> as student_race
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_race.primary_student_id
left join
<student> as student
on student_program.primary_student_id = student.primary_student_id
left join
<student_race_multiracial> as race_multiracial
on student_program.primary_student_id = race_multiracial.primary_student_id
where  substring(coalesce(student_term_application.eab_entry_year_academic, student_program.eab_entry_year_academic), 1, 4) not in ('', 'Unma')

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

left join

left join
<student_email> as student_email
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_email.primary_student_id
left join
<student_phone> as student_phone

left join

left join

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

coalesce(student_race.ethnicity_5,'0') as ethnicity_5,
coalesce(student_race.ethnicity_6,'0') as ethnicity_6,

NULL as analysis_custom_field2,
NULL as analysis_custom_field3,
NULL as analysis_custom_field4,
NULL as analysis_custom_field5,
NULL as custom_segment_1,
NULL as custom_segment_2,
NULL as custom_segment_3,
NULL as custom_segment_4
from <[ALR].[Student Program].{final}> as student_program
left join
<student_address> as student_address
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_address.primary_student_id
left join
<[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{Countries}> as countries
on student_address.country_name = countries.eab_common_country_name		 
left join
<student_email> as student_email
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_email.primary_student_id
left join
<student_phone> as student_phone
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_phone.primary_student_id
left join
<student_prior_college> as student_prior_college
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_prior_college.primary_student_id
left join
<student_test_scores> as student_test_scores
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_test_scores.primary_student_id
left join
<student_term_application> as student_term_application
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_term_application.primary_student_id
and student_program.program = student_term_application.school_program		 
left join
<student_race> as student_race
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_race.primary_student_id
left join
<student> as student
on student_program.primary_student_id = student.primary_student_id
left join
<student_race_multiracial> as race_multiracial
on student_program.primary_student_id = race_multiracial.primary_student_id
where  substring(coalesce(student_term_application.eab_entry_year_academic, student_program.eab_entry_year_academic), 1, 4) not in ('', 'Unma') and substring(coalesce(lower(student_term_application.eab_entry_term), lower(student_program.eab_entry_term)), 1, 2) in ('fa', 'su', 'sp', 'wi') and
substring(coalesce(student_term_application.eab_entry_year_academic, student_program.eab_entry_year_academic), 1, 4) >= cast(substring(CURRENT_DATE(), 1, 4) as varchar) and
student_program.audience_code = 'SUS' and
substring(student.origin_source_dt,1,7) >= cast((year(getdate())||'-'||lpad(month(getdate()),2,'0')) as varchar)

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

year(cast(student.birth_dt as date)) as birth_year,

lpad(day(cast(student.birth_dt as date)),2,'0') as birth_day,

substring(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(trim(student_address.city),'[^[:ascii:]]',''),chr(0),' '),chr(10),' '),chr(13),' '),',',' '),'"',' '),'[^a-zA-Z]',' '),1,100) as city,
case when countries.alpha_3_code = 'USA' then 
case
when student_address.state = 'Alabama' then 'AL'
when student_address.state = 'Alaska' then 'AK'
when student_address.state = 'Arizona' then 'AZ'
when student_address.state = 'Arkansas' then 'AR'
when student_address.state = 'California' then 'CA'

when student_address.state = 'Connecticut' then 'CT'
when student_address.state = 'Delaware' then 'DE'
when student_address.state = 'District of Columbia' then 'DC'
when student_address.state = 'Florida' then 'FL'
when student_address.state = 'Georgia' then 'GA'
when student_address.state = 'Hawaii' then 'HI'
when student_address.state = 'Idaho' then 'ID'
when student_address.state = 'Illinois' then 'IL'
when student_address.state = 'Indiana' then 'IN'
when student_address.state = 'Iowa' then 'IA'
when student_address.state = 'Kansas' then 'KS'
when student_address.state = 'Kentucky' then 'KY'
when student_address.state = 'Louisiana' then 'LA'
when student_address.state = 'Maine' then 'ME'
when student_address.state = 'Maryland' then 'MD'
when student_address.state = 'Massachusetts' then 'MA'
when student_address.state = 'Michigan' then 'MI'
when student_address.state = 'Minnesota' then 'MN'
when student_address.state = 'Mississippi' then 'MS'
when student_address.state = 'Missouri' then 'MO'
when student_address.state = 'Montana' then 'MT'

when student_address.state = 'New Mexico' then 'NM'
when student_address.state = 'New York' then 'NY'
when student_address.state = 'North Carolina' then 'NC'
when student_address.state = 'North Dakota' then 'ND'
when student_address.state = 'Ohio' then 'OH'
when student_address.state = 'Oklahoma' then 'OK'
when student_address.state = 'Oregon' then 'OR'
when student_address.state = 'Pennsylvania' then 'PA'
when student_address.state = 'Rhode Island' then 'RI'
when student_address.state = 'South Carolina' then 'SC'
when student_address.state = 'South Dakota' then 'SD'
when student_address.state = 'Tennessee' then 'TN'

else substring(student_address.state,1,2) end else null end as state,

countries.alpha_3_code as country_name,
substring(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(trim(student_email.email_address),'[^[:ascii:]]',''),chr(0),' '),chr(10),' '),chr(13),' '),',',' '),'"',' '),1,100) as email_address,
case when length(regexp_replace(student_phone.cell_phone,'[^0-9]','')) = 10 then regexp_replace(student_phone.cell_phone,'[^0-9]','') 
	when length(regexp_replace(student_phone.cell_phone,'[^0-9]','')) = 11 and substr(regexp_replace(student_phone.cell_phone,'[^0-9]',''),1,1) = '1' then substr(regexp_replace(student_phone.cell_phone,'[^0-9]','') ,2,10)

	when length(regexp_replace(student_phone.home_phone,'[^0-9]','')) = 11 and substr(regexp_replace(student_phone.home_phone,'[^0-9]',''),1,1) = '1' then substr(regexp_replace(student_phone.home_phone,'[^0-9]','') ,2,10)
else null end as home_phone,

NULL as previous_college_grad_year_2,
NULL as previous_college_grad_year_3,
substring(split_part(student_test_scores.gre_comp_score,'.',1),1,5) as gre_comp_score,
substring(split_part(student_test_scores.gmat_comp_score,'.',1),1,5) as gmat_comp_score,
substring(split_part(student_test_scores.lsat_comp_score,'.',1),1,5) as lsat_comp_score,

left join

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

--generic staging field 01 should be bound to partner InqStatus field.  Panto often auto-binds the enroll term and we have to remove the bindings that were auto-generated.

select
CONCAT(TRY_TO_DATE(ADMIT_DATE),' 00:00:00') ADMIT_DATE
--,ADDRESS_LINE_1
,substring(regexp_replace(ADDRESS_LINE_1, ',', ' '), 1, 50) as ADDRESS_LINE_1
--,ADDRESS_LINE_2
,substring(regexp_replace(ADDRESS_LINE_2, ',', ' '), 1, 50) as ADDRESS_LINE_2
--,ADMIT_SOURCE_VALUE 
,ADMIT_INDICATOR
,ANALYSIS_CUSTOM_FIELD_1
,ANALYSIS_CUSTOM_FIELD_2
,ANALYSIS_CUSTOM_FIELD_3
,ANALYSIS_CUSTOM_FIELD_4
,ANALYSIS_CUSTOM_FIELD_5
,CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('Undergraduate',ENTRY_YEAR_SOURCE_VALUE) > 0 AND SCHOOL_PROGRAM NOT IN ('Education:  Driver & Safety Ed 5-12 Endorsement - Undergraduate Level') AND SUBSTRING(ENTRY_TERM_SOURCE_VALUE,CHARINDEX(' ', ENTRY_TERM_SOURCE_VALUE, 2)+1,4) >= '2021' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END INCLUDE_IN_ANALYSIS
,CONCAT(TRY_TO_DATE(APPLICATION_COMPLETION_DATE),' 00:00:00') APPLICATION_COMPLETION_DATE
,APPLICATION_START_DATE
,CONCAT(TRY_TO_DATE(APPLICATION_SUBMIT_DATE),' 00:00:00') APPLICATION_SUBMIT_DATE
,APPLICATION_TYPE
,APPLICATION_TYPE_SOURCE_VALUE
,CASE 
	WHEN GENERIC_STAGING_FIELD_01 IN ('Admit','Enrolled','Application Submitted','Application Complete') OR WITHDRAWN_SOURCE_VALUE = 1 THEN 'PAPPL'
	WHEN (CHARINDEX('First Year',STUDENT_TYPE_SOURCE_VALUE) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('Transfer',STUDENT_TYPE_SOURCE_VALUE) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('Readmit',STUDENT_TYPE_SOURCE_VALUE) > 0) AND GENERIC_STAGING_FIELD_01 = 'Application Started' AND (CHARINDEX(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()),ENTRY_TERM_SOURCE_VALUE) > 0 OR CHARINDEX((YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())-1),ENTRY_TERM_SOURCE_VALUE) > 0) THEN 'APPSTART'
	WHEN (CHARINDEX('First Year',STUDENT_TYPE_SOURCE_VALUE) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('Transfer',STUDENT_TYPE_SOURCE_VALUE) > 0 OR CHARINDEX('Readmit',STUDENT_TYPE_SOURCE_VALUE) > 0) AND GENERIC_STAGING_FIELD_01 = 'Inquiry' AND (INQUIRY_DATE IS NULL OR TRY_TO_DATE(INQUIRY_DATE) > '2018-01-01') THEN 'INQ'
	ELSE NULL END as AUDIENCE_CODE
,SUBSTRING(BIRTH_DAY,4,2) BIRTH_DAY
,LEFT(BIRTH_MONTH,2) BIRTH_MONTH
,RIGHT(BIRTH_YEAR,4) BIRTH_YEAR
,CAMPAIGN_YEAR
,CAMPUS_SOURCE_VALUE CAMPUS
,CAMPUS_TYPE
,HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB_CODE
,CASE WHEN LEN(REGEXP_REPLACE(CELL_PHONE,'[^0-9]','')) = 10 THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(CELL_PHONE,'[^0-9]','') ELSE NULL END CELL_PHONE
--,CITY
,substring(regexp_replace(city, ',', ' '), 1, 25) as city
,NULL CLIENT_FILE_NAME
,LEFT(SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID_FOR_THE_PERSON,30) SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID_FOR_THE_PERSON
,COHORT_DESC

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

,case when COUNTRY_NAME != 'usa' then null else replace(state,'"','') end as state

,case when nullif(b.SUBMITTED_APPLICATION_SOURCE_VALUE,'""') is not null then '1' else '0' end as submitted_application_indicator

,case when length(substr(replace(withdraw_date,'"',''),1,19)) = 19 then substr(replace(withdraw_date,'"',''),7,4) || '-' || substr(replace(withdraw_date,'"',''),1,2) || '-' ||   substr(replace(withdraw_date,'"',''),4,2) || ' 00:00:00' else null end as withdraw_date

	(																			
	(	ifnull(b.GENERIC_STAGING_FIELD_05,'"Undergraduate"') = '"Undergraduate"'

	(	ifnull(b.GENERIC_STAGING_FIELD_05,'"Undergraduate"') = '"Undergraduate"'

	 	and b.GENERIC_STAGING_FIELD_06 is null

		   --and withdraw_date is not null
--) x group by x.audience_code

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

when b.race_3 = '1' then 'b'

,b.mcat_exam_date
,b.middle_name

,b.nch_file_indicator
,b.opt_out_indicator
,b.other_audience_indicator
,b.other_exam_date
,b.other_exam_identifier
,b.other_exam_score
,b.parent_email

,b.parent_last_name
,b.eab_id_from_partner
,b.pcat_account_identifier
,b.pcat_comp_score
,b.pcat_exam_date
,b.preferred_name
,b.prefix
,b.previous_college_ceeb_code_1
,b.previous_college_ceeb_code_2
,b.previous_college_ceeb_code_3
,b.previous_college_gpa_1
,b.previous_college_gpa_2
,b.previous_college_gpa_3
,b.previous_college_grad_year
,b.previous_college_grad_year_1
,b.previous_college_grad_year_2
,b.previous_college_grad_year_3
,b.previous_college_major
,b.previous_college_name_1
,b.previous_college_name_2
,b.previous_college_name_3
,b.previously_enrolled_indicator
,b.high_school_gpa
,b.hispanic_latino
,b.school_concentration
,b.school_identifier
,b.school_name
,b.school_of_study
,regexp_replace(b.school_program, '[^a-zA-Z]',' ') as school_program
,b.started_application_indicator
,b.state
,b.student_type
,b.student_type_source_value
,b.submitted_application_indicator
,b.suffix
,b.text_message_opt_out_indicator
,b.us_citizenship_status
,substr(b.withdraw_date,1,19) as withdraw_date
,b.withdrawn_indicator
,b.years_employed
,b.young_alumni_indicator
,b.zip5																			
from
<[ALR].[Suspects]> b							   
where 
nullif(b.STARTED_APPLICATION_SOURCE_VALUE,'') is null
and b.EMAIL_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR = 'FALSE'
and b.generic_staging_field_02 = 'FALSE'
and b.email_address is not null	
and b.email_address not like '%edu%'																					
and b.email_address like '%@%'		
and b.email_address like '%.%'																						
and b.first_name not like '%test%'
and b.first_name not like '%Test%'
and REGEXP_LIKE(b.first_name, '[a-zA-Z]{3}.*') = TRUE
and b.last_name not like '%test%'
and b.last_name not like '%Test%'
and REGEXP_LIKE(b.last_name, '[a-zA-Z]{3}.*') = TRUE																				
and																				
try_to_date('20'||substr(split_part(b.generic_staging_field_01, '/', 3),1,2)||'-'||lpad(split_part(b.generic_staging_field_01, '/', 1),2,'0')||'-'||lpad(split_part(b.generic_staging_field_01, '/', 2),2,'0')||' 00:00:01') < DATEADD(Day ,-547, current_date)
																				
and																			
try_to_date('20'||substr(split_part(b.generic_staging_field_01, '/', 3),1,2)||'-'||lpad(split_part(b.generic_staging_field_01, '/', 1),2,'0')||'-'||lpad(split_part(b.generic_staging_field_01, '/', 2),2,'0')||' 00:00:01') > DATEADD(Day ,-701, current_date)		
order by b.generic_staging_field_01	desc	
limit 2000 offset 8000
--) c group by c.audience_code
						
;

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

	when sta.application_id is not null then 'app exists'
	else 'app does not exist'
	end as app_exists_ind
from <[Enroll360].[Student Term].{final}> as st
left outer join <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application].{final}> as sta 
	on st.primary_student_id = sta.primary_student_id
	and st.eab_entry_year_academic = sta.eab_entry_year_academic
	and st.eab_entry_term = sta.eab_entry_term
	and st.eab_student_type = sta.eab_student_type
where 1=1
and st.eab_entry_year_academic in ('2021','2022')
  ) x 
group by recruitment_status, app_exists_ind
  order by recruitment_status, app_exists_ind



select app_start_ind, student_type, count(*) as ct
from <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application].{final}> stud_term_app
group by app_start_ind, student_type
order by app_start_ind, student_type


--Term file example
--select *
select count(*)
from "54543_388316" a
where a.PANTO_FILE_ID = 139738740
and student_type like '%Freshman%'
--and a.curr_entry_year_academic in (2019,2020,2021,2022)
and a.recruitment_status = 'Inquiry'

Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.sqlPreview: select case when student_program.audience_code is not null or student_program.audience_code != '' then '1' else '0' end as marketing_ind, case when student_prog…
queryResults.querySql:
select
case when student_program.audience_code is not null or student_program.audience_code != '' then '1' else '0' end as marketing_ind,
case when student_program.audience_code is not null or student_program.audience_code != '' then '1' else '0' end as analysis_ind,
'0' as young_alumni_ind,
'0' as current_undergrad_college_senior_ind,
case when substring(upper(student_program.audience_code),1,3) = 'NSC'  then '1' else '0' end as nch_file_ind,
null as partner_eab_id,
<school_id> as school_id,
<school_name> as school_name,
student.client_file_name,
'0' as campaign_year,
substring(student_program.primary_student_id,1,30) as client_id,
substring(student.fname,1,50) as first_name,
substring(student.mname,1,50) as middle_name,
substring(student.lname,1,50) as last_name,
substring(student.preferred_fname,1,50) as preferred_name,
substring(student.prefix,1,6) as prefix,
substring(student.suffix,1,6) as suffix,
case when substring(student.eab_pref_gender,1,1) = 'F' then 'F'
	when substring(student.eab_pref_gender,1,1) = 'M' then 'M' else 'U' end as gender,
year(cast(student.birth_dt as date)) as birth_year,
lpad(month(cast(student.birth_dt as date)),2,'0') as birth_month,
lpad(day(cast(student.birth_dt as date)),2,'0') as birth_day,
substring(student.us_citizenship_status,1,50) as us_citizenship_status,
case when student.eab_ethnicity = 'Hispanic or Latino/a/e/x' then '1' else '0' end as race_hispanic_latino,
case when student.sms_optout_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end as txt_opt_out_ind,
case when student.eab_opt_out_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end as opt_out_ind,
case when student.eab_email_optout_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end as email_opt_out_ind,
case when student.eab_mail_optout_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end as mail_opt_out_ind,
case when student_program.eab_inquiry_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end as inquiry_ind,
substring(student_program.inquiry_date,1,19) as inquiry_date,
substring(student.origin_source,1,20) as first_source_desc,
substring(student.origin_source,1,20) as first_source_src,
substring(student.employer,1,100) as employer,
case when eab_military_veteran_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end as military_service_status,
substring(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(trim(student_address.address_line_1),'[^[:ascii:]]',''),chr(0),' '),chr(10),' '),chr(13),' '),',',' '),'"',' '),'[^0-9a-zA-Z]',' '),1,100) as address_1,
substring(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(trim(student_address.address_line_2),'[^[:ascii:]]',''),chr(0),' '),chr(10),' '),chr(13),' '),',',' '),'"',' '),'[^0-9a-zA-Z]',' '),1,100) as address_2,
substring(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(trim(student_address.city),'[^[:ascii:]]',''),chr(0),' '),chr(10),' '),chr(13),' '),',',' '),'"',' '),'[^a-zA-Z]',' '),1,100) as city,
substring(student_address.state,1,2) as state,
lpad(substring(try_to_number(student_address.zip5),1,5),5,'0') as zip5,
countries.alpha_3_code as country_name,
substring(student_email.email_address,1,100) as email_address,
case when length(regexp_replace(student_phone.cell_phone,'[^0-9]','')) = 10 then regexp_replace(student_phone.cell_phone,'[^0-9]','') 
	when length(regexp_replace(student_phone.cell_phone,'[^0-9]','')) = 11 and substr(regexp_replace(student_phone.cell_phone,'[^0-9]',''),1,1) = '1' then substr(regexp_replace(student_phone.cell_phone,'[^0-9]','') ,2,10)
else null end as cell_phone,		 
case when length(regexp_replace(student_phone.home_phone,'[^0-9]','')) = 10 then regexp_replace(student_phone.home_phone,'[^0-9]','') 
	when length(regexp_replace(student_phone.home_phone,'[^0-9]','')) = 11 and substr(regexp_replace(student_phone.home_phone,'[^0-9]',''),1,1) = '1' then substr(regexp_replace(student_phone.home_phone,'[^0-9]','') ,2,10)
else null end as home_phone,
coalesce(substring(student_term_application.curr_entry_year_academic,1,4),substring(student_program.curr_entry_year_academic,1,4)) as entry_year_src,
NULL as previous_college_grad_year,
NULL as gmat_major,
substring(student_prior_college.previous_college_major,1,50) as previous_college_major,
right(student_prior_college.previous_college_ceeb_cd_1,4) as previous_college_ceeb_cd_1,
right(student_prior_college.previous_college_ceeb_cd_2,4) as previous_college_ceeb_cd_2,
right(student_prior_college.previous_college_ceeb_cd_3,4) as previous_college_ceeb_cd_3,
substring(student_prior_college.previous_college_name_1,50) as previous_college_name_1,
substring(student_prior_college.previous_college_name_2,50) as previous_college_name_2,
substring(student_prior_college.previous_college_name_3,50) as previous_college_name_3,
try_to_decimal(student_prior_college.previous_college_gpa_1,5,2) as previous_college_gpa_1,
try_to_decimal(student_prior_college.previous_college_gpa_2,5,2) as previous_college_gpa_2,
try_to_decimal(student_prior_college.previous_college_gpa_3,5,2) as previous_college_gpa_3,
NULL as previous_college_grad_year_1,
NULL as previous_college_grad_year_2,
NULL as previous_college_grad_year_3,
substring(split_part(student_test_scores.gre_comp_score,'.',1),1,5) as gre_comp_score,
substring(split_part(student_test_scores.gmat_comp_score,'.',1),1,5) as gmat_comp_score,
substring(split_part(student_test_scores.lsat_comp_score,'.',1),1,5) as lsat_comp_score,
substring(split_part(student_test_scores.other_exam_score,'.',1),1,5) as other_exam_score,
substring(split_part(student_test_scores.mcat_comp_score,'.',1),1,5) as mcat_comp_score,
substring(split_part(student_test_scores.pcat_comp_score,'.',1),1,5) as pcat_comp_score,
try_to_date(student_test_scores.gmat_test_dt,'MM/dd/yyyy') as gmat_test_dt,
try_to_date(student_test_scores.lsat_exam_dt,'MM/dd/yyyy') as lsat_exam_dt,
try_to_date(student_test_scores.pcat_exam_dt,'MM/dd/yyyy') as pcat_exam_dt,
try_to_date(student_test_scores.other_exam_dt,'MM/dd/yyyy') as other_exam_dt,
try_to_date(student_test_scores.mcat_exam_dt,'MM/dd/yyyy') as mcat_exam_dt,
try_to_date(student_test_scores.gre_exam_dt,'MM/dd/yyyy') as gre_exam_dt,
NULL as ceeb_cd,
NULL as years_employed,
case when student_term_application.started_application_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end as started_application_ind,
case when student_term_application.submitted_application_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end  as submitted_application_ind,
case when student_term_application.completed_application_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end  as completed_application_ind,
case when student_term_application.admit_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end  as admit_ind,
case when student_term_application.denied_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end  as denied_ind,
case when student_term_application.deposit_2_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end  as deposit_2_ind,
case when student_term_application.enroll_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end  as enrolled_ind,
case when student_term_application.defer_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end  as defer_ind,
case when student_term_application.withdrawn_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end  as withdrawn_ind,
substring(student_term_application.application_submit_dt,1,19) as application_submit_dt,
substring(student_term_application.application_start_dt,1,19) as application_start_dt,
substring(student_term_application.application_completion_dt,1,19) as application_completion_dt,
substring(student_term_application.accept_dt,1,19) as accept_dt,
substring(student_term_application.deposit_2_dt,1,19) as deposit_2_dt,
case when student_term_application.deposit_ind = 'true' then '1' else '0' end as deposit_ind,
substring(student_term_application.deposit_dt,1,19) as deposit_dt,
substring(student_term_application.enroll_dt,1,19) as enroll_dt,
substring(student_term_application.withdraw_dt,1,19) as withdraw_dt,
substring(student_term_application.eab_app_type,1,50) as application_type,
substring(student_term_application.application_type,1,50) as application_type_src,
NULL as decision_type,
substring(student_term_application.campus,1,100) as campus,
NULL as campus_type,
substring(coalesce(student_term_application.eab_entry_year_academic,student_program.eab_entry_year_academic),1,4) as entry_year,
substring(coalesce(lower(student_term_application.eab_entry_term),lower(student_program.eab_entry_term)),1,2) as entry_term,
coalesce(student_term_application.curr_entry_term,student_program.curr_entry_term) as entry_term_src,
substring(student_term_application.cohort_desc,1,50) as cohort_desc,
coalesce(substring(upper(student_term_application.eab_student_type),1,1),substring(upper(student_program.eab_student_type),1,1)) as student_type,
coalesce(substring(student_term_application.student_type,1,50),substring(student_program.student_type,1,50)) as student_type_src,
substring(coalesce(upper(student_term_application.degree_type),upper(student_program.degree_type)),1,50) as degree_type_src,
coalesce(substring(upper(student_term_application.eab_degree_type),1,2),substring(upper(student_program.eab_degree_type),1,2)) as degree_type,
substring(student_term_application.enroll_type,1,3) as enroll_type,
substring(student_term_application.full_part_time,1,1) as full_part_time,
coalesce(substring(student_term_application.school_program,1,64),substring(student_program.program,1,64)) as school_program,
substring(student_term_application.school_concentration,1,50) as school_concentration,
substring(student_term_application.school_of_study,1,50) as school_of_study,
'0' as previous_enrolled_ind,
case when lower(student_program.audience_code) = 'other'  then '1' else '0' end as other_audience_ind,
NULL as gre_major,
NULL as lsat_account_id,
NULL as other_exam_id,
NULL as pcat_account_id,
NULL as mcat_account_id,
NULL as income,
NULL as previous_hs_gpa,
NULL as lead_eligible_for_marketing_export_ind,
NULL as lead_eligible_for_partner_analysis_ind,
student_program.audience_code as audience_cd,
substring(student_race.ethnicity,1,50) as ethnicity,
coalesce(student_race.ethnicity_2,'0') as ethnicity_2,
coalesce(student_race.ethnicity_3,'0') as ethnicity_3,
coalesce(student_race.ethnicity_4,'0') as ethnicity_4,
coalesce(student_race.ethnicity_5,'0') as ethnicity_5,
coalesce(student_race.ethnicity_6,'0') as ethnicity_6,
case when race_multiracial.primary_student_id is not null then 'M' 
when student_race.ethnicity_2 = '1' then 'A' 
when student_race.ethnicity_3 = '1' then 'B' 
when student_race.ethnicity_4 = '1' then 'C' 
when student_race.ethnicity_5 = '1' then 'B' 
when student_race.ethnicity_6 = '1' then 'E' 		 
else 'U' end as ethnicity_rollup,
NULL as parent_first_name,
NULL as parent_last_name,
NULL as parent_email,
NULL as file_received_from_partner_dt,
NULL as analysis_custom_field1,
NULL as analysis_custom_field2,
NULL as analysis_custom_field3,
NULL as analysis_custom_field4,
NULL as analysis_custom_field5,
NULL as custom_segment_1,
NULL as custom_segment_2,
NULL as custom_segment_3,
NULL as custom_segment_4
from <[ALR].[Student Program].{final}> as student_program
left join
<student_address> as student_address
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_address.primary_student_id
left join
<[ALR].[Partner Code Mapping].{Countries}> as countries
on student_address.country_name = countries.eab_common_country_name		 
left join
<student_email> as student_email
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_email.primary_student_id
left join
<student_phone> as student_phone
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_phone.primary_student_id
left join
<student_prior_college> as student_prior_college
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_prior_college.primary_student_id
left join
<student_test_scores> as student_test_scores
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_test_scores.primary_student_id
left join
<student_term_application> as student_term_application
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_term_application.primary_student_id
and student_program.program = student_term_application.school_program		 
left join
<student_race> as student_race
on student_program.primary_student_id = student_race.primary_student_id
left join
<student> as student
on student_program.primary_student_id = student.primary_student_id
left join
<student_race_multiracial> as race_multiracial
on student_program.primary_student_id = race_multiracial.primary_student_id
where  substring(coalesce(student_term_application.eab_entry_year_academic, student_program.eab_entry_year_academic), 1, 4) not in ('', 'Unma') and substring(coalesce(lower(student_term_application.eab_entry_term), lower(student_program.eab_entry_term)), 1, 2) in ('fa', 'su', 'sp', 'wi') and
student_program.audience_code in ('INQ', 'SUS', 'APPSTART')

b.partner_file_name,

select

,application_type
,application_type_source_value
,'YGALUM' as audience_code

,source_system_id_for_the_person

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

-- #terukula 09/15 AMS-64 V0.1 created query to populate donor in AMS
-- #terukula 09/21 AMS-64 V0.1 Added donor_status_partner column
-- #terukula 10/21/2022 AMS-182 V0.1 Added pledge_status_partner,Mailing Addressee Name and athletic_donation_status_partner columns
-- #kkhanuja 10/21/2022 AMS-175 V0.1 Added ask_partner column
--syeravadekar 11/06 Added hh_primary , salutation_partner_mail and salutation_partner_email
--syeravadekar added variable to tenant bundle for contact_optout_ind
--parasu 12/8  updated entity to donor
--spatole 12/16 Added default value for deceased indicator
-------kkhanuja 12/16 removing _partner

with shared_emails as (
select distinct src_donor_id from <[AMS].[donor_email].{final}> as de
where email in 
(
select email from <[AMS].[donor_email].{final}> as de
where (email not in ('') or email is not null)
group by email having count(*)>1  
)
)

SELECT
  CAST(donor.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
  CAST(donor.<donor category code> AS VARCHAR) AS donor_category_cd,
  CAST(dc.donor_category_desc AS VARCHAR) AS donor_category_desc,
  coalesce(CAST(ect.eab_contact_type AS VARCHAR),'Unknown') AS eab_contact_type,
  CAST(donor.<gender> AS VARCHAR) AS gender,
  try_cast(donor.<birth Date> as timestamp) AS birth_dt,
  CAST(coalesce(donor.<donor deceased indicator>, False) AS BOOLEAN) AS donor_deceased_ind,
  CAST(donor.<donor joint mailing indicator> AS BOOLEAN) AS donor_joint_mailing_ind,
  CAST(donor.<individual salutation> AS VARCHAR) AS individual_salutation,
  CAST(donor.<joint salutation> AS VARCHAR) AS joint_salutation,
  CAST(donor.<donor status> AS VARCHAR) AS donor_status,
  CAST(donor.<first name> AS VARCHAR) AS fname,
  CAST(donor.<last name> AS VARCHAR) AS lname,
  CAST(donor.<middle name> AS VARCHAR) AS mname,
  CAST(donor.<prefix> AS VARCHAR) AS prefix,
  CAST(donor.<suffix> AS VARCHAR) AS suffix,
  CAST(donor.<nickname> AS VARCHAR) AS nickname,
  CAST(np.preferred_full_name AS VARCHAR) AS preferred_full_name,
  CAST(np.preferred_joint_name AS VARCHAR) AS preferred_joint_name,
  CAST(donor.<preferred joint name second> AS VARCHAR) AS  preferred_joint_name_second,
  CAST(donor.<spouse id> AS VARCHAR) AS  spouse_id,
  CAST(donor.<audience segment code>AS VARCHAR) AS audience_segment_cd,
  CAST(donor.<giving society name> AS VARCHAR) AS giving_society_name,
  CAST(donor.<giving officer name> AS VARCHAR) AS giving_officer_name,
  CAST(nc.email_optout_ind AS VARCHAR) AS email_optout_ind,
  CAST(nc.mail_optout_ind AS VARCHAR) AS mail_optout_ind,
  CAST(nc.solicit_optout_ind AS VARCHAR) AS solicit_optout_ind,
  CAST(nc.contact_optout_ind AS VARCHAR) AS contact_optout_ind,
sp.salutation_mail as salutation_mail,
sp.salutation_email as salutation_email,
-- CAST(hhprimary.hh_primary as boolean) as hh_primary,
case when donor.src_donor_id in (select src_donor_id from shared_emails) and donor.intake_date < (select max(intake_date) from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as dd) then cast('false' as boolean) else cast(hhprimary.hh_primary as boolean) end as hh_primary,
DECODE(replace(replace(replace(LOWER(CAST(nc.email_optout_ind AS VARCHAR)),' ','<>'),'><',''),'<>',' '),'0','False','FALSE','False','False','False','false','False','1','True','TRUE','True','True','True','true','True','no email','True', 'False') AS eab_email_optout_ind,
  DECODE(replace(replace(replace(LOWER(CAST(nc.mail_optout_ind AS VARCHAR)),' ','<>'),'><',''),'<>',' '),'0','False','FALSE','False','False','False','false','False','1','True','TRUE','True','True','True','true','True','no mail','True', 'False') AS eab_mail_optout_ind,
  DECODE(replace(replace(replace(LOWER(CAST(nc.solicit_optout_ind AS VARCHAR)),' ','<>'),'><',''),'<>',' '),'0','False','FALSE','False','False','False','false','False','1','True','TRUE','True','True','True','true','True','no solicit','True', 'False') AS eab_solicit_optout_ind,
  DECODE(replace(replace(replace(LOWER(CAST(nc.contact_optout_ind AS VARCHAR)),' ','<>'),'><',''),'<>',' '),'0','False','FALSE','False','False','False','false','False','1','True','TRUE','True','True','True','true','True','no contact','True', 'False') AS eab_contact_optout_ind,
  CAST(donor.<intake date> AS VARCHAR) AS intake_dt,
  CAST (case WHEN regexp_like( donor.<Ask>,'[a-zA-Z]+')
		then regexp_replace( donor.<Ask>,'[a-zA-Z]+', 0)
		else regexp_replace(donor.<Ask>,'[^0-9.]', '') end AS FLOAT) AS ask,
  DECODE(CAST(donor.<Pledge Status> AS VARCHAR),'0','False','FALSE','False','False','False','false','False','1','True','TRUE','True','True','True','true','True', null) AS pledge_status,
  CAST(donor.<Athletic Donation Status> AS VARCHAR) AS athletic_donation_status,
  CAST(donor.<Mailing Addressee Name> AS VARCHAR) AS mailing_addressee_name
FROM <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> AS donor
LEFT JOIN <salutation_partner> as sp ON
donor.src_donor_id = sp.src_donor_id
LEFT JOIN  <hh_primary>  as hhprimary
on hhprimary.src_donor_id = donor.src_donor_id
LEFT JOIN <no_contact> as nc ON
donor.src_donor_id = nc.src_donor_id
LEFT JOIN <name_preferred> as np ON
donor.src_donor_id = np.src_donor_id
LEFT JOIN <donor_category> as dc ON
donor.src_donor_id = dc.src_donor_id
LEFT JOIN <eab_contact_type> as ect ON
donor.src_donor_id = ect.src_donor_id
where CAST(donor.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
