-- #terukula 09/15 AMS-64 V0.1 created query to populate donor in AMS
-- #terukula 09/21 AMS-64 V0.1 Added donor_status_partner column
-- #terukula 10/21/2022 AMS-182 V0.1 Added pledge_status_partner,Mailing Addressee Name and athletic_donation_status_partner columns
-- #kkhanuja 10/21/2022 AMS-175 V0.1 Added ask_partner column
--syeravadekar 11/06 Added hh_primary , salutation_partner_mail and salutation_partner_email
--syeravadekar added variable to tenant bundle for contact_optout_ind
--parasu 12/8  updated entity to donor
--spatole 12/16 Added default value for deceased indicator
-------kkhanuja 12/16 removing _partner
--add distinct as the query can create duplicates when a spouse can be associated to more than 1 donor -- temporary until better SQL is ready -- dhicks 10/17/2024
--gsudhakar 04/16/2025 Moved pledge status logic to bindings. Marked tenant query as Inactive and switched donor.final to master version
SELECT distinct
  CAST(donor.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
  CAST(donor.<donor category code> AS VARCHAR) AS donor_category_cd,
  CAST(dc.donor_category_desc AS VARCHAR) AS donor_category_desc,
  coalesce(CAST(ect.eab_contact_type AS VARCHAR),'Unknown') AS eab_contact_type,
  CAST(donor.<gender> AS VARCHAR) AS gender,
  try_cast(donor.<birth Date> as timestamp) AS birth_dt,
  CAST(coalesce(donor.<donor deceased indicator>, False) AS BOOLEAN) AS donor_deceased_ind,
  CAST(donor.<donor joint mailing indicator> AS BOOLEAN) AS donor_joint_mailing_ind,
  CAST(donor.<individual salutation> AS VARCHAR) AS individual_salutation,
  CAST(donor.<joint salutation> AS VARCHAR) AS joint_salutation,
  CAST(donor.<donor status> AS VARCHAR) AS donor_status,
  CAST(donor.<first name> AS VARCHAR) AS fname,
  CAST(donor.<last name> AS VARCHAR) AS lname,
  CAST(donor.<middle name> AS VARCHAR) AS mname,
  CAST(donor.<prefix> AS VARCHAR) AS prefix,
  CAST(donor.<suffix> AS VARCHAR) AS suffix,
  CAST(donor.<nickname> AS VARCHAR) AS nickname,
  CAST(np.preferred_full_name AS VARCHAR) AS preferred_full_name,
  CAST(np.preferred_joint_name AS VARCHAR) AS preferred_joint_name,
  CAST(donor.<preferred joint name second> AS VARCHAR) AS  preferred_joint_name_second,
  CAST(donor.<spouse id> AS VARCHAR) AS  spouse_id,
  CAST(donor.<audience segment code>AS VARCHAR) AS audience_segment_cd,
  CAST(donor.<giving society name> AS VARCHAR) AS giving_society_name,
  CAST(donor.<giving officer name> AS VARCHAR) AS giving_officer_name,
  CAST(nc.email_optout_ind AS VARCHAR) AS email_optout_ind,
  CAST(nc.mail_optout_ind AS VARCHAR) AS mail_optout_ind,
  CAST(nc.solicit_optout_ind AS VARCHAR) AS solicit_optout_ind,
  CAST(nc.contact_optout_ind AS VARCHAR) AS contact_optout_ind,
sp.salutation_mail as salutation_mail,
sp.salutation_email as salutation_email,
 CAST(hhprimary.hh_primary as boolean) as hh_primary,
  DECODE(replace(replace(replace(LOWER(CAST(nc.email_optout_ind AS VARCHAR)),' ','<>'),'><',''),'<>',' '),'0','False','FALSE','False','False','False','false','False','1','True','TRUE','True','True','True','true','True','no email','True', 'False') AS eab_email_optout_ind,
  DECODE(replace(replace(replace(LOWER(CAST(nc.mail_optout_ind AS VARCHAR)),' ','<>'),'><',''),'<>',' '),'0','False','FALSE','False','False','False','false','False','1','True','TRUE','True','True','True','true','True','no mail','True', 'False') AS eab_mail_optout_ind,
  DECODE(replace(replace(replace(LOWER(CAST(nc.solicit_optout_ind AS VARCHAR)),' ','<>'),'><',''),'<>',' '),'0','False','FALSE','False','False','False','false','False','1','True','TRUE','True','True','True','true','True','no solicit','True', 'False') AS eab_solicit_optout_ind,
  DECODE(replace(replace(replace(LOWER(CAST(nc.contact_optout_ind AS VARCHAR)),' ','<>'),'><',''),'<>',' '),'0','False','FALSE','False','False','False','false','False','1','True','TRUE','True','True','True','true','True','no contact','True', 'False') AS eab_contact_optout_ind,
  CAST(donor.<intake date> AS VARCHAR) AS intake_dt,
  CAST (case WHEN regexp_like( donor.<Ask>,'[a-zA-Z]+')
		then regexp_replace( donor.<Ask>,'[a-zA-Z]+', 0)
		else regexp_replace(donor.<Ask>,'[^0-9.]', '') end AS FLOAT) AS ask,
  --DECODE(CAST(donor.<Pledge Status> AS VARCHAR),'0','False','FALSE','False','False','False','false','False','1','True','TRUE','True','True','True','true','True', null) AS pledge_status,
  case when ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(pledge_status,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0)>0 then 'true' else 'false' end as pledge_status,				 
  CAST(donor.<Athletic Donation Status> AS VARCHAR) AS athletic_donation_status,
  CAST(donor.<Mailing Addressee Name> AS VARCHAR) AS mailing_addressee_name
FROM <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> AS donor
LEFT JOIN <salutation_partner> as sp ON
donor.src_donor_id = sp.src_donor_id
LEFT JOIN  <hh_primary>  as hhprimary
on hhprimary.src_donor_id = donor.src_donor_id
LEFT JOIN <no_contact> as nc ON
donor.src_donor_id = nc.src_donor_id
LEFT JOIN <name_preferred> as np ON
donor.src_donor_id = np.src_donor_id
LEFT JOIN <donor_category> as dc ON
donor.src_donor_id = dc.src_donor_id
LEFT JOIN <eab_contact_type> as ect ON
donor.src_donor_id = ect.src_donor_id
where CAST(donor.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL

/*2025-03-07: test for new Master updates, character stripping to align with E360, adding join extension variable - ccreekman*/
-- Kkhanuja 14/9/2022 V0.1 Query for moving Address details of donor from donor_source to  donor_address
-- Kkhanuja V0.1 06/10/2022 added  zip5 and zip4 logic
-- spatole 12/09 AMS-322 - Change references for source entities in the donor bound queries
-- csugguna 02/08 AMS-623 - Add logic to filter duplicate records from fulfillment population where addr1 have next line character
-- csugguna,syeravadekar,nvijayakumar 03/01 AMS-682 - Add logic to filter duplicate records from fulfillment population where addr1 have special character
-- csugguna,syeravadekar,nvijayakumar 03/02 AMS-682 -- Add updated logic to remove unicode characters

WITH cte_address AS (
SELECT
  nullif(trim(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR),'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS src_donor_id,
  CAST(donor_address.<addr type> AS VARCHAR) AS addr_type,
  nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<addr1> AS VARCHAR),'[\\s]',' '),'[[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS addr1,
  nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<addr2> AS VARCHAR),'[\\s]',' '),'[[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS addr2,
  nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<addr3> AS VARCHAR),'[\\s]',' '),'[[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'')  AS addr3,
  nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<addr4> AS VARCHAR),'[\\s]',' '),'[[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'')  AS addr4,
  nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<city> AS VARCHAR),'[\\s]',' '),'[[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'')  AS city,
  nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<state> AS VARCHAR),'[\\s]',' '),'[[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'')  AS state,
  nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<country> AS VARCHAR),'[\\s]',' '),'[[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'')  AS country,
  CASE
     WHEN CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR)  REGEXP  '[^0-9]+' then null
     WHEN LENGTH( CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR)) >= 5   AND donor_address.<zip5> like '%-%'
     THEN   split_part(CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR) , '-',  1)
     ELSE (nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR),'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''))
  END AS ZIP5,
  CASE
	 WHEN donor_address.<zip4> is not null THEN donor_address.<zip4> --PLD ADDED 7/28/2026
     WHEN CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR)  REGEXP  '[^0-9]+' then null
     WHEN LENGTH( CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR)) >= 5   AND donor_address.<zip5> like '%-%'
     THEN split_part(CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR) , '-',  2)
     ELSE NULL
  END AS ZIP4,
  CAST(donor_address.<effective date> AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY donor_address.src_donor_id,	CAST(regexp_replace(replace(replace(donor_address.<addr1>, char(10)), char(13)),'[^a-zA-Z 0-9]+') AS VARCHAR)  ORDER BY effective_date DESC) AS rn
FROM <[AMS].[donor_address].{fulfillment}> AS donor_address

<join_extension_donor_address>

where CAST(donor_address.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL
AND CAST(donor_address.<addr1> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL
)

SELECT
       src_donor_id,
       addr_type,
       addr1,
       addr2,
       addr3,
       addr4,
       city,
       state,
       country,
       ZIP5,
       ZIP4,
       effective_dt,
	   <source_partner_system_name_donor_address> as source_partner_system_name,
	   <source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
FROM cte_address
WHERE rn=1

-- csugguna,syeravadekar,nvijayakumar 03/01 AMS-682 - Add logic to filter duplicate records from fulfillment population where addr1 have special character
-- csugguna,syeravadekar,nvijayakumar 03/02 AMS-682 -- Add updated logic to remove unicode characters


WITH cte_address AS (
SELECT
  CAST(donor_address.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
  CAST(donor_address.<addr type> AS VARCHAR) AS addr_type,
  REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(donor_address.<addr1> AS VARCHAR),char(10)), char(13)) AS addr1,
  REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(donor_address.<addr2> AS VARCHAR),char(10)), char(13)) AS addr2,
  REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(donor_address.<addr3> AS VARCHAR),char(10)), char(13))  AS addr3,
  REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(donor_address.<addr4> AS VARCHAR),char(10)), char(13))  AS addr4,
  REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(donor_address.<city> AS VARCHAR),char(10)), char(13))  AS city,
  REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(donor_address.<state> AS VARCHAR),char(10)), char(13))  AS state,
  REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(donor_address.<country> As VARCHAR),char(10)), char(13))  AS country,
  CASE
     WHEN CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR)  REGEXP  '[^0-9]+' then null
     WHEN LENGTH( CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR)) >= 5   AND donor_address.<zip5> like '%-%'
     THEN   split_part(CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR) , '-',  1)
     ELSE ( CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR))
  END AS ZIP5,
  CASE
     WHEN CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR)  REGEXP  '[^0-9]+' then null
     WHEN LENGTH( CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR)) >= 5   AND donor_address.<zip5> like '%-%'
     THEN   split_part(CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR) , '-',  2)
     ELSE NULL
  END AS ZIP4,
  CAST(donor_address.<effective date> AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY donor_address.src_donor_id,	CAST(regexp_replace(replace(replace(donor_address.<addr1>, char(10)), char(13)),'[^a-zA-Z 0-9]+') AS VARCHAR)  ORDER BY effective_date DESC) AS rn
FROM <[AMS].[donor_address].{fulfillment}> AS donor_address
JOIN <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts on
donor_address.src_donor_id = ams_gifts.src_donor_id
where CAST(donor_address.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL
AND cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) is not null
AND CAST(donor_address.<addr1> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL
)

SELECT
       src_donor_id,
       addr_type,
       addr1,
       addr2,
       addr3,
       addr4,
       city,
       state,
       country,
       ZIP5,
       ZIP4,
       effective_dt
FROM cte_address
WHERE rn=1

-- Kkhanuja 14/9/2022 V0.1 Query for moving Address details of donor from donor_source to  donor_address
-- Kkhanuja V0.1 06/10/2022 added  zip5 and zip4 logic
-- spatole 12/09 AMS-322 - Change references for source entities in the donor bound queries
-- csugguna 02/08 AMS-623 - Add logic to filter duplicate records from fulfillment population where addr1 have next line character
-- csugguna,syeravadekar,nvijayakumar 03/01 AMS-682 - Add logic to filter duplicate records from fulfillment population where addr1 have special character
-- csugguna,syeravadekar,nvijayakumar 03/02 AMS-682 -- Add updated logic to remove unicode characters

WITH cte_address AS (
SELECT
  nullif(trim(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR),'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS src_donor_id,
  CAST(donor_address.<addr type> AS VARCHAR) AS addr_type,
  nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<addr1> AS VARCHAR),'[\\s]',' '),'[[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS addr1,
  nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<addr2> AS VARCHAR),'[\\s]',' '),'[[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS addr2,
  nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<addr3> AS VARCHAR),'[\\s]',' '),'[[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'')  AS addr3,
  nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<addr4> AS VARCHAR),'[\\s]',' '),'[[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'')  AS addr4,
  nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<city> AS VARCHAR),'[\\s]',' '),'[[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'')  AS city,
  nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<state> AS VARCHAR),'[\\s]',' '),'[[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'')  AS state,
  nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<country> AS VARCHAR),'[\\s]',' '),'[[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'')  AS country,
  CASE
     WHEN CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR)  REGEXP  '[^0-9]+' then null
     WHEN LENGTH( CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR)) >= 5   AND donor_address.<zip5> like '%-%'
     THEN   split_part(CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR) , '-',  1)
     ELSE (nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR),'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''))
  END AS ZIP5,
  CASE
     WHEN CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR)  REGEXP  '[^0-9]+' then null
     WHEN LENGTH( CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR)) >= 5   AND donor_address.<zip5> like '%-%'
     THEN split_part(CAST(donor_address.<zip5> AS VARCHAR) , '-',  2)
     ELSE NULL
  END AS ZIP4,
  CAST(donor_address.<effective date> AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY donor_address.src_donor_id,	CAST(regexp_replace(replace(replace(donor_address.<addr1>, char(10)), char(13)),'[^a-zA-Z 0-9]+') AS VARCHAR)  ORDER BY effective_date DESC) AS rn
FROM <[AMS].[donor_address].{fulfillment}> AS donor_address

<join_extension_donor_address>

where CAST(donor_address.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL
AND CAST(donor_address.<addr1> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL
)

SELECT
       src_donor_id,
       addr_type,
       addr1,
       addr2,
       addr3,
       addr4,
       city,
       state,
       country,
       ZIP5,
       ZIP4,
       effective_dt
FROM cte_address
WHERE rn=1

-- jyothi 09/15/2022  V0.1 Added bound query for donor_audience_segments in AMS domain
-- Chitti 11/04/2022  V0.2 Rename query name
-- kkhanuja 11/17/2022 -- V0.1 Added bound query for donor_attributes in AMS domain
-- csugguna 2/10/2023 added eab_attribute_type field from AMS Donor attributes

select
  CAST(src_donor_id AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id ,
  CAST(attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS attribute_type,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY src_donor_id) as attribute_key,
  CAST(src_donor_attribute_value AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_attribute_value,
  CAST(effective_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt,
  CAST(eab_attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS eab_attribute_type,
  effective_end_date,
  <source_partner_system_name_donor_attributes> as source_partner_system_name,
  <source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
  from (
/*
select donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,donor_attribute.attribute_type as attribute_type ,
        donor_attribute.src_donor_attribute_value as src_donor_attribute_value, donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        NULL as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
*/	

----Faculty that are also Alumni	
select distinct
src_donor_id
,'Alumni Faculty' as attribute_type
,'alumni faculty' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_sub_type].{fulfillment}> as dst
where (contact_sub_type = 'Alumni' 
AND (
calculated_field_1 = 'Employee' OR
calculated_field_2 = 'Employee' OR
calculated_field_3 = 'Employee' OR
calculated_field_4 = 'Employee'
)) 
	
union all

---------Fall26 donors
select distinct
src_donor_id
,'Fall26 Donors' as attribute_type
,'fall26 donor' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1
and appeal_code like '%FY26 FALL%'
	
union all	
	
select distinct
src_donor_id
,'Texting Program' as attribute_type
,'text program' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as da
where 1=1
and src_donor_attribute_value in ('Text Opt-in - UAF','Text Opt-in - UAS','Text Opt-in - UAA')	
	
	
union all	
	
select distinct
src_donor_id
,'GenX' as attribute_type
,'GenX' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as d
where 1=1
and (birth_date >= '1965-01-01 00:00:00.000' and birth_date <='1980-12-31 00:00:00.000')

union all 
	
select distinct
src_donor_id
,'Millenial' as attribute_type
,'Millennial' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as d
where 1=1
and (birth_date >= '1981-01-01 00:00:00.000' and birth_date <='1996-12-31 00:00:00.000')

union all 
	
	
select distinct
src_donor_id
,'Southeast Email Opt Out' as attribute_type
,'Southeast Email Opt Out' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as da
where 1=1
and src_donor_attribute_value in ('No Email Solicitations - ALL','Do Not Email - UAS','No Email Solicitations - UAS','Do Not Call or Email - At All','Do Not Email - ALL')	

union all 

select distinct
src_donor_id
,'Anchorage Mail Opt out' as attribute_type
,'Anchorage Mail Opt out' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as da
where 1=1
and src_donor_attribute_value in ('Do Not Mail - ALL','Do Not Mail - UAA','Do Not Mail Solicitations - ALL','Do Not Mail Solicitations - UAA')
	
union all 
	
select distinct
src_donor_id
,'Fairbanks Mail Opt out' as attribute_type
,'Fairbanks Mail Opt out' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as da
where 1=1
and src_donor_attribute_value in ('Do Not Mail - ALL','Do Not Mail - UAF','Do Not Mail Solicitations - ALL','Do Not Mail Solicitations - UAF')
	
union all 
	
select distinct
src_donor_id
,'Southeast Mail Opt out' as attribute_type
,'Southeast Mail Opt out' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as da
where 1=1
and src_donor_attribute_value in ('Do Not Mail - ALL','Do Not Mail - UAS','Do Not Mail Solicitations - ALL','Do Not Mail Solicitations - UAS')	

union all 
	
select distinct
src_donor_id
,'Anchorage Contact Opt out' as attribute_type
,'Anchorage Contact Opt out' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as da
where 1=1
and src_donor_attribute_value in ('Do Not Contact - ALL','Do Not Contact - Child','No Marketing Alumni Partners','Do Not Contact - UAA','Exclude - Anonymous','Check Annotation','Do Not Solicit')	

union all
	
select distinct
src_donor_id
,'Fairbanks Contact Opt out' as attribute_type
,'Fairbanks Contact Opt out' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as da
where 1=1
and src_donor_attribute_value in ('Do Not Contact - ALL','Do Not Contact - Child','No Marketing Alumni Partners','Do Not Contact - UAF','Exclude - Anonymous','Check Annotation','Do Not Solicit')	

union all
	
select distinct
src_donor_id
,'Southeast Contact Opt out' as attribute_type
,'Southeast Contact Opt out' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as da
where 1=1
and src_donor_attribute_value in ('Do Not Contact - ALL','Do Not Contact - Child','Do Not Contact - UAS','Exclude - Anonymous','Check Annotation','Do Not Solicit')
	
union all 
	
select distinct
src_donor_id
,'Anchorage Email Opt out' as attribute_type
,'Anchorage Email Opt out' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as da
where 1=1
and src_donor_attribute_value in ('No Email Solicitations - ALL','Do Not Email - UAA','Do Not Email - UAA Annual Giving','No Email Solicitations - UAA','Do Not Call or Email - At All','Do Not Email - ALL')

union all
	
select distinct
src_donor_id
,'Fairbanks Email Opt Out' as attribute_type
,'Fairbanks Email Opt Out' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as da
where 1=1
and src_donor_attribute_value in ('No Email Solicitations - ALL','Do Not Email - UAF','Do Not Email - UAF Annual Giving','No Email Solicitations - UAF','Do Not Call or Email - At All','Do Not Email - ALL')	

union all
	
select distinct
src_donor_id
, case 
    when appeal_cd like 'UAA%' then 'Anchorage'
    when appeal_cd like 'UAS%' then 'Southeast'
    when appeal_cd like 'UAF%' then 'Fairbanks'
    else 'General'
  end as attribute_type
, case 
    when appeal_cd like 'UAA%' then 'Anchorage'
    when appeal_cd like 'UAS%' then 'Southeast'
    when appeal_cd like 'UAF%' then 'Fairbanks'
    else 'General'
  end as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,NULL as effective_end_date  
from <[AMS].[gifts].{final}> as g1
where 1=1
and gift_dt = (select max(gift_dt) from <[AMS].[gifts].{final}> as g2 where g1.src_donor_id = g2.src_donor_id)	

union all 
	
select distinct
src_donor_id
,case 
    when degree_campus = 'University of Alaska Anchorage' then 'Anchorage'
    when degree_campus = 'University of Alaska Southeast' then 'Southeast'
    when degree_campus = 'University of Alaska Fairbanks' then 'Fairbanks'
    else 'General'
 end as attribute_type
, case 
    when degree_campus = 'University of Alaska Anchorage' then 'Anchorage'
    when degree_campus = 'University of Alaska Southeast' then 'Southeast'
    when degree_campus = 'University of Alaska Fairbanks' then 'Fairbanks'
    else 'General'
  end as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,NULL as effective_end_date   
from <[AMS].[donor_degree].{final}> as dd
where 1=1
and src_donor_id not in (select distinct src_donor_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{final}> as g)	
	
union all	
	
select distinct 
src_donor_id
,'FundExclusionList' as attribute_type
,'FundExclusionList' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,NULL as effective_end_date
from
<[AMS].[gifts].{final}> as g1
where 1=1
and gift_dt = (select max(gift_dt) as max_gift_dt from <[AMS].[gifts].{final}> as g2 where g1.src_donor_id = g2.src_donor_id)
and g1.gift_id in (
                    select distinct gift_id
                    from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{final}> as g1
                    where 1=1
                    and fund_cd in 
                                    (
                                    '21467','20564','20123','20124','40822','20094','20919','21441','80794','21255','10500',
                                    '20274','20208','20133','21538','20884','21427','20447','21473','20042','20931','21469',
                                    '80637','10996','21438','20019','20371','20332','20283','20297','20323','20084','20957',
                                    '21262','21012','21118','20527','21552','20740','20155','21184','10403','20453','21104',
                                    '21045','20355','10513','21140','10307','21531','21554','20877','20601','21442','21378',
                                    '21379','21577','10305','20728','20236','21310','20462'
                                    )
                    )	
	

union all
 
 select donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
        donor_attributes_segmentations.attribute_type as attribute_type,
        donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_attribute_value as src_donor_attribute_value,
        donor_attributes_segmentations.effective_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
       donor_attributes_segmentations.effective_end_date  as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes_segmentations].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes_segmentations    ) as ds  where src_donor_id is not null and attribute_type is not null order by attribute_key,src_donor_id,attribute_type

join <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as donor on donor.src_donor_id = donor_attributes.src_donor_id

union all

select a.src_donor_id,

	from (

				ORDER BY donor_attributes_segmentations.effective_date DESC) AS rn
	  from <[AMS].[donor_attributes_segmentations].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes_segmentations
	  ) as a 
		where rn = 1
	
) as ds  where src_donor_id is not null and attribute_type is not null order by attribute_key, src_donor_id, attribute_type

-- jyothi 09/15/2022  V0.1 Added bound query for donor_audience_segments in AMS domain
-- Chitti 11/04/2022  V0.2 Rename query name
-- kkhanuja 11/17/2022 -- V0.1 Added bound query for donor_attributes in AMS domain
-- csugguna 2/10/2023 added eab_attribute_type field from AMS Donor attributes

select
  CAST(src_donor_id AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id ,
  CAST(attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS attribute_type,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY src_donor_id) as attribute_key,
  CAST(src_donor_attribute_value AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_attribute_value,
  CAST(effective_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt,
  CAST(eab_attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS eab_attribute_type,
  effective_end_date,
  <source_partner_system_name_donor_attributes> as source_partner_system_name,
  <source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
from (
    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Trustee' as attribute_type,
           'Trustee' as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		   NULL as effective_end_date
    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where calculated_field_1 = 'Y'
	   or calculated_field_2 = 'Y'
        union all
    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Staff' as attribute_type,
           'Staff' as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		   NULL as effective_end_date
    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where calculated_field_3 = 'Y'
	   or calculated_field_4 = 'Y'
        union all
    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Faculty' as attribute_type,
           'Faculty' as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		   NULL as effective_end_date
    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where calculated_field_5 = 'Y'
	   or calculated_field_6 = 'Y'
        union all
    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Current Parent' as attribute_type,
           'Current Parent' as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		   NULL as effective_end_date
    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where calculated_field_7 = 'Y'	
        union all
    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Incoming Parent' as attribute_type,
           'Incoming Parent' as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		   NULL as effective_end_date
    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where calculated_field_8 = 'Y'
        union all
    select donor_attributes.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Former Parent' as attribute_type,
           'Former Parent' as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		   NULL as effective_end_date
    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    inner join <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as donor on donor.src_donor_id = donor_attributes.src_donor_id
    where donor_attributes.calculated_field_7 <> 'Y'
      and donor_attributes.calculated_field_8 <> 'Y'
  	  and donor.donor_category_description = 'Parent'
        union all
    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Presidents Club Curr FY' as attribute_type,
           'Presidents Club Curr FY' as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		   NULL as effective_end_date
    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where calculated_field_9 like 'Presidents Club%'
        union all
    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Presidents Club Last FY' as attribute_type,
           'Presidents Club Last FY' as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		   NULL as effective_end_date
    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where calculated_field_10 like 'Presidents Club%'
        union all
    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Presidents Club Associates Last FY' as attribute_type,
           'Presidents Club Associates Last FY' as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		   NULL as effective_end_date
    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where calculated_field_10 = 'Presidents Club - Associates (Young Alum $250 - $999)'
  		union all
     select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Presidents Club Lapsed' as attribute_type,
           'Presidents Club Lapsed' as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		   NULL as effective_end_date
    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where calculated_field_21 like 'Presidents Club%'
       or calculated_field_22 like 'Presidents Club%'
       or calculated_field_23 like 'Presidents Club%'
       or calculated_field_24 like 'Presidents Club%'
  		union all 
    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Pledge Due' as attribute_type,
           'Pledge Due' as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		   NULL as effective_end_date
    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where calculated_field_11 = 'Y'
        union all
    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Former Staff' as attribute_type,
           'Former Staff' as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		   NULL as effective_end_date
    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where (calculated_field_12 = 'Y'
	   or  calculated_field_13 = 'Y')
	  and  calculated_field_20 != 'A'
	  and  calculated_field_7 != 'Y'
        union all
    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Former Faculty' as attribute_type,
           'Former Faculty' as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		   NULL as effective_end_date
    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where (calculated_field_14 = 'Y'
	   or  calculated_field_15 = 'Y')
	  and  calculated_field_20 != 'A'
	  and  calculated_field_7 != 'Y'
        union all
    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Presidents Cabinet' as attribute_type,
           'Presidents Cabinet' as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		   NULL as effective_end_date
    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where calculated_field_16 = 'Y'
	   or calculated_field_17 = 'Y'

        union all
    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Engagement Score' as attribute_type,
           'engscore:'||calculated_field_5 as src_donor_attribute_value,
           current_date as effective_dt,
		   'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
		   NULL as effective_end_date
    from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where calculated_field_5 <> ''  
  
--update 1/8/2024 to remove suppression of Trustee Emeriti 
--        union all
--    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
--           'Trustee Emeriti' as attribute_type,
--           'Trustee Emeriti' as src_donor_attribute_value,
--           effective_date as effective_dt,
--		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
--		   NULL as effective_end_date
--    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
--    where calculated_field_18 = 'Y'
--	   or calculated_field_19 = 'Y'
union all
 
 select donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
        donor_attributes_segmentations.attribute_type as attribute_type,
        donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_attribute_value as src_donor_attribute_value,
        donor_attributes_segmentations.effective_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
       donor_attributes_segmentations.effective_end_date  as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes_segmentations].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes_segmentations 


) as ds
where src_donor_id is not null
  and src_donor_attribute_value is not null
order by attribute_key, src_donor_id, attribute_type

queryResults.querySql:
-- jyothi 09/15/2022  V0.1 Added bound query for donor_audience_segments in AMS domain
-- Chitti 11/04/2022  V0.2 Rename query name
-- kkhanuja 11/17/2022 -- V0.1 Added bound query for donor_attributes in AMS domain
-- csugguna 2/10/2023 added eab_attribute_type field from AMS Donor attributes

with current_fiscal_year as (
select case when MONTH(cast(current_date as timestamp)) between 7 and 12 then YEAR(cast(current_date as timestamp)) + 1 else YEAR(cast(current_date as timestamp)) end as current_year
)
																														  
,near_1850 as (
select distinct src_donor_id
	, 'Near 1850 Society' as attribute_type
	, 'Near 1850 Society' as src_donor_attribute_value
	, current_date as effective_dt
	, 'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
	, null as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1
  and fund_code not in ('410053','RE054','410062','410060','410063','410070','410069') --not ASP fund
  and (case when MONTH(cast(g.gift_date as timestamp)) between 7 and 12 then YEAR(cast(g.gift_date as timestamp)) + 1 else YEAR(cast(g.gift_date as timestamp)) end) = (select current_year from current_fiscal_year)-1
group by src_donor_id having sum(gift_amount) >= 1000
union --PLD added soft credit sql section below for FY27 (previously only hard credit sql section above)
select distinct ga.soft_credit_id as src_donor_id
	, 'Near 1850 Society' as attribute_type
	, 'Near 1850 Society' as src_donor_attribute_value
	, current_date as effective_dt
	, 'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
	, null as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
inner join <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{fulfillment}> as ga on ga.gift_id = g.gift_id
where 1=1
  and g.fund_code not in ('410053','RE054','410062','410060','410063','410070','410069') --not ASP fund
  and (case when MONTH(cast(g.gift_date as timestamp)) between 7 and 12 then YEAR(cast(g.gift_date as timestamp)) + 1 else YEAR(cast(g.gift_date as timestamp)) end) = (select current_year from current_fiscal_year)-1
group by ga.soft_credit_id having sum(soft_credit_amount) >= 1000
)

,lapsed_1850 as ( --PLD added for FY27, this is used in sybnt_1000_plus logic
select distinct src_donor_id
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
where donor_attribute.attribute_type in ('1850 Society FY21','1850 Society FY22','1850 Society FY23','1850 Society FY24','1850 Society FY25') --past FY Society (set for FY27 - adjust each fiscal year)
  and donor_attribute.attribute_type not in ('1850 Society FY26','1850 Society FY27') --last FY and curr FY are not lapsed (set for FY27 - adjust each fiscal year)
)

,current_1850 as ( --PLD added for FY27
select distinct src_donor_id
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
where donor_attribute.attribute_type in ('1850 Society FY26','1850 Society FY27') --last FY and curr FY are considered active society (set for FY27 - adjust each fiscal year)
)

/* NOT USED
,gift_fulfillment_new as (																														 
select src_donor_id
	,(case when MONTH(cast(g.gift_date as timestamp)) between 7 and 12 then YEAR(cast(g.gift_date as timestamp)) + 1 else YEAR(cast(g.gift_date as timestamp)) end) as credit_fiscal_year
	, gift_amount
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g 
where 1=1
and fund_code not in ('410053','RE054','410062','410060','410063','410070','410069') --not ASP fund
)
*/
																			  
,donors_not_asp_last5years as ( --PLD added for FY27
	select distinct g.src_donor_id as src_donor_id
	from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> g
	where g.credit_fiscal_year between 2022 and 2027 --Last 5 Years + CFY (set for FY27 - change each fiscal year)
	  and g.calculated_field_1 = 'False' --NOT Athletic_Seating_Flag
	  and cast(g.gift_amount as decimal(12,2)) > 0
	union
	select distinct ga.soft_credit_id as src_donor_id
	from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> g
	inner join <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{final}> ga on ga.gift_id=g.gift_id
	where g.credit_fiscal_year between 2022 and 2027 --Last 5 Years + CFY (set for FY27 - change each fiscal year)
 	  and g.calculated_field_1 = 'False' --NOT Athletic_Seating_Flag
  	  and cast(ga.soft_credit_amount as decimal(12,2)) > 0
)

,lybnt_donor as ( --PLD added for FY27, this is used in sybnt_1000_plus logic
select distinct src_donor_id
	from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> g
	where credit_fiscal_year = 2026 --LYBNT=2026 (set for FY27 - change each fiscal year)
union
select distinct ga.soft_credit_id as src_donor_id
	from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> g
	inner join <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{final}> ga on ga.gift_id=g.gift_id
	where g.credit_fiscal_year = 2026 --LYBNT=2026 (set for FY27 - change each fiscal year)
)

select
  CAST(src_donor_id AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id ,
  CAST(attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS attribute_type,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY src_donor_id) as attribute_key,
  CAST(src_donor_attribute_value AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_attribute_value,
  CAST(effective_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt,
  CAST(eab_attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS eab_attribute_type,
  effective_end_date,
  <source_partner_system_name_donor_attributes> as source_partner_system_name,
  <source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
  from (

select donor_sub_type.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'Faculty' as attribute_type,
        'Faculty' as src_donor_attribute_value,
         current_date as effective_dt,
		'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
-- jyothi 09/15/2022  V0.1 Added bound query for donor_audience_segments in AMS domain
-- Chitti 11/04/2022  V0.2 Rename query name
-- kkhanuja 11/17/2022 -- V0.1 Added bound query for donor_attributes in AMS domain
-- csugguna 2/10/2023 added eab_attribute_type field from AMS Donor attributes

with cte_credit_year as(
  select distinct gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))
		   when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited > 50 then to_number(concat(19,a.fy_credited))
		   else to_number(a.fy_credited)
	   end as credited_fy
from (
select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
	   gift_date,
       case when (giftmonth  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then giftyear + 1 else giftyear end as fy_credited
from
(SELECT
 	   GS.gift_id,
 	   GS.src_donor_id,
       GS.gift_date ,
       MONTH(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftmonth,
       YEAR(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs) as gb ) as a)

select
  CAST(src_donor_id AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id ,
  CAST(attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS attribute_type,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY src_donor_id) as attribute_key,
  CAST(src_donor_attribute_value AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_attribute_value,
  CAST(effective_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt,
  CAST(eab_attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS eab_attribute_type,
  effective_end_date,
  <source_partner_system_name_donor_attributes> as source_partner_system_name,
  <source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
  from (
	
select distinct
g.src_donor_id
,'FY26 Athletic Donors' as attribute_type
,'FY26 Athletic Donors' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,null as effective_end_date

from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
			 
join cte_credit_year as c on coalesce(g.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'') and coalesce(g.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')

where 1=1

and g.gift_id in (select distinct gf.gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as gf 
				where 1=1
				and gf.calculated_field_2 = 'Athletics'
				)
and TO_NUMBER(cast(c.credited_fy as varchar))=2026
				   
union all 
			   

select distinct
g.src_donor_id
,'FY25 Athletic Donors' as attribute_type
,'FY25 Athletic Donors' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,null as effective_end_date

from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
			 
join cte_credit_year as c on coalesce(g.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'') and coalesce(g.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')

where 1=1

and g.gift_id in (select distinct gf.gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as gf 
				where 1=1
				and gf.calculated_field_2 = 'Athletics'
				)
and TO_NUMBER(cast(c.credited_fy as varchar))=2025
				   
union all				   

select distinct
g.src_donor_id
,'Athletic Donors' as attribute_type
,'Athletic Donors' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,null as effective_end_date

from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g

where 1=1

and g.gift_id in (select distinct gf.gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as gf 
				where 1=1
				and gf.calculated_field_2 = 'Athletics'
				)
and g.src_donor_id not in (select distinct g.src_donor_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
						   where 1=1
						   and g.gift_id in (select distinct gf.gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as gf 
											where 1=1
											and gf.calculated_field_2 = 'Athletics'
											and gf.gift_id not in (select distinct gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as gf 
								   									where 1=1
								   									and gf.calculated_field_2<>'Athletics'
								  								   )
											)

							)
				   
union all 
				   
select distinct
g.src_donor_id
,'Athletic Only Donors' as attribute_type
,'Athletic Only Donors' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,null as effective_end_date

from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g

where 1=1

and g.gift_id in (select distinct gf.gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as gf 
				where 1=1
				and gf.calculated_field_2 = 'Athletics'
				and gf.gift_id not in (select distinct gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as gf 
								   where 1=1
								   and gf.calculated_field_2<>'Athletics'
								  )
				)

union all 
				   
select distinct
g.src_donor_id
,'High Dollar Athletic Donors' as attribute_type
,'High Dollar Athletic Donors' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,null as effective_end_date

from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
			 
join cte_credit_year as c on coalesce(g.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'') and coalesce(g.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')

where 1=1

and c.credited_fy>=(case when (MONTH(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) between 7 and 12) then (YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) +1) else YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) end)-5
			 
and g.gift_id in (select distinct gf.gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as gf 
				where 1=1
				and gf.calculated_field_2 = 'Athletics'
				)
and ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(g.gift_amount,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float), 0) >= 50000
--group by g.src_donor_id
--having sum(ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(g.gift_amount,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float), 0))>=50000
																																			
union all 
																																			
select distinct
g.src_donor_id
,'FY26 Annual Donors' as attribute_type
,'FY26 Annual Donors' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,null as effective_end_date

from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
			 
join cte_credit_year as c on coalesce(g.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'') and coalesce(g.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')

where 1=1

and g.gift_id in (select distinct gf.gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as gf 
				where 1=1
				and gf.calculated_field_2 <> 'Athletics'
				)

and g.gift_id not in (select distinct gf.gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as gf 
				where 1=1
				and gf.calculated_field_2 = 'Athletics'
				)

and TO_NUMBER(cast(c.credited_fy as varchar))=2026
				   
union all 
				   
select distinct
g.src_donor_id
,'FY25 Annual Donors' as attribute_type
,'FY25 Annual Donors' as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type
,null as effective_end_date

from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
			 
join cte_credit_year as c on coalesce(g.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'') and coalesce(g.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')

where 1=1

and g.gift_id in (select distinct gf.gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as gf

				and gf.calculated_field_2 <> 'Athletics'
				)

and g.gift_id not in (select distinct gf.gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as gf 
				where 1=1
				and gf.calculated_field_2 = 'Athletics'
				)

and TO_NUMBER(cast(c.credited_fy as varchar))=2025

union all

select donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,donor_attribute.attribute_type as attribute_type,
        donor_attribute.src_donor_attribute_value as src_donor_attribute_value, donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        NULL as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
				   
union all

select  gifts.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'Day of Giving Donor' as attribute_type,
        'dog26_donor' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		current_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gifts	
where gifts.appeal_code = 'Day of Giving 2026'


union all
 
select src_donor_id,
		   attribute_type,
		   src_donor_attribute_value,
		   effective_dt,
		   eab_attribute_type,
		   effective_end_date
	from (
		select donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
			  donor_attributes_segmentations.attribute_type as attribute_type,
			  donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_attribute_value as src_donor_attribute_value,
			  donor_attributes_segmentations.effective_date as effective_dt,

-- jyothi 09/15/2022  V0.1 Added bound query for donor_audience_segments in AMS domain

  CAST(eab_attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS eab_attribute_type,
  effective_end_date,
  <source_partner_system_name_donor_attributes> as source_partner_system_name,

from (
    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Former Athlete' as attribute_type,

           effective_date as effective_dt,

    where ifnull(calculated_field_1,'') != ''

    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Faculty' as attribute_type,
           'Faculty' as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,

    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where (ifnull(calculated_field_4,'') in ('EMP','EFA')
	   or  ifnull(calculated_field_5,'') in ('EMP','EFA')
	   or  ifnull(calculated_field_6,'') in ('EMP','EFA')
  	   or  ifnull(calculated_field_7,'') in ('EMP','EFA')
	   or  ifnull(calculated_field_8,'') in ('EMP','EFA')
	   or  ifnull(calculated_field_9,'') in ('EMP','EFA'))

    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Parent of Athlete' as attribute_type,
           'Parent of Athlete' as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,

    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where ifnull(calculated_field_10,'') != ''

    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where (ifnull(calculated_field_4,'') in ('PAC')

		union all

           'Sport' as attribute_type,
           calculated_field_1 as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		   NULL as effective_end_date
    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where ifnull(calculated_field_1,'') != ''
		union all
    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
           'Sport' as attribute_type,
           calculated_field_2 as src_donor_attribute_value,
           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,

    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where ifnull(calculated_field_1,'') = ''

    select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,

           effective_date as effective_dt,
		   'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		   NULL as effective_end_date
    from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
    where ifnull(calculated_field_1,'') = ''
	  and ifnull(calculated_field_2,'') = ''
	  and ifnull(calculated_field_3,'') != ''

union all

	 'C40123','C40125','C40343','C40347','C40387','C40399','C40413','C40418','C40419','C40437',
	 'C40456','C40461','C40464','C40465','C40474','C40477')

	select donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,

	from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
	where calculated_field_13 <> ''
	and calculated_field_13 between '2024-06-01' and '2025-05-31'											 

union all

		'23AGGreyhoundsGive','24AGGHGAlumni','24AGGHGAlumni','24AGGHGDayOf','24AGGHGEmail1','24AGGHGEmail2','24AGGHGEmail3','24AGGHGEmail4',

	from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gifts
	inner join <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gifts_allocation on gifts_allocation.gift_id = gifts.gift_id
	where gifts.appeal_code in (
		'21AGGHGConsecutive','21AGGHGJES','21AGGHGParents','21AGGHGStudents','21AGGreyhoundsGive','22AGGHGAnticipate','22AGGHGAnticipate',
		'22AGGHGDeadline8pm','22AGGHGEarlyGiving','22AGGHGKickoff12am','22AGGHGProgress12pm','22AGGHGSaveTheDate','22AGGHGSaveTheDate',

        donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_attribute_value as src_donor_attribute_value,

       donor_attributes_segmentations.effective_end_date  as effective_end_date

-- jyothi 09/15/2022  V0.1 Added bound query for donor_audience_segments in AMS domain
-- Chitti 11/04/2022  V0.2 Rename query name
-- kkhanuja 11/17/2022 -- V0.1 Added bound query for donor_attributes in AMS domain
-- csugguna 2/10/2023 added eab_attribute_type field from AMS Donor attributes

select
  CAST(src_donor_id AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id ,
  CAST(attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS attribute_type,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY src_donor_id) as attribute_key,
  CAST(src_donor_attribute_value AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_attribute_value,
  CAST(effective_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt,
  CAST(eab_attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS eab_attribute_type,
  effective_end_date,
  <source_partner_system_name_donor_attributes> as source_partner_system_name,
  <source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
from (

select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
	'Former Athlete' as attribute_type,
	'Former Athlete' as src_donor_attribute_value,
	current_date as effective_dt,
	'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
	NULL as effective_end_date
  from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
  where ifnull(calculated_field_1,'') != ''
  or ifnull(calculated_field_2,'') != ''
  or ifnull(calculated_field_3,'') != ''
  
union all
  
select donor.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
	'Faculty' as attribute_type,
	'Faculty' as src_donor_attribute_value,
	current_date as effective_dt,
	'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
	NULL as effective_end_date
  from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as donor
  inner join <[AMS].[donor_sub_type].{fulfillment}> as donor_sub_type on donor_sub_type.src_donor_id = donor.src_donor_id
  where contact_sub_type in ('Employee','Faculty')
	and donor_category_description not like 'Alumni%'

union all

select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
	'Parent of Athlete' as attribute_type,
	'Parent of Athlete' as src_donor_attribute_value,
	current_date as effective_dt,
	'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
	NULL as effective_end_date
  from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
  where ifnull(calculated_field_10,'') != ''

union all

select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
	'Current Parent' as attribute_type,
	'Current Parent' as src_donor_attribute_value,
	current_date as effective_dt,
	'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
	NULL as effective_end_date
  from <[AMS].[donor_sub_type].{fulfillment}> as donor_sub_type
  where contact_sub_type in ('Parent of Undergrad Student')

union all

select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
	'Sport' as attribute_type,
	calculated_field_1 as src_donor_attribute_value,
	current_date as effective_dt,
	'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
	NULL as effective_end_date
  from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
  where ifnull(calculated_field_1,'') != ''
union all
select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
	'Sport' as attribute_type,
	calculated_field_2 as src_donor_attribute_value,
	current_date as effective_dt,
	'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
	NULL as effective_end_date
  from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
  where ifnull(calculated_field_2,'') != ''
union all
select src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
	'Sport' as attribute_type,
	calculated_field_3 as src_donor_attribute_value,
	current_date as effective_dt,
	'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
	NULL as effective_end_date
  from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes
  where ifnull(calculated_field_3,'') != ''

union all

select g.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
	'Athletic Donor' as attribute_type,
	'Athletic Donor' as src_donor_attribute_value,
	current_date as effective_dt,
	'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
	NULL as effective_end_date
	from <[AMS].[gifts].{final}> g
    inner join <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> gf on gf.gift_id = g.gift_id and gf.src_donor_id = g.src_donor_id
	where g.credit_fiscal_year between 2022 and 2027
      and gf.calculated_field_1 = 'NCAA Athletics'
union all
select ga.soft_credit_id as src_donor_id,
	'Athletic Donor' as attribute_type,
	'Athletic Donor' as src_donor_attribute_value,
	current_date as effective_dt,
	'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

  from (

/*
 select donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,donor_attribute.attribute_type as attribute_type ,
        donor_attribute.src_donor_attribute_value as src_donor_attribute_value, donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,

		NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
	
*/
select donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'VIP' as attribute_type ,
        'VIP' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
where donor_attribute.calculated_field_6 is not null
	or donor_attribute.calculated_field_7 is not null

union all
	
select donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'Honors' as attribute_type ,
        'Honors' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute	
where 	donor_attribute.calculated_field_1 = 'Monteith'
	or donor_attribute.calculated_field_2 = 'Mackenzie Honor'
	or donor_attribute.calculated_field_3 = 'Merit Scholar'
	or donor_attribute.calculated_field_4 = 'University Honors'
	or donor_attribute.calculated_field_5 = 'Department Honors'
	
union all	

select donor_degree.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
	case
		when donor_degree.degree_division_Description = 'School of Business' then 'School of Business'
		when donor_degree.degree_division_Description = 'College of Education' then 'College of Education'
	    when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'College of Engineering' then 'College of Engineering'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'Fine, Performing & Comm. Arts' then 'College of Fine, Performing & Communication Arts'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'Graduate School' then 'Graduate School'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'School of Information Sciences' then 'School of Information Sciences'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'Law' then 'Law'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'Law School' then 'Law'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'Liberal Arts & Sciences' then 'College of Liberal Arts and Sciences'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'College of Nursing' then 'Nursing'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'Pharmacy and Health Sciences' then 'Pharmacy and Health Sciences'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'School of Social Work' then 'Social Work'
	    when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'School of Medicine' and donor_degree.DEGREE_CODE = 'MD' then 'Medicine - MD'
	    when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'School of Medicine' and donor_degree.DEGREE_CODE = 'PHD' then 'Medicine - PHD'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'School of Medicine' and donor_degree.DEGREE_CODE in ('FA','RA') then 'Fellow or Resident'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'School of Medicine' and donor_degree.DEGREE_CODE = 'M' then 'Medical Masters'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'School of Medicine' and donor_degree.DEGREE_CODE = 'MPH' then 'MPH'
		when donor_degree.degree_division_description = 'School of Medicine' then 'SOM'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'College of Lifelong Learning' then 'CLL'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'Urban, Labor, & Metro Affairs' then 'ULMA'
		    		
	else 'No college'
	end as attribute_type ,
    case
		when donor_degree.degree_division_Description = 'School of Business' then 'School of Business'
		when donor_degree.degree_division_Description = 'College of Education' then 'College of Education'
	    when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'College of Engineering' then 'College of Engineering'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'Fine, Performing & Comm. Arts' then 'College of Fine, Performing & Communication Arts'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'Graduate School' then 'Graduate School'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'School of Information Sciences' then 'School of Information Sciences'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'Law' then 'Law'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'Law School' then 'Law'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'Liberal Arts & Sciences' then 'College of Liberal Arts and Sciences'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'College of Nursing' then 'Nursing'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'Pharmacy and Health Sciences' then 'Pharmacy and Health Sciences'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'School of Social Work' then 'Social Work'
	    when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'School of Medicine' and donor_degree.DEGREE_CODE = 'MD' then 'Medicine - MD'
	    when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'School of Medicine' and donor_degree.DEGREE_CODE = 'PHD' then 'Medicine - PHD'
	    when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'School of Medicine' and donor_degree.DEGREE_CODE in ('FA','RA') then 'Fellow or Resident'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'School of Medicine' and donor_degree.DEGREE_CODE = 'M' then 'Medical Masters'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'School of Medicine' and donor_degree.DEGREE_CODE = 'MPH' then 'MPH'
		when donor_degree.degree_division_description = 'School of Medicine' then 'SOM'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'College of Lifelong Learning' then 'CLL'
		when donor_degree.DEGREE_DIVISION_DESCRIPTION = 'Urban, Labor, & Metro Affairs' then 'ULMA'
			
	else 'No college'
	end as src_donor_attribute_value,
		current_date as effective_dt,
        'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_degree].{fulfillment}> as donor_degree
	

union all

gifts.src_donor_id as src_donor_id

-- jyothi 09/15/2022  V0.1 Added bound query for donor_audience_segments in AMS domain
-- Chitti 11/04/2022  V0.2 Rename query name
-- kkhanuja 11/17/2022 -- V0.1 Added bound query for donor_attributes in AMS domain
-- csugguna 2/10/2023 added eab_attribute_type field from AMS Donor attributes
-- bellerson 2/1/2024 - added MemorialOnly and FY24NonAnnualDonor. Added Or in PastParent
--gsudhakar 9/12/2024 - added trusteehousehold custom segment - https://jira.devops.eab.com/browse/ESANALYTIC-41152

select
  CAST(src_donor_id AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id ,
  CAST(attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS attribute_type,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY src_donor_id) as attribute_key,
  CAST(src_donor_attribute_value AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_attribute_value,
  CAST(effective_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt,
  CAST(eab_attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS eab_attribute_type,
  effective_end_date,
  <source_partner_system_name_donor_attributes> as source_partner_system_name,
  <source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
  from (

select distinct donor.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'PastParent' as attribute_type ,
        'PastParent' as src_donor_attribute_value,
		current_date as effective_dt,
        'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as donor
left join <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> gifts
	on donor.src_donor_id = gifts.src_donor_id
		where 1=1
		and donor.DONOR_CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION = 'Past Parent'
			or (
			  	gifts.annual_giving_ind = 'ADEF - Annual Scholarships & Financial Aid' 
			  	 and year(gifts.gift_date) >= (year(current_date) - 5)
			) 
	
union all	
	
select distinct donor.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'FY24NonAnnualDonor' as attribute_type ,
        'FY24NonAnnualDonor' as src_donor_attribute_value,
		current_date as effective_dt,
        'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as donor
	left join <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> gifts
	on donor.src_donor_id = gifts.src_donor_id
		where 1=1
			and gifts.gift_date between '2023-06-01 00:00:00.000' and '2023-12-31 00:00:00.000'
			and gifts.annual_giving_ind = 'False'	

union all

select distinct donor.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'ParentAnnualFundNotAthletisDonor' as attribute_type ,
        'parent_af_not_ath_dnr' as src_donor_attribute_value,
		current_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
		NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as donor
	left join <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> gifts
	on donor.src_donor_id = gifts.src_donor_id
		where donor.donor_category_code in ('Current Parent','Past Parent')
		and gifts.credit_fiscal_year between '2021' and '2025'
		and gifts.annual_giving_ind <> 'False'
	    and donor.src_donor_id not in
		(
		select distinct g.src_donor_id
		  from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> g
		  inner join <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> gf on gf.gift_id = g.gift_id
		  where credit_fiscal_year between '2021' and '2025'
		    and g.gift_type_description <> 'Gift-in-Kind'
		    and gf.fund_code in (
		    'ATHDIR','ATHAD','ATHHALLFM','ATHTRA','BASPE','ATHBENEFITS','ATHP','BASBAL','BBBOOTKT','ATHBA','ATBOW','CHEERLEADER','CYCSPRENO','POMSQU','AGYATHBSB',
		    'AGYATHMBB','AGYATHWBB','AGYATHCC','AGYATHMGLF','AGYWGLF','AGYATHMSOC','AGYATHWSOC','AGYATHMSWM','AGYATHWSWM','AGYWTENNIS','AGYATHVL','DEOFEC','DRATH',
		    'WOMENSAUXAF','DRWCA','DRWDU','DRWOMENAUXEN','DAUXOTH','BKDACCOUNT','GENATHLETE','ICHOC','KAPALPHHOUS','KADEL','KAMCK','MABA','MEADORRENO','MBBALL',
		    'MBDUK','MBBBENEFITS','MENBBBOO','MBBTICKETS','MBBGO','MEBOW','CROSSCNTRY','MGOLF','MIHOCK','MLACRO','MRUGB','MSOCCER','MENSOCLR','MSWIM','MTENNIS',
		    'TRAFI','ORFAMCON','ORFAMOPEXP','ORSUI','PANPAD','CRAYPANTHER','PASOC','PICKBALL','PRECOLPROG','SHOGU','SSGGLFTRN','SIGPIFRAT','SIGPIFTSPEN','WSOFBL',
		    'SPONS','SPAUC','ATHSPI','STUNT','ATHSWIM','SWIHA','SWIMCO','DESWI','SWSCO','AGYATHMTN','TRDEL','DELDE','VOLLEYBALL','VOLBOO','WBBALL','WOBBBOO','WBBTICKETS',
		    'WBBGOSPO','WOBTF','WOBOW','WCRSSCNTRY','WGOLF','WGOLFENT','WGOLFFEE','WLACRO','WRUGB','WSOCCER','WOMSOCLR','WSWIM','WTENNIS','WTRAFI','TRIAT','WREST')
		)
	
union all
	
select distinct donor.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'MemorialOnly' as attribute_type ,
        'MemorialOnly' as src_donor_attribute_value,
		current_date as effective_dt,
        'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as donor
	left join <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> gifts
	on donor.src_donor_id = gifts.src_donor_id
		where 1=1
			and gifts.calculated_field_1 ilike '%in memory of%'
	
union all

/*	
select gifts.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'FY23 DoG Donor' as attribute_type ,
        'FY23 DoG Donor' as src_donor_attribute_value,
		current_date as effective_dt,
        'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
		NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gifts
	where gifts.APPEAL_CODE in ('2223DMAN08','2223OLAN00')
	
union all
*/

select distinct 
d.src_donor_id, 
'trusteehousehold' as attribute_type ,
'trusteehousehold' as src_donor_attribute_value,
current_date as effective_dt,
'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as d
where 1=1
and
(
d.donor_category_description = 'Trustee'
or 
d.spouse_id in (select distinct src_donor_id
                   from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as d2
                   where 1=1
                   and d2.src_donor_id = d.spouse_id
                   and d2.donor_category_description = 'Trustee'
                   )
)
	
union all

select distinct 
d.src_donor_id, 
'Assigned_Prospect' as attribute_type ,
'Assigned_Prospect' as src_donor_attribute_value,
current_date as effective_dt,
'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as d
where 1=1
and d.giving_officer_name is not null
	
union all

select distinct 
d.src_donor_id, 
'age_70.5_2025' as attribute_type ,
'age_70.5_2025' as src_donor_attribute_value,
current_date as effective_dt,
'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> d
where donor_category_description in ('Alumnus','Associate Alumnus','Certificate Holder')
  and cast(birth_date as date) < '1954-05-01'
  and donor_deceased_indicator = 'No'
	
/*union all

 select donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,donor_attribute.attribute_type as attribute_type ,
        donor_attribute.src_donor_attribute_value as src_donor_attribute_value, donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        NULL as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute*/
	
union all

--**PLD added 12/11/2025 (START)
(
select distinct gifts.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'prior_dog_dnr_2026' as attribute_type ,
        'prior_dog_dnr_2026' as src_donor_attribute_value,
		current_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
		NULL as effective_end_date
	from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gifts
	where appeal_description like '%Match Madness%' or appeal_description like '%MatchMadness%' or appeal_description like '%Day of Giving%'
union
select distinct gifts_allocation.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'prior_dog_dnr_2026' as attribute_type ,
        'prior_dog_dnr_2026' as src_donor_attribute_value,
		current_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
		NULL as effective_end_date
	from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gifts
	inner join <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gifts_allocation on gifts_allocation.gift_id = gifts.gift_id
    where gifts.appeal_description like '%Match Madness%' or gifts.appeal_description like '%MatchMadness%' or gifts.appeal_description like '%Day of Giving%'
)
--**PLD added 12/11/2025 (END)
	
union all	

select donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		donor_attributes_segmentations.attribute_type as attribute_type,
        donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_attribute_value as src_donor_attribute_value,
		donor_attributes_segmentations.effective_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
	   donor_attributes_segmentations.effective_end_date  as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes_segmentations].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes_segmentations	
) as ds  where src_donor_id is not null and attribute_type is not null order by attribute_key,src_donor_id,attribute_type

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

-- jyothi 09/15/2022  V0.1 Added bound query for donor_audience_segments in AMS domain
-- Chitti 11/04/2022  V0.2 Rename query name
-- kkhanuja 11/17/2022 -- V0.1 Added bound query for donor_attributes in AMS domain
-- csugguna 2/10/2023 added eab_attribute_type field from AMS Donor attributes

select
  CAST(src_donor_id AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id ,
  CAST(attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS attribute_type,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY src_donor_id) as attribute_key,
  CAST(src_donor_attribute_value AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_attribute_value,
  CAST(effective_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt,
  CAST(eab_attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS eab_attribute_type,
  effective_end_date,
  <source_partner_system_name> as source_partner_system_name,
  <source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
  from (
	
select distinct 
g.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
'WomenOfDistinction' as attribute_type ,
'WomenOfDistinction' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
current_date as effective_dt,
'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[gifts].{final}> as g
join <[AMS].[donor].{final}> as d on g.src_donor_id = d.src_donor_id
where 1=1 
and gift_id in (
select distinct gift_id 
from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{final}> as gf 
where 1=1 
and fund_desc like '%Women of Distinction%'
)  

union all 
  
select distinct 
g.SRC_DONOR_ID as src_donor_id,
'OpenPledge' as attribute_type,
'OpenPledge' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
current_date as effective_dt,
'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[Gifts].{final}> g
where 1=1
and g.GIFT_TYPE_DESC in ('Pledge','MG Pledge')
and g.CURRENT_FISCAL_YEAR = case when (date_part(month, getdate())  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then date_part(year, getdate()) + 1 else date_part(year, getdate()) end
group by g.SRC_DONOR_ID 	

union all

	where g.fund_desc like '%Mission%' and g.credit_fiscal_year between 2021 and 2026 --last 5 years

 select donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,

       donor_attributes_segmentations.effective_end_date  as effective_end_date

union all

	when degree_division_desc = 'College of Business' then 'Business'
	when degree_division_desc = 'College of Engineering and Science' then 'Engineering and Science'
	when degree_division_desc = 'College of Education & Human Sciences' then 'Education and Human Sciences'
	else null
 end as attribute_type
,case 
	when degree_division_desc = 'Liberal Arts' then 'Liberal Arts'
	when degree_division_desc = 'Applied and Natural Sciences' then 'Applied and Natural Sciences'
	when degree_division_desc = 'Business' then 'Business'
	when degree_division_desc = 'Engineering and Science' then 'Engineering and Science'
	when degree_division_desc = 'Education and Human Sciences' then 'Education and Human Sciences'
	else null
 end as src_donor_attribute_value
,current_date as effective_dt
,case when degree_division_desc in ('Liberal Arts','Applied and Natural Sciences','Business','Engineering and Science','Education and Human Sciences') then 'custom_segment' else null end as eab_attribute_type

from <[AMS].[donor_degree].{final}> as d
where 1=1 
and d.src_donor_id not in (select distinct src_donor_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{final}> as g)

select donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,donor_attribute.attribute_type as attribute_type ,
        donor_attribute.src_donor_attribute_value as src_donor_attribute_value, donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        NULL as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
*/
	

) as ds  where src_donor_id is not null and attribute_type is not null order by attribute_key,src_donor_id,attribute_type
