-- jyothi 09/15/2022  V0.1 Added bound query for donor_audience_segments in AMS domain
-- Chitti 11/04/2022  V0.2 Rename query name
-- kkhanuja 11/17/2022 -- V0.1 Added bound query for donor_attributes in AMS domain
-- csugguna 2/10/2023 added eab_attribute_type field from AMS Donor attributes

select
  CAST(src_donor_id AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id ,
  CAST(attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS attribute_type,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY src_donor_id) as attribute_key,
  CAST(src_donor_attribute_value AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_attribute_value,
  CAST(effective_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt,
  CAST(eab_attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS eab_attribute_type,
  effective_end_date,
  <source_partner_system_name_donor_attributes> as source_partner_system_name,
  <source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
  from (

select  gifts.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'Give to Gustavus Day Donors' as attribute_type ,
        'dogdonor' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		current_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gifts
where gifts.APPEAL_DESCRIPTION like '%Give to Gustavus Day%'
	
union all
	
select  donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'Open Pledge to Gustavus Fund' as attribute_type ,
        'openpledge' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
where donor_attribute.attribute_type = 'Pledge Gustavus Fund Donor'
	
union all
	
select  donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'Recurring Gustavus Fund Donor' as attribute_type ,
        'recurringdonor' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
where donor_attribute.attribute_type = 'Recurring Gustavus Fund Donor'
	
union all
	
select  donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'Spouse of Employee' as attribute_type ,
        'spouseemployee' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
where donor_attribute.attribute_type = 'Relationship'
and donor_attribute.src_donor_attribute_value = 'Spouse of Employee'	
	
union all
	
select  donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'Parent of Current Student' as attribute_type ,
        'currentparent' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
where donor_attribute.src_donor_attribute_value = 'Parent of Current Student'
	
union all
	
select  donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'First Year Parent' as attribute_type ,
        'firstparent' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
where donor_attribute.attribute_type = 'Relationship'
and donor_attribute.src_donor_attribute_value like '%2030 |%'	
	
union all
	
select  donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'Parent of Young Alumni' as attribute_type ,
        'youngalumniparent' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
where donor_attribute.attribute_type = 'Relationship'
and (
donor_attribute.src_donor_attribute_value like '%2020 |%' OR
donor_attribute.src_donor_attribute_value like '%2021 |%' OR
donor_attribute.src_donor_attribute_value like '%2022 |%' OR
donor_attribute.src_donor_attribute_value like '%2023 |%' OR
donor_attribute.src_donor_attribute_value like '%2024 |%' OR
donor_attribute.src_donor_attribute_value like '%2025 |%' )  
	
union all
	
select src_donor_id,
		   'age_70plus' as attribute_type,
		   'age_70plus' as src_donor_attribute_value,
		   current_date as effective_dt,
		   'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
		  	NULL as effective_end_date
		  from <[ams].[donor].{fulfillment}> d
		  where 1=1
		  and CAST(BIRTH_DATE AS DATE) <= DATEADD(MONTH, -846, CURRENT_DATE() )
union all
	
select  donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'Other Board Member' as attribute_type ,
        'otherboards' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
where donor_attribute.attribute_type in ('Gustavus Board of Trustees','Gustavus Alumni Association Board','Gustavus Parents\' Committee','Gustavus Class Officers')

union all
 
select src_donor_id,
		   attribute_type,
		   src_donor_attribute_value,
		   effective_dt,
		   eab_attribute_type,
		   effective_end_date
	from (
		select donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
			  donor_attributes_segmentations.attribute_type as attribute_type,
			  donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_attribute_value as src_donor_attribute_value,
			  donor_attributes_segmentations.effective_date as effective_dt,
			  'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
			  donor_attributes_segmentations.effective_end_date  as effective_end_date,
			  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 
				donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_id, 
				LOWER(donor_attributes_segmentations.attribute_type), 
				LOWER(donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_attribute_value) 
				ORDER BY donor_attributes_segmentations.effective_date DESC) AS rn
	  from <[AMS].[donor_attributes_segmentations].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes_segmentations
	  ) as a 
		where rn = 1
	*/

where src_donor_id is not null and attribute_type is not null order by attribute_key,src_donor_id,attribute_type

-- jyothi 09/15/2022  V0.1 Added bound query for donor_audience_segments in AMS domain

-- csugguna 2/10/2023 added eab_attribute_type field from AMS Donor attributes

WITH latest_gift_designation AS (
    SELECT
        src_donor_id,
        gift_id,
        gift_date,
        fund_code,
        fund_desc
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.src_donor_id,
            g.gift_id,
            g.gift_date,
            gf.fund_code,
            gf.fund_desc,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY g.src_donor_id
                ORDER BY
                    g.gift_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    g.gift_id DESC,
                    gf.gift_fund_id DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM <[ams].[gifts].{fulfillment}> g
        LEFT JOIN <[ams].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> gf
            ON g.gift_id = gf.gift_id
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)

select
  CAST(src_donor_id AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id ,
  CAST(attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS attribute_type,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY src_donor_id) as attribute_key,
  CAST(src_donor_attribute_value AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_attribute_value,
  CAST(effective_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt,

  effective_end_date,

  <source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
  from (

select donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,donor_attribute.attribute_type as attribute_type ,

from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute

,'athletics' as attribute_type

,current_date as effective_dt

    where da.calculated_field_8 ilike '%true%'

-- csugguna 2/10/2023 added eab_attribute_type field from AMS Donor attributes

select
  CAST(src_donor_id AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id ,
  CAST(attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS attribute_type,

from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
where donor_attributes.calculated_field_1 is not null
	
union all	
	
select  donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'Trustee' as attribute_type ,
        'trustee' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
where donor_attributes.calculated_field_2 is not null
	
union all	
	
select  donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'Active Legacy Society' as attribute_type ,
        'activels' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
where donor_attributes.calculated_field_3 is not null
	
union all
	
select  donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'ActiveLS' as attribute_type ,
        'activels' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        'giving_society' as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
where donor_attributes.calculated_field_3 is not null
	
union all
	
select  donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		donor_attribute.calculated_field_4 as attribute_type ,
        'first time parent' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
where donor_attributes.calculated_field_5 = '2028'

union all
	
select  donor.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'Current Parent' as attribute_type ,

union all
	
select donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,donor_attribute.attribute_type as attribute_type ,
        donor_attribute.src_donor_attribute_value as src_donor_attribute_value, donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        NULL as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
	
--adding query as part of custom record loads - esanalytic-43936	

union all
 
 select donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
        donor_attributes_segmentations.attribute_type as attribute_type,
        donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_attribute_value as src_donor_attribute_value,
        donor_attributes_segmentations.effective_date as effective_dt,

from <[AMS].[donor_attributes_segmentations].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes_segmentations    
	
) as ds  where src_donor_id is not null and attribute_type is not null order by attribute_key,src_donor_id,attribute_type

-- csugguna 2/10/2023 added eab_attribute_type field from AMS Donor attributes

select
  CAST(src_donor_id AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id ,
  CAST(attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS attribute_type,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY src_donor_id) as attribute_key,
  CAST(src_donor_attribute_value AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_attribute_value,
  CAST(effective_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt,
  CAST(eab_attribute_type AS VARCHAR) AS eab_attribute_type,
  effective_end_date,
  <source_partner_system_name_donor_attributes> as source_partner_system_name,
  <source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
  from (
	
select distinct 
src_donor_id,
'Law Donors' as attribute_type,
'Law Donors' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
current_date as effective_dt,
'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
join <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as gf on g.gift_id = gf.gift_id
where gf.fund_desc = 'Stetson Law Fund'	
	
union all
	
select  donor.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'Deland Campus' as attribute_type ,
        'Deland Campus' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		 current_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as donor
where donor.DONOR_CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION In ('DeLand Alumni Undergrad Degree', 'DeLand Alumni Graduate Degree','DeLand Former Student', 'DeLand Non-degreed Alumni', 'DeLand Honorary Alum', 'DeLand Honorary Degree', 'DeLand Faculty/Staff', 'Trustee - DeLand', 'DeLand Friend', 'DeLand Former', 'Faculty/Staff', 'Former Trustee - DeLand', 'DeLand Grandparent', 'DeLand Parent')
	
union all
	
select  donor.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'Law Campus' as attribute_type ,
        'Law Campus' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		 current_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as donor
where donor.DONOR_CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION In ('Law Alum', 'Law Non-degreed Alum', 'Law Faculty/Staff', 'Law Friend', 'Former Overseer - Law', 'Law Former Faculty/Staff', 'Overseer - Law', 'Overseer Emeriti - Law', 'Law Parent')	

union all
	
select  donor.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'Trustee' as attribute_type ,
        'Trustee' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		 current_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as donor
where donor.DONOR_CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION In ('Former Trustee - DeLand', 'Former Overseer - Law', 'Overseer - Law', 'Overseer Emeriti - Law', 'Trustee - Emeriti', 'Trustee Spouse')

union all 

select  donor.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
		'Athletics' as attribute_type ,
        'Athletics' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
		 current_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> as donor
where 1=1 
and (donor.calculated_field_6 is not null or donor.calculated_field_7 is not null)	
	
union all 
	
select 
distinct 
g.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
'Athletics' as attribute_type ,
'Athletics' as src_donor_attribute_value, 
current_date as effective_dt,
'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
NULL as effective_end_date	
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1
and gift_id in (
				select distinct gift_id
				from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as gf
				where 1=1
				and (calculated_field_13 = 'Athletics' or calculated_field_14 = 'Athletics' or calculated_field_15 = 'Athletics' or calculated_field_16 = 'Athletics' or calculated_field_17 = 'Athletics' or calculated_field_18 = 'Athletics')
				)
	
/*select donor_attribute.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,donor_attribute.attribute_type as attribute_type ,
        donor_attribute.src_donor_attribute_value as src_donor_attribute_value, donor_attribute.effective_date as effective_dt,
        NULL as eab_attribute_type,
	    NULL as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes].{fulfillment}> as donor_attribute
*/	

union all
 
 select donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_id as src_donor_id,
        donor_attributes_segmentations.attribute_type as attribute_type,
        donor_attributes_segmentations.src_donor_attribute_value as src_donor_attribute_value,
        donor_attributes_segmentations.effective_date as effective_dt,
        'custom_segment' as eab_attribute_type,
       donor_attributes_segmentations.effective_end_date  as effective_end_date
from <[AMS].[donor_attributes_segmentations].{fulfillment}> as donor_attributes_segmentations   
	
) as ds  where src_donor_id is not null and attribute_type is not null order by attribute_key,src_donor_id,attribute_type

-- #terukula 09/15 AMS-77 V0.1 created query to populate donor_degree in AMS
--Navya 11/03/2022 AMS-177 Updating query to capture multiple degrees and majors
		
	WITH CTE_donor_degree AS (	
		SELECT ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by tmp.src_donor_id,tmp.degree_desc,tmp.degree_major_desc ORDER BY  tmp.src_donor_id) AS Rno,
				tmp.src_donor_id,
				tmp.grad_year,
				tmp.degree_desc,
				tmp.degree_major_desc
		  FROM	(
			--Degree 1 Major 1
            SELECT CAST(donor_source.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
			CAST(donor_source.<grad year 1> AS VARCHAR) AS grad_year,
			CAST(donor_source.<degree description 1> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_desc,
			CAST(NVL(donor_source.<degree major 1 description>,donor_source.<degree major 2 description>) AS VARCHAR) AS degree_major_desc								             FROM <[AMS].[donor_source].{fulfillment}> AS donor_source
		  	where  CAST(donor_source.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL AND
			CAST(COALESCE(donor_source.<degree major 1 description>,donor_source.<degree major 2 description>,donor_source.<degree description 1>) AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL

		UNION
			--degree 1 major 2
			SELECT CAST(donor_source.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
			CAST(donor_source.<grad year 1> AS VARCHAR) AS grad_year,
			CAST(donor_source.<degree description 1> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_desc,
			CAST(donor_source.<degree major 2 description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_major_desc
		  	FROM <[AMS].[donor_source].{fulfillment}> AS donor_source
		  	where  CAST(donor_source.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL
		  	AND CAST(donor_source.<degree major 1 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
			AND CAST(donor_source.<degree major 2 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL

		UNION
			--degree 1 major 3 if degree 2 null	and gradyr2 null else degree 2 major 3
			SELECT
			CAST(donor_source.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
			CAST(NVL(donor_source.<grad year 2>,donor_source.<grad year 1>) AS VARCHAR) AS grad_year,
			CASE WHEN CAST(donor_source.<degree description 2> AS VARCHAR) IS NULL AND CAST(donor_source.<grad year 2> AS VARCHAR) IS NULL
			     THEN CAST(donor_source.<degree description 1> AS VARCHAR)
				 ELSE CAST(donor_source.<degree description 2> AS VARCHAR) END AS degree_desc,
			CAST(NVL(donor_source.<degree major 3 description>,donor_source.<degree major 4 description>) AS VARCHAR) AS degree_major_desc
		  	FROM <[AMS].[donor_source].{fulfillment}> AS donor_source
		  	where  CAST(donor_source.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL AND
			CAST(COALESCE(donor_source.<degree major 3 description>,donor_source.<degree major 4 description>,donor_source.<degree description 2>) AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL

        UNION
        ---Degree 2 major 4
        SELECT CAST(donor_source.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
			CAST(donor_source.<grad year 2> AS VARCHAR) AS grad_year,
			CAST(donor_source.<degree description 2> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_desc,
			CAST(donor_source.<degree major 4 description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_major_desc
		  	FROM <[AMS].[donor_source].{fulfillment}> AS donor_source
		  	where  CAST(donor_source.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL AND CAST(donor_source.<degree major 3 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
			AND CAST(donor_source.<degree major 4 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL

        UNION
        -- Degree 3 Major 5
        SELECT CAST(donor_source.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
			CAST(donor_source.<grad year 3> AS VARCHAR) AS grad_year,
			CAST(donor_source.<degree description 3> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_desc,
			CAST(NVL(donor_source.<degree major 5 description>,donor_source.<degree major 6 description>) AS VARCHAR) AS degree_major_desc
		  	FROM <[AMS].[donor_source].{fulfillment}> AS donor_source
		  	where  CAST(donor_source.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL AND
			CAST(COALESCE(donor_source.<degree major 5 description>,donor_source.<degree major 6 description>,donor_source.<degree description 3>) AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL

        UNION
        --Degree 3 Major 6
        SELECT CAST(donor_source.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
			CAST(donor_source.<grad year 3> AS VARCHAR) AS grad_year,
			CAST(donor_source.<degree description 3> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_desc,
			CAST(donor_source.<degree major 6 description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_major_desc
		  	FROM <[AMS].[donor_source].{fulfillment}> AS donor_source
		  	where  CAST(donor_source.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL
		  	AND CAST(donor_source.<degree major 5 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
			AND CAST(donor_source.<degree major 6 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
			) tmp
			WHERE NVL(tmp.degree_desc,tmp.degree_major_desc) IS NOT NULL
		)

 SELECT
  CAST(donor_source.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
  ct.grad_year AS grad_year,
  ct.degree_desc AS degree_desc,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_cd,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree type code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_type_cd,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree type description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_type_desc,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree award date> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_award_date,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree division code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_division_cd,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree division description> As VARCHAR) AS degree_division_desc,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree campus> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_campus,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree department code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_dept_cd,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree department description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_dept_desc,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree major code> As VARCHAR) AS degree_major_cd,
  ct.degree_major_desc AS degree_major_desc

FROM <[AMS].[donor_source].{fulfillment}> AS donor_source
JOIN CTE_donor_degree ct on donor_source.src_donor_id = ct.src_donor_id
WHERE ct.Rno = 1

		AND CAST(donor_degree.<degree major 2 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL

		UNION
		--degree 1 major 3 if degree 2 null	and gradyr2 null else degree 2 major 3

		CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
		CAST(NVL(donor_degree.<grad year 2>,donor_degree.<grad year>) AS VARCHAR) AS grad_year,
		CASE WHEN CAST(donor_degree.<degree description 2> AS VARCHAR) IS NULL AND CAST(donor_degree.<grad year 2> AS VARCHAR) IS NULL

		where  CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL

  CAST(donor_degree.<degree award date> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_award_date,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree division code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_division_cd,

  CAST(donor_degree.<degree campus> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_campus,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree department code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_dept_cd,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree department description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_dept_desc,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree major code> As VARCHAR) AS degree_major_cd,
  ct.degree_major_desc AS degree_major_desc

FROM <[AMS].[donor_degree].{fulfillment}> AS donor_degree
JOIN CTE_donor_degree ct on donor_degree.src_donor_id = ct.src_donor_id
JOIN <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> AS donor
ON  donor_degree.src_donor_id = donor.src_donor_id
WHERE (donor.calculated_field_1 ='Doctor of Medicine'
or donor.calculated_field_2='Doctor of Medicine'
or donor.calculated_field_3='Doctor of Medicine'
or donor.calculated_field_4='Doctor of Medicine'
or donor.calculated_field_5='True'
or donor.calculated_field_6='True'
or donor.calculated_field_7='True'
or donor.calculated_field_8='True')
AND ct.Rno = 1

-- #terukula 09/15 AMS-77 created query to populate donor_degree in AMS
WITH donor_degree AS (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by  CAST(donor_source.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) ORDER  BY  CAST(donor_source.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR)) AS Rno,
  CAST(donor_source.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
  CAST(donor_source.<grad year> AS VARCHAR) AS grad_year,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_desc,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_cd,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree type code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_type_cd,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree type description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_type_desc,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree award date> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_award_date,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree division code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_division_cd,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree division description> As VARCHAR) AS degree_division_desc,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree campus> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_campus, 
  CAST(donor_source.<degree department code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_dept_cd, 
  CAST(donor_source.<degree department description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_dept_desc,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree major 1 code> As VARCHAR) AS degree_major1_cd,
  CAST(donor_source.<degree major 1 description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_major1_desc, 
  CAST(donor_source.<degree major 2 code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_major2_cd, 
  CAST(donor_source.<degree major 2 description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_major2_desc
FROM <[AMS].[donor_source].{fulfillment}> AS donor_source
where  CAST(donor_source.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL
  )
SELECT   
  src_donor_id, 
  grad_year, 
  degree_desc, 
  degree_cd, 
  degree_type_cd, 
  degree_type_desc, 
  degree_award_date, 
  degree_division_cd, 
  degree_division_desc, 
  degree_campus, 
  degree_dept_cd, 
  degree_dept_desc, 
  degree_major1_cd, 
  degree_major1_desc, 
  degree_major2_cd 
  degree_major2_desc

-- #terukula 09/15 AMS-77 V0.1 created query to populate donor_degree in AMS
--Navya 11/03/2022 AMS-177 Updating query to capture multiple degrees and majors
-- spatole 12/09 AMS-322 - Change references for source entities in the donor bound queries
-- gsudhakar 09/11/2023 Adding education_level and eab_education_level to donor_degree bound query
--Abhilash ,08/14 processing only those donor ids which are present in gifts table and having gift id is not null
  WITH CTE_donor_degree AS (
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by tmp.src_donor_id,tmp.degree_desc,tmp.degree_major_desc ORDER BY  tmp.src_donor_id) AS Rno,
    tmp.src_donor_id,
    tmp.grad_year,
    tmp.degree_desc,
    tmp.degree_major_desc,
    tmp.education_level
    FROM  (
    --Degree 1 Major 1
    SELECT CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
    CAST(donor_degree.<grad year> AS VARCHAR) AS grad_year,
    CAST(donor_degree.<degree description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_desc,
    CAST(NVL(donor_degree.<degree major description>,donor_degree.<degree major 2 description>) AS VARCHAR) AS degree_major_desc,
    education_level
    FROM <[AMS].[donor_degree].{fulfillment}> AS donor_degree
    where  CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL AND
    CAST(COALESCE(donor_degree.<degree major description>,donor_degree.<degree major 2 description>,donor_degree.<degree description>) AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL

    UNION
    --degree 1 major 2
    SELECT CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
    CAST(donor_degree.<grad year> AS VARCHAR) AS grad_year,
    CAST(donor_degree.<degree description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_desc,
    CAST(donor_degree.<degree major 2 description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_major_desc,
    education_level
    FROM <[AMS].[donor_degree].{fulfillment}> AS donor_degree
    where  CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL
    AND CAST(donor_degree.<degree major description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(donor_degree.<degree major 2 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL

    UNION
    --degree 1 major 3 if degree 2 null and gradyr2 null else degree 2 major 3
    SELECT
    CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
    CAST(NVL(donor_degree.<grad year 2>,donor_degree.<grad year>) AS VARCHAR) AS grad_year,
    CASE WHEN CAST(donor_degree.<degree description 2> AS VARCHAR) IS NULL AND CAST(donor_degree.<grad year 2> AS VARCHAR) IS NULL
    THEN CAST(donor_degree.<degree description> AS VARCHAR)
    ELSE CAST(donor_degree.<degree description 2> AS VARCHAR) END AS degree_desc,
    CAST(NVL(donor_degree.<degree major 3 description>,donor_degree.<degree major 4 description>) AS VARCHAR) AS degree_major_desc,
    education_level
    FROM <[AMS].[donor_degree].{fulfillment}> AS donor_degree
    where  CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL AND
    CAST(COALESCE(donor_degree.<degree major 3 description>,donor_degree.<degree major 4 description>,donor_degree.<degree description 2>) AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL

    UNION
    ---Degree 2 major 4
    SELECT CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
    CAST(donor_degree.<grad year 2> AS VARCHAR) AS grad_year,
    CAST(donor_degree.<degree description 2> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_desc,
    CAST(donor_degree.<degree major 4 description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_major_desc,
    education_level
    FROM <[AMS].[donor_degree].{fulfillment}> AS donor_degree
    where  CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL AND CAST(donor_degree.<degree major 3 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(donor_degree.<degree major 4 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL

    UNION
    -- Degree 3 Major 5
    SELECT CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
    CAST(donor_degree.<grad year 3> AS VARCHAR) AS grad_year,
    CAST(donor_degree.<degree description 3> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_desc,
    CAST(NVL(donor_degree.<degree major 5 description>,donor_degree.<degree major 6 description>) AS VARCHAR) AS degree_major_desc,
    education_level
    FROM <[AMS].[donor_degree].{fulfillment}> AS donor_degree
    where  CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL AND
    CAST(COALESCE(donor_degree.<degree major 5 description>,donor_degree.<degree major 6 description>,donor_degree.<degree description 3>) AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL

    UNION
    --Degree 3 Major 6
    SELECT CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
    CAST(donor_degree.<grad year 3> AS VARCHAR) AS grad_year,
    CAST(donor_degree.<degree description 3> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_desc,
    CAST(donor_degree.<degree major 6 description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_major_desc,
    education_level
    FROM <[AMS].[donor_degree].{fulfillment}> AS donor_degree
    where  CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) is NOT NULL
    AND CAST(donor_degree.<degree major 5 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(donor_degree.<degree major 6 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
    ) tmp
    WHERE NVL(tmp.degree_desc,tmp.degree_major_desc) IS NOT NULL
  )

 SELECT distinct
  CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
  ct.grad_year AS grad_year,
  ct.degree_desc AS degree_desc,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_cd,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree type code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_type_cd,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree type description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_type_desc,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree award date> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_award_date,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree division code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_division_cd,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree division description> As VARCHAR) AS degree_division_desc,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree campus> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_campus,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree department code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_dept_cd,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree department description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_dept_desc,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree major code> As VARCHAR) AS degree_major_cd,
  ct.degree_major_desc AS degree_major_desc,
  eel.eab_education_level

FROM <[AMS].[donor_degree].{fulfillment}> AS donor_degree
JOIN <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts on
donor_degree.src_donor_id = ams_gifts.src_donor_id
JOIN CTE_donor_degree ct on donor_degree.src_donor_id = ct.src_donor_id and coalesce(ct.degree_desc,'') = coalesce(donor_degree.degree_description,'') and coalesce(ct.degree_major_desc,'') = coalesce(donor_degree.degree_major_description,'')
LEFT JOIN <eab_education_level> as eel on ct.src_donor_id = eel.src_donor_id and coalesce(ct.degree_desc,'') = coalesce(eel.degree_description,'') and coalesce(ct.degree_major_desc,'') = coalesce(eel.degree_major_description,'')
WHERE ct.Rno = 1
AND cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) is not null

-- #terukula 09/15 AMS-77 V0.1 created query to populate donor_degree in AMS

  WITH CTE_donor_degree AS (
   -- SELECT ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by tmp.src_donor_id,tmp.degree_desc,tmp.degree_major_desc ORDER BY  tmp.src_donor_id) AS Rno,
    select
	tmp.src_donor_id,
    tmp.grad_year,
    REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(tmp.degree_desc AS VARCHAR), CHAR(0), ''), CHAR(10), ''), CHAR(13), '') AS degree_desc,
	--tmp.degree_desc,
    REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(tmp.degree_major_desc AS VARCHAR), CHAR(0), ''), CHAR(10), ''), CHAR(13), '') AS degree_major_desc,
	--tmp.degree_major_desc,
    tmp.education_level
    FROM  (
    --Degree 1 Major 1
    SELECT CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
    CAST(donor_degree.<grad year> AS VARCHAR) AS grad_year,

    --degree 1 major 2

    --AND CAST(donor_degree.<degree major 2 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL

    --AND CAST(donor_degree.<degree major 4 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL

    --AND CAST(donor_degree.<degree major 5 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
    --AND CAST(donor_degree.<degree major 6 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
    ) tmp
    --WHERE NVL(tmp.degree_desc,tmp.degree_major_desc) IS NOT NULL
  )

-- new - intended to dedupe across the entire dataset
select 
src_donor_id,
  grad_year,
  degree_desc,
  degree_cd,
  degree_type_cd,
  degree_type_desc,
  degree_award_date,
  degree_division_cd,
  degree_division_desc,
  degree_campus,
  degree_dept_cd,
  degree_dept_desc,
  degree_major_cd,

from( -- new - intended to dedupe across the entire dataset
 SELECT

  IFF(ct.grad_year REGEXP '^\\d{4}$', TRY_TO_NUMBER(ct.grad_year), NULL) AS grad_year,

  CAST(donor_degree.<degree type code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_type_cd,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree type description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_type_desc,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree award date> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_award_date,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree division code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_division_cd,
  REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(donor_degree.<degree division description> AS VARCHAR), CHAR(0), ''), CHAR(10), ''), CHAR(13), '') AS degree_division_desc,
  --CAST(donor_degree.<degree division description> As VARCHAR) AS degree_division_desc,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree campus> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_campus,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree department code> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_dept_cd,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree department description> AS VARCHAR) AS degree_dept_desc,
  CAST(donor_degree.<degree major code> As VARCHAR) AS degree_major_cd,
  ct.degree_major_desc AS degree_major_desc,
  eel.eab_education_level,
  donor_degree.intake_dt,
  <source_partner_system_name_donor_degree> as source_partner_system_name,
  <source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type,

   -- new - intended to dedupe across the entire dataset
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY 
        CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR),
        ct.degree_desc,
        ct.degree_major_desc,
        <source_partner_system_name_donor_degree>
      ORDER BY 
    CASE
        WHEN ct.grad_year REGEXP '^\\d{4}$' THEN 0
        ELSE 1
    END,
    CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR)
	--CAST(donor_degree.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR)
    ) AS rn --new - intended to dedupe across the entire dataset
  
  
FROM <[AMS].[donor_degree].{fulfillment}> AS donor_degree
JOIN CTE_donor_degree ct on donor_degree.src_donor_id = ct.src_donor_id and coalesce(ct.degree_desc,'') = coalesce(donor_degree.degree_description,'') and coalesce(ct.degree_major_desc,'') = coalesce(donor_degree.degree_major_description,'')
LEFT JOIN <eab_education_level> as eel on ct.src_donor_id = eel.src_donor_id and coalesce(ct.degree_desc,'') = coalesce(eel.degree_description,'') and coalesce(ct.degree_major_desc,'') = coalesce(eel.degree_major_description,'')
<join_extension_donor_degree>
    ) final -- new
  where rn = 1 -- new
--WHERE ct.Rno = 1

    --AND CAST(donor_degree.<degree major 2 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL

    --AND CAST(donor_degree.<degree major 6 description> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL

-- #terukula 09/15 AMS-51 V0.1 created query to populate donor_email in AMS
-- #spatole 12/12 AMS-322 - Change references for source entities in the donor bound queries
-- #terukula 12/16 renamed secondary_email column to calculated field_1 and added case statement for email_type column
--#gsudhakar 10/6/23 added intake_dt field
--#gsudhakar 11/08/23 add logic to include null emails where email_type=primary 
--#gsudhakar 03/19/25 added <join_extension_donor_email> variable
SELECT
src_donor_id,
email,
email_type,
intake_dt,
<source_partner_system_name_donor_email> as source_partner_system_name,
<source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
FROM
((SELECT
  CAST(donor_email.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
  CAST(donor_email.<email> AS VARCHAR) AS email,
  CASE WHEN CAST(donor_email.<email type> AS VARCHAR) IS NULL THEN CAST('primary' AS VARCHAR)
       ELSE CAST(donor_email.<email type> AS VARCHAR)
  END AS email_type,
  donor_email.intake_date as intake_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (partition by donor_email.email ORDER BY d.hh_primary DESC, donor_email.src_donor_id) as donor_email_rank
FROM <[AMS].[donor_email].{fulfillment}> AS donor_email
join <[AMS].[donor].{final}> d
on donor_email.src_donor_id = d.src_donor_id
WHERE CAST(donor_email.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
--AND CAST(donor_email.<email> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
)
UNION
(SELECT
  CAST(donor_email.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
  CAST(donor_email.<Calculated Field 1> AS VARCHAR) AS email,
  CAST('secondary' AS VARCHAR) AS email_type,
  donor_email.intake_date as intake_dt, null as donor_email_rank
FROM <[AMS].[donor_email].{fulfillment}> AS donor_email
WHERE CAST(donor_email.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
AND CAST(donor_email.<Calculated Field 1> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
AND CAST(donor_email.<Calculated Field 1> AS VARCHAR) <>  CAST(NVL(donor_email.<email>,'No Email') AS VARCHAR)
)) AS donor_email
<join_extension_donor_email>
WHERE donor_email.src_donor_id IS NOT NULL AND donor_email.donor_email_rank = 1
AND ((lower(donor_email.email_type) != 'primary' and coalesce(donor_email.email,'') <> '' ) OR lower(donor_email.email_type) = 'primary')
order by donor_email.src_donor_id, donor_email.email_type

WITH id_xwalk AS
    (
    SELECT * FROM
        (
        Select
            DISTINCT nullif(trim(regexp_replace(donor_id_xwalk.src_donor_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as src_donor_id,
            nullif(trim(regexp_replace(donor_id_xwalk.eab_donor_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_donor_id,
            nullif(trim(regexp_replace(donor_id_xwalk.eab_donor_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_donor_id_type,
            nullif(trim(regexp_replace(donor_id_xwalk.donor_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as donor_id_type,
            CAST(donor_id_xwalk.intake_date as timestamp) AS intake_dt
        FROM <[AMS].[donor_id_xwalk].{fulfillment}> as donor_id_xwalk
        ) dix
    WHERE COALESCE(dix.src_donor_id,'')<>''
    AND COALESCE(dix.eab_donor_id_type,'')<>''
    AND COALESCE(dix.eab_donor_id,'')<>''
    )
SELECT DISTINCT
    src_donor_id,
    eab_donor_id,
    eab_donor_id_type,
    donor_id_type,
    intake_dt
FROM id_xwalk

-- #terukula 09/15 AMS-48 V0.1 created query to populate donor_phone in AMS
-- #spatole 12/09 Change references for source entities in the donor bound queries
-- #terukula 12/16 renamed cell_phone_number column to calculated field_1 and added case statement for phone_type column
-- #gsudhakar 06/08/26 added sms_optout_ind, sms_optin_ind, phone_optout_ind, eab_sms_optin_ind, eab_phone_optout_ind, eab_phone_type fields

with final_phone as (select *,
       row_number() over (partition by src_donor_id, regexp_replace(phone_number, '[^0-9]+',''), phone_type
			order by effective_dt desc) as rn
from ((SELECT
  CAST(donor_phone.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
  CAST(donor_phone.<phone number> AS VARCHAR) AS phone_number,
  CASE WHEN CAST(donor_phone.<phone type> AS VARCHAR) IS NULL THEN CAST('home' AS VARCHAR)
       ELSE CAST(donor_phone.<phone type> AS VARCHAR)
  END AS phone_type,
  CAST(donor_phone.<effective date> AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt,
  donor_phone.sms_optout_ind,
  donor_phone.sms_optin_ind,
  donor_phone.phone_optout_ind
FROM <[AMS].[donor_phone].{fulfillment}> AS donor_phone
WHERE CAST(donor_phone.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
AND CAST(donor_phone.<phone number> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL)
UNION
(SELECT
  CAST(donor_phone.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
  CAST(donor_phone.<Calculated Field 1> AS VARCHAR) AS phone_number,
  CAST('mobile' AS VARCHAR)
  AS phone_type,
  CAST(donor_phone.<effective date> AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt,  
  donor_phone.sms_optout_ind,
  donor_phone.sms_optin_ind,
  donor_phone.phone_optout_ind
 
FROM <[AMS].[donor_phone].{fulfillment}> AS donor_phone
WHERE CAST(donor_phone.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
AND CAST(donor_phone.<Calculated Field 1> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL)) A
<join_extension_donor_phone>
)


select 
src_donor_id, 
REGEXP_REPLACE(
        CAST(phone_number AS VARCHAR),
        '[\\x00-\\x1F\\x7F]',
        ''
    ) AS phone_number,
case when phone_type in ('IOM Preferred Business Phone') then 'Preferred Business Phone' else phone_type end as phone_type, 
effective_dt,
sms_optout_ind,
sms_optin_ind,
phone_optout_ind,
<eab_sms_optin_ind> as eab_sms_optin_ind,
<eab_phone_optout_ind> as eab_phone_optout_ind,
<eab_phone_type> as eab_phone_type,
<source_partner_system_name_donor_phone> as source_partner_system_name,
<source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
from final_phone
where rn = 1

-- #terukula 09/15 AMS-48 V0.1 created query to populate donor_phone in AMS
-- #spatole 12/09 Change references for source entities in the donor bound queries
-- #terukula 12/16 renamed cell_phone_number column to calculated field_1 and added case statement for phone_type column
--Abhilash ,08/14 processing only those donor ids which are present in gifts table and having gift id is not null

with cte as (select *,
       row_number() over (partition by src_donor_id, regexp_replace(phone_number, '[^0-9]+',''), phone_type
			order by effective_dt desc) as rn
from ((SELECT
  CAST(donor_phone.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
  CAST(donor_phone.<phone number> AS VARCHAR) AS phone_number,
  CASE WHEN CAST(donor_phone.<phone type> AS VARCHAR) IS NULL THEN CAST('home' AS VARCHAR)
       ELSE CAST(donor_phone.<phone type> AS VARCHAR)
  END AS phone_type,
  CAST(donor_phone.<effective date> AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt
FROM <[AMS].[donor_phone].{fulfillment}> AS donor_phone
JOIN <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts on
donor_phone.src_donor_id = ams_gifts.src_donor_id
WHERE CAST(donor_phone.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
AND CAST(donor_phone.<phone number> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
AND cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) is not null)
UNION
(SELECT
  CAST(donor_phone.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
  CAST(donor_phone.<Calculated Field 1> AS VARCHAR) AS phone_number,
  CAST('mobile' AS VARCHAR)
  AS phone_type,
  CAST(donor_phone.<effective date> AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt
FROM <[AMS].[donor_phone].{fulfillment}> AS donor_phone
--JOIN <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts on
--donor_phone.src_donor_id = ams_gifts.src_donor_id
WHERE CAST(donor_phone.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
AND CAST(donor_phone.<Calculated Field 1> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
--AND cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) is not null)) A)

<join_extension_donor_phone>
 
select src_donor_id, phone_number, phone_type, effective_dt
from cte
where rn = 1

-- #terukula 09/15 AMS-48 V0.1 created query to populate donor_phone in AMS
-- #spatole 12/09 Change references for source entities in the donor bound queries
-- #terukula 12/16 renamed cell_phone_number column to calculated field_1 and added case statement for phone_type column
-- #bellerson 03/25/25 added replace functions around phone_number to sanitize linebreaks, null bytes, and carriage returns
-- #gsudhakar 06/05/26 added sms_optout_ind, sms_optin_ind, phone_optout_ind, eab_sms_optin_ind, eab_phone_optout_ind, eab_phone_type fields

with phone_cte as (select *,
       row_number() over (partition by src_donor_id, regexp_replace(phone_number, '[^0-9]+',''), phone_type
			order by effective_dt desc) as rn
from ((SELECT
  CAST(donor_phone.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
  CAST(donor_phone.<phone number> AS VARCHAR) AS phone_number,
  CASE WHEN CAST(donor_phone.<phone type> AS VARCHAR) IS NULL THEN CAST('home' AS VARCHAR)
       ELSE CAST(donor_phone.<phone type> AS VARCHAR)
  END AS phone_type,
  CAST(donor_phone.<effective date> AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt,
  donor_phone.sms_optout_ind,
  donor_phone.sms_optin_ind,
  donor_phone.phone_optout_ind
FROM <[AMS].[donor_phone].{fulfillment}> AS donor_phone
WHERE CAST(donor_phone.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
AND CAST(donor_phone.<phone number> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL)
UNION
(SELECT
  CAST(donor_phone.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) AS src_donor_id,
  CAST(donor_phone.<Calculated Field 1> AS VARCHAR) AS phone_number,
  CAST('mobile' AS VARCHAR)
  AS phone_type,
  CAST(donor_phone.<effective date> AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_dt,
  donor_phone.sms_optout_ind,
  donor_phone.sms_optin_ind,
  donor_phone.phone_optout_ind
FROM <[AMS].[donor_phone].{fulfillment}> AS donor_phone
WHERE CAST(donor_phone.<src donor id> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
AND CAST(donor_phone.<Calculated Field 1> AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL)) A
<join_extension_donor_phone>
)


select 
src_donor_id, 
REGEXP_REPLACE(
        CAST(phone_number AS VARCHAR),
        '[\\x00-\\x1F\\x7F]',
        ''
    ) AS phone_number,
--REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(phone_number AS VARCHAR), CHAR(0), ''), CHAR(10), ''), CHAR(13), '') AS phone_number,
--phone_number, 
phone_type, 
effective_dt,
sms_optout_ind,
sms_optin_ind,
phone_optout_ind,
<eab_sms_optin_ind> as eab_sms_optin_ind,
<eab_phone_optout_ind> as eab_phone_optout_ind,
<eab_phone_type> as eab_phone_type,
<source_partner_system_name_donor_phone> as source_partner_system_name,
<source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
from phone_cte
where rn = 1

/*syeravadekar v0.1 09/19*/
-- #terukula V0.1 09/28/2022 joined <fy_credited_gifts> variaams_giftsle to calculate credit fiscal year for gifts in AMS domain
-- kamaldeep V0.1 9/28/2022 added not null condition for gift id and src donor id
-- jgogineni 09/29 AMS-136 adding current_fiscal_year
-- csugguna, syeravadekar- 02/08 distinct was added to cte_credi_year to avoid duplicates in AMS gifts final
-- gsudhakar - 09/11/23 - added eab_reporting_ind and eab_production_ind fields
-- bellerson - 03/21/25	- Updated Appeal code to be a concatenation of appeal code and credit fiscal year
-- bellerson - 10/22/25 - Updated to use row number logic to dedupe
-- sbailey   - 03/17/26 - updated fiscal year to reflect change from Jan-Dec to July-June

with cte_credit_year as(
  select distinct gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))
		   when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited > 50 then to_number(concat(19,a.fy_credited))
		   else to_number(a.fy_credited)
	   end as credited_fy
from (
select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
	   gift_date,
       --giftyear as fy_credited
	   case when (giftmonth  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	        giftyear + 1
       else
   	       giftyear
       end as fy_credited
from
(SELECT
 	   GS.gift_id,
 	   GS.src_donor_id,
       GS.gift_date ,
       MONTH(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftmonth,
       YEAR(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs) as gb ) as a)

--begin additional logic for selecting most recent record per gift_id

select
gift_id,
src_donor_id,
gift_amount,
gift_dt,
gift_type,
gift_type_desc,
appeal_cd,
appeal_desc,
appeal_type,
appeal_type_desc,
appeal_group_cd,
appeal_group_desc,
transaction_type,
transaction_type_desc,
payment_method,
payment_method_desc,
credit_fiscal_year,
campaign_cd,
campaign_desc,
fund_cd,
fund_desc,
anonymous_ind,
current_fiscal_year,
eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,
eab_reporting_inclusion_ind,
--is_gift_annual_flag.eab_gift_is_annual_flag as eab_gift_is_annual_flag,
intake_dt,			 
source_partner_system_name,
source_eab_system_type,
rn

from ( --end additional logic for selecting most recent record per gift_id
select
cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) as src_donor_id,
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) as gift_amount,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type> as varchar) as gift_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type description> as varchar)  as gift_type_desc,
--cast(ams_gifts.<appeal code> as varchar) as appeal_cd,
<appeal_cd> as appeal_cd,
/*			 
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal code> as varchar)||'-'||case when ( len(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year>) > 4 or TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar)) is null)
 then c.credited_fy
 else TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar))
 end as appeal_cd ,
*/
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal description> as varchar) as appeal_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type> as varchar) as appeal_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type Description> as varchar) as appeal_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal group code> as varchar) as appeal_group_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal group description> as varchar) as appeal_group_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<transaction type>as varchar) as transaction_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<transaction type description> as varchar) as transaction_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<payment method> as varchar) as payment_method,
cast(ams_gifts.<payment method description> as varchar) as  payment_method_desc,
case when ( len(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year>) > 4 or TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar)) is null)
 then c.credited_fy
 else TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar))
 end as credit_fiscal_year,
cast(ams_gifts.<campaign code> as varchar) as campaign_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<campaign description> as varchar) as campaign_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund code> as varchar) as fund_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund description> as varchar) as fund_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<anonymous indicator> as boolean) as anonymous_ind,
YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) as current_fiscal_year,
--case when
--(MONTH(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
--	   YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) -1
--			   else
--			    YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) end  as  current_fiscal_year,
eab_marketing_inclusion.eab_marketing_inclusion_ind as eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,
eab_reporting_inclusion.eab_reporting_inclusion_ind as eab_reporting_inclusion_ind,
--is_gift_annual_flag.eab_gift_is_annual_flag as eab_gift_is_annual_flag,
ams_gifts.intake_date as intake_dt,
<source_partner_system_name_gifts> as source_partner_system_name,
<source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type,
row_number() over (partition by cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) order by ams_gifts.intake_date desc) as rn --additional logic for selecting most recent record per gift_id
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts
						  
left join <eab_marketing_inclusion_ind> as eab_marketing_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
						  
left join <eab_reporting_inclusion_ind> as eab_reporting_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
						  
/*left join <eab_gift_is_annual_flag> as is_gift_annual_flag 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.src_donor_id,'')*/
						  
join cte_credit_year as c
     on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'')
     and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')
where (cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) > 0
OR (
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) = 0
))
AND
 cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) is not null
AND
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) is not null
)alcorn_gifts --additional logic for selecting most recent record per gift_id 
where alcorn_gifts.rn=1 --additional logic for selecting most recent record per gift_id

Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
SELECT GIFT_ID, SRC_DONOR_ID, GIFT_AMOUNT, GIFT_DT, GIFT_TYPE_DESC, APPEAL_CD, APPEAL_DESC, APPEAL_TYPE_DESC, APPEAL_GROUP_DESC, TRANSACTION_TYPE_DESC, PAYMENT_METHOD_DESC, CAMPAIGN_DESC, FUND_CD, FUND_DESC, ANONYMOUS_IND, CREDIT_FISCAL_YEAR, RN
FROM (SELECT top10gifts.*
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY credit_fiscal_year 
                                  ORDER BY gift_amount DESC) as rn 
      FROM (SELECT g.* 
            FROM <[AMS].[gifts].{final}> as g
            where 1=1) top10gifts
      JOIN <[AMS].[donor].{final}> d
	       ON top10gifts.src_donor_id = d.src_donor_id 
           AND D.EAB_CONTACT_TYPE NOT IN ('Unknown')
      WHERE 1=1) x
WHERE 1=1 
   AND rn <= 10
ORDER BY credit_fiscal_year DESC, rn

queryResults.sqlPreview: with gift_totals as ( select g.credit_fiscal_year, sum(g.gift_amount) as total_gift_amount, count(*) as total_number_of_gifts from <[AMS].[gifts].{final}> as g …
queryResults.querySql:
with gift_totals as (
    select
        g.credit_fiscal_year,
        sum(g.gift_amount) as total_gift_amount,
        count(*) as total_number_of_gifts
    from <[AMS].[gifts].{final}> as g
    --join <[AMS].[donor].{final}> as d on d.src_donor_id = g.src_donor_id
    group by g.credit_fiscal_year
),
annual_totals as (
    select
        g.credit_fiscal_year,
        sum(gfl.fund_amount) as total_annual_amount
    from <[AMS].[gifts].{final}> as g
    --join <[AMS].[donor].{final}> as d on d.src_donor_id = g.src_donor_id
    inner join <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{final}> as gfl
        on g.gift_id = gfl.gift_id
    where gfl.eab_gift_is_annual_flag = 'true'
    group by g.credit_fiscal_year
),
reporting_totals as (
    select
        g.credit_fiscal_year,
        sum(g.gift_amount) as total_in_reporting
    from <[AMS].[gifts].{final}> as g
    --join <[AMS].[donor].{final}> as d on d.src_donor_id = g.src_donor_id
    where g.eab_reporting_inclusion_ind = 'true'
    group by g.credit_fiscal_year
),
marketing_totals as (
    select
        g.credit_fiscal_year,
        sum(g.gift_amount) as total_in_marketing
    from <[AMS].[gifts].{final}> as g
    --join <[AMS].[donor].{final}> as d on d.src_donor_id = g.src_donor_id
    where g.eab_marketing_inclusion_ind = 'true'
    group by g.credit_fiscal_year
)
select
    gt.credit_fiscal_year,
    gt.total_number_of_gifts,	
    gt.total_gift_amount,
    coalesce(at.total_annual_amount, 0) as total_annual_amount,
    coalesce(rt.total_in_reporting, 0) as total_in_reporting,
    coalesce(mt.total_in_marketing, 0) as total_in_marketing
from gift_totals gt
left join annual_totals at
    on at.credit_fiscal_year = gt.credit_fiscal_year
left join reporting_totals rt
    on rt.credit_fiscal_year = gt.credit_fiscal_year
left join marketing_totals mt
    on mt.credit_fiscal_year = gt.credit_fiscal_year
order by gt.credit_fiscal_year desc;

/*parasu 01/13*/

with cte_credit_year as(
  select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))
		   when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited > 50 then to_number(concat(19,a.fy_credited))
		   else to_number(a.fy_credited)
	   end as credited_fy
from (
select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
	   gift_date,
	   case when (giftmonth  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	        giftyear + 1
       else
   		    giftyear
       end as fy_credited
from
(SELECT
 	   GS.gift_id,
 	   GS.src_donor_id,
       GS.gift_date ,
       MONTH(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftmonth,
       YEAR(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs) as gb ) as a)

select
cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) as src_donor_id,
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) as gift_amount,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type> as varchar) as gift_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type description> as varchar)  as gift_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal code> as varchar) as appeal_cd ,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal description> as varchar) as appeal_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type> as varchar) as appeal_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type Description> as varchar) as appeal_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal group code> as varchar) as appeal_group_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal group description> as varchar) as appeal_group_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<transaction type>as varchar) as transaction_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<transaction type description> as varchar) as transaction_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<payment method> as varchar) as payment_method,
cast(ams_gifts.<payment method description> as varchar) as  payment_method_desc,
case when TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar)) is null then c.credited_fy
 else TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar))
 end as credit_fiscal_year,

cast(ams_gifts.<campaign code> as varchar) as campaign_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<campaign description> as varchar) as campaign_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund code> as varchar) as fund_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund description> as varchar) as fund_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<anonymous indicator> as boolean) as anonymous_ind,
case when
(MONTH(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	   YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) +1
			   else
			    YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) end  as  current_fiscal_year
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts
join cte_credit_year as c

     and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')
where (cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) > 0
or (
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) = 0
))
and
 cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) is not null
and
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) is not null
and
cast(ams_gifts.<Calculated Field 1> as varchar) not in ('Soft Credit')
and 
cast(ams_gifts.<fund description> as varchar) in ('M60038 - Medicine Annual Fund')

  select distinct gift_id,
       src_donor_id,
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))
           when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited > 50 then to_number(concat(19,a.fy_credited))

from (
select gift_id,

       gift_date,

            giftyear

from ( --end additional logic for selecting most recent record per gift_id

cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) as src_donor_id,
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) as gift_amount,

          on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
          and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
          and coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_allocation_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.gift_allocation_id,'')
                          
left join <eab_reporting_inclusion_ind> as eab_reporting_inclusion 
          on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
          and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
          and coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_allocation_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.gift_allocation_id,'')

          and coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_allocation_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.gift_allocation_id,'')*/
                          
join cte_credit_year as c
     on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'')
     and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')

where (
cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) > 0
OR
(
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) = 0
)
)
AND cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) is not null
AND cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) is not null

) as base_gifts --additional logic for selecting most recent record per gift_id

where base_gifts.rn = 1 --additional logic for selecting most recent record per gift_id

select gift_id,

from

 	   GS.gift_id,

       YEAR(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs) as gb ) as a)

--sum gift amount per gifts for gifts tied to multiple donors
,gifts_multiple_donors as (
select gift_id,sum(ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(g.gift_amount,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0)) as total_gift_amount 
from 
<[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1
group by gift_id having count(distinct src_donor_id)>1
)
				   
 
,gifts_multiple_funds as (
--sum gift amount per gifts for gifts tied to multiple funds and does not have multiple dates and multiple donors  
select gift_id,sum(ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(g.gift_amount,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0)) as total_gift_amount 
from 
<[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1
and gift_id not in (select gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g group by gift_id having count(distinct src_donor_id)>1)
and gift_id not in (select gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g group by gift_id having count(distinct gift_date)>1)
group by gift_id having count(distinct fund_code)>1
						  
union all
--sum gift amount per gifts for gifts with multiple rows and does not have multiple dates, multiple funds, and multiple donors				  
select gift_id,sum(ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(g.gift_amount,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0)) as total_gift_amount 
from 
<[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1
and gift_id not in (select gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g group by gift_id having count(distinct src_donor_id)>1)
and gift_id not in (select gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g group by gift_id having count(distinct gift_date)>1)
and gift_id not in (select gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g group by gift_id having count(distinct fund_code)>1)
group by gift_id having count(*)>1
)

--Gifts with multiple dates and does not have multiple donors and multiple funds
,gifts_multiple_dates_single_funds as (  
select gift_id
from 
<[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1
and gift_id not in (select gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g group by gift_id having count(distinct src_donor_id)>1)
and gift_id not in (select gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g group by gift_id having count(distinct fund_code)>1)
group by gift_id having count(distinct gift_date)>1
)

--sum gift amount per gifts for gifts tied to multiple dates and multiple funds and does not have multiple donors
,gifts_multiple_dates_multiple_funds as (
select gift_id,gift_date,total_gift_amount from ( 
select
gift_id,gift_date,row_number() over (partition by gift_id,gift_date order by 1) as row_rn,sum(gift_amount) over (partition by gift_id,gift_date order by 1) as total_gift_amount
from 
<[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1
and gift_id not in (select gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g group by gift_id having count(distinct src_donor_id)>1)
and gift_id in (select gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g group by gift_id having count(distinct fund_code)>1)
)gifts_multiple_dates_multiple_funds where row_rn=1
)

select
gift_id,
src_donor_id,
gift_amount,
gift_dt,
gift_type,
gift_type_desc,
appeal_cd ,
appeal_desc,
appeal_type,
appeal_type_desc,
appeal_group_cd,
appeal_group_desc,
transaction_type,
transaction_type_desc,
payment_method,
payment_method_desc,
credit_fiscal_year,
campaign_cd,
campaign_desc,
fund_cd,
fund_desc,
anonymous_ind,
current_fiscal_year,
eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,
eab_reporting_inclusion_ind,
--eab_gift_is_annual_flag,
<source_partner_system_name_gifts> as source_partner_system_name,
<source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
from (  				   
				   
select DISTINCT --pdove added DISTINCT 3/3/2023 to avoid dups
case 
  when cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) in (select gift_id from gifts_multiple_dates_single_funds) then calculated_field_3
  else cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) 
end as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) as src_donor_id,
--ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) as gift_amount,
case 
	when gifts_multiple_funds.gift_id is not null then gifts_multiple_funds.total_gift_amount 
	else ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0)		
end as gift_amount,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,

cast(ams_gifts.<gift type description> as varchar)  as gift_type_desc,

eab_marketing_inclusion.eab_marketing_inclusion_ind as eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

/*syeravadekar v0.1 09/19*/
-- #terukula V0.1 09/28/2022 joined <fy_credited_gifts> variaams_giftsle to calculate credit fiscal year for gifts in AMS domain
-- kamaldeep V0.1 9/28/2022 added not null condition for gift id and src donor id
-- jgogineni 09/29 AMS-136 adding current_fiscal_year
-- csugguna, syeravadekar- 02/08 distinct was added to cte_credi_year to avoid duplicates in AMS gifts final
-- gsudhakar - 09/11/23 - added eab_reporting_ind and eab_production_ind fields
-- bellerson - 5/30/24 - adding row number query to only select the most recent records


with cte_credit_year as(
  select distinct gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))
		   when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited > 50 then to_number(concat(19,a.fy_credited))
		   else to_number(a.fy_credited)
	   end as credited_fy
from (
select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
	   gift_date,
	   case when (giftmonth  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	        giftyear + 1
       else
   		    giftyear
       end as fy_credited
from
(SELECT
 	   GS.gift_id,
 	   GS.src_donor_id,
       GS.gift_date ,
       MONTH(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftmonth,
       YEAR(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs) as gb ) as a)

select 
gift_id,
src_donor_id,
gift_amount,
gift_dt, 
gift_type, 
gift_type_desc,
appeal_cd,
appeal_desc,
appeal_type, 
appeal_type_desc,
appeal_group_cd,
appeal_group_desc,
transaction_type,
transaction_type_desc,
payment_method,
payment_method_desc,
credit_fiscal_year,
campaign_cd,
campaign_desc,
fund_cd,
fund_desc,
anonymous_ind,
current_fiscal_year,
eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,
eab_reporting_inclusion_ind,
--eab_gift_is_annual_flag,
intake_dt,
<source_partner_system_name_gifts> as source_partner_system_name,
<source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type,
rn

from (
select
cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) as src_donor_id,
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) as gift_amount,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type> as varchar) as gift_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type description> as varchar)  as gift_type_desc,
<appeal_cd> as appeal_cd,
--cast(ams_gifts.<appeal code> as varchar) as appeal_cd ,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal description> as varchar) as appeal_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type> as varchar) as appeal_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type Description> as varchar) as appeal_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal group code> as varchar) as appeal_group_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal group description> as varchar) as appeal_group_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<transaction type>as varchar) as transaction_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<transaction type description> as varchar) as transaction_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<payment method> as varchar) as payment_method,
cast(ams_gifts.<payment method description> as varchar) as  payment_method_desc,
case when ( len(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year>) > 4 or TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar)) is null)
 then c.credited_fy
 else TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar))
 end as credit_fiscal_year,
cast(ams_gifts.<campaign code> as varchar) as campaign_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<campaign description> as varchar) as campaign_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund code> as varchar) as fund_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund description> as varchar) as fund_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<anonymous indicator> as boolean) as anonymous_ind,
case when
(MONTH(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	   YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) +1
			   else
			    YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) end  as  current_fiscal_year,
eab_marketing_inclusion.eab_marketing_inclusion_ind as eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,
eab_reporting_inclusion.eab_reporting_inclusion_ind as eab_reporting_inclusion_ind,
--is_gift_annual_flag.eab_gift_is_annual_flag as eab_gift_is_annual_flag,
ams_gifts.intake_date as intake_dt,
row_number() over (partition by cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) order by intake_date desc) as rn 
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts
						  
left join <eab_marketing_inclusion_ind> as eab_marketing_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
						  
left join <eab_reporting_inclusion_ind> as eab_reporting_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
						  
/*left join <eab_gift_is_annual_flag> as is_gift_annual_flag 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.src_donor_id,'')*/
						  
join cte_credit_year as c
     on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'')
     and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')
where (cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) > 0
OR (
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) = 0
))
AND
 cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) is not null
AND
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) is not null
)biola_gifts
where biola_gifts.rn=1

/*syeravadekar v0.1 09/19*/
-- #terukula V0.1 09/28/2022 joined <fy_credited_gifts> variaams_giftsle to calculate credit fiscal year for gifts in AMS domain
-- kamaldeep V0.1 9/28/2022 added not null condition for gift id and src donor id
-- jgogineni 09/29 AMS-136 adding current_fiscal_year
-- csugguna, syeravadekar- 02/08 distinct was added to cte_credi_year to avoid duplicates in AMS gifts final

with cte_credit_year as(
  select distinct gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))
		   when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited > 50 then to_number(concat(19,a.fy_credited))
		   else to_number(a.fy_credited)
	   end as credited_fy
from (
select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
	   gift_date,
	   case when (giftmonth  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	        giftyear + 1
       else
   		    giftyear
       end as fy_credited
from
(SELECT
 	   GS.gift_id,
 	   GS.src_donor_id,
       case when len(GS.gift_date) > 10 then cast(REGEXP_SUBSTR(GS.gift_date,'[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{4,4}') as TIMESTAMP)
			 else
cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp) end as gift_date ,
       MONTH(cast(case when len(GS.gift_date) > 10 then REGEXP_SUBSTR(GS.gift_date,'[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{4,4}') 
				  else GS.gift_date end as timestamp)) as giftmonth,
      YEAR(cast(case when len(GS.gift_date) > 10 then REGEXP_SUBSTR(GS.gift_date,'[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{4,4}') 
				  else GS.gift_date end as timestamp)) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs) as gb ) as a)
			 
/*,
			 multiple_funds as (
select gift_id,sum(ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(g.gift_amount,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0)) as total_gift_amount
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1
and calculated_field_3 is null
group by gift_id having count(distinct fund_code)>1
)*/			 


select
gift_id,
src_donor_id,
gift_amount,
gift_dt,
gift_type,
gift_type_desc,
appeal_cd ,
appeal_desc,
appeal_type,
appeal_type_desc,
appeal_group_cd,
appeal_group_desc,
transaction_type,
transaction_type_desc,
payment_method,
payment_method_desc,
credit_fiscal_year,
campaign_cd,
campaign_desc,
fund_cd,
fund_desc,
anonymous_ind,
current_fiscal_year,
eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,
eab_reporting_inclusion_ind,
--eab_gift_is_annual_flag,
<source_partner_system_name_gifts> as source_partner_system_name,
<source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type

from(				   
				   
select
cast(ams_gifts.gift_id as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts.src_donor_id as varchar) as src_donor_id,
--ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.gift_amount,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) as gift_amount,
--case when multiple_funds.gift_id is not null then multiple_funds.total_gift_amount else 
  ifnull(
  (
  select sum(cast(regexp_replace(g.gift_amount,'[^0-9.]', '') as float)) from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
  where g.gift_id = ams_gifts.gift_id
  )
  , 0) as gift_amount,
case when len(ams_gifts.gift_date ) > 10 then cast(REGEXP_SUBSTR(ams_gifts.gift_date ,'[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{4,4}') as TIMESTAMP)
			 else
cast(ams_gifts.gift_date  as timestamp) end as gift_dt,
--cast(ams_gifts.gift_date as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts.gift_type as varchar) as gift_type,
cast(ams_gifts.gift_type_description as varchar)  as gift_type_desc,
appeal_code as appeal_cd,
--cast(ams_gifts.appeal_code as varchar) as appeal_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.appeal_description as varchar) as appeal_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.appeal_type as varchar) as appeal_type,
cast(ams_gifts.appeal_type_description as varchar) as appeal_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.appeal_group_code as varchar) as appeal_group_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.appeal_group_description as varchar) as appeal_group_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.transaction_type as varchar) as transaction_type,
cast(ams_gifts.transaction_type_description as varchar) as transaction_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.payment_method as varchar) as payment_method,
cast(ams_gifts.payment_method_description as varchar) as  payment_method_desc,
case when ( len(ams_gifts.credit_fiscal_year) > 4 or TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.credit_fiscal_year as varchar)) is null)
 then c.credited_fy
 else TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.credit_fiscal_year as varchar))
 end as credit_fiscal_year,
cast(ams_gifts.campaign_code as varchar) as campaign_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.campaign_description as varchar) as campaign_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.fund_code as varchar) as fund_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.fund_description as varchar) as fund_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.anonymous_indicator as boolean) as anonymous_ind,
case when
(MONTH(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	   YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) +1
			   else
			    YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) end  as  current_fiscal_year,
eab_marketing_inclusion.eab_marketing_inclusion_ind as eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,
eab_reporting_inclusion.eab_reporting_inclusion_ind as eab_reporting_inclusion_ind,
--is_gift_annual_flag.eab_gift_is_annual_flag as eab_gift_is_annual_flag,
row_number() over (partition by ams_gifts.gift_id order by ams_gifts.gift_amount nulls last) as rn

from (
select g.*
, row_number() over (partition by gift_id, src_donor_id order by gift_amount desc) as rn
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
) as ams_gifts

left join <eab_marketing_inclusion_ind> as eab_marketing_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
						  
left join <eab_reporting_inclusion_ind> as eab_reporting_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
