with cte_credit_year as(
  select distinct gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))
		   when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited > 50 then to_number(concat(19,a.fy_credited))
		   else to_number(a.fy_credited)
	   end as credited_fy
from (
select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
	   gift_date,
	   case when (giftmonth  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	        giftyear + 1
       else
   		    giftyear
       end as fy_credited
from
(SELECT
 	   GS.gift_id,
 	   GS.src_donor_id,
       GS.gift_date ,
       MONTH(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftmonth,
       YEAR(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs) as gb ) as a)

cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) as src_donor_id,
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) as gift_amount,

cast(ams_gifts.<gift type> as varchar) as gift_type,

cast(ams_gifts.<payment method> as varchar) as payment_method,

case when ( len(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year>) > 4 or TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar)) is null)

 end as credit_fiscal_year,
cast(ams_gifts.<campaign code> as varchar) as campaign_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<campaign description> as varchar) as campaign_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund code> as varchar) as fund_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund description> as varchar) as fund_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<anonymous indicator> as boolean) as anonymous_ind,

left join <eab_marketing_inclusion_ind> as eab_marketing_inclusion

		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.fund_code,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.fund_code,'')

		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.calculated_field_3,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.calculated_field_3,'')
						  
left join <eab_reporting_inclusion_ind> as eab_reporting_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.fund_code,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.fund_code,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_allocation_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.gift_allocation_id,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.calculated_field_3,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.calculated_field_3,'')
						  
left join <eab_gift_is_annual_flag> as is_gift_annual_flag 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.src_donor_id,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.fund_code,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.fund_code,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_allocation_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.gift_allocation_id,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.calculated_field_3,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.calculated_field_3,'')						  
						  
join cte_credit_year as c
     on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'')

 cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) is not null

cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) is not null

     on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'')
     and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')
	 and coalesce(ams_gifts.fund_code,'') = coalesce(c.fund_code,'')
	 and coalesce(ams_gifts.calculated_field_2,'') = coalesce(c.calculated_field_2,'')

ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) = 0
))
AND
 cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) is not null
AND
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) is not null
AND coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(ams_gifts.calculated_field_1,'')
)marist_gifts where marist_gifts.rn=1

gift_id,
src_donor_id,
gift_amount,
gift_dt, 
gift_type, 
gift_type_desc,
appeal_cd,
appeal_desc,
appeal_type, 
appeal_type_desc,
appeal_group_cd,
appeal_group_desc,

from(

calculated_field_1 as src_donor_id,
'0' as gift_amount,
case when g.gift_date like '%-%' then cast(try_to_timestamp(g.gift_date, 'DD-MON-YY') as timestamp)

end as gift_dt, 
null as gift_type, 
null as gift_type_desc,
null as appeal_cd,
null as appeal_desc,
null as appeal_type, 
null as appeal_type_desc,
null as appeal_group_cd,
null as appeal_group_desc,
null as transaction_type,
null as transaction_type_desc,
null as payment_method,
null as payment_method_desc,

null as campaign_cd,
null as campaign_desc,
null as fund_cd,
null as fund_desc,

case

					 from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as g
					 where 1=1
					 and fund_code in ('10000-1100','10000-5003','10000-5013','10000-5208','10000-5301','10000-5302','10000-6414','10000-8230')

case

					) then 'false'
	else 'true'
	end as eab_reporting_inclusion_ind,
row_number() over (partition by gift_id order by 1) as rn 	
from <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1 
and gift_id not in (select distinct gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g where 1=1 and coalesce(g.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(g.calculated_field_1,''))

/*syeravadekar v0.1 09/19*/
-- #terukula V0.1 09/28/2022 joined <fy_credited_gifts> variaams_giftsle to calculate credit fiscal year for gifts in AMS domain
-- kamaldeep V0.1 9/28/2022 added not null condition for gift id and src donor id
-- jgogineni 09/29 AMS-136 adding current_fiscal_year
-- csugguna, syeravadekar- 02/08 distinct was added to cte_credi_year to avoid duplicates in AMS gifts final

with cte_credit_year as(
  select distinct gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))
		   when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited > 50 then to_number(concat(19,a.fy_credited))
		   else to_number(a.fy_credited)
	   end as credited_fy
from (
select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
	   gift_date,
	   case when (giftmonth  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	        giftyear + 1
       else
   		    giftyear
       end as fy_credited
from
(SELECT
 	   GS.gift_id,
 	   GS.src_donor_id,
       GS.gift_date ,
       MONTH(TO_DATE(RTRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(GS.gift_date,'[0-9]*:[0-9]*:[0-9]* [A-Z][A-Z]','')),'MON DD, YYYY')) as giftmonth,
       YEAR(TO_DATE(RTRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(GS.gift_date,'[0-9]*:[0-9]*:[0-9]* [A-Z][A-Z]','')),'MON DD, YYYY')) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs) as gb ) as a)

select
cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) as src_donor_id,
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) as gift_amount,
cast(to_date(
  case
	when len(rtrim(substr(ams_gifts.<gift date>,1,12))) = 11 then substr(ams_gifts.<gift date>,1,4) || '0' || substr(ams_gifts.<gift date>,5,7)
    else substr(ams_gifts.<gift date>,1,12)
	end
  , 'MON dd, yyyy') as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type> as varchar) as gift_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type description> as varchar)  as gift_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal code> as varchar) as appeal_cd ,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal description> as varchar) as appeal_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type> as varchar) as appeal_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type Description> as varchar) as appeal_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal group code> as varchar) as appeal_group_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal group description> as varchar) as appeal_group_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<transaction type>as varchar) as transaction_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<transaction type description> as varchar) as transaction_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<payment method> as varchar) as payment_method,
cast(ams_gifts.<payment method description> as varchar) as  payment_method_desc,
case when ( len(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year>) > 4 or TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar)) is null)
 then c.credited_fy
 else TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar))
 end as credit_fiscal_year,
cast(ams_gifts.<campaign code> as varchar) as campaign_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<campaign description> as varchar) as campaign_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund code> as varchar) as fund_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund description> as varchar) as fund_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<anonymous indicator> as boolean) as anonymous_ind,
case when
(MONTH(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	   YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) +1
			   else
			    YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) end  as  current_fiscal_year,
eab_marketing_inclusion.eab_marketing_inclusion_ind as eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,
eab_reporting_inclusion.eab_reporting_inclusion_ind as eab_reporting_inclusion_ind,
is_gift_annual_flag.eab_gift_is_annual_flag as eab_gift_is_annual_flag
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts
						  
left join <eab_marketing_inclusion_ind> as eab_marketing_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_allocation_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.gift_allocation_id,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_type,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.gift_type,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_date,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.gift_date,'')
						  
left join <eab_reporting_inclusion_ind> as eab_reporting_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_allocation_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.gift_allocation_id,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_type,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.gift_type,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_date,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.gift_date,'')
						  
left join <eab_gift_is_annual_flag> as is_gift_annual_flag 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.src_donor_id,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_allocation_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.gift_allocation_id,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_type,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.gift_type,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_date,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.gift_date,'')
						  
join cte_credit_year as c
     on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'')
     and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')
where (cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) > 0
OR (
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) = 0
))
AND
 cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) is not null
AND
 cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) is not null
AND
 cast(ams_gifts.<fund code> as varchar) in ('01921','00487','01776','03345','02818') --pdove - only these 5 funds count as real gifts

  select distinct gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))

	   end as credited_fy
from (
select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
	   gift_date,
	   case when (giftmonth  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	        giftyear + 1
       else
   		    giftyear
       end as fy_credited
from
(SELECT
 	   GS.gift_id,

       --MONTH(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftmonth,
       --YEAR(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs) as gb ) as a),
			 
cte_gift_amount as 
			 (
			   select 
			   gift_id, sum(fund_amount) as gift_amount_total
			   from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts_funds
			   group by 1
			 ) 

select
cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
ltrim(cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar),'0') as src_donor_id,
--cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) as src_donor_id,
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(c2.gift_amount_total,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) as gift_amount,

cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift date>,'[\\s].*','') as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type> as varchar) as gift_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type description> as varchar)  as gift_type_desc,
<appeal_cd> as appeal_cd,
--cast(ams_gifts.<appeal code> as varchar) as appeal_cd ,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal description> as varchar) as appeal_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type> as varchar) as appeal_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type Description> as varchar) as appeal_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal group code> as varchar) as appeal_group_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal group description> as varchar) as appeal_group_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<transaction type>as varchar) as transaction_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<transaction type description> as varchar) as transaction_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<payment method> as varchar) as payment_method,
cast(ams_gifts.<payment method description> as varchar) as  payment_method_desc,
case when ( len(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year>) > 4 or TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar)) is null)
 then c.credited_fy
 else TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar))
 end as credit_fiscal_year,
cast(ams_gifts.<campaign code> as varchar) as campaign_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<campaign description> as varchar) as campaign_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund code> as varchar) as fund_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund description> as varchar) as fund_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<anonymous indicator> as boolean) as anonymous_ind,
case when
(MONTH(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	   YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) +1
			   else
			    YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) end  as  current_fiscal_year,
eab_marketing_inclusion.eab_marketing_inclusion_ind as eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,
eab_reporting_inclusion.eab_reporting_inclusion_ind as eab_reporting_inclusion_ind,
--is_gift_annual_flag.eab_gift_is_annual_flag as eab_gift_is_annual_flag,
<source_partner_system_name_gifts> as source_partner_system_name,
<source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts
						  
left join <eab_marketing_inclusion_ind> as eab_marketing_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
						  
left join <eab_reporting_inclusion_ind> as eab_reporting_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
						  
/*left join <eab_gift_is_annual_flag> as is_gift_annual_flag 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.src_donor_id,'')*/
						  
join cte_credit_year as c
     on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'')
     and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')
						  
join cte_gift_amount as c2
	on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c2.gift_id,'')
						  
where (cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) > 0
OR (
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) = 0
))
AND
 cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) is not null
AND
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) is not null

-- #terukula V0.1 09/28/2022 joined <fy_credited_gifts> variaams_giftsle to calculate credit fiscal year for gifts in AMS domain

with cte_credit_year as(
  select distinct gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))
		   when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited > 50 then to_number(concat(19,a.fy_credited))

from (
select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
	   gift_date,
	   case when (giftmonth  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	        giftyear + 1
       else
   		    giftyear
       end as fy_credited
from
(SELECT
 	   GS.gift_id,
 	   GS.src_donor_id,
       GS.gift_date ,
       MONTH(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftmonth,
       YEAR(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs) as gb ) as a)

--Sum gift amount if a gift ID has multiple fund codes or multiple donors			 
,gifts_multiple_fund_codes_donor_ids as (
select gift_id,sum(ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(g.gift_amount,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0)) as total_gift_amount
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1 
and gift_id not in (select gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g group by gift_id having count(distinct src_donor_id)>1) -- Exclude cases where gift id has duplicates due to fund code and src donor id (Only gift_id example found = 998682)
group by gift_id having count(distinct fund_code)>1
						  
union all 
						  
select gift_id,sum(ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(g.gift_amount,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0)) as total_gift_amount
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1 
group by gift_id having count(distinct src_donor_id)>1						  
)

select
gift_id,
src_donor_id,
gift_amount,
gift_dt,
gift_type,
gift_type_desc,
appeal_cd ,
appeal_desc,
appeal_type,
appeal_type_desc,
appeal_group_cd,
appeal_group_desc,
transaction_type,
transaction_type_desc,
payment_method,
payment_method_desc,
credit_fiscal_year,

anonymous_ind,
current_fiscal_year,
eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,
eab_reporting_inclusion_ind,
--eab_gift_is_annual_flag,
intake_dt,
<source_partner_system_name_gifts> as source_partner_system_name,
<source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type

from(
  
select
cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) as src_donor_id,
--ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) as gift_amount,
case 
	when gifts_multiple_fund_codes_donor_ids.gift_id is not null then gifts_multiple_fund_codes_donor_ids.total_gift_amount

cast(ams_gifts.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type> as varchar) as gift_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type description> as varchar)  as gift_type_desc,
<appeal_cd> as appeal_cd,
--cast(ams_gifts.<appeal code> as varchar) as appeal_cd ,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal description> as varchar) as appeal_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type> as varchar) as appeal_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type Description> as varchar) as appeal_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal group code> as varchar) as appeal_group_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal group description> as varchar) as appeal_group_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<transaction type>as varchar) as transaction_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<transaction type description> as varchar) as transaction_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<payment method> as varchar) as payment_method,
cast(ams_gifts.<payment method description> as varchar) as  payment_method_desc,
case when ( len(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year>) > 4 or TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar)) is null)
 then c.credited_fy
 else TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar))
 end as credit_fiscal_year,
cast(ams_gifts.<campaign code> as varchar) as campaign_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<campaign description> as varchar) as campaign_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund code> as varchar) as fund_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund description> as varchar) as fund_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<anonymous indicator> as boolean) as anonymous_ind,
case when
(MONTH(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	   YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) +1
			   else
			    YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) end  as  current_fiscal_year,
eab_marketing_inclusion.eab_marketing_inclusion_ind as eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,
eab_reporting_inclusion.eab_reporting_inclusion_ind as eab_reporting_inclusion_ind,
--is_gift_annual_flag.eab_gift_is_annual_flag as eab_gift_is_annual_flag,
ams_gifts.intake_date as intake_dt,
row_number() over (partition by ams_gifts.gift_id order by ams_gifts.src_donor_id asc) as rn
--row_number() over (partition by ams_gifts.gift_id,ams_gifts.src_donor_id order by 1) as rn --Dedup the gift records with multiple fund codes. Preserve duplicate gift records due to multiple donor IDs for the time being
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts
						  
left join <eab_marketing_inclusion_ind> as eab_marketing_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
          and coalesce(ams_gifts.fund_code,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.fund_code,'') 
						  
left join <eab_reporting_inclusion_ind> as eab_reporting_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
          and coalesce(ams_gifts.fund_code,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.fund_code,'') 
						  
/*left join <eab_gift_is_annual_flag> as is_gift_annual_flag 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.src_donor_id,'')
          and coalesce(ams_gifts.fund_code,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.fund_code,'')*/
						  
left join gifts_multiple_fund_codes_donor_ids on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = gifts_multiple_fund_codes_donor_ids.gift_id						  
						  
join cte_credit_year as c
     on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'')
     and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')
where (cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) > 0
OR (
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) = 0
))
and cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) not in ('974104','973028') 
AND
 cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) is not null
AND
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) is not null
)gifts
where 1=1
and gifts.rn=1

Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. /*syeravadekar v0.1 09/19*/
-- #terukula V0.1 09/28/2022 joined <fy_credited_gifts> variable to calculate credit fiscal year for gifts in AMS domain
-- kamaldeep V0.1 9/28/2022 added not null condition for gift id and src donor id
-- jgogineni 09/29 AMS-136 adding current_fiscal_year

with cte_credit_year as(
  select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id, 
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))
		   when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited > 50 then to_number(concat(19,a.fy_credited))
		   else to_number(a.fy_credited)
	   end as credited_fy
from (
select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
	   gift_date,
	   case when (giftmonth  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	        giftyear + 1
       else
   		    giftyear 
       end as fy_credited
from
(SELECT
 	   GS.gift_id,
 	   GS.src_donor_id,
       GS.gift_date ,
       MONTH(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftmonth,
       YEAR(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts_source]> as gs) as gb ) as a)

select
cast(b.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(b.<src donor id> as varchar) as src_donor_id,
cast(regexp_replace( b.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) as gift_amount,
cast(b.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(b.<gift type> as varchar) as gift_type,
cast(b.<gift type description> as varchar)  as gift_type_desc,
cast(b.<appeal code> as varchar) as appeal_cd ,
cast(b.<appeal description> as varchar) as appeal_desc,
cast(b.<appeal type> as varchar) as appeal_type,
cast(b.<appeal type Description> as varchar) as appeal_type_desc,
cast(b.<appeal group code> as varchar) as appeal_group_cd,
cast(b.<appeal group description> as varchar) as appeal_group_desc,
cast(b.<transaction type>as varchar) as transaction_type,
cast(b.<transaction type description> as varchar) as transaction_type_desc,
cast(b.<payment method> as varchar) as payment_method,
cast(b.<payment method description> as varchar) as  payment_method_desc,
case when TO_NUMBER(cast(b.<credit fiscal year> as varchar)) is null then c.credited_fy
 else TO_NUMBER(cast(b.<credit fiscal year> as varchar))
 end as credit_fiscal_year,
		
cast(b.<campaign code> as varchar) as campaign_cd,
cast(b.<campaign description> as varchar) as campaign_desc,
cast(b.<fund code> as varchar) as fund_cd,
cast(b.<fund description> as varchar) as fund_desc,
cast(b.<anonymous indicator> as boolean) as anonymous_ind,
---cast(<current_fiscal_year> as varchar) as current_fiscal_year,			 
case when 
(MONTH(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	   YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) +1 
			   else 
			    YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) end  as  current_fiscal_year
from <[AMS].[gifts_source].{fulfillment}> as b
join cte_credit_year as c
     on coalesce(b.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'')
    and coalesce(b.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')
where (cast(regexp_replace( b.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) > 0
OR (
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace( b.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) = 0 AND
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace( b.<soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float),0)=0 AND
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace( b.<second soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float),0)=0 AND
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace( b.<third soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float),0)=0 AND
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace( b.<fourth soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float),0)=0 AND
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace( b.<fifth soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float),0)=0
))
AND
 cast(b.<gift id> as varchar) is not null
AND
cast(b.<src donor id> as varchar) is not null

/*syeravadekar v0.1 09/19*/
-- #terukula V0.1 09/28/2022 joined <fy_credited_gifts> variaams_giftsle to calculate credit fiscal year for gifts in AMS domain
-- kamaldeep V0.1 9/28/2022 added not null condition for gift id and src donor id
-- jgogineni 09/29 AMS-136 adding current_fiscal_year
-- csugguna, syeravadekar- 02/08 distinct was added to cte_credi_year to avoid duplicates in AMS gifts final
-- gsudhakar - 09/11/23 - added eab_reporting_ind and eab_production_ind fields
--Bindings to Calculated Fields
	--calculated_field_1 = amt_actual
	--calculated_field_3 = src_primary_donor_id
	--calculated_field_4 = joint_ind

with gifts_multiple_fund_codes as (
select g.gift_id
, sum(cast(regexp_replace(g.gift_amount,'[^0-9.]', '') as float)) as total_gift_amount  
--,case when calculated_field_4 = 'Y' then sum(cast(regexp_replace(g.gift_amount,'[^0-9.]', '') as float))
--      else sum(cast(regexp_replace(g.calculated_field_1,'[^0-9.]', '') as float))
-- end as total_gift_amount
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1
and g.intake_date = (select max(intake_date) as i from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g1 where g1.gift_id = g.gift_id)
and g.calculated_field_4 = 'Y'
and coalesce(g.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(g.calculated_field_3,'') 
and cast(g.gift_id as varchar) is not null
and cast(g.src_donor_id as varchar) is not null
group by g.gift_id having count(distinct fund_code)>1
		   
union all

select g.gift_id
, sum(cast(regexp_replace(g.calculated_field_1,'[^0-9.]', '') as float)) as total_gift_amount  
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1
and g.intake_date = (select max(intake_date) as i from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g1 where g1.gift_id = g.gift_id)
and g.calculated_field_4 = 'N'
and coalesce(g.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(g.calculated_field_3,'') 
and cast(g.gift_id as varchar) is not null
and cast(g.src_donor_id as varchar) is not null
group by g.gift_id having count(distinct fund_code)>1
)
					 
,cte_credit_year as(
  select distinct gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
       fund_code,
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))
		   when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited > 50 then to_number(concat(19,a.fy_credited))
		   else to_number(a.fy_credited)
	   end as credited_fy
from (
select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
       fund_code,
	   gift_date,
	   case when (giftmonth  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	        giftyear + 1
       else
   		    giftyear
       end as fy_credited
from
(SELECT
 	   GS.gift_id,
 	   GS.src_donor_id,
 	   GS.fund_code,
       GS.gift_date as gift_date,
       MONTH(cast(try_to_timestamp(GS.gift_date, 'DD-MON-YY') as timestamp)) as giftmonth,
       YEAR(cast(try_to_timestamp(GS.gift_date, 'DD-MON-YY') as timestamp)) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs
where 1=1 and gs.intake_date = (select max(intake_date) as i from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g1 where g1.gift_id = gs.gift_id)		
				) as gb ) as a)

select 
gift_id,
src_donor_id,
gift_amount,
gift_dt, 
gift_type, 
gift_type_desc,
appeal_cd,
appeal_desc,
appeal_type, 
appeal_type_desc,
appeal_group_cd,
appeal_group_desc,
transaction_type,
transaction_type_desc,
payment_method,
payment_method_desc,
credit_fiscal_year,
campaign_cd,
campaign_desc,
fund_cd,
fund_desc,
anonymous_ind,
current_fiscal_year,
eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,
eab_reporting_inclusion_ind		
from (			 
			 
select
cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) as src_donor_id,
--ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) as gift_amount,
case 
	when gifts_multiple_fund_codes.gift_id is not null then gifts_multiple_fund_codes.total_gift_amount
    when gifts_multiple_fund_codes.gift_id is null and ams_gifts.calculated_field_4 = 'N' then ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.calculated_field_1,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) 
	else ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) 
end as gift_amount,
			 
--cast(try_to_timestamp(ams_gifts.gift_date, 'DD-MON-YY') as timestamp) as gift_dt,
case when ams_gifts.gift_date like '%-%' then cast(try_to_timestamp(ams_gifts.gift_date, 'DD-MON-YY') as timestamp) 
else try_to_timestamp(substring(ams_gifts.gift_date,1,19))
end as gift_dt,			 
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type> as varchar) as gift_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type description> as varchar)  as gift_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal code> as varchar) as appeal_cd ,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal description> as varchar) as appeal_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type> as varchar) as appeal_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type Description> as varchar) as appeal_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal group code> as varchar) as appeal_group_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal group description> as varchar) as appeal_group_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<transaction type>as varchar) as transaction_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<transaction type description> as varchar) as transaction_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<payment method> as varchar) as payment_method,
cast(ams_gifts.<payment method description> as varchar) as  payment_method_desc,
case when ( len(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year>) > 4 or TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar)) is null)
 then c.credited_fy
 else TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar))
 end as credit_fiscal_year,
cast(ams_gifts.<campaign code> as varchar) as campaign_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<campaign description> as varchar) as campaign_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund code> as varchar) as fund_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund description> as varchar) as fund_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<anonymous indicator> as boolean) as anonymous_ind,
case when
(MONTH(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	   YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) +1
			   else
			    YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) end  as  current_fiscal_year,
eab_marketing_inclusion.eab_marketing_inclusion_ind as eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,
eab_reporting_inclusion.eab_reporting_inclusion_ind as eab_reporting_inclusion_ind,
row_number() over (partition by cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) order by intake_date desc) as rn						  
--is_gift_annual_flag.eab_gift_is_annual_flag as eab_gift_is_annual_flag
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts
						  
left join <eab_marketing_inclusion_ind> as eab_marketing_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.fund_code,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.fund_code,'')
						  
left join <eab_reporting_inclusion_ind> as eab_reporting_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.fund_code,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.fund_code,'')

/*						  
left join <eab_gift_is_annual_flag> as is_gift_annual_flag 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.src_donor_id,'')
*/
						  
join cte_credit_year as c
     on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'')
     and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')
	 and coalesce(ams_gifts.fund_code,'') = coalesce(c.fund_code,'')
						  
left join gifts_multiple_fund_codes on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = gifts_multiple_fund_codes.gift_id						  
						  
where (cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) > 0
OR (
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) = 0
))
AND
 cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) is not null
AND
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) is not null
AND
coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(ams_gifts.calculated_field_3,'')
AND 
ams_gifts.intake_date = (select max(intake_date) as i from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g1 where g1.gift_id = ams_gifts.gift_id)  
)ttu_gifts where ttu_gifts.rn=1
	   
union all
	   
select
gift_id,
src_donor_id,
gift_amount,
gift_dt, 
gift_type, 
gift_type_desc,
appeal_cd,
appeal_desc,
appeal_type, 
appeal_type_desc,
appeal_group_cd,
appeal_group_desc,
transaction_type,
transaction_type_desc,
payment_method,
payment_method_desc,
credit_fiscal_year,
campaign_cd,
campaign_desc,
fund_cd,
fund_desc,
anonymous_ind,
current_fiscal_year,
eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,
eab_reporting_inclusion_ind
from(
select
gift_id,
calculated_field_4 as src_donor_id,
'0' as gift_amount,
case when g.gift_date like '%-%' then cast(try_to_timestamp(g.gift_date, 'DD-MON-YY') as timestamp) 
else try_to_timestamp(substring(g.gift_date,1,19))
end as gift_dt, 
null as gift_type, 
null as gift_type_desc,
null as appeal_cd,
null as appeal_desc,
null as appeal_type, 
null as appeal_type_desc,
null as appeal_group_cd,
null as appeal_group_desc,
null as transaction_type,
null as transaction_type_desc,
null as payment_method,
null as payment_method_desc,
TO_NUMBER(credit_fiscal_year) as credit_fiscal_year,
null as campaign_cd,
null as campaign_desc,
null as fund_cd,
null as fund_desc,
null as anonymous_ind,
case when
(MONTH(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	   YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) +1
			   else
			    YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) end as current_fiscal_year,
case 
	when gift_id in (select distinct gift_id 
					 from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as g
					 where 1=1
					 and g.calculated_field_3 = (select max(calculated_field_3) as i from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as g1 where g1.gift_id = g.gift_id) 
					 and fund_desc in ('Red Raider Club Excellence Fund', 'Loyalty Fund - Alumni Assoc')
					) then 'false'
	else 'true'
	end as eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,
case 
	when gift_id in (select distinct gift_id 
					 from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as g
					 where 1=1
					 and g.calculated_field_3 = (select max(calculated_field_3) as i from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as g1 where g1.gift_id = g.gift_id) 
					 and fund_desc in ('Red Raider Club Excellence Fund', 'Loyalty Fund - Alumni Assoc')
					) then 'false'
	else 'true'
	end as eab_reporting_inclusion_ind,
row_number() over (partition by gift_id order by 1) as rn 						  
from <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1 
and gift_id not in (select distinct gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g 
					where 1=1
					and coalesce(g.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(g.calculated_field_3,'')
				   )
)gifts where gifts.rn=1

/*syeravadekar v0.1 09/19*/
-- #terukula V0.1 09/28/2022 joined <fy_credited_gifts> variaams_giftsle to calculate credit fiscal year for gifts in AMS domain
-- kamaldeep V0.1 9/28/2022 added not null condition for gift id and src donor id
-- jgogineni 09/29 AMS-136 adding current_fiscal_year
-- csugguna, syeravadekar- 02/08 distinct was added to cte_credi_year to avoid duplicates in AMS gifts final
-- gsudhakar - 09/11/23 - added eab_reporting_ind and eab_production_ind fields
-- pulling fund info from gifts funds file


with cte_credit_year as(
  select distinct gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))
		   when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited > 50 then to_number(concat(19,a.fy_credited))
		   else to_number(a.fy_credited)
	   end as credited_fy
from (
select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
	   gift_date,
	   case when (giftmonth  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	        giftyear + 1
       else
   		    giftyear
       end as fy_credited
from
(SELECT
 	   GS.gift_id,
 	   GS.src_donor_id,
       GS.gift_date ,
       MONTH(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftmonth,
       YEAR(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs) as gb ) as a)

select
cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) as src_donor_id,
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) as gift_amount,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type> as varchar) as gift_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type description> as varchar)  as gift_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal code> as varchar) as appeal_cd ,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal description> as varchar) as appeal_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type> as varchar) as appeal_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type Description> as varchar) as appeal_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal group code> as varchar) as appeal_group_cd,

  select distinct gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))

from (
select gift_id,

from

 	   GS.gift_id,

from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs) as gb ) as a)

cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) as src_donor_id,
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) as gift_amount,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type> as varchar) as gift_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type description> as varchar)  as gift_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal code> as varchar) as appeal_cd ,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal description> as varchar) as appeal_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type> as varchar) as appeal_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type Description> as varchar) as appeal_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal group code> as varchar) as appeal_group_cd,

cast(ams_gifts.<payment method> as varchar) as payment_method,

is_gift_annual_flag.eab_gift_is_annual_flag as eab_gift_is_annual_flag
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts
						  
left join <eab_marketing_inclusion_ind> as eab_marketing_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.gift_id,'')

		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.fund_code,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.fund_code,'')
						  
left join <eab_gift_is_annual_flag> as is_gift_annual_flag 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.src_donor_id,'')
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.fund_code,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.fund_code,'')						  
						  
join cte_credit_year as c
     on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'')
     and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')
where (cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) > 0
OR (
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) = 0
))
AND
 cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) is not null
AND
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) is not null

with cte_credit_year as(
  select distinct gift_id,

from (
select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
	   gift_date,
	   case when (giftmonth  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then

       else

from
(SELECT
 	   GS.gift_id,

       GS.gift_date ,
       MONTH(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftmonth,

/*syeravadekar v0.1 09/19*/
-- #terukula V0.1 09/28/2022 joined <fy_credited_gifts> variaams_giftsle to calculate credit fiscal year for gifts in AMS domain
-- kamaldeep V0.1 9/28/2022 added not null condition for gift id and src donor id
-- jgogineni 09/29 AMS-136 adding current_fiscal_year
-- csugguna, syeravadekar- 02/08 distinct was added to cte_credi_year to avoid duplicates in AMS gifts final
-- gsudhakar - 09/11/23 - added eab_reporting_ind and eab_production_ind fields


with cte_credit_year as(
  select distinct gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))
		   when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited > 50 then to_number(concat(19,a.fy_credited))
		   else to_number(a.fy_credited)
	   end as credited_fy
from (
select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
	   gift_date,
	   case when (giftmonth  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	        giftyear + 1
       else
   		    giftyear
       end as fy_credited
from
(SELECT
 	   GS.gift_id,
 	   GS.src_donor_id,
       GS.gift_date ,
       MONTH(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftmonth,
       YEAR(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs) as gb ) as a)

select
--cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
replace(cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar),' ','') as gift_id, 
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) as src_donor_id,
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(y.GIFT_ID_TOTAL_AMOUNT,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) as gift_amount,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type> as varchar) as gift_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<gift type description> as varchar)  as gift_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal code> as varchar) as appeal_cd ,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal description> as varchar) as appeal_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type> as varchar) as appeal_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal type Description> as varchar) as appeal_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<appeal group code> as varchar) as appeal_group_cd,

cast(ams_gifts.<transaction type>as varchar) as transaction_type,
cast(ams_gifts.<transaction type description> as varchar) as transaction_type_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<payment method> as varchar) as payment_method,
cast(ams_gifts.<payment method description> as varchar) as  payment_method_desc,
case when ( len(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year>) > 4 or TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar)) is null)
 then c.credited_fy
 else TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar))
 end as credit_fiscal_year,
cast(ams_gifts.<campaign code> as varchar) as campaign_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<campaign description> as varchar) as campaign_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund code> as varchar) as fund_cd,
cast(ams_gifts.<fund description> as varchar) as fund_desc,
cast(ams_gifts.<anonymous indicator> as boolean) as anonymous_ind,
case when
(MONTH(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	   YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) +1
			   else
			    YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) end  as  current_fiscal_year,
eab_marketing_inclusion.eab_marketing_inclusion_ind as eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,
eab_reporting_inclusion.eab_reporting_inclusion_ind as eab_reporting_inclusion_ind,
is_gift_annual_flag.eab_gift_is_annual_flag as eab_gift_is_annual_flag
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts
/*** CUSTOM SECTION to remove duplicates and get the accurate total gift***/
join -- inner join - we want to remove duplicates 
/*Gift hard credits totals*/
(
select x.SRC_DONOR_ID_L, x.GIFT_ID_L, x.GIFT_ID_TOTAL_AMOUNT from (
select a.SRC_DONOR_ID as SRC_DONOR_ID_L, b.GIFT_ID as GIFT_ID_L, c.GIFT_ID_TOTAL_AMOUNT from (
select d.SRC_DONOR_ID, concat(d.SRC_DONOR_ID,ifnull(d.FIRST_NAME,''),' ',ifnull(d.MIDDLE_NAME,''),' ',ifnull(d.LAST_NAME,'')) as donor_XREF
from <[AMS].[donor].{fulfillment}> d
) a
join
(
select g.SRC_DONOR_ID, g.GIFT_ID, case when contains(regexp_replace(g.GIFT_ID,' Miss ',' Ms. '),'.') then concat(g.SRC_DONOR_ID,ltrim(split_part(regexp_replace(g.GIFT_ID,' Miss ',' Ms. '),'.',2))) else concat(g.SRC_DONOR_ID,ltrim(split_part(g.GIFT_ID,'-',2))) end as gift_XREF
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> g
) b
--on a.donor_XREF = b.gift_XREF
on regexp_replace(a.donor_XREF,' ','') =regexp_replace(b.gift_XREF,' ','')
join
(
select gg.GIFT_ID,sum(gg.GIFT_AMOUNT) as GIFT_ID_TOTAL_AMOUNT
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> gg
group by gg.GIFT_ID
) c
on b.GIFT_ID = c.GIFT_ID
) x
) y
on cast(y.SRC_DONOR_ID_L as varchar) = cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar)
and cast(y.GIFT_ID_L as varchar) = cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar)
/*** CUSTOM SECTION ***/						  
left join <eab_marketing_inclusion_ind> as eab_marketing_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_marketing_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
						  
left join <eab_reporting_inclusion_ind> as eab_reporting_inclusion 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
						  
left join <eab_gift_is_annual_flag> as is_gift_annual_flag 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.src_donor_id,'')
						  
join cte_credit_year as c
     on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'')
     and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')
where (cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) > 0
OR (
ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float), 0) = 0
))
AND
 cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) is not null
AND
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) is not null
AND cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) NOT in ('140036','140037','158006','158005')

from (
select gift_id,
       src_donor_id,

            giftyear + 1

            giftyear

(SELECT
       GS.gift_id,

       GS.gift_date ,
       MONTH(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftmonth,
       YEAR(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs) as gb ) as a),
			 
cte_gift_amount as 
			 (
			   select 
			   gift_id, sum(fund_amount) as gift_amount_total
			   from <[AMS].[gifts_funds].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts_funds

rn

,multiple_gifts_records as (

from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1
group by gift_id having count(gift_id)>1
)			 

select
gift_id,
src_donor_id,
gift_amount,
gift_dt,
gift_type,
gift_type_desc,
appeal_cd ,
appeal_desc,
appeal_type,
appeal_type_desc,

intake_dt,
<source_partner_system_name_gifts> as source_partner_system_name,

from(

cast(ams_gifts.<fund code> as varchar) as fund_cd,

cast(ams_gifts.<anonymous indicator> as boolean) as anonymous_ind,
case when
(MONTH(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	   YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) +1
			   else
			    YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) end  as  current_fiscal_year,
eab_marketing_inclusion.eab_marketing_inclusion_ind as eab_marketing_inclusion_ind,
eab_reporting_inclusion.eab_reporting_inclusion_ind as eab_reporting_inclusion_ind,
--is_gift_annual_flag.eab_gift_is_annual_flag as eab_gift_is_annual_flag,
ams_gifts.intake_date as intake_dt,
row_number() over (partition by ams_gifts.<gift id> order by ams_gifts.<appeal code> nulls last) as rn

		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
						  
/*left join <eab_gift_is_annual_flag> as is_gift_annual_flag 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.src_donor_id,'')*/

where (cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) > 0

/*syeravadekar v0.1 09/19*/
-- #terukula V0.1 09/28/2022 joined <fy_credited_gifts> variaams_giftsle to calculate credit fiscal year for gifts in AMS domain

-- csugguna, syeravadekar- 02/08 distinct was added to cte_credi_year to avoid duplicates in AMS gifts final
-- gsudhakar - 09/11/23 - added eab_reporting_ind and eab_production_ind fields


with cte_credit_year as(
  select distinct gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))
		   when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited > 50 then to_number(concat(19,a.fy_credited))
		   else to_number(a.fy_credited)
	   end as credited_fy
from (
select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
	   gift_date,
	   case when (giftmonth  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	        giftyear + 1
       else
   		    giftyear
       end as fy_credited
from
(SELECT
 	   GS.gift_id,
 	   GS.src_donor_id,
       GS.gift_date ,
       MONTH(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftmonth,
       YEAR(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs) as gb ) as a)

cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts.<src donor id> as varchar) as src_donor_id,

 else TO_NUMBER(cast(ams_gifts.<credit fiscal year> as varchar))

		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(eab_reporting_inclusion.src_donor_id,'')
						  
left join <eab_gift_is_annual_flag> as is_gift_annual_flag 
		  on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.gift_id,'') 
		  and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(is_gift_annual_flag.src_donor_id,'')
						  
join cte_credit_year as c
     on coalesce(ams_gifts.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'')
     and coalesce(ams_gifts.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')
where (cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts.<gift amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) > 0
OR (

 cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) is not null

 cast(ams_gifts.<gift id> as varchar) like '%-%'

-- Chitti 09/09  V0.1 Added bound query for gifts_allocation in AMS domain
-- terukula V0.1 09/28/2022 joined <fy_credited_gifts_allocation> variable to calculate credit fiscal year for gifts_allocation in AMS domain
-- kamaldeep 9/28/2022 adding not null condition for gift id ,soft credit amount,soft credit id and sequence
-- jgogineni 09/29 AMS-136 adding current_fiscal_year
-- navya 12/09/2022 AMS-317 Updating references


with gifts_allocation as
(
select
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit id> as varchar) as soft_credit_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift allocation id> as varchar) as gift_allocation_id,
---cast(replace(replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit amount>, '$', ''),',','')  as float) as soft_credit_amount,
try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) as  soft_credit_amount,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<intake date> as timestamp) as intake_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<credit fiscal year> as varchar) as credit_fiscal_year
from <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment
where ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit id> is not null
and try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) >= 0


union

select
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<second soft credit id> as varchar) as soft_credit_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift allocation id> as varchar) as gift_allocation_id,
--cast(replace(replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<second soft credit amount>, '$', ''),',','')  as float) as soft_credit_amount,
try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<second soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) as  soft_credit_amount,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<intake date> as timestamp) as intake_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<credit fiscal year> as varchar) as credit_fiscal_year
from <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment
where ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<second soft credit id> is not null
and try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<second soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float)  >= 0

union

select
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<third soft credit id> as varchar) as soft_credit_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift allocation id> as varchar) as gift_allocation_id,
--cast(replace(replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<third soft credit amount>, '$', ''),',','')  as float) as soft_credit_amount,
try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<third soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) as  soft_credit_amount,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<intake date> as timestamp) as intake_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<credit fiscal year> as varchar) as credit_fiscal_year
from <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment
where ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<third soft credit id> is not null
and try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<third soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) >= 0

union

select
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fourth soft credit id> as varchar) as soft_credit_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift allocation id> as varchar) as gift_allocation_id,

try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fourth soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) as  soft_credit_amount,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<intake date> as timestamp) as intake_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<credit fiscal year> as varchar) as credit_fiscal_year
from <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment
where ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fourth soft credit id> is not null
and try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fourth soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) >= 0

union

select
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fifth soft credit id> as varchar) as soft_credit_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift allocation id> as varchar) as gift_allocation_id,
---cast(replace(replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fifth soft credit amount>, '$', ''),',','')  as float) as soft_credit_amount,
try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fifth soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) as  soft_credit_amount,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<intake date> as timestamp) as intake_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<credit fiscal year> as varchar) as credit_fiscal_year
from <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment
where ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fifth soft credit id> is not null
and try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fifth soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) >= 0

union

select
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<Calculated Field 1> as varchar) as soft_credit_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift allocation id> as varchar) as gift_allocation_id,
---cast(replace(replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit amount>, '$', ''),',','')  as float) as soft_credit_amount,
try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) as  soft_credit_amount,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<intake date> as timestamp) as intake_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<credit fiscal year> as varchar) as credit_fiscal_year
from <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment
where try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<Calculated Field 2>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) = 0
and ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit id> is null
and  try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.]', '') as float) >= 0
)
select
ga.gift_id as gift_id,
ga.soft_credit_id as soft_credit_id,
ga.gift_allocation_id as gift_allocation_id,
row_number() over (partition by ga.gift_id order by ga.soft_credit_id desc, intake_dt desc) as soft_credit_sequence,
ga.soft_credit_amount as soft_credit_amount,
ga.intake_dt as intake_dt,
ga.gift_dt as gift_dt,
case when TO_NUMBER(ga.credit_fiscal_year) is null then gb.credited_fy
	 else TO_NUMBER(ga.credit_fiscal_year)
end as credit_fiscal_year,
case when
(MONTH(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	   YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) +1
			   else
			    YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) end  as  current_fiscal_year
from gifts_allocation as ga
join <fy_credited_gifts_allocation> as gb
on coalesce(ga.gift_id,'') = coalesce(gb.gift_id,'')
and coalesce(ga.soft_credit_id,'') = coalesce(gb.soft_credit_id,'')
where ga.gift_id is not null
and ga.soft_credit_id is not null
and ga.soft_credit_amount is not null

with gifts_multiple_dates_single_funds as (
select gift_id
from 
<[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1
and gift_id not in (select gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g group by gift_id having count(distinct src_donor_id)>1)
and gift_id not in (select gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g group by gift_id having count(distinct fund_code)>1)
group by gift_id having count(distinct gift_date)>1
)

,gifts_multiple_dates_multiple_funds as (
select gift_id,gift_date,calculated_field_3 from ( 
select
gift_id,gift_date,calculated_field_3,row_number() over (partition by gift_id,gift_date order by calculated_field_3) as rn
from 
<[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1

and gift_id in (select gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g group by gift_id having count(distinct fund_code)>1)
)gifts_multiple_dates_multiple_funds where rn=1
)

,cte_credit_year as(
  select distinct gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))
		   when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited > 50 then to_number(concat(19,a.fy_credited))
		   else to_number(a.fy_credited)
	   end as credited_fy
from (
select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
	   gift_date,
	   case when (giftmonth  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	        giftyear + 1
       else
   		    giftyear
       end as fy_credited
from
(SELECT
 	   GS.gift_id,
 	   GS.src_donor_id,
       GS.gift_date ,
       MONTH(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftmonth,
       YEAR(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs) as gb ) as a)

Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. -- Chitti 09/09  V0.1 Added bound query for gifts_allocation in AMS domain
-- terukula V0.1 09/28/2022 joined <fy_credited_gifts_allocation> variable to calculate credit fiscal year for gifts_allocation in AMS domain
-- kamaldeep 9/28/2022 adding not null condition for gift id ,soft credit amount,soft credit id and sequence
-- jgogineni 09/29 AMS-136 adding current_fiscal_year
-- navya 12/09/2022 AMS-317 Updating references

with cte_credit_year as(
  select distinct gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
       case when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited < 50 then to_number(concat(20,a.fy_credited))
		   when len(a.fy_credited) < 4 and a.fy_credited > 50 then to_number(concat(19,a.fy_credited))
		   else to_number(a.fy_credited)
	   end as credited_fy
from (
select gift_id,
	   src_donor_id,
	   gift_date,
	   case when (giftmonth  between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	        giftyear + 1
       else
   		    giftyear
       end as fy_credited
from
(SELECT
 	   GS.gift_id,
 	   GS.src_donor_id,
       GS.gift_date ,
       MONTH(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftmonth,
       YEAR(cast(GS.gift_date as timestamp)) as giftyear
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as gs) as gb ) as a) 

,gifts_multiple_fund_codes as (
select gift_id,sum(ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(g.gift_amount,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float), 0)) as total_gift_amount
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1 
and gift_id not in (select gift_id from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g group by gift_id having count(distinct src_donor_id)>1) -- Exclude cases where gift id has duplicates due to fund code and src donor id (Only gift_id example found = 998682)
group by gift_id having count(distinct fund_code)>1
)

,gifts_multiple_donors as (
select gift_id,sum(ifnull(cast(regexp_replace(g.gift_amount,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float), 0)) as total_gift_amount
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1 
group by gift_id having count(distinct src_donor_id)>1
)				   
				   
,gifts_allocation as
(
select
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit id> as varchar) as soft_credit_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift allocation id> as varchar) as gift_allocation_id,
---cast(replace(replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit amount>, '$', ''),',','')  as float) as soft_credit_amount,
try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float) as  soft_credit_amount,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<intake date> as timestamp) as intake_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<credit fiscal year> as varchar) as credit_fiscal_year
from <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment
where ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit id> is not null
and try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float) >= 0


union

select
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<second soft credit id> as varchar) as soft_credit_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift allocation id> as varchar) as gift_allocation_id,
--cast(replace(replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<second soft credit amount>, '$', ''),',','')  as float) as soft_credit_amount,
try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<second soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float) as  soft_credit_amount,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<intake date> as timestamp) as intake_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<credit fiscal year> as varchar) as credit_fiscal_year
from <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment
where ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<second soft credit id> is not null
and try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<second soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float)  >= 0

union

select
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<third soft credit id> as varchar) as soft_credit_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift allocation id> as varchar) as gift_allocation_id,
--cast(replace(replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<third soft credit amount>, '$', ''),',','')  as float) as soft_credit_amount,
try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<third soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float) as  soft_credit_amount,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<intake date> as timestamp) as intake_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<credit fiscal year> as varchar) as credit_fiscal_year
from <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment
where ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<third soft credit id> is not null
and try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<third soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float) >= 0

union

select
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fourth soft credit id> as varchar) as soft_credit_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift allocation id> as varchar) as gift_allocation_id,
----cast(replace(replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fourth soft credit amount>, '$', ''),',','')  as float) as soft_credit_amount,
try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fourth soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float) as  soft_credit_amount,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<intake date> as timestamp) as intake_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<credit fiscal year> as varchar) as credit_fiscal_year
from <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment
where ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fourth soft credit id> is not null
and try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fourth soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float) >= 0

union

select
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fifth soft credit id> as varchar) as soft_credit_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift allocation id> as varchar) as gift_allocation_id,
---cast(replace(replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fifth soft credit amount>, '$', ''),',','')  as float) as soft_credit_amount,
try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fifth soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float) as  soft_credit_amount,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<intake date> as timestamp) as intake_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<credit fiscal year> as varchar) as credit_fiscal_year
from <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment
where ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fifth soft credit id> is not null
and try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fifth soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float) >= 0

union

select
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<Calculated Field 1> as varchar) as soft_credit_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift allocation id> as varchar) as gift_allocation_id,
---cast(replace(replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit amount>, '$', ''),',','')  as float) as soft_credit_amount,
try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float) as  soft_credit_amount,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<intake date> as timestamp) as intake_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<credit fiscal year> as varchar) as credit_fiscal_year
from <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment
where try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<Calculated Field 2>,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float) = 0
and ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit id> is null
and  try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float) >= 0
)
select
ga.gift_id as gift_id,
ga.soft_credit_id as soft_credit_id,
ga.gift_allocation_id as gift_allocation_id,
row_number() over (partition by ga.gift_id order by ga.soft_credit_id desc, intake_dt desc) as soft_credit_sequence,
case when gifts_multiple_fund_codes.gift_id is not null then gifts_multiple_fund_codes.total_gift_amount
	else ga.soft_credit_amount 
end as soft_credit_amount,
ga.intake_dt as intake_dt,
ga.gift_dt as gift_dt,
case when TO_NUMBER(ga.credit_fiscal_year) is null then gb.credited_fy
	 else TO_NUMBER(ga.credit_fiscal_year)
end as credit_fiscal_year,
case when
(MONTH(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	   YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) +1
			   else
			    YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) end  as  current_fiscal_year,
<source_partner_system_name_gifts_allocation> as source_partner_system_name,
<source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
from gifts_allocation as ga
left join gifts_multiple_fund_codes on gifts_multiple_fund_codes.gift_id = ga.gift_id						  
join <fy_credited_gifts_allocation> as gb
on coalesce(ga.gift_id,'') = coalesce(gb.gift_id,'')
and coalesce(ga.soft_credit_id,'') = coalesce(gb.soft_credit_id,'')
where ga.gift_id is not null
and ga.soft_credit_id is not null
and ga.soft_credit_amount is not null
						  
union all 

select
gift_id,
soft_credit_id,
gift_allocation_id,
soft_credit_sequence,
soft_credit_amount,
intake_dt,
gift_dt,
credit_fiscal_year,
current_fiscal_year,
<source_partner_system_name_gifts_allocation> as source_partner_system_name,
<source_eab_system_type> as source_eab_system_type
from (
select 
g.gift_id as gift_id,
g.src_donor_id as soft_credit_id,
null as gift_allocation_id,
row_number() over (partition by g.gift_id order by g.src_donor_id desc, intake_date desc) as soft_credit_sequence,
gifts_multiple_donors.total_gift_amount as soft_credit_amount,
g.intake_date as intake_dt,
g.gift_date as gift_dt,
case when ( len(g.<credit fiscal year>) > 4 or TO_NUMBER(cast(g.<credit fiscal year> as varchar)) is null)
 then c.credited_fy
 else TO_NUMBER(cast(g.<credit fiscal year> as varchar))
 end as credit_fiscal_year,
case when
(MONTH(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) between <fy_month_1> and <fy_month_2>) then
	   YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) +1
			   else
			    YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) end  as  current_fiscal_year
,row_number() over (partition by g.gift_id order by g.src_donor_id desc) as rn 						  
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
left join gifts_multiple_donors on g.gift_id = gifts_multiple_donors.gift_id
join cte_credit_year as c
     on coalesce(g.gift_id,'') = coalesce(c.gift_id,'')
     and coalesce(g.src_donor_id,'') = coalesce(c.src_donor_id,'')
where 1=1
and g.gift_id in (
select gift_id
from <[AMS].[gifts].{fulfillment}> as g
where 1=1 
group by gift_id having count(distinct src_donor_id)>1
)
)gifts
where 1=1 
and gifts.rn=1

-- Chitti 09/09  V0.1 Added bound query for gifts_allocation in AMS domain
-- terukula V0.1 09/28/2022 joined <fy_credited_gifts_allocation> variable to calculate credit fiscal year for gifts_allocation in AMS domain
-- kamaldeep 9/28/2022 adding not null condition for gift id ,soft credit amount,soft credit id and sequence
-- jgogineni 09/29 AMS-136 adding current_fiscal_year


with gifts_allocation as
(
select
cast(ams_gifts_source.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts_source.<soft credit id> as varchar) as soft_credit_id,
cast(ams_gifts_source.<gift allocation id> as varchar) as gift_allocation_id,
cast(replace(replace(ams_gifts_source.<soft credit amount>, '$', ''),',','')  as float) as soft_credit_amount,
cast(ams_gifts_source.<intake date> as timestamp) as intake_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_source.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_source.<credit fiscal year> as varchar) as credit_fiscal_year
from <[AMS].[gifts_source].{fulfillment}> as ams_gifts_source
where ams_gifts_source.<soft credit id> is not null
and cast(replace(replace(ams_gifts_source.<soft credit amount>, '$', ''),',','')  as float) > 0

union

select
cast(ams_gifts_source.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts_source.<second soft credit id> as varchar) as soft_credit_id,

	   YEAR(cast(getdate() as timestamp)) +1
			   else

from gifts_allocation as ga

on coalesce(ga.gift_id,'') = coalesce(gb.gift_id,'')
and coalesce(ga.soft_credit_id,'') = coalesce(gb.soft_credit_id,'')
where ga.gift_id is not null
and ga.soft_credit_id is not null
and ga.soft_credit_amount is not null

-- Chitti 09/09  V0.1 Added bound query for gifts_allocation in AMS domain
-- terukula V0.1 09/28/2022 joined <fy_credited_gifts_allocation> variable to calculate credit fiscal year for gifts_allocation in AMS domain

-- jgogineni 09/29 AMS-136 adding current_fiscal_year
-- navya 12/09/2022 AMS-317 Updating references


with gifts_allocation as
(
select
    CAST(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift id> AS varchar) AS gift_id,
    CAST(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit id> AS varchar) AS soft_credit_id,
    CAST(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift allocation id> AS varchar) AS gift_allocation_id,

    SUM(
        TRY_CAST(
            REGEXP_REPLACE(
                ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit amount>
                ,'[^0-9.-]',
                ''
            ) AS float
        )
    ) AS soft_credit_amount,

    max(CAST(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<intake date> AS timestamp)) AS intake_dt,
    max(CAST(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift date> AS timestamp)) AS gift_dt,
    max(CAST(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<credit fiscal year> AS varchar)) AS credit_fiscal_year

FROM <[AMS].[gifts_allocation].{fulfillment}> AS ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment
WHERE ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit id> IS NOT NULL
--and ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.gift_id = '000672320001i000000bwDX1'
GROUP BY
    CAST(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift id> AS varchar),
    CAST(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<soft credit id> AS varchar),
    CAST(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift allocation id> AS varchar)
			 --,
    --CAST(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<intake date> AS timestamp),
    --CAST(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift date> AS timestamp),
    --CAST(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<credit fiscal year> AS varchar)

union

select
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift id> as varchar) as gift_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<second soft credit id> as varchar) as soft_credit_id,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift allocation id> as varchar) as gift_allocation_id,
--cast(replace(replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<second soft credit amount>, '$', ''),',','')  as float) as soft_credit_amount,
try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<second soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float) as  soft_credit_amount,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<intake date> as timestamp) as intake_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<gift date> as timestamp) as gift_dt,
cast(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<credit fiscal year> as varchar) as credit_fiscal_year

try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fourth soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float) as  soft_credit_amount,

select

try_cast(regexp_replace(ams_gifts_allocation_fulfillment.<fifth soft credit amount>,'[^0-9.-]', '') as float) as  soft_credit_amount,
