setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. queryResults.querySql:
/*final prelim cte - calculates agg metrics*/
/*still needs ac rank, fix test scores*/
with cte09_final_totals as (
select
agg_prelim.eab_entry_year_academic
, agg_prelim.eab_entry_term
, agg_prelim.eab_student_type

/*based on current defer logic, this needs to be updated if we roll defers into withdraw/melt/completed app*/
, count(distinct(agg_prelim.partnercontact_id)) as backfilled_gross_admits
, count(distinct(case when agg_prelim.net_dep_ind = true then agg_prelim.partnercontact_id else null end)) as backfilled_net_deps

, ((backfilled_net_deps/backfilled_gross_admits) * 100) as yield

, sum(case when agg_prelim.net_dep_ind = true then agg_prelim.institutional_gift_total else null end) as inst_gift_net_deps_total
, cast(avg(case when agg_prelim.net_dep_ind = true then agg_prelim.institutional_gift_total else null end) as DECIMAL(18,2)) as inst_gift_net_deps_avg --students without finaid data won't be considered here?
, sum(case when agg_prelim.net_dep_ind = true then agg_prelim.institutional_gift_w_waiver_total else null end) as inst_gift_waiver_net_deps_total
, cast(avg(case when agg_prelim.net_dep_ind = true then agg_prelim.institutional_gift_w_waiver_total else null end) as DECIMAL(18,2)) as inst_gift_waiver_net_deps_avg --students without finaid data won't be considered here?

, sum(case when agg_prelim.net_dep_ind = true then agg_prelim.ntr else null end) as ntr_net_deps_total
, cast(avg(case when agg_prelim.net_dep_ind = true then agg_prelim.ntr else null end) as DECIMAL(18,2)) as ntr_net_deps_avg --students without finaid data won't be considered here?

, sum(case when agg_prelim.net_dep_ind = true then agg_prelim.variable_gap else null end) as variable_gap_net_deps_total
, cast(avg(case when agg_prelim.net_dep_ind = true then agg_prelim.variable_gap else null end) as DECIMAL(18,2)) as variable_gap_net_deps_avg --students without finaid data won't be considered here?

, cast(
	((sum(case when agg_prelim.net_dep_ind = true then agg_prelim.institutional_gift_total else null end)
    /
	nullif(sum(case when agg_prelim.net_dep_ind = true then agg_prelim.tuition else null end),0))
	* 100)
	as decimal(18,2)) as discount_rate_net_deps

, cast(
	((sum(case when agg_prelim.net_dep_ind = true then agg_prelim.institutional_gift_w_waiver_total else null end)
    /
	nullif(sum(case when agg_prelim.net_dep_ind = true then agg_prelim.tuition else null end),0))
	* 100)
	as decimal(18,2)) as discount_rate_w_waiver_net_deps

, cast(avg(agg_prelim.eab_hs_gpa) as DECIMAL(18,2)) as gpa_gross_admits_avg

, cast(avg(agg_prelim.eab_exam_score) as DECIMAL(18,2)) as testscore_gross_admits_avg

, sum(case when agg_prelim.net_dep_ind = true then agg_prelim.tuition else null end) as agg_tuition_net_dep

, avg(case when agg_prelim.eab_aid_app_ind = true then agg_prelim.eab_financial_sai else null end) as sai_gross_admits_avg --students without finaid data won't be considered here?

, median(case when agg_prelim.eab_aid_app_ind = true then agg_prelim.eab_financial_sai else null end) as sai_gross_admits_median

, avg(agg_prelim.adjusted_sai) as adj_sai_gross_admits_avg --students without finaid data won't be considered here?

, median(agg_prelim.adjusted_sai) as adj_sai_gross_admits_median
				 
from <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{prelim_stud_data}> agg_prelim
											 
where 1=1

group by agg_prelim.eab_entry_year_academic
, agg_prelim.eab_student_type
, agg_prelim.eab_entry_term
order by agg_prelim.eab_entry_year_academic desc
, agg_prelim.eab_student_type
, agg_prelim.eab_entry_term
)

, cte10_metric_map as 
(
    select '# of Admits' as metric, 1 as sort_order union all
    select 'Yield', 2 union all
    select '# of Net Deposits', 3 union all
    select 'Average Institutional Gift', 4 union all
    select 'Total Institutional Gift', 5 union all
    select 'Average Unmet Need', 6 union all
    select 'Average Net Tuition Revenue', 7 union all
    select 'Total Net Tuition Revenue', 8 union all
    select 'Discount Rate', 9 union all
    select '# in Selection', 10 union all
    select 'Average GPA', 11 union all
    select 'Average Test', 12 union all
    select 'Median Adjusted SAI**', 13 union all
    select 'Average Adjusted SAI**', 14 union all
    select 'Median SAI (Aid applicants)', 15 union all
    select 'Average SAI (Aid applicants)', 16
)

select metric, result, metric_year from (

select
    m.metric,
	m.sort_order,
    cast(sum(
        case
			when m.metric = '# of Admits' then agg.backfilled_gross_admits
			when m.metric = 'Yield' then agg.yield
			when m.metric = '# of Net Deposits' then agg.backfilled_net_deps
			when m.metric = 'Average Institutional Gift' then agg.inst_gift_net_deps_avg 
	  			/*to incl waivers: agg.inst_gift_waiver_net_deps_avg*/
			when m.metric = 'Total Institutional Gift' then agg.inst_gift_net_deps_total 
	  			/*to incl waivers: agg.inst_gift_waiver_net_deps_total*/
			when m.metric = 'Average Unmet Need' then agg.variable_gap_net_deps_avg
			when m.metric = 'Average Net Tuition Revenue' then agg.ntr_net_deps_avg
			when m.metric = 'Total Net Tuition Revenue' then agg.ntr_net_deps_total
			when m.metric = 'Discount Rate' then agg.discount_rate_net_deps /*incl waivers: agg.discount_rate_w_waiver_net_deps*/
			when m.metric = 'Average GPA' then agg.gpa_gross_admits_avg
			when m.metric = 'Average Test' then agg.testscore_gross_admits_avg
			when m.metric = 'Median Adjusted SAI**' then agg.adj_sai_gross_admits_median
			when m.metric = 'Average Adjusted SAI**' then agg.adj_sai_gross_admits_avg
			when m.metric = 'Median SAI (Aid applicants)' then agg.sai_gross_admits_median
			when m.metric = 'Average SAI (Aid applicants)' then agg.sai_gross_admits_avg
            else 0
        end
    ) as decimal(18,2)) as result,
	agg.eab_entry_year_academic as metric_year

from cte09_final_totals agg
cross join cte10_metric_map m
group by 
m.metric, m.sort_order, agg.eab_entry_year_academic
) final_union
order by 
sort_order

--select slice, metric, result, metric_year, category, eab_full_part_time 
--from (

select 
	m.sort_order,
	agg.category,
	agg.slice,
	agg.eab_full_part_time,
  	m.metric,

    cast(sum(
        case
			when m.metric = '# of Admits' then agg.backfilled_gross_admits
			when m.metric = 'Yield' then agg.yield
			when m.metric = '# of Net Deposits' then agg.backfilled_net_deps
			when m.metric = 'Average Institutional Gift' then agg.inst_gift_net_deps_avg 
	  			/*to incl waivers: agg.inst_gift_waiver_net_deps_avg*/
			when m.metric = 'Total Institutional Gift' then agg.inst_gift_net_deps_total 
	  			/*to incl waivers: agg.inst_gift_waiver_net_deps_total*/
			when m.metric = 'Average Unmet Need' then agg.variable_gap_net_deps_avg
			when m.metric = 'Average Net Tuition Revenue' then agg.ntr_net_deps_avg
			when m.metric = 'Total Net Tuition Revenue' then agg.ntr_net_deps_total
			when m.metric = 'Discount Rate' then agg.discount_rate_net_deps /*incl waivers: agg.discount_rate_w_waiver_net_deps*/
			when m.metric = 'Average GPA' then agg.gpa_gross_admits_avg
			when m.metric = 'Average Test' then agg.testscore_gross_admits_avg
			when m.metric = 'Median Adjusted SAI**' then agg.adj_sai_gross_admits_median
			when m.metric = 'Average Adjusted SAI**' then agg.adj_sai_gross_admits_avg
			when m.metric = 'Median SAI (Aid applicants)' then agg.sai_gross_admits_median
			when m.metric = 'Average SAI (Aid applicants)' then agg.sai_gross_admits_avg
            else 0
        end
    ) as decimal(18,2)) as result,
	agg.eab_entry_year_academic as metric_year

from <cte10_final_totals_sliced> agg
cross join <cte10_metric_map> m
group by 
agg.category, agg.slice, m.metric, m.sort_order, agg.eab_entry_year_academic, agg.eab_full_part_time

--) final_union
order by 
case when eab_full_part_time = 'Full-Time' then 1
	when eab_full_part_time = 'Part-Time' then 2
	when eab_full_part_time = 'Unknown' then 3
	else 9 end
, case when category = 'All' then 1
	when category = 'Gender' then 2
	when category = 'Ethnicity' then 3
	when category = 'Race' then 4
	when category = 'ModelPop' then 5
	else 6 end
, case when slice = 'Male' then 1
	when slice = 'Female' then 2
	when slice ilike '%Non-Binary%' then 3
	when slice = 'Hispanic or Latino/a/e/x' then 1
	when slice = 'Not Hispanic or Latino/a/e/x' then 2
	when slice = 'POC' then 1
	when slice = 'Model' then 1
	else 9 end
, sort_order

/*2026-11-06: model pop breakout counts added*/
/*2026-10-27: temporary union for band aid weighting while downstream math is changed*/
/*2026-06-03: updated with more information for investigative purposes - ccreekman*/

select * from (
select 'decimal weighting' as weight_type,
acrk_sort_order, 
coalesce(acrk_band,'NO Ac Rank') as acrk_band,
case when ACRK_BAND is null then acrk else null end as unbucketed_acrks, 
count(distinct(case when coalesce(eab_hs_gpa,0) = 0 then partnercontact_id else null end)) as no_gpa,
count(distinct(case when coalesce(eab_exam_score,0) = 0 then partnercontact_id else null end)) as no_exam,
count(distinct(case when coalesce(eab_class_rank,0) = 0 then partnercontact_id else null end)) as no_rank,
count(distinct(case when coalesce(eab_alternative_academic_rank,0) = 0 then partnercontact_id else null end)) as no_alt_ac_rank,

count(*) as all_stud_rec_ct,
count(distinct(case when agg.model_population = true then partnercontact_id else null end)) as model_pop_ct

from <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{prelim_stud_data}> agg

group by acrk_band, acrk_sort_order, case when ACRK_BAND is null then acrk else null end

/*remove later*/
union all

select 
'integer weighting_temp' as weight_type,
null as sort_order,
coalesce(acrk_band_temp_pilots2026,'NO Ac Rank') as acrk_band, /*1,2,3 weighting*/
case when acrk_band_temp_pilots2026 is null then acrk_band_temp_pilots2026 else null end as unbucketed_acrks, 
count(distinct(case when coalesce(eab_hs_gpa,0) = 0 then partnercontact_id else null end)) as no_gpa,
count(distinct(case when coalesce(eab_exam_score,0) = 0 then partnercontact_id else null end)) as no_exam,
count(distinct(case when coalesce(eab_class_rank,0) = 0 then partnercontact_id else null end)) as no_rank,
count(distinct(case when coalesce(eab_alternative_academic_rank,0) = 0 then partnercontact_id else null end)) as no_alt_ac_rank,

count(*) as all_stud_rec_ct,
count(distinct(case when agg.model_population = true then partnercontact_id else null end)) as model_pop_ct

from <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{prelim_stud_data}> agg

group by acrk_band_temp_pilots2026,
coalesce(acrk_band_temp_pilots2026,'NO Ac Rank') /*1,2,3 weighting*/

)

order by weight_type, acrk_sort_order, case when ACRK_BAND is null then 9999 else 1 end, coalesce(acrk_band,'NO Ac Rank')

select 
	pdc.configuration_type

	, pdc.eab_student_type

	from pdp_ug.par__display_controls pdc
		
	join <cte00_pop_definition> pop_year
	on (pop_year.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic'
	and coalesce(pdc.eab_entry_year_academic,'') = coalesce(pop_year.value,''))

	join <cte00_pop_definition> pop_stype
	on (pop_stype.field_name = 'eab_student_type'
	and coalesce(pdc.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(pop_stype.value,''))
	
	where configuration_type = 'academic_index_points_band'

	order by pdc.configuration_type, pdc.eab_student_type, pdc.stored_value_exact_or_range_min

/**************************************************************************************************
Date Formatting Check (SIS dates):
-outputs fields with date values in fulfillment that will not parse correctly
NOTE: query set up for standard fulfillment tables. For partners with non-standard fulfillments
you will need to update the table names (eg: fulfillment_ug_applicants, fulfillment_entering_class)
**************************************************************************************************/
/*select enrollment_date, try_to_timestamp(enrollment_date) as final_date, count(*)
from <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application].{fulfillment}> stud
where ((try_to_timestamp(enrollment_date) is null 
		or year(try_to_timestamp(enrollment_date))<1980) 
		and coalesce(enrollment_date,'') <>'')
group by 1,2
order by 3 desc*/


SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        'Student SIS' AS entity,
        CASE
            WHEN (
                (
                    TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(SUBSTRING(BIRTH_DATE, 1, 19)) IS NULL
                    OR YEAR(TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(SUBSTRING(BIRTH_DATE, 1, 19))) < 1900
                )
                AND COALESCE(BIRTH_DATE, '') <> ''
            )
            THEN 'BIRTH_DATE'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS check_date_field,
        COUNT(*) AS rec_ct
    FROM <[Enroll360].[Student SIS].{fulfillment}> stud
    WHERE 1 = 1
    GROUP BY entity, check_date_field

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Student SIS' AS entity,
        CASE
            WHEN (
                (
                    TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(SUBSTRING(FIRST_CAMPUS_VISIT_DATE, 1, 19)) IS NULL
                    OR YEAR(TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(SUBSTRING(FIRST_CAMPUS_VISIT_DATE, 1, 19))) < 1980
                )
                AND COALESCE(FIRST_CAMPUS_VISIT_DATE, '') <> ''
            )
            THEN 'FIRST_CAMPUS_VISIT_DATE'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS check_date_field,
        COUNT(*) AS rec_ct
    FROM <[Enroll360].[Student SIS].{fulfillment}> stud
    WHERE 1 = 1
    GROUP BY entity, check_date_field

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Student SIS' AS entity,
        CASE
            WHEN (
                (
                    TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(SUBSTRING(MOST_RECENT_CAMPUS_VISIT_DATE, 1, 19)) IS NULL
                    OR YEAR(TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(SUBSTRING(MOST_RECENT_CAMPUS_VISIT_DATE, 1, 19))) < 1980
                )
                AND COALESCE(MOST_RECENT_CAMPUS_VISIT_DATE, '') <> ''
            )
            THEN 'MOST_RECENT_CAMPUS_VISIT_DATE'
            ELSE NULL

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
/**Source of Truth = this Query: Enroll360.Project Atlas Migration Checks.demographics*/
with cte01_attributes as (
select distinct stud_data.partnercontact_id
, stud_data.eab_entry_year_academic
, stud_data.eab_entry_term
, stud_data.eab_student_type
, stud_data.eab_full_part_time
, coalesce(stud_data.eab_aid_app_ind,false) as aid_app
, coalesce(stud_data.eab_fafsa_submitted_ind,false) as fafsa_filer
, coalesce(stud_data.eab_css_profile_submitted_ind,false) as im_filer
, coalesce(stud_data.eab_pell_eligible_ind,false) as pell_el
, coalesce(stud_data.eab_campus_visit_ind,false) as visited
/*, case when coalesce(stud_data.eab_aid_app_ind,false) = true then 'aid app' else 'non aid app' end as aid_app
, case when coalesce(stud_data.eab_fafsa_submitted_ind,false) = true then 'FAFSA Filer' else 'Not FAFSA Filer' end as fafsa_filer
, case when coalesce(stud_data.eab_css_profile_submitted_ind,false) = true then 'IM Filer' else 'Not IM Filer'  end as im_filer
, case when coalesce(stud_data.eab_pell_eligible_ind,false) = true then 'Pell Eligible' else 'Not Pell Eligible' end as pell_el
, case when coalesce(stud_data.eab_campus_visit_ind,false) = true then 'Visited' else 'No Visit' end as visited
*/
from <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{prelim_stud_data}> stud_data
)

, cte02_unpivot_atts as (
select partnercontact_id, eab_entry_year_academic, eab_full_part_time, 'Aidapp' as group_name
, count(distinct(case when aid_app = true then partnercontact_id else null end)) as rec_ct
, count(distinct(case when aid_app = true AND eab_full_part_time ilike '%full%' then partnercontact_id else null end)) as fulltime_ct
, 1 as sort_order
FROM cte01_attributes atts
group by partnercontact_id, eab_entry_year_academic, eab_full_part_time

union all

select partnercontact_id, eab_entry_year_academic, eab_full_part_time, 'Non Aidapp' as group_name

group by partnercontact_id, eab_entry_year_academic, eab_full_part_time

union all

, 5 as sort_order
FROM cte01_attributes atts
group by partnercontact_id, eab_entry_year_academic, eab_full_part_time

union all

select partnercontact_id, eab_entry_year_academic, eab_full_part_time, 'Visited' as group_name
, count(distinct(case when visited = true then partnercontact_id else null end)) as rec_ct
, count(distinct(case when visited = true AND eab_full_part_time ilike '%full%' then partnercontact_id else null end)) as fulltime_ct
, 6 as sort_order
FROM cte01_attributes atts
group by partnercontact_id, eab_entry_year_academic, eab_full_part_time

union all

select partnercontact_id, eab_entry_year_academic, eab_full_part_time, 'No Visit' as group_name

queryResults.sqlPreview: SELECT CONFIGURATION_TYPE as metric, CASE WHEN CONFIGURATION_TYPE like '%revenue_goal' THEN ROUND(CONFIGURATION_VALUE / 1000000.0, 1) /*does this need to be dec…
queryResults.querySql:
SELECT 
    CONFIGURATION_TYPE as metric,
CASE 
WHEN CONFIGURATION_TYPE like '%revenue_goal' 
THEN ROUND(CONFIGURATION_VALUE / 1000000.0, 1) /*does this need to be decimal?*/
ELSE try_to_number(CONFIGURATION_VALUE,18,0)
END AS goal_amt

from <tuple.PartnerConfigurations> as goals

join <cte00_pop_definition> pop_year
on (pop_year.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic'
and coalesce(goals.eab_entry_year_academic,'') = coalesce(pop_year.value,''))

join <cte00_pop_definition> pop_stype
on (pop_stype.field_name = 'eab_student_type'
and coalesce(goals.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(pop_stype.value,''))

where 1=1
and configuration_type like any ('%admit_goal' , '%deposit_goal', '%revenue_goal')

order by
configuration_type ASC

queryResults.querySql:
/**Source of Truth = this Query: Enroll360.Project Atlas Migration Checks.prelim_stud_data.v2*/
/*almost to the end here - at this point all data is admit and up only
prelim cte here is doing final calculations at the student level so next query can do aggregate calcs per type/term/year*/
/*************************/
/*2026-07-22: residency added - must set state(s) in <cte00_pop_definition> variable in Enroll360.MigrationChecks bundle
adjusted joins to configs final tables - should join on stud_term eab_student_type*/
/*2026-07-20: added tuition band fields for investigative support - ccreekman*/
/*2026-07-16: added cost_of_attendance for investigative support - ccreekman*/
/*2026-07-14: V2 = updated ACRK logic with imputing calculations- ccreekman*/ 

(
select 
  agg.*,
  acrk_band.display_bucket_label as acrk_band,
  acrk_band_temp_pilots2026.display_bucket_label as acrk_band_temp_pilots2026,
  acrk_band.sort_order as acrk_sort_order
  from ( 
select distinct
/***stud term data***/
stat.*,
case when stat.eab_current_funnel_status_adj in ('Uncommitted Admit') then true else false end as pending_ind,
case when stat.eab_current_funnel_status_adj in ('Net Deposit','Enrolled') then true else false end as net_dep_ind,
case when stat.eab_current_funnel_status_adj in ('Melt') then true else false end as melt_ind,

/***model/cohorts***/
case when stud_co.total_excl_grp_ct > 0 then false else true end as model_population,
stud_co.first_excl_group as waterfall_excl_grp,

/***residency***/
res.defined_residency_states as allowed_res_states, 
res.agg_stud_states,
case when res.partnercontact_id is not null then true else false end as residency_calc,

/***funds and finaid***/
cast(coalesce(funds_agg.institutional_gift_total,0) as decimal(18,2)) as institutional_gift_total,
cast(coalesce(funds_agg.institutional_gift_w_waiver_total,0) as decimal(18,2)) as institutional_gift_w_waiver_total,
case when finaid_agg.eab_aid_app_ind = true then cast(finaid_agg.gap_final as decimal(18,2)) else null end as variable_gap,
(coalesce(finaid_agg.tuition,0) - coalesce(funds_agg.institutional_gift_total,0)) as ntr,
ntr + institutional_gift_total as ntr_plus_inst_gift,
finaid_agg.eab_expense_group_key,
coalesce(finaid_agg.tuition,0) as tuition,
finaid_agg.expense_group_label,
finaid_agg.tuition_band_rollup,

case when coalesce(finaid_agg.partnercontact_id,'') = ''
	then 'no match: ST to SYFA' /*integrity: ST <> SYFA (unlikely)*/
	else finaid_agg.exp_grp_warning
end as exp_grp_warnings,

finaid_agg.cost_of_attendance,
finaid_agg.eab_aid_app_ind,
finaid_agg.eab_financial_sai,
finaid_agg.eab_financial_need,
finaid_agg.adjusted_sai,
finaid_agg.ability_to_pay_source,
finaid_agg.ability_to_pay_display_key,
finaid_agg.ability_to_pay_stud_value,
try_to_number(pdc_score.display_bucket_label) as ability_to_pay_score,
case when coalesce(finaid_agg.eab_aid_app_ind,false) = false then 'Non-Aid Applicants'
	when finaid_agg.ability_to_pay_stud_value is null then 'Non-Aid Applicants'
	else pdc_band.display_bucket_label end as ability_to_pay_band,
case when coalesce(finaid_agg.eab_aid_app_ind,false) = false then 999
	when finaid_agg.ability_to_pay_stud_value is null then 999
	else try_to_number(pdc_band.sort_order) end as ability_to_pay_sort_order,
case
	when coalesce(finaid_agg.eab_aid_app_ind,false) = false then null
	when finaid_agg.ability_to_pay_stud_value is null then 'student has null ability to pay amount'
	when pdc_score.configuration_type is null then 'no match: ability to pay student value to score range'
	when try_to_number(pdc_score.display_bucket_label) is null then 'ability to pay score is not numeric'
	when pdc_band.configuration_type is null then 'no match: ability to pay score to display band'
	else null
end as ability_to_pay_warning,
finaid_agg.eab_pell_eligible_ind,
finaid_agg.eab_css_profile_submitted_ind,
finaid_agg.eab_fafsa_submitted_ind,

/*******AC Rank calcs*****/
cast(gpas.eab_hs_gpa as decimal(18,2)) as eab_hs_gpa,
case when acrk_gpa_wt.configuration_value > 0 and gpas.eab_hs_gpa is not null then cast(gpas.points as decimal(18,2)) 
	else null end as base_gpa_points,

cast(c_rank.eab_class_rank as decimal(18,2)) as eab_class_rank,
case when acrk_classrank_wt.configuration_value > 0 and c_rank.eab_class_rank is not null then cast(c_rank.points as decimal(18,2)) 
	else null end as base_rank_points,

cast(scores.normalized_exam_score as decimal(18,2)) as eab_exam_score,
case when acrk_exam_wt.configuration_value > 0 and scores.normalized_exam_score is not null then cast(scores.points as decimal(18,2)) 
	else null end as base_exam_points,

acrk_alt_acrk_wt.configuration_value as alt_ac_rank_weighting,
acrk_gpa_wt.configuration_value as gpa_weighting,
acrk_exam_wt.configuration_value as exam_weighting,
acrk_classrank_wt.configuration_value as classrank_weighting,
coalesce(BASE_GPA_POINTS, BASE_RANK_POINTS, BASE_EXAM_POINTS) as impute_base_gpa_pts,
coalesce(BASE_EXAM_POINTS, BASE_GPA_POINTS, BASE_RANK_POINTS) as impute_base_exam_pts,
coalesce(BASE_RANK_POINTS, BASE_GPA_POINTS, BASE_EXAM_POINTS) as impute_base_rank_pts,
coalesce(BASE_GPA_POINTS, BASE_RANK_POINTS, BASE_EXAM_POINTS) * round(try_to_number(acrk_gpa_wt.configuration_value,10,2)*3,1) as adj_gpa_points,
coalesce(BASE_EXAM_POINTS, BASE_GPA_POINTS, BASE_RANK_POINTS) * round(try_to_number(acrk_exam_wt.configuration_value,10,2)*3,1) as adj_exam_points,
coalesce(BASE_RANK_POINTS, BASE_GPA_POINTS, BASE_EXAM_POINTS) * round(try_to_number(acrk_classrank_wt.configuration_value,10,2)*3,1) as adj_class_rank_points,

coalesce(BASE_GPA_POINTS, BASE_RANK_POINTS, BASE_EXAM_POINTS) * round(try_to_number(acrk_gpa_wt.configuration_value,10,2),1) as adj_gpa_points_temp_pilots2026,
coalesce(BASE_EXAM_POINTS, BASE_GPA_POINTS, BASE_RANK_POINTS) * round(try_to_number(acrk_exam_wt.configuration_value,10,2),1) as adj_exam_points_temp_pilots2026,
coalesce(BASE_RANK_POINTS, BASE_GPA_POINTS, BASE_EXAM_POINTS) * round(try_to_number(acrk_classrank_wt.configuration_value,10,2),1) as adj_class_rank_points_temp_pilots2026,


(coalesce(adj_exam_points,0)+ coalesce(adj_class_rank_points,0) + coalesce(adj_gpa_points,0) + coalesce(stat.adj_alt_ac_rank_points,0)
) as acrk

,(coalesce(adj_exam_points_temp_pilots2026,0)+ coalesce(adj_class_rank_points_temp_pilots2026,0) + coalesce(adj_gpa_points_temp_pilots2026,0) + coalesce(stat.adj_alt_ac_rank_points,0)
) as acrk_calc_temp_pilots2026

from <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{st_sta_data}> stat

left join <cte05_state_residency> res
on (stat.partnercontact_id = res.partnercontact_id
and coalesce(stat.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(res.partner_system_name,''))

left join <cte05_acrk_configs> acrk_gpa_wt
on (acrk_gpa_wt.config_configuration_type  = 'hs_gpa_weight'
and coalesce(stat.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(acrk_gpa_wt.eab_student_type,'')
and coalesce(try_to_number(stat.eab_entry_year_academic),0) = coalesce(try_to_number(acrk_gpa_wt.eab_entry_year_academic),0))

left join <cte05_acrk_configs> acrk_exam_wt 
on (acrk_exam_wt.config_configuration_type  = 'exam_score_weight'
and coalesce(stat.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(acrk_exam_wt.eab_student_type,'')
and coalesce(try_to_number(stat.eab_entry_year_academic),0) = coalesce(try_to_number(acrk_exam_wt.eab_entry_year_academic),0))

left join <cte05_acrk_configs> acrk_alt_acrk_wt
on (acrk_alt_acrk_wt.config_configuration_type  = 'alternative_academic_weight'
and coalesce(stat.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(acrk_alt_acrk_wt.eab_student_type,'')
and coalesce(try_to_number(stat.eab_entry_year_academic),0) = coalesce(try_to_number(acrk_alt_acrk_wt.eab_entry_year_academic),0))

left join <cte05_acrk_configs> acrk_classrank_wt
on (acrk_classrank_wt.config_configuration_type = 'class_rank_weight'
and coalesce(stat.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(acrk_classrank_wt.eab_student_type,'')
and coalesce(try_to_number(stat.eab_entry_year_academic),0) = coalesce(try_to_number(acrk_classrank_wt.eab_entry_year_academic),0))

left join <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{funds_totals}> funds_agg
on (stat.partnercontact_id = funds_agg.partnercontact_id
and coalesce(stat.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(funds_agg.partner_system_name,'')
and coalesce(stat.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(funds_agg.eab_entry_year_academic,0))

left join <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{finaid_variable_gap}> finaid_agg
on (stat.partnercontact_id = finaid_agg.partnercontact_id
and coalesce(stat.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(finaid_agg.partner_system_name,'')
and coalesce(stat.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(finaid_agg.migrationcheck_allowed_stypes,'')
and coalesce(stat.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(finaid_agg.eab_entry_year_academic,0))

left join <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{stud_agg_cohort}> stud_co
on (stat.partnercontact_id = stud_co.partnercontact_id
and coalesce(stat.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(stud_co.partner_system_name,'')
and coalesce(stat.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(stud_co.eab_student_type,'')
and coalesce(stat.eab_entry_term,'') = coalesce(stud_co.eab_entry_term,'')
and coalesce(stat.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(stud_co.eab_entry_year_academic,0))


left join (select * from <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{prioritized_gpa}> gpas where rn2 = 1) gpas
on (stat.partnercontact_id = gpas.partnercontact_id
and coalesce(stat.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(gpas.partner_system_name,'')
and coalesce(stat.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(gpas.config_entry_year_academic,0)
and coalesce(stat.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(gpas.config_student_type,''))

left join (select * from <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{prioritized_rank}> c_rank where rn2 = 1) c_rank
	on (stat.partnercontact_id = c_rank.partnercontact_id
	and coalesce(stat.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(c_rank.partner_system_name,'')
and coalesce(stat.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(c_rank.config_entry_year_academic,0)
and coalesce(stat.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(c_rank.config_student_type,''))

left join (select * from <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{prioritized_test}> scores where rn2 = 1) scores
	on (stat.partnercontact_id = scores.partnercontact_id
	and coalesce(stat.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(scores.partner_system_name,'')
and coalesce(stat.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(scores.config_entry_year_academic,0)
and coalesce(stat.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(scores.config_student_type,''))

left join <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{key_configs}> pdc_score
on (coalesce(finaid_agg.ability_to_pay_score_key,'') = coalesce(pdc_score.configuration_type,'')
	and coalesce(stat.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(pdc_score.eab_student_type,'')
	and coalesce(try_to_number(stat.eab_entry_year_academic),0) = coalesce(try_to_number(pdc_score.eab_entry_year_academic),0)
	and coalesce(finaid_agg.ability_to_pay_stud_value,0) between coalesce(pdc_score.stored_value_exact_or_range_min,0) and coalesce(pdc_score.stored_value_range_max,99999999)) 

left join <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{key_configs}> pdc_band
on (coalesce(finaid_agg.ability_to_pay_display_key,'') = coalesce(pdc_band.configuration_type,'')
	and coalesce(stat.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(pdc_band.eab_student_type,'')
	and coalesce(try_to_number(stat.eab_entry_year_academic),0) = coalesce(try_to_number(pdc_band.eab_entry_year_academic),0)
	and try_to_number(pdc_score.display_bucket_label) between try_to_number(pdc_band.stored_value_exact_or_range_min) and try_to_number(pdc_band.stored_value_range_max))

) agg

left join <cte05_acrk_index_bands> acrk_band
	on (coalesce(agg.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(acrk_band.eab_student_type,'')
	and coalesce(try_to_number(agg.eab_entry_year_academic),0) = coalesce(try_to_number(acrk_band.eab_entry_year_academic),0)
	and coalesce(agg.acrk,0.00) between coalesce(acrk_band.stored_value_exact_or_range_min,0) and coalesce(acrk_band.stored_value_range_max,99999999))

left join <cte05_acrk_index_bands> acrk_band_temp_pilots2026
	on (coalesce(agg.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(acrk_band_temp_pilots2026.eab_student_type,'')
	and coalesce(try_to_number(agg.eab_entry_year_academic),0) = coalesce(try_to_number(acrk_band_temp_pilots2026.eab_entry_year_academic),0)
	and coalesce(agg.acrk_calc_temp_pilots2026,0.00) between coalesce(acrk_band_temp_pilots2026.stored_value_exact_or_range_min,0) and coalesce(acrk_band_temp_pilots2026.stored_value_range_max,99999999))


where 1=1
)

queryResults.sqlPreview: /**Source of Truth = this Query: Enroll360.Project Atlas Migration Checks.stud_agg_cohort*/ /*1 row per student/type/term/year*/ select agg.partnercontact_id , …
queryResults.querySql:
/**Source of Truth = this Query: Enroll360.Project Atlas Migration Checks.stud_agg_cohort*/
/*1 row per student/type/term/year*/

select 
agg.partnercontact_id
, agg.partner_system_name
, agg.eab_entry_year_academic
, agg.eab_entry_term
, agg.eab_student_type
, agg.stud_cohorts_tab
, agg.stud_cohorts_dropdown
, agg.stud_excgroups_tab
, agg.total_excl_grp_ct
, agg.first_excl_group_eab_std_value
, agg.first_excl_group
, agg.first_excl_group_pdc_sort
, agg.first_excl_group_warning

from (
SELECT 
stud_co.partnercontact_id
, stud_co.partner_system_name
, stud_co.eab_entry_year_academic
, stud_co.eab_entry_term
, stud_co.eab_student_type
, listagg(case when eab_attribute_type = 'custom_cohort' and stud_co.display_bucket_label is not null and configuration_type = 'cohort_display'
		  then stud_co.display_bucket_label else null end,'| ') as stud_cohorts_tab
, listagg(case when eab_attribute_type = 'custom_cohort' and stud_co.display_bucket_label is not null and configuration_type = 'cohort_category_display'
		  then stud_co.display_bucket_label else null end,'| ') as stud_cohorts_dropdown
, listagg(case when eab_attribute_type = 'excluded_group' and stud_co.display_bucket_label is not null and configuration_type = 'excluded_group_display'
		  then stud_co.display_bucket_label else null end,'| ') as stud_excgroups_tab
--, eg_agg.excl_grp_ct as total_excl_grp_ct
, sum(case when eab_attribute_type = 'excluded_group' and stud_co.display_bucket_label is not null and configuration_type = 'excluded_group_display' 
	  then 1 else 0 end) as total_excl_grp_ct /*only counts if on PDC*/
, eg_sort.eab_std_value as first_excl_group_eab_std_value
, eg_sort.exc_group_name as first_excl_group
, eg_sort.exc_group_sort as first_excl_group_pdc_sort
, eg_sort.exc_group_warning as first_excl_group_warning
from (
	select distinct stud_co.partnercontact_id, stud_co.partner_system_name, stud_co.eab_entry_year_academic, stud_co.eab_entry_term
	, stud_co.eab_student_type, stud_co.eab_std_value, stud_co.eab_attribute_type, stud_co.configuration_type, stud_co.display_bucket_label, stud_co.sort_order
	from <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{stud_all_atts}> stud_co
) stud_co

left join (
select *, row_number() over(partition by stud_co.partnercontact_id, stud_co.partner_system_name, stud_co.eab_entry_year_academic, stud_co.eab_entry_term, stud_co.eab_student_type
  order by case when exc_group_warning is not null then 9 else 1 end, try_to_number(stud_co.exc_group_sort) nulls last) as rn
  from (
	select distinct stud_co.partnercontact_id, stud_co.partner_system_name, stud_co.eab_entry_year_academic, stud_co.eab_entry_term, stud_co.eab_student_type
	, stud_co.eab_std_value
	, stud_co.sort_order as exc_group_sort
	, stud_co.display_bucket_label as exc_group_name
	, stud_co.cohort_pdc_warning as exc_group_warning
	from  <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{stud_all_atts}> stud_co
	where eab_attribute_type = 'excluded_group'
  ) stud_co
) eg_sort
on (eg_sort.rn = 1 
and stud_co.partnercontact_id = eg_sort.partnercontact_id
and coalesce(stud_co.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(eg_sort.partner_system_name,'')
and coalesce(stud_co.eab_entry_term,'') = coalesce(eg_sort.eab_entry_term,'')
and coalesce(stud_co.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(eg_sort.eab_student_type,'')
and coalesce(stud_co.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(eg_sort.eab_entry_year_academic,0))


group by
stud_co.partnercontact_id
, stud_co.partner_system_name
, stud_co.eab_entry_year_academic
, stud_co.eab_entry_term
, stud_co.eab_student_type
, eg_sort.eab_std_value
, eg_sort.exc_group_name
, eg_sort.exc_group_sort
, eg_sort.exc_group_warning
) agg

order by 
agg.partnercontact_id
, agg.partner_system_name
, agg.eab_entry_year_academic
, agg.eab_student_type
, agg.eab_entry_term

queryResults.sqlPreview: /**Source of Truth = this Query: Enroll360.Project Atlas Migration Checks.stud_race_eth*/ select prelim.partnercontact_id, prelim.partner_system_name, prelim.ea…
queryResults.querySql:
/**Source of Truth = this Query: Enroll360.Project Atlas Migration Checks.stud_race_eth*/

select 
prelim.partnercontact_id,
prelim.partner_system_name,
prelim.eab_student_type,
prelim.eab_entry_term,
prelim.eab_entry_year_academic,
prelim.eab_full_part_time,
stud.eab_ethnicity,
stud.eab_international_ind,
stud_race.agg_race,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%American Indian/Alaska Native%'
then true
else null
end as amer_ind,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%Asian/Asian American%'
then true
else null
end as asn,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%Black/African American%'
then true
else null
end as blk,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%Middle Eastern%'
then true
else null
end as middle_eastern,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%Multiracial%'
then true
else null
end as multiracial,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander%'
then true
else null
end as native_hawaiian,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%Other%'
then true
else null
end as other,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%Prefer Not to Respond%'
then true
else null
end as prefer_not_to_respond,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%White%'
then true
else null
end as wht,

case when (coalesce(stud.eab_ethnicity,'Unknown') = 'Hispanic or Latino/a/e/x' or coalesce(stud_race_agg.POC_rollup,'non-POC') = 'POC')
then 'POC'
else 'non-POC'
end as ofcolor_rollup_new,

case when coalesce(eab_international_ind,false) = false 
	and (coalesce(stud.eab_ethnicity,'Unknown') = 'Hispanic or Latino/a/e/x' or coalesce(stud_race_agg.POC_rollup,'non-POC') = 'POC')
then 'POC'
else 'non-POC'
end as ofcolor_rollup_legacy

from <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{prelim_stud_data}> prelim
left join <tuple.Student> stud
    on (prelim.partnercontact_id = stud.partnercontact_id
    and coalesce(prelim.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(stud.partner_system_name,''))

left join (select 
		partnercontact_id, partner_system_name,
		listagg(eab_race,'|') as agg_race 
  		from (
			select distinct
			stud_race.partnercontact_id, stud_race.partner_system_name, stud_race.eab_race
			from <tuple.StudentRace> stud_race
		) agg
	group by partnercontact_id, partner_system_name ) stud_race
    on (prelim.partnercontact_id = stud_race.partnercontact_id
    and coalesce(prelim.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(stud_race.partner_system_name,''))

left join  <cte01_race> stud_race_agg
on (prelim.partnercontact_id = stud_race_agg.partnercontact_id
and coalesce(prelim.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(stud_race_agg.partner_system_name,''))

/*left join (

queryResults.sqlPreview: /**Source of Truth = this Query: Enroll360.Project Atlas Migration Checks.stud_race_eth*/ with stud_race_eth as ( select prelim.partnercontact_id, prelim.partne…
queryResults.querySql:
/**Source of Truth = this Query: Enroll360.Project Atlas Migration Checks.stud_race_eth*/
with stud_race_eth as (
select 
prelim.partnercontact_id,
prelim.partner_system_name,
prelim.partnercontact_id_sis,
prelim.partner_system_name_sis,
prelim.partnercontact_id_crm,
prelim.partner_system_name_crm,
prelim.eab_student_type,
prelim.eab_entry_term,
prelim.eab_entry_year_academic,
prelim.eab_full_part_time,
stud.eab_ethnicity,
stud.eab_international_ind,
stud_race.agg_race,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%American Indian/Alaska Native%'
then true
else null
end as amer_ind,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%Asian/Asian American%'
then true
else null
end as asn,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%Black/African American%'
then true
else null
end as blk,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%Middle Eastern%'
then true
else null
end as middle_eastern,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%Multiracial%'
then true
else null
end as multiracial,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander%'
then true
else null
end as native_hawaiian,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%Other%'
then true
else null
end as other,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%Prefer Not to Respond%'
then true
else null
end as prefer_not_to_respond,

case
when stud_race.agg_race ilike '%White%'
then true
else null
end as wht,

case when coalesce(stud.eab_ethnicity,'Unknown') = 'Hispanic or Latino/a/e/x'
then 'POC'
else 'non-POC'
end as ofcolor_rollup_hispanic_only,

case when coalesce(stud_race_agg.POC_rollup,'non-POC') = 'POC'
then 'POC'
else 'non-POC'
end as ofcolor_rollup_new_poconly,

case when (coalesce(stud.eab_ethnicity,'Unknown') = 'Hispanic or Latino/a/e/x' or coalesce(stud_race_agg.POC_rollup,'non-POC') = 'POC')
then 'POC'
else 'non-POC'
end as ofcolor_rollup_new,

case when coalesce(eab_international_ind,false) = false 
	and (coalesce(stud.eab_ethnicity,'Unknown') = 'Hispanic or Latino/a/e/x' or coalesce(stud_race_agg.POC_rollup,'non-POC') = 'POC')
then 'POC'
else 'non-POC'
end as ofcolor_rollup_legacy

from <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{prelim_stud_data}> prelim
left join  <[Enroll360].[Student PDP Delivery].[Last Validated].{final}> stud
    on (prelim.partnercontact_id = stud.partnercontact_id
    and coalesce(prelim.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(stud.partner_system_name,''))

left join (select 
		partnercontact_id, partner_system_name,
		listagg(eab_race,'|') as agg_race 
  		from (
			select distinct
			stud_race.partnercontact_id, stud_race.partner_system_name, stud_race.eab_race
			from <[Enroll360].[Student Race PDP Delivery].[Last Validated].{final}> stud_race
		) agg
	group by partnercontact_id, partner_system_name ) stud_race
    on (prelim.partnercontact_id = stud_race.partnercontact_id
    and coalesce(prelim.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(stud_race.partner_system_name,''))

left join  (
select distinct
partnercontact_id, partner_system_name,
 case when coalesce(agg_race,'') like any ('%Black%','%Asian%','%Native%','%Middle%','%Multi%','%Other%') then 'POC' else 'non-POC' end as POC_rollup
from (
	select 
		partnercontact_id, partner_system_name,
		listagg(eab_race,'|') as agg_race 
  		from (
			select distinct
			stud_race.partnercontact_id, stud_race.partner_system_name, stud_race.eab_race
			from <[Enroll360].[Student Race PDP Delivery].[Last Validated].{final}> stud_race
		) agg
	group by partnercontact_id, partner_system_name
) agg2
) stud_race_agg
on (prelim.partnercontact_id = stud_race_agg.partnercontact_id
and coalesce(prelim.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(stud_race_agg.partner_system_name,''))
)

select
    eab_student_type,
    eab_entry_term,
    eab_entry_year_academic,
    eab_full_part_time,
    rollup_value as ofcolor_rollup,
    count(distinct(case when ofcolor_rollup_new_poconly = rollup_value then partnercontact_id else null end)) as ofcolor_poconly,
    count(distinct(case when ofcolor_rollup_hispanic_only = rollup_value then partnercontact_id else null end)) as ofcolor_hisponly,
    count(distinct(case when ofcolor_rollup_new = rollup_value then partnercontact_id else null end)) as ofcolor_cnt,
    count(distinct(case when ofcolor_rollup_legacy = rollup_value then partnercontact_id else null end)) as ofcolor_legacy_cnt,
    count(distinct(case when ofcolor_rollup_new = rollup_value and ofcolor_rollup_legacy = 'non-POC' and ofcolor_rollup_new = 'POC' and eab_international_ind = true 
				   then partnercontact_id else null end)) as ofcolor_new_intls_cnt,
    count(distinct(case when ofcolor_rollup_legacy = rollup_value and ofcolor_rollup_legacy = 'non-POC' and ofcolor_rollup_new = 'POC' and eab_international_ind = true 
				   then partnercontact_id else null end)) as non_ofcolor_legacy_intls_cnt

from (
    select distinct
        partnercontact_id,
		partner_system_name,
		eab_student_type,
        eab_entry_term,
        eab_entry_year_academic,
        eab_full_part_time,
		eab_international_ind,
		ofcolor_rollup_new_poconly,
		ofcolor_rollup_hispanic_only,
        ofcolor_rollup_new,
        ofcolor_rollup_legacy,
		eab_ethnicity,
        'POC' as rollup_value
    from stud_race_eth
    union all

    select distinct
        partnercontact_id,
		partner_system_name,
		eab_student_type,
        eab_entry_term,
        eab_entry_year_academic,
        eab_full_part_time,
        eab_international_ind,
		ofcolor_rollup_new_poconly,
		ofcolor_rollup_hispanic_only,
        ofcolor_rollup_new,
        ofcolor_rollup_legacy,
        eab_ethnicity,
        'non-POC' as rollup_value
    from stud_race_eth
) ofcolor_rollup
group by
    eab_student_type,
    eab_entry_term,
    eab_entry_year_academic,
    eab_full_part_time,
    rollup_value
order by
    eab_student_type,
    eab_entry_term,
    eab_entry_year_academic,
    eab_full_part_time,
    rollup_value;

queryResults.sqlPreview: /**2026-07-16: Source of Truth = Enroll360.Project Atlas Migration Checks.prelim_stud_data.v2*/ /*almost to the end here - at this point all data is admit and u…
queryResults.querySql:
/**2026-07-16: Source of Truth =  Enroll360.Project Atlas Migration Checks.prelim_stud_data.v2*/
/*almost to the end here - at this point all data is admit and up only
prelim cte here is doing final calculations at the student level so next query can do aggregate calcs per type/term/year*/

(
select 
  agg_with_dupes.*,
  acrk_band.display_bucket_label as acrk_band,
  acrk_band.sort_order as acrk_sort_order
  from ( 
select distinct
stat.*,
case when stat.eab_current_funnel_status_adj in ('Uncomitted Admit','Previous Defer','Future Defer') then true else false end as pending_ind,
case when stat.eab_current_funnel_status_adj in ('Net Deposit','Enrolled') then true else false end as net_dep_ind,
case when stat.eab_current_funnel_status_adj in ('Melt') then true else false end as melt_ind,
cast(coalesce(funds_agg.institutional_gift_total,0) as decimal(18,2)) as institutional_gift_total,
cast(coalesce(funds_agg.institutional_gift_w_waiver_total,0) as decimal(18,2)) as institutional_gift_w_waiver_total,
case when finaid_agg.eab_aid_app_ind = true then cast(finaid_agg.gap_final as decimal(18,2)) else null end as variable_gap,
(coalesce(finaid_agg.tuition,0) - coalesce(funds_agg.institutional_gift_total,0)) as ntr,
ntr + institutional_gift_total as ntr_plus_inst_gift,
coalesce(finaid_agg.tuition,0) as tuition,
finaid_agg.eab_aid_app_ind,
finaid_agg.eab_financial_sai,
finaid_agg.eab_financial_need,
finaid_agg.adjusted_sai,
finaid_agg.ability_to_pay_source,
finaid_agg.ability_to_pay_display_key,
finaid_agg.ability_to_pay_stud_value,
case when coalesce(finaid_agg.eab_aid_app_ind,false) = false then 'Non-Aid Applicants'
	when finaid_agg.ability_to_pay_stud_value is null then 'Non-Aid Applicants'
	else pdc.display_bucket_label end as ability_to_pay_band,
case when coalesce(finaid_agg.eab_aid_app_ind,false) = false then 999
	when finaid_agg.ability_to_pay_stud_value is null then 999
	else try_to_number(pdc.sort_order) end as ability_to_pay_sort_order,
finaid_agg.eab_pell_eligible_ind,
finaid_agg.eab_css_profile_submitted_ind,
finaid_agg.eab_fafsa_submitted_ind,
cast(gpas.eab_hs_gpa as decimal(18,2)) as eab_hs_gpa,
cast(coalesce(gpas.points,0) as decimal(18,2)) as gpa_points,
cast(coalesce(gpas.adj_points,0) as decimal(18,2)) as adj_gpa_points,
cast(c_rank.eab_class_rank as decimal(18,2)) as eab_class_rank,
cast(coalesce(c_rank.points,0) as decimal(18,2)) as class_rank_points,
cast(coalesce(c_rank.adj_points,0) as decimal(18,2)) as adj_class_rank_points,
cast(scores.normalized_exam_score as decimal(18,2)) as eab_exam_score,
cast(coalesce(scores.points,0) as decimal(18,2)) as exam_points,
cast(coalesce(scores.adj_points,0) as decimal(18,2)) as adj_exam_points,
(adj_exam_points + adj_class_rank_points + adj_gpa_points + coalesce(stat.adj_alt_ac_rank_points,0)) as acrk,

row_number() over(partition by stat.partnercontact_id, stat.partner_system_name, stat.eab_entry_year_academic, stat.eab_student_type
		order by  stat.stapp_file_date, stat.partnercontact_id_sis, stat.partnercontact_id_crm, stat.eab_entry_term, stat.eab_full_part_time) as pc_id_multiterm_dupe_rn,
row_number() over(partition by stat.partnercontact_id, stat.partner_system_name, stat.eab_entry_term, stat.eab_entry_year_academic, stat.eab_student_type
		order by stat.stapp_file_date, stat.partnercontact_id_sis, stat.partnercontact_id_crm, stat.eab_full_part_time) as pc_id_dupe_rn,
row_number() over(partition by stat.partnercontact_id_sis, stat.partner_system_name_sis, stat.eab_entry_term, stat.eab_entry_year_academic, stat.eab_student_type
		order by stat.stapp_file_date, stat.partnercontact_id, stat.partnercontact_id_crm, stat.eab_full_part_time) as sis_pc_id_dupe_rn

from <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{st_sta_data}> stat

left join <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{funds_totals}> funds_agg
	on (stat.partnercontact_id_sis = funds_agg.partnercontact_id
	and coalesce(stat.partner_system_name_sis,'') = coalesce(funds_agg.partner_system_name,'')
	and coalesce(stat.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(funds_agg.eab_entry_year_academic,0))

left join <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{finaid_variable_gap}> finaid_agg
	on (stat.partnercontact_id_sis = finaid_agg.partnercontact_id
	and coalesce(stat.partner_system_name_sis,'') = coalesce(finaid_agg.partner_system_name,'')
	and coalesce(stat.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(finaid_agg.eab_entry_year_academic,0))

left join (select * from <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{prioritized_gpa}> gpas where rn2 = 1) gpas
	on (stat.partnercontact_id = gpas.partnercontact_id
	and coalesce(stat.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(gpas.partner_system_name,'')
--	and coalesce(stat.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(gpas.eab_student_type,'')
)

left join (select * from <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{prioritized_rank}> c_rank where rn2 = 1) c_rank
	on (stat.partnercontact_id = c_rank.partnercontact_id
	and coalesce(stat.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(c_rank.partner_system_name,'')
--	and coalesce(stat.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(c_rank.eab_student_type,'')
)

left join (select * from <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{prioritized_test}> scores where rn2 = 1) scores
	on (stat.partnercontact_id = scores.partnercontact_id
	and coalesce(stat.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(scores.partner_system_name,'')
--	and coalesce(stat.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(scores.eab_student_type,'')
)

left join <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{key_configs}> pdc
on (coalesce(finaid_agg.ability_to_pay_display_key,'') = coalesce(pdc.configuration_type,'')
	and coalesce(stat.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(pdc.eab_student_type,'')
	and coalesce(try_to_number(stat.eab_entry_year_academic),0) = coalesce(try_to_number(pdc.eab_entry_year_academic),0)
	and coalesce(finaid_agg.ability_to_pay_stud_value,0) between coalesce(pdc.stored_value_exact_or_range_min,0) and coalesce(pdc.stored_value_range_max,99999999)) 

) agg_with_dupes

left join <cte05_acrk_index_bands> acrk_band
	on (coalesce(agg_with_dupes.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(acrk_band.eab_student_type,'')
	and coalesce(try_to_number(agg_with_dupes.eab_entry_year_academic),0) = coalesce(try_to_number(acrk_band.eab_entry_year_academic),0)
	and coalesce(agg_with_dupes.acrk,0.00) between coalesce(acrk_band.stored_value_exact_or_range_min,0) and coalesce(acrk_band.stored_value_range_max,99999999))

where 1=1
and ((agg_with_dupes.partnercontact_id_sis is not null and agg_with_dupes.sis_pc_id_dupe_rn = 1) /*dedupes multiID FAO students*/ 
	or (agg_with_dupes.partnercontact_id_sis is null and agg_with_dupes.pc_id_dupe_rn = 1)) /*dedupes UG only students*/
)

queryResults.querySql:
WITH configuration_data AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pdc.eab_entry_year_academic,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_entry_year_academic
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pdc.eab_student_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_student_type
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pdc.configuration_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS configuration_type
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pdc.configuration_value,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS configuration_value
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pdc.display_label,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS display_label
          , CAST(pdc.sort_order AS number) AS sort_order
          , CAST(pdc.intake_dt AS timestamp) AS intake_dt
        FROM <[Enroll360].[Partner Dashboard Configurations].{fulfillment}> AS pdc
    ) sq
    WHERE COALESCE(sq.configuration_type,'')<>''
      AND COALESCE(sq.configuration_value,'')<>''
      AND COALESCE(sq.eab_entry_year_academic,'')<>''
      AND COALESCE(sq.eab_student_type,'')<>''
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    eab_entry_year_academic
  , eab_student_type
  , configuration_type
  , configuration_value
  , display_label
  , sort_order
  , intake_dt
FROM configuration_data

queryResults.querySql:
WITH configuration_data AS (
/*Partner Display Controls*/
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pdc.eab_entry_year_academic,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_entry_year_academic
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pdc.eab_student_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_student_type
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pdc.configuration_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS configuration_type
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pdc.STORED_VALUE_EXACT_OR_RANGE_MIN,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS configuration_value
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pdc.display_bucket_label,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS display_label
          , CAST(pdc.sort_order AS number) AS sort_order
          , CAST(pdc.intake_dt AS timestamp) AS intake_dt
        FROM <[Enroll360].[Partner Display Controls].{final}> AS pdc
union all
/*Partner Configurations*/
        SELECT DISTINCT					
            nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pc.eab_entry_year_academic,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_entry_year_academic
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pc.eab_student_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_student_type
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pc.configuration_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS configuration_type
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pc.configuration_value,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS configuration_value
          , --nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pc.display_bucket_label,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') 
					NULL AS display_label
          , --CAST(pc.sort_order AS number) 
					NULL AS sort_order
          , CAST(pc.intake_dt AS timestamp) AS intake_dt
        FROM <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{final}> AS pc
union all
/*Partner Expense Breakdown x Partner Configurations*/
        SELECT DISTINCT
            nullif(trim(regexp_replace(peb.eab_entry_year_academic,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_entry_year_academic
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pc.eab_student_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_student_type
          , --nullif(trim(regexp_replace(peb.configuration_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') 
				'tuition_type_display' AS configuration_type
				--'expense_group_key' AS configuration_type						
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(peb.expense_group_label,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS configuration_value
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pc.configuration_value,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS display_label
          , --CAST(peb.sort_order AS number) 
					NULL AS sort_order
          , CAST(peb.intake_dt AS timestamp) AS intake_dt
        FROM <[Enroll360].[Partner Expense Breakdown].{final}> AS peb
		left join <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{final}> AS pc
		on (coalesce(peb.expense_group_label,'') = coalesce(pc.configuration_type,'')
		and coalesce(peb.eab_entry_year_academic,'') = coalesce(pc.eab_entry_year_academic,'')
		)
union all
/*Partner Expense Breakdown x Partner Configurations*/
        SELECT DISTINCT
            nullif(trim(regexp_replace(peb.eab_entry_year_academic,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_entry_year_academic
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pc.eab_student_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_student_type
          , --nullif(trim(regexp_replace(peb.configuration_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') 
				'expense_group_key' AS configuration_type						
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(peb.expense_group_key,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS configuration_value
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(peb.expense_group_label,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS display_label
          , --CAST(peb.sort_order AS number) 
					NULL AS sort_order
          , CAST(peb.intake_dt AS timestamp) AS intake_dt
        FROM <[Enroll360].[Partner Expense Breakdown].{final}> AS peb
		left join <[Enroll360].[Partner Configurations].{final}> AS pc
		on (coalesce(peb.expense_group_label,'') = coalesce(pc.configuration_type,'')
		and coalesce(peb.eab_entry_year_academic,'') = coalesce(pc.eab_entry_year_academic,'')
		)
    ) sq
    WHERE COALESCE(sq.configuration_type,'')<>''
      AND COALESCE(sq.configuration_value,'')<>''
      AND COALESCE(sq.eab_entry_year_academic,'')<>''
      AND COALESCE(sq.eab_student_type,'')<>''
	  AND COALESCE(sq.configuration_type,'') in (
		'financial_need_band',
		'financial_sai_band',
		'tuition_type_display',
		'expense_group_key',
		'ability_to_pay_source',
		'full_time_revenue_goal',
		'full_time_admit_goal',
		'full_time_deposit_goal',
		'excluded_group_display',
		'display_exam_type',
		'cohort_display',
		'cohort_category_display',
		'market_cohort_display')
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    eab_entry_year_academic
  , eab_student_type
  , configuration_type
  , configuration_value
  , display_label
  , sort_order
  , intake_dt
FROM configuration_data

order by 
    eab_entry_year_academic
  , eab_student_type
  , configuration_type
  , intake_dt
  , sort_order
  , configuration_value

queryResults.querySql:
WITH dc_data AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
              NULLIF(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(pdc.configuration_type, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') AS configuration_type
            , NULLIF(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(pdc.entry_year_as_academic_year_eab AS number), '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') AS eab_entry_year_academic
            , NULLIF(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(pdc.stored_value_exact_or_range_minimum, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') AS stored_value_exact_or_range_min
            , NULLIF(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(pdc.stored_value_range_maximum, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') AS stored_value_range_max
            , NULLIF(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(pdc.student_type_eab, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') AS eab_student_type
            , pdc.stored_value_data_type AS stored_value_data_type
            , pdc.display_bucket_label AS display_bucket_label
            , CAST(pdc.sort_order AS number) AS sort_order
            , CAST(pdc.intake_dt AS timestamp) AS intake_dt
        FROM <[Enroll360].[Partner Display Controls].{fulfillment}> AS pdc
    ) sq
    WHERE COALESCE(sq.configuration_type,'') <> ''
      AND COALESCE(sq.eab_entry_year_academic,'') <> ''
      AND COALESCE(sq.stored_value_exact_or_range_min,'') <> ''
      -- allow NULLs, but exclude empty strings
      AND (sq.stored_value_range_max IS NULL OR sq.stored_value_range_max <> '')
      AND COALESCE(sq.eab_student_type,'') <> ''
)

SELECT DISTINCT
      configuration_type
    , eab_entry_year_academic
    , stored_value_exact_or_range_min
    , stored_value_range_max
    , eab_student_type
    , stored_value_data_type
    , display_bucket_label
    , sort_order
    , intake_dt
FROM dc_data

from <[Enroll360].[Partner ID Xwalk].{fulfillment}> part_id_x

union all 
			
<union_add.Partner ID Xwalk>


)agg

<join_extension.Partner ID Xwalk>

where 1=1
and coalesce(agg.source_partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(agg.source_partner_system_name,'') <> ''
and coalesce(agg.target_partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(agg.target_partner_system_name,'') <> ''
)

, cte2_primary_sets as (
select
a.source_partnercontact_id,
a.source_partner_system_name,
a.source_eab_system_type,
a.target_partnercontact_id,
a.target_partner_system_name,
a.target_eab_system_type,
a.intake_dt
from all_id_sets a
where a.source_partner_system_name = 'primary'

union all

select
b.target_partnercontact_id as source_partnercontact_id,
b.target_partner_system_name as source_partner_system_name,
b.target_eab_system_type as source_eab_system_type,
b.source_partnercontact_id as target_partnercontact_id,
b.source_partner_system_name as target_partner_system_name,
b.source_eab_system_type as target_eab_system_type,
b.intake_dt
from all_id_sets b
where b.target_partner_system_name = 'primary')

/*****Final Query******/
--select source_partner_system_name, target_partner_system_name, count(*) from (

select distinct * from (

select *
from cte2_primary_sets c

union all

select 
p.source_partnercontact_id, 
p.source_partner_system_name, 
p.source_eab_system_type,
a.target_partnercontact_id,
a.target_partner_system_name,
a.target_eab_system_type,
a.intake_dt
from cte2_primary_sets p
join all_id_sets a
on a.source_partnercontact_id = p.target_partnercontact_id
and a.source_partner_system_name = p.target_partner_system_name
where 1=1
and a.target_partner_system_name <> 'primary'
and a.source_partner_system_name <> 'primary'

union all

select 
p.source_partnercontact_id, 
p.source_partner_system_name, 
p.source_eab_system_type,
a.source_partnercontact_id as target_partnercontact_id,
a.source_partner_system_name as target_partner_system_name,
a.source_eab_system_type as target_eab_system_type,
a.intake_dt
from cte2_primary_sets p
join all_id_sets a
on a.target_partnercontact_id = p.target_partnercontact_id
and a.target_partner_system_name = p.target_partner_system_name
where 1=1
and a.target_partner_system_name <> 'primary'
and a.source_partner_system_name <> 'primary'

union all

select a.*
  --, p.source_partnercontact_id as primary_id
from all_id_sets a 
left join cte2_primary_sets p
on (a.target_partnercontact_id = p.target_partnercontact_id
		and a.target_partner_system_name = p.target_partner_system_name) 
  or (a.source_partnercontact_id = p.target_partnercontact_id
	and a.source_partner_system_name = p.target_partner_system_name)
where 1=1
and a.target_partner_system_name <> 'primary'
and a.source_partner_system_name <> 'primary'
and p.source_partnercontact_id is null

)agg

where 1=1
and coalesce(agg.source_partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(agg.source_partner_system_name,'') <> ''
and coalesce(agg.target_partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(agg.target_partner_system_name,'') <> ''

--group by source_partner_system_name, target_partner_system_name
--order by source_partner_system_name, target_partner_system_name

Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. queryResults.sqlPreview: WITH cte1_EDGES_RAW AS ( SELECT CAST(source_partner_system_name AS STRING) AS SYS_A, CAST(source_partnercontact_id AS STRING) AS ID_A, CAST(target_partner_syste…
queryResults.querySql:
WITH

cte1_EDGES_RAW AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(source_partner_system_name AS STRING) AS SYS_A,
    CAST(source_partnercontact_id   AS STRING) AS ID_A,
    CAST(target_partner_system_name AS STRING) AS SYS_B,
    CAST(target_partnercontact_id   AS STRING) AS ID_B
  FROM <[Enroll360].[Partner ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> AS id_xwalk
  where source_partner_system_name is not null
  and source_partnercontact_id is not null
  and target_partner_system_name is not null
  and target_partnercontact_id is not null

),

cte2_SYMMETRIC_EDGES AS ( 
  SELECT SYS_A||'::'||ID_A AS A, SYS_B||'::'||ID_B AS B FROM cte1_EDGES_RAW
  UNION ALL
  SELECT SYS_B||'::'||ID_B AS A, SYS_A||'::'||ID_A AS B FROM cte1_EDGES_RAW
),

cte3_NODES AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT SYS_A AS SYSTEM_NAME, ID_A AS ID
  FROM cte1_EDGES_RAW

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT SYS_B AS SYSTEM_NAME, ID_B AS ID
  FROM cte1_EDGES_RAW

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT
         EAB_STUDENT_ID_TYPE AS SYSTEM_NAME,
         EAB_STUDENT_ID      AS ID
  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term].[Last Validated].{final}> AS stud_term_crm

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT
         EAB_STUDENT_ID_TYPE AS SYSTEM_NAME,
         EAB_STUDENT_ID      AS ID
  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> AS stud_term_sis
),

cte4_ALL_PATHS AS (
  -- anchor: each node reaches itself
  SELECT
    SYSTEM_NAME||'::'||ID                  AS START_NODE,
    SYSTEM_NAME||'::'||ID                  AS REACHABLE_NODE,
    ARRAY_CONSTRUCT(SYSTEM_NAME||'::'||ID) AS PATH
  FROM cte3_NODES

  UNION ALL

  -- step: walk one hop using symmetric edges, avoid revisiting nodes
  SELECT
    ap.START_NODE,
    se.B                                   AS REACHABLE_NODE,
    ARRAY_APPEND(ap.PATH, se.B)            AS PATH
  FROM cte4_ALL_PATHS AS ap
  JOIN cte2_SYMMETRIC_EDGES AS se
    ON ap.REACHABLE_NODE = se.A
  WHERE NOT ARRAY_CONTAINS(ap.PATH, TO_VARIANT(se.B))
)

SELECT *
FROM cte4_ALL_PATHS AS ap;
