queryResults.sqlPreview: WITH latest_applications AS ( SELECT app_ranked.id AS id, app_ranked.prospect_id AS prospect_id, app_ranked.updated_at AS updated_at, app_ranked.created_at AS c…
queryResults.querySql:
WITH
latest_applications AS (
    SELECT
        app_ranked.id AS id,
        app_ranked.prospect_id AS prospect_id,
        app_ranked.updated_at AS updated_at,
        app_ranked.created_at AS created_at,
        app_ranked.sis_student_id AS sis_student_id,
        app_ranked.first_name AS first_name,
        app_ranked.middle_name AS middle_name,
        app_ranked.last_name AS last_name,
        app_ranked.us_citizenship_status AS us_citizenship_status,
        app_ranked.international_indicator AS international_indicator,
        app_ranked.date_of_birth AS date_of_birth,
        app_ranked.gender AS gender,
        app_ranked.gender_identity AS gender_identity,
        app_ranked.religious_affiliation AS religious_affiliation,
        app_ranked.high_school_graduation_year AS high_school_graduation_year,
        app_ranked.first_generation_college AS first_generation_college,
        app_ranked.military_status AS military_status,
        app_ranked.alumni_relation_indicator AS alumni_relation_indicator,
        app_ranked.ethnicity AS ethnicity,
        app_ranked.campus_visit_count AS campus_visit_count,
        app_ranked.campus_visit_indicator AS campus_visit_indicator,
        app_ranked.first_campus_visit_date AS first_campus_visit_date,
        app_ranked.last_campus_visit_date AS last_campus_visit_date,
        app_ranked.ok_to_email AS ok_to_email,
        app_ranked.ok_to_call AS ok_to_call,
        app_ranked.ok_to_text AS ok_to_text
    FROM (
        SELECT
            app_src.id AS id,
            app_src.prospect_id AS prospect_id,
            app_src.updated_at AS updated_at,
            app_src.created_at AS created_at,
            app_src.sis_student_id AS sis_student_id,
            app_src.first_name AS first_name,
            app_src.middle_name AS middle_name,
            app_src.last_name AS last_name,
            app_src.us_citizenship_status AS us_citizenship_status,
            app_src.international_indicator AS international_indicator,
            app_src.date_of_birth AS date_of_birth,
            app_src.gender AS gender,
            app_src.gender_identity AS gender_identity,
            app_src.religious_affiliation AS religious_affiliation,
            app_src.high_school_graduation_year AS high_school_graduation_year,
            app_src.first_generation_college AS first_generation_college,
            app_src.military_status AS military_status,
            app_src.alumni_relation_indicator AS alumni_relation_indicator,
            app_src.ethnicity AS ethnicity,
            app_src.campus_visit_count AS campus_visit_count,
            app_src.campus_visit_indicator AS campus_visit_indicator,
            app_src.first_campus_visit_date AS first_campus_visit_date,
            app_src.last_campus_visit_date AS last_campus_visit_date,
            app_src.ok_to_email AS ok_to_email,
            app_src.ok_to_call AS ok_to_call,
            app_src.ok_to_text AS ok_to_text,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY app_src.prospect_id
                ORDER BY TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(app_src.updated_at) DESC NULLS LAST,
                TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(app_src.created_at) DESC NULLS LAST,
                TO_VARCHAR(app_src.id) DESC
            ) AS application_row_num
        FROM <[ECRM].[Applications].{fulfillment}> AS app_src
    ) AS app_ranked
    WHERE app_ranked.application_row_num = 1
),
activity_prospect_map AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            IFF(act_src.activitable_type ILIKE '%prospect%', NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(act_src.activitable_id)), ''), NULL),
            NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app_for_act.prospect_id)), '')
        ) AS prospect_id,
        act_src.activity_type AS activity_type,
        act_src.description AS description,
        act_src.activity_date AS activity_date
    FROM <[ECRM].[Activities].{fulfillment}> AS act_src
    LEFT JOIN <[ECRM].[Applications].{fulfillment}> AS app_for_act
        ON NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app_for_act.id)), '') = NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(act_src.activitable_id)), '')
       AND act_src.activitable_type ILIKE '%application%'
    WHERE COALESCE(
        IFF(act_src.activitable_type ILIKE '%prospect%', NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(act_src.activitable_id)), ''), NULL),
        NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app_for_act.prospect_id)), '')
    ) IS NOT NULL
),
campus_visit_activity AS (
    SELECT
        apm.prospect_id AS prospect_id,
        COUNT(*) AS campus_visit_count_from_activities,
        MIN(TRY_TO_DATE(apm.activity_date)) AS first_campus_visit_date_from_activities,
        MAX(TRY_TO_DATE(apm.activity_date)) AS last_campus_visit_date_from_activities
    FROM activity_prospect_map AS apm
    WHERE apm.activity_type ILIKE '%campus%'
      AND (apm.activity_type ILIKE '%visit%' OR apm.description ILIKE '%visit%')
    GROUP BY apm.prospect_id
)
SELECT
    null as ALUMNI_RELATIONSHIP_EAB,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.alumni_relation_indicator)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.legacy_status)), '')) as ALUMNI_RELATIONSHIP_INDICATOR,
    TRY_TO_DATE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.date_of_birth)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.date_of_birth)), ''))) as BIRTH_DATE,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.id)), '') as CRM_STUDENT_ID,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_1,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_2,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_3,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_4,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_5,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_6,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_7,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_8,
    null as CALCULATED_ID_FIELD,
    cva.campus_visit_count_from_activities as CAMPUS_VISIT_COUNT,
    case when cva.campus_visit_count_from_activities > 0 then 'true' else 'false' end as CAMPUS_VISIT_INDICATOR,
    null as CAMPUS_VISIT_INDICATOR_EAB,
    null as EAB_STUDENT_ID,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_email)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_email)), '')) IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_email)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_email)), '')) AS VARCHAR) = '0' then '1'
        WHEN CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_email)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_email)), '')) AS VARCHAR) = '1' then '0'
        ELSE NULL
    END as EMAIL_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR,
    null as EMAIL_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR_EAB,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ethnicity)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ethnicity)), '')) as ETHNICITY,
    null as ETHNICITY_EAB,
    cva.first_campus_visit_date_from_activities as FIRST_CAMPUS_VISIT_DATE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.first_generation_college)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.first_generation_college)), '')) as FIRST_GENERATION_INDICATOR,
    null as FIRST_GENERATION_INDICATOR_EAB,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.first_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.first_name)), '')) as FIRST_NAME,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.gender)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.gender)), '')) as GENDER,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.high_school_graduation_year)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.high_school_graduation_year)), '')) as HIGH_SCHOOL_GRAD_YEAR,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ethnicity)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ethnicity)), '')) IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ethnicity)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ethnicity)), '')) ILIKE '%hispanic%'
          OR COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ethnicity)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ethnicity)), '')) ILIKE '%latino%'
          OR COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ethnicity)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ethnicity)), '')) ILIKE '%latina%'
          OR COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ethnicity)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ethnicity)), '')) ILIKE '%latinx%'
        THEN 'TRUE'
        ELSE 'FALSE'
    END as HISPANIC_INDICATOR,
    p.intake_date as INTAKE_DATE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.international_indicator)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.international_ind)), '')) as INTERNATIONAL_INDICATOR,
    null as INTERNATIONAL_INDICATOR_EAB,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.last_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.last_name)), '')) as LAST_NAME,
    CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.mail_optout_ind)), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.mail_optout_ind)), '') AS VARCHAR) = '0' then '1'
        WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.mail_optout_ind)), '') AS VARCHAR) = '1' then '0'
        ELSE NULL
    END as MAIL_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR,
    null as MAIL_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR_EAB,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.middle_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.middle_name)), '')) as MIDDLE_NAME,
    null as MILITARY_SERVICE_OR_VETERAN_INDICATOR_EAB,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.military_status)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.military_status)), '')) as MILITARY_SERVICE_OR_VETERAN_STATUS,
    cva.last_campus_visit_date_from_activities as MOST_RECENT_CAMPUS_VISIT_DATE,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_email)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_email)), '')) IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_email)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_email)), '')) AS VARCHAR) = '0' then '1'
        WHEN CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_email)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_email)), '')) AS VARCHAR) = '1' then '0'
        ELSE NULL
    END as OPT_OUT_INDICATOR_GENERAL,
    null as OPT_OUT_INDICATOR_GENERAL_EAB,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.PRIMARY_SOURCE)), '') as ORIGIN_SOURCE_CODE,
    TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.created_at)), '')) as ORIGIN_SOURCE_DATE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.external_id)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.sis_integration_id)), '')) as OTHER_STUDENT_ID,
    'navigate_crm_1' as PARTNER_SYSTEM_NAME,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_call)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_call)), '')) IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_call)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_call)), '')) AS VARCHAR) = '0' then '1'
        WHEN CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_call)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_call)), '')) AS VARCHAR) = '1' then '0'
        ELSE NULL
    END as PHONE_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR,
    null as PHONE_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR_EAB,
    null as POPULATION_NAME,
    null as PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.gender_identity)), ''),NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.gender)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.gender)), '')) as PREFERRED_GENDER,
    null as PREFERRED_GENDER_EAB,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.id)), '') as PRIMARY_STUDENT_ID,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.religious_affiliation)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.religious_affiliation)), '')) as RELIGIOUS_AFFILIATION,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.sis_student_id)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.sis_student_id)), '')) as SIS_STUDENT_ID,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_text)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_text)), '')) as SMS_OPT_IN_INDICATOR,
    null as SMS_OPT_IN_INDICATOR_EAB,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_text)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_text)), '')) IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_text)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_text)), '')) AS VARCHAR) = '0' then '1'
        WHEN CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_text)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_text)), '')) AS VARCHAR) = '1' then '0'
        ELSE NULL
    END as SMS_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.us_citizenship_status)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.us_citizenship_status)), '')) as US_CITIZENSHIP_STATUS
FROM <[ECRM].[Prospects].{fulfillment}> AS p
LEFT JOIN latest_applications AS la
    ON la.prospect_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN campus_visit_activity AS cva
    ON cva.prospect_id = NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.id)), '')
<student_join_extension>
where <student_where>

queryResults.sqlPreview: WITH latest_applications AS ( SELECT app_ranked.id AS id, app_ranked.prospect_id AS prospect_id, app_ranked.updated_at AS updated_at, app_ranked.created_at AS c…
queryResults.querySql:
WITH
latest_applications AS (
    SELECT
        app_ranked.id AS id,
        app_ranked.prospect_id AS prospect_id,
        app_ranked.updated_at AS updated_at,
        app_ranked.created_at AS created_at,
        app_ranked.sis_student_id AS sis_student_id,
        app_ranked.first_name AS first_name,
        app_ranked.middle_name AS middle_name,
        app_ranked.last_name AS last_name,
        app_ranked.us_citizenship_status AS us_citizenship_status,
        app_ranked.international_indicator AS international_indicator,
        app_ranked.date_of_birth AS date_of_birth,
        app_ranked.gender AS gender,
        app_ranked.gender_identity AS gender_identity,
        app_ranked.religious_affiliation AS religious_affiliation,
        app_ranked.high_school_graduation_year AS high_school_graduation_year,
        app_ranked.first_generation_college AS first_generation_college,
        app_ranked.military_status AS military_status,
        app_ranked.alumni_relation_indicator AS alumni_relation_indicator,
        app_ranked.ethnicity AS ethnicity,
        app_ranked.campus_visit_count AS campus_visit_count,
        app_ranked.campus_visit_indicator AS campus_visit_indicator,
        app_ranked.first_campus_visit_date AS first_campus_visit_date,
        app_ranked.last_campus_visit_date AS last_campus_visit_date,
        app_ranked.ok_to_email AS ok_to_email,
        app_ranked.ok_to_call AS ok_to_call,
        app_ranked.ok_to_text AS ok_to_text
    FROM (
        SELECT
            app_src.id AS id,
            app_src.prospect_id AS prospect_id,
            app_src.updated_at AS updated_at,
            app_src.created_at AS created_at,
            app_src.sis_student_id AS sis_student_id,
            app_src.first_name AS first_name,
            app_src.middle_name AS middle_name,
            app_src.last_name AS last_name,
            app_src.us_citizenship_status AS us_citizenship_status,
            app_src.international_indicator AS international_indicator,
            app_src.date_of_birth AS date_of_birth,
            app_src.gender AS gender,
            app_src.gender_identity AS gender_identity,
            app_src.religious_affiliation AS religious_affiliation,
            app_src.high_school_graduation_year AS high_school_graduation_year,
            app_src.first_generation_college AS first_generation_college,
            app_src.military_status AS military_status,
            app_src.alumni_relation_indicator AS alumni_relation_indicator,
            app_src.ethnicity AS ethnicity,
            app_src.campus_visit_count AS campus_visit_count,
            app_src.campus_visit_indicator AS campus_visit_indicator,
            app_src.first_campus_visit_date AS first_campus_visit_date,
            app_src.last_campus_visit_date AS last_campus_visit_date,
            app_src.ok_to_email AS ok_to_email,
            app_src.ok_to_call AS ok_to_call,
            app_src.ok_to_text AS ok_to_text,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY app_src.prospect_id
                ORDER BY TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(app_src.updated_at) DESC NULLS LAST,
                TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(app_src.created_at) DESC NULLS LAST,
                TO_VARCHAR(app_src.id) DESC
            ) AS application_row_num
        FROM <[ECRM].[Applications].{fulfillment}> AS app_src
    ) AS app_ranked
    WHERE app_ranked.application_row_num = 1
),
activity_prospect_map AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            IFF(act_src.activitable_type ILIKE '%prospect%', NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(act_src.activitable_id)), ''), NULL),
            NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app_for_act.prospect_id)), '')
        ) AS prospect_id,
        act_src.activity_type AS activity_type,
        act_src.description AS description,
        act_src.activity_date AS activity_date
    FROM <[ECRM].[Activities].{fulfillment}> AS act_src
    LEFT JOIN <[ECRM].[Applications].{fulfillment}> AS app_for_act
        ON NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app_for_act.id)), '') = NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(act_src.activitable_id)), '')
       AND act_src.activitable_type ILIKE '%application%'
    WHERE COALESCE(
        IFF(act_src.activitable_type ILIKE '%prospect%', NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(act_src.activitable_id)), ''), NULL),
        NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app_for_act.prospect_id)), '')
    ) IS NOT NULL
),
campus_visit_activity AS (
    SELECT
        apm.prospect_id AS prospect_id,
        COUNT(*) AS campus_visit_count_from_activities,
        MIN(TRY_TO_DATE(apm.activity_date)) AS first_campus_visit_date_from_activities,
        MAX(TRY_TO_DATE(apm.activity_date)) AS last_campus_visit_date_from_activities
    FROM activity_prospect_map AS apm
    WHERE apm.activity_type ILIKE '%campus%'
      AND (apm.activity_type ILIKE '%visit%' OR apm.description ILIKE '%visit%')
    GROUP BY apm.prospect_id
)
SELECT
    null as ALUMNI_RELATIONSHIP_EAB,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.alumni_relation_indicator)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.legacy_status)), '')) as ALUMNI_RELATIONSHIP_INDICATOR,
    TRY_TO_DATE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.date_of_birth)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.date_of_birth)), ''))) as BIRTH_DATE,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.id)), '') as CRM_STUDENT_ID,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_1,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_2,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_3,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_4,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_5,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_6,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_7,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_8,
    null as CALCULATED_ID_FIELD,
    cva.campus_visit_count_from_activities as CAMPUS_VISIT_COUNT,
    case when cva.campus_visit_count_from_activities > 0 then 'true' else 'false' end as CAMPUS_VISIT_INDICATOR,
    null as CAMPUS_VISIT_INDICATOR_EAB,
    null as EAB_STUDENT_ID,
    CASE
		WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.status)), '') = 'Current Student' THEN '1'
        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_email)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_email)), '')) IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_email)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_email)), '')) AS VARCHAR) = '0' then '1'
        WHEN CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_email)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_email)), '')) AS VARCHAR) = '1' then '0'
        ELSE NULL
    END as EMAIL_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR,
    null as EMAIL_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR_EAB,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ethnicity)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ethnicity)), '')) as ETHNICITY,
    null as ETHNICITY_EAB,
    cva.first_campus_visit_date_from_activities as FIRST_CAMPUS_VISIT_DATE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.first_generation_college)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.first_generation_college)), '')) as FIRST_GENERATION_INDICATOR,
    null as FIRST_GENERATION_INDICATOR_EAB,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.first_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.first_name)), '')) as FIRST_NAME,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.gender)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.gender)), '')) as GENDER,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.high_school_graduation_year)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.high_school_graduation_year)), '')) as HIGH_SCHOOL_GRAD_YEAR,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ethnicity)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ethnicity)), '')) IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ethnicity)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ethnicity)), '')) ILIKE '%hispanic%'
          OR COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ethnicity)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ethnicity)), '')) ILIKE '%latino%'
          OR COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ethnicity)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ethnicity)), '')) ILIKE '%latina%'
          OR COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ethnicity)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ethnicity)), '')) ILIKE '%latinx%'
        THEN 'TRUE'
        ELSE 'FALSE'
    END as HISPANIC_INDICATOR,
    p.intake_date as INTAKE_DATE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.international_indicator)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.international_ind)), '')) as INTERNATIONAL_INDICATOR,
    null as INTERNATIONAL_INDICATOR_EAB,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.last_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.last_name)), '')) as LAST_NAME,
    CASE
		WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.status)), '') = 'Current Student' THEN '1'
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.mail_optout_ind)), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.mail_optout_ind)), '') AS VARCHAR) = '0' then '1'
        WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.mail_optout_ind)), '') AS VARCHAR) = '1' then '0'
        ELSE NULL
    END as MAIL_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR,
    null as MAIL_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR_EAB,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.middle_name)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.middle_name)), '')) as MIDDLE_NAME,
    null as MILITARY_SERVICE_OR_VETERAN_INDICATOR_EAB,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.military_status)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.military_status)), '')) as MILITARY_SERVICE_OR_VETERAN_STATUS,
    cva.last_campus_visit_date_from_activities as MOST_RECENT_CAMPUS_VISIT_DATE,
    CASE
		WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.status)), '') = 'Current Student' THEN '1'
        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_email)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_email)), '')) IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_email)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_email)), '')) AS VARCHAR) = '0' then '1'
        WHEN CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_email)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_email)), '')) AS VARCHAR) = '1' then '0'
        ELSE NULL
    END as OPT_OUT_INDICATOR_GENERAL,
    null as OPT_OUT_INDICATOR_GENERAL_EAB,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.PRIMARY_SOURCE)), '') as ORIGIN_SOURCE_CODE,
    TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.created_at)), '')) as ORIGIN_SOURCE_DATE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.external_id)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.sis_integration_id)), '')) as OTHER_STUDENT_ID,
    'navigate_crm_1' as PARTNER_SYSTEM_NAME,
    CASE
		WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.status)), '') = 'Current Student' THEN '1'
        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_call)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_call)), '')) IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_call)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_call)), '')) AS VARCHAR) = '0' then '1'
        WHEN CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_call)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_call)), '')) AS VARCHAR) = '1' then '0'
        ELSE NULL
    END as PHONE_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR,
    null as PHONE_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR_EAB,
    null as POPULATION_NAME,
    null as PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.gender_identity)), ''),NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.gender)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.gender)), '')) as PREFERRED_GENDER,
    null as PREFERRED_GENDER_EAB,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.id)), '') as PRIMARY_STUDENT_ID,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.religious_affiliation)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.religious_affiliation)), '')) as RELIGIOUS_AFFILIATION,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.sis_student_id)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.sis_student_id)), '')) as SIS_STUDENT_ID,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_text)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_text)), '')) as SMS_OPT_IN_INDICATOR,
    null as SMS_OPT_IN_INDICATOR_EAB,
    CASE
		WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.status)), '') = 'Current Student' THEN '1'
        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_text)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_text)), '')) IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_text)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_text)), '')) AS VARCHAR) = '0' then '1'
        WHEN CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.ok_to_text)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ok_to_text)), '')) AS VARCHAR) = '1' then '0'
        ELSE NULL
    END as SMS_OPT_OUT_INDICATOR,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.us_citizenship_status)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.us_citizenship_status)), '')) as US_CITIZENSHIP_STATUS
FROM <[ECRM].[Prospects].{fulfillment}> AS p
LEFT JOIN latest_applications AS la
    ON la.prospect_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN campus_visit_activity AS cva
    ON cva.prospect_id = NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.id)), '')
<student_join_extension>
where <student_where>

queryResults.sqlPreview: --select count(*), c.current_entry_year_as_calendar_year from ( select s.primary_student_id , st.current_entry_year_as_academic_year as curr_entry_year_academic…
queryResults.querySql:
--select count(*), c.current_entry_year_as_calendar_year from (
select 
s.primary_student_id
, st.current_entry_year_as_academic_year as curr_entry_year_academic
, st.current_entry_term as curr_entry_term
, st.student_type
, sa.zip_code as zip
, sa.state_or_province as state
, sa.country 
, international_indicator as international_ind
, st.inquiry_indicator as inquiry_ind
, sta.application_incomplete_indicator as app_submit_ind
, sta.application_completed_indicator as app_complete_ind
, sta.admit_indicator as admit_ind
, sta.deposit_confirmed_indicator as deposit_ind
, sta.enrollment_indicator as enroll_ind
from <[Enroll360].[Student].{fulfillment}> as s
join <[Enroll360].[Student Term].{fulfillment}> as st on s.primary_student_id = st.primary_student_id
left outer join 
(
select s.*, row_number() over (partition by primary_student_id order by address_type) rn
from <[Enroll360].[Student Address].{fulfillment}> as s
  ) sa on s.primary_student_id = sa.primary_student_id and sa.rn = 1
left outer join <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application].{fulfillment}> sta
	on s.primary_student_id = sta.primary_student_id
where 1=1
and sta.primary_student_id is not null
order by s.primary_student_id
, st.current_entry_year_as_academic_year
, st.current_entry_term
--  ) c group by c.current_entry_year_as_calendar_year order by c.current_entry_year_as_calendar_year

queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-08-28: added deduping at pdp_ug key grain - ccreekman*/
/*2026-08-27: partner_system_name was not getting set to lowercase, having spaces removed as all other entities are. Corrected - ccreekman*/
/*2026-02-23: moved events join to join extension*/
/*2026_01-27: updated/added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name, and join_extension.student */
/*2025-07-07: added join extension - ccreekman*/
/*2025-06-19: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-03-24: added eab_student_id_type - ccreekman*/

select
    agg2.primary_student_id,
    agg2.eab_student_id,
    agg2.eab_student_id_type,
    agg2.partnercontact_id,
    agg2.partner_system_name,
    agg2.sis_student_id,
    agg2.crm_student_id,
    agg2.other_student_id,
    agg2.fname,
    agg2.mname,
    agg2.lname,
    agg2.preferred_fname,
    agg2.us_citizenship_status,
    agg2.international_ind,
    agg2.birth_dt,
    agg2.gender,
    agg2.pref_gender,
    agg2.religious_affiliation,
    agg2.hs_grad_year,
    agg2.origin_source,
    agg2.origin_source_dt,
    agg2.first_gen_ind,
    agg2.military_service_status,
    agg2.eab_first_gen_ind,
    agg2.eab_pref_gender,
    agg2.eab_international_ind,
    agg2.eab_military_veteran_ind,
    agg2.alumni_relation_ind,
    agg2.eab_alumni_relation_ind,
    agg2.eab_ethnicity,
    agg2.hispanic_ind,
    agg2.ethnicity,
    agg2.campus_visit_cnt,
    agg2.campus_visit_ind,
    agg2.first_campus_visit_dt,
    agg2.last_campus_visit_dt,
    agg2.eab_campus_visit_ind,
    agg2.mail_optout_ind,
    agg2.eab_mail_optout_ind,
    agg2.email_optout_ind,
    agg2.phone_optout_ind,
    agg2.sms_optin_ind,
    agg2.sms_optout_ind,
    agg2.eab_email_optout_ind,
    agg2.eab_phone_optout_ind,
    agg2.eab_sms_optin_ind,
    agg2.eab_opt_out_ind,
    agg2.opt_out_ind,
    agg2.intake_dt

from (
select agg.*,
row_number() over(partition by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.partner_system_name
				  order by agg.intake_dt desc nulls last) as rn
from (

select distinct
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as primary_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(stud.partner_system_name,'primary'),'[\\s]','')),'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(<partnercontact_id.crm_ug>,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.crm_ug>,'[\\s]','')),'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,
			
stud.sis_student_id,
stud.crm_student_id,
stud.other_student_id,
			
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(stud.first_name,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as fname,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(stud.middle_name,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as mname,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(stud.last_name,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as lname,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(stud.preferred_first_name,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as preferred_fname,
stud.us_citizenship_status as us_citizenship_status,
stud.international_indicator as international_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud.birth_date,1,19)) as birth_dt,
stud.gender,
stud.preferred_gender as pref_gender,
stud.religious_affiliation as religious_affiliation,
substr(try_to_date(stud.high_school_grad_year,'yyyy'),1,4) as hs_grad_year,
stud.origin_source_code as origin_source,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud.origin_source_date,1,19)) as origin_source_dt,
stud.first_generation_indicator as first_gen_ind,
stud.military_service_or_veteran_status as military_service_status,

case when pcm_first_gen.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_first_gen.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_first_gen_ind,

pcm_pref_gen.eab_standard_value as eab_pref_gender,

case when pcm_int_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_int_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_international_ind,

case when pcm_mil_vet_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_mil_vet_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_military_veteran_ind,

stud.alumni_relationship_indicator as alumni_relation_ind,

case when pcm_alum_rel_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_alum_rel_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_alumni_relation_ind,

pcm_ethn.eab_standard_value as eab_ethnicity,
stud.hispanic_indicator as hispanic_ind,
stud.ethnicity,

/*2023-12-01: we are agging all event date data from both Student.fulfillment and Student Events.final in a left joined table below
and pulling from that to populate campus visit fields as completely as possible*/
event_agg.event_ct as campus_visit_cnt,
case when event_agg.primary_student_id_ev is not null then 'TRUE' else stud.campus_visit_indicator end as campus_visit_ind,
event_agg.min_event_date as first_campus_visit_dt,
event_agg.max_event_date as last_campus_visit_dt,

case when event_agg.primary_student_id_ev is not null
then try_to_boolean(true)
when pcm_campus_visit_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_campus_visit_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_campus_visit_ind,

stud.mail_opt_out_indicator as mail_optout_ind,

case when pcm_mail_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_mail_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_mail_optout_ind,

stud.email_opt_out_indicator as email_optout_ind,
stud.phone_opt_out_indicator as phone_optout_ind,
stud.sms_opt_in_indicator as sms_optin_ind,
stud.sms_opt_out_indicator as sms_optout_ind,

case when pcm_email_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_email_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_email_optout_ind,

case when pcm_phone_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_phone_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_phone_optout_ind,

case when pcm_sms_optin_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_sms_optin_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_sms_optin_ind,

case
when pcm_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_opt_out_ind,

stud.opt_out_indicator_general as opt_out_ind,
stud.intake_date as intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student].{fulfillment}> stud

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_first_gen
on (pcm_first_gen.field_name = 'eab_first_gen_ind'
and coalesce(stud.first_generation_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_first_gen.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_pref_gen
on (pcm_pref_gen.field_name = 'eab_pref_gender'
and coalesce(stud.preferred_gender,'') = coalesce(pcm_pref_gen.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_int_ind
on (pcm_int_ind.field_name = 'eab_international_ind'
and coalesce(stud.international_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_int_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_mil_vet_ind
on (pcm_mil_vet_ind.field_name = 'eab_military_veteran_ind'
and coalesce(stud.military_service_or_veteran_status,'') = coalesce(pcm_mil_vet_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_alum_rel_ind
on (pcm_alum_rel_ind.field_name = 'eab_alumni_relation_ind'
and coalesce(stud.alumni_relationship_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_alum_rel_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_ethn
on (pcm_ethn.field_name = 'eab_ethnicity'
and coalesce(stud.ethnicity,'') = coalesce(pcm_ethn.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_campus_visit_ind
on (pcm_campus_visit_ind.field_name = 'eab_campus_visit_ind'
and coalesce(stud.campus_visit_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_campus_visit_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_mail_optout_ind
on (pcm_mail_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_mail_optout_ind'
and coalesce(stud.mail_opt_out_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_mail_optout_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_email_optout_ind
on (pcm_email_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_email_optout_ind'
and coalesce(stud.email_opt_out_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_email_optout_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_phone_optout_ind
on (pcm_phone_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_phone_optout_ind'
and coalesce(stud.phone_opt_out_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_phone_optout_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_sms_optin_ind
on (pcm_sms_optin_ind.field_name = 'eab_sms_optin_ind'
and coalesce(stud.sms_opt_in_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_sms_optin_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_optout_ind
on (pcm_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_opt_out_ind'
and coalesce(stud.opt_out_indicator_general,'') = coalesce(pcm_optout_ind.partner_value,''))

<join_extension.Student>

where <where_statement>
) agg
where coalesce(agg.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(agg.partner_system_name,'') <> ''

)agg2
where agg2.rn = 1

queryResults.querySql:
select * from (
select distinct
stud.primary_student_id,
stud.sis_student_id,
stud.eab_student_id,
stud.crm_student_id,
stud.other_student_id,
trim(regexp_replace(stud.first_name,'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]','')) as fname,
trim(regexp_replace(stud.middle_name,'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]','')) as mname,
trim(regexp_replace(stud.last_name,'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]','')) as lname,
trim(regexp_replace(stud.preferred_first_name,'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]','')) as preferred_fname,
stud.us_citizenship_status as us_citizenship_status,
stud.international_indicator as international_ind,
try_to_timestamp(stud.birth_date) as birth_dt,
stud.gender,
stud.preferred_gender as pref_gender,
stud.religious_affiliation as religious_affiliation,
substr(try_to_date(stud.high_school_grad_year,'yyyy'),1,4) as hs_grad_year,
stud.origin_source_code as origin_source,
try_to_timestamp(stud.origin_source_date) as origin_source_dt,
stud.first_generation_indicator as first_gen_ind,
stud.military_service_or_veteran_status as military_service_status,

case when pcm_first_gen.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_first_gen.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_first_gen_ind,

pcm_pref_gen.eab_standard_value as eab_pref_gender,

case when pcm_int_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_int_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_international_ind,

case when pcm_mil_vet_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_mil_vet_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_military_veteran_ind,

stud.alumni_relationship_indicator as alumni_relation_ind,

case when pcm_alum_rel_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_alum_rel_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_alumni_relation_ind,

pcm_ethn.eab_standard_value as eab_ethnicity,
stud.hispanic_indicator as hispanic_ind,
stud.ethnicity,
stud.campus_visit_count as campus_visit_cnt,
stud.campus_visit_indicator as campus_visit_ind,
try_to_timestamp(stud.first_campus_visit_date) as first_campus_visit_dt,
try_to_timestamp(stud.most_recent_campus_visit_date) as last_campus_visit_dt,

case when pcm_campus_visit_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_campus_visit_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_campus_visit_ind,

stud.mail_opt_out_indicator as mail_optout_ind,

case when pcm_mail_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_mail_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_mail_optout_ind,

stud.email_opt_out_indicator as email_optout_ind,
stud.phone_opt_out_indicator as phone_optout_ind,
stud.sms_opt_in_indicator as sms_optin_ind,
stud.sms_opt_out_indicator as sms_optout_ind,

case when pcm_email_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_email_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_email_optout_ind,

then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_phone_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_phone_optout_ind,

then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_sms_optin_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_sms_optin_ind,
  
case 
when spring_summer_2023_admits.st_primary_student_id is not null then 'true'
----TO MARK CULINARY ADMITS AS OPT OUTS (SPECIFICALLY FOR DSM CAMPAIGN)---lharbaugh 02/13/2023
when STUD.CALCULATED_FIELD_1 ='Y' then 'true'
when pcm_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_opt_out_ind,  
  
stud.opt_out_indicator_general as opt_out_ind,
stud.intake_date as intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student].{fulfillment}> stud

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_first_gen
on (pcm_first_gen.field_name = 'eab_first_gen_ind'
and coalesce(stud.first_generation_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_first_gen.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_pref_gen
on (pcm_pref_gen.field_name = 'eab_pref_gender'
and coalesce(stud.preferred_gender,'') = coalesce(pcm_pref_gen.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_int_ind
on (pcm_int_ind.field_name = 'eab_international_ind'
and coalesce(stud.international_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_int_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_mil_vet_ind
on (pcm_mil_vet_ind.field_name = 'eab_military_veteran_ind'
and coalesce(stud.military_service_or_veteran_status,'') = coalesce(pcm_mil_vet_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_alum_rel_ind
on (pcm_alum_rel_ind.field_name = 'eab_alumni_relation_ind'
and coalesce(stud.alumni_relationship_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_alum_rel_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_ethn
on (pcm_ethn.field_name = 'eab_ethnicity'
and coalesce(stud.ethnicity,'') = coalesce(pcm_ethn.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_campus_visit_ind
on (pcm_campus_visit_ind.field_name = 'eab_campus_visit_ind'
and coalesce(stud.campus_visit_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_campus_visit_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_mail_optout_ind
on (pcm_mail_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_mail_optout_ind'
and coalesce(stud.mail_opt_out_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_mail_optout_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_email_optout_ind
on (pcm_email_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_email_optout_ind'
and coalesce(stud.email_opt_out_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_email_optout_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_phone_optout_ind
on (pcm_phone_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_phone_optout_ind'
and coalesce(stud.phone_opt_out_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_phone_optout_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_sms_optin_ind
on (pcm_sms_optin_ind.field_name = 'eab_sms_optin_ind'
and coalesce(stud.sms_opt_in_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_sms_optin_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_optout_ind
on (pcm_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_opt_out_ind'
and coalesce(stud.opt_out_indicator_general,'') = coalesce(pcm_optout_ind.partner_value,''))
														   
left outer join (
  select st.primary_student_id as st_primary_student_id
  from <[Enroll360].[Student Term].{final}> as st
  where 1=1
  and eab_entry_year_academic = '2023'
  and eab_entry_term in ('Spring','Summer')
  and eab_current_funnel_status = 'Uncommitted Admit'
) spring_summer_2023_admits
   on stud.primary_student_id = spring_summer_2023_admits.st_primary_student_id	
														   
where <where_statement>
) x
where x.primary_student_id is not null

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

case when pcm_first_gen.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'

pcm_pref_gen.eab_standard_value as eab_pref_gender,

case when pcm_int_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'

stud.alumni_relationship_indicator as alumni_relation_ind,

case when pcm_alum_rel_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_alum_rel_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_alumni_relation_ind,

pcm_ethn.eab_standard_value as eab_ethnicity,
stud.hispanic_indicator as hispanic_ind,
stud.ethnicity,

event_agg.event_ct as campus_visit_cnt,
case when event_agg.primary_student_id_ev is not null then 'TRUE' else stud.campus_visit_indicator end as campus_visit_ind,
event_agg.min_event_date as first_campus_visit_dt,
event_agg.max_event_date as last_campus_visit_dt,

case when event_agg.primary_student_id_ev is not null
then try_to_boolean(true)
when pcm_campus_visit_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'

/*6-22-2023: opt out info is only in ug_other file, all students in ug_other are an opt out*/

case when stud_other.crm_student_id is not null

stud.phone_opt_out_indicator as phone_optout_ind,
stud.sms_opt_in_indicator as sms_optin_ind,
stud.sms_opt_out_indicator as sms_optout_ind,

/*case when pcm_email_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null

end as eab_email_optout_ind,*/

case when pcm_phone_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'

case when pcm_sms_optin_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'

end as eab_sms_optin_ind,

--stud.opt_out_indicator_general as opt_out_ind,
case when stud_other.crm_student_id is not null
then 'true'
else 'false' end as opt_out_ind,

stud.intake_date as intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student].{fulfillment_ug_inquiries}> stud

	select distinct crm_student_id, other_student_id

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_pref_gen

and coalesce(stud.preferred_gender,'') = coalesce(pcm_pref_gen.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_int_ind
on (pcm_int_ind.field_name = 'eab_international_ind'
and coalesce(stud.international_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_int_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_mil_vet_ind
on (pcm_mil_vet_ind.field_name = 'eab_military_veteran_ind'
and coalesce(stud.military_service_or_veteran_status,'') = coalesce(pcm_mil_vet_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_alum_rel_ind

and coalesce(stud.alumni_relationship_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_alum_rel_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_ethn
on (pcm_ethn.field_name = 'eab_ethnicity'
and coalesce(stud.ethnicity,'') = coalesce(pcm_ethn.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_campus_visit_ind
on (pcm_campus_visit_ind.field_name = 'eab_campus_visit_ind'
and coalesce(stud.campus_visit_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_campus_visit_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_mail_optout_ind
on (pcm_mail_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_mail_optout_ind'
and coalesce(stud.mail_opt_out_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_mail_optout_ind.partner_value,''))

/*left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_email_optout_ind

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_phone_optout_ind

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_sms_optin_ind

and coalesce(stud.sms_opt_in_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_sms_optin_ind.partner_value,''))

/*left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_optout_ind
on (pcm_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_opt_out_ind'

<join_extension.Student>

where <where_statement>

) agg2

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.
setOpInterfaceDistinctness.migrationReason: 5.1.4 surfaces duplicate unaliased select-list output names in a set-op branch and the resulting interface-width miscount; authors should add distinct AS aliases — not a parser regression vs silent 5.0.0-3

queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-02-23: moved events join to join extension, note we are bringing in opt out ind from ug inqs 
but it doesn't look like we are using it for eab_opt_out_ind (not connected to PCM join) - ccreekman*/

added variables: <join_extension.Student>, partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-03-25: added eab_student_id_type - ccreekman*/
/*2025-03-04: on tenant query due to left join to ug_inqs to bring in citizenship to app records. - ccreekman
removed: 2023 DSM opt out logic, hardcoding on ug_app international_ind (moved to bindings), 
leaving: left join to inq citizenship, left join to PCM for eab_campus_visit_ind through inqs field. Code aggregating visit data makes this redundant, probably can be removed in future*/

select distinct * from (

select distinct
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as primary_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,

agg2.sis_student_id,
agg2.crm_student_id,
agg2.other_student_id,

/*3-2-2023 Updated the name fields to remove problem characters. Copied from master student.final*/

nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(agg2.fname,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as fname,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(agg2.mname,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as mname,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(agg2.lname,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as lname,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(agg2.preferred_fname,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as preferred_fname,


agg2.us_citizenship_status,
agg2.international_ind,
agg2.birth_dt,
agg2.gender,
agg2.pref_gender,
agg2.religious_affiliation,
substr(try_to_date(agg2.hs_grad_year,'yyyy'),1,4) as hs_grad_year,
agg2.origin_source,
agg2.origin_source_dt,
agg2.first_gen_ind,
agg2.military_service_status,
agg2.eab_first_gen_ind,
agg2.eab_pref_gender,
agg2.eab_international_ind,
agg2.eab_military_veteran_ind,
agg2.alumni_relation_ind,
agg2.eab_alumni_relation_ind,
agg2.eab_ethnicity,
agg2.hispanic_ind,
agg2.ethnicity,
agg2.campus_visit_cnt,
agg2.campus_visit_ind,
agg2.first_campus_visit_dt,
agg2.last_campus_visit_dt,
agg2.eab_campus_visit_ind,
agg2.mail_optout_ind,
agg2.eab_mail_optout_ind,
agg2.email_optout_ind,
agg2.phone_optout_ind,
agg2.sms_optin_ind,
agg2.sms_optout_ind,
agg2.eab_email_optout_ind,
agg2.eab_phone_optout_ind,
agg2.eab_sms_optin_ind,
agg2.eab_opt_out_ind,
agg2.opt_out_ind,
agg2.intake_dt

from (

select agg.*,
row_number() over (partition by 
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''),  
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'')
  order by agg.rn, agg.intake_dt desc nulls last) rn2
from (

select distinct
1 as rn,
stud.primary_student_id,
stud.primary_student_id as eab_student_id,
lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(stud.partner_system_name,'primary'),'[\\s]','')) as eab_student_id_type,
<partnercontact_id.crm_ug> as partnercontact_id,
lower(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.crm_ug>,'[\\s]','')) as partner_system_name,

stud.sis_student_id,
stud.crm_student_id,
stud.other_student_id,
stud.first_name as fname,
stud.middle_name as mname,
stud.last_name as lname,
stud.preferred_first_name as preferred_fname,
stud_inq.us_citizenship_status as us_citizenship_status,
stud.international_indicator as international_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud.birth_date,1,19)) as birth_dt,
stud.gender,
stud.preferred_gender as pref_gender,
stud.religious_affiliation as religious_affiliation,
stud.high_school_grad_year as hs_grad_year,
stud.origin_source_code as origin_source,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud.origin_source_date,1,19)) as origin_source_dt,
stud.first_generation_indicator as first_gen_ind,
stud.military_service_or_veteran_status as military_service_status,

case when pcm_first_gen.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_first_gen.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_first_gen_ind,

pcm_pref_gen.eab_standard_value as eab_pref_gender,

case when pcm_int_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_int_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_international_ind,

case when pcm_mil_vet_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_mil_vet_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_military_veteran_ind,

stud.alumni_relationship_indicator as alumni_relation_ind,

case when pcm_alum_rel_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_alum_rel_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_alumni_relation_ind,

pcm_ethn.eab_standard_value as eab_ethnicity,
stud.hispanic_indicator as hispanic_ind,
stud.ethnicity,

event_agg.event_ct as campus_visit_cnt,
case when event_agg.primary_student_id_ev is not null then 'TRUE' else stud.campus_visit_indicator end as campus_visit_ind,
event_agg.min_event_date as first_campus_visit_dt,
event_agg.max_event_date as last_campus_visit_dt,

case when event_agg.primary_student_id_ev is not null
then try_to_boolean(true)
when pcm_campus_visit_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_campus_visit_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_campus_visit_ind,

stud.mail_opt_out_indicator as mail_optout_ind,

case when pcm_mail_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_mail_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_mail_optout_ind,

stud.email_opt_out_indicator as email_optout_ind,
stud.phone_opt_out_indicator as phone_optout_ind,
stud.sms_opt_in_indicator as sms_optin_ind,
stud.sms_opt_out_indicator as sms_optout_ind,

case when pcm_email_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_email_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_email_optout_ind,

case when pcm_phone_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_phone_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_phone_optout_ind,

case when pcm_sms_optin_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_sms_optin_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_sms_optin_ind,

case when pcm_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_opt_out_ind,

stud_inq.opt_out_indicator_general as opt_out_ind,
stud.intake_date as intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student].{fulfillment_ug_applicants}> stud
/*12-14-22: left join to ug_inqs to bring in fields that aren't present in ug_apps - ccreekman*/
left outer join (
  select primary_student_id as ugi_primary_student_id, opt_out_indicator_general,us_citizenship_status
  from <[Enroll360].[Student].{fulfillment_ug_inquiries}> stud_inq) stud_inq
on stud.primary_student_id = stud_inq.ugi_primary_student_id

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_first_gen
on (pcm_first_gen.field_name = 'eab_first_gen_ind'
and coalesce(stud.first_generation_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_first_gen.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_pref_gen
on (pcm_pref_gen.field_name = 'eab_pref_gender'
and coalesce(stud.preferred_gender,'') = coalesce(pcm_pref_gen.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_int_ind
on (pcm_int_ind.field_name = 'eab_international_ind'
and coalesce(stud.international_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_int_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_mil_vet_ind
on (pcm_mil_vet_ind.field_name = 'eab_military_veteran_ind'
and coalesce(stud.military_service_or_veteran_status,'') = coalesce(pcm_mil_vet_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_alum_rel_ind

and coalesce(stud.opt_out_indicator_general,'') = coalesce(pcm_optout_ind.partner_value,''))

/*campus visit agg data*/													   
left outer join 
	(
	select events2.primary_student_id, count(events2.primary_student_id) as event_ct, 
	min(events2.event_date) as min_event_date, max(events2.event_date) as max_event_date 
	from (
	select distinct * from (
	select se.primary_student_id, se.event_dt as event_date
	from <[Enroll360].[Student Events].{final}> as se
	union all
	select s.primary_student_id, try_to_timestamp(substring(s.first_campus_visit_date,1,19)) as event_date
	from <[Enroll360].[Student].{fulfillment}> as s
	union all
	select s.primary_student_id, try_to_timestamp(substring(s.MOST_RECENT_CAMPUS_VISIT_DATE,1,19)) as event_date
	from <[Enroll360].[Student].{fulfillment}> as s
	) events 
	where 1=1
	and events.event_date is not null
    ) events2
	group by primary_student_id
) event_agg
on stud.primary_student_id = event_agg.primary_student_id

<join_extension.Student>

where coalesce(x.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
/* 2026-02-10: updated for ESANALYTIC-56375, ID XWalk updates blang */
/*2025-08-08: eab_opt_out_ind logic edited to set Unmapped Value to null per ESANALYTIC-46889 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-22: edited to align with recent Master updates, join_extension and partnercontact_id partner_system_name - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-22: custom left join to opt out international students, logic dating back to at least 2024 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-03-25: added eab_student_id_type - ccreekman*/
/*2023-03-20: added left join to calc grad year from year on Student Term lharbaugh*/

select distinct * from (
select distinct
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as primary_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(stud.partner_system_name,'primary'),'[\\s]','')),'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(<partnercontact_id.crm_ug>,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.crm_ug>,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,
			
stud.sis_student_id,
stud.crm_student_id,
stud.other_student_id,
			
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(stud.first_name,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as fname,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(stud.middle_name,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as mname,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(stud.last_name,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as lname,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(stud.preferred_first_name,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as preferred_fname,
stud.us_citizenship_status as us_citizenship_status,
--stud.international_indicator as international_ind,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(stud.international_indicator,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as international_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud.birth_date,1,19)) as birth_dt,
stud.gender,
stud.preferred_gender as pref_gender,
stud.religious_affiliation as religious_affiliation,

--grad year calculated from student term

--substr(try_to_date(stud.high_school_grad_year,'yyyy'),1,4) as hs_grad_year,

case when coalesce(stud_term.max_year,1901) <> 1901
then substr(stud_term.max_year,1,4)
else substr(try_to_date(stud.high_school_grad_year,'yyyy'),1,4)
end as hs_grad_year,
						   
stud.origin_source_code as origin_source,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud.origin_source_date,1,19)) as origin_source_dt,
stud.first_generation_indicator as first_gen_ind,
stud.military_service_or_veteran_status as military_service_status,

case when pcm_first_gen.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_first_gen.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_first_gen_ind,

pcm_pref_gen.eab_standard_value as eab_pref_gender,

case when pcm_int_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_int_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_international_ind,

case when pcm_mil_vet_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_mil_vet_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_military_veteran_ind,

stud.alumni_relationship_indicator as alumni_relation_ind,

case when pcm_alum_rel_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_alum_rel_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_alumni_relation_ind,

pcm_ethn.eab_standard_value as eab_ethnicity,
stud.hispanic_indicator as hispanic_ind,
stud.ethnicity,

/*2023-12-01: we are agging all event date data from both Student.fulfillment and Student Events.final in a left joined table below
and pulling from that to populate campus visit fields as completely as possible*/
event_agg.event_ct as campus_visit_cnt,
case when event_agg.primary_student_id_ev is not null then 'TRUE' else stud.campus_visit_indicator end as campus_visit_ind,
event_agg.min_event_date as first_campus_visit_dt,
event_agg.max_event_date as last_campus_visit_dt,

case when event_agg.primary_student_id_ev is not null
then try_to_boolean(true)
when pcm_campus_visit_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_campus_visit_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_campus_visit_ind,

stud.mail_opt_out_indicator as mail_optout_ind,

case when pcm_mail_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_mail_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_mail_optout_ind,

stud.email_opt_out_indicator as email_optout_ind,
stud.phone_opt_out_indicator as phone_optout_ind,
stud.sms_opt_in_indicator as sms_optin_ind,
stud.sms_opt_out_indicator as sms_optout_ind,

case when pcm_email_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_email_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_email_optout_ind,

case when pcm_phone_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_phone_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_phone_optout_ind,

case when pcm_sms_optin_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_sms_optin_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_sms_optin_ind,

--custom logic to opt out all international students
case
when int_students.primary_student_id_int is not null 
then try_to_boolean(true)
when pcm_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_opt_out_ind,

stud.opt_out_indicator_general as opt_out_ind,
stud.intake_date as intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student].{fulfillment}> stud

--joining to Student Term to use in calculating grad_year						   
left outer join (
  select primary_student_id as primary_student_id_st, max(eab_entry_year_academic) as max_year 
  from <[Enroll360].[Student Term].{final}> a  
  where coalesce(eab_entry_year_academic,1901) <> 1901 
  group by primary_student_id
) stud_term	
on stud.primary_student_id = stud_term.primary_student_id_st

--left join to Student Term to identify and opt-out international students
left outer join (
  select st.primary_student_id as primary_student_id_int
  from <[Enroll360].[Student Term].{final}> as st
  where 1=1
  and student_type = 'IF'
) int_students
on stud.primary_student_id = int_students.primary_student_id_int

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_first_gen
on (pcm_first_gen.field_name = 'eab_first_gen_ind'
and coalesce(stud.first_generation_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_first_gen.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_pref_gen
on (pcm_pref_gen.field_name = 'eab_pref_gender'
and coalesce(stud.preferred_gender,'') = coalesce(pcm_pref_gen.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_int_ind
on (pcm_int_ind.field_name = 'eab_international_ind'
and coalesce(stud.international_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_int_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_mil_vet_ind
on (pcm_mil_vet_ind.field_name = 'eab_military_veteran_ind'
and coalesce(stud.military_service_or_veteran_status,'') = coalesce(pcm_mil_vet_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_alum_rel_ind
on (pcm_alum_rel_ind.field_name = 'eab_alumni_relation_ind'
and coalesce(stud.alumni_relationship_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_alum_rel_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_ethn
on (pcm_ethn.field_name = 'eab_ethnicity'
and coalesce(stud.ethnicity,'') = coalesce(pcm_ethn.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_campus_visit_ind
on (pcm_campus_visit_ind.field_name = 'eab_campus_visit_ind'
and coalesce(stud.campus_visit_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_campus_visit_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_mail_optout_ind
on (pcm_mail_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_mail_optout_ind'
and coalesce(stud.mail_opt_out_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_mail_optout_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_email_optout_ind
on (pcm_email_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_email_optout_ind'
and coalesce(stud.email_opt_out_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_email_optout_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_phone_optout_ind
on (pcm_phone_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_phone_optout_ind'
and coalesce(stud.phone_opt_out_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_phone_optout_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_sms_optin_ind
on (pcm_sms_optin_ind.field_name = 'eab_sms_optin_ind'
and coalesce(stud.sms_opt_in_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_sms_optin_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_optout_ind
on (pcm_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_opt_out_ind'
and coalesce(stud.opt_out_indicator_general,'') = coalesce(pcm_optout_ind.partner_value,''))

<join_extension.Student>

where <where_statement>
) x
where coalesce(x.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(x.partner_system_name,'') <> ''

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

WITH UNION_CTE AS
(  	SELECT
        ps.primary_student_id AS par_stu_hash_key,
		ps.primary_student_id,
		ps.sis_student_id,
		ps.partnercontact_id, -- Changed as part of ESAE-8042
		ps.partner_system_name, -- Changed as part of ESAE-8042
		ps.crm_student_id,
		ps.other_student_id,
		ps.fname,
		ps.mname,
		ps.lname,
		ps.preferred_fname,
		ps.us_citizenship_status,
		ps.international_ind,
		ps.birth_dt,
		ps.gender,
		ps.pref_gender,
		ps.religious_affiliation,
		ps.hs_grad_year,
		ps.origin_source,
		ps.origin_source_dt,
		ps.first_gen_ind,
		ps.military_service_status,
		ps.eab_first_gen_ind,
		ps.eab_pref_gender,
		ps.eab_international_ind,
		ps.eab_military_veteran_ind,
		ps.alumni_relation_ind,
		ps.eab_alumni_relation_ind,
		ps.eab_ethnicity,
		ps.hispanic_ind,
		ps.ethnicity,
		ps.campus_visit_cnt,
		ps.campus_visit_ind,
		ps.first_campus_visit_dt,
		ps.last_campus_visit_dt,
		ps.eab_campus_visit_ind,
		ps.mail_optout_ind,
		ps.eab_mail_optout_ind,
		ps.email_optout_ind,
		ps.phone_optout_ind,
		ps.sms_optin_ind,
		ps.sms_optout_ind,
		ps.eab_email_optout_ind,
		ps.eab_phone_optout_ind,
		ps.eab_sms_optin_ind,
		ps.eab_opt_out_ind,
		ps.opt_out_ind,
		ps.fin_aid_student_id,
		ps.intake_dt
  	FROM PDP_UG.PAR__STUDENT AS ps
  	LEFT JOIN <[Enroll360].[Student PDP Delivery].[Last Validated].{final}> AS es
	ON  ps.partnercontact_id = es.partnercontact_id -- Changed as part of ESAE-8042
	AND ps.partner_system_name = es.partner_system_name -- Changed as part of ESAE-8042
  	WHERE es.partnercontact_id IS NULL
    AND es.partner_system_name IS NULL
)
SELECT cte.*
FROM UNION_CTE AS cte
LEFT JOIN PDP_UG.mkt__data_deletion AS data_del
    ON cte.par_stu_hash_key = data_del.pdp_key
    AND LOWER(data_del.entity_name) = 'par__student'
    AND LOWER(data_del.removal_type) = 'hard_delete'
LEFT JOIN <[PDP_UG].[gdpr__record_deletion].{final}> AS gdpr
    ON cte.partnercontact_id = gdpr.partnercontact_id
   AND cte.partner_system_name = gdpr.partner_system_name
WHERE data_del.pdp_key IS NULL
AND gdpr.partnercontact_id IS NULL -- filter to avoid GDPR deleted records
AND gdpr.partner_system_name IS NULL

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

case when pcm_first_gen.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'

pcm_pref_gen.eab_standard_value as eab_pref_gender,

case when pcm_int_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_sms_optin_ind

	on sev.primary_student_id = stud.primary_student_id
where <where_statement>
) x
where x.primary_student_id is not null

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_phone_optout_ind

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_sms_optin_ind

and coalesce(stud.sms_opt_in_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_sms_optin_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_optout_ind
on (pcm_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_opt_out_ind'
and coalesce(stud.opt_out_indicator_general,'') = coalesce(pcm_optout_ind.partner_value,''))
														   
left outer join (
  select a.primary_student_id as primary_student_id_pace
  from <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application].{fulfillment}> a 
  where a.campus_location = 'PaCE'
  group by a.primary_student_id) pace
  on stud.primary_student_id = pace.primary_student_id_pace
									
left outer join 
    (
    select events2.primary_student_id, count(events2.primary_student_id) as event_ct, 
    min(events2.event_date) as min_event_date, max(events2.event_date) as max_event_date 
    from (
    	select distinct * from (
	    select se.primary_student_id, se.event_dt as event_date
    	from <[Enroll360].[Student Events].{final}> as se
	    union all
	    select s.primary_student_id, try_to_timestamp(s.first_campus_visit_date) as event_date

	    from <[Enroll360].[Student].{fulfillment}> as s
    	) events 
    where 1=1
    and events.event_date is not null
    ) events2
    group by primary_student_id
) event_agg
on stud.primary_student_id = event_agg.primary_student_id

<join_extension.Student>

where <where_statement>
) x

and coalesce(x.partner_system_name,'') <> ''

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
--select count(*), c.current_entry_year_as_calendar_year from (
select 
s.primary_student_id
, st.current_entry_year_as_calendar_year as curr_entry_year_academic
, st.current_entry_term as curr_entry_term
, st.student_type
, sa.zip_code as zip
, sa.state_or_province as state
, sa.country 
, international_indicator as international_ind
, st.inquiry_indicator as inquiry_ind
, sta.application_incomplete_indicator as app_submit_ind
, sta.application_completed_indicator as app_complete_ind
, sta.admit_indicator as admit_ind
, sta.deposit_confirmed_indicator as deposit_ind
, sta.enrollment_indicator as enroll_ind
from <[Enroll360].[Student].{fulfillment}> as s
join <[Enroll360].[Student Term].{fulfillment}> as st on s.primary_student_id = st.primary_student_id
left outer join 
(
select s.*, row_number() over (partition by primary_student_id order by address_type) rn
from <[Enroll360].[Student Address].{fulfillment}> as s
  ) sa on s.primary_student_id = sa.primary_student_id and sa.rn = 1
left outer join <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application].{fulfillment}> sta
	on s.primary_student_id = sta.primary_student_id
where 1=1
and sta.primary_student_id is not null
order by s.primary_student_id
, st.current_entry_year_as_calendar_year
, st.current_entry_term
--  ) c group by c.current_entry_year_as_calendar_year order by c.current_entry_year_as_calendar_year

            app_src.mailing_address_1 AS mailing_address_1,
