/*2026-06-10: updated to align with Atlas pilot query best practices. This query DOES NOT merge UG and FAO data.  -- ccreekman*/

WITH 
student_addr_sis_fao as (
    SELECT * from (
  SELECT distinct
  	null as join_partnercontact_id, /*used for merging records only; do not delete*/
	null as join_partner_system_name, /*used for merging records only; do not delete*/
	stud_addr.*,
  row_number() over(partition by stud_addr.partnercontact_id, stud_addr.partner_system_name
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.addr1,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.addr2,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.city,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.state,'')))
			--, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.county,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(left(stud_addr.zip,5),'')))
			--, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.eab_address_type,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.eab_country,'Unknown')))
		order by stud_addr.intake_dt desc nulls last, stud_addr.eab_address_type desc nulls last) as fao_rn

  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Address SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stud_addr

	where TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.addr1,'')) ||
	TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.addr2,'')) ||
	TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.city,'')) ||
	TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.state,'')) ||
	--TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.county,'')) ||
	TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.zip,'')) ||
	TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.eab_address_type,'')) ||
	TRIM(COALESCE(nullif(stud_addr.eab_country,'Unknown'),'')) <> ''
) agg
where 1=1
and agg.fao_rn = 1)

select * from (
select agg.*
, row_number() over (partition by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.partner_system_name
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(agg.addr1,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(agg.addr2,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(agg.city,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(agg.state,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(agg.county,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(agg.zip,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(agg.eab_address_type,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(agg.eab_country,'')))
		order by agg.intake_dt desc nulls last) pdp_delivery_rn
from (
SELECT
	crm_ug.primary_student_id, /*crm id*/

	sis_fao.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_sis,
    sis_fao.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
    crm_ug.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_crm,
    crm_ug.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_crm,
    <eab_student_id> AS eab_student_id, /*default: sis > crm; not passed to pdp_ug*/
    <eab_student_id_type> AS eab_student_id_type, /*default: sis > crm; not passed to pdp_ug*/

    sis_fao.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_sis,
    sis_fao.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_sis,
    crm_ug.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_crm,
    crm_ug.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_crm,
    <partnercontact_id> AS partnercontact_id, /*default: crm > join > sis*/
    <partner_system_name> AS partner_system_name, /*default: crm > join > sis*/

		crm_ug.addr1 AS addr1_crm,
		sis_fao.addr1 AS addr1_sis,
		<addr1> AS addr1,
		
		crm_ug.addr2 AS addr2_crm,
		sis_fao.addr2 AS addr2_sis,
		<addr2> AS addr2,
		
		crm_ug.city AS city_crm,
		sis_fao.city AS city_sis,
		<city> AS city,
		
		crm_ug.state AS state_crm,
		sis_fao.state AS state_sis,
		<state> AS state,
		
		crm_ug.county AS county_crm,
		sis_fao.county AS county_sis,
		<county> AS county,
		
		crm_ug.zip AS zip_crm,
		sis_fao.zip AS zip_sis,
		<zip> AS zip,
		
		crm_ug.country AS country_crm,
		sis_fao.country AS country_sis,
		<country> AS country,
		
        crm_ug.address_type AS address_type_crm,
		sis_fao.address_type AS address_type_sis,
		<address_type> AS address_type,
		
		crm_ug.eab_address_type AS eab_address_type_crm,
  		sis_fao.eab_address_type AS eab_address_type_sis,
  		<eab_address_type> as eab_address_type,
		
        crm_ug.eab_country AS eab_country_crm,
		sis_fao.eab_country AS eab_country_sis,
		<eab_country> AS eab_country,
		
		to_timestamp(crm_ug.intake_dt) AS intake_dt_crm,
		to_timestamp(sis_fao.intake_dt) AS intake_dt_sis,
		to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt
		
FROM student_addr_sis_fao as sis_fao

<join_extension.Student Address PDP Delivery>

where <where_statement.Student Address PDP Delivery>
and (coalesce(crm_ug.partnercontact_id,'') <> '' and coalesce(crm_ug.partner_system_name,'') <> '')
or (coalesce(sis_fao.partnercontact_id,'') <> '' and coalesce(sis_fao.partner_system_name,'') <> '')

) agg

) agg2
where agg2.pdp_delivery_rn = 1



/*2026-06-09: due to set up not using eab_address_type from crm which is nulling all address types, we are getting false failures on uniqueness. Updated to pull in crm values - ccreekman*/

join fields are in merge query, null placecholder fields added to this query

		coalesce(enr_addr_crm.eab_student_id_type,'primary') AS eab_student_id_type_crm,
		enr_addr_crm.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_crm,
		coalesce(enr_addr_crm.partner_system_name,'primary') AS partner_system_name_crm,
		enr_addr_crm.addr1 AS addr1_crm,

		enr_addr_crm.city AS city_crm,
		enr_addr_crm.state AS state_crm,
		enr_addr_crm.county AS county_crm,
		enr_addr_crm.zip AS zip_crm,
		enr_addr_crm.country AS country_crm,

queryResults.sqlPreview: /*2026-03-03: crm psname crossjoin now checks STerm to ensure we are populating pcID even if crm table does not have data, <partnercontact_id>,<partner_system_n…
queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-03-03: crm psname crossjoin now checks STerm to ensure we are populating pcID even if crm table does not have data, 
<partnercontact_id>,<partner_system_name> master bundle updated to choose ID in this order: crm ID from merged record > join ID from SIS record, SIS ID - ccreekman*/
/*2026-02-06: merge query notes - ccreekman
student_addr_sis_fao cte: takes all SIS data, appends any partner_system_name(s) that are present in CRM_UG Student Address.final
	Expectation is for one partner_system_name in CRM_UG Student Address.final, but set up to account for crm changes, other scenarios where there may be a mix of ID types
	Uses this to pull in only IDs from Xwalk that align with CRM_UG Student Address.final partner_system_name(s), excluding any irrelevant matching ID pairs
	if there are multiple CRM_UG Student Address.final partner_system_name(s), multiple rows per SIS record will be created
	deduping logic will exclude records with null join_partnercontact_id only if there is not a record with a populated join_partnercontact_id
	multiple records per student may still persist if they have unique populated join_partnercontact_id/join_partner_system_name values
	in that scenario resulting counts on this table may be inflated, need further examples to determine if we need to build in variables to allow customization here
main query: takes results from student_addr_sis_fao cte and does a full outer join to CRM_UG Student Address.final using the join ID / ID type / address fields (if populated)
	crm join currently in variables - unclear if we need that level of customization available
*/

WITH 
student_addr_sis_fao as (
    SELECT * from (
  SELECT distinct
  	id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id as join_partnercontact_id,
	id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name as join_partner_system_name,
	stud_addr.*,
  row_number() over(partition by stud_addr.partnercontact_id, stud_addr.partner_system_name
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.addr1,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.addr2,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.city,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.state,'')))
			--, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.county,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(left(stud_addr.zip,5),'')))
			--, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.eab_address_type,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.eab_country,'Unknown')))
		order by id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id, stud_addr.eab_address_type desc nulls last) as rn

  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Address SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stud_addr

  /*cross join below will associate current crm_ug partner_system_name(s) with SIS record to limit the IDs pulled from xwalk to relevent psnames
  join parcontID/psname will later only be populated when Xwalk has records where one ID pair is the parcontID/psname from this SIS data 
  and the other set has a psname that matches what we appended here
  eg: partner xwalk includes psnames of sis_01, sis_02, primary, crm_01 but crm tables only have ID psns of primary, crm_01 so only those are appended to the records*/ 
  CROSS JOIN (
  		select distinct partner_system_name as crm_ug_partner_system_name
		FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Address].[Last Validated].{final}> stud_addr_crm
		union
		select distinct partner_system_name as crm_ug_partner_system_name
		FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term].[Last Validated].{final}> stud_addr_crm
  		) crm_psn

  LEFT JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> id_xwalk
	on (stud_addr.partnercontact_id = id_xwalk.target_partnercontact_id
	and coalesce(stud_addr.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(id_xwalk.target_partner_system_name,'')
	and coalesce(crm_psn.CRM_UG_PARTNER_SYSTEM_NAME,'') = coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name,''))

	where TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.addr1,'')) ||
	TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.addr2,'')) ||
	TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.city,'')) ||
	TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.state,'')) ||
	TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.county,'')) ||
	TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.zip,'')) ||
	TRIM(COALESCE(stud_addr.eab_address_type,'')) ||
	TRIM(COALESCE(nullif(stud_addr.eab_country,'Unknown'),'')) <> ''
)agg
where 1=1
/*xwalk may have multiple id pairs which meet join criteria
	this criteria limits the result set to only allow necessary dupes
	[rn = 1]: to ensure at least one copy of the SIS record is retained regardless if there is a match in ID Xwalk
	[agg.join_partnercontact_id is not null]: any dupes with distinct partnercontact_id/partner_system_name*/

and (agg.join_partnercontact_id is not null or rn = 1) 
--and agg.join_partnercontact_id is null /*for troubleshooting - SIS records with no xwalk match*/
)

select distinct * from (
select distinct *
, row_number() over (partition by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.partner_system_name
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(agg.addr1,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(agg.addr2,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(agg.city,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(agg.state,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(agg.county,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(agg.zip,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(agg.address_type,'')))
			, LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(agg.eab_country,'')))
		order by agg.intake_dt desc nulls last) rn
from (
SELECT
	crm_ug.primary_student_id, /*crm id*/

	sis_fao.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_sis,
    sis_fao.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
    crm_ug.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_crm,
    crm_ug.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_crm,
    <eab_student_id> AS eab_student_id, /*default: sis > crm*/
    <eab_student_id_type> AS eab_student_id_type, /*default: sis > crm*/

    sis_fao.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_sis,
    sis_fao.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_sis,
    crm_ug.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_crm,
    crm_ug.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_crm,
    <partnercontact_id> AS partnercontact_id, /*default: crm > join > sis*/
    <partner_system_name> AS partner_system_name, /*default: crm > join > sis*/

		crm_ug.addr1 AS addr1_crm,
		sis_fao.addr1 AS addr1_sis,
		<addr1> AS addr1,
		
		crm_ug.addr2 AS addr2_crm,
		sis_fao.addr2 AS addr2_sis,
		<addr2> AS addr2,
		
		crm_ug.city AS city_crm,
		sis_fao.city AS city_sis,
		<city> AS city,
		
		crm_ug.state AS state_crm,
		sis_fao.state AS state_sis,
		<state> AS state,
		
		crm_ug.county AS county_crm,
		sis_fao.county AS county_sis,
		<county> AS county,
		
		crm_ug.zip AS zip_crm,
		sis_fao.zip AS zip_sis,
		<zip> AS zip,
		
		crm_ug.country AS country_crm,
		sis_fao.country AS country_sis,
		<country> AS country,
		
        crm_ug.address_type AS address_type_crm,
		sis_fao.address_type AS address_type_sis,
		<address_type> AS address_type,
		
		crm_ug.eab_address_type AS eab_address_type_crm,
  		sis_fao.eab_address_type AS eab_address_type_sis,
  		<eab_address_type> as eab_address_type,
		
        crm_ug.eab_country AS eab_country_crm,
		sis_fao.eab_country AS eab_country_sis,
		<eab_country> AS eab_country,
		
		to_timestamp(crm_ug.intake_dt) AS intake_dt_crm,
		to_timestamp(sis_fao.intake_dt) AS intake_dt_sis,
		to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt
		
FROM student_addr_sis_fao as sis_fao

<join_extension.Student Address PDP Delivery>

WHERE 
(coalesce(crm_ug.partnercontact_id,'') <> '' and coalesce(crm_ug.partner_system_name,'') <> '')
or (coalesce(sis_fao.partnercontact_id,'') <> '' and coalesce(sis_fao.partner_system_name,'') <> '')

) agg

) agg2
where agg2.rn = 1

order by 
	(agg2.partnercontact_id_crm||agg2.partnercontact_id_sis) nulls last, /*null in either field will return null, merged records (both fields populated) will come before non-merged records in results*/
	agg2.partnercontact_id_crm, agg2.intake_dt_crm, /*most recent non-merged UG records next*/
	agg2.partnercontact_id_sis, agg2.intake_dt_sis /*most recent non-merged FAO records next*/

queryResults.sqlPreview: WITH latest_applications AS ( SELECT app_ranked.id AS id, app_ranked.prospect_id AS prospect_id, app_ranked.updated_at AS updated_at, app_ranked.created_at AS c…
queryResults.querySql:
WITH
latest_applications AS (
    SELECT
        app_ranked.id AS id,
        app_ranked.prospect_id AS prospect_id,
        app_ranked.updated_at AS updated_at,
        app_ranked.created_at AS created_at,
        app_ranked.primary_email AS primary_email
    FROM (
        SELECT
            app_src.id AS id,
            app_src.prospect_id AS prospect_id,
            app_src.updated_at AS updated_at,
            app_src.created_at AS created_at,
            app_src.primary_email AS primary_email,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY app_src.prospect_id
                ORDER BY TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(app_src.updated_at) DESC NULLS LAST,
                TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(app_src.created_at) DESC NULLS LAST,
                TO_VARCHAR(app_src.id) DESC
            ) AS application_row_num
        FROM <[ECRM].[Applications].{fulfillment}> AS app_src
    ) AS app_ranked
    WHERE app_ranked.application_row_num = 1
)
SELECT
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_1,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_2,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_3,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_4,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_5,
	null as CALCULATED_ID_FIELD,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.primary_email)), '') AS "EMAIL_ADDRESS",
	1 AS EMAIL_RANK,
	p.intake_date AS INTAKE_DATE,
	'navigate_crm_1' AS PARTNER_SYSTEM_NAME,
	NULL AS POPULATION_NAME,
    NULL AS "EMAIL_TYPE",
    NULL AS "EMAIL_TYPE_EAB",
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.id)), '') AS "PRIMARY_STUDENT_ID"
FROM <[ECRM].[Prospects].{fulfillment}> AS p
JOIN latest_applications AS la
    ON la.prospect_id = p.id
<student_email_join_extension>				
WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.primary_email)), '') IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_1,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_2,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_3,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_4,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_5,
	null as CALCULATED_ID_FIELD,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.primary_email)), '') AS "EMAIL_ADDRESS",
	1 AS EMAIL_RANK,
	p.intake_date AS INTAKE_DATE,
	'navigate_crm_1' AS PARTNER_SYSTEM_NAME,
	NULL AS POPULATION_NAME,
    NULL AS "EMAIL_TYPE",
    NULL AS "EMAIL_TYPE_EAB",
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.id)), '') AS "PRIMARY_STUDENT_ID"
FROM <[ECRM].[Prospects].{fulfillment}> AS p
<student_email_join_extension>
WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.primary_email)), '') IS NOT NULL

queryResults.querySql:
/*10-9-2024: tenant query created for DDM Email Prioritization pilot partners, see ESANALYTIC-41787 - ccreekman*/
/*9-30-2024: updated with new Project Atlas fields plus email_rank for ESANALYTIC-41787 - ccreekman*/
/*8-26-2024: email_exclusion variable is live - ccreekman*/

select * from (

select distinct
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as primary_student_id,
agg.email,
agg.email_type,
agg.email_rank,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
agg.eab_student_id_type,
agg.eab_email_type,
agg.email_optout_ind,
agg.eab_email_optout_ind,
agg.intake_dt

from (

--Email set 1
select distinct
stud_email.primary_student_id,
stud_email.email_address as email,

case when pcm_email_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then 'Unknown'
else pcm_email_type.eab_standard_value
end as email_type,
email_rank as email_rank,
stud_email.primary_student_id as eab_student_id,
null as eab_student_id_type,
<eab_email_type> as eab_email_type,
null as email_optout_ind,
null as eab_email_optout_ind,
stud_email.intake_date as intake_dt


from <[Enroll360].[Student Email].{fulfillment}> stud_email

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_email_type
on (pcm_email_type.field_name = 'email_type'
and coalesce(stud_email.email_type,'') = coalesce(pcm_email_type.partner_value,''))
												  
where <where_statement>

union all

--Email set 2
select distinct
stud_email.primary_student_id,
stud_email.calculated_field_1 as email,

case when pcm_email_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then 'Unknown'
else pcm_email_type.eab_standard_value
end as email_type,
null as email_rank, /*email sets 2 & 3 cannot be considered primary so do not have email rank data*/
stud_email.primary_student_id as eab_student_id,
null as eab_student_id_type,
<eab_email_type> as eab_email_type,
null as email_optout_ind,
null as eab_email_optout_ind,
stud_email.intake_date as intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student Email].{fulfillment}> stud_email

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_email_type
on (pcm_email_type.field_name = 'email_type'
and coalesce(stud_email.calculated_field_2,'') = coalesce(pcm_email_type.partner_value,''))

where <where_statement>

union all

--Email set 3
select distinct
stud_email.primary_student_id,
stud_email.calculated_field_3 as email,

case when pcm_email_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then 'Unknown'
else pcm_email_type.eab_standard_value
end as email_type,
null as email_rank, /*email sets 2 & 3 cannot be considered primary so do not have email rank data*/
stud_email.primary_student_id as eab_student_id,
null as eab_student_id_type,
<eab_email_type> as eab_email_type,
null as email_optout_ind,
null as eab_email_optout_ind,
stud_email.intake_date as intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student Email].{fulfillment}> stud_email

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_email_type
on (pcm_email_type.field_name = 'email_type'
and coalesce(stud_email.calculated_field_4,'') = coalesce(pcm_email_type.partner_value,''))

where <where_statement>

) agg

where coalesce(trim(agg.email),'') <> ''
and len(agg.email) <= 64

) agg2
where coalesce(agg2.primary_student_id,'') <> ''
and <email_exclusion>

/*10-9-2024: tenant query created for DDM Email Prioritization pilot partners, see ESANALYTIC-41787 - ccreekman*/
/*9-30-2024: updated with new Project Atlas fields plus email_rank for ESANALYTIC-41787 - ccreekman*/
/*8-26-2024: email_exclusion variable is live - ccreekman*/

select * from (

select distinct
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as primary_student_id,
agg.email,
agg.email_type,
agg.email_rank,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
agg.eab_student_id_type,
agg.eab_email_type,
agg.email_optout_ind,
agg.eab_email_optout_ind,
agg.intake_dt

from (

--Email set 1
select distinct
stud_email.primary_student_id,
stud_email.email_address as email,

case when pcm_email_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then 'Unknown'
else pcm_email_type.eab_standard_value
end as email_type,
email_rank as email_rank,
stud_email.primary_student_id as eab_student_id,
null as eab_student_id_type,
<eab_email_type> as eab_email_type,
null as email_optout_ind,
null as eab_email_optout_ind,
stud_email.intake_date as intake_dt


from <[Enroll360].[Student Email].{fulfillment}> stud_email

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_email_type
on (pcm_email_type.field_name = 'email_type'
and coalesce(stud_email.email_type,'') = coalesce(pcm_email_type.partner_value,''))
												  
where <where_statement>

union all

--Email set 2
select distinct
stud_email.primary_student_id,
stud_email.calculated_field_1 as email,

case when pcm_email_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then 'Unknown'
else pcm_email_type.eab_standard_value
end as email_type,
null as email_rank, /*email sets 2 & 3 cannot be considered primary so do not have email rank data*/
stud_email.primary_student_id as eab_student_id,
null as eab_student_id_type,
<eab_email_type> as eab_email_type,
null as email_optout_ind,
null as eab_email_optout_ind,
stud_email.intake_date as intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student Email].{fulfillment}> stud_email

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_email_type
on (pcm_email_type.field_name = 'email_type'
and coalesce(stud_email.calculated_field_2,'') = coalesce(pcm_email_type.partner_value,''))

where <where_statement>

union all

--Email set 3
select distinct
stud_email.primary_student_id,
stud_email.calculated_field_3 as email,

case when pcm_email_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then 'Unknown'
else pcm_email_type.eab_standard_value
end as email_type,
null as email_rank, /*email sets 2 & 3 cannot be considered primary so do not have email rank data*/
stud_email.primary_student_id as eab_student_id,
null as eab_student_id_type,
<eab_email_type> as eab_email_type,
null as email_optout_ind,
null as eab_email_optout_ind,
stud_email.intake_date as intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student Email].{fulfillment}> stud_email

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_email_type
on (pcm_email_type.field_name = 'email_type'
and coalesce(stud_email.calculated_field_4,'') = coalesce(pcm_email_type.partner_value,''))

where <where_statement>

) agg

where coalesce(trim(agg.email),'') <> ''
and len(agg.email) <= 64

) agg2
where coalesce(agg2.primary_student_id,'') <> ''
and <email_exclusion>

queryResults.querySql:
WITH
hs_education AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.prospect_id)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.id)), '')) AS id,
        inst.ceeb_code AS ceeb_code,
        inst.name AS name,
        inst.city AS city,
        inst.state AS state,
        aer.class_rank_percent AS class_rank_percent,
        aer.class_rank AS class_rank,
        aer.class_size AS class_size,
        aer.cgpa_recalculated AS cgpa_recalculated,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(aer.cgpa)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(aer.gpa)), ''),NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.high_school_gpa)), '')) AS hs_gpa_nbr,
        aer.gpa_scale AS gpa_scale,
		p.intake_date
    FROM <[ECRM].[Application Education Records].{fulfillment}> AS aer
    JOIN <[ECRM].[Applications].{fulfillment}> AS app
        ON app.id = aer.application_id
    JOIN <[ECRM].[Prospects].{fulfillment}> AS p
        ON p.id = app.prospect_id
    JOIN <[ECRM].[Institutions].{fulfillment}> AS inst
        ON inst.id = aer.institution_id
    WHERE <student_high_school_where>
)
SELECT
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_1,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_10,																			  
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_2,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_3,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_4,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_5,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_6,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_7,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_8,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_9,
	null as CALCULATED_ID_FIELD,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.ceeb_code)), '') AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB_CODE",
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.city)), '') AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_CITY",
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.class_rank)), '') AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_CLASS_RANK",
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.class_rank_percent)), '') AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_CLASS_RANK_PERCENTILE",
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.class_size)), '') AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_CLASS_SIZE",
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.hs_gpa_nbr)), '') AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_GPA",
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.name)), '') AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_NAME",
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.gpa_scale)), '') AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_SCALE",
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.state)), '') AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_STATE",
	p.intake_date as INTAKE_DATE,
	'navigate_crm_1' as PARTNER_SYSTEM_NAME,
	null as POPULATION_NAME,
    p.id AS "PRIMARY_STUDENT_ID",
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.cgpa_recalculated)), '') AS "RECALCULATED_HIGH_SCHOOL_GPA"
FROM hs_education AS p
<student_high_school_join_extension>
WHERE p.id IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_1,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_10,																			  
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_2,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_3,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_4,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_5,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_6,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_7,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_8,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_9,
	null as CALCULATED_ID_FIELD,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(inst.ceeb_code)), '') AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB_CODE",
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(inst.city)), '') AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_CITY",
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_CLASS_RANK",
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_CLASS_RANK_PERCENTILE",
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_CLASS_SIZE",
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.high_school_gpa)), '') AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_GPA",
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(inst.name)), '') AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_NAME",
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_SCALE",
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(inst.state)), '') AS "HIGH_SCHOOL_STATE",
	p.intake_date as INTAKE_DATE,
	'navigate_crm_1' as PARTNER_SYSTEM_NAME,
	null as POPULATION_NAME,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.id)), '') AS "PRIMARY_STUDENT_ID",
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "RECALCULATED_HIGH_SCHOOL_GPA"
FROM <[ECRM].[Prospects].{fulfillment}> AS p
JOIN <[ECRM].[Institutions].{fulfillment}> AS inst
    ON inst.id = p.last_high_school_id
<student_high_school_join_extension>				
WHERE p.last_high_school_id IS NOT NULL
  and <student_high_school_where>

/*******************************************************/
/*2025-11-26: adding partner system name functionality, variables, updated join - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-18: added <join_extension.Student High School> - ccreekman*/
/*2025-06-19: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*//*2025-06-19: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/

select * from (

select distinct 
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as primary_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,
case 
	when agg.hs_ceeb_cd is not null 
		and length(ltrim(rtrim(agg.hs_ceeb_cd))) = 6 -- 6 digits long
		and try_to_numeric(agg.hs_ceeb_cd) not like '%.%'  -- no periods
		and try_to_numeric(agg.hs_ceeb_cd) then cast(agg.hs_ceeb_cd as varchar) -- is castable to a number
	else null 
	end as hs_ceeb_cd,
agg.hs_name,
agg.hs_city,
agg.hs_state,
agg.hs_class_rank_pct,
agg.hs_class_rank,
agg.hs_class_size,
agg.hs_cum_gpa_recalc,
agg.hs_gpa_nbr,
agg.hs_gpa_scale,
agg.intake_dt

from (

--High school set 1
select distinct
stud_hs.primary_student_id,
stud_hs.primary_student_id as eab_student_id,
lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(stud_hs.partner_system_name,'primary'),'[\\s]','')) as eab_student_id_type,
<partnercontact_id.crm_ug> as partnercontact_id,
lower(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.crm_ug>,'[\\s]','')) as partner_system_name,

case when stud_hs.high_school_ceeb_code is not null then lpad(try_to_numeric(stud_hs.high_school_ceeb_code),6,'0') else null end as hs_ceeb_cd,
sra.calculated_field_11 as hs_name,
stud_hs.high_school_city as hs_city,
stud_hs.high_school_state as hs_state,
stud_hs.high_school_class_rank_percentile as hs_class_rank_pct,
stud_hs.high_school_class_rank as hs_class_rank,
stud_hs.high_school_class_size as hs_class_size,
stud_hs.recalculated_high_school_gpa as hs_cum_gpa_recalc,
stud_hs.high_school_gpa as hs_gpa_nbr,
stud_hs.high_school_scale as hs_gpa_scale,
stud_hs.intake_date as intake_dt
  
from <[Enroll360].[Student High School].{fulfillment}> as stud_hs

<join_extension.Student High School>

where <where_statement>

union all

--High school set 2
select distinct
stud_hs.primary_student_id,
stud_hs.primary_student_id as eab_student_id,
lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(stud_hs.partner_system_name,'primary'),'[\\s]','')) as eab_student_id_type,
<partnercontact_id.crm_ug> as partnercontact_id,
lower(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.crm_ug>,'[\\s]','')) as partner_system_name,

case when stud_hs.calculated_field_1 is not null then lpad(try_to_numeric(stud_hs.calculated_field_1),6,'0') else null end as hs_ceeb_cd,
stud_hs.calculated_field_2 as hs_name,
stud_hs.calculated_field_3 as hs_city,
stud_hs.calculated_field_4 as hs_state,
stud_hs.calculated_field_5 as hs_class_rank_pct,
stud_hs.calculated_field_6 as hs_class_rank,
stud_hs.calculated_field_7 as hs_class_size,
stud_hs.calculated_field_8 as hs_cum_gpa_recalc,
stud_hs.calculated_field_9 as hs_gpa_nbr,
stud_hs.calculated_field_10 as hs_gpa_scale,
stud_hs.intake_date as intake_dt
  
from <[Enroll360].[Student High School].{fulfillment}> as stud_hs

<join_extension.Student High School>

where <where_statement>

) agg

where coalesce(agg.hs_ceeb_cd,'') ||
coalesce(agg.hs_name,'') ||
coalesce(agg.hs_city,'') ||
coalesce(agg.hs_state,'') ||
coalesce(agg.hs_class_rank_pct,'') ||
coalesce(agg.hs_class_rank,'') ||
coalesce(agg.hs_class_size,'') ||
coalesce(agg.hs_cum_gpa_recalc,'') ||
coalesce(agg.hs_gpa_nbr,'') ||
coalesce(agg.hs_gpa_scale,'') <> ''
) agg2
where coalesce(agg2.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(agg2.partner_system_name,'') <> ''

queryResults.sqlPreview: /*2026-04-06: updated eab_class_rank to decimal to support percentile values - ccreekman*/ /*2026-03-10: updated eab gpa fields from to_number(field) to try_to_…
queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-04-06: updated eab_class_rank to decimal to support percentile values - ccreekman*/
/*2026-03-10: updated eab gpa fields from to_number(field) to try_to_decimal(field,10,2). EAB GPA numbers were being rounded to integers. Currently par query sources from hs_gpa_nbr though 
added <eab_hs_gpa> variable and updated <hs_gpa_nbr> variable as eab_hs_gpa is not being pulled into par currently, both now default in bundle to
	COALESCE(to_varchar(eab_hs_gpa_sis), hs_gpa_nbr_sis,hs_gpa_nbr_crm). Which may be updated in future if par intake queries are updated to ingest eab_hs_gpa
- ccreekman*/
/*2026-03-03: <partnercontact_id>,<partner_system_name> master bundle updated to choose ID in this order: crm ID from merged record > join ID from SIS record, SIS ID 
join fields are in merge query, null placecholder fields added to this query - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-07: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473; corrected incomplete where statement - ccreekman*/

WITH stud_high_sch_crm AS 
(
	SELECT
		high_sch_crm.primary_student_id AS primary_student_id_crm,
		high_sch_crm.eab_student_id as eab_student_id_crm,
  		high_sch_crm.eab_student_id_type as eab_student_id_type_crm,
		high_sch_crm.partnercontact_id as partnercontact_id_crm,
  		high_sch_crm.partner_system_name as partner_system_name_crm,

		high_sch_crm.hs_gpa_scale AS hs_gpa_scale_crm,
		high_sch_crm.hs_ceeb_cd AS hs_ceeb_cd_crm,
		high_sch_crm.hs_name AS hs_name_crm,
		high_sch_crm.hs_city AS hs_city_crm,
		high_sch_crm.hs_state AS hs_state_crm,
		high_sch_crm.hs_class_rank_pct AS hs_class_rank_pct_crm,
		high_sch_crm.hs_class_rank AS hs_class_rank_crm,
		high_sch_crm.hs_class_size AS hs_class_size_crm,
		high_sch_crm.hs_cum_gpa_recalc AS hs_cum_gpa_recalc_crm,
		high_sch_crm.hs_gpa_nbr AS hs_gpa_nbr_crm,
		high_sch_crm.intake_dt AS intake_dt_crm,
		null as join_partnercontact_id,
		null as join_partner_system_name

--select *
	FROM <[Enroll360].[Student High School].[Last Validated].{final}> as high_sch_crm
)
SELECT
		hs_crm.primary_student_id_crm AS primary_student_id,

		hs_crm.eab_student_id_crm,
		hs_sis.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_sis,
		<eab_student_id> AS eab_student_id, /*default: sis > crm*/

		hs_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm,
		hs_sis.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
		<eab_student_id_type> AS eab_student_id_type, /*default: sis > crm*/

		hs_crm.partnercontact_id_crm,
		hs_sis.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_sis,
		<partnercontact_id> AS partnercontact_id, /*default: crm > join > sis*/	

		hs_crm.partner_system_name_crm,
		hs_sis.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_sis, 
		<partner_system_name> AS partner_system_name, /*default: crm > join > sis*/

		hs_crm.hs_gpa_scale_crm AS hs_gpa_scale,
		hs_sis.self_reported_gpa,
		hs_sis.official_gpa,
		hs_sis.awarded_gpa,
		try_to_decimal(hs_sis.eab_self_reported_gpa,10,2) AS eab_self_reported_gpa,
		try_to_decimal(hs_sis.eab_official_gpa,10,2) AS eab_official_gpa,
		try_to_decimal(hs_sis.eab_awarded_gpa,10,2) AS eab_awarded_gpa,
		hs_sis.self_reported_gpa_scale,
		hs_sis.official_gpa_scale,
		hs_sis.awarded_gpa_scale,
		hs_sis.eab_hs_gpa_type,

		cast(hs_sis.eab_class_rank as decimal(10,2)) AS eab_class_rank,
		to_boolean(hs_sis.eab_point_record_ind) AS eab_point_record_ind,
		
		hs_crm.hs_ceeb_cd_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_ceeb_cd AS hs_ceeb_cd_sis,
		<hs_ceeb_cd> AS hs_ceeb_cd,
		
		hs_crm.hs_name_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_name AS hs_name_sis,
		<hs_name> AS hs_name,
		
		hs_crm.hs_city_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_city AS hs_city_sis,
		<hs_city> AS hs_city,
		
		hs_crm.hs_state_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_state AS hs_state_sis,
		<hs_state> AS hs_state,
		
		hs_crm.hs_class_rank_pct_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_class_rank_pct AS hs_class_rank_pct_sis,
		<hs_class_rank_pct> AS hs_class_rank_pct,
		
		hs_crm.hs_class_rank_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_class_rank AS hs_class_rank_sis,
		<hs_class_rank> AS hs_class_rank,
		
		hs_crm.hs_class_size_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_class_size AS hs_class_size_sis,
		<hs_class_size> AS hs_class_size,
		
        hs_crm.hs_cum_gpa_recalc_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_cum_gpa_recalc AS hs_cum_gpa_recalc_sis,
		<hs_cum_gpa_recalc> AS hs_cum_gpa_recalc,
		
		--hs_crm.eab_hs_gpa AS eab_hs_gpa_crm, /*field does not exist in UG/CRM feed currently*/
		hs_sis.eab_hs_gpa AS eab_hs_gpa_sis,
        hs_crm.hs_gpa_nbr_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_gpa_nbr AS hs_gpa_nbr_sis,
		<hs_gpa_nbr> AS hs_gpa_nbr,
		try_to_decimal(<eab_hs_gpa>,10,2) AS eab_hs_gpa,


        hs_crm.intake_dt_crm AS intake_dt_crm,
		hs_sis.intake_dt AS intake_dt_sis,
		<intake_dt> AS intake_dt
		
FROM <[Enroll360].[Student High School SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as hs_sis
FULL OUTER JOIN stud_high_sch_crm as hs_crm
			ON hs_crm.eab_student_id_crm = hs_sis.eab_student_id
			AND hs_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm = hs_sis.eab_student_id_type
			AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(hs_crm.hs_ceeb_cd_crm,''))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(hs_sis.hs_ceeb_cd,'')))
			AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(hs_crm.hs_name_crm,''))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(hs_sis.hs_name,'')))
WHERE (hs_sis.eab_student_id IS NOT NULL AND hs_sis.eab_student_id_type IS NOT NULL) OR (hs_crm.eab_student_id_crm IS NOT NULL AND hs_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm IS NOT NULL)

queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-06-10: updated to align with Atlas pilot query best practices. This query DOES NOT merge UG and FAO records.  -- ccreekman*/

WITH 
student_hs_sis_fao as (
    SELECT * from (
  SELECT distinct
  	null as join_partnercontact_id, /*used for merging records only; do not delete*/
	null as join_partner_system_name, /*used for merging records only; do not delete*/
	stud_hs.*,
  row_number() over(partition by stud_hs.partnercontact_id, stud_hs.partner_system_name, stud_hs.hs_ceeb_cd, lower(stud_hs.hs_name)
		order by coalesce(stud_hs.eab_hs_gpa,try_to_decimal(stud_hs.hs_gpa_nbr,10,2)) desc nulls last, stud_hs.eab_class_rank desc nulls last, stud_hs.intake_dt desc nulls last) as hs_rn

  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student High School SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stud_hs

)agg
where 1=1

and hs_rn = 1 
)

select * from (
select *
, row_number() over (partition by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.partner_system_name,
				   agg.hs_ceeb_cd, lower(agg.hs_name)
				   order by coalesce(agg.eab_hs_gpa,try_to_decimal(agg.hs_gpa_nbr,10,2)) desc nulls last, agg.eab_class_rank desc nulls last, agg.intake_dt desc nulls last) pdp_delivery_rn
from (
SELECT
	crm_ug.primary_student_id,

	sis_fao.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_sis,
    sis_fao.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
    crm_ug.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_crm,
    crm_ug.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_crm,
    <eab_student_id> AS eab_student_id, /*default: sis > crm*/
    <eab_student_id_type> AS eab_student_id_type, /*default: sis > crm*/

    sis_fao.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_sis,
    sis_fao.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_sis,
    crm_ug.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_crm,
    crm_ug.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_crm,
    <partnercontact_id> AS partnercontact_id, /*default: crm > join > sis*/
    <partner_system_name> AS partner_system_name, /*default: crm > join > sis*/

	crm_ug.hs_gpa_scale AS hs_gpa_scale,

	sis_fao.self_reported_gpa,
	sis_fao.official_gpa,
	sis_fao.awarded_gpa,
	try_to_decimal(sis_fao.eab_self_reported_gpa,10,2) AS eab_self_reported_gpa,
	try_to_decimal(sis_fao.eab_official_gpa, 10,2) AS eab_official_gpa,
	try_to_decimal(sis_fao.eab_awarded_gpa,10,2) AS eab_awarded_gpa,
	sis_fao.self_reported_gpa_scale,
	sis_fao.official_gpa_scale,
	sis_fao.awarded_gpa_scale,
	sis_fao.eab_hs_gpa_type,
	cast(sis_fao.eab_class_rank as decimal(10,2)) AS eab_class_rank,
	to_boolean(sis_fao.eab_point_record_ind) AS eab_point_record_ind,
		
	crm_ug.hs_ceeb_cd as hs_ceeb_cd_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_ceeb_cd AS hs_ceeb_cd_sis,
	<hs_ceeb_cd> AS hs_ceeb_cd,
		
	crm_ug.hs_name as hs_name_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_name AS hs_name_sis,
	<hs_name> AS hs_name,
		
	crm_ug.hs_city as hs_city_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_city AS hs_city_sis,
	<hs_city> AS hs_city,
		
	crm_ug.hs_state as hs_state_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_state AS hs_state_sis,
	<hs_state> AS hs_state,
		
	crm_ug.hs_class_rank_pct as hs_class_rank_pct_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_class_rank_pct AS hs_class_rank_pct_sis,
	<hs_class_rank_pct> AS hs_class_rank_pct,
		
	crm_ug.hs_class_rank as hs_class_rank_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_class_rank AS hs_class_rank_sis,
	<hs_class_rank> AS hs_class_rank,
		
	crm_ug.hs_class_size as hs_class_size_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_class_size AS hs_class_size_sis,
	<hs_class_size> AS hs_class_size,
		
	crm_ug.hs_cum_gpa_recalc as hs_cum_gpa_recalc_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_cum_gpa_recalc AS hs_cum_gpa_recalc_sis,
	<hs_cum_gpa_recalc> AS hs_cum_gpa_recalc,

	--crm_ug.eab_hs_gpa AS eab_hs_gpa_crm, /*field does not exist in UG/CRM feed currently*/
	sis_fao.eab_hs_gpa AS eab_hs_gpa_sis,
	crm_ug.hs_gpa_nbr as hs_gpa_nbr_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_gpa_nbr AS hs_gpa_nbr_sis,
	<hs_gpa_nbr> AS hs_gpa_nbr,
	try_to_decimal(<eab_hs_gpa>,10,2) AS eab_hs_gpa,

	crm_ug.intake_dt AS intake_dt_crm,
	sis_fao.intake_dt AS intake_dt_sis,
	to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt
		
FROM student_hs_sis_fao as sis_fao

<join_extension.Student High School PDP Delivery>

where <where_statement.Student High School PDP Delivery>
and (coalesce(crm_ug.partnercontact_id,'') <> '' and coalesce(crm_ug.partner_system_name,'') <> '')
or (coalesce(sis_fao.partnercontact_id,'') <> '' and coalesce(sis_fao.partner_system_name,'') <> '')

) agg

) agg2
where agg2.pdp_delivery_rn = 1

queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-06-16: where condition variable added, deduping tweaked -ccreekman*/
/*2026-04-06: updated eab_class_rank to decimal to support percentile values - ccreekman*/
/*2026-03-10: updated eab gpa fields from to_number(field) to try_to_decimal(field ,10,2). eab_*_gpa field numbers were being rounded to integers. Currently par query sources from hs_gpa_nbr though 
updates also made to bundle to add <eab_hs_gpa> and update default logic to pull in eab_hs_gpa first before other gpa fields - ccreekman*/
/*2026-03-04: crm psname crossjoin now checks STerm to ensure we are populating pcID even if crm table does not have data, 
<partnercontact_id>,<partner_system_name> master bundle updated to choose ID in this order: crm ID from merged record > join ID from SIS record, SIS ID - ccreekman*/

/**************/
/*2026-01-13: merge query functionality notes - ccreekman
student_hs_sis_fao cte: takes all SIS data, appends any partner_system_name(s) that are present in CRM_UG Student High School.final
	Expectation is for one partner_system_name in CRM_UG Student High School.final, but set up to account for crm changes, other scenarios where there may be a mix of ID types
	Uses this to pull in only IDs from Xwalk that align with CRM_UG Student High School.final partner_system_name(s), excluding any irrelevant matching ID pairs
	if there are multiple CRM_UG Student High School.final partner_system_name(s), multiple rows per SIS record will be created
	deduping logic will exclude records with null join_partnercontact_id only if there is not a record with a populated join_partnercontact_id
	multiple records per student may still persist if they have unique populated join_partnercontact_id/join_partner_system_name values
	in that scenario resulting counts on this table may be inflated, need further examples to determine if we need to build in variables to allow customization here
main query: takes results from student_hs_sis_fao cte and does a full outer join to CRM_UG Student High School.final using the join ID / ID type / hs_ceeb_cd (if populated)
	crm join currently in variables - unclear if we need that level of customization available
*/


WITH 
student_hs_sis_fao as (
    SELECT * from (
  SELECT distinct
  	id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id as join_partnercontact_id,
	id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name as join_partner_system_name,
	stud_hs.*,
  row_number() over(partition by stud_hs.partnercontact_id, stud_hs.partner_system_name, stud_hs.hs_ceeb_cd, lower(stud_hs.hs_name)
		order by id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id, coalesce(stud_hs.eab_hs_gpa,try_to_decimal(stud_hs.hs_gpa_nbr,10,2)) desc nulls last, 
			stud_hs.eab_class_rank desc nulls last, stud_hs.intake_dt desc nulls last) as hs_rn

  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student High School SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stud_hs

  /*cross join below will associate current crm_ug partner_system_name(s) with SIS record to limit the IDs pulled from xwalk to relevent psnames
  join parcontID/psname will later only be populated when Xwalk has records where one ID pair is the parcontID/psname from this SIS data 
  and the other set has a psname that matches what we appended here
  eg: partner xwalk includes psnames of sis_01, sis_02, primary, crm_01 but crm tables only have ID psns of primary, crm_01 so only those are appended to the records*/ 
  CROSS JOIN (
  		select distinct partner_system_name as crm_ug_partner_system_name
		FROM <[Enroll360].[Student High School].[Last Validated].{final}> stud_crm
		union
		select distinct partner_system_name as crm_ug_partner_system_name
		FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term].[Last Validated].{final}> stud_crm
  		) crm_psn

  LEFT JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> id_xwalk
	on (stud_hs.partnercontact_id = id_xwalk.target_partnercontact_id
	and coalesce(stud_hs.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(id_xwalk.target_partner_system_name,'')
	and coalesce(crm_psn.CRM_UG_PARTNER_SYSTEM_NAME,'') = coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name,''))
)agg
where 1=1
/*xwalk may have multiple id pairs which meet join criteria
	this criteria limits the result set to only allow necessary dupes
	[rn = 1]: to ensure at least one copy of the SIS record is retained regardless if there is a match in ID Xwalk
	[agg.join_partnercontact_id is not null]: any dupes with distinct partnercontact_id/partner_system_name*/

and (agg.join_partnercontact_id is not null or hs_rn = 1) 
--and agg.join_partnercontact_id is null /*for troubleshooting - SIS records with no xwalk match*/
)

select distinct * from (
select distinct *
, row_number() over (partition by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.partner_system_name,
				   agg.hs_ceeb_cd, lower(agg.hs_name)
				   order by coalesce(agg.eab_hs_gpa,try_to_decimal(agg.hs_gpa_nbr,10,2)) desc nulls last, agg.eab_class_rank desc nulls last, agg.intake_dt desc nulls last) pdp_delivery_rn
from (
SELECT
	crm_ug.primary_student_id,

	sis_fao.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_sis,
    sis_fao.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
    crm_ug.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_crm,
    crm_ug.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_crm,
    <eab_student_id> AS eab_student_id, /*default: sis > crm*/
    <eab_student_id_type> AS eab_student_id_type, /*default: sis > crm*/

    sis_fao.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_sis,
    sis_fao.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_sis,
    crm_ug.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_crm,
    crm_ug.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_crm,
    <partnercontact_id> AS partnercontact_id, /*default: crm > join > sis*/
    <partner_system_name> AS partner_system_name, /*default: crm > join > sis*/

	crm_ug.hs_gpa_scale AS hs_gpa_scale,

	sis_fao.self_reported_gpa,
	sis_fao.official_gpa,
	sis_fao.awarded_gpa,
	try_to_decimal(sis_fao.eab_self_reported_gpa,10,2) AS eab_self_reported_gpa,
	try_to_decimal(sis_fao.eab_official_gpa, 10,2) AS eab_official_gpa,
	try_to_decimal(sis_fao.eab_awarded_gpa,10,2) AS eab_awarded_gpa,
	sis_fao.self_reported_gpa_scale,
	sis_fao.official_gpa_scale,
	sis_fao.awarded_gpa_scale,
	sis_fao.eab_hs_gpa_type,
	cast(sis_fao.eab_class_rank as decimal(10,2)) AS eab_class_rank,
	to_boolean(sis_fao.eab_point_record_ind) AS eab_point_record_ind,
		
	crm_ug.hs_ceeb_cd as hs_ceeb_cd_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_ceeb_cd AS hs_ceeb_cd_sis,
	<hs_ceeb_cd> AS hs_ceeb_cd,
		
	crm_ug.hs_name as hs_name_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_name AS hs_name_sis,
	<hs_name> AS hs_name,
		
	crm_ug.hs_city as hs_city_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_city AS hs_city_sis,
	<hs_city> AS hs_city,
		
	crm_ug.hs_state as hs_state_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_state AS hs_state_sis,
	<hs_state> AS hs_state,
		
	crm_ug.hs_class_rank_pct as hs_class_rank_pct_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_class_rank_pct AS hs_class_rank_pct_sis,
	<hs_class_rank_pct> AS hs_class_rank_pct,
		
	crm_ug.hs_class_rank as hs_class_rank_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_class_rank AS hs_class_rank_sis,
	<hs_class_rank> AS hs_class_rank,
		
	crm_ug.hs_class_size as hs_class_size_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_class_size AS hs_class_size_sis,
	<hs_class_size> AS hs_class_size,
		
	crm_ug.hs_cum_gpa_recalc as hs_cum_gpa_recalc_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_cum_gpa_recalc AS hs_cum_gpa_recalc_sis,
	<hs_cum_gpa_recalc> AS hs_cum_gpa_recalc,

	--crm_ug.eab_hs_gpa AS eab_hs_gpa_crm, /*field does not exist in UG/CRM feed currently*/
	sis_fao.eab_hs_gpa AS eab_hs_gpa_sis,
	crm_ug.hs_gpa_nbr as hs_gpa_nbr_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_gpa_nbr AS hs_gpa_nbr_sis,
	<hs_gpa_nbr> AS hs_gpa_nbr,
	try_to_decimal(<eab_hs_gpa>,10,2) AS eab_hs_gpa,

	crm_ug.intake_dt AS intake_dt_crm,
	sis_fao.intake_dt AS intake_dt_sis,
	to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt
		
FROM student_hs_sis_fao as sis_fao

<join_extension.Student High School PDP Delivery>

WHERE 
(coalesce(crm_ug.partnercontact_id,'') <> '' and coalesce(crm_ug.partner_system_name,'') <> '')
or (coalesce(sis_fao.partnercontact_id,'') <> '' and coalesce(sis_fao.partner_system_name,'') <> '')

) agg

) agg2
where agg2.pdp_delivery_rn = 1

order by 
	(agg2.partnercontact_id_crm||agg2.partnercontact_id_sis) nulls last, /*null in either field will return null, merged records (both fields populated) will come before non-merged records in results*/
	agg2.partnercontact_id_crm, agg2.intake_dt_crm, /*most recent non-merged UG records next*/
	agg2.partnercontact_id_sis, agg2.intake_dt_sis /*most recent non-merged FAO records next*/

queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-03-10: updated eab gpa fields from to_number() to try_to_decimal(10,2)). EAB GPA numbers were being rounded to integers. Currently par query sources from hs_gpa_nbr though - ccreekman*/
/*2026-03-04: crm psname crossjoin now checks STerm to ensure we are populating pcID even if crm table does not have data, 
<partnercontact_id>,<partner_system_name> master bundle updated to choose ID in this order: crm ID from merged record > join ID from SIS record, SIS ID - ccreekman*/
/*2026-01-13: merge query notes - ccreekman
student_hs_sis_fao cte: takes all SIS data, appends any partner_system_name(s) that are present in CRM_UG Student High School.final
	Expectation is for one partner_system_name in CRM_UG Student High School.final, but set up to account for crm changes, other scenarios where there may be a mix of ID types
	Uses this to pull in only IDs from Xwalk that align with CRM_UG Student High School.final partner_system_name(s), excluding any irrelevant matching ID pairs
	if there are multiple CRM_UG Student High School.final partner_system_name(s), multiple rows per SIS record will be created
	deduping logic will exclude records with null join_partnercontact_id only if there is not a record with a populated join_partnercontact_id
	multiple records per student may still persist if they have unique populated join_partnercontact_id/join_partner_system_name values
	in that scenario resulting counts on this table may be inflated, need further examples to determine if we need to build in variables to allow customization here
main query: takes results from student_hs_sis_fao cte and does a full outer join to CRM_UG Student High School.final using the join ID / ID type / hs_ceeb_cd (if populated)
	crm join currently in variables - unclear if we need that level of customization available
*/


WITH id_joins as (
select * from (
  SELECT 
  	id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id as join_partnercontact_id,
	id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name as join_partner_system_name,
	stud_hs.partnercontact_id,
    stud_hs.partner_system_name,
	stud_hs.hs_ceeb_cd, 
	lower(stud_hs.hs_name) as hs_name_normed,
  row_number() over(partition by stud_hs.partnercontact_id, stud_hs.partner_system_name, id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id, id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name, stud_hs.hs_ceeb_cd, lower(stud_hs.hs_name)
		order by id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id) as rn

  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student High School SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stud_hs

  /*cross join below will associate current crm_ug partner_system_name(s) with SIS record to limit the IDs pulled from xwalk to relevent psnames
  join parcontID/psname will later only be populated when Xwalk has records where one ID pair is the parcontID/psname from this SIS data 
  and the other set has a psname that matches what we appended here
  eg: partner xwalk includes psnames of sis_01, sis_02, primary, crm_01 but crm tables only have ID psns of primary, crm_01 so only those are appended to the records*/ 
  CROSS JOIN (
  		select distinct partner_system_name as crm_ug_partner_system_name 
		from (
		select partner_system_name 
		FROM <[Enroll360].[Student High School].[Last Validated].{final}> stud_crm
		union all
		select partner_system_name
		FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term].[Last Validated].{final}> stud_crm
		) agg
  		) crm_psn

  LEFT JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> id_xwalk
	on (stud_hs.partnercontact_id = id_xwalk.target_partnercontact_id
	and coalesce(stud_hs.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(id_xwalk.target_partner_system_name,'')
	and coalesce(crm_psn.CRM_UG_PARTNER_SYSTEM_NAME,'') = coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name,''))
) agg
where 1=1

and rn = 1
)
 
, student_hs_sis_fao as (
    SELECT
  	idj.join_partnercontact_id,
	idj.join_partner_system_name,
	stud_hs.*
	
	FROM <[Enroll360].[Student High School SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stud_hs
	left join id_joins idj
	on stud_hs.partnercontact_id = idj.partnercontact_id
	and stud_hs.partner_system_name = idj.partner_system_name
	and coalesce(stud_hs.hs_ceeb_cd,'') = coalesce(idj.hs_ceeb_cd,'')
	and coalesce(lower(stud_hs.hs_name),'') = coalesce(idj.hs_name_normed,'')
)

select distinct * from (
select distinct *
, row_number() over (partition by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.partner_system_name,
				   agg.hs_ceeb_cd, lower(agg.hs_name)
				   order by agg.intake_dt desc nulls last, coalesce(agg.eab_hs_gpa,try_to_number(agg.hs_gpa_nbr)) desc nulls last) rn
from (
SELECT
	crm_ug.primary_student_id,

	sis_fao.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_sis,
    sis_fao.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_sis,

    <eab_student_id> AS eab_student_id, /*default: sis > crm*/
    <eab_student_id_type> AS eab_student_id_type, /*default: sis > crm*/

    sis_fao.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_sis,

    crm_ug.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_crm,

    <partnercontact_id> AS partnercontact_id, /*default: crm > join > sis*/

	sis_fao.official_gpa,

	to_number(sis_fao.eab_class_rank) AS eab_class_rank,
	to_boolean(sis_fao.eab_point_record_ind) AS eab_point_record_ind,
		
	crm_ug.hs_ceeb_cd as hs_ceeb_cd_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_ceeb_cd AS hs_ceeb_cd_sis,
	<hs_ceeb_cd> AS hs_ceeb_cd,
		
	crm_ug.hs_name as hs_name_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_name AS hs_name_sis,
	<hs_name> AS hs_name,
		
	crm_ug.hs_city as hs_city_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_city AS hs_city_sis,
	<hs_city> AS hs_city,
		
	crm_ug.hs_state as hs_state_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_state AS hs_state_sis,
	<hs_state> AS hs_state,
		
	crm_ug.hs_class_rank_pct as hs_class_rank_pct_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_class_rank_pct AS hs_class_rank_pct_sis,
	<hs_class_rank_pct> AS hs_class_rank_pct,
		
	crm_ug.hs_class_rank as hs_class_rank_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_class_rank AS hs_class_rank_sis,
	<hs_class_rank> AS hs_class_rank,
		
	crm_ug.hs_class_size as hs_class_size_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_class_size AS hs_class_size_sis,
	<hs_class_size> AS hs_class_size,
		
	crm_ug.hs_cum_gpa_recalc as hs_cum_gpa_recalc_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_cum_gpa_recalc AS hs_cum_gpa_recalc_sis,
	<hs_cum_gpa_recalc> AS hs_cum_gpa_recalc,

	--crm_ug.eab_hs_gpa AS eab_hs_gpa_crm, /*field does not exist in UG/CRM feed currently*/
	sis_fao.eab_hs_gpa AS eab_hs_gpa_sis,
	crm_ug.hs_gpa_nbr as hs_gpa_nbr_crm,
	sis_fao.hs_gpa_nbr AS hs_gpa_nbr_sis,
	<hs_gpa_nbr> AS hs_gpa_nbr,
	try_to_decimal(<eab_hs_gpa>,10,2) AS eab_hs_gpa,

	crm_ug.intake_dt AS intake_dt_crm,
	sis_fao.intake_dt AS intake_dt_sis,
	to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt
		
FROM student_hs_sis_fao as sis_fao

<join_extension.Student High School PDP Delivery>

WHERE 
(coalesce(crm_ug.partnercontact_id,'') <> '' and coalesce(crm_ug.partner_system_name,'') <> '')
or (coalesce(sis_fao.partnercontact_id,'') <> '' and coalesce(sis_fao.partner_system_name,'') <> '')

) agg

) agg2
where agg2.rn = 1

order by 
	(agg2.partnercontact_id_crm||agg2.partnercontact_id_sis) nulls last, /*null in either field will return null, merged records (both fields populated) will come before non-merged records in results*/
	agg2.partnercontact_id_crm, agg2.intake_dt_crm, /*most recent non-merged UG records next*/
	agg2.partnercontact_id_sis, agg2.intake_dt_sis /*most recent non-merged FAO records next*/

SELECT
		hs_crm.primary_student_id_crm AS primary_student_id,
		hs_crm.hs_gpa_scale_crm AS hs_gpa_scale,
		hs_sis.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_sis,
        hs_crm.eab_student_id_crm,
        <eab_student_id> AS eab_student_id,

		hs_sis.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
		hs_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm,
        <eab_student_id_type> AS eab_student_id_type,
		hs_sis.self_reported_gpa,
		hs_sis.official_gpa,
		hs_sis.awarded_gpa,
		to_number(hs_sis.eab_self_reported_gpa) AS eab_self_reported_gpa,
		to_number(hs_sis.eab_official_gpa) AS eab_official_gpa,
		to_number(hs_sis.eab_awarded_gpa) AS eab_awarded_gpa,
		hs_sis.self_reported_gpa_scale,
		hs_sis.official_gpa_scale,
		hs_sis.awarded_gpa_scale,
		hs_sis.eab_hs_gpa_type,
		to_number(hs_sis.eab_hs_gpa) AS eab_hs_gpa,
		to_number(hs_sis.eab_class_rank) AS eab_class_rank,
		to_boolean(hs_sis.eab_point_record_ind) AS eab_point_record_ind,
		
		hs_crm.hs_ceeb_cd_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_ceeb_cd AS hs_ceeb_cd_sis,
		<hs_ceeb_cd> AS hs_ceeb_cd,
		
		hs_crm.hs_name_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_name AS hs_name_sis,
		<hs_name> AS hs_name,
		
		hs_crm.hs_city_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_city AS hs_city_sis,
		<hs_city> AS hs_city,
		
		hs_crm.hs_state_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_state AS hs_state_sis,
		<hs_state> AS hs_state,
		
		hs_crm.hs_class_rank_pct_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_class_rank_pct AS hs_class_rank_pct_sis,
		<hs_class_rank_pct> AS hs_class_rank_pct,
		
		hs_crm.hs_class_rank_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_class_rank AS hs_class_rank_sis,
		<hs_class_rank> AS hs_class_rank,
		
		hs_crm.hs_class_size_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_class_size AS hs_class_size_sis,
		<hs_class_size> AS hs_class_size,
		
        hs_crm.hs_cum_gpa_recalc_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_cum_gpa_recalc AS hs_cum_gpa_recalc_sis,
		<hs_cum_gpa_recalc> AS hs_cum_gpa_recalc,
		
        hs_crm.hs_gpa_nbr_crm,
		hs_sis.hs_gpa_nbr AS hs_gpa_nbr_sis,
		<hs_gpa_nbr> AS hs_gpa_nbr,
		
        to_timestamp(hs_crm.intake_dt_crm) AS intake_dt_crm,
		to_timestamp(hs_sis.intake_dt) AS intake_dt_sis,
		to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt
		
FROM <[Enroll360].[Student High School SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as hs_sis
FULL OUTER JOIN stud_high_sch_crm as hs_crm
			ON hs_crm.eab_student_id_crm = hs_sis.eab_student_id
			AND hs_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm = hs_sis.eab_student_id_type
			AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(hs_crm.hs_ceeb_cd_crm,''))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(hs_sis.hs_ceeb_cd,'')))
			AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(hs_crm.hs_name_crm,''))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(hs_sis.hs_name,'')))
WHERE (hs_sis.eab_student_id IS NOT NULL AND hs_sis.eab_student_id_type IS NOT NULL) OR (hs_crm.eab_student_id_crm IS NOT NULL AND hs_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm IS NOT NULL)

queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-08-05: Enroll360.Student High School SIS.final.v1 version is archived in University of Denver-FAO Pilot space
this query and Enroll360.Student High School SIS.final are aligned at this time*/

/*2026-07: eab_class_rank is outputing integer based on current par query reqs -ccreekman*/
/*2026-06-15: added row_number deduping at pdp key grain, priority = highest GPA > highest class rank > most recent intake date wins otherwise random - ccreekman*/
/*2026-04-06: eab_class_rank edits, field is cast to decimal instead of number, 
<eab_class_rank> master variable is updated to calculate percentile based on standard logic - ccreekman*/
/*2025-11-11: updates made to use variable for partner_system_name, 
new attributes high_school_gpa_type, point_record_indicator incorporated, these fields will not persist to par tables - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-03: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-06-10: removed second set after further consultation, added join extension variable - ccreekman*/
/*2025-04-24: edits include moving gpa, rank variable from PCM query to this query
added code for second HS set*/

select 
agg3.eab_student_id,
agg3.eab_student_id_type,
agg3.partnercontact_id,
agg3.partner_system_name,
agg3.hs_ceeb_cd,
agg3.hs_name,
agg3.hs_city,
agg3.hs_state,
agg3.hs_class_rank_pct,
agg3.hs_class_rank,
agg3.hs_class_size,
agg3.hs_cum_gpa_recalc,
agg3.hs_gpa_nbr,
agg3.self_reported_gpa,
agg3.official_gpa,
agg3.awarded_gpa,
agg3.eab_self_reported_gpa,
agg3.eab_official_gpa,
agg3.eab_awarded_gpa,
agg3.self_reported_gpa_scale,
agg3.official_gpa_scale,
agg3.awarded_gpa_scale,
agg3.eab_hs_gpa_type,
agg3.eab_hs_gpa,
agg3.eab_class_rank,
agg3.eab_point_record_ind,
agg3.intake_dt

from (
select agg2.*,
row_number() over(partition by agg2.partnercontact_id, agg2.partner_system_name, 
				  lower(agg2.hs_name), agg2.hs_ceeb_cd
				  order by agg2.eab_hs_gpa desc nulls last, 
							agg2.eab_class_rank desc nulls last, 
							agg2.intake_dt desc nulls last) as hs_rn

from (
select 
	distinct 
  	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
  	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,
	/*prev logic:
	case 
		when agg.hs_ceeb_cd is not null 
			and length(ltrim(rtrim(agg.hs_ceeb_cd))) = 6 -- 6 digits long
			and try_to_numeric(agg.hs_ceeb_cd) not like '%.%'  -- no periods
			and try_to_numeric(agg.hs_ceeb_cd) then cast(agg.hs_ceeb_cd as varchar) -- is castable to a number
		else null 
		end as hs_ceeb_cd,*/
	case 
		when regexp_like(trim(agg.hs_ceeb_cd),'^[0-9]{1,6}$')
		then lpad(agg.hs_ceeb_cd,6,'0')
		else null 
		end as hs_ceeb_cd,
	agg.hs_name,
	agg.hs_city,
	agg.hs_state,
	agg.hs_class_rank_pct,
	agg.hs_class_rank,
	agg.hs_class_size,
	agg.hs_cum_gpa_recalc,
	agg.hs_gpa_nbr,
	agg.self_reported_gpa,
	agg.official_gpa,
	agg.awarded_gpa,
	CAST(agg.eab_self_reported_gpa as decimal (10,2)) as eab_self_reported_gpa,
	CAST(agg.eab_official_gpa as decimal (10,2)) as eab_official_gpa,
	CAST(agg.eab_awarded_gpa as decimal (10,2)) as eab_awarded_gpa,
	agg.self_reported_gpa_scale,
	agg.official_gpa_scale,
	agg.awarded_gpa_scale,
	agg.eab_hs_gpa_type,
	CAST(agg.eab_hs_gpa as decimal (10,2)) as eab_hs_gpa,
	agg.eab_class_rank as eab_class_rank,
	CAST(agg.eab_point_record_ind as boolean) as eab_point_record_ind,
	CAST(agg.intake_dt as timestamp) as intake_dt

from 
(
--High school set 1
	select 
		distinct stud_hs.eab_student_id,
		lower(regexp_replace(stud_hs.eab_student_id_type,'[\\s]','')) as eab_student_id_type,
		<partnercontact_id.sis_fao> as partnercontact_id,
		lower(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.sis_fao>,'[\\s]','')) as partner_system_name,
		case when stud_hs.high_school_ceeb_code is not null 
			then lpad(try_to_numeric(stud_hs.high_school_ceeb_code),6,'0') 
			else null 
			end as hs_ceeb_cd,
		stud_hs.high_school_name as hs_name,
		stud_hs.high_school_city as hs_city,
		stud_hs.high_school_state as hs_state,
		stud_hs.high_school_class_rank_percentile as hs_class_rank_pct,
		stud_hs.high_school_class_rank as hs_class_rank,
		stud_hs.high_school_class_size as hs_class_size,
		stud_hs.recalculated_high_school_gpa as hs_cum_gpa_recalc,
		stud_hs.high_school_gpa as hs_gpa_nbr,
		stud_hs.high_school_gpa_type as hs_gpa_type,
		stud_hs.self_reported_gpa as self_reported_gpa,
		stud_hs.official_gpa as official_gpa,
		stud_hs.awarded_gpa as awarded_gpa,
		stud_hs.point_record_indicator as point_record_ind,

		--stud_hs.eab_self_reported_gpa as eab_self_reported_gpa,
  		case when self_reported_gpa is not null 
  		then <eab_self_reported_gpa>
		else null
		end as eab_self_reported_gpa,

		--stud_hs.eab_official_gpa as eab_official_gpa,
  		case when stud_hs.official_gpa is not null 
  		then <eab_official_gpa> 
		else null
		end as eab_official_gpa,
		
  		--stud_hs.eab_awarded_gpa as eab_awarded_gpa,
  		case when stud_hs.awarded_gpa is not null 
  		then <eab_awarded_gpa>
		else null
		end as eab_awarded_gpa,
  
  		stud_hs.self_reported_gpa_scale as self_reported_gpa_scale,
		stud_hs.official_gpa_scale as official_gpa_scale,
		stud_hs.awarded_gpa_scale as awarded_gpa_scale,
		--stud_hs.eab_high_school_gpa_type as eab_hs_gpa_type,
  		pcm_hs_gpa_type.eab_standard_value as eab_hs_gpa_type,
  
		--stud_hs.eab_high_school_gpa as eab_hs_gpa,
  		<eab_hs_gpa> as eab_hs_gpa,
  
		--stud_hs.eab_class_rank as eab_class_rank,
  		/*case when stud_hs.high_school_class_rank is not null 
  		then <eab_class_rank>
  		else null*/
  		to_number(<eab_class_rank>) as eab_class_rank,
  
		--stud_hs.eab_point_record_indicator as eab_point_record_ind,
  		pcm_point_record_ind.eab_standard_value as eab_point_record_ind,
  
		stud_hs.intake_date as intake_dt
	from <[Enroll360].[Student High School SIS].{fulfillment}> as stud_hs
  
  	left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_hs_gpa_type
	on (pcm_hs_gpa_type.field_name = 'eab_hs_gpa_type'
	and coalesce(stud_hs.high_school_gpa_type,'') = coalesce(pcm_hs_gpa_type.partner_value,''))
  
  	left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_point_record_ind
	on (pcm_point_record_ind.field_name = 'eab_point_record_ind'
	and coalesce(stud_hs.point_record_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_point_record_ind.partner_value,''))

<join_extension.Student High School SIS>

) agg

where coalesce(agg.hs_ceeb_cd,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_name,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_city,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_state,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_class_rank_pct,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_class_rank,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_class_size,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_cum_gpa_recalc,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_gpa_nbr,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.self_reported_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.official_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.awarded_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.eab_self_reported_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.eab_official_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.eab_awarded_gpa,'') ||
	--coalesce(agg.self_reported_gpa_scale,'') ||
	--coalesce(agg.official_gpa_scale,'') ||
	--coalesce(agg.awarded_gpa_scale,'') ||
	--coalesce(agg.eab_hs_gpa_type,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.eab_hs_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(to_varchar(agg.eab_class_rank),'') ||
	coalesce(agg.eab_point_record_ind,'') <> ''
) agg2
where coalesce(agg2.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(agg2.partner_system_name,'') <> ''

) agg3

where agg3.hs_rn = 1

		stud_hs.self_reported_gpa as self_reported_gpa,
		stud_hs.official_gpa as official_gpa,
		stud_hs.awarded_gpa as awarded_gpa,

		--stud_hs.eab_high_school_gpa as eab_hs_gpa,

queryResults.sqlPreview: /*2026-08-05: Enroll360.Student High School SIS.final.v1 version is archived in University of Denver-FAO Pilot space this query and Enroll360.Student High Schoo…
queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-08-05: Enroll360.Student High School SIS.final.v1 version is archived in University of Denver-FAO Pilot space
this query and Enroll360.Student High School SIS.final are aligned at this time
Change log: Enroll360.Student High School SIS.final -> NEW Enroll360.Student High School SIS.final
- Uses newer version of id/system_type variables and normalizes eab_student_id_type.
- Uses more explicit CEEB normalization
- eab_hs_gpa and eab_class_rank EAB values now use direct variables instead of PCM conversion mappings.
- eab_hs_gpa_type and eab_point_record_ind PCM mappings now use high_school_gpa_type and point_record_indicator.
- scale fields no longer a part of the non-null record filter, must have other data to persist
- Adds high-school deduplication: highest eab_hs_gpa, then eab_class_rank, then latest intake_dt.*/

/*2026-07: eab_class_rank is outputing integer based on current par query reqs -ccreekman*/
/*2026-06-15: see ARCHIVED_Enroll360.Student High School SIS.v1 for prev version, current version is based on DataOrgPilot.Enroll360.Student High School SIS.final as of this date - ccreekman*/
/***********************/
/*2026-06-15: added row_number deduping at pdp key grain, priority = highest GPA > highest class rank > most recent intake date wins otherwise random - ccreekman*/
/*2026-04-06: eab_class_rank edits, field is cast to decimal instead of number, 
<eab_class_rank> master variable is updated to calculate percentile based on standard logic - ccreekman*/
/*2025-11-11: updates made to use variable for partner_system_name, 
new attributes high_school_gpa_type, point_record_indicator incorporated, these fields will not persist to par tables - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-03: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-06-10: removed second set after further consultation, added join extension variable - ccreekman*/
/*2025-04-24: edits include moving gpa, rank variable from PCM query to this query
added code for second HS set*/

select 
agg3.eab_student_id,
agg3.eab_student_id_type,
agg3.partnercontact_id,
agg3.partner_system_name,
agg3.hs_ceeb_cd,
agg3.hs_name,
agg3.hs_city,
agg3.hs_state,
agg3.hs_class_rank_pct,
agg3.hs_class_rank,
agg3.hs_class_size,
agg3.hs_cum_gpa_recalc,
agg3.hs_gpa_nbr,
agg3.self_reported_gpa,
agg3.official_gpa,
agg3.awarded_gpa,
agg3.eab_self_reported_gpa,
agg3.eab_official_gpa,
agg3.eab_awarded_gpa,
agg3.self_reported_gpa_scale,
agg3.official_gpa_scale,
agg3.awarded_gpa_scale,
agg3.eab_hs_gpa_type,
agg3.eab_hs_gpa,
agg3.eab_class_rank,
agg3.eab_point_record_ind,
agg3.intake_dt

from (
select agg2.*,
row_number() over(partition by agg2.partnercontact_id, agg2.partner_system_name, 
				  lower(agg2.hs_name), agg2.hs_ceeb_cd
				  order by agg2.eab_hs_gpa desc nulls last, 
							agg2.eab_class_rank desc nulls last, 
							agg2.intake_dt desc nulls last) as hs_rn

from (
select 
	distinct 
  	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
  	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,
	case 
		when regexp_like(trim(agg.hs_ceeb_cd),'^[0-9]{1,6}$')
		then lpad(agg.hs_ceeb_cd,6,'0')
		else null 
		end as hs_ceeb_cd,
	agg.hs_name,
	agg.hs_city,
	agg.hs_state,
	agg.hs_class_rank_pct,
	agg.hs_class_rank,
	agg.hs_class_size,
	agg.hs_cum_gpa_recalc,
	agg.hs_gpa_nbr,
	agg.self_reported_gpa,
	agg.official_gpa,
	agg.awarded_gpa,
	CAST(agg.eab_self_reported_gpa as decimal (10,2)) as eab_self_reported_gpa,
	CAST(agg.eab_official_gpa as decimal (10,2)) as eab_official_gpa,
	CAST(agg.eab_awarded_gpa as decimal (10,2)) as eab_awarded_gpa,
	agg.self_reported_gpa_scale,
	agg.official_gpa_scale,
	agg.awarded_gpa_scale,
	agg.eab_hs_gpa_type,
	CAST(agg.eab_hs_gpa as decimal (10,2)) as eab_hs_gpa,
	agg.eab_class_rank as eab_class_rank,
	CAST(agg.eab_point_record_ind as boolean) as eab_point_record_ind,
	CAST(agg.intake_dt as timestamp) as intake_dt

from 
(
--High school set 1
	select 
		distinct stud_hs.eab_student_id,
		lower(regexp_replace(stud_hs.eab_student_id_type,'[\\s]','')) as eab_student_id_type,
		<partnercontact_id.sis_fao> as partnercontact_id,
		lower(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.sis_fao>,'[\\s]','')) as partner_system_name,
		case when stud_hs.high_school_ceeb_code is not null 
			then lpad(try_to_numeric(stud_hs.high_school_ceeb_code),6,'0') 
			else null 
			end as hs_ceeb_cd,
		stud_hs.high_school_name as hs_name,
		stud_hs.high_school_city as hs_city,
		stud_hs.high_school_state as hs_state,
		stud_hs.high_school_class_rank_percentile as hs_class_rank_pct,
		stud_hs.high_school_class_rank as hs_class_rank,
		stud_hs.high_school_class_size as hs_class_size,
		stud_hs.recalculated_high_school_gpa as hs_cum_gpa_recalc,
		stud_hs.high_school_gpa as hs_gpa_nbr,
		stud_hs.high_school_gpa_type as hs_gpa_type,
		stud_hs.self_reported_gpa as self_reported_gpa,
		stud_hs.official_gpa as official_gpa,
		stud_hs.awarded_gpa as awarded_gpa,
		stud_hs.point_record_indicator as point_record_ind,

		--stud_hs.eab_self_reported_gpa as eab_self_reported_gpa,
  		case when self_reported_gpa is not null 
  		then <eab_self_reported_gpa>
		else null
		end as eab_self_reported_gpa,

		--stud_hs.eab_official_gpa as eab_official_gpa,
  		case when stud_hs.official_gpa is not null 
  		then <eab_official_gpa> 
		else null
		end as eab_official_gpa,
		
  		--stud_hs.eab_awarded_gpa as eab_awarded_gpa,
  		case when stud_hs.awarded_gpa is not null 
  		then <eab_awarded_gpa>
		else null
		end as eab_awarded_gpa,
  
  		stud_hs.self_reported_gpa_scale as self_reported_gpa_scale,
		stud_hs.official_gpa_scale as official_gpa_scale,
		stud_hs.awarded_gpa_scale as awarded_gpa_scale,
		--stud_hs.eab_high_school_gpa_type as eab_hs_gpa_type,
  		pcm_hs_gpa_type.eab_standard_value as eab_hs_gpa_type,
  
		--stud_hs.eab_high_school_gpa as eab_hs_gpa,
  		<eab_hs_gpa> as eab_hs_gpa,
  
		--stud_hs.eab_class_rank as eab_class_rank,
  		/*case when stud_hs.high_school_class_rank is not null 
  		then <eab_class_rank>
  		else null*/
  		cast(<eab_class_rank> as DECIMAL (10,2)) as eab_class_rank,
  
		--stud_hs.eab_point_record_indicator as eab_point_record_ind,
  		pcm_point_record_ind.eab_standard_value as eab_point_record_ind,
  
		stud_hs.intake_date as intake_dt
	from <[Enroll360].[Student High School SIS].{fulfillment}> as stud_hs
  
  	left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_hs_gpa_type
	on (pcm_hs_gpa_type.field_name = 'eab_hs_gpa_type'
	and coalesce(stud_hs.high_school_gpa_type,'') = coalesce(pcm_hs_gpa_type.partner_value,''))
  
  	left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_point_record_ind
	on (pcm_point_record_ind.field_name = 'eab_point_record_ind'
	and coalesce(stud_hs.point_record_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_point_record_ind.partner_value,''))

<join_extension.Student High School SIS>

) agg

where coalesce(agg.hs_ceeb_cd,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_name,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_city,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_state,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_class_rank_pct,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_class_rank,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_class_size,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_cum_gpa_recalc,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_gpa_nbr,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.self_reported_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.official_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.awarded_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.eab_self_reported_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.eab_official_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.eab_awarded_gpa,'') ||
	--coalesce(agg.self_reported_gpa_scale,'') ||
	--coalesce(agg.official_gpa_scale,'') ||
	--coalesce(agg.awarded_gpa_scale,'') ||
	--coalesce(agg.eab_hs_gpa_type,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.eab_hs_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(to_varchar(agg.eab_class_rank),'') ||
	coalesce(agg.eab_point_record_ind,'') <> ''
) agg2
where coalesce(agg2.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(agg2.partner_system_name,'') <> ''

) agg3

where agg3.hs_rn = 1
