queryResults.querySql:
select 
	distinct nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
	case 
		when agg.hs_ceeb_cd is not null 
			and length(ltrim(rtrim(agg.hs_ceeb_cd))) = 6 -- 6 digits long
			and try_to_numeric(agg.hs_ceeb_cd) not like '%.%'  -- no periods
			and try_to_numeric(agg.hs_ceeb_cd) then cast(agg.hs_ceeb_cd as varchar) -- is castable to a number
		else null 
		end as hs_ceeb_cd,
	agg.hs_name,
	agg.hs_city,
	agg.hs_state,
	agg.hs_class_rank_pct,
	agg.hs_class_rank,
	agg.hs_class_size,
	agg.hs_cum_gpa_recalc,
	agg.hs_gpa_nbr,
	agg.self_reported_gpa,
	agg.official_gpa,
	agg.awarded_gpa,
	CAST(agg.eab_self_reported_gpa as decimal (10,2)) as eab_self_reported_gpa,
	CAST(agg.eab_official_gpa as decimal (10,2)) as eab_official_gpa,
	CAST(agg.eab_awarded_gpa as decimal (10,2)) as eab_awarded_gpa,
	agg.self_reported_gpa_scale,
	agg.official_gpa_scale,
	agg.awarded_gpa_scale,
	agg.eab_hs_gpa_type,
	CAST(agg.eab_hs_gpa as decimal (10,2)) as eab_hs_gpa,
	CAST(agg.eab_class_rank as number) as eab_class_rank,
	CAST(agg.eab_point_record_ind as boolean) as eab_point_record_ind,
	CAST(agg.intake_dt as timestamp) as intake_dt

from 
(
--High school set 1
	select 
		distinct stud_hs.eab_student_id,
		stud_hs.eab_student_id_type,
		case 	when stud_hs.high_school_ceeb_code is not null 
				then lpad(try_to_numeric(stud_hs.high_school_ceeb_code),6,'0') 
				else null 
			end as hs_ceeb_cd,
		stud_hs.high_school_name as hs_name,
		stud_hs.high_school_city as hs_city,
		stud_hs.high_school_state as hs_state,
		stud_hs.high_school_class_rank_percentile as hs_class_rank_pct,
		stud_hs.high_school_class_rank as hs_class_rank,
		stud_hs.high_school_class_size as hs_class_size,
		stud_hs.recalculated_high_school_gpa as hs_cum_gpa_recalc,
		stud_hs.high_school_gpa as hs_gpa_nbr,
		stud_hs.self_reported_gpa as self_reported_gpa,
		stud_hs.official_gpa as official_gpa,
		stud_hs.awarded_gpa as awarded_gpa,
		--stud_hs.eab_self_reported_gpa as eab_self_reported_gpa,
  		case when self_reported_gpa is not null 
  		then <eab_self_reported_gpa>
		else null
		end as eab_self_reported_gpa,

		--stud_hs.eab_official_gpa as eab_official_gpa,
  		case when stud_hs.official_gpa is not null 
  		then <eab_official_gpa> 
		else null
		end as eab_official_gpa,
		
  		--stud_hs.eab_awarded_gpa as eab_awarded_gpa,
  		case when stud_hs.awarded_gpa is not null 
  		then <eab_awarded_gpa>
		else null
		end as eab_awarded_gpa,
  
  		stud_hs.self_reported_gpa_scale as self_reported_gpa_scale,
		stud_hs.official_gpa_scale as official_gpa_scale,
		stud_hs.awarded_gpa_scale as awarded_gpa_scale,
		--stud_hs.eab_high_school_gpa_type as eab_hs_gpa_type,
  		pcm_hs_gpa_type.eab_standard_value as eab_hs_gpa_type,
  
		--stud_hs.eab_high_school_gpa as eab_hs_gpa,
  		<eab_hs_gpa> as eab_hs_gpa,
  
		--stud_hs.eab_class_rank as eab_class_rank,
  		case when stud_hs.high_school_class_rank is not null 
  		then <eab_class_rank>
  		else null 
  		end as eab_class_rank,
  
		--stud_hs.eab_point_record_indicator as eab_point_record_ind,
  		pcm_point_record_ind.eab_standard_value as eab_point_record_ind,
  
		stud_hs.intake_date as intake_dt
	from <[Enroll360].[Student High School SIS].{fulfillment}> as stud_hs
  
  	left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_hs_gpa_type
	on (pcm_hs_gpa_type.field_name = 'eab_hs_gpa_type'
	and coalesce(stud_hs.eab_high_school_gpa_type,'') = coalesce(pcm_hs_gpa_type.partner_value,''))
  
  	left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_point_record_ind
	on (pcm_point_record_ind.field_name = 'eab_point_record_ind'
	and coalesce(stud_hs.eab_point_record_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_hs_gpa_type.partner_value,''))
  
  union all
  
  --High school set 2
	select 
		distinct stud_hs.eab_student_id,
		stud_hs.eab_student_id_type,
		case 	when stud_hs.calculated_field_1 is not null 
				then lpad(try_to_numeric(stud_hs.calculated_field_1),6,'0') 
				else null 
			end as hs_ceeb_cd,
		stud_hs.calculated_field_2 as hs_name,
		stud_hs.calculated_field_3 as hs_city,
		stud_hs.calculated_field_4 as hs_state,
		stud_hs.calculated_field_5 as hs_class_rank_pct,
		stud_hs.calculated_field_6 as hs_class_rank,
		stud_hs.calculated_field_7 as hs_class_size,
		stud_hs.calculated_field_8 as hs_cum_gpa_recalc,
		stud_hs.calculated_field_9 as hs_gpa_nbr,
		null as self_reported_gpa, /*no field available for set 2*/
		null as official_gpa, /*no field available for set 2*/
		null as awarded_gpa, /*no field available for set 2*/
		--stud_hs.eab_self_reported_gpa as eab_self_reported_gpa,
  		/*case when self_reported_gpa is not null 
  		then <eab_self_reported_gpa>
		else null
		end as eab_self_reported_gpa,*/ /*no field available for set 2*/
  		null as eab_self_reported_gpa, 

		--stud_hs.eab_official_gpa as eab_official_gpa,
  		/*case when stud_hs.awarded_gpa is not null 
  		then <eab_awarded_gpa>
		else null
		end as eab_awarded_gpa,*/ /*no official_gpa field available for set 2*/
  		null as eab_official_gpa,
		
  		--stud_hs.eab_awarded_gpa as eab_awarded_gpa,
  		/*case when stud_hs.awarded_gpa is not null 
  		then pcm_awarded_gpa.eab_standard_value 
		else null
		end as eab_awarded_gpa,*/ /*no awarded_gpa field available for set 2*/
  		null as eab_awarded_gpa,
  
  		null as self_reported_gpa_scale, /*no field available for set 2*/
		null as official_gpa_scale, /*no field available for set 2*/
		null as awarded_gpa_scale, /*no field available for set 2*/
		--stud_hs.eab_high_school_gpa_type as eab_hs_gpa_type,
  		/*case when stud_hs.calculated_field_9 is not null 
  		then pcm_hs_gpa_type.eab_standard_value 
		else null
		end as eab_hs_gpa_type,*/ /*no field available for set 2*/
		null as eab_hs_gpa_type,
		  
		--stud_hs.eab_high_school_gpa as eab_hs_gpa,
  		case when stud_hs.calculated_field_9 is not null 
  		then try_cast(stud_hs.calculated_field_9 as varchar)
		else null
		end as eab_hs_gpa,
  
		--stud_hs.eab_class_rank as eab_class_rank,
  		case when stud_hs.calculated_field_6 is not null 
  		then try_cast(stud_hs.calculated_field_6 as varchar)
  		else null 
		end as eab_class_rank,
  
		--stud_hs.eab_point_record_indicator as eab_point_record_ind,
  		/*pcm_point_record_ind.eab_standard_value as eab_point_record_ind,*/
  		null as eab_point_record_ind,

		stud_hs.intake_date as intake_dt
	from <[Enroll360].[Student High School SIS].{fulfillment}> as stud_hs
  
/*  	left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_hs_gpa_type
	on (pcm_hs_gpa_type.field_name = 'eab_hs_gpa_type'
	and coalesce(stud_hs.eab_high_school_gpa_type,'') = coalesce(pcm_hs_gpa_type.partner_value,''))*/
  
/*  	left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_point_record_ind
	on (pcm_point_record_ind.field_name = 'eab_point_record_ind'
	and coalesce(stud_hs.eab_point_record_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_hs_gpa_type.partner_value,''))*/

) agg

where 
	coalesce(eab_student_id,'') <> '' and
	coalesce(eab_student_id_type,'') <> '' and
	coalesce(agg.hs_ceeb_cd,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_name,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_city,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_state,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_class_rank_pct,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_class_rank,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_class_size,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_cum_gpa_recalc,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.hs_gpa_nbr,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.self_reported_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.official_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.awarded_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.eab_self_reported_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.eab_official_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.eab_awarded_gpa,'') ||
	--coalesce(agg.self_reported_gpa_scale,'') ||
	--coalesce(agg.official_gpa_scale,'') ||
	--coalesce(agg.awarded_gpa_scale,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.eab_hs_gpa_type,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.eab_hs_gpa,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.eab_class_rank,'') ||
	coalesce(agg.eab_point_record_ind,'') <> ''

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. queryResults.sqlPreview: WITH id_xwalk AS ( SELECT * FROM ( Select DISTINCT nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_xwalk.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as primary_student_i…
queryResults.querySql:
WITH id_xwalk AS 
	(
	SELECT * FROM
		(
		Select 
			DISTINCT nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_xwalk.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as primary_student_id,
			nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_xwalk.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
			nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_xwalk.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
			nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_xwalk.student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as student_id_type,
			CAST(stud_xwalk.intake_dt as timestamp) AS intake_dt
		FROM <[Enroll360].[Student ID Xwalk].{fulfillment}> as stud_xwalk
		) sq 
	WHERE COALESCE(sq.primary_student_id,'')<>''
	AND COALESCE(sq.eab_student_id_type,'')<>''
	AND COALESCE(sq.eab_student_id,'')<>''
	)
SELECT DISTINCT
	primary_student_id,
	eab_student_id,
	eab_student_id_type,
	student_id_type,					
	intake_dt
FROM id_xwalk

queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-06-16: archived, main query being updated to align with Atlas pilot corrections. - ccreekman*/
/*2026-03-03: <partnercontact_id>,<partner_system_name> master bundle updated to choose ID in this order: crm ID from merged record > join ID from SIS record, SIS ID 
join fields are in merge query, null placecholder fields added to this query - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-07: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473; corrected where statement - ccreekman*/
WITH student_crm AS 
(
	SELECT
		COALESCE(ps_xwalk.eab_student_id, enr_stud_crm.primary_student_id) AS eab_student_id_crm,
		COALESCE(ps_xwalk.eab_student_id_type, 'primary') AS eab_student_id_type_crm,

		enr_stud_crm.sis_student_id AS sis_student_id_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.crm_student_id AS crm_student_id_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.other_student_id AS other_student_id_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.fname AS fname_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.mname AS mname_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.lname AS lname_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.preferred_fname AS preferred_fname_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.us_citizenship_status AS us_citizenship_status_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.international_ind AS international_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.birth_dt AS birth_dt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.gender AS gender_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.pref_gender AS pref_gender_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.religious_affiliation AS religious_affiliation_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.hs_grad_year AS hs_grad_year_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.origin_source AS origin_source_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.origin_source_dt AS origin_source_dt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.first_gen_ind AS first_gen_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.military_service_status AS military_service_status_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.alumni_relation_ind AS alumni_relation_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.hispanic_ind AS hispanic_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.ethnicity AS ethnicity_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.campus_visit_cnt AS campus_visit_cnt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.campus_visit_ind AS campus_visit_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.first_campus_visit_dt AS first_campus_visit_dt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.last_campus_visit_dt AS last_campus_visit_dt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.mail_optout_ind AS mail_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.email_optout_ind AS email_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.phone_optout_ind AS phone_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.sms_optin_ind AS sms_optin_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.sms_optout_ind AS sms_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.opt_out_ind AS opt_out_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_first_gen_ind AS eab_first_gen_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_pref_gender AS eab_pref_gender_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_international_ind AS eab_international_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_military_veteran_ind AS eab_military_veteran_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_alumni_relation_ind AS eab_alumni_relation_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_ethnicity AS eab_ethnicity_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_campus_visit_ind AS eab_campus_visit_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_mail_optout_ind AS eab_mail_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_email_optout_ind AS eab_email_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_phone_optout_ind AS eab_phone_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_sms_optin_ind AS eab_sms_optin_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_opt_out_ind AS eab_opt_out_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.intake_dt AS intake_dt_crm,
		null as join_partnercontact_id,
		null as join_partner_system_name

	FROM <[Enroll360].[Student].[Last Validated].{final}> as enr_stud_crm
	left join <[Enroll360].[Student ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> AS ps_xwalk
		on ps_xwalk.primary_student_id = enr_stud_crm.primary_student_id
),
student_sis AS 
(
 	SELECT
        COALESCE(ps_xwalk.eab_student_id, stud_sis.primary_student_id) AS eab_student_id_sis,
		COALESCE(ps_xwalk.eab_student_id_type, 'primary') AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
		stud_sis.primary_student_id AS primary_student_id_sis,
        stud_sis.sis_student_id AS sis_student_id_sis,
		stud_sis.crm_student_id AS crm_student_id_sis,
		stud_sis.other_student_id AS other_student_id_sis,
		stud_sis.fname AS fname_sis,
		stud_sis.mname AS mname_sis,
		stud_sis.lname AS lname_sis,
		stud_sis.preferred_fname AS preferred_fname_sis,
		stud_sis.us_citizenship_status AS us_citizenship_status_sis,
		stud_sis.international_ind AS international_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.birth_dt AS birth_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.gender AS gender_sis,
		stud_sis.pref_gender AS pref_gender_sis,
		stud_sis.religious_affiliation AS religious_affiliation_sis,
		stud_sis.hs_grad_year AS hs_grad_year_sis,
		stud_sis.origin_source AS origin_source_sis,
		stud_sis.origin_source_dt AS origin_source_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.first_gen_ind AS first_gen_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.military_service_status AS military_service_status_sis,
		stud_sis.alumni_relation_ind AS alumni_relation_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.hispanic_ind AS hispanic_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.ethnicity AS ethnicity_sis,
		stud_sis.campus_visit_cnt AS campus_visit_cnt_sis,
		stud_sis.campus_visit_ind AS campus_visit_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.first_campus_visit_dt AS first_campus_visit_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.last_campus_visit_dt AS last_campus_visit_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.mail_optout_ind AS mail_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.email_optout_ind AS email_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.phone_optout_ind AS phone_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.sms_optin_ind AS sms_optin_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.sms_optout_ind AS sms_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.opt_out_ind AS opt_out_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_first_gen_ind AS eab_first_gen_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_pref_gender AS eab_pref_gender_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_international_ind AS eab_international_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_military_veteran_ind AS eab_military_veteran_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_alumni_relation_ind AS eab_alumni_relation_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_ethnicity AS eab_ethnicity_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_campus_visit_ind AS eab_campus_visit_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_mail_optout_ind AS eab_mail_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_email_optout_ind AS eab_email_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_phone_optout_ind AS eab_phone_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_sms_optin_ind AS eab_sms_optin_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_opt_out_ind AS eab_opt_out_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.intake_dt AS intake_dt_sis
	FROM <[Enroll360].[Student SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> AS stud_sis
	left join <[Enroll360].[Student ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> AS ps_xwalk
		on ps_xwalk.primary_student_id = stud_sis.primary_student_id		
)
SELECT
		stud_crm.eab_student_id_crm,
		stud_sis.eab_student_id_sis,
		<eab_student_id> As eab_student_id,
		<eab_student_id> AS partnercontact_id,
		
		stud_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm,
		stud_sis.eab_student_id_type_sis,
		<eab_student_id_type> As eab_student_id_type,
        <eab_student_id_type> AS partner_system_name,
		
		stud_crm.primary_student_id_crm,
		stud_sis.primary_student_id_sis,
		<primary_student_id> As primary_student_id,
		
		stud_crm.sis_student_id_crm,
		stud_sis.sis_student_id_sis,
		<sis_student_id> AS sis_student_id,
		
		stud_crm.crm_student_id_crm,
		stud_sis.crm_student_id_sis,
		<crm_student_id> AS crm_student_id,
		
		stud_crm.other_student_id_crm,
		stud_sis.other_student_id_sis,
		<other_student_id> AS other_student_id,
		
		stud_crm.fname_crm,
		stud_sis.fname_sis,
		<fname> AS fname,
		
		stud_crm.mname_crm,
		stud_sis.mname_sis,
		<mname> AS mname,
		
		stud_crm.lname_crm,
		stud_sis.lname_sis,
		<lname> AS lname,
		
        stud_crm.preferred_fname_crm,
		stud_sis.preferred_fname_sis,
		<preferred_fname> AS preferred_fname,
		
        stud_crm.us_citizenship_status_crm,
		stud_sis.us_citizenship_status_sis,
		<us_citizenship_status> AS us_citizenship_status,
		
        stud_crm.international_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.international_ind_sis,
		<international_ind> AS international_ind,
		
        to_date(stud_crm.birth_dt_crm) AS birth_dt_crm,
		to_date(stud_sis.birth_dt_sis) AS birth_dt_sis,
		to_date(<birth_dt>) AS birth_dt,
		
		stud_crm.gender_crm,
		stud_sis.gender_sis,
		<gender> AS gender,
		
		stud_crm.pref_gender_crm,
		stud_sis.pref_gender_sis,
		<pref_gender> AS pref_gender,
		
		stud_crm.religious_affiliation_crm,
		stud_sis.religious_affiliation_sis,
		<religious_affiliation> AS religious_affiliation,
		
		stud_crm.hs_grad_year_crm,
		stud_sis.hs_grad_year_sis,
		<hs_grad_year> AS hs_grad_year,
		
		stud_crm.origin_source_crm,
		stud_sis.origin_source_sis,
		<origin_source> AS origin_source,
		
		to_date(stud_crm.origin_source_dt_crm) AS origin_source_dt_crm,
		to_date(stud_sis.origin_source_dt_sis) AS origin_source_dt_sis,
		to_date(<origin_source_dt>) AS origin_source_dt,
		
        stud_crm.first_gen_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.first_gen_ind_sis,
		<first_gen_ind> AS first_gen_ind,
		
        stud_crm.military_service_status_crm,
		stud_sis.military_service_status_sis,
		<military_service_status> AS military_service_status,
		
        stud_crm.alumni_relation_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.alumni_relation_ind_sis,
		<alumni_relation_ind> AS alumni_relation_ind,
		
        stud_crm.hispanic_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.hispanic_ind_sis,
		<hispanic_ind> AS hispanic_ind,
		
		stud_crm.ethnicity_crm,
		stud_sis.ethnicity_sis,
		<ethnicity> AS ethnicity,
		
		stud_crm.campus_visit_cnt_crm,
		stud_sis.campus_visit_cnt_sis,
		<campus_visit_cnt> AS campus_visit_cnt,
		
		stud_crm.campus_visit_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.campus_visit_ind_sis,
		<campus_visit_ind> AS campus_visit_ind,
		
		to_date(stud_crm.first_campus_visit_dt_crm) AS first_campus_visit_dt_crm,
		to_date(stud_sis.first_campus_visit_dt_sis) AS first_campus_visit_dt_sis,
		to_date(<first_campus_visit_dt>) AS first_campus_visit_dt,
		
		to_date(stud_crm.last_campus_visit_dt_crm) AS last_campus_visit_dt_crm,
		to_date(stud_sis.last_campus_visit_dt_sis) AS last_campus_visit_dt_sis,
		to_date(<last_campus_visit_dt>) AS last_campus_visit_dt,
		
		stud_crm.mail_optout_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.mail_optout_ind_sis,
		<mail_optout_ind> AS mail_optout_ind,
		
        stud_crm.email_optout_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.email_optout_ind_sis,
		<email_optout_ind> AS email_optout_ind,
		
        stud_crm.phone_optout_ind_crm,

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

WITH student_crm AS 
(
	SELECT
		enr_stud_crm.primary_student_id AS primary_student_id_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.sis_student_id AS sis_student_id_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.crm_student_id AS crm_student_id_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.other_student_id AS other_student_id_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.fname AS fname_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.mname AS mname_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.lname AS lname_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.preferred_fname AS preferred_fname_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.us_citizenship_status AS us_citizenship_status_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.international_ind AS international_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.birth_dt AS birth_dt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.gender AS gender_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.pref_gender AS pref_gender_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.religious_affiliation AS religious_affiliation_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.hs_grad_year AS hs_grad_year_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.origin_source AS origin_source_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.origin_source_dt AS origin_source_dt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.first_gen_ind AS first_gen_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.military_service_status AS military_service_status_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.alumni_relation_ind AS alumni_relation_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.hispanic_ind AS hispanic_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.ethnicity AS ethnicity_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.campus_visit_cnt AS campus_visit_cnt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.campus_visit_ind AS campus_visit_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.first_campus_visit_dt AS first_campus_visit_dt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.last_campus_visit_dt AS last_campus_visit_dt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.mail_optout_ind AS mail_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.email_optout_ind AS email_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.phone_optout_ind AS phone_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.sms_optin_ind AS sms_optin_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.sms_optout_ind AS sms_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.opt_out_ind AS opt_out_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_first_gen_ind AS eab_first_gen_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_pref_gender AS eab_pref_gender_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_international_ind AS eab_international_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_military_veteran_ind AS eab_military_veteran_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_alumni_relation_ind AS eab_alumni_relation_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_ethnicity AS eab_ethnicity_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_campus_visit_ind AS eab_campus_visit_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_mail_optout_ind AS eab_mail_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_email_optout_ind AS eab_email_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_phone_optout_ind AS eab_phone_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_sms_optin_ind AS eab_sms_optin_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_opt_out_ind AS eab_opt_out_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.intake_dt AS intake_dt_crm
	FROM <[Enroll360].[Student].[Last Validated].{final}> as enr_stud_crm
),
student_sis AS 
(
 	SELECT
        stud_sis.primary_student_id AS primary_student_id_sis,
        stud_sis.sis_student_id AS sis_student_id_sis,
		stud_sis.crm_student_id AS crm_student_id_sis,
		stud_sis.other_student_id AS other_student_id_sis,
		stud_sis.fin_aid_student_id AS fin_aid_student_id_sis,
		stud_sis.fname AS fname_sis,
		stud_sis.mname AS mname_sis,
		stud_sis.lname AS lname_sis,
		stud_sis.preferred_fname AS preferred_fname_sis,
		stud_sis.us_citizenship_status AS us_citizenship_status_sis,
		stud_sis.international_ind AS international_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.birth_dt AS birth_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.gender AS gender_sis,
		stud_sis.pref_gender AS pref_gender_sis,
		stud_sis.religious_affiliation AS religious_affiliation_sis,
		stud_sis.hs_grad_year AS hs_grad_year_sis,
		stud_sis.origin_source AS origin_source_sis,
		stud_sis.origin_source_dt AS origin_source_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.first_gen_ind AS first_gen_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.military_service_status AS military_service_status_sis,
		stud_sis.alumni_relation_ind AS alumni_relation_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.hispanic_ind AS hispanic_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.ethnicity AS ethnicity_sis,
		stud_sis.campus_visit_cnt AS campus_visit_cnt_sis,
		stud_sis.campus_visit_ind AS campus_visit_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.first_campus_visit_dt AS first_campus_visit_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.last_campus_visit_dt AS last_campus_visit_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.mail_optout_ind AS mail_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.email_optout_ind AS email_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.phone_optout_ind AS phone_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.sms_optin_ind AS sms_optin_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.sms_optout_ind AS sms_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.opt_out_ind AS opt_out_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_first_gen_ind AS eab_first_gen_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_pref_gender AS eab_pref_gender_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_international_ind AS eab_international_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_military_veteran_ind AS eab_military_veteran_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_alumni_relation_ind AS eab_alumni_relation_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_ethnicity AS eab_ethnicity_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_campus_visit_ind AS eab_campus_visit_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_mail_optout_ind AS eab_mail_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_email_optout_ind AS eab_email_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_phone_optout_ind AS eab_phone_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_sms_optin_ind AS eab_sms_optin_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_opt_out_ind AS eab_opt_out_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.intake_dt AS intake_dt_sis
	FROM <[Enroll360].[Student SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> AS stud_sis
)

select distinct * from (

SELECT
		<eab_student_id> As eab_student_id,
		<eab_student_id_type> As eab_student_id_type,
        <partnercontact_id> AS partnercontact_id,
		<partner_system_name> AS partner_system_name,
		
		stud_crm.primary_student_id_crm,
		stud_sis.primary_student_id_sis,
		<primary_student_id> As primary_student_id,		
		
		stud_crm.sis_student_id_crm,
		stud_sis.sis_student_id_sis,
		<sis_student_id> AS sis_student_id,
		
		stud_crm.crm_student_id_crm,
		stud_sis.crm_student_id_sis,
		<crm_student_id> AS crm_student_id,
		
		stud_crm.other_student_id_crm,
		stud_sis.other_student_id_sis,
		<other_student_id> AS other_student_id,
		
		stud_sis.fin_aid_student_id_sis as fin_aid_student_id,

		stud_crm.fname_crm,
		stud_sis.fname_sis,
		<fname> AS fname,
		
		stud_crm.mname_crm,
		stud_sis.mname_sis,
		<mname> AS mname,
		
		stud_crm.lname_crm,
		stud_sis.lname_sis,
		<lname> AS lname,
		
        stud_crm.preferred_fname_crm,
		stud_sis.preferred_fname_sis,
		<preferred_fname> AS preferred_fname,
		
        stud_crm.us_citizenship_status_crm,
		stud_sis.us_citizenship_status_sis,
		<us_citizenship_status> AS us_citizenship_status,
		
        stud_crm.international_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.international_ind_sis,
		<international_ind> AS international_ind,
		
        to_date(stud_crm.birth_dt_crm) AS birth_dt_crm,
		to_date(stud_sis.birth_dt_sis) AS birth_dt_sis,
		to_date(<birth_dt>) AS birth_dt,
		
		stud_crm.gender_crm,
		stud_sis.gender_sis,
		<gender> AS gender,
		
		stud_crm.pref_gender_crm,
		stud_sis.pref_gender_sis,
		<pref_gender> AS pref_gender,
		
		stud_crm.religious_affiliation_crm,
		stud_sis.religious_affiliation_sis,
		<religious_affiliation> AS religious_affiliation,
		
		stud_crm.hs_grad_year_crm,
		stud_sis.hs_grad_year_sis,
		<hs_grad_year> AS hs_grad_year,
		
		stud_crm.origin_source_crm,
		stud_sis.origin_source_sis,
		<origin_source> AS origin_source,
		
		to_date(stud_crm.origin_source_dt_crm) AS origin_source_dt_crm,
		to_date(stud_sis.origin_source_dt_sis) AS origin_source_dt_sis,
		to_date(<origin_source_dt>) AS origin_source_dt,
		
        stud_crm.first_gen_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.first_gen_ind_sis,
		<first_gen_ind> AS first_gen_ind,
		
        stud_crm.military_service_status_crm,
		stud_sis.military_service_status_sis,
		<military_service_status> AS military_service_status,
		
        stud_crm.alumni_relation_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.alumni_relation_ind_sis,
		<alumni_relation_ind> AS alumni_relation_ind,
		
        stud_crm.hispanic_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.hispanic_ind_sis,
		<hispanic_ind> AS hispanic_ind,
		
		stud_crm.ethnicity_crm,
		stud_sis.ethnicity_sis,
		<ethnicity> AS ethnicity,
		
		stud_crm.campus_visit_cnt_crm,
		stud_sis.campus_visit_cnt_sis,
		<campus_visit_cnt> AS campus_visit_cnt,
		
		stud_crm.campus_visit_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.campus_visit_ind_sis,
		<campus_visit_ind> AS campus_visit_ind,
		
		to_date(stud_crm.first_campus_visit_dt_crm) AS first_campus_visit_dt_crm,
		to_date(stud_sis.first_campus_visit_dt_sis) AS first_campus_visit_dt_sis,
		to_date(<first_campus_visit_dt>) AS first_campus_visit_dt,
		
		to_date(stud_crm.last_campus_visit_dt_crm) AS last_campus_visit_dt_crm,
		to_date(stud_sis.last_campus_visit_dt_sis) AS last_campus_visit_dt_sis,
		to_date(<last_campus_visit_dt>) AS last_campus_visit_dt,
		
		stud_crm.mail_optout_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.mail_optout_ind_sis,
		<mail_optout_ind> AS mail_optout_ind,
		
        stud_crm.email_optout_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.email_optout_ind_sis,
		<email_optout_ind> AS email_optout_ind,
		
        stud_crm.phone_optout_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.phone_optout_ind_sis,
		<phone_optout_ind> AS phone_optout_ind,
		
        stud_crm.sms_optin_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.sms_optin_ind_sis,
		<sms_optin_ind> AS sms_optin_ind,
		
        stud_crm.sms_optout_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.sms_optout_ind_sis,
		<sms_optout_ind> AS sms_optout_ind,
		
		stud_crm.opt_out_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.opt_out_ind_sis,
		<opt_out_ind> AS opt_out_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_first_gen_ind_crm) AS eab_first_gen_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_first_gen_ind_sis) AS eab_first_gen_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_first_gen_ind>) AS eab_first_gen_ind,
		
		stud_crm.eab_pref_gender_crm,
		stud_sis.eab_pref_gender_sis,
		<eab_pref_gender> AS eab_pref_gender,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_international_ind_crm) AS eab_international_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_international_ind_sis) AS eab_international_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_international_ind>) AS eab_international_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_military_veteran_ind_crm) AS eab_military_veteran_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_military_veteran_ind_sis) AS eab_military_veteran_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_military_veteran_ind>) AS eab_military_veteran_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_alumni_relation_ind_crm) AS eab_alumni_relation_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_alumni_relation_ind_sis) AS eab_alumni_relation_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_alumni_relation_ind>) AS eab_alumni_relation_ind,
		
        stud_crm.eab_ethnicity_crm,
		stud_sis.eab_ethnicity_sis,
		<eab_ethnicity> AS eab_ethnicity,
		
        to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_campus_visit_ind_crm) AS eab_campus_visit_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_campus_visit_ind_sis) AS eab_campus_visit_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_campus_visit_ind>) AS eab_campus_visit_ind,
		
        to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_mail_optout_ind_crm) AS eab_mail_optout_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_mail_optout_ind_sis) AS eab_mail_optout_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_mail_optout_ind>) AS eab_mail_optout_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_email_optout_ind_crm) AS eab_email_optout_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_email_optout_ind_sis) AS eab_email_optout_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_email_optout_ind>) AS eab_email_optout_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_phone_optout_ind_crm) AS eab_phone_optout_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_phone_optout_ind_sis) AS eab_phone_optout_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_phone_optout_ind>) AS eab_phone_optout_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_sms_optin_ind_crm) AS eab_sms_optin_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_sms_optin_ind_sis) AS eab_sms_optin_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_sms_optin_ind>) AS eab_sms_optin_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_opt_out_ind_crm) AS eab_opt_out_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_opt_out_ind_sis) AS eab_opt_out_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_opt_out_ind>) AS eab_opt_out_ind,
		
		to_timestamp(stud_crm.intake_dt_crm) AS intake_dt_crm,
		to_timestamp(stud_sis.intake_dt_sis) AS intake_dt_sis,
		to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt

FROM student_sis as stud_sis

<join_extension.Student PDP Delivery> --join to ID Xwalk and SIS tables located here

) stud_agg
WHERE 1=1
and coalesce(stud_agg.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and	coalesce(stud_agg.partner_system_name,'') <> ''

queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-06-16: updated to align more with Atlas merge version. This version *does not* merge data between SIS and CRM feed since join IDs are null.
- references to fin_aid_student_id (FAO only field) and <fin_aid_student_id> variable added, where variable added <where_statement.Student PDP Delivery> - ccreekman*/
/*2026-03-03: <partnercontact_id>,<partner_system_name> master bundle updated to choose ID in this order: crm ID from merged record > join ID from SIS record, SIS ID 
join fields are in merge query, null placecholder fields added to this query - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-07: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473; corrected where statement - ccreekman*/
WITH 
student_sis_fao as (
  SELECT * from (
  SELECT distinct
  	null as join_partnercontact_id, /*field used in merge query variables so must be present here; do not delete*/
	null as join_partner_system_name, /*field used in merge query variables so must be present here; do not delete*/
	stud.*,
  row_number() over(partition by stud.partnercontact_id, stud.partner_system_name
		order by stud.intake_dt desc nulls last) as stud_rn

  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stud
)agg
where 1=1
and agg.stud_rn = 1
)	
	
	
select * from (
select distinct *
, row_number() over (partition by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.partner_system_name
				   order by agg.intake_dt desc nulls last) rn
from (

SELECT 
	crm_ug.primary_student_id as primary_student_id_crm,
	sis_fao.primary_student_id as primary_student_id_sis,
  	<primary_student_id> as primary_student_id,

    sis_fao.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_sis,
    sis_fao.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
    crm_ug.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_crm,
    crm_ug.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_crm,
    <eab_student_id> AS eab_student_id, /*default: sis > crm*/
    <eab_student_id_type> AS eab_student_id_type, /*default: sis > crm*/

    sis_fao.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_sis,
    sis_fao.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_sis,
    crm_ug.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_crm,
    crm_ug.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_crm,
    <partnercontact_id> AS partnercontact_id, /*default: crm > join > sis*/
    <partner_system_name> AS partner_system_name, /*default: crm > join > sis*/

	crm_ug.sis_student_id as sis_student_id_crm,
	sis_fao.sis_student_id as sis_student_id_sis,
	<sis_student_id> AS sis_student_id,
		
	crm_ug.crm_student_id as crm_student_id_crm,
	sis_fao.crm_student_id as crm_student_id_sis,
	<crm_student_id> AS crm_student_id,
		
	crm_ug.other_student_id as other_student_id_crm,
	sis_fao.other_student_id as other_student_id_sis,
	<other_student_id> AS other_student_id,

	null as fin_aid_student_id_crm,
  	sis_fao.fin_aid_student_id as fin_aid_student_id_sis,
  	<fin_aid_student_id> as fin_aid_student_id,
	
	crm_ug.fname as fname_crm,
	sis_fao.fname as fname_sis,
	<fname> AS fname,
	
	crm_ug.mname as mname_crm,
	sis_fao.mname as mname_sis,
	<mname> AS mname,
	
	crm_ug.lname as lname_crm,
	sis_fao.lname as lname_sis,
	<lname> AS lname,
	
    crm_ug.preferred_fname as preferred_fname_crm,
	sis_fao.preferred_fname as preferred_fname_sis,

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

        to_date(stud_crm.birth_dt_crm) AS birth_dt_crm,
		to_date(stud_sis.birth_dt_sis) AS birth_dt_sis,
		to_date(<birth_dt>) AS birth_dt,
		
		stud_crm.gender_crm,
		stud_sis.gender_sis,
		<gender> AS gender,
		
		stud_crm.pref_gender_crm,

		to_date(<origin_source_dt>) AS origin_source_dt,
		
        stud_crm.first_gen_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.first_gen_ind_sis,
		<first_gen_ind> AS first_gen_ind,
		
        stud_crm.military_service_status_crm,
		stud_sis.military_service_status_sis,
		<military_service_status> AS military_service_status,
		
        stud_crm.alumni_relation_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.alumni_relation_ind_sis,

		stud_sis.sms_optin_ind_sis,
		<sms_optin_ind> AS sms_optin_ind,
		
        stud_crm.sms_optout_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.sms_optout_ind_sis,
		<sms_optout_ind> AS sms_optout_ind,
		
		stud_crm.opt_out_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.opt_out_ind_sis,
		<opt_out_ind> AS opt_out_ind,

		stud_crm.eab_pref_gender_crm,
		stud_sis.eab_pref_gender_sis,
		<eab_pref_gender> AS eab_pref_gender,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_international_ind_crm) AS eab_international_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_international_ind_sis) AS eab_international_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_international_ind>) AS eab_international_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_military_veteran_ind_crm) AS eab_military_veteran_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_military_veteran_ind_sis) AS eab_military_veteran_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_military_veteran_ind>) AS eab_military_veteran_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_alumni_relation_ind_crm) AS eab_alumni_relation_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_alumni_relation_ind_sis) AS eab_alumni_relation_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_alumni_relation_ind>) AS eab_alumni_relation_ind,
		
        stud_crm.eab_ethnicity_crm,
		stud_sis.eab_ethnicity_sis,
		<eab_ethnicity> AS eab_ethnicity,
		
        to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_campus_visit_ind_crm) AS eab_campus_visit_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_campus_visit_ind_sis) AS eab_campus_visit_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_campus_visit_ind>) AS eab_campus_visit_ind,
		
        to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_mail_optout_ind_crm) AS eab_mail_optout_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_mail_optout_ind_sis) AS eab_mail_optout_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_mail_optout_ind>) AS eab_mail_optout_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_email_optout_ind_crm) AS eab_email_optout_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_email_optout_ind_sis) AS eab_email_optout_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_email_optout_ind>) AS eab_email_optout_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_phone_optout_ind_crm) AS eab_phone_optout_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_phone_optout_ind_sis) AS eab_phone_optout_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_phone_optout_ind>) AS eab_phone_optout_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_sms_optin_ind_crm) AS eab_sms_optin_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_sms_optin_ind_sis) AS eab_sms_optin_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_sms_optin_ind>) AS eab_sms_optin_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_opt_out_ind_crm) AS eab_opt_out_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_opt_out_ind_sis) AS eab_opt_out_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_opt_out_ind>) AS eab_opt_out_ind,
		
		to_timestamp(stud_crm.intake_dt_crm) AS intake_dt_crm,
		to_timestamp(stud_sis.intake_dt_sis) AS intake_dt_sis,
		to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt

FROM student_crm as stud_crm
FULL OUTER JOIN student_sis as stud_sis
			ON stud_sis.eab_student_id_sis = stud_crm.eab_student_id_crm
			AND stud_sis.eab_student_id_type_sis = stud_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm
WHERE (stud_sis.eab_student_id_sis IS NOT NULL AND stud_sis.eab_student_id_type_sis IS NOT NULL) OR (stud_crm.eab_student_id_crm IS NOT NULL AND stud_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm IS NOT NULL)

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-06-16: references to fin_aid_student_id (FAO only field) and <fin_aid_student_id> variable added, where variable added <where_statement.Student PDP Delivery> - ccreekman*/
/*2026-03-03: crm psname crossjoin now checks STerm to ensure we are populating pcID even if crm table does not have data, 
<partnercontact_id>,<partner_system_name> master bundle updated to choose ID in this order: crm ID from merged record > join ID from SIS record, SIS ID - ccreekman*/
/*2026-02-09: removed to_date on origin_source_dt to allow any timestamps to persist- ccreekman*/
/*2026-01-13: merge query notes - ccreekman
student_sis_fao cte: takes all SIS data, appends any partner_system_name(s) that are present in CRM_UG Student.final
	Expectation is for one partner_system_name in CRM_UG Student.final, but set up to account for crm changes, other scenarios where there may be a mix of ID types
	Uses this to pull in only IDs from Xwalk that align with CRM_UG Student.final partner_system_name(s), excluding any irrelevant matching ID pairs
	if there are multiple CRM_UG Student.final partner_system_names, multiple rows per SIS record will be created
	deduping logic will exclude records with null join_partnercontact_id only if there is not a record with a populated join_partnercontact_id
	multiple records per student may still persist if they have unique populated join_partnercontact_id/join_partner_system_name values
	in that scenario resulting counts on this table may be inflated, need further examples to determine if we need to build in variables to allow customization here
main query: takes results from student_sis_fao cte and does a full outer join to CRM_UG Student.final using the join ID / ID type (if populated)
	crm join currently in variables - unclear if we need that level of customization available
*/
WITH 
student_sis_fao as (
  SELECT * from (
  SELECT distinct
  	id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id as join_partnercontact_id,
	id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name as join_partner_system_name,
	stud.*,
  row_number() over(partition by stud.partnercontact_id, stud.partner_system_name
		order by id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id) as rn

  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stud

  /*cross join below will associate current crm_ug partner_system_name(s) with SIS record to limit the IDs pulled from xwalk to relevent psnames
  join parcontID/psname will later only be populated when Xwalk has records where one ID pair is the parcontID/psname from this SIS data 
  and the other set has a psname that matches what we appended here
  eg: partner xwalk includes psnames of sis_01, sis_02, primary, crm_01 but crm tables only have ID psns of primary, crm_01 so only those are appended to the records*/ 
  CROSS JOIN (
  		select distinct partner_system_name as crm_ug_partner_system_name
		FROM <[Enroll360].[Student].[Last Validated].{final}> stud_crm
		union
		select distinct partner_system_name as crm_ug_partner_system_name
		FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term].[Last Validated].{final}> stud_crm
  		) crm_psn

  LEFT JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> id_xwalk
	on (stud.partnercontact_id = id_xwalk.target_partnercontact_id
	and coalesce(stud.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(id_xwalk.target_partner_system_name,'')
	and coalesce(crm_psn.CRM_UG_PARTNER_SYSTEM_NAME,'') = coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name,''))
)agg
where 1=1
/*xwalk may have multiple id pairs which meet join criteria
	this criteria limits the result set to only allow necessary dupes
	[rn = 1]: to ensure at least one copy of the SIS record is retained regardless if there is a match in ID Xwalk
	[agg.join_partnercontact_id is not null]: any dupes with distinct partnercontact_id/partner_system_name*/

and (agg.join_partnercontact_id is not null or rn = 1) 
--and agg.join_partnercontact_id is null /*for troubleshooting - SIS records with no xwalk match*/
)


select * from (
select distinct *
, row_number() over (partition by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.partner_system_name
				   order by agg.intake_dt desc nulls last) rn
from (

SELECT 
	crm_ug.primary_student_id as primary_student_id_crm,
	sis_fao.primary_student_id as primary_student_id_sis,
  	<primary_student_id> as primary_student_id,

    sis_fao.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_sis,
    sis_fao.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
    crm_ug.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_crm,
    crm_ug.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_crm,
    <eab_student_id> AS eab_student_id, /*default: sis > crm*/
    <eab_student_id_type> AS eab_student_id_type, /*default: sis > crm*/

    sis_fao.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_sis,
    sis_fao.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_sis,
    crm_ug.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_crm,
    crm_ug.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_crm,
    <partnercontact_id> AS partnercontact_id, /*default: crm > join > sis*/
    <partner_system_name> AS partner_system_name, /*default: crm > join > sis*/

	crm_ug.sis_student_id as sis_student_id_crm,
	sis_fao.sis_student_id as sis_student_id_sis,
	<sis_student_id> AS sis_student_id,
		
	crm_ug.crm_student_id as crm_student_id_crm,
	sis_fao.crm_student_id as crm_student_id_sis,
	<crm_student_id> AS crm_student_id,
		
	crm_ug.other_student_id as other_student_id_crm,
	sis_fao.other_student_id as other_student_id_sis,
	<other_student_id> AS other_student_id,
	
	null as fin_aid_student_id_crm,
  	sis_fao.fin_aid_student_id as fin_aid_student_id_sis,
  	<fin_aid_student_id> as fin_aid_student_id,
	
	crm_ug.fname as fname_crm,
	sis_fao.fname as fname_sis,
	<fname> AS fname,
	
	crm_ug.mname as mname_crm,
	sis_fao.mname as mname_sis,
	<mname> AS mname,
	
	crm_ug.lname as lname_crm,
	sis_fao.lname as lname_sis,
	<lname> AS lname,
	
    crm_ug.preferred_fname as preferred_fname_crm,
	sis_fao.preferred_fname as preferred_fname_sis,
	<preferred_fname> AS preferred_fname,
	
    crm_ug.us_citizenship_status as us_citizenship_status_crm,
	sis_fao.us_citizenship_status as us_citizenship_status_sis,
	<us_citizenship_status> AS us_citizenship_status,
		
    crm_ug.international_ind as international_ind_crm,
	sis_fao.international_ind as international_ind_sis,

<join_extension.Student PDP Delivery>

where <where_statement.Student PDP Delivery>
and (coalesce(crm_ug.partnercontact_id,'') <> '' and coalesce(crm_ug.partner_system_name,'') <> '')
or (coalesce(sis_fao.partnercontact_id,'') <> '' and coalesce(sis_fao.partner_system_name,'') <> '')

) agg

) agg2
where agg2.rn = 1

order by (
  	agg2.partnercontact_id_crm||agg2.partnercontact_id_sis) nulls last, /*null in either field will return null, merged records (both fields populated) will come before non-merged records in results*/

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

		enr_stud_crm.gender AS gender_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.pref_gender AS pref_gender_crm,

		enr_stud_crm.origin_source AS origin_source_crm,

		enr_stud_crm.first_gen_ind AS first_gen_ind_crm,

		enr_stud_crm.mail_optout_ind AS mail_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.email_optout_ind AS email_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.phone_optout_ind AS phone_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.sms_optin_ind AS sms_optin_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.sms_optout_ind AS sms_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.opt_out_ind AS opt_out_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_first_gen_ind AS eab_first_gen_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_pref_gender AS eab_pref_gender_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_international_ind AS eab_international_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_military_veteran_ind AS eab_military_veteran_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_alumni_relation_ind AS eab_alumni_relation_ind_crm,

	left join <[Enroll360].[Student ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> AS ps_xwalk

),

(
 	SELECT
        COALESCE(ps_xwalk.eab_student_id, stud_sis.primary_student_id) AS eab_student_id_sis,

		stud_sis.birth_dt AS birth_dt_sis,

		stud_sis.pref_gender AS pref_gender_sis,
		stud_sis.religious_affiliation AS religious_affiliation_sis,
		stud_sis.hs_grad_year AS hs_grad_year_sis,
		stud_sis.origin_source AS origin_source_sis,
		stud_sis.origin_source_dt AS origin_source_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.first_gen_ind AS first_gen_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.military_service_status AS military_service_status_sis,
		stud_sis.alumni_relation_ind AS alumni_relation_ind_sis,

		stud_sis.ethnicity AS ethnicity_sis,
		stud_sis.campus_visit_cnt AS campus_visit_cnt_sis,
		stud_sis.campus_visit_ind AS campus_visit_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.first_campus_visit_dt AS first_campus_visit_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.last_campus_visit_dt AS last_campus_visit_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.mail_optout_ind AS mail_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.email_optout_ind AS email_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.phone_optout_ind AS phone_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.sms_optin_ind AS sms_optin_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.sms_optout_ind AS sms_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.opt_out_ind AS opt_out_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_first_gen_ind AS eab_first_gen_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_pref_gender AS eab_pref_gender_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_international_ind AS eab_international_ind_sis,

		stud_sis.eab_sms_optin_ind AS eab_sms_optin_ind_sis,

		stud_crm.primary_student_id_crm,

		to_date(stud_crm.origin_source_dt_crm) AS origin_source_dt_crm,

        stud_crm.eab_ethnicity_crm,

        to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_campus_visit_ind_crm) AS eab_campus_visit_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_campus_visit_ind_sis) AS eab_campus_visit_ind_sis,
		--to_boolean(<eab_campus_visit_ind>) AS eab_campus_visit_ind,
		to_boolean(coalesce(stud_sis.eab_campus_visit_ind_sis, stud_crm.eab_campus_visit_ind_crm)) as eab_campus_visit_ind,
		
        to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_mail_optout_ind_crm) AS eab_mail_optout_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_mail_optout_ind_sis) AS eab_mail_optout_ind_sis,
		--to_boolean(<eab_mail_optout_ind>) AS eab_mail_optout_ind,
		to_boolean(coalesce(stud_sis.eab_mail_optout_ind_sis, stud_crm.eab_mail_optout_ind_crm)) as eab_mail_optout_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_email_optout_ind_crm) AS eab_email_optout_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_email_optout_ind_sis) AS eab_email_optout_ind_sis,
		--to_boolean(<eab_email_optout_ind>) AS eab_email_optout_ind,
		to_boolean(coalesce(stud_sis.eab_email_optout_ind_sis, stud_crm.eab_email_optout_ind_crm)) as eab_email_optout_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_phone_optout_ind_crm) AS eab_phone_optout_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_phone_optout_ind_sis) AS eab_phone_optout_ind_sis,
		--to_boolean(<eab_phone_optout_ind>) AS eab_phone_optout_ind,
		to_boolean(coalesce(stud_sis.eab_phone_optout_ind_sis, stud_crm.eab_phone_optout_ind_crm)) as eab_phone_optout_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_sms_optin_ind_crm) AS eab_sms_optin_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_sms_optin_ind_sis) AS eab_sms_optin_ind_sis,
		--to_boolean(<eab_sms_optin_ind>) AS eab_sms_optin_ind,
		to_boolean(coalesce(stud_sis.eab_sms_optin_ind_sis, stud_crm.eab_sms_optin_ind_crm)) as eab_sms_optin_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_opt_out_ind_crm) AS eab_opt_out_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_opt_out_ind_sis) AS eab_opt_out_ind_sis,
		--to_boolean(<eab_opt_out_ind>) AS eab_opt_out_ind,
		to_boolean(coalesce(stud_sis.eab_opt_out_ind_sis, stud_crm.eab_opt_out_ind_crm)) as eab_opt_out_ind,
		
		to_timestamp(stud_crm.intake_dt_crm) AS intake_dt_crm,
		to_timestamp(stud_sis.intake_dt_sis) AS intake_dt_sis,
		--to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt
		to_timestamp(coalesce(stud_sis.intake_dt_sis, stud_crm.intake_dt_crm)) as intake_dt
		
FROM student_crm as stud_crm
FULL OUTER JOIN student_sis as stud_sis
			ON stud_sis.eab_student_id_sis = stud_crm.eab_student_id_crm
			AND stud_sis.eab_student_id_type_sis = stud_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm
							  
where EAB_STUDENT_ID_CRM is not null and EAB_STUDENT_ID_SIS is not null

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

WITH student_crm AS 
(
	SELECT
		COALESCE(ps_xwalk.eab_student_id, enr_stud_crm.primary_student_id) AS eab_student_id_crm,
		COALESCE(ps_xwalk.eab_student_id_type, 'primary') AS eab_student_id_type_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.primary_student_id AS primary_student_id_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.sis_student_id AS sis_student_id_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.crm_student_id AS crm_student_id_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.other_student_id AS other_student_id_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.fname AS fname_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.mname AS mname_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.lname AS lname_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.preferred_fname AS preferred_fname_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.us_citizenship_status AS us_citizenship_status_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.international_ind AS international_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.birth_dt AS birth_dt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.gender AS gender_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.pref_gender AS pref_gender_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.religious_affiliation AS religious_affiliation_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.hs_grad_year AS hs_grad_year_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.origin_source AS origin_source_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.origin_source_dt AS origin_source_dt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.first_gen_ind AS first_gen_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.military_service_status AS military_service_status_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.alumni_relation_ind AS alumni_relation_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.hispanic_ind AS hispanic_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.ethnicity AS ethnicity_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.campus_visit_cnt AS campus_visit_cnt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.campus_visit_ind AS campus_visit_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.first_campus_visit_dt AS first_campus_visit_dt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.last_campus_visit_dt AS last_campus_visit_dt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.mail_optout_ind AS mail_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.email_optout_ind AS email_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.phone_optout_ind AS phone_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.sms_optin_ind AS sms_optin_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.sms_optout_ind AS sms_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.opt_out_ind AS opt_out_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_first_gen_ind AS eab_first_gen_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_pref_gender AS eab_pref_gender_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_international_ind AS eab_international_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_military_veteran_ind AS eab_military_veteran_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_alumni_relation_ind AS eab_alumni_relation_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_ethnicity AS eab_ethnicity_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_campus_visit_ind AS eab_campus_visit_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_mail_optout_ind AS eab_mail_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_email_optout_ind AS eab_email_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_phone_optout_ind AS eab_phone_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_sms_optin_ind AS eab_sms_optin_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_opt_out_ind AS eab_opt_out_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.intake_dt AS intake_dt_crm
	FROM <[Enroll360].[Student].[Last Validated].{final}> as enr_stud_crm
	left join <[Enroll360].[Student ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> AS ps_xwalk
		on ps_xwalk.primary_student_id = enr_stud_crm.primary_student_id
),
student_sis AS 
(
 	SELECT
        COALESCE(ps_xwalk.eab_student_id, stud_sis.primary_student_id) AS eab_student_id_sis,
		COALESCE(ps_xwalk.eab_student_id_type, 'primary') AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
		stud_sis.primary_student_id AS primary_student_id_sis,
        stud_sis.sis_student_id AS sis_student_id_sis,
		stud_sis.crm_student_id AS crm_student_id_sis,
		stud_sis.other_student_id AS other_student_id_sis,
		stud_sis.fname AS fname_sis,
		stud_sis.mname AS mname_sis,
		stud_sis.lname AS lname_sis,

		stud_sis.us_citizenship_status AS us_citizenship_status_sis,
		stud_sis.international_ind AS international_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.birth_dt AS birth_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.gender AS gender_sis,
		stud_sis.pref_gender AS pref_gender_sis,
		stud_sis.religious_affiliation AS religious_affiliation_sis,
		stud_sis.hs_grad_year AS hs_grad_year_sis,
		stud_sis.origin_source AS origin_source_sis,
		stud_sis.origin_source_dt AS origin_source_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.first_gen_ind AS first_gen_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.military_service_status AS military_service_status_sis,
		stud_sis.alumni_relation_ind AS alumni_relation_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.hispanic_ind AS hispanic_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.ethnicity AS ethnicity_sis,
		stud_sis.campus_visit_cnt AS campus_visit_cnt_sis,
		stud_sis.campus_visit_ind AS campus_visit_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.first_campus_visit_dt AS first_campus_visit_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.last_campus_visit_dt AS last_campus_visit_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.mail_optout_ind AS mail_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.email_optout_ind AS email_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.phone_optout_ind AS phone_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.sms_optin_ind AS sms_optin_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.sms_optout_ind AS sms_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.opt_out_ind AS opt_out_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_first_gen_ind AS eab_first_gen_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_pref_gender AS eab_pref_gender_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_international_ind AS eab_international_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_military_veteran_ind AS eab_military_veteran_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_alumni_relation_ind AS eab_alumni_relation_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_ethnicity AS eab_ethnicity_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_campus_visit_ind AS eab_campus_visit_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_mail_optout_ind AS eab_mail_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_email_optout_ind AS eab_email_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_phone_optout_ind AS eab_phone_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_sms_optin_ind AS eab_sms_optin_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_opt_out_ind AS eab_opt_out_ind_sis,

	left join <[Enroll360].[Student ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> AS ps_xwalk

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

        to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_mail_optout_ind_crm) AS eab_mail_optout_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_mail_optout_ind_sis) AS eab_mail_optout_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_mail_optout_ind>) AS eab_mail_optout_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_email_optout_ind_crm) AS eab_email_optout_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_email_optout_ind_sis) AS eab_email_optout_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_email_optout_ind>) AS eab_email_optout_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_phone_optout_ind_crm) AS eab_phone_optout_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_phone_optout_ind_sis) AS eab_phone_optout_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_phone_optout_ind>) AS eab_phone_optout_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_sms_optin_ind_crm) AS eab_sms_optin_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_sms_optin_ind_sis) AS eab_sms_optin_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_sms_optin_ind>) AS eab_sms_optin_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_opt_out_ind_crm) AS eab_opt_out_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_opt_out_ind_sis) AS eab_opt_out_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_opt_out_ind>) AS eab_opt_out_ind,
		
		to_timestamp(stud_crm.intake_dt_crm) AS intake_dt_crm,
		to_timestamp(stud_sis.intake_dt_sis) AS intake_dt_sis,
		to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt

FROM student_crm as stud_crm
FULL OUTER JOIN student_sis as stud_sis
			ON stud_sis.eab_student_id_sis = stud_crm.eab_student_id_crm
			AND stud_sis.eab_student_id_type_sis = stud_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm
WHERE (stud_sis.eab_student_id_sis IS NOT NULL AND stud_sis.eab_student_id_type_sis IS NOT NULL) OR (stud_crm.eab_student_id_crm IS NOT NULL AND stud_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm IS NOT NULL)

/*2025-10-15: removed ID xwalk references and hardcoded SIS eab_student_id_type to fix issues with that join, 
this is temporary fix for Denver until we figure out the new ID Xwalk integration and make changes to the Combined Feed - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-07: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473; corrected where statement - ccreekman*/
WITH student_crm AS 
(
	SELECT
		--COALESCE(ps_xwalk.eab_student_id, enr_stud_crm.primary_student_id) AS eab_student_id_crm,
		--COALESCE(ps_xwalk.eab_student_id_type, 'primary') AS eab_student_id_type_crm,
  		enr_stud_crm.primary_student_id AS eab_student_id_crm,
		'primary' AS eab_student_id_type_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.primary_student_id AS primary_student_id_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.sis_student_id AS sis_student_id_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.crm_student_id AS crm_student_id_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.other_student_id AS other_student_id_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.fname AS fname_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.mname AS mname_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.lname AS lname_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.preferred_fname AS preferred_fname_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.us_citizenship_status AS us_citizenship_status_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.international_ind AS international_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.birth_dt AS birth_dt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.gender AS gender_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.pref_gender AS pref_gender_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.religious_affiliation AS religious_affiliation_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.hs_grad_year AS hs_grad_year_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.origin_source AS origin_source_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.origin_source_dt AS origin_source_dt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.first_gen_ind AS first_gen_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.military_service_status AS military_service_status_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.alumni_relation_ind AS alumni_relation_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.hispanic_ind AS hispanic_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.ethnicity AS ethnicity_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.campus_visit_cnt AS campus_visit_cnt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.campus_visit_ind AS campus_visit_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.first_campus_visit_dt AS first_campus_visit_dt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.last_campus_visit_dt AS last_campus_visit_dt_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.mail_optout_ind AS mail_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.email_optout_ind AS email_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.phone_optout_ind AS phone_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.sms_optin_ind AS sms_optin_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.sms_optout_ind AS sms_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.opt_out_ind AS opt_out_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_first_gen_ind AS eab_first_gen_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_pref_gender AS eab_pref_gender_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_international_ind AS eab_international_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_military_veteran_ind AS eab_military_veteran_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_alumni_relation_ind AS eab_alumni_relation_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_ethnicity AS eab_ethnicity_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_campus_visit_ind AS eab_campus_visit_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_mail_optout_ind AS eab_mail_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_email_optout_ind AS eab_email_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_phone_optout_ind AS eab_phone_optout_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_sms_optin_ind AS eab_sms_optin_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.eab_opt_out_ind AS eab_opt_out_ind_crm,
		enr_stud_crm.intake_dt AS intake_dt_crm
	FROM <[Enroll360].[Student].[Last Validated].{final}> as enr_stud_crm
	--left join <[Enroll360].[Student ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> AS ps_xwalk
		--on ps_xwalk.primary_student_id = enr_stud_crm.primary_student_id
),
student_sis AS 
(
 	SELECT
        --COALESCE(ps_xwalk.eab_student_id, stud_sis.primary_student_id) AS eab_student_id_sis,
		--COALESCE(ps_xwalk.eab_student_id_type, 'primary') AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
		stud_sis.primary_student_id AS eab_student_id_sis,
		'sis_banner_1' AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
		stud_sis.primary_student_id AS primary_student_id_sis,
        stud_sis.sis_student_id AS sis_student_id_sis,
		stud_sis.crm_student_id AS crm_student_id_sis,
		stud_sis.other_student_id AS other_student_id_sis,
		stud_sis.fname AS fname_sis,
		stud_sis.mname AS mname_sis,
		stud_sis.lname AS lname_sis,
		stud_sis.preferred_fname AS preferred_fname_sis,
		stud_sis.us_citizenship_status AS us_citizenship_status_sis,
		stud_sis.international_ind AS international_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.birth_dt AS birth_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.gender AS gender_sis,
		stud_sis.pref_gender AS pref_gender_sis,
		stud_sis.religious_affiliation AS religious_affiliation_sis,
		stud_sis.hs_grad_year AS hs_grad_year_sis,
		stud_sis.origin_source AS origin_source_sis,
		stud_sis.origin_source_dt AS origin_source_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.first_gen_ind AS first_gen_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.military_service_status AS military_service_status_sis,
		stud_sis.alumni_relation_ind AS alumni_relation_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.hispanic_ind AS hispanic_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.ethnicity AS ethnicity_sis,
		stud_sis.campus_visit_cnt AS campus_visit_cnt_sis,
		stud_sis.campus_visit_ind AS campus_visit_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.first_campus_visit_dt AS first_campus_visit_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.last_campus_visit_dt AS last_campus_visit_dt_sis,
		stud_sis.mail_optout_ind AS mail_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.email_optout_ind AS email_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.phone_optout_ind AS phone_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.sms_optin_ind AS sms_optin_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.sms_optout_ind AS sms_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.opt_out_ind AS opt_out_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_first_gen_ind AS eab_first_gen_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_pref_gender AS eab_pref_gender_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_international_ind AS eab_international_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_military_veteran_ind AS eab_military_veteran_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_alumni_relation_ind AS eab_alumni_relation_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_ethnicity AS eab_ethnicity_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_campus_visit_ind AS eab_campus_visit_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_mail_optout_ind AS eab_mail_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_email_optout_ind AS eab_email_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_phone_optout_ind AS eab_phone_optout_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_sms_optin_ind AS eab_sms_optin_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.eab_opt_out_ind AS eab_opt_out_ind_sis,
		stud_sis.intake_dt AS intake_dt_sis
	FROM <[Enroll360].[Student SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> AS stud_sis
	--left join <[Enroll360].[Student ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> AS ps_xwalk
	--	on ps_xwalk.primary_student_id = stud_sis.primary_student_id		
)
SELECT
		stud_crm.eab_student_id_crm,
		stud_sis.eab_student_id_sis,
		<eab_student_id> As eab_student_id,
		<eab_student_id> AS partnercontact_id,
		
		stud_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm,
		stud_sis.eab_student_id_type_sis,
		<eab_student_id_type> As eab_student_id_type,
        <eab_student_id_type> AS partner_system_name,
		
		stud_crm.primary_student_id_crm,
		stud_sis.primary_student_id_sis,
		<primary_student_id> As primary_student_id,
		
		stud_crm.sis_student_id_crm,
		stud_sis.sis_student_id_sis,
		<sis_student_id> AS sis_student_id,
		
		stud_crm.crm_student_id_crm,
		stud_sis.crm_student_id_sis,
		<crm_student_id> AS crm_student_id,
		
		stud_crm.other_student_id_crm,
		stud_sis.other_student_id_sis,
		<other_student_id> AS other_student_id,
		
		stud_crm.fname_crm,
		stud_sis.fname_sis,
		<fname> AS fname,
		
		stud_crm.mname_crm,
		stud_sis.mname_sis,
		<mname> AS mname,
		
		stud_crm.lname_crm,
		stud_sis.lname_sis,
		<lname> AS lname,
		
        stud_crm.preferred_fname_crm,
		stud_sis.preferred_fname_sis,
		<preferred_fname> AS preferred_fname,
		
        stud_crm.us_citizenship_status_crm,
		stud_sis.us_citizenship_status_sis,
		<us_citizenship_status> AS us_citizenship_status,
		
        stud_crm.international_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.international_ind_sis,
		<international_ind> AS international_ind,
		
        to_date(stud_crm.birth_dt_crm) AS birth_dt_crm,
		to_date(stud_sis.birth_dt_sis) AS birth_dt_sis,
		to_date(<birth_dt>) AS birth_dt,
		
		stud_crm.gender_crm,
		stud_sis.gender_sis,
		<gender> AS gender,
		
		stud_crm.pref_gender_crm,
		stud_sis.pref_gender_sis,
		<pref_gender> AS pref_gender,
		
		stud_crm.religious_affiliation_crm,
		stud_sis.religious_affiliation_sis,
		<religious_affiliation> AS religious_affiliation,
		
		stud_crm.hs_grad_year_crm,
		stud_sis.hs_grad_year_sis,
		<hs_grad_year> AS hs_grad_year,
		
		stud_crm.origin_source_crm,
		stud_sis.origin_source_sis,
		<origin_source> AS origin_source,
		
		to_date(stud_crm.origin_source_dt_crm) AS origin_source_dt_crm,
		to_date(stud_sis.origin_source_dt_sis) AS origin_source_dt_sis,
		to_date(<origin_source_dt>) AS origin_source_dt,
		
        stud_crm.first_gen_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.first_gen_ind_sis,
		<first_gen_ind> AS first_gen_ind,
		
        stud_crm.military_service_status_crm,
		stud_sis.military_service_status_sis,
		<military_service_status> AS military_service_status,
		
        stud_crm.alumni_relation_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.alumni_relation_ind_sis,
		<alumni_relation_ind> AS alumni_relation_ind,
		
        stud_crm.hispanic_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.hispanic_ind_sis,
		<hispanic_ind> AS hispanic_ind,
		
		stud_crm.ethnicity_crm,
		stud_sis.ethnicity_sis,
		<ethnicity> AS ethnicity,
		
		stud_crm.campus_visit_cnt_crm,
		stud_sis.campus_visit_cnt_sis,
		<campus_visit_cnt> AS campus_visit_cnt,
		
		stud_crm.campus_visit_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.campus_visit_ind_sis,
		<campus_visit_ind> AS campus_visit_ind,
		
		to_date(stud_crm.first_campus_visit_dt_crm) AS first_campus_visit_dt_crm,
		to_date(stud_sis.first_campus_visit_dt_sis) AS first_campus_visit_dt_sis,
		to_date(<first_campus_visit_dt>) AS first_campus_visit_dt,
		
		to_date(stud_crm.last_campus_visit_dt_crm) AS last_campus_visit_dt_crm,
		to_date(stud_sis.last_campus_visit_dt_sis) AS last_campus_visit_dt_sis,
		to_date(<last_campus_visit_dt>) AS last_campus_visit_dt,
		
		stud_crm.mail_optout_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.mail_optout_ind_sis,
		<mail_optout_ind> AS mail_optout_ind,
		
        stud_crm.email_optout_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.email_optout_ind_sis,
		<email_optout_ind> AS email_optout_ind,
		
        stud_crm.phone_optout_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.phone_optout_ind_sis,
		<phone_optout_ind> AS phone_optout_ind,
		
        stud_crm.sms_optin_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.sms_optin_ind_sis,
		<sms_optin_ind> AS sms_optin_ind,
		
        stud_crm.sms_optout_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.sms_optout_ind_sis,
		<sms_optout_ind> AS sms_optout_ind,
		
		stud_crm.opt_out_ind_crm,
		stud_sis.opt_out_ind_sis,
		<opt_out_ind> AS opt_out_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_first_gen_ind_crm) AS eab_first_gen_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_first_gen_ind_sis) AS eab_first_gen_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_first_gen_ind>) AS eab_first_gen_ind,
		
		stud_crm.eab_pref_gender_crm,
		stud_sis.eab_pref_gender_sis,
		<eab_pref_gender> AS eab_pref_gender,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_international_ind_crm) AS eab_international_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_international_ind_sis) AS eab_international_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_international_ind>) AS eab_international_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_military_veteran_ind_crm) AS eab_military_veteran_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_military_veteran_ind_sis) AS eab_military_veteran_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_military_veteran_ind>) AS eab_military_veteran_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_alumni_relation_ind_crm) AS eab_alumni_relation_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_alumni_relation_ind_sis) AS eab_alumni_relation_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_alumni_relation_ind>) AS eab_alumni_relation_ind,
		
        stud_crm.eab_ethnicity_crm,
		stud_sis.eab_ethnicity_sis,
		<eab_ethnicity> AS eab_ethnicity,
		
        to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_campus_visit_ind_crm) AS eab_campus_visit_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_campus_visit_ind_sis) AS eab_campus_visit_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_campus_visit_ind>) AS eab_campus_visit_ind,
		
        to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_mail_optout_ind_crm) AS eab_mail_optout_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_mail_optout_ind_sis) AS eab_mail_optout_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_mail_optout_ind>) AS eab_mail_optout_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_email_optout_ind_crm) AS eab_email_optout_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_email_optout_ind_sis) AS eab_email_optout_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_email_optout_ind>) AS eab_email_optout_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_phone_optout_ind_crm) AS eab_phone_optout_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_phone_optout_ind_sis) AS eab_phone_optout_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_phone_optout_ind>) AS eab_phone_optout_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_sms_optin_ind_crm) AS eab_sms_optin_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_sms_optin_ind_sis) AS eab_sms_optin_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_sms_optin_ind>) AS eab_sms_optin_ind,
		
		to_boolean(stud_crm.eab_opt_out_ind_crm) AS eab_opt_out_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(stud_sis.eab_opt_out_ind_sis) AS eab_opt_out_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_opt_out_ind>) AS eab_opt_out_ind,
		
		to_timestamp(stud_crm.intake_dt_crm) AS intake_dt_crm,
		to_timestamp(stud_sis.intake_dt_sis) AS intake_dt_sis,
		to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt

FROM student_crm as stud_crm
FULL OUTER JOIN student_sis as stud_sis
			ON stud_sis.eab_student_id_sis = stud_crm.eab_student_id_crm
			AND stud_sis.eab_student_id_type_sis = stud_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm
WHERE 
(stud_sis.eab_student_id_sis IS NOT NULL AND stud_sis.eab_student_id_type_sis IS NOT NULL) OR (stud_crm.eab_student_id_crm IS NOT NULL AND stud_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm IS NOT NULL)
