queryResults.querySql:
/*archived 2026-08-05: v1 of query- prior to pilot corrections*/

/*2025-07-23: added join_extension variable <join_extension.Student Race SIS> per ESANALYTIC-50998 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-03: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
with race_data as 
(
	select * from 
		(
		select distinct
			nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_race.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
			nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_race.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
			nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_race.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
			nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_race.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,
			nullif(trim(stud_race.race),'') as race,
			case 
			when pcm_race.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then 'Unknown'
			else pcm_race.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race,
			CAST(stud_race.intake_dt as timestamp) as intake_dt
		from <[Enroll360].[Student Race SIS].{fulfillment}> as stud_race
		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race
			on (pcm_race.field_name = 'eab_race'
			and coalesce(stud_race.race,'') = coalesce(pcm_race.partner_value,''))													  

		<join_extension.Student Race SIS>

		where 1=1
								  
		) agg
	where coalesce(agg.eab_student_id,'') <> ''
	and coalesce(agg.eab_student_id_type,'') <> ''
)

select 
	distinct eab_student_id,
	eab_student_id_type,
	partnercontact_id,
	partner_system_name,
	race,
	case 
	when eab_race in ('Asian/Asian American','Asian') then 'Asian'
	else eab_race
	end as eab_race,
	intake_dt 
from race_data
where eab_race is not null 
and race <> ''
and coalesce(partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(partner_system_name,'') <> ''

with race_data as

		(
		select distinct 
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_race.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(stud_race.eab_student_id_type,'[\\s]','')),'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(<partnercontact_id.sis_fao>,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,

			nullif(trim(stud_race.race),'') as race,
			case 
			when pcm_race.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race,
  
			case when pcm_race_amer_indian.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_amer_indian.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_amer_indian,

			case when pcm_race_asian.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_asian.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_asian,

			case when pcm_race_black.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_black.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_black,

			case when pcm_race_native_hawaiian.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_native_hawaiian.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_native_hawaiian,

			case when pcm_race_white.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_white.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_white,

			case when pcm_race_middle_eastern.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_middle_eastern.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_middle_eastern,

			case when pcm_race_multiracial.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_multiracial.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_multiracial,

			case when pcm_race_other.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_other.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_other,

			case when pcm_race_prefer_not_respond.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null

			end as eab_race_prefer_not_respond,

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race

			and coalesce(stud_race.race,'') = coalesce(pcm_race.partner_value,''))	
													   
		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_amer_indian
		on (pcm_race_amer_indian.field_name = 'eab_race_amer_indian'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_1,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_amer_indian.partner_value,''))

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_asian
		on (pcm_race_asian.field_name = 'eab_race_asian'

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-06-23: Enroll360.Student Race SIS.final.v1 version is archived in University of Denver-FAO Pilot space
this query and Enroll360.Student Race SIS.final are aligned at this time
Change log: Enroll360.Student Race SIS.final -> NEW Enroll360.Student Race SIS.final
- Uses newer version of id/system_type variables and normalizes eab_student_id_type.
- Unmapped primary races now become NULL and are excluded, rather than outputting 'Unknown'.
- Adds nine calc field race mappings
- added row_number deduping at pdp key grain, priority = most recent intake date wins*/

/*2025-07-23: added join_extension variable <join_extension.Student Race SIS> per ESANALYTIC-50998 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-03: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*updated to standard set up using Calc Fields*/

with race_data as 
(
	select * from 
		(
		select distinct 
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_race.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(stud_race.eab_student_id_type,'[\\s]','')),'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(<partnercontact_id.sis_fao>,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.sis_fao>,'[\\s]','')),'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,
			nullif(trim(stud_race.race),'') as race,
			case 
			when pcm_race.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race,
  
			case when pcm_race_amer_indian.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_amer_indian.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_amer_indian,

			case when pcm_race_asian.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_asian.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_asian,

			case when pcm_race_black.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_black.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_black,

			case when pcm_race_native_hawaiian.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_native_hawaiian.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_native_hawaiian,

			case when pcm_race_white.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_white.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_white,

			case when pcm_race_middle_eastern.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_middle_eastern.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_middle_eastern,

			case when pcm_race_multiracial.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_multiracial.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_multiracial,

			case when pcm_race_other.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_other.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_other,

			case when pcm_race_prefer_not_respond.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_prefer_not_respond.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_prefer_not_respond,
			CAST(stud_race.intake_dt as timestamp) as intake_dt
		from <[Enroll360].[Student Race SIS].{fulfillment}> as stud_race
		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race
			on (pcm_race.field_name = 'eab_race'
			and coalesce(stud_race.race,'') = coalesce(pcm_race.partner_value,''))	
													   
		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_amer_indian
		on (pcm_race_amer_indian.field_name = 'eab_race_amer_indian'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_1,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_amer_indian.partner_value,''))

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_asian
		on (pcm_race_asian.field_name = 'eab_race_asian'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_2,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_asian.partner_value,''))

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_black
		on (pcm_race_black.field_name = 'eab_race_black'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_3,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_black.partner_value,''))

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_native_hawaiian
		on (pcm_race_native_hawaiian.field_name = 'eab_race_native_hawaiian'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_4,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_native_hawaiian.partner_value,''))

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_white
		on (pcm_race_white.field_name = 'eab_race_white'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_5,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_white.partner_value,''))

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_middle_eastern
		on (pcm_race_middle_eastern.field_name = 'eab_race_middle_eastern'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_6,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_middle_eastern.partner_value,''))

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_multiracial
		on (pcm_race_multiracial.field_name = 'eab_race_multiracial'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_7,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_multiracial.partner_value,''))

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_other
		on (pcm_race_other.field_name = 'eab_race_other'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_8,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_other.partner_value,''))

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_prefer_not_respond
		on (pcm_race_prefer_not_respond.field_name = 'eab_race_prefer_not_respond'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_9,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_prefer_not_respond.partner_value,''))
		
		<join_extension.Student Race SIS>
		
		where 1=1

		) agg

	

	where coalesce(agg.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
	and coalesce(agg.partner_system_name,'') <> ''
)


select
agg2.eab_student_id,
agg2.eab_student_id_type,
agg2.partnercontact_id,
agg2.partner_system_name,
agg2.race,
agg2.eab_race,
agg2.intake_dt

from (
select agg.*,
row_number() over(partition by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.partner_system_name, agg.eab_race
				  order by agg.intake_dt desc nulls last) as race_rn
  
from (	
  select 
	distinct eab_student_id,
	eab_student_id_type,
  	partnercontact_id,
	partner_system_name,
	race,
	case 
	when eab_race in ('Asian/Asian American','Asian') then 'Asian'
	else eab_race
	end as eab_race,
	intake_dt 
from race_data
where coalesce(eab_race,'') not in ('Unknown','Unmapped Value','')
and race <> ''

union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, partnercontact_id
, partner_system_name
, EAB_RACE_AMER_INDIAN
, EAB_RACE_AMER_INDIAN
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_AMER_INDIAN is not null
	
union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, partnercontact_id
, partner_system_name
, EAB_RACE_ASIAN
, case 
	when EAB_RACE_ASIAN in ('Asian/Asian American','Asian') then 'Asian'
	else null
	end as EAB_RACE_ASIAN
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_ASIAN is not null
	
union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, partnercontact_id
, partner_system_name
, EAB_RACE_BLACK
, EAB_RACE_BLACK
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_BLACK is not null

union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, partnercontact_id
, partner_system_name
, EAB_RACE_NATIVE_HAWAIIAN
, EAB_RACE_NATIVE_HAWAIIAN
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_NATIVE_HAWAIIAN is not null

union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, partnercontact_id
, partner_system_name
, EAB_RACE_WHITE
, EAB_RACE_WHITE
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_WHITE is not null

union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, partnercontact_id
, partner_system_name
, EAB_RACE_MIDDLE_EASTERN
, EAB_RACE_MIDDLE_EASTERN
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_MIDDLE_EASTERN is not null

union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, partnercontact_id
, partner_system_name
, EAB_RACE_MULTIRACIAL
, EAB_RACE_MULTIRACIAL
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_MULTIRACIAL is not null

union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, partnercontact_id
, partner_system_name
, EAB_RACE_OTHER
, EAB_RACE_OTHER
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_OTHER is not null

union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, partnercontact_id
, partner_system_name
, EAB_RACE_PREFER_NOT_RESPOND
, EAB_RACE_PREFER_NOT_RESPOND
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_PREFER_NOT_RESPOND is not null

) agg  
where coalesce(agg.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(agg.partner_system_name,'') <> ''

) agg2
where agg2.race_rn = 1

queryResults.sqlPreview: /*updated to standard set up using Calc Fields*/ with race_data as ( select * from ( select distinct nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_race.eab_student_id,'"|[\\0…
queryResults.querySql:
/*updated to standard set up using Calc Fields*/

with race_data as 
(
	select * from 
		(
		select distinct
			nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_race.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
			nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_race.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
			nullif(trim(stud_race.race),'') as race,
			case 
			when pcm_race.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race,
  
			case when pcm_race_amer_indian.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_amer_indian.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_amer_indian,

			case when pcm_race_asian.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_asian.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_asian,

			case when pcm_race_black.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_black.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_black,

			case when pcm_race_native_hawaiian.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_native_hawaiian.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_native_hawaiian,

			case when pcm_race_white.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_white.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_white,

			case when pcm_race_middle_eastern.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_middle_eastern.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_middle_eastern,

			case when pcm_race_multiracial.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_multiracial.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_multiracial,

			case when pcm_race_other.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_other.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_other,

			case when pcm_race_prefer_not_respond.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then null
			else pcm_race_prefer_not_respond.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_race_prefer_not_respond,
			CAST(stud_race.intake_dt as timestamp) as intake_dt
		from <[Enroll360].[Student Race SIS].{fulfillment}> as stud_race
		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race
			on (pcm_race.field_name = 'eab_race'
			and coalesce(stud_race.race,'') = coalesce(pcm_race.partner_value,''))	
													   
		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_amer_indian
		on (pcm_race_amer_indian.field_name = 'eab_race_amer_indian'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_1,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_amer_indian.partner_value,''))

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_asian
		on (pcm_race_asian.field_name = 'eab_race_asian'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_2,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_asian.partner_value,''))

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_black
		on (pcm_race_black.field_name = 'eab_race_black'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_3,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_black.partner_value,''))

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_native_hawaiian
		on (pcm_race_native_hawaiian.field_name = 'eab_race_native_hawaiian'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_4,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_native_hawaiian.partner_value,''))

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_white
		on (pcm_race_white.field_name = 'eab_race_white'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_5,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_white.partner_value,''))

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_middle_eastern
		on (pcm_race_middle_eastern.field_name = 'eab_race_middle_eastern'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_6,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_middle_eastern.partner_value,''))

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_multiracial
		on (pcm_race_multiracial.field_name = 'eab_race_multiracial'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_7,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_multiracial.partner_value,''))

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_other
		on (pcm_race_other.field_name = 'eab_race_other'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_8,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_other.partner_value,''))

		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_race_prefer_not_respond
		on (pcm_race_prefer_not_respond.field_name = 'eab_race_prefer_not_respond'
		and coalesce(stud_race.calculated_field_9,'') = coalesce(pcm_race_prefer_not_respond.partner_value,''))
		where 1=1									  
		) agg
	where coalesce(agg.eab_student_id,'') <> ''
	and coalesce(agg.eab_student_id_type,'') <> ''
)

select distinct 
eab_student_id,
eab_student_id_type,
race,
eab_race,
intake_dt

from (	
  select 
	distinct eab_student_id,
	eab_student_id_type,
	race,
	case 
	when eab_race in ('Asian/Asian American','Asian') then 'Asian'
	else eab_race
	end as eab_race,
	intake_dt 
from race_data
where coalesce(eab_race,'') not in ('Unknown','Unmapped Value','')
and race <> ''

union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, EAB_RACE_AMER_INDIAN
, EAB_RACE_AMER_INDIAN
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_AMER_INDIAN is not null
	
union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, EAB_RACE_ASIAN
, case 
	when EAB_RACE_ASIAN in ('Asian/Asian American','Asian') then 'Asian'
	else null
	end as EAB_RACE_ASIAN
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_ASIAN is not null
	
union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, EAB_RACE_BLACK
, EAB_RACE_BLACK
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_BLACK is not null

union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, EAB_RACE_NATIVE_HAWAIIAN
, EAB_RACE_NATIVE_HAWAIIAN
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_NATIVE_HAWAIIAN is not null

union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, EAB_RACE_WHITE
, EAB_RACE_WHITE
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_WHITE is not null

union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, EAB_RACE_MIDDLE_EASTERN
, EAB_RACE_MIDDLE_EASTERN
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_MIDDLE_EASTERN is not null

union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, EAB_RACE_MULTIRACIAL
, EAB_RACE_MULTIRACIAL
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_MULTIRACIAL is not null

union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, EAB_RACE_OTHER
, EAB_RACE_OTHER
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_OTHER is not null

union all

select eab_student_id
, eab_student_id_type
, EAB_RACE_PREFER_NOT_RESPOND
, EAB_RACE_PREFER_NOT_RESPOND
, intake_dt
from race_data
where EAB_RACE_PREFER_NOT_RESPOND is not null

) agg  
where coalesce(eab_student_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(eab_student_id_type,'') <> ''

queryResults.querySql:
/*2025-03-04: customization is on calculated_field_11 to break out counselor name, this has since been fixed in the files 
switching to single file master - ccreekman*/

--Updates done to Counselor Fname, Counselor LName

select distinct
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as primary_student_id,
agg.relationship_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.relationship_email,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as relationship_email,
-- Adding regex to clean invalid chacters based on same code from Student Master wjl 9/25/2023
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(agg.relationship_fname,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as relationship_fname,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(agg.relationship_lname,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as relationship_lname,
--agg.relationship_fname,
--agg.relationship_lname,
agg.relationship_email_optout_ind,
agg.relationship_mail_optout_ind,
agg.relationship_sms_optin_ind,
agg.relationship_sms_optout_ind,
agg.relationship_optout_ind,
agg.relationship_to_student,
agg.intake_dt

from (

--Relationship set 1 - parent/guardian
select distinct
stud_rship.primary_student_id,
stud_rship.relationship_id,
stud_rship.relationship_email_address as relationship_email,
stud_rship.relationship_first_name as relationship_fname,
stud_rship.relationship_last_name as relationship_lname,
stud_rship.relationship_email_opt_out_indicator as relationship_email_optout_ind,
stud_rship.relationship_mail_opt_out_indicator as relationship_mail_optout_ind,
stud_rship.relationship_sms_opt_in_indicator as relationship_sms_optin_ind,
stud_rship.relationship_sms_opt_out_indicator as relationship_sms_optout_ind,
stud_rship.relationship_opt_out_indicator_for_mail_email_phone as relationship_optout_ind,

case when pcm_relationship.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' 
and len(coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_id,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_email_address,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_first_name,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_last_name,'')) > 0 
then 'Parent/Guardian'
when len(coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_id,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_email_address,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_first_name,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_last_name,'')) > 0 
then pcm_relationship.eab_standard_value
else null
end as relationship_to_student,
stud_rship.intake_date as intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student Relationship].{fulfillment}> as stud_rship

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_relationship
on (pcm_relationship.field_name = 'relationship_to_student'
and coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_to_student,'') = coalesce(pcm_relationship.partner_value,''))

where <where_statement>

union all

--Relationship set 2 - parent/guardian
select distinct
stud_rship.primary_student_id,
stud_rship.calculated_field_1 as relationship_id,
stud_rship.calculated_field_2 as relationship_email,
stud_rship.calculated_field_4 as relationship_fname,
stud_rship.calculated_field_5 as relationship_lname,
stud_rship.calculated_field_6 as relationship_email_optout_ind,
stud_rship.calculated_field_7 as relationship_mail_optout_ind,
stud_rship.calculated_field_8 as relationship_sms_optin_ind,
stud_rship.calculated_field_9 as relationship_sms_optout_ind,
stud_rship.calculated_field_10 as relationship_optout_ind,

case when pcm_relationship.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
and len(coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_1,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_2,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_3,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_4,'')) > 0 
then 'Parent/Guardian'
when len(coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_1,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_2,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_3,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_4,'')) > 0 
then pcm_relationship.eab_standard_value
else null
end as relationship_to_student,
stud_rship.intake_date as intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student Relationship].{fulfillment}> as stud_rship

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_relationship
on (pcm_relationship.field_name = 'relationship_to_student'
and coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_3,'') = coalesce(pcm_relationship.partner_value,''))

where <where_statement>

union all

--Relationship set 3 - admissions counselor
select distinct
stud_rship.primary_student_id,
stud_rship.calculated_field_11 as relationship_id,
stud_rship.calculated_field_12 as relationship_email,
														  
--stud_rship.calculated_field_14 as relationship_fname,
--stud_rship.calculated_field_15 as relationship_lname,
SUBSTRING(stud_rship.calculated_field_11, 1, POSITION(' ', stud_rship.calculated_field_11) - 1) as relationship_fname,
SUBSTRING(stud_rship.calculated_field_11, POSITION(' ', stud_rship.calculated_field_11) + 1, LEN(stud_rship.calculated_field_11)) as relationship_fname,													  
null as relationship_email_optout_ind,
null as relationship_mail_optout_ind,
null as relationship_sms_optin_ind,
null as relationship_sms_optout_ind,
null as relationship_optout_ind,

case when pcm_relationship.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
and len(coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_11,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_12,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_13,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_14,'')) > 0 
then 'Counselor'
when len(coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_11,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_12,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_13,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_14,'')) > 0 
then pcm_relationship.eab_standard_value
else null
end as relationship_to_student,
stud_rship.intake_date as intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student Relationship].{fulfillment}> as stud_rship

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_relationship
on (pcm_relationship.field_name = 'relationship_to_student'
and coalesce(stud_rship.calculated_field_13,'') = coalesce(pcm_relationship.partner_value,''))

where <where_statement>
														   
) agg

where coalesce(agg.relationship_id,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_email,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_fname,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_lname,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_email_optout_ind,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_mail_optout_ind,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_sms_optin_ind,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_sms_optout_ind,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_optout_ind,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_to_student,'') <> ''
and coalesce(agg.primary_student_id,'') <> ''

/*2026-08-31: switched to v3 - ccreekman*/
/*partner customization: left join to student, email to bring in names and emails
*/

/*2025-12-01: adding partner system name functionality, variables - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-21: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name*/
/*2025-05-16: added eab_student_id, eab_student_id_type*/
/*2024-02-01: mixed 13 file + object set up*/

select * from (

select distinct
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as primary_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,
agg.relationship_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.relationship_email,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as relationship_email,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(agg.relationship_fname,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as relationship_fname,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(agg.relationship_lname,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as relationship_lname,

agg.relationship_email_optout_ind,
agg.relationship_mail_optout_ind,
agg.relationship_sms_optin_ind,
agg.relationship_sms_optout_ind,
agg.relationship_optout_ind,
agg.relationship_to_student,
agg.intake_dt

from (

--Relationship set 1 - parent/guardian
select distinct
stud_rship.primary_student_id,
stud_rship.primary_student_id as eab_student_id,
lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(stud_rship.partner_system_name,'primary'),'[\\s]','')) as eab_student_id_type,
<partnercontact_id.crm_ug> as partnercontact_id,
lower(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.crm_ug>,'[\\s]','')) as partner_system_name,

stud_rship.relationship_id,
coalesce(stud_rship.RELATIONSHIP_EMAIL_ADDRESS,se.email_address) as relationship_email,
coalesce(stud_rship.RELATIONSHIP_FIRST_NAME,sc.first_name) as relationship_fname,
coalesce(stud_rship.RELATIONSHIP_LAST_NAME,sc.last_name) as relationship_lname,
stud_rship.relationship_email_opt_out_indicator as relationship_email_optout_ind,
stud_rship.relationship_mail_opt_out_indicator as relationship_mail_optout_ind,
stud_rship.relationship_sms_opt_in_indicator as relationship_sms_optin_ind,
stud_rship.relationship_sms_opt_out_indicator as relationship_sms_optout_ind,
stud_rship.relationship_opt_out_indicator_for_mail_email_phone as relationship_optout_ind,

case when pcm_relationship.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' 
then null
when len(coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_id,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_email_address,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_first_name,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_last_name,'')) > 0 
then pcm_relationship.eab_standard_value
else null
end as relationship_to_student,
stud_rship.intake_date as intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student Relationship].{fulfillment}> as stud_rship

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_relationship
on (pcm_relationship.field_name = 'relationship_to_student'
and coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_to_student,'') = coalesce(pcm_relationship.partner_value,''))

<join_extension.Student Relationship>

where <where_statement>
and stud_rship.RELATIONSHIP_TO_STUDENT in ('Counselor','Father','Guardian','Mother','Parent','Stepfather','Stepmother','Stepparent')
														   
) agg

where coalesce(agg.relationship_id,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_email,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_fname,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_lname,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_email_optout_ind,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_mail_optout_ind,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_sms_optin_ind,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_sms_optout_ind,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_optout_ind,'') ||
coalesce(agg.relationship_to_student,'') <> ''

) agg2
where coalesce(agg2.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(agg2.partner_system_name,'') <> ''

/*partner customization: left join to student, email to bring in names and emails*/

/*2026-08-31: added deduping, eab_ fields to align with master, eab_fields are not functional yet  -ccreekman*/
/*2025-12-01: adding partner system name functionality, variables - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-21: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name*/
/*2025-05-16: added eab_student_id, eab_student_id_type*/
/*2024-02-01: mixed 13 file + object set up*/


select 
agg3.primary_student_id,
agg3.eab_student_id,
agg3.eab_student_id_type,
agg3.partnercontact_id,
agg3.partner_system_name,
agg3.relationship_to_student,
agg3.eab_relationship_type,
agg3.relationship_id,
agg3.relationship_email,

agg3.eab_relationship_optout_ind,
agg3.intake_dt

select agg2.*,
row_number() over(partition by agg2.partnercontact_id, agg2.partner_system_name, 
				  agg2.relationship_id, agg2.relationship_email, agg2.relationship_to_student /*change to eab_ field*/
				  order by agg2.intake_dt desc nulls last) as rn

from (

select distinct

nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,
agg.relationship_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.relationship_email,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as relationship_email,

nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(agg.relationship_lname,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as relationship_lname,

agg.relationship_email_optout_ind,
agg.relationship_mail_optout_ind,
agg.relationship_sms_optin_ind,
agg.relationship_sms_optout_ind,
agg.relationship_optout_ind,
agg.relationship_to_student,
agg.eab_relationship_type,
agg.eab_relationship_email_optout_ind,
agg.eab_relationship_mail_optout_ind,
agg.eab_relationship_sms_optin_ind,
agg.eab_relationship_sms_optout_ind,
agg.eab_relationship_optout_ind,
agg.intake_dt

from (

--Relationship set 1 - parent/guardian
select distinct
stud_rship.primary_student_id,
stud_rship.primary_student_id as eab_student_id,
lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(stud_rship.partner_system_name,'primary'),'[\\s]','')) as eab_student_id_type,
<partnercontact_id.crm_ug> as partnercontact_id,
lower(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.crm_ug>,'[\\s]','')) as partner_system_name,

stud_rship.relationship_id,
coalesce(stud_rship.RELATIONSHIP_EMAIL_ADDRESS,se.email_address) as relationship_email,
coalesce(stud_rship.RELATIONSHIP_FIRST_NAME,sc.first_name) as relationship_fname,
coalesce(stud_rship.RELATIONSHIP_LAST_NAME,sc.last_name) as relationship_lname,
stud_rship.relationship_email_opt_out_indicator as relationship_email_optout_ind,
stud_rship.relationship_mail_opt_out_indicator as relationship_mail_optout_ind,
stud_rship.relationship_sms_opt_in_indicator as relationship_sms_optin_ind,
stud_rship.relationship_sms_opt_out_indicator as relationship_sms_optout_ind,
stud_rship.relationship_opt_out_indicator_for_mail_email_phone as relationship_optout_ind,

case when pcm_relationship.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' 
then null
when len(coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_id,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_email_address,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_first_name,'') || coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_last_name,'')) > 0 
then pcm_relationship.eab_standard_value
else null
end as relationship_to_student,

null as eab_relationship_type,
null as eab_relationship_email_optout_ind,
null as eab_relationship_mail_optout_ind,
null as eab_relationship_sms_optin_ind,
null as eab_relationship_sms_optout_ind,
null as eab_relationship_optout_ind,

stud_rship.intake_date as intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student Relationship].{fulfillment}> as stud_rship

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_relationship
on (pcm_relationship.field_name = 'relationship_to_student'
and coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_to_student,'') = coalesce(pcm_relationship.partner_value,''))

/*new conversions, not yet functional*/
left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_relationship_type_new
on (pcm_relationship_type_new.field_name = 'eab_relationship_type'
and coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_to_student,'') = coalesce(pcm_relationship_type_new.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_rel_email_optout

and coalesce(stud_rship.relationship_email_opt_out_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_rel_email_optout.partner_value,''))

case when pcm_relationship_sms_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'

end as eab_relationship_sms_optout_ind,

case when pcm_relationship_general_optout.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'

stud_rship.intake_date as intake_dt

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_relationship_sms_optin_ind

coalesce(agg.relationship_email_optout_ind,'') ||

/*2025-11-11: updated with <partner_system_name.sis_fao> references - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-23: added join_extension variable <join_extension.Student Retention> per ESANALYTIC-50998 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-03: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/

WITH sr_data AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT

		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(sr.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id
		, nullif(trim(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(sr.eab_student_id_type,'[\\s]','')),'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type
		, nullif(trim(regexp_replace(<partnercontact_id.sis_fao>,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id
		, nullif(trim(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.sis_fao>,'[\\s]','')),'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name

          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(sr.eab_entry_term,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_entry_term
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(sr.eab_entry_year_academic,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_entry_year_academic
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_enrolled_term.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
                 ELSE nullif(trim(regexp_replace(pcm_eab_enrolled_term.eab_standard_value,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'')
            END AS eab_enrolled_term
          , sr.current_entry_term AS curr_entry_term
          , sr.current_entry_year_academic AS curr_entry_year_academic
          , sr.term_enrolled AS term_enrolled
          , sr.term_credits AS term_credits
          , sr.cumulative_credits AS cumulative_credits
          , sr.term_gpa AS term_gpa
          , sr.cumulative_gpa AS cumulative_gpa
          , sr.eab_enrolled_year_academic AS eab_enrolled_year_academic
          , cast(sr.intake_dt as timestamp) AS intake_dt
        FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Retention].{fulfillment}> AS sr
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_enrolled_term
             ON (pcm_eab_enrolled_term.field_name = 'eab_enrolled_term'
            AND COALESCE(sr.eab_enrolled_term,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_enrolled_term.partner_value,''))

		<join_extension.Student Retention> 

    ) sq
    WHERE (COALESCE(sq.eab_entry_term,'')<>''
          OR COALESCE(sq.eab_entry_year_academic,'')<>''
          OR COALESCE(sq.eab_enrolled_term,'')<>''
          )
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    eab_student_id
  , eab_student_id_type
  , partnercontact_id
  , partner_system_name
  , eab_entry_term
  , eab_entry_year_academic
  , eab_enrolled_term
  , curr_entry_term
  , curr_entry_year_academic
  , term_enrolled
  , term_credits
  , cumulative_credits
  , term_gpa
  , cumulative_gpa
  , eab_enrolled_year_academic
  , intake_dt
FROM sr_data
WHERE COALESCE(partnercontact_id,'')<>''
      AND COALESCE(partner_system_name,'')<>''

select
    agg2.primary_student_id,
    agg2.eab_student_id,
    agg2.eab_student_id_type,
    agg2.partnercontact_id,

from (
select agg.*,
row_number() over(partition by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.partner_system_name

from (
select 
	distinct 
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as primary_student_id,

	stud.other_student_id,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(stud.first_name,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as fname,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(stud.middle_name,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as mname,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(stud.last_name,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as lname,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(stud.preferred_first_name,'[\\s]',' '),'[^[:ascii:]]|[\\0]|"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as preferred_fname,
	stud.us_citizenship_status as us_citizenship_status,
	stud.international_indicator as international_ind,
	try_to_timestamp(substring(stud.birth_date,1,19)) as birth_dt,
	stud.gender,
	stud.preferred_gender as pref_gender,
	stud.religious_affiliation as religious_affiliation,
	substr(try_to_date(stud.high_school_grad_year,'yyyy'),1,4) as hs_grad_year,
	stud.origin_source_code as origin_source,
	try_to_timestamp(substring(stud.origin_source_date,1,19)) as origin_source_dt,
	stud.first_generation_indicator as first_gen_ind,
	stud.military_service_or_veteran_status as military_service_status,
	stud.alumni_relationship_indicator as alumni_relation_ind,
	stud.hispanic_indicator as hispanic_ind,
	stud.ethnicity,
	stud.campus_visit_count as campus_visit_cnt,
	stud.campus_visit_indicator as campus_visit_ind,
	stud.first_campus_visit_date as first_campus_visit_dt,
	stud.most_recent_campus_visit_date as last_campus_visit_dt,
	stud.mail_opt_out_indicator as mail_optout_ind,
	stud.email_opt_out_indicator as email_optout_ind,
	stud.phone_opt_out_indicator as phone_optout_ind,
	stud.sms_opt_in_indicator as sms_optin_ind,
	stud.sms_opt_out_indicator as sms_optout_ind,
	stud.opt_out_indicator_general as opt_out_ind,

	case when pcm_first_gen.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
	then null
	else try_to_boolean(pcm_first_gen.eab_standard_value)
	end as eab_first_gen_ind,

	pcm_pref_gen.eab_standard_value as eab_pref_gender,

	case when pcm_int_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
	then null
	else try_to_boolean(pcm_int_ind.eab_standard_value)
	end as eab_international_ind,

	case when pcm_mil_vet_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
	then null
	else try_to_boolean(pcm_mil_vet_ind.eab_standard_value)
	end as eab_military_veteran_ind,

	case when pcm_alum_rel_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
	then null
	else try_to_boolean(pcm_alum_rel_ind.eab_standard_value)
	end as eab_alumni_relation_ind,

	pcm_ethn.eab_standard_value as eab_ethnicity,

	case when pcm_campus_visit_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
	then null
	else try_to_boolean(pcm_campus_visit_ind.eab_standard_value)
	end as eab_campus_visit_ind,

	case when pcm_mail_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
	then null
	else try_to_boolean(pcm_mail_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
	end as eab_mail_optout_ind,

	case when pcm_email_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
	then null
	else try_to_boolean(pcm_email_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
	end as eab_email_optout_ind,

	case when pcm_phone_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
	then null
	else try_to_boolean(pcm_phone_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
	end as eab_phone_optout_ind,

	case when pcm_sms_optin_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
	then null
	else try_to_boolean(pcm_sms_optin_ind.eab_standard_value)
	end as eab_sms_optin_ind,

	case
	when pcm_optout_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
	then null
	else try_to_boolean(pcm_optout_ind.eab_standard_value)
	end as eab_opt_out_ind,

	CAST(stud.intake_dt as timestamp) as intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student SIS].{fulfillment}> stud

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_first_gen
on (pcm_first_gen.field_name = 'eab_first_gen_ind'
and coalesce(stud.first_generation_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_first_gen.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_pref_gen
on (pcm_pref_gen.field_name = 'eab_pref_gender'
and coalesce(stud.preferred_gender,'') = coalesce(pcm_pref_gen.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_int_ind
on (pcm_int_ind.field_name = 'eab_international_ind'
and coalesce(stud.international_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_int_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_mil_vet_ind
on (pcm_mil_vet_ind.field_name = 'eab_military_veteran_ind'
and coalesce(stud.military_service_or_veteran_status,'') = coalesce(pcm_mil_vet_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_alum_rel_ind
on (pcm_alum_rel_ind.field_name = 'eab_alumni_relation_ind'
and coalesce(stud.alumni_relationship_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_alum_rel_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_ethn
on (pcm_ethn.field_name = 'eab_ethnicity'
and coalesce(stud.ethnicity,'') = coalesce(pcm_ethn.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_campus_visit_ind
on (pcm_campus_visit_ind.field_name = 'eab_campus_visit_ind'
and coalesce(stud.campus_visit_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_campus_visit_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_mail_optout_ind
on (pcm_mail_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_mail_optout_ind'
and coalesce(stud.mail_opt_out_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_mail_optout_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_email_optout_ind
on (pcm_email_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_email_optout_ind'
and coalesce(stud.email_opt_out_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_email_optout_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_phone_optout_ind
on (pcm_phone_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_phone_optout_ind'
and coalesce(stud.phone_opt_out_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_phone_optout_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_sms_optin_ind
on (pcm_sms_optin_ind.field_name = 'eab_sms_optin_ind'
and coalesce(stud.sms_opt_in_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_sms_optin_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_optout_ind
on (pcm_optout_ind.field_name = 'eab_opt_out_ind'
and coalesce(stud.opt_out_indicator_general,'') = coalesce(pcm_optout_ind.partner_value,''))

<join_extension.Student SIS>
) agg
where coalesce(agg.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(agg.partner_system_name,'') <> ''

)agg2
where agg2.rn = 1

queryResults.querySql:
/* 2026-09-08: adding Plymouth campus to campus_location criteria ESANALYTIC-64778 */
/*Custom Tenant Final required to join to STA to use campus_location in the student type logic 2026-03-23 blang*/
/*2026-01-27: normalization added to ID fields in row_number() deduping logic, deferral PCM joins moved to <join_extension.Student Term Application>, 
adding partner system name functionality, variables - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-10: added variables: <join_extension.Student Term>, <where_statement.eab_student_type>, default Freshman criteria moved to <where_statement.eab_student_type> - ccreekman*/
/*2025-06-19: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-03-24: added eab_student_id and eab_student_id_type - ccreekman*/

select distinct * from (

select distinct 
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as primary_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,
agg2.student_type,
agg2.curr_entry_term,
agg2.curr_entry_year_academic,
agg2.inquiry_ind,
agg2.recruitment_status,
agg2.state_resident,
/*2-27-2023: updated to streamline regexp on first source - ccreekman*/
nullif(regexp_replace(agg2.first_source,'[^[:ascii:]]|"|[\\0]|[\\000-\\037\\177]',''),'') as first_source,
agg2.first_source_dt,
agg2.athletic_recruit_ind,
agg2.athletic_recruit_sport,
agg2.years_employed,
agg2.academic_rating,
agg2.interest_rating,
agg2.student_level,
agg2.curr_entry_year_calendar,
agg2.eab_athletic_recruit_ind,
agg2.eab_entry_term,
agg2.eab_entry_year_academic,
agg2.eab_first_source,
agg2.eab_inquiry_ind,
agg2.eab_student_type,
agg2.eab_current_funnel_status,
agg2.intake_dt

from (

	select agg.*,

	case 
		when stud_term_app.eab_enroll_ind = 'true' then 'Enrolled'
		when stud_term_app.eab_deny_ind = 'true' then 'Deny'
		when stud_term_app.eab_deferral_future_ind = 'true' then 'Future Defer'
		when stud_term_app.eab_deferral_prev_ind = 'true' then 'Previous Defer'
		when stud_term_app.eab_deposit_ind = 'true' and stud_term_app.eab_withdrawal_ind = 'true' and (IFNULL(stud_term_app.deposit_dt,'1/1/1800') <= IFNULL(stud_term_app.withdrawal_dt,'12/31/9999')) then 'Melt'
		when stud_term_app.eab_deposit_ind = 'true' and stud_term_app.cancel_dt is not null and (IFNULL(stud_term_app.deposit_dt,'1/1/1800') <= IFNULL(stud_term_app.cancel_dt,'12/31/9999')) then 'Melt'
		when stud_term_app.eab_deposit_ind  = 'true' and IFNULL(stud_term_app.eab_withdrawal_ind,'false') = 'false' then 'Net Deposit'
		when stud_term_app.eab_withdrawal_ind = 'true' then 'Withdraw'  
		when stud_term_app.cancel_dt is not null then 'Withdraw'  	
		when stud_term_app.eab_readmit_ind = 'true' then 'Readmit'
		when stud_term_app.eab_admit_ind = 'true' then 'Uncommitted Admit'
		when stud_term_app.eab_cond_admit_ind = 'true' then 'Conditional Admit'
		when stud_term_app.eab_waitlist_ind = 'true' then 'Waitlist'
		when stud_term_app.eab_app_complete_ind = 'true' then 'Completed Applicant'
		when stud_term_app.eab_app_incomplete_ind = 'true' then 'Incomplete Applicant' 
		when stud_term_app.eab_app_start_ind = 'true' then 'Started Applicant'
		when agg.eab_inquiry_ind = 'true' then 'Inquiry'
		else 'Prospect'
	end eab_current_funnel_status,

	row_number() over (partition by 
			nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''),  
			nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''),
			agg.eab_student_type, agg.eab_entry_term, agg.eab_entry_year_academic
	order by stud_term_app.eab_enroll_ind desc nulls last,
					   stud_term_app.eab_deny_ind desc nulls last,
					   stud_term_app.eab_deferral_future_ind desc nulls last,
					   stud_term_app.eab_deferral_prev_ind desc nulls last,
					   stud_term_app.eab_deposit_ind desc nulls last,
					   stud_term_app.eab_withdrawal_ind desc nulls last,
					   stud_term_app.eab_admit_ind desc nulls last,
					   stud_term_app.eab_cond_admit_ind desc nulls last,
					   stud_term_app.eab_waitlist_ind desc nulls last,
					   stud_term_app.eab_app_complete_ind desc nulls last,
					   stud_term_app.eab_app_incomplete_ind desc nulls last,
					   stud_term_app.eab_app_start_ind desc nulls last,  
					   agg.eab_inquiry_ind desc nulls last) rn

	from 

		  (select distinct
		  stud_term.primary_student_id,
		  stud_term.primary_student_id as eab_student_id,
		  lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(stud_term.partner_system_name,'primary'),'[\\s]','')) as eab_student_id_type,
		  <partnercontact_id.crm_ug> as partnercontact_id,
		  lower(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.crm_ug>,'[\\s]','')) as partner_system_name,
--custom value on unconverted student type
		  case when stud_term_app.campus_location ilike 'Saint%' or stud_term_app.campus_location ilike 'Ancilla%' or stud_term_app.campus_location ilike 'Plymouth%'
		  then stud_term_app.student_type else stud_term.student_type end as student_type,
		  stud_term.current_entry_term as curr_entry_term,
		  stud_term.current_entry_year_as_academic_year as curr_entry_year_academic,
		  stud_term.inquiry_indicator as inquiry_ind,
		  stud_term.recruitment_status,
		  stud_term.state_of_residence_for_tuition_purposes as state_resident,
		  stud_term.inquiry_first_source_code as first_source,
		  try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term.inquiry_first_source_date,1,19)) as first_source_dt,
		  stud_term.athletic_recruit as athletic_recruit_ind,
		  stud_term.athletic_recruit_primary_sport_description as athletic_recruit_sport,
		  stud_term.years_of_work_experience as years_employed,
		  stud_term.academic_rating as academic_rating,
		  stud_term.interest_rating as interest_rating,
		  stud_term.student_level,
		  stud_term.current_entry_year_as_calendar_year as curr_entry_year_calendar,

		  case when pcm_athletic_rec.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
		  then try_to_boolean(false)
		  else try_to_boolean(pcm_athletic_rec.eab_standard_value)
		  end as eab_athletic_recruit_ind,

		  case when pcm_entry_term.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
		  then 'Unknown'
		  else pcm_entry_term.eab_standard_value
		  end as eab_entry_term,

		  case when pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
		  then null
		  else try_to_number(pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value)
		  end as eab_entry_year_academic,

		  case when pcm_first_source.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
		  then 'Unknown'
		  else pcm_first_source.eab_standard_value
		  end as eab_first_source,

		  case when pcm_inquiry_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
		  then try_to_boolean(false)
		  else try_to_boolean(pcm_inquiry_ind.eab_standard_value)
		  end as eab_inquiry_ind,

		  case when stud_term_app.campus_location ilike 'Saint%' or stud_term_app.campus_location ilike 'Ancilla%' or stud_term_app.campus_location ilike 'Plymouth%'
		  then 'Other'
		  when pcm_stud_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
		  then 'Unknown'
		  else pcm_stud_type.eab_standard_value
		  end as eab_student_type,

		  stud_term.intake_date as intake_dt


		  from <[Enroll360].[Student Term].{fulfillment}> as stud_term

		  left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_first_source}> pcm_first_source
			on (pcm_first_source.field_name = 'eab_first_source'
			and coalesce(stud_term.inquiry_first_source_code,'') = coalesce(pcm_first_source.partner_value,''))

		  left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_athletic_rec
			on (pcm_athletic_rec.field_name = 'eab_athletic_recruit_ind'
			and coalesce(stud_term.athletic_recruit,'') = coalesce(pcm_athletic_rec.partner_value,''))

		  left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_entry_term
			on (pcm_entry_term.field_name = 'eab_entry_term'
			and coalesce(stud_term.current_entry_term,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_term.partner_value,''))

		  left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_entry_year
			on (pcm_entry_year.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic'
			and coalesce(stud_term.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_year.partner_value,''))

		  left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_inquiry_ind
			on (pcm_inquiry_ind.field_name = 'eab_inquiry_ind'
			and coalesce(stud_term.inquiry_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_inquiry_ind.partner_value,''))

		  left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_stud_type
			on (pcm_stud_type.field_name = 'eab_student_type'
			and coalesce(stud_term.student_type,'') = coalesce(pcm_stud_type.partner_value,''))

		  <join_extension.Student Term>

		  where <where_statement>

		  ) agg

	left outer join 
	(select stud_term_app.*,
	row_number () over (partition by stud_term_app.partnercontact_id, stud_term_app.partner_system_name,  
	coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_student_type,''),
	coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_term,''),
	coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_year_academic,0)
	order by stud_term_app.eab_enroll_ind desc nulls last,
			 stud_term_app.eab_deny_ind desc nulls last,
			 stud_term_app.eab_deferral_future_ind desc nulls last,
			 stud_term_app.eab_deferral_prev_ind desc nulls last,
			 stud_term_app.eab_deposit_ind desc nulls last,
			 stud_term_app.eab_withdrawal_ind desc nulls last,
			 stud_term_app.eab_admit_ind desc nulls last,
			 stud_term_app.eab_cond_admit_ind desc nulls last,
			 stud_term_app.eab_waitlist_ind desc nulls last,
			 stud_term_app.eab_app_complete_ind desc nulls last,
			 stud_term_app.eab_app_incomplete_ind desc nulls last,
			 stud_term_app.eab_app_start_ind desc nulls last) rn

	from <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application].{final}> as stud_term_app) as stud_term_app
		on (agg.partnercontact_id = stud_term_app.partnercontact_id
		and	coalesce(agg.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(stud_term_app.partner_system_name,'')
		and	coalesce(agg.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_student_type,'')
		and coalesce(agg.eab_entry_term,'') = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_term,'')
		and coalesce(agg.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_year_academic,0))

queryResults.sqlPreview: WITH UNION_CTE AS ( SELECT pdp_pst.par_stu_term_hash_key, --to be deleted pdp_pst.primary_student_id, --to be deleted pdp_pst.student_type, pdp_pst.curr_entry_t…
queryResults.querySql:
WITH UNION_CTE AS
(
    SELECT
	    pdp_pst.par_stu_term_hash_key, --to be deleted
	    pdp_pst.primary_student_id, --to be deleted
	    pdp_pst.student_type,
	    pdp_pst.curr_entry_term,
	    pdp_pst.curr_entry_year_academic,
	    pdp_pst.inquiry_ind,
	    pdp_pst.recruitment_status,
	    pdp_pst.state_resident,
	    pdp_pst.first_source,
	    pdp_pst.first_source_dt,
	    pdp_pst.athletic_recruit_ind,
	    pdp_pst.athletic_recruit_sport,
	    pdp_pst.years_employed,
	    pdp_pst.academic_rating,
	    pdp_pst.interest_rating,
	    pdp_pst.student_level,
	    pdp_pst.curr_entry_year_calendar,
	    pdp_pst.eab_athletic_recruit_ind,
	    pdp_pst.eab_entry_term,
	    pdp_pst.eab_entry_year_academic,
	    pdp_pst.eab_first_source,
	    pdp_pst.eab_inquiry_ind,
	    pdp_pst.eab_student_type,
	    pdp_pst.eab_current_funnel_status,
		pdp_pst.partnercontact_id,
		pdp_pst.partner_system_name,
        pdp_pst.alternative_academic_rank,
        pdp_pst.eab_alternative_academic_rank,
        pdp_pst.intake_dt
    FROM PDP_UG.PAR__STUDENT_TERM AS pdp_pst
    LEFT JOIN <[Enroll360].[Student Term PDP Delivery].[Last Validated].{final}> AS en_st
	    ON pdp_pst.partnercontact_id = en_st.partnercontact_id -- Changed as part of ESAE-8034
	   AND pdp_pst.partner_system_name = en_st.partner_system_name -- Changed as part of ESAE-8034
	   AND COALESCE(pdp_pst.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = COALESCE(en_st.eab_entry_year_academic,0) -- Changed as part of ESAE-8034
	   AND COALESCE(pdp_pst.eab_entry_term,'') = COALESCE(en_st.eab_entry_term,'') -- Changed as part of ESAE-8034
       AND COALESCE(pdp_pst.eab_student_type,'') = COALESCE(en_st.eab_student_type,'')
    WHERE
		en_st.partnercontact_id IS NULL
        AND en_st.partner_system_name IS NULL
		AND en_st.eab_entry_year_academic IS NULL
		AND en_st.eab_entry_term IS NULL
        AND en_st.eab_student_type IS NULL
)
SELECT cte.*
FROM UNION_CTE AS cte
LEFT JOIN PDP_UG.mkt__data_deletion AS data_del
    ON cte.par_stu_term_hash_key = data_del.pdp_key
    AND LOWER(data_del.entity_name) = 'par__student_term'
    AND LOWER(data_del.removal_type) = 'hard_delete'
LEFT JOIN <[PDP_UG].[gdpr__record_deletion].{final}> AS gdpr
    ON cte.partnercontact_id = gdpr.partnercontact_id
    AND cte.partner_system_name = gdpr.partner_system_name
WHERE data_del.pdp_key IS NULL
    AND gdpr.partnercontact_id IS NULL -- filter to avoid GDPR deleted records
    AND gdpr.partner_system_name IS NULL

queryResults.querySql:
-- psft_term_app_parkside.sql
-- Emits *_DT as VARCHAR(19) and *_IND as 'true'/'false' strings.

WITH cte_01 AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,

    /* indicators (BOOLEAN) */
    (app_start.emplid    IS NOT NULL) AS app_start_ind_b,
    (withdraw_app.emplid IS NOT NULL) AS app_withdrawal_ind_b,
    (admit.emplid        IS NOT NULL) AS admit_ind_b,
    (WAPPNATT.emplid        IS NOT NULL) AS WAPPNATT_ind_b, 
    (cond_admit.emplid   IS NOT NULL) AS cond_admit_ind_b,
    (deny.emplid         IS NOT NULL) AS deny_ind_b,
    (enroll.emplid       IS NOT NULL) AS enroll_ind_b,
    (withdrawal.emplid   IS NOT NULL) AS withdraw_ind_b,
    (defer.emplid        IS NOT NULL) AS deferral_ind_b,

    /* timestamps (TIMESTAMP) */
    app_start.effdt    AS app_start_ts,
    withdraw_app.effdt AS app_withdrawal_ts,
    admit.effdt        AS admit_ts,
  	WAPPNATT.effdt        AS WAPPNATT_ts,
    cond_admit.effdt   AS cond_admit_ts,
    deny.effdt         AS deny_ts,
    enroll.effdt       AS enroll_ts,
    withdrawal.effdt   AS withdraw_ts,
    defer.effdt        AS deferral_ts

  FROM <[PeopleSoft].[ps_adm_appl_prog]> a

  /* APP START */
  LEFT JOIN <[PeopleSoft].[ps_adm_appl_prog]> app_start
    ON app_start.emplid        = a.emplid
   AND app_start.acad_career   = a.acad_career
   AND app_start.stdnt_car_nbr = a.stdnt_car_nbr
   AND app_start.adm_appl_nbr  = a.adm_appl_nbr
   AND app_start.admit_term    = a.admit_term
   AND app_start.campus        = a.campus
   AND app_start.acad_prog     = a.acad_prog
   AND app_start.appl_prog_nbr = a.appl_prog_nbr
   AND app_start.prog_action   = 'APPL'
   AND app_start.effdt = (
         SELECT MAX(effdt)
         FROM <[PeopleSoft].[ps_adm_appl_prog]> s1
         WHERE s1.emplid        = app_start.emplid
           AND s1.acad_career   = app_start.acad_career
           AND s1.stdnt_car_nbr = app_start.stdnt_car_nbr
           AND s1.adm_appl_nbr  = app_start.adm_appl_nbr
           AND s1.admit_term    = app_start.admit_term
           AND s1.campus        = app_start.campus
           AND s1.acad_prog     = app_start.acad_prog
           AND s1.appl_prog_nbr = app_start.appl_prog_nbr
           AND s1.prog_action   = 'APPL'
           AND s1.effdt        <= CURRENT_DATE
   )
   AND app_start.effseq = (
         SELECT MAX(effseq)
         FROM <[PeopleSoft].[ps_adm_appl_prog]> s2
         WHERE s2.emplid        = app_start.emplid
           AND s2.acad_career   = app_start.acad_career
           AND s2.stdnt_car_nbr = app_start.stdnt_car_nbr
           AND s2.adm_appl_nbr  = app_start.adm_appl_nbr
           AND s2.admit_term    = app_start.admit_term
           AND s2.campus        = app_start.campus
           AND s2.acad_prog     = app_start.acad_prog
           AND s2.appl_prog_nbr = app_start.appl_prog_nbr
           AND s2.prog_action   = 'APPL'
           AND s2.effdt         = app_start.effdt
   )

  /* ADMIT */
  LEFT JOIN <[PeopleSoft].[ps_adm_appl_prog]> admit
    ON admit.emplid        = a.emplid
   AND admit.acad_career   = a.acad_career
   AND admit.stdnt_car_nbr = a.stdnt_car_nbr
   AND admit.adm_appl_nbr  = a.adm_appl_nbr
   AND admit.admit_term    = a.admit_term
   AND admit.campus        = a.campus
   AND admit.prog_status   = 'AD'
   AND admit.prog_action   = 'ADMT'
   AND admit.effdt = (
         SELECT MAX(effdt)
         FROM <[PeopleSoft].[ps_adm_appl_prog]> a1
         WHERE a1.emplid        = admit.emplid
           AND a1.acad_career   = admit.acad_career
           AND a1.stdnt_car_nbr = admit.stdnt_car_nbr
           AND a1.adm_appl_nbr  = admit.adm_appl_nbr
           AND a1.admit_term    = admit.admit_term
           AND a1.campus        = admit.campus
           AND a1.appl_prog_nbr = admit.appl_prog_nbr
           AND a1.acad_prog     = admit.acad_prog
           AND a1.prog_status   = 'AD'
           AND a1.prog_action   = 'ADMT'
           AND a1.effdt        <= CURRENT_DATE
   )
   AND admit.effseq = (
         SELECT MAX(effseq)
         FROM <[PeopleSoft].[ps_adm_appl_prog]> a2
         WHERE a2.emplid        = admit.emplid
           AND a2.acad_career   = admit.acad_career
           AND a2.stdnt_car_nbr = admit.stdnt_car_nbr
           AND a2.adm_appl_nbr  = admit.adm_appl_nbr
           AND a2.admit_term    = admit.admit_term
           AND a2.campus        = admit.campus
           AND a2.appl_prog_nbr = admit.appl_prog_nbr
           AND a2.acad_prog     = admit.acad_prog
           AND a2.prog_status   = 'AD'
           AND a2.prog_action   = 'ADMT'
           AND a2.effdt         = admit.effdt
   )

  /* COND ADMIT */
  LEFT JOIN <[PeopleSoft].[ps_adm_appl_prog]> cond_admit
    ON cond_admit.emplid        = a.emplid
   AND cond_admit.acad_career   = a.acad_career
   AND cond_admit.stdnt_car_nbr = a.stdnt_car_nbr
   AND cond_admit.adm_appl_nbr  = a.adm_appl_nbr
   AND cond_admit.admit_term    = a.admit_term
   AND cond_admit.campus        = a.campus
   AND cond_admit.acad_prog     = a.acad_prog
   AND cond_admit.appl_prog_nbr = a.appl_prog_nbr
   AND cond_admit.prog_status   = 'AD'
   AND cond_admit.prog_action   = 'COND'
   AND cond_admit.effdt = (
         SELECT MAX(effdt)
         FROM <[PeopleSoft].[ps_adm_appl_prog]> c1
         WHERE c1.emplid        = cond_admit.emplid
           AND c1.acad_career   = cond_admit.acad_career
           AND c1.stdnt_car_nbr = cond_admit.stdnt_car_nbr
           AND c1.adm_appl_nbr  = cond_admit.adm_appl_nbr
           AND c1.admit_term    = cond_admit.admit_term
           AND c1.campus        = cond_admit.campus
           AND c1.acad_prog     = cond_admit.acad_prog
           AND c1.appl_prog_nbr = cond_admit.appl_prog_nbr
           AND c1.prog_status   = 'AD'
           AND c1.prog_action   = 'COND'
           AND c1.effdt        <= CURRENT_DATE
   )
   AND cond_admit.effseq = (
         SELECT MAX(effseq)
         FROM <[PeopleSoft].[ps_adm_appl_prog]> c2
         WHERE c2.emplid        = cond_admit.emplid
           AND c2.acad_career   = cond_admit.acad_career
           AND c2.stdnt_car_nbr = cond_admit.stdnt_car_nbr
           AND c2.adm_appl_nbr  = cond_admit.adm_appl_nbr
           AND c2.admit_term    = cond_admit.admit_term
           AND c2.campus        = cond_admit.campus
           AND c2.acad_prog     = cond_admit.acad_prog
           AND c2.appl_prog_nbr = cond_admit.appl_prog_nbr
           AND c2.prog_status   = 'AD'
           AND c2.prog_action   = 'COND'
           AND c2.effdt         = cond_admit.effdt
   )


  /* WAPP NATT */
  LEFT JOIN <[PeopleSoft].[ps_adm_appl_prog]> WAPPNATT
    ON WAPPNATT.emplid        = a.emplid
   AND WAPPNATT.acad_career   = a.acad_career
   AND WAPPNATT.stdnt_car_nbr = a.stdnt_car_nbr
   AND WAPPNATT.adm_appl_nbr  = a.adm_appl_nbr
   AND WAPPNATT.admit_term    = a.admit_term
   AND WAPPNATT.campus        = a.campus
   AND WAPPNATT.acad_prog     = a.acad_prog
   AND WAPPNATT.appl_prog_nbr = a.appl_prog_nbr
   AND WAPPNATT.PROG_REASON   = 'NATT'
   AND WAPPNATT.prog_action   = 'WAPP'
   AND WAPPNATT.effdt = (
         SELECT MAX(effdt)
         FROM <[PeopleSoft].[ps_adm_appl_prog]> c1
         WHERE c1.emplid        = WAPPNATT.emplid
           AND c1.acad_career   = WAPPNATT.acad_career
           AND c1.stdnt_car_nbr = WAPPNATT.stdnt_car_nbr
           AND c1.adm_appl_nbr  = WAPPNATT.adm_appl_nbr
           AND c1.admit_term    = WAPPNATT.admit_term
           AND c1.campus        = WAPPNATT.campus
           AND c1.acad_prog     = WAPPNATT.acad_prog
           AND c1.appl_prog_nbr = WAPPNATT.appl_prog_nbr
           AND c1.PROG_REASON   = 'NATT'
           AND c1.prog_action   = 'WAPP'
           AND c1.effdt        <= CURRENT_DATE
   )
   AND WAPPNATT.effseq = (
         SELECT MAX(effseq)
         FROM <[PeopleSoft].[ps_adm_appl_prog]> c2
         WHERE c2.emplid        = WAPPNATT.emplid
           AND c2.acad_career   = WAPPNATT.acad_career
           AND c2.stdnt_car_nbr = WAPPNATT.stdnt_car_nbr
           AND c2.adm_appl_nbr  = WAPPNATT.adm_appl_nbr
           AND c2.admit_term    = WAPPNATT.admit_term
           AND c2.campus        = WAPPNATT.campus
           AND c2.acad_prog     = WAPPNATT.acad_prog
           AND c2.appl_prog_nbr = WAPPNATT.appl_prog_nbr
           AND c2.PROG_REASON   = 'NATT'
           AND c2.prog_action   = 'WAPP'
           AND c2.effdt         = WAPPNATT.effdt
   )
  
  /* DENY */
  LEFT JOIN <[PeopleSoft].[ps_adm_appl_prog]> deny
    ON deny.emplid        = a.emplid
   AND deny.acad_career   = a.acad_career
   AND deny.stdnt_car_nbr = a.stdnt_car_nbr
   AND deny.adm_appl_nbr  = a.adm_appl_nbr
   AND deny.admit_term    = a.admit_term
   AND deny.campus        = a.campus
   AND deny.acad_prog     = a.acad_prog
   AND deny.appl_prog_nbr = a.appl_prog_nbr
   --AND deny.prog_status   = 'CN'
   AND deny.prog_action   = 'DENY'
   AND deny.effdt = (
         SELECT MAX(effdt)
         FROM <[PeopleSoft].[ps_adm_appl_prog]> d1
         WHERE d1.emplid        = deny.emplid
           AND d1.acad_career   = deny.acad_career
           AND d1.stdnt_car_nbr = deny.stdnt_car_nbr
           AND d1.adm_appl_nbr  = deny.adm_appl_nbr
           AND d1.admit_term    = deny.admit_term
           AND d1.campus        = deny.campus
           AND d1.acad_prog     = deny.acad_prog
           AND d1.appl_prog_nbr = deny.appl_prog_nbr
           --AND d1.prog_status   = 'CN'
           AND d1.prog_action   = 'DENY'
           AND d1.effdt        <= CURRENT_DATE
   )
   AND deny.effseq = (
         SELECT MAX(effseq)
         FROM <[PeopleSoft].[ps_adm_appl_prog]> d2
         WHERE d2.emplid        = deny.emplid
           AND d2.acad_career   = deny.acad_career
           AND d2.stdnt_car_nbr = deny.stdnt_car_nbr
           AND d2.adm_appl_nbr  = deny.adm_appl_nbr
           AND d2.admit_term    = deny.admit_term

           AND d2.appl_prog_nbr = deny.appl_prog_nbr
           AND d2.prog_action   = 'DENY'
           AND d2.effdt         = deny.effdt

  /* ENROLL/MATRICULATE */

   AND enroll.stdnt_car_nbr = a.stdnt_car_nbr

  /* APPLICATION WITHDRAWAL */

    ON withdraw_app.emplid        = a.emplid

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.
