queryResults.querySql:
select * from (
SELECT
    CASE
    WHEN TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          (
              TRY_TO_DATE(CASE WHEN app.status IN ('Accepted','Deposited','Confirmed','Admitted','Contingently Admitted') THEN app.updated_at ELSE appd.admit_dt END) IS NOT NULL
              AND TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) > TRY_TO_DATE(CASE WHEN app.status IN ('Accepted','Deposited','Confirmed','Admitted','Contingently Admitted') THEN app.updated_at ELSE appd.admit_dt END)
          )
          OR (
              TRY_TO_DATE(appd.cond_admit_dt) IS NOT NULL
              AND TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) > TRY_TO_DATE(appd.cond_admit_dt)
          )
      )
    THEN NULL
    ELSE CASE WHEN app.status IN ('Accepted','Deposited','Confirmed','Admitted','Contingently Admitted') THEN app.updated_at ELSE appd.admit_dt END
END as ADMIT_DATE,
    CASE
    WHEN TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          (
              TRY_TO_DATE(CASE WHEN app.status IN ('Accepted','Deposited','Confirmed','Admitted','Contingently Admitted') THEN app.updated_at ELSE appd.admit_dt END) IS NOT NULL
              AND TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) > TRY_TO_DATE(CASE WHEN app.status IN ('Accepted','Deposited','Confirmed','Admitted','Contingently Admitted') THEN app.updated_at ELSE appd.admit_dt END)
          )
          OR (
              TRY_TO_DATE(appd.cond_admit_dt) IS NOT NULL
              AND TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) > TRY_TO_DATE(appd.cond_admit_dt)
          )
      )
    THEN NULL
    ELSE CASE
        WHEN appd.admit_ind = '1' THEN appd.admit_ind
        WHEN aapp.deposit_ind = '1' THEN aapp.deposit_ind
        WHEN aapp.enroll_ind = '1' THEN aapp.enroll_ind
        WHEN app.status IN ('Accepted','Deposited','Confirmed','Admitted','Contingently Admitted') THEN '1'
        ELSE NULL
    END
END as ADMIT_INDICATOR,
    null as ADMIT_INDICATOR_EAB,
    appd.admit_notify_dt as ADMIT_NOTIFY_DATE,
    TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.app_completion_dt)), '')) as APPLICATION_COMPLETED_DATE,
    case	WHEN app.status IN ('Confirmed/Deposit','Completed','Confirmed','Deposited','Complete','Registered','Accepted','Deposited','Confirmed','Admitted','Contingently Admitted') THEN '1' 
			ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.app_complete_ind)), '') END as APPLICATION_COMPLETED_INDICATOR,
    null as APPLICATION_COMPLETED_INDICATOR_EAB,
    null as APPLICATION_DECISION_TYPE_CODE,
    null as APPLICATION_DECISION_TYPE_EAB,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.id)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.external_id)), '')) as APPLICATION_ID,
    TRY_TO_DATE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.app_submission_date_time)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.submitted_at)), ''))) as APPLICATION_INCOMPLETE_DATE,
    IFF(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.app_submission_date_time)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.submitted_at)), '')) IS NOT NULL, 'TRUE', NULL) as APPLICATION_INCOMPLETE_INDICATOR,
    null as APPLICATION_INCOMPLETE_INDICATOR_EAB,
    TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.created_at)), '')) as APPLICATION_STARTED_DATE,
    IFF(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.created_at)), '') IS NOT NULL, 'TRUE', NULL) as APPLICATION_STARTED_INDICATOR,
    null as APPLICATION_STARTED_INDICATOR_EAB,
    app.application_name as APPLICATION_TYPE,
    null as APPLICATION_TYPE_EAB,
    TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.app_withdrawal_dt)), '')) as APPLICATION_WITHDRAWAL_DATE,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.app_withdrawal_ind)), '') as APPLICATION_WITHDRAWAL_INDICATOR,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.major)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.program)), '')) as AREA_OF_ACADEMIC_INTEREST_OR_MAJOR_FOR_UNDERGRADUATE_SCHOOL,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_1,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_10,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_2,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_3,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_4,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_5,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_6,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_7,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_8,
    null as CALCULATED_FIELD_9,
    null as CALCULATED_ID_FIELD,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.campus_location)), '') as CAMPUS_LOCATION,
    CASE
        WHEN TRY_TO_BOOLEAN(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.commuter_indicator)), '')) = TRUE THEN 'Commuter'
        WHEN TRY_TO_BOOLEAN(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.commuter_indicator)), '')) = FALSE THEN 'Resident'
        ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.commuter_indicator)), '')
    END as CAMPUS_RESIDENT_OR_COMMUTER_INDICATOR,
    null as CAMPUS_RESIDENT_OR_COMMUTER_INDICATOR_EAB,
    TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.cancel_dt)), '')) as CANCEL_DATE,
    CASE
    WHEN TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          (
              TRY_TO_DATE(CASE WHEN app.status IN ('Contingently Admitted') THEN app.updated_at ELSE appd.admit_dt END) IS NOT NULL
              AND TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) > TRY_TO_DATE(CASE WHEN app.status IN ('Contingently Admitted') THEN app.updated_at ELSE appd.admit_dt END)
          )
          OR (
              TRY_TO_DATE(appd.cond_admit_dt) IS NOT NULL
              AND TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) > TRY_TO_DATE(appd.cond_admit_dt)
          )
      )
    THEN NULL
    ELSE appd.cond_admit_dt
	END as CONDITIONAL_ADMIT_DATE,
    CASE
    WHEN TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          (
              TRY_TO_DATE(CASE WHEN app.status IN ('Contingently Admitted') THEN app.updated_at ELSE appd.admit_dt END) IS NOT NULL
              AND TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) > TRY_TO_DATE(CASE WHEN app.status IN ('Contingently Admitted') THEN app.updated_at ELSE appd.admit_dt END)
          )
          OR (
              TRY_TO_DATE(appd.cond_admit_dt) IS NOT NULL
              AND TRY_TO_DATE(appd.deny_dt) > TRY_TO_DATE(appd.cond_admit_dt)
          )
      )
    THEN NULL
    ELSE appd.cond_admit_ind
	END as CONDITIONAL_ADMIT_INDICATOR,
    null as CONDITIONAL_ADMIT_INDICATOR_EAB,
    appd.cond_admit_reason as CONDITIONAL_ADMIT_REASON,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.entry_term)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.intended_start_term)), '')) as CURRENT_ENTRY_TERM,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.entry_year)), '') as CURRENT_ENTRY_YEAR_AS_ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    null as DECISION_DATE_1,
    null as DECISION_DATE_2,
    null as DECISION_DATE_3,
    null as DECISION_DATE_4,
    null as DECISION_DATE_5,
    null as DECISION_STATUS_1,
    null as DECISION_STATUS_2,
    null as DECISION_STATUS_3,
    null as DECISION_STATUS_4,
    null as DECISION_STATUS_5,
    appd.deferral_dt as DEFERRAL_DATE,
    appd.deferral_from_term as DEFERRAL_FROM_TERM,
    case when app.status in ('Deferred') then '1' else appd.deferral_ind end as DEFERRAL_INDICATOR,
    appd.deferral_to_term as DEFERRAL_TO_TERM,
    case when appd.admit_dt > appd.deny_dt then null else appd.deny_dt end as DENY_DATE,
    case when appd.admit_dt > appd.deny_dt then null else appd.deny_ind end as DENY_INDICATOR,
    null as DENY_INDICATOR_EAB,
    aapp.deposit_dt as DEPOSIT_CONFIRMED_DATE,
    case when app.status in ('Confirmed/Deposit','Deposited') then '1' else aapp.deposit_ind end as DEPOSIT_CONFIRMED_INDICATOR,
    null as DEPOSIT_CONFIRMED_INDICATOR_EAB,
    case when COALESCE(TRY_TO_DATE(aapp.withdrawal_dt),TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.app_withdrawal_dt)), '')), TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.cancel_dt)), ''))) is not null or app.status in ('Withdrawn') then null else aapp.enroll_dt end as ENROLLMENT_DATE,
    case when COALESCE(TRY_TO_DATE(aapp.withdrawal_dt),TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.app_withdrawal_dt)), '')), TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.cancel_dt)), ''))) is not null or app.status in ('Withdrawn') then null else aapp.enroll_ind end as ENROLLMENT_INDICATOR,
    null as ENROLLMENT_INDICATOR_EAB,
    null as ENTRY_TERM_EAB,
    null as ENTRY_YEAR_AS_ACADEMIC_YEAR_EAB,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.full_part_time)), '') as FULLTIME_OR_PARTTIME_STATUS,
    null as FULLTIME_OR_PARTTIME_STATUS_EAB,
    null as FUTURE_DEFERRAL_INDICATOR_EAB,
    aapp.housing_deposit_dt as HOUSING_DEPOSIT_DATE,
    aapp.housing_deposit_ind as HOUSING_DEPOSIT_PAID_OR_WAIVED_INDICATOR,
    null as HOUSING_DEPOSIT_PAID_OR_WAIVED_INDICATOR_EAB,
    app.intake_date as INTAKE_DATE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.program)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.program_multi)), '')) as INTENDED_PROGRAM,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.school_applied)), '') as INTENDED_SCHOOL,
    'navigate_crm_1' as PARTNER_SYSTEM_NAME,
    null as POPULATION_NAME,
    null as PREVIOUS_DEFERRAL_INDICATOR_EAB,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.prospect_id)), '') as PRIMARY_STUDENT_ID,
    app.status as READMIT_INDICATOR,
    null as READMIT_INDICATOR_EAB,
    coalesce(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.STUDENT_TYPE)), ''),NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(appc.CUSTOM_SHORT_ANSWER_5)), '')) as STUDENT_TYPE,
    null as STUDENT_TYPE_EAB,
    null as TEST_OPTIONAL_EAB,
    NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.test_optional_indicator)), '') as TEST_OPTIONAL_INDICATOR,
    appd.waitlist_admit_ind as WAITLIST_ADMIT,
    appd.waitlist_dt as WAITLIST_DATE,

    null as WAITLISTED_INDICATOR_EAB,
    COALESCE(TRY_TO_DATE(aapp.withdrawal_dt),TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.app_withdrawal_dt)), '')), TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(app.cancel_dt)), ''))) as WITHDRAWAL_DATE,
	--null as WITHDRAWAL_DATE,
    CASE WHEN app.status in ('Withdrawn') then '1' else COALESCE(aapp.withdrawal_ind,

/*2025-06-19: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-03-24: added eab_student_id and eab_student_id_type - ccreekman*/

select distinct * from (

select distinct
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as primary_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,
agg2.student_type,
agg2.curr_entry_term,
agg2.curr_entry_year_academic,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.application_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as application_id,
agg2.app_start_ind,
agg2.app_start_dt,
agg2.app_submit_ind,
agg2.app_submit_dt,
agg2.app_complete_ind,
agg2.app_completion_dt,
agg2.app_withdrawal_ind,
agg2.app_withdrawal_dt,
agg2.app_type,
agg2.app_decision,
agg2.admit_ind,
agg2.admit_dt,
agg2.cond_admit_ind,
agg2.cond_admit_dt,
agg2.cond_admit_reason,
agg2.admit_notify_dt,
agg2.deny_ind,
agg2.deny_dt,
agg2.deferral_ind,
agg2.deferral_dt,
agg2.deferral_from_term,
agg2.deferral_to_term,
agg2.waitlist_ind,
agg2.waitlist_admit_ind,
agg2.waitlist_dt,
agg2.deposit_ind,
agg2.deposit_dt,
agg2.housing_deposit_ind,
agg2.housing_deposit_dt,
agg2.enroll_ind,
agg2.enroll_dt,
agg2.withdrawal_ind,
agg2.withdrawal_dt,
agg2.test_optional_ind,
agg2.full_part_time,
agg2.school_applied,
agg2.program,
agg2.commuter_type,
agg2.campus_location,
agg2.eab_withdrawal_ind,
agg2.eab_waitlist_ind,
agg2.eab_admit_ind,
agg2.eab_readmit_ind,
agg2.eab_cond_admit_ind,
agg2.eab_full_part_time,
agg2.eab_deposit_ind,
agg2.cancel_dt,
agg2.eab_test_optional_ind,
agg2.eab_app_start_ind,
agg2.eab_app_incomplete_ind,
agg2.eab_app_complete_ind,
agg2.eab_app_type,
agg2.eab_app_decision_type,
agg2.eab_commuter_ind,
agg2.eab_deferral_prev_ind,
agg2.eab_deferral_future_ind,
agg2.eab_deny_ind,
agg2.eab_enroll_ind,
agg2.eab_housing_deposit_ind,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.major,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as major,
agg2.eab_entry_term,
agg2.eab_entry_year_academic,
agg2.eab_student_type,
agg2.intake_dt

from (

select agg.*,
row_number() over (partition by 
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''),  
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''),
		agg.eab_student_type, agg.eab_entry_term, agg.eab_entry_year_academic, 
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.application_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'')
order by agg.eab_enroll_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_deposit_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_admit_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_cond_admit_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_deny_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_app_complete_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_app_incomplete_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_app_start_ind desc nulls last) rn

from (

select distinct
stud_term_app.primary_student_id,
stud_term_app.primary_student_id as eab_student_id,
lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(stud_term_app.partner_system_name,'primary'),'[\\s]','')) as eab_student_id_type,
<partnercontact_id.crm_ug> as partnercontact_id,
lower(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.crm_ug>,'[\\s]','')) as partner_system_name,
stud_term_app.student_type,
stud_term_app.current_entry_term as curr_entry_term,
stud_term_app.current_entry_year_as_academic_year as curr_entry_year_academic,
stud_term_app.application_id,
stud_term_app.application_started_indicator as app_start_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.application_started_date,1,19)) as app_start_dt,
stud_term_app.application_incomplete_indicator as app_submit_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.application_incomplete_date,1,19)) as app_submit_dt,
stud_term_app.application_completed_indicator as app_complete_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.application_completed_date,1,19)) as app_completion_dt,
stud_term_app.application_withdrawal_indicator as app_withdrawal_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.application_withdrawal_date,1,19)) as app_withdrawal_dt,
stud_term_app.application_type as app_type,
stud_term_app.application_decision_type_code as app_decision,
stud_term_app.admit_indicator as admit_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.admit_date,1,19)) as admit_dt,
stud_term_app.conditional_admit_indicator as cond_admit_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.conditional_admit_date,1,19)) as cond_admit_dt,
stud_term_app.conditional_admit_reason as cond_admit_reason,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.admit_notify_date,1,19)) as admit_notify_dt,
stud_term_app.deny_indicator as deny_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.deny_date,1,19)) as deny_dt,
stud_term_app.deferral_indicator as deferral_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.deferral_date,1,19)) as deferral_dt,
stud_term_app.deferral_from_term as deferral_from_term,
stud_term_app.deferral_to_term as deferral_to_term,
stud_term_app.waitlist_indicator as waitlist_ind,
stud_term_app.waitlist_admit as waitlist_admit_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.waitlist_date,1,19)) as waitlist_dt,
stud_term_app.deposit_confirmed_indicator as deposit_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.deposit_confirmed_date,1,19)) as deposit_dt,
stud_term_app.housing_deposit_paid_or_waived_indicator as housing_deposit_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.housing_deposit_date,1,19)) as housing_deposit_dt,
stud_term_app.enrollment_indicator as enroll_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.enrollment_date,1,19)) as enroll_dt,
stud_term_app.withdrawal_indicator as withdrawal_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.withdrawal_date,1,19)) as withdrawal_dt,
stud_term_app.test_optional_indicator as test_optional_ind,
stud_term_app.fulltime_or_parttime_status as full_part_time,
stud_term_app.intended_school as school_applied,
stud_term_app.intended_program as program,
stud_term_app.campus_resident_or_commuter_indicator as commuter_type,
stud_term_app.campus_location as campus_location,

case when pcm_withdrawal_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then try_to_boolean(false)
when try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.withdrawal_date,1,19)) is not null
then try_to_boolean(true)
else try_to_boolean(pcm_withdrawal_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_withdrawal_ind,

case when pcm_waitlist_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then try_to_boolean(false)

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

/*2025-07-14: moving partner customization from prev tenant query into new tenant with current STA master code 
partner customization is joining to a Major crosswalk (located in a Student Relationship fulfillment table) to bring in human readable major value 
left join has been moved to <join_extension.Student Term Application>; major and program fields are populated from lookup table - ccreekman*/

/*2025-03-24: added eab_student_id and eab_student_id_type - ccreekman*/
/******************/
/*tenant query due to major and program fields are populated from lookup table - ccreekman*/

select distinct * from (

select distinct
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as primary_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,

from (

select agg.*,
row_number() over (partition by 
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''),  
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''),
		agg.eab_student_type, agg.eab_entry_term, agg.eab_entry_year_academic, 
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.application_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'')

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

agg2.eab_entry_term,
agg2.eab_entry_year_academic,
agg2.eab_student_type,

from (

select agg.*,
row_number() over (partition by 
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''),  
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''),
		agg.eab_student_type, agg.eab_entry_term, agg.eab_entry_year_academic, 
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.application_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'')

agg.eab_deposit_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_admit_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_cond_admit_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_deny_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_app_complete_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_app_incomplete_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_app_start_ind desc nulls last) rn

from (

select distinct
stud_term_app.primary_student_id,
stud_term_app.primary_student_id as eab_student_id,
lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(stud_term_app.partner_system_name,'primary'),'[\\s]','')) as eab_student_id_type,

*/

try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.enrollment_date,1,19)) as enroll_dt,

try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.withdrawal_date,1,19)) as withdrawal_dt,
stud_term_app.test_optional_indicator as test_optional_ind,
stud_term_app.fulltime_or_parttime_status as full_part_time,

stud_term_app.intended_program as program,
stud_term_app.campus_resident_or_commuter_indicator as commuter_type,

case when pcm_waitlist_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then try_to_boolean(false)
when try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.waitlist_date,1,19)) is not null
then try_to_boolean(true)
else try_to_boolean(pcm_waitlist_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_waitlist_ind,

case when pcm_admit_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then try_to_boolean(false)
when try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.admit_date,1,19)) is not null
then try_to_boolean(true)
else try_to_boolean(pcm_admit_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_admit_ind,

try_to_boolean(false) as eab_readmit_ind,

case when pcm_cond_admit_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then try_to_boolean(false)
when try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.conditional_admit_date,1,19)) is not null
then try_to_boolean(true)
else try_to_boolean(pcm_cond_admit_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_cond_admit_ind,

pcm_full_part_time.eab_standard_value as eab_full_part_time,

/*
-- old code for eab_deposit_ind, 3/23/26 dherman
case when pcm_deposit_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then try_to_boolean(false)
when try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.deposit_confirmed_date,1,19)) is not null
then try_to_boolean(true)
else try_to_boolean(pcm_deposit_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_deposit_ind,
*/

then try_to_boolean(false)
when student_events.stud_events_event_date is not null
then try_to_boolean(true)
else try_to_boolean(pcm_deposit_ind.eab_standard_value)

try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.cancel_date,1,19)) as cancel_dt,

case when pcm_test_optional_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_test_optional_ind.eab_standard_value)

case when pcm_app_start_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then try_to_boolean(false)
when try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.application_started_date,1,19)) is not null
then try_to_boolean(true)
else try_to_boolean(pcm_app_start_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_app_start_ind,

case when pcm_app_incomplete_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then try_to_boolean(false)
when try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.application_incomplete_date,1,19)) is not null
then try_to_boolean(true)
else try_to_boolean(pcm_app_incomplete_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_app_incomplete_ind,

case when pcm_app_complete_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then try_to_boolean(false)

then try_to_boolean(true)
else try_to_boolean(pcm_app_complete_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_app_complete_ind,

pcm_app_type.eab_standard_value as eab_app_type,

pcm_app_decision_type.eab_standard_value as eab_app_decision_type,

case when pcm_commuter_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_commuter_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_commuter_ind,

case when pcm_deferral_prev_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then try_to_boolean(false)
else try_to_boolean(pcm_deferral_prev_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_deferral_prev_ind,

case when pcm_deferral_future_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then try_to_boolean(false)
else try_to_boolean(pcm_deferral_future_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_deferral_future_ind,

case when pcm_deny_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then try_to_boolean(false)
when try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.deny_date,1,19)) is not null
then try_to_boolean(true)
else try_to_boolean(pcm_deny_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_deny_ind,

case when pcm_enroll_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then try_to_boolean(false)
when try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.enrollment_date,1,19)) is not null
then try_to_boolean(true)
else try_to_boolean(pcm_enroll_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_enroll_ind,

case when pcm_housing_deposit_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then try_to_boolean(false)
when try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term_app.housing_deposit_date,1,19)) is not null
then try_to_boolean(true)
else try_to_boolean(pcm_housing_deposit_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_housing_deposit_ind,

stud_term_app.area_of_academic_interest_or_major_for_undergraduate_school as major,

case when pcm_entry_term.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then 'Unknown'
else pcm_entry_term.eab_standard_value
end as eab_entry_term,

case when pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value
end as eab_entry_year_academic,

case when pcm_student_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then 'Unknown'
else pcm_student_type.eab_standard_value
end as eab_student_type,

stud_term_app.intake_date as intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application].{fulfillment}> as stud_term_app

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_withdrawal_ind
on (pcm_withdrawal_ind.field_name = 'eab_withdrawal_ind'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.withdrawal_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_withdrawal_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_waitlist_ind
on (pcm_waitlist_ind.field_name = 'eab_waitlist_ind'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.waitlist_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_waitlist_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_admit_ind
on (pcm_admit_ind.field_name = 'eab_admit_ind'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.admit_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_admit_ind.partner_value,''))
														  
left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_cond_admit_ind
on (pcm_cond_admit_ind.field_name = 'eab_cond_admit_ind'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.conditional_admit_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_cond_admit_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_full_part_time
on (pcm_full_part_time.field_name = 'eab_full_part_time'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.fulltime_or_parttime_status,'') = coalesce(pcm_full_part_time.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_deposit_ind
on (pcm_deposit_ind.field_name = 'eab_deposit_ind'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.deposit_confirmed_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_deposit_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_test_optional_ind
on (pcm_test_optional_ind.field_name = 'eab_test_optional_ind'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.test_optional_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_test_optional_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_app_start_ind
on (pcm_app_start_ind.field_name = 'eab_app_start_ind'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.application_started_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_app_start_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_app_incomplete_ind
on (pcm_app_incomplete_ind.field_name = 'eab_app_incomplete_ind'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.application_incomplete_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_app_incomplete_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_app_complete_ind
on (pcm_app_complete_ind.field_name = 'eab_app_complete_ind'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.application_completed_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_app_complete_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_app_type
on (pcm_app_type.field_name = 'eab_app_type'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.application_type,'') = coalesce(pcm_app_type.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_app_decision_type
on (pcm_app_decision_type.field_name = 'eab_app_decision_type'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.application_decision_type_code,'') = coalesce(pcm_app_decision_type.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_commuter_ind
on (pcm_commuter_ind.field_name = 'eab_commuter_ind'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.campus_resident_or_commuter_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_commuter_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_deny_ind
on (pcm_deny_ind.field_name = 'eab_deny_ind'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.deny_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_deny_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_enroll_ind
on (pcm_enroll_ind.field_name = 'eab_enroll_ind'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.enrollment_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_enroll_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_housing_deposit_ind
on (pcm_housing_deposit_ind.field_name = 'eab_housing_deposit_ind'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.housing_deposit_paid_or_waived_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_housing_deposit_ind.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_entry_term
on (pcm_entry_term.field_name = 'eab_entry_term'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.current_entry_term,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_term.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_entry_year_academic
on (pcm_entry_year_academic.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_year_academic.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_student_type
on (pcm_student_type.field_name = 'eab_student_type'
and coalesce(stud_term_app.student_type,'') = coalesce(pcm_student_type.partner_value,''))

-- add code for student events
left join (
	
    select 
  		stud.primary_student_id as stud_primary_student_id,
  		stud.sis_student_id as stud_sis_student_id, 
  		stud_events.primary_student_id as stud_events_primary_student_id,
        stud_events.event_date as stud_events_event_date,

		case when pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' then null 
		else try_to_number(pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value) 
		end as eab_entry_year_academic_se,

		case when pcm_entry_term.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' then 'Unknown' 
		else pcm_entry_term.eab_standard_value 
		end as eab_entry_term_se
													   
													   
    from <[Enroll360].[Student].{fulfillment}> as stud 
  
    join <[Enroll360].[Student Events].{fulfillment}> as stud_events
    on stud.sis_student_id=stud_events.primary_student_id

        left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_attributes}> as pcm_entry_year 
		on pcm_entry_year.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic' 
		and coalesce(stud_events.calculated_field_1,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_year.partner_value,'') 

        left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_attributes}> as pcm_entry_term 
		on pcm_entry_term.field_name = 'eab_entry_term' 
		and coalesce(stud_events.calculated_field_2,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_term.partner_value,'')
													  
		) student_events

    on stud_term_app.primary_student_id=student_events.stud_primary_student_id
 	and coalesce(stud_term_app.CURRENT_ENTRY_YEAR_AS_ACADEMIC_YEAR,'1901')=coalesce(student_events.eab_entry_year_academic_se,'1901')
    and coalesce(stud_term_app.CURRENT_ENTRY_TERM,'')=coalesce(student_events.eab_entry_term_se,'')

-- end code for student events

<join_extension.Student Term Application>

where <where_statement>

) agg

) agg2

where agg2.rn = 1
and <where_statement.eab_student_type> 
and coalesce(agg2.application_id,'') ||
coalesce(agg2.app_start_ind,'') ||
coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.app_start_dt),'') ||
coalesce(agg2.app_submit_ind,'') ||
coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.app_submit_dt),'') ||
coalesce(agg2.app_complete_ind,'') ||
coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.app_completion_dt),'') ||
coalesce(agg2.app_withdrawal_ind,'') ||
coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.app_withdrawal_dt),'') ||
coalesce(agg2.app_type,'') ||
coalesce(agg2.app_decision,'') ||
coalesce(agg2.admit_ind,'') ||
coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.admit_dt),'') ||
coalesce(agg2.cond_admit_ind,'') ||
coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.cond_admit_dt),'') ||
coalesce(agg2.cond_admit_reason,'') ||
coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.admit_notify_dt),'') ||
coalesce(agg2.deny_ind,'') ||
coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.deny_dt),'') ||
coalesce(agg2.deferral_ind,'') ||
coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.deferral_dt),'') ||
coalesce(agg2.deferral_from_term,'') ||
coalesce(agg2.deferral_to_term,'') ||

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

AND gdpr.partner_system_name IS NULL

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

select stud_term_app.eab_entry_year_academic,

--where stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic in (2021,2022)

and a.student_type <> 'Unknown'

group by a.curr_entry_year_academic, a.curr_entry_term, a.student_type
order by a.curr_entry_year_academic, a.curr_entry_term, a.student_type;

queryResults.sqlPreview: --Prospect & Inquiry Counts select stud_term.CURR_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC as entry_year, stud_term.CURR_ENTRY_TERM as entry_term, stud_term.student_type as student_…
queryResults.querySql:
--Prospect & Inquiry Counts

select 
stud_term.CURR_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC as entry_year,
stud_term.CURR_ENTRY_TERM as entry_term, 
stud_term.student_type as student_type, 
sum(case when stud_term.inquiry_ind = 'FALSE' then 1 else 0 end) as prospects,
sum(case when stud_term.inquiry_ind = 'TRUE' then 1 else 0 end) as inquiries
from "61607_634679" stud_term
where stud_term.PANTO_FILE_ID = 204635592
and stud_term.student_type = 'NEW TRANSFER'
group by stud_term.CURR_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC,
stud_term.CURR_ENTRY_TERM,
stud_term.student_type
order by stud_term.CURR_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC,
stud_term.CURR_ENTRY_TERM,
stud_term.student_type

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--App Funnel Counts

select distinct
stud_term_app.CURR_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC as entry_year, 
stud_term_app.CURR_ENTRY_TERM as entry_term, 
stud_term_app.student_type as student_type, 
stal.APP_SUBMIT_IND, 
stal.APP_COMPLETE_IND, 
stal.admit_ind, 
stal.deny_ind, 
stal.deposit_ind, 
stal.WITHDRAWAL_IND, 
stal.enroll_ind
from "61607_635064" stud_term_app

full outer join	(select distinct	
		stud_term_app.CURR_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC, 
		stud_term_app.CURR_ENTRY_TERM, 
		stud_term_app.student_type, 
		sum(case when stud_term_app.APP_SUBMIT_IND = 'TRUE' then 1 else 0 end) as APP_SUBMIT_IND, 
		sum(case when stud_term_app.APP_COMPLETE_IND = 'TRUE' then 1 else 0 end) as APP_COMPLETE_IND, 
		sum(case when stud_term_app.admit_ind = 'TRUE' then 1 else 0 end) as admit_ind, 
		sum(case when stud_term_app.deny_ind = 'TRUE' then 1 else 0 end) as deny_ind, 
		sum(case when stud_term_app.deposit_ind = 'TRUE' then 1 else 0 end) as deposit_ind, 
		sum(case when stud_term_app.WITHDRAWAL_IND = 'TRUE' then 1 else 0 end) as WITHDRAWAL_IND, 
		sum(case when stud_term_app.enroll_ind = 'TRUE' then 1 else 0 end) as enroll_ind  
		from "61607_635064" stud_term_app
		where 1=1 
		and stud_term_app.PANTO_FILE_ID = 204635613
		and stud_term_app.student_type = 'NEW TRANSFER'	
		group by stud_term_app.CURR_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC, stud_term_app.CURR_ENTRY_TERM, stud_term_app.student_type
		order by stud_term_app.CURR_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC, stud_term_app.CURR_ENTRY_TERM, stud_term_app.student_type
		) stal
		on stud_term_app.CURR_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC = stal.CURR_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC
		and stud_term_app.CURR_ENTRY_TERM = stal.CURR_ENTRY_TERM
		and stud_term_app.student_type = stal.student_type
		
	where 1=1
	and stud_term_app.PANTO_FILE_ID = 204635613
	and stud_term_app.student_type = 'NEW TRANSFER'
group by stud_term_app.CURR_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC, stud_term_app.CURR_ENTRY_TERM, stud_term_app.student_type, stal.APP_SUBMIT_IND, stal.APP_COMPLETE_IND, stal.admit_ind, stal.deny_ind, stal.deposit_ind, stal.WITHDRAWAL_IND, stal.enroll_ind
order by stud_term_app.CURR_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC, stud_term_app.CURR_ENTRY_TERM, stud_term_app.student_type

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

ON crm.eab_student_id=sis.eab_student_id
AND crm.eab_student_id_type=sis.eab_student_id_type
AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(crm.eab_entry_year_academic,0))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(sis.eab_entry_year_academic,0)))

WHERE (sis.eab_student_id IS NOT NULL AND sis.eab_student_id_type IS NOT NULL) OR (crm.eab_student_id IS NOT NULL AND crm.eab_student_id_type IS NOT NULL)

queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-07-01: updated to align with Atlas pilot query best practices. This query DOES NOT merge UG and FAO data.  - ccreekman*/
/*2026-07-01: added where statement variable for filtering prior to ranking and deduping - ccreekman*/
/*2026-03-03: <partnercontact_id>,<partner_system_name> master bundle updated to choose ID in this order: crm ID from merged record > join ID from SIS record, SIS ID 
join fields are in merge query, null placecholder fields added to this query - ccreekman*/
/*2026-02-09: updated to look for eab_student_id fields, partnercontact_id, partner_system_name from final tables, added to_number to eab_entry_year_academic
prev. the top level cast to number was removed as the source fields were numeric, added this back after engineering update. 
Result fields will not have decimals as default type from to_number is NUMBER(38,0) - ccreekman*/
/*2026-01-20: engineering updated bundle for <eab_entry_year_academic> to cast fields to varchar before the coalesce. 
coalescing the null from the empty SIS field with the numeric value from CRM was creating a numeric value of type NUMBER(18,5) (eg 2025.00000)*/
/*2026-01-12: corrected code that was changing dates with timestamps to just dates - ccreekman*/
/*2025-12-05: partnercontact_id and partner_system_name were removed in prev edit from 11-20, restoring fields - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-07: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2024-11-21: corrected coalesce, prev code was coalesce(crm.eab_entry_year_academic,''), eab_entry_year_academic is a numeric field - ccreekman*/




WITH 
stud_term_app_sis_fao as (
SELECT * from (
  SELECT distinct
  	null as join_partnercontact_id,
	null as join_partner_system_name,
	stud_term_app.*,
  row_number() over(partition by stud_term_app.partnercontact_id, stud_term_app.partner_system_name, stud_term_app.eab_student_type, stud_term_app.eab_entry_term, stud_term_app.eab_entry_year_academic 
		order by stud_term_app.intake_dt desc nulls last) as merge_rn

  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stud_term_app

)agg
where 1=1
and merge_rn = 1

)

select * from (
select distinct agg.*,
row_number() over (partition by agg.partnercontact_id,
                                agg.partner_system_name,
                                agg.eab_entry_term, 
                                agg.eab_entry_year_academic,
				   				agg.eab_student_type,
                                agg.application_id
order by agg.eab_enroll_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_deposit_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_admit_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_cond_admit_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_deny_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_app_complete_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_app_submit_ind asc nulls last,
agg.eab_app_start_ind desc nulls last, agg.intake_dt desc nulls last) pdp_delivery_rn

from (

SELECT distinct

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-07-01: added where statement variable for filtering prior to ranking and deduping - ccreekman*/
/*2026-03-03: crm psname crossjoin now checks STerm to ensure we are populating pcID even if crm table does not have data, 
<partnercontact_id>,<partner_system_name> master bundle updated to choose ID in this order: crm ID from merged record > join ID from SIS record, SIS ID - ccreekman*/
/*2026-01-13: merge query notes - ccreekman
stud_term_app_sis_fao cte: takes all SIS data, appends any partner_system_name(s) that are present in CRM_UG Student Term Application.final
	Expectation is for one partner_system_name in CRM_UG STA.final, but set up to account for crm changes, other scenarios where there may be a mix of ID types
	Uses this to pull in only IDs from Xwalk that align with CRM_UG STA.final partner_system_name(s), excluding any irrelevant matching ID pairs
	if there are multiple CRM_UG STA.final partner_system_name(s), multiple rows per SIS record will be created
	deduping logic will exclude records with null join_partnercontact_id only if there is not a record with a populated join_partnercontact_id
	multiple records per student may still persist if they have unique populated join_partnercontact_id/join_partner_system_name values
	in that scenario resulting counts on this table may be inflated, need further examples to determine if we need to build in variables to allow customization here
main query: takes results from stud_term_app_sis_fao cte and does a full outer join to CRM_UG STA.final using the join ID / ID type (if populated)
	crm join currently in variables - unclear if we need that level of customization available
*/

WITH 
stud_term_app_sis_fao as (
SELECT * from (
  SELECT distinct
  	id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id as join_partnercontact_id,
	id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name as join_partner_system_name,
	stud_term_app.*,
  row_number() over(partition by stud_term_app.partnercontact_id, stud_term_app.partner_system_name, stud_term_app.eab_student_type, stud_term_app.eab_entry_term, stud_term_app.eab_entry_year_academic 
		order by id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id) as merge_rn

  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stud_term_app

  /*cross join below will associate current crm_ug partner_system_name(s) with SIS record to limit the IDs pulled from xwalk to relevent psnames
  join parcontID/psname will later only be populated when Xwalk has records where one ID pair is the parcontID/psname from this SIS data 
  and the other set has a psname that matches what we appended here
  eg: partner xwalk includes psnames of sis_01, sis_02, primary, crm_01 but crm tables only have ID psns of primary, crm_01 so only those are appended to the records*/ 
  CROSS JOIN (
  		select distinct partner_system_name as crm_ug_partner_system_name
		FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application].[Last Validated].{final}> stud_crm
		union
		select distinct partner_system_name as crm_ug_partner_system_name
		FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term].[Last Validated].{final}> stud_crm
  		) crm_psn

  LEFT JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> id_xwalk
	on (stud_term_app.partnercontact_id = id_xwalk.target_partnercontact_id
	and coalesce(stud_term_app.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(id_xwalk.target_partner_system_name,'')
	and coalesce(crm_psn.CRM_UG_PARTNER_SYSTEM_NAME,'') = coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name,''))
)agg
where 1=1
/*xwalk may have multiple id pairs which meet join criteria
	this criteria limits the result set to only allow necessary dupes
	[rn = 1]: to ensure at least one copy of the SIS record is retained regardless if there is a match in ID Xwalk
	[agg.join_partnercontact_id is not null]: any dupes with distinct partnercontact_id/partner_system_name*/

and (agg.join_partnercontact_id is not null or merge_rn = 1) 
--and agg.join_partnercontact_id is null /*for troubleshooting - SIS records with no xwalk match*/

)

select * from (
select distinct agg.*,
row_number() over (partition by agg.partnercontact_id,
                                agg.partner_system_name,
                                agg.eab_entry_term, 
                                agg.eab_entry_year_academic,
				   				agg.eab_student_type,
                                agg.application_id
order by agg.eab_enroll_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_deposit_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_admit_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_cond_admit_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_deny_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_app_complete_ind desc nulls last,
agg.eab_app_submit_ind asc nulls last,
agg.eab_app_start_ind desc nulls last, agg.intake_dt desc nulls last) pdp_delivery_rn

    crm_ug.primary_student_id,

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

FULL OUTER JOIN crm_source_data AS crm 

ON (crm.partnercontact_id = sis.partnercontact_id
AND crm.partner_system_name = sis.partner_system_name
AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(crm.eab_entry_year_academic,0))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(sis.eab_entry_year_academic,0)))
AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(crm.eab_entry_term,''))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(sis.eab_entry_term,'')))
AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(crm.eab_student_type,''))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(sis.eab_student_type,'')))
AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(crm.application_id,''))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(sis.application_id,''))))
WHERE (sis.partnercontact_id IS NOT NULL AND sis.partner_system_name IS NOT NULL) OR (crm.partnercontact_id IS NOT NULL AND crm.partner_system_name IS NOT NULL)

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

select * from (

select distinct
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
agg2.curr_entry_year_academic,
agg2.curr_entry_term,
agg2.src_attribute_type,
agg2.eab_entry_term,
agg2.src_attribute_value,
agg2.eab_entry_year_academic,
agg2.eab_attribute_group,
agg2.eab_std_value,
agg2.intake_dt,
agg2.effective_start_date,
agg2.effective_end_date,
agg2.eab_attribute_type

from (

select distinct
eab_student_id as eab_student_id,
'primary' as eab_student_id_type,

CURRENT_ENTRY_YEAR_AS_ACADEMIC_YEAR as curr_entry_year_academic,
CURRENT_ENTRY_TERM as curr_entry_term,
'Dual Enrollment' as src_attribute_type,

case when pcm_entry_term.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then 'Unknown'
else pcm_entry_term.eab_standard_value
end as eab_entry_term,  

source_attribute_value as src_attribute_value,
  
case when pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_number(pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_entry_year_academic,

'partner_segment' as eab_attribute_group,   
'fy25_dual_enroll' as eab_std_value,
current_date as intake_dt,
null as effective_start_date,
null as effective_end_date,
null as eab_attribute_type

from <[Enroll360].[Student Term Attributes].{fulfillment}> as stud_term_att
  
left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_entry_year
on (pcm_entry_year.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic'
and coalesce(stud_term_att.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_year.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_entry_term
on (pcm_entry_term.field_name = 'eab_entry_term'
and coalesce(stud_term_att.current_entry_term,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_term.partner_value,''))
										 
where 1=1
and source_attribute_value='1'
and CURRENT_ENTRY_YEAR_AS_ACADEMIC_YEAR = 'Fall 2025'

													  
) agg2

where 1=1 
  and coalesce(agg2.eab_student_id,'') <> ''
  and coalesce(agg2.eab_student_id_type,'') <> ''
  and coalesce(agg2.eab_entry_term,'')<>''
  and coalesce(agg2.eab_attribute_group,'')<>''

) agg3

select 
agg3.eab_student_id,
agg3.eab_student_id_type,
agg3.partnercontact_id,
agg3.partner_system_name,
agg3.curr_entry_term,
agg3.curr_entry_year_academic,
agg3.student_type,
agg3.eab_entry_year_academic,
agg3.eab_entry_term,
agg3.eab_student_type,
agg3.src_attribute_value,
agg3.src_attribute_type,
agg3.eab_attribute_group,
agg3.eab_attribute_type,
agg3.eab_std_value,
agg3.effective_start_date,
agg3.effective_end_date,
agg3.intake_dt
from (

select agg2.*,
row_number() over(partition by agg2.partnercontact_id, agg2.partner_system_name, agg2.eab_entry_year_academic, agg2.eab_entry_term, agg2.src_attribute_type, agg2.src_attribute_value
				  order by agg2.intake_dt desc nulls last, agg2.eab_student_type) as rn

from (
select distinct 
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(unpivot_agg.eab_student_id, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as eab_student_id,  
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(unpivot_agg.eab_student_id_type, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as eab_student_id_type, 
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(unpivot_agg.eab_student_id, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as partnercontact_id,  
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(unpivot_agg.eab_student_id_type, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as partner_system_name,  
unpivot_agg.curr_entry_term,
unpivot_agg.curr_entry_year_academic,
unpivot_agg.student_type,
unpivot_agg.eab_entry_year_academic,
unpivot_agg.eab_entry_term, 
unpivot_agg.eab_student_type,
<src_attribute_value> as src_attribute_value,
<src_attribute_type> as src_attribute_type,
		 
case when pcm_attribute_group.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' 
then null 
else lower(pcm_attribute_group.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_attribute_group,

<eab_attribute_type> as eab_attribute_type,
lower(<eab_std_value>) as eab_std_value,

<effective_start_date> as effective_start_date,
<effective_end_date> as effective_end_date,

/*2026-08-06: updated with deduping, aligns with updates to other pdp_delivery queries
student_type fields added, cannot push live to overwrite master until we confirm partners with blank crm Student Term Attributes rerun to update that table*/
/*2025-07-07: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
--This is  created to source from the .final population each CRM and SIS entity and deliver to the .student_pdp_delivery population
-- Bonfire Nights Release Update

WITH 
student_att_sis_fao as (
    SELECT * from (
  SELECT distinct
  	null as join_partnercontact_id, /*used for merging records only; do not delete*/
	null as join_partner_system_name, /*used for merging records only; do not delete*/
	stud_att.* ,
  row_number() over(partition by stud_att.partnercontact_id, stud_att.partner_system_name, 
		lower(stud_att.src_attribute_type), lower(stud_att.src_attribute_value), stud_att.eab_entry_year_academic, stud_att.eab_entry_term
		order by intake_dt desc nulls last, eab_std_value desc nulls last) as att_rn

 FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term Attributes SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stud_att

) agg
where 1=1
and att_rn = 1 

)

select * from (
select agg.*
, row_number() over (partition by studagg_att.partnercontact_id, agg.partner_system_name, 
		lower(agg.src_attribute_type), lower(agg.src_attribute_value), agg.eab_entry_year_academic, agg.eab_entry_term
		order by intake_dt desc nulls last, eab_std_value desc nulls last) as pdp_delivery_rn
from (
SELECT 
    crm_ug.eab_student_id as primary_student_id,
	
    sis_fao.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_sis,
    sis_fao.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
    crm_ug.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_crm,
    crm_ug.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_crm,
    <eab_student_id> AS eab_student_id, /*default: sis > crm*/
    <eab_student_id_type> AS eab_student_id_type, /*default: sis > crm*/

    sis_fao.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_sis,
    sis_fao.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_sis,
    crm_ug.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_crm,
    crm_ug.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_crm,
    <partnercontact_id> AS partnercontact_id, /*default: crm > join > sis*/
    <partner_system_name> AS partner_system_name, /*default: crm > join > sis*/

	try_to_number(sis_fao.eab_entry_year_academic) AS eab_entry_year_academic_sis,
	try_to_number(crm_ug.eab_entry_year_academic) AS eab_entry_year_academic_crm,
	<eab_entry_year_academic> AS eab_entry_year_academic,

	sis_fao.eab_entry_term AS eab_entry_term_sis,
	crm_ug.eab_entry_term AS eab_entry_term_crm,
	<eab_entry_term> AS eab_entry_term,

	sis_fao.eab_student_type AS eab_student_type_sis,
	crm_ug.eab_student_type AS eab_student_type_crm,
	<eab_student_type> AS eab_student_type,
	
	sis_fao.src_attribute_type AS src_attribute_type_sis,
	crm_ug.src_attribute_type AS src_attribute_type_crm,
	<src_attribute_type> AS src_attribute_type,	
	
	sis_fao.curr_entry_year_academic AS curr_entry_year_academic_sis,
	crm_ug.curr_entry_year_academic AS curr_entry_year_academic_crm,
	<curr_entry_year_academic> AS curr_entry_year_academic,
	
	sis_fao.curr_entry_term AS curr_entry_term_sis,
	crm_ug.curr_entry_term AS curr_entry_term_crm,
	<curr_entry_term> AS curr_entry_term,
	
	sis_fao.student_type AS student_type_sis,
	crm_ug.student_type AS student_type_crm,
	<student_type> AS student_type,
	
	sis_fao.src_attribute_value AS src_attribute_value_sis,
	crm_ug.src_attribute_value AS src_attribute_value_crm,
	<src_attribute_value> AS src_attribute_value,	
	
	sis_fao.eab_attribute_group AS eab_attribute_group_sis,
	crm_ug.eab_attribute_group AS eab_attribute_group_crm,
	<eab_attribute_group> AS eab_attribute_group,

    sis_fao.eab_attribute_type AS eab_attribute_type_sis,
	crm_ug.eab_attribute_type AS eab_attribute_type_crm,
	<eab_attribute_type> AS eab_attribute_type,	
	
	sis_fao.eab_std_value AS eab_std_value_sis,
	crm_ug.eab_std_value AS eab_std_value_crm,
	<eab_std_value> AS eab_std_value,

    to_date(sis_fao.effective_start_date) AS effective_start_date_sis,
	to_date(crm_ug.effective_start_date) AS effective_start_date_crm,
	<effective_start_date> AS effective_start_date,	
	
    to_date(sis_fao.effective_end_date) AS effective_end_date_sis,

student_term_attributes_crm AS crm

queryResults.querySql:
--NOTE: this is JSU-Pilot specific

--formatting the source data into the proper format, per ref__attribute_types' standard values
SELECT
	attr.eab_student_id
  , attr.eab_student_id_type
  ,	LPAD(attr.eab_student_id, 9, '0') AS partnercontact_id
  , attr.eab_student_id_type AS partner_system_name
  , attr.CURRENT_ENTRY_YEAR_AS_ACADEMIC_YEAR AS curr_entry_year_academic
  , CASE WHEN attr.CURRENT_ENTRY_YEAR_AS_ACADEMIC_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN attr.CURRENT_ENTRY_YEAR_AS_ACADEMIC_YEAR
           ELSE NULL
     END AS eab_entry_year_academic
  , attr.CURRENT_ENTRY_TERM AS curr_entry_term
  , CASE WHEN LEFT(attr.CURRENT_ENTRY_TERM, LEN(attr.CURRENT_ENTRY_TERM) - 5) IN ('Fall', 'Spring', 'Summer') THEN LEFT(attr.CURRENT_ENTRY_TERM, LEN(attr.CURRENT_ENTRY_TERM) - 5)
         ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS eab_entry_term
  , attr.student_type AS student_type
  , DECODE(attr.student_type, 'F', 'Freshman', 'T', 'Transfer', 'R', 'Readmit', 'Unknown') AS eab_student_type

--attribute group
  , 'cohort' AS eab_attribute_group

--attribute type
  , attr.source_attribute_type AS src_attribute_type
  , CASE WHEN LOWER(attr.source_attribute_type) ILIKE ('excl%') THEN 'excluded_group'
         ELSE 'custom_cohort'
    END AS eab_attribute_type

--attribute value
  , attr.source_attribute_value AS src_attribute_value
  , attr.source_attribute_value AS eab_std_value
  , attr.intake_dt
  , NULL AS effective_start_date
  , NULL AS effective_end_date
FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term Attributes SIS].{fulfillment}> AS attr
WHERE eab_std_value IS NOT NULL

from (
select distinct 
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(unpivot_agg.eab_student_id, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as eab_student_id,  
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(unpivot_agg.eab_student_id_type, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as eab_student_id_type,

case when pcm_attribute_group.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' 
then null

end as eab_attribute_group,

unpivot_agg.intake_dt as intake_dt

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis_attributes}> as pcm_attribute_group 
on pcm_attribute_group.field_name = 'eab_attribute_group' 
and unpivot_agg.src_attribute_value = pcm_attribute_group.partner_value 

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis_attributes}> as pcm_attribute_type

)agg3

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

select distinct * from (
select distinct 
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(unpivot_agg.eab_student_id, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as eab_student_id,  
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(unpivot_agg.eab_student_id_type, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as eab_student_id_type, 
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(unpivot_agg.partnercontact_id, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as partnercontact_id,  
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(unpivot_agg.partner_system_name, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as partner_system_name,  
unpivot_agg.curr_entry_term,
unpivot_agg.curr_entry_year_academic,
unpivot_agg.student_type,
unpivot_agg.eab_entry_year_academic,
unpivot_agg.eab_entry_term, 
unpivot_agg.eab_student_type,
<src_attribute_value> as src_attribute_value,
<src_attribute_type> as src_attribute_type,
		 
case when pcm_attribute_group.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' 
then null 
else lower(pcm_attribute_group.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_attribute_group,

<eab_attribute_type> as eab_attribute_type,
lower(<eab_std_value>) as eab_std_value,

<effective_start_date> as effective_start_date,
<effective_end_date> as effective_end_date,
unpivot_agg.intake_dt as intake_dt
, par_statt.intake_dt as parintake
from unpivot_agg
		 
left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis_attributes}> as pcm_attribute_group 
on pcm_attribute_group.field_name = 'eab_attribute_group' 
and unpivot_agg.src_attribute_value = pcm_attribute_group.partner_value 

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis_attributes}> as pcm_attribute_type
on pcm_attribute_group.field_name = 'eab_attribute_type' 
and unpivot_agg.src_attribute_value = pcm_attribute_type.partner_value 

left outer join pdp_ug.par__student_term_attributes par_statt
on (unpivot_agg.partnercontact_id = par_statt.partnercontact_id
and coalesce(unpivot_agg.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(par_statt.partner_system_name,'')
and coalesce(unpivot_agg.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(par_statt.eab_entry_year_academic,0)
and coalesce(unpivot_agg.eab_entry_term,'') = coalesce(par_statt.eab_entry_term,'')
and coalesce(unpivot_agg.src_attribute_value,'') = coalesce(par_statt.src_attribute_value,'')
and coalesce(unpivot_agg.src_attribute_type,'') = coalesce(par_statt.src_attribute_type,''))

) agg
where 1=1
and coalesce(partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(partner_system_name,'') <> ''
and coalesce(eab_std_value,'') <> ''

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

from <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].{final}> stud_term

left join 
  (select *, 
   case when pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
	then null
	else try_to_number(pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value)
	end as eab_entry_year_academic,
	case when pcm_entry_term.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
	then 'Unknown'
	else pcm_entry_term.eab_standard_value
	end as eab_entry_term 
	from <[Enroll360].[Student Term Attributes SIS].{fulfillment}> stud_term_att
   
	left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_entry_year
	on (pcm_entry_year.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic'
	and coalesce(stud_term_att.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_year.partner_value,''))

	left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_entry_term
	on (pcm_entry_term.field_name = 'eab_entry_term'
	and coalesce(stud_term_att.current_entry_term,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_term.partner_value,''))

	) stud_term_att
   
on (stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_term_att.eab_student_id
and stud_term.eab_student_id_type = stud_term_att.eab_student_id_type
and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(stud_term_att.eab_entry_year_academic,0))

left join <[Enroll360].[Student SIS].{final}> stud
on stud_term.eab_student_id = stud.primary_student_id 

left join <[Enroll360].[Student Address SIS].{final}> stud_addr

left join (select eab_student_id, eab_student_id_type, 
		   listagg(stud_race.eab_race,'|') as eab_race
		   from <[Enroll360].[Student Race SIS].{final}> stud_race
		   group by eab_student_id, eab_student_id_type) stud_race
on (stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_race.eab_student_id
and stud_term.eab_student_id_type = stud_race.eab_student_id_type)

left join <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application SIS].{final}> stud_term_app
on (stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_term_app.eab_student_id
and stud_term.eab_student_id_type = stud_term_app.eab_student_id_type
and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_year_academic,0)
and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_term,'') = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_term,''))

left join <[Enroll360].[Student Year Finaid Application].{final}> syfa
on (stud_term.eab_student_id = syfa.eab_student_id
and stud_term.eab_student_id_type = syfa.eab_student_id_type
and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(syfa.eab_entry_year_academic,0))

left join (select eab_student_id, eab_student_id_type, eab_entry_year_academic,
		  listagg(syf.eab_fund_type,'|') as agg_eab_fund_type,
		  listagg(syf.fund_type,'|') as agg_fund_code
		  , count(*)
		  from <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{final}> syf
		  group by eab_student_id, eab_student_id_type, eab_entry_year_academic) syf
on (stud_term.eab_student_id = syf.eab_student_id
and stud_term.eab_student_id_type = syf.eab_student_id_type
and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(syf.eab_entry_year_academic,0))

left join <[Enroll360].[Student High School SIS].{final}> stud_hs
on (stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_hs.eab_student_id
and stud_term.eab_student_id_type = stud_hs.eab_student_id_type)

left join <[Enroll360].[Student Test Scores SIS].{final}> stud_test
on (stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_test.eab_student_id
and stud_term.eab_student_id_type = stud_test.eab_student_id_type)

where 1=1

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.
