queryResults.queryKey: Enroll360/Student Term Attributes SIS/w_Variables_Enroll360.Student Term Attributes SIS.final.test_20250214
queryResults.sqlPreview: With agg_att as (select distinct stud_term.eab_student_id, stud_term.eab_student_id_type, stud_term.curr_entry_term, stud_term.curr_entry_year_academic, stud_te…
queryResults.querySql:
With agg_att as (select
        distinct stud_term.eab_student_id,
        stud_term.eab_student_id_type,
        stud_term.curr_entry_term,
        stud_term.curr_entry_year_academic,
        stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,
		stud_term.eab_entry_term,
        stud_term.intake_dt,
        case 
            when stud_term.curr_entry_term ilike 'P' then 'ExclSummer' 
            else null 
        end  as source_attribute_type01,
        case 
            when stud_term_app.deferral_ind = 'Defer (Later Term)' then 'ExclDeferredToNext' 
            when stud_term_app.deferral_ind = 'Admit, Previously Deferred' then 'ExclDeferredFromLast' 
            else null 
        end  as source_attribute_type02,
        case 
            when syf.agg_eab_fund_type ilike '%Tuition Waiver%' then 'ExclWaiver' 
            else null 
        end  as source_attribute_type03,
        case 
            when syf.agg_eab_fund_type ilike '%7023FS|%' then 'ExclMUSIC' 
            else null 
        end  as source_attribute_type04,
        case 
            when stud_term_app.eab_waitlist_ind = true then 'ExclWaitlist' 
            else null 
        end  as source_attribute_type05,
        case 
            when syfa.EAB_INDEPENDENT_IND = true then 'ExclIndependent' 
            else null 
        end  as source_attribute_type06,
        case 
            when coalesce(stud_term.academic_rating,
            '') = '' 
            and stud_term.eab_student_type = 'Freshman' then 'ExclNOACAD' 
            when coalesce(stud_term.academic_rating,
            '') = '' 
            and stud_term.eab_student_type = 'Transfer' then 'ExclNoAcadTR' 
            else null 
        end  as source_attribute_type07,
        case 
            when stud_term_app.eab_cond_admit_ind = true then 'ExclConditionalAdmit' 
            else null 
        end  as source_attribute_type08,
        case 
            when stud_term_app.eab_readmit_ind = true then 'ExclReadmit' 
            else null 
        end  as source_attribute_type09,
        case 
            when stud_addr.state = 'CO' 
            and (stud.eab_ethnicity = 'Hispanic or Latino/a/e/x' 
            or stud_race.eab_race ilike any ('%Black%',
            '%Asian%',
            '%Native%',
            '%Middle%',
            '%Multi%',
            '%Other%')) then 'ColoradoOfColor' 
            else null 
        end  as source_attribute_type10,
        case 
            when syf.agg_eab_fund_type ilike '%8450FS|%' then 'Pathways' 
            else 'Not Pathways Recipient' 
        end  as source_attribute_type11,
        case 
            when syf.agg_eab_fund_type ilike '%8450FS|%' 
            and stud_term_app.eab_major = 'MajEng' then 'Ritchie Pathways' 
            else 'Not Ritchie Pathways' 
        end  as source_attribute_type12,
        case 
            when syf.agg_eab_fund_type ilike '%0760FS|%' then 'Impact Grant Recipient' 
            else 'Not Impact Grant Recipient' 
        end  as source_attribute_type13,
        case 
            when syf.agg_eab_fund_type ilike '%0693FS|%' then 'Denver Scholarship Recipient' 
            else 'Not Denver Scholarship Recipient' 
        end  as source_attribute_type14,
        case 
            when syfa.eab_aid_app_ind = true 
            and to_number(syfa.fafsa_sai) < 6657 
            and stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic = 2023 then 'PellEligible' 
            when syfa.eab_aid_app_ind = true 
            and stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic in (2024,
            2025) 
            and (to_number(syfa.fafsa_sai) < 6656 
            or syf.agg_fund_code ilike '%8812FS|%') then 'PellEligible' 
            else null 
        end  as source_attribute_type15,
        case 
            when syf.agg_eab_fund_type ilike '%Athletic Scholarship%' then 'ExclAthlete' 
            else null 
        end  as source_attribute_type16,
        case 
            when stud_term_app.eab_app_decision_type = 'Early Decision' then 'ExclEarlyDecision1' 
            when stud_term_app.eab_app_decision_type = 'Early Decision 2' then 'ExclEarlyDecision2' 
            when stud_term_app.app_decision = 'Late Action' then 'ExclLateAdmit' 
            else null 
        end  as source_attribute_type17,
        case 
            when stud_term.eab_student_type = 'Transfer' 
            and coalesce(stud_hs.hs_ceeb_cd,
            '') <> '' then 'TRInstNotNull' 
            else null 
        end  as source_attribute_type18,
        case 
            when syfa.eab_aid_app_ind = true 
            and to_number(syfa.fafsa_sai) > 6601 
            and to_number(syfa.fafsa_sai) < 6657 then 'PellMin' 
            when syfa.eab_aid_app_ind = true 
            and to_number(syfa.fafsa_sai) = 0 then 'PellMax' 
            else null 
        end  as source_attribute_type19,
        case 
            when syfa.number_in_college = '1' then 'Num in College 1' 
            when syfa.number_in_college = '2' then 'Num in College 2' 
            when to_number(syfa.number_in_college) > 2 then 'Num in College 3 ' 
            else null 
        end  as source_attribute_type20,
        case 
            when stud_term.eab_student_type = 'Transfer' then 'ExclTransfer' 
            else null 
        end  as source_attribute_type21,
        case 
            when stud_term.academic_rating = '1' 
            and pdc_need_rank.sort_order = '5' then 'ACRK1NDRK5' 
            else null end  as source_attribute_type22,
-- DT added 23, 24, and 25
		case when syf.agg_eab_fund_type ilike '%5073FS|%'
			then 'ElevateGrant'
			else 'NotElevateGrant'
			end  as source_attribute_type23,
	   case when stud_term_app.eab_major = 'MajArt'
			then 'ArtsandHumanities'
			when stud_term_app.eab_major = 'MajBus'
			then 'Business'
			when stud_term_app.eab_major = 'MajEng'
			then 'EngineeringandCompSci'
			when stud_term_app.eab_major = 'MajHum'
			then 'ArtsandHumanities'
			when stud_term_app.eab_major = 'MajSci'
			then 'NaturalSciencesandMath'
			when stud_term_app.eab_major = 'MajSoc'
			then 'SocialSciences'
			when stud_term_app.eab_major = 'MajUnd'
			then 'Undeclared'
			else null end  as source_attribute_type24,
	    case when stud_term_app.EAB_TEST_OPTIONAL_IND = True
			Then 'TestOptional'
			Else 'NotTestOptional' end  as source_attribute_type25,
        null  as source_attribute_type26,
        null  as source_attribute_type27,
        null  as source_attribute_type28,
        null  as source_attribute_type29,
        null  as source_attribute_type30,
        null  as source_attribute_type31,
        null  as source_attribute_type32,
        null  as source_attribute_type33,
        null  as source_attribute_type34,
        null  as source_attribute_type35,
        null  as source_attribute_type36,
        null  as source_attribute_type37,
        null  as source_attribute_type38,
        null  as source_attribute_type39,
        null  as source_attribute_type40,
        null  as source_attribute_type41,
        null  as source_attribute_type42,
        null  as source_attribute_type43,
        null  as source_attribute_type44,
        null  as source_attribute_type45,
        null  as source_attribute_type46,
        null  as source_attribute_type47,
        null  as source_attribute_type48,
        null  as source_attribute_type49,
        null  as source_attribute_type50
    from
        <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].{final}> as stud_term 
    left join
        (select
            *,
            case 
                when pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' then null 
                else try_to_number(pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value) 
            end  as eab_entry_year_academic,
            case 
                when pcm_entry_term.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' then 'Unknown' 
                else pcm_entry_term.eab_standard_value 
            end  as eab_entry_term  
        from
            <[Enroll360].[Student Term Attributes SIS].{fulfillment}> as stud_term_att 
        left outer join
            <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> as pcm_entry_year 
                on pcm_entry_year.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic' 
                and coalesce(stud_term_att.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,
            '') = coalesce(pcm_entry_year.partner_value,
            '') 
        left outer join
            <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> as pcm_entry_term 
                on pcm_entry_term.field_name = 'eab_entry_term' 
                and coalesce(stud_term_att.current_entry_term,
            '') = coalesce(pcm_entry_term.partner_value,
            '') ) as stud_term_att 
            on stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_term_att.eab_student_id 
            and stud_term.eab_student_id_type = stud_term_att.eab_student_id_type 
            and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,
        0) = coalesce(stud_term_att.eab_entry_year_academic,
        0) 
    left join
        <[Enroll360].[Student SIS].{final}> as stud 
            on stud_term.eab_student_id = stud.primary_student_id  
    left join
        <[Enroll360].[Student Address SIS].{final}> as stud_addr 
            on stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_addr.eab_student_id 
            and stud_term.eab_student_id_type = stud_addr.eab_student_id_type 
    left join
        (select
            eab_student_id,
            eab_student_id_type,
            listagg(stud_race.eab_race,
            '|')  as eab_race  
        from
            <[Enroll360].[Student Race SIS].{final}> as stud_race  
        group by
            eab_student_id,
            eab_student_id_type ) as stud_race 
            on stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_race.eab_student_id 
            and stud_term.eab_student_id_type = stud_race.eab_student_id_type 
    left join
        <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application SIS].{final}> as stud_term_app 
            on stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_term_app.eab_student_id 
            and stud_term.eab_student_id_type = stud_term_app.eab_student_id_type 
            and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,
        0) = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_year_academic,
        0) 
        and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_term,
        '') = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_term,
        '') 
    left join
        <[Enroll360].[Student Year Finaid Application].{final}> as syfa 
            on stud_term.eab_student_id = syfa.eab_student_id 
            and stud_term.eab_student_id_type = syfa.eab_student_id_type 
            and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,
        0) = coalesce(syfa.eab_entry_year_academic,
        0) 
    left join
        (select
            eab_student_id,
            eab_student_id_type,
            eab_entry_year_academic,
            listagg(syf.eab_fund_type,
            '|')  as agg_eab_fund_type,
            listagg(concat(syf.fund_type,'|'),'')  as agg_fund_code,
            COUNT(*)  
        from
            <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{final}> as syf  
        group by
            eab_student_id,
            eab_student_id_type,
            eab_entry_year_academic ) as syf 
            on stud_term.eab_student_id = syf.eab_student_id 
            and stud_term.eab_student_id_type = syf.eab_student_id_type 
            and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,
        0) = coalesce(syf.eab_entry_year_academic,
        0) 
    left join
        <[Enroll360].[Student High School SIS].{final}> as stud_hs 
            on stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_hs.eab_student_id 
            and stud_term.eab_student_id_type = stud_hs.eab_student_id_type 
    left join
        <[Enroll360].[Student Test Scores SIS].{final}> as stud_test 
            on stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_test.eab_student_id 
            and stud_term.eab_student_id_type = stud_test.eab_student_id_type 

	left join <[Enroll360].[Student ID Xwalk].{final}> stud_x
	on (stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_x.eab_student_id
	and stud_term.eab_student_id_type = stud_x.eab_student_id_type)

	/*need rank*/
	left join <[Enroll360].[Partner Display Controls].{final}> as pdc_need_rank

, pivot_pcm as (

select 
'eab_std_value' as field_name,
case when coalesce(trim(src_attribute_value),'') = '' then null
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclSummer' then 'Summer Term'
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclDeferredToNext' then 'Deferred to Future Term/Gap Year'
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclDeferredFromLast' then 'Deferred from Last Year'
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclWaiver' then 'Waivers/Exchanges'
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclAthlete' then 'Athletes'
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclMUSIC' then 'Music Program'
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclELC' then 'ELC Program'
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclInternational' then 'Internationals'
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclEarlyDecision1' then 'Early Decision 1'
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclEarlyDecision2' then 'Early Decision 2'
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclLateAdmit' then 'Late Action'
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclWaitlist' then 'Waitlist Admits'
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclConditionalAdmit' then 'Conditional Admit'
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclIndependent' then 'Independents'
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclNOACAD' then 'No Academic Info'
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclReadmit' then 'Re-Admits'
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclNoAcadTR' then 'No Academic Info'
when src_attribute_value = 'ColoradoOfColor' then 'Colorado Students of Color'
when src_attribute_value = 'DepositExtensionRequest' then 'Deposit Extension Requested'
when src_attribute_value = 'PellEligible' then 'Pell - Eligible'
when src_attribute_value = 'TR2YRInst' then '2 YR Inst Transfer'
when src_attribute_value = 'TR4YRInst' then '4 YR Inst Transfer'
when src_attribute_value = 'TRInstNotNull' then 'TR CEEB Not Null'
when src_attribute_value = 'PellMin' then 'Pell - Min'
when src_attribute_value = 'PellMax' then 'Pell - Max'
when src_attribute_value = 'ExclTransfer' then 'Transfers'
when src_attribute_value = 'ACRK1NDRK5' then 'ACRK 1 NDRK 5'
when src_attribute_value = 'ImpactAwd' then 'Impact Award'
when src_attribute_value = 'ConsideredForFullNeed' then 'Considered for Full Need'

when src_attribute_value = 'NaturalSciencesandMath' then 'Natural Sciences and Math'
when src_attribute_value = 'SocialSciences' then 'Social Sciences'

when src_attribute_value = 'TestOptional' then 'Test Optional'
when src_attribute_value = 'NotTestOptional' then 'Not Test Optional'  
when src_attribute_value in ('Pathways', 
'Not Pathways Recipient',
'Ritchie Pathways',
'Not Ritchie Pathways',
'Impact Grant Recipient', 
'Not Impact Grant Recipient', 
'Denver Scholarship Recipient',

then src_attribute_value

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
/*query to merge UG and FAO data into single record per ID/ID type. ID match can be 1:1 or via Partner ID Xwalk, merge code is written to accommodate both*/ 
/*all IDs are pulling directly from their .final tables, any adjustment to IDs to support merging should happen in individual feeds*/
/*Partner ID Xwalk (in CRM/UG feed) must be set up for merge to work correctly. This entity can be bound to either UG and/or FAO files but is processed during CRM feed*/
/*join extension variable for this entity can be edited to adjust join between UG and FAO as needed*/
/*****************************/

/*2025-12-08: merge query is tentatively set up and ready for testing. Master Enroll360.Student_Term_PDP_Delivery bundle is compatible with both Master queries currently, 
if we update non-merged Master to pull partnercontact_id and partner_system_name from final - additional non-merge query updates are needed to ensure functionality*/
/*2025-11-14: partnercontact_id and partner_system_name should be set up correctly in individual feeds to join to partner id xwalk*/
/*2025-07-07: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473; corrected where statement - ccreekman*/

WITH 
student_crm_ug AS 
(
	SELECT
  		coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id, stu.partnercontact_id) as join_partnercontact_id,
		coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name, stu.partner_system_name) as join_partner_system_name,
		stu.*

  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student].[Last Validated].{final}> as stu

  LEFT JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> id_xwalk
	on (stu.partnercontact_id = id_xwalk.target_partnercontact_id
	and stu.partner_system_name = id_xwalk.target_partner_system_name)
)

, student_sis_fao as (
  SELECT
  	coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id, stu.partnercontact_id) as join_partnercontact_id,
	coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name, stu.partner_system_name) as join_partner_system_name,
	stu.*

  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stu

  LEFT JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> id_xwalk
	on (stu.partnercontact_id = id_xwalk.target_partnercontact_id
	and stu.partner_system_name = id_xwalk.target_partner_system_name)
)


--select rn, count(*) from(
select * from (
select distinct *
, row_number() over (partition by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.partner_system_name
				   order by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.intake_dt desc nulls last) rn
from (

SELECT 
	crm_ug.primary_student_id as primary_student_id_crm,

    crm_ug.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_crm,

	crm_ug.sis_student_id as sis_student_id_crm,

	<fname> AS fname,
	
	crm_ug.mname as mname_crm,
	sis_fao.mname as mname_sis,
	<mname> AS mname,
	
	crm_ug.lname as lname_crm,
	sis_fao.lname as lname_sis,
	<lname> AS lname,
	
    crm_ug.preferred_fname as preferred_fname_crm,

    crm_ug.first_gen_ind as first_gen_ind_crm,

	<first_gen_ind> AS first_gen_ind,
		
    crm_ug.military_service_status as military_service_status_crm,
	sis_fao.military_service_status as military_service_status_sis,
	<military_service_status> AS military_service_status,
		
    crm_ug.alumni_relation_ind as alumni_relation_ind_crm,
	sis_fao.alumni_relation_ind as alumni_relation_ind_sis,
	<alumni_relation_ind> AS alumni_relation_ind,
		
    crm_ug.hispanic_ind as hispanic_ind_crm,
	sis_fao.hispanic_ind as hispanic_ind_sis,
	<hispanic_ind> AS hispanic_ind,
		
	crm_ug.ethnicity as ethnicity_crm,
	sis_fao.ethnicity as ethnicity_sis,
	<ethnicity> AS ethnicity,
	
	crm_ug.campus_visit_cnt as campus_visit_cnt_crm,

	<mail_optout_ind> AS mail_optout_ind,

--group by rn

	to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt

FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stu_term_sis
	
<join_extension.Student Term PDP Delivery> --join to ID Xwalk and SIS tables located here

) stud_agg
WHERE 1=1
and coalesce(stud_agg.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and	coalesce(stud_agg.partner_system_name,'') <> ''

		stu_term.years_employed AS years_employed_crm,

	stud_term_crm.inquiry_ind_crm,
	stu_term_sis.inquiry_ind AS inquiry_ind_sis,
	<inquiry_ind> AS inquiry_ind,
	
	stud_term_crm.recruitment_status_crm,
	stu_term_sis.recruitment_status AS recruitment_status_sis,
	<recruitment_status> AS recruitment_status,
	
	stud_term_crm.state_resident_crm,
	stu_term_sis.state_resident AS state_resident_sis,
	<state_resident> AS state_resident,
	
	stud_term_crm.first_source_crm,
	stu_term_sis.first_source AS first_source_sis,
	<first_source> AS first_source,
	
	stud_term_crm.first_source_dt_crm AS first_source_dt_crm,
	stu_term_sis.first_source_dt AS first_source_dt_sis,
	<first_source_dt> AS first_source_dt,
	
	stud_term_crm.athletic_recruit_ind_crm,
	stu_term_sis.athletic_recruit_ind AS athletic_recruit_ind_sis,
	<athletic_recruit_ind> AS athletic_recruit_ind,
	
	stud_term_crm.athletic_recruit_sport_crm,
	stu_term_sis.athletic_recruit_sport AS athletic_recruit_sport_sis,
	<athletic_recruit_sport> AS athletic_recruit_sport,
	
	stud_term_crm.years_employed_crm,
	stu_term_sis.years_employed AS years_employed_sis,
	<years_employed> AS years_employed,
	
	stud_term_crm.academic_rating_crm,
	stu_term_sis.academic_rating AS academic_rating_sis,
	<academic_rating> AS academic_rating,
	
	stud_term_crm.interest_rating_crm,
	stu_term_sis.interest_rating AS interest_rating_sis,

	stud_term_crm.student_level_crm,
	stu_term_sis.student_level AS student_level_sis,
	<student_level> AS student_level,
	
	stud_term_crm.curr_entry_year_calendar_crm,
	stu_term_sis.curr_entry_year_calendar AS curr_entry_year_calendar_sis,
	<curr_entry_year_calendar> AS curr_entry_year_calendar,
	
	to_boolean(stud_term_crm.eab_inquiry_ind_crm) AS eab_inquiry_ind_crm,
	to_boolean(stu_term_sis.eab_inquiry_ind) AS eab_inquiry_ind_sis,
	to_boolean(<eab_inquiry_ind>) AS eab_inquiry_ind,
	
	to_boolean(stud_term_crm.eab_athletic_recruit_ind_crm) AS eab_athletic_recruit_ind_crm,
	to_boolean(stu_term_sis.eab_athletic_recruit_ind) AS eab_athletic_recruit_ind_sis,
	to_boolean(<eab_athletic_recruit_ind>) AS eab_athletic_recruit_ind,
	
	stud_term_crm.eab_current_funnel_status_crm,
	stu_term_sis.eab_current_funnel_status AS eab_current_funnel_status_sis,
	<eab_current_funnel_status> AS eab_current_funnel_status,
	
	stud_term_crm.eab_first_source_crm,
	stu_term_sis.eab_first_source AS eab_first_source_sis,
	<eab_first_source> AS eab_first_source,
	
	stud_term_crm.eab_student_type_crm,
	stu_term_sis.eab_student_type AS eab_student_type_sis,
	<eab_student_type> AS eab_student_type,
	
	stud_term_crm.intake_dt_crm AS intake_dt_crm ,
	stu_term_sis.intake_dt AS intake_dt_sis,
	<intake_dt> AS intake_dt
	
FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stu_term_sis
FULL OUTER JOIN student_term_crm AS stud_term_crm
			ON stud_term_crm.eab_student_id_crm = stu_term_sis.eab_student_id
			AND stud_term_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm = stu_term_sis.eab_student_id_type
			AND COALESCE(stud_term_crm.eab_entry_year_academic_crm, 0) = COALESCE(stu_term_sis.eab_entry_year_academic, 0)
			AND stud_term_crm.eab_entry_term_crm = stu_term_sis.eab_entry_term
WHERE (stu_term_sis.eab_student_id IS NOT NULL AND stu_term_sis.eab_student_id_type IS NOT NULL) OR (stud_term_crm.eab_student_id_crm IS NOT NULL AND stud_term_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm IS NOT NULL)
AND stu_term_sis.eab_entry_year_academic >= 2026

Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

/*2026-07-01: updated to align with Atlas pilot query best practices. This query DOES NOT merge UG and FAO data.  - ccreekman*/
/*2026-07-01: added where statement variable for filtering prior to ranking and deduping - ccreekman*/
/*2026-03-03: <partnercontact_id>,<partner_system_name> master bundle updated to choose ID in this order: crm ID from merged record > join ID from SIS record, SIS ID 
join fields are in merge query, null placecholder fields added to this query - ccreekman*/
/*2026-02-09: updated to look for eab_student_id fields, partnercontact_id, partner_system_name from final tables, added to_number to eab_entry_year_academic
prev. the top level cast to number was removed as the source fields were numeric, added this back after engineering update. 
Result fields will not have decimals as default type from to_number is NUMBER(38,0) - ccreekman*/
/*2026-01-20: engineering updated bundle for <eab_entry_year_academic> to cast fields to varchar before the coalesce. 
coalescing the null from the empty SIS field with the numeric value from CRM was creating a numeric value of type NUMBER(18,5) (eg 2025.00000)*/
/*2025-07-07: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473; corrected where statement - ccreekman*/


WITH 
student_term_sis_fao as (
SELECT * from (
  SELECT distinct
  	null as join_partnercontact_id, /*used for merging records only; do not delete*/
	null as join_partner_system_name, /*used for merging records only; do not delete*/
	stu_term.*,
  row_number() over(partition by stu_term.partnercontact_id, stu_term.partner_system_name, stu_term.eab_student_type, stu_term.eab_entry_term, stu_term.eab_entry_year_academic 
		order by stu_term.intake_dt desc nulls last) as term_rn

  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stu_term

)agg
where 1=1
and term_rn = 1 
)

    agg2.eab_current_funnel_status,
    agg2.intake_dt_crm,
    agg2.intake_dt_sis,
    agg2.intake_dt
from (
  select *
  , row_number() over (partition by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.partner_system_name,
					 agg.eab_student_type, agg.eab_entry_term, agg.eab_entry_year_academic 
					 order by to_date(agg.intake_dt) desc nulls last,
					   CASE 
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Prospect' THEN 1
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Inquiry' THEN 2
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Started Applicant' THEN 3
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Incomplete Applicant' THEN 4
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Completed Applicant' THEN 5
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Previous Defer' THEN 6
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Uncommitted Admit' THEN 8
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Readmit' THEN 9
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Withdraw' THEN 10
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Net Deposit' THEN 11
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Melt' THEN 12
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Future Defer' THEN 14
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Deny' THEN 15

		<partnercontact_id> AS partnercontact_id, /*default: crm > join > sis*/

		crm_ug.curr_entry_term AS curr_entry_term_crm,

		sis_fao.eab_entry_term AS eab_entry_term_sis,

		crm_ug.state_resident AS state_resident_crm,

		to_boolean(<eab_athletic_recruit_ind>) AS eab_athletic_recruit_ind,

		crm_ug.years_employed AS years_employed_crm,
		sis_fao.years_employed AS years_employed_sis,
		<years_employed> AS years_employed,

		crm_ug.academic_rating AS academic_rating_crm,
		sis_fao.academic_rating AS academic_rating_sis,
		<academic_rating> AS academic_rating,

		crm_ug.interest_rating AS interest_rating_crm,
		sis_fao.interest_rating AS interest_rating_sis,
		<interest_rating> AS interest_rating,

		crm_ug.student_level AS student_level_crm,
		sis_fao.student_level AS student_level_sis,
		<student_level> AS student_level,

		crm_ug.curr_entry_year_calendar AS curr_entry_year_calendar_crm,
		sis_fao.curr_entry_year_calendar AS curr_entry_year_calendar_sis,
		<curr_entry_year_calendar> AS curr_entry_year_calendar,

		crm_ug.eab_current_funnel_status AS eab_current_funnel_status_crm,
		sis_fao.eab_current_funnel_status AS eab_current_funnel_status_sis,
		<eab_current_funnel_status> AS eab_current_funnel_status,

		sis_fao.alternative_academic_rank,
		to_number(sis_fao.eab_alternative_academic_rank) AS eab_alternative_academic_rank,

		crm_ug.intake_dt AS intake_dt_crm,
		sis_fao.intake_dt AS intake_dt_sis,
		<intake_dt> AS intake_dt

	FROM student_term_sis_fao as sis_fao

	<join_extension.Student Term PDP Delivery>

	WHERE <where_statement.Student Term PDP Delivery>
	and (coalesce(crm_ug.partnercontact_id,'') <> '' and coalesce(crm_ug.partner_system_name,'') <> '')
	or (coalesce(sis_fao.partnercontact_id,'') <> '' and coalesce(sis_fao.partner_system_name,'') <> '')

  ) agg

) agg2
where agg2.pdp_delivery_rn = 1


/*************************************/

			ON stud_term_crm.eab_student_id_crm = stu_term_sis.eab_student_id
			AND stud_term_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm = stu_term_sis.eab_student_id_type
			AND COALESCE(stud_term_crm.eab_entry_year_academic_crm, 0) = COALESCE(stu_term_sis.eab_entry_year_academic, 0)
			AND stud_term_crm.eab_entry_term_crm = stu_term_sis.eab_entry_term
WHERE (stu_term_sis.eab_student_id IS NOT NULL AND stu_term_sis.eab_student_id_type) OR (stud_term_crm.eab_student_id_crm IS NOT NULL AND stud_term_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm IS NOT NULL)

		stu_term.student_level AS student_level_crm,
		stu_term.curr_entry_year_calendar AS curr_entry_year_calendar_crm,

--select *

left join (
select partnercontact_id_01, partner_system_name_01, partnercontact_id_02, partner_system_name_02 
from (

	from <[Enroll360].[Partner ID Xwalk].{final}> AS xw
	union all 
	select xw.target_partnercontact_id as partnercontact_id_01,
 	xw.target_partner_system_name as partner_system_name_01,
 	xw.source_partnercontact_id as partnercontact_id_02,
 	xw.source_partner_system_name as partner_system_name_02,
 	xw.intake_dt
	from <[Enroll360].[Partner ID Xwalk].{final}> AS xw
	union all
	select xw.source_partnercontact_id as partnercontact_id_01,
 	xw.source_partner_system_name as partner_system_name_01,

 	xw.intake_dt
	from <[Enroll360].[Partner ID Xwalk].{final}> AS xw
	union all 
	select xw.target_partnercontact_id as partnercontact_id_01,
 	xw.target_partner_system_name as partner_system_name_01,
 	xw.target_partnercontact_id as partnercontact_id_02,
 	xw.target_partner_system_name as partner_system_name_02,
 	xw.intake_dt

  ) xw
where rn = 1
)xw

on 
--(stud.primary_student_id = xw.partnercontact_id_01 and xw.partner_system_name_01 = 'sis_banner_1')
(stu_term.partnercontact_id = xw.partnercontact_id_01 and coalesce(stu_term.partner_system_name,'') =  coalesce(xw.partner_system_name_01,''))
/***************************************************************************/
)

SELECT * FROM (

SELECT 
	stud_term_crm.eab_student_id_crm,

	stud_term_crm.inquiry_ind_crm,
	stu_term_sis.inquiry_ind AS inquiry_ind_sis,
	<inquiry_ind> AS inquiry_ind,
	
	stud_term_crm.recruitment_status_crm,
	stu_term_sis.recruitment_status AS recruitment_status_sis,
	<recruitment_status> AS recruitment_status,
	
	stud_term_crm.state_resident_crm,
	stu_term_sis.state_resident AS state_resident_sis,
	<state_resident> AS state_resident,
	
	stud_term_crm.first_source_crm,
	stu_term_sis.first_source AS first_source_sis,
	<first_source> AS first_source,
	
	to_date(stud_term_crm.first_source_dt_crm) AS first_source_dt_crm,
	to_date(stu_term_sis.first_source_dt) AS first_source_dt_sis,
	to_date(<first_source_dt>) AS first_source_dt,
	
	stud_term_crm.athletic_recruit_ind_crm,
	stu_term_sis.athletic_recruit_ind AS athletic_recruit_ind_sis,
	<athletic_recruit_ind> AS athletic_recruit_ind,
	
	stud_term_crm.athletic_recruit_sport_crm,
	stu_term_sis.athletic_recruit_sport AS athletic_recruit_sport_sis,
	<athletic_recruit_sport> AS athletic_recruit_sport,
	
	stud_term_crm.years_employed_crm,
	stu_term_sis.years_employed AS years_employed_sis,
	<years_employed> AS years_employed,
	
	stud_term_crm.academic_rating_crm,
	stu_term_sis.academic_rating AS academic_rating_sis,
	<academic_rating> AS academic_rating,
	
	stud_term_crm.interest_rating_crm,
	stu_term_sis.interest_rating AS interest_rating_sis,
	<interest_rating> AS interest_rating,
	
	stud_term_crm.student_level_crm,
	stu_term_sis.student_level AS student_level_sis,
	<student_level> AS student_level,
	
	stud_term_crm.curr_entry_year_calendar_crm,
	stu_term_sis.curr_entry_year_calendar AS curr_entry_year_calendar_sis,
	<curr_entry_year_calendar> AS curr_entry_year_calendar,
	
	to_boolean(stud_term_crm.eab_inquiry_ind_crm) AS eab_inquiry_ind_crm,
	to_boolean(stu_term_sis.eab_inquiry_ind) AS eab_inquiry_ind_sis,
	to_boolean(<eab_inquiry_ind>) AS eab_inquiry_ind,
	
	to_boolean(stud_term_crm.eab_athletic_recruit_ind_crm) AS eab_athletic_recruit_ind_crm,
	to_boolean(stu_term_sis.eab_athletic_recruit_ind) AS eab_athletic_recruit_ind_sis,
	to_boolean(<eab_athletic_recruit_ind>) AS eab_athletic_recruit_ind,
	
	stud_term_crm.eab_current_funnel_status_crm,
	stu_term_sis.eab_current_funnel_status AS eab_current_funnel_status_sis,
	<eab_current_funnel_status> AS eab_current_funnel_status,
	
	stud_term_crm.eab_first_source_crm,
	stu_term_sis.eab_first_source AS eab_first_source_sis,
	<eab_first_source> AS eab_first_source,
	
	stud_term_crm.eab_student_type_crm,
	stu_term_sis.eab_student_type AS eab_student_type_sis,
	<eab_student_type> AS eab_student_type,
	
	to_timestamp(stud_term_crm.intake_dt_crm) AS intake_dt_crm ,
	to_timestamp(stu_term_sis.intake_dt) AS intake_dt_sis,
	to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt
	
FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stu_term_sis 
 
FULL OUTER JOIN student_term_crm AS stud_term_crm
			ON stu_term_sis.partnercontact_id = stud_term_crm.partnercontact_id_02
			AND stu_term_sis.partner_system_name = stud_term_crm.partner_system_name_02
			AND COALESCE(stu_term_sis.eab_entry_year_academic, 0) = COALESCE(stud_term_crm.eab_entry_year_academic_CRM, 0)
 			AND COALESCE(stu_term_sis.eab_student_type, '') = COALESCE(stud_term_crm.eab_student_type_crm, '')
			AND COALESCE(stu_term_sis.eab_entry_term,'') = COALESCE(stud_term_crm.eab_entry_term_crm,'')
WHERE (stu_term_sis.eab_student_id IS NOT NULL AND stu_term_sis.eab_student_id_type IS NOT NULL) OR (stud_term_crm.eab_student_id_crm IS NOT NULL AND stud_term_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm IS NOT NULL)
) final
where 1=1
  and (EAB_STUDENT_ID_SIS IS NOT NULL AND eab_student_id_crm IS NOT NULL)
  AND EAB_CURRENT_FUNNEL_STATUS_SIS <> EAB_CURRENT_FUNNEL_STATUS_CRM

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-07-01: added where statement variable for filtering prior to ranking and deduping - ccreekman*/
/*2026-03-03: <partnercontact_id>,<partner_system_name> master bundle updated to choose ID in this order: crm ID from merged record > join ID from SIS record, SIS ID - ccreekman*/
/*2026-01-13: merge query notes - ccreekman
student_term_sis_fao cte: takes all SIS data, appends any partner_system_name(s) that are present in CRM_UG Student Term.final
	Expectation is for one partner_system_name in CRM_UG ST.final, but set up to account for crm changes, other scenarios where there may be a mix of ID types
	Uses this to pull in only IDs from Xwalk that align with CRM_UG ST.final partner_system_name(s), excluding any irrelevant matching ID pairs
	if there are multiple CRM_UG ST.final partner_system_name(s), multiple rows per SIS record will be created
	deduping logic will exclude records with null join_partnercontact_id only if there is not a record with a populated join_partnercontact_id
	multiple records per student may still persist if they have unique populated join_partnercontact_id/join_partner_system_name values
	in that scenario resulting counts on this table may be inflated, need further examples to determine if we need to build in variables to allow customization here
main query: takes results from student_term_sis_fao cte and does a full outer join to CRM_UG ST.final using the join ID / ID type (if populated)
	crm join currently in variables - unclear if we need that level of customization available
*/

WITH 
student_term_sis_fao as (
SELECT * from (
  SELECT distinct
  	id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id as join_partnercontact_id,
	id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name as join_partner_system_name,
	stu_term.*,
  row_number() over(partition by stu_term.partnercontact_id, stu_term.partner_system_name, stu_term.eab_student_type, stu_term.eab_entry_term, stu_term.eab_entry_year_academic 
		order by id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id) as rn

  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stu_term

  /*cross join below will associate available crm_ug partner_system_name(s) with SIS record*/ 
  CROSS JOIN (
  		select distinct partner_system_name as crm_ug_partner_system_name
		FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term].[Last Validated].{final}> stu_term_crm) crm_psn

  LEFT JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> id_xwalk
	on (stu_term.partnercontact_id = id_xwalk.target_partnercontact_id
	and coalesce(stu_term.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(id_xwalk.target_partner_system_name,'')
	and coalesce(crm_psn.CRM_UG_PARTNER_SYSTEM_NAME,'') = coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name,''))
)agg
where 1=1
/*xwalk may have multiple id pairs which meet join criteria
	this criteria limits the result set to only allow necessary dupes
	[rn = 1]: to ensure at least one copy of the SIS record is retained regardless if there is a match in ID Xwalk
	[agg.join_partnercontact_id is not null]: any dupes with distinct partnercontact_id/partner_system_name*/

and (agg.join_partnercontact_id is not null or rn = 1) 
--and agg.join_partnercontact_id is null /*for troubleshooting - SIS records with no xwalk match*/
)


select
    agg2.primary_student_id,
    agg2.eab_student_id_sis,
    agg2.eab_student_id_type_sis,
    agg2.eab_student_id_crm,
    agg2.eab_student_id_type_crm,
    agg2.eab_student_id,
    agg2.eab_student_id_type,
    agg2.partnercontact_id_sis,
    agg2.partner_system_name_sis,
    agg2.partnercontact_id_crm,
    agg2.partner_system_name_crm,
    agg2.partnercontact_id,
    agg2.partner_system_name,
    agg2.student_type_crm,
    agg2.student_type_sis,
    agg2.student_type,
    agg2.curr_entry_term_crm,
    agg2.curr_entry_term_sis,
    agg2.curr_entry_term,
    agg2.curr_entry_year_academic_crm,
    agg2.curr_entry_year_academic_sis,
    agg2.curr_entry_year_academic,
    agg2.eab_student_type_crm,
    agg2.eab_student_type_sis,
    agg2.eab_student_type,
    agg2.eab_entry_year_academic_crm,
    agg2.eab_entry_year_academic_sis,
    agg2.eab_entry_year_academic,
    agg2.eab_entry_term_crm,
    agg2.eab_entry_term_sis,
    agg2.eab_entry_term,
    agg2.inquiry_ind_crm,
    agg2.inquiry_ind_sis,
    agg2.inquiry_ind,
    agg2.eab_inquiry_ind_crm,
    agg2.eab_inquiry_ind_sis,
    agg2.eab_inquiry_ind,
    agg2.recruitment_status_crm,
    agg2.recruitment_status_sis,
    agg2.recruitment_status,
    agg2.state_resident_crm,
    agg2.state_resident_sis,
    agg2.state_resident,
    agg2.first_source_crm,
    agg2.first_source_sis,
    agg2.first_source,
    agg2.first_source_dt_crm,
    agg2.first_source_dt_sis,
    agg2.first_source_dt,
    agg2.eab_first_source_crm,
    agg2.eab_first_source_sis,
    agg2.eab_first_source,
    agg2.athletic_recruit_ind_crm,
    agg2.athletic_recruit_ind_sis,
    agg2.athletic_recruit_ind,
    agg2.athletic_recruit_sport_crm,
    agg2.athletic_recruit_sport_sis,
    agg2.athletic_recruit_sport,
    agg2.eab_athletic_recruit_ind_crm,
    agg2.eab_athletic_recruit_ind_sis,
    agg2.eab_athletic_recruit_ind,
    agg2.years_employed_crm,
    agg2.years_employed_sis,
    agg2.years_employed,
    agg2.academic_rating_crm,
    agg2.academic_rating_sis,
    agg2.academic_rating,
    agg2.interest_rating_crm,
    agg2.interest_rating_sis,
    agg2.interest_rating,
    agg2.student_level_crm,
    agg2.student_level_sis,
    agg2.student_level,
    agg2.curr_entry_year_calendar_crm,
    agg2.curr_entry_year_calendar_sis,
    agg2.curr_entry_year_calendar,
    agg2.alternative_academic_rank,
    agg2.eab_alternative_academic_rank,
    agg2.eab_current_funnel_status_crm,
    agg2.eab_current_funnel_status_sis,
    agg2.eab_current_funnel_status,
    agg2.intake_dt_crm,
    agg2.intake_dt_sis,
    agg2.intake_dt
from (
  select distinct *
  , row_number() over (partition by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.partner_system_name,
					 agg.eab_student_type, agg.eab_entry_term, agg.eab_entry_year_academic 
					 order by agg.partnercontact_id, to_date(agg.intake_dt) desc nulls last,
					   CASE 
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Prospect' THEN 1
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Inquiry' THEN 2
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Started Applicant' THEN 3
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Incomplete Applicant' THEN 4
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Completed Applicant' THEN 5
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Previous Defer' THEN 6
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Uncommitted Admit' THEN 8
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Readmit' THEN 9
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Withdraw' THEN 10
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Net Deposit' THEN 11
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Melt' THEN 12
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Future Defer' THEN 14
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Deny' THEN 15
						 WHEN eab_current_funnel_status = 'Enrolled' THEN 16
						  ELSE 0 END DESC) pdp_delivery_rn
  from (

	SELECT 
		crm_ug.primary_student_id,

		sis_fao.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_sis,
		sis_fao.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
		crm_ug.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_crm,
		crm_ug.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_crm,
		<eab_student_id> AS eab_student_id, /*default: sis > crm*/
		<eab_student_id_type> AS eab_student_id_type, /*default: sis > crm*/

		sis_fao.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_sis,
		sis_fao.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_sis,
		crm_ug.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_crm,
		crm_ug.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_crm,
		<partnercontact_id> AS partnercontact_id, /*default: crm > join > sis*/
		<partner_system_name> AS partner_system_name, /*default: crm > join > sis*/

		crm_ug.student_type AS student_type_crm,
		sis_fao.student_type AS student_type_sis,
		<student_type> AS student_type,

		crm_ug.curr_entry_term AS curr_entry_term_crm,
		sis_fao.curr_entry_term AS curr_entry_term_sis,
		<curr_entry_term> AS curr_entry_term,

		crm_ug.curr_entry_year_academic AS curr_entry_year_academic_crm,
		sis_fao.curr_entry_year_academic AS curr_entry_year_academic_sis,
		<curr_entry_year_academic> AS curr_entry_year_academic, 

		crm_ug.eab_student_type AS eab_student_type_crm,
		sis_fao.eab_student_type AS eab_student_type_sis,
		<eab_student_type> AS eab_student_type, /*matching on this so is this necessary as variable or is plain coalesce enough?*/

		try_to_number(crm_ug.eab_entry_year_academic) AS eab_entry_year_academic_crm,
		try_to_number(sis_fao.eab_entry_year_academic) AS eab_entry_year_academic_sis,
		<eab_entry_year_academic> AS eab_entry_year_academic, /*matching on this so is this necessary as variable or is plain coalesce enough?*/

		crm_ug.eab_entry_term AS eab_entry_term_crm,
		sis_fao.eab_entry_term AS eab_entry_term_sis,
		<eab_entry_term> AS eab_entry_term, /*matching on this so is this necessary as variable or is plain coalesce enough?*/

		crm_ug.inquiry_ind AS inquiry_ind_crm,
		sis_fao.inquiry_ind AS inquiry_ind_sis,
		<inquiry_ind> AS inquiry_ind,

		to_boolean(crm_ug.eab_inquiry_ind) AS eab_inquiry_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(sis_fao.eab_inquiry_ind) AS eab_inquiry_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_inquiry_ind>) AS eab_inquiry_ind,

		crm_ug.recruitment_status AS recruitment_status_crm,
		sis_fao.recruitment_status AS recruitment_status_sis,
		<recruitment_status> AS recruitment_status,

		crm_ug.state_resident AS state_resident_crm,
		sis_fao.state_resident AS state_resident_sis,
		<state_resident> AS state_resident,

		crm_ug.first_source AS first_source_crm,
		sis_fao.first_source AS first_source_sis,
		<first_source> AS first_source,

		crm_ug.first_source_dt AS first_source_dt_crm,
		sis_fao.first_source_dt AS first_source_dt_sis,
		<first_source_dt> AS first_source_dt,

		crm_ug.eab_first_source AS eab_first_source_crm,
		sis_fao.eab_first_source AS eab_first_source_sis,
		<eab_first_source> AS eab_first_source,

		crm_ug.athletic_recruit_ind AS athletic_recruit_ind_crm,
		sis_fao.athletic_recruit_ind AS athletic_recruit_ind_sis,
		<athletic_recruit_ind> AS athletic_recruit_ind,

		crm_ug.athletic_recruit_sport AS athletic_recruit_sport_crm,
		sis_fao.athletic_recruit_sport AS athletic_recruit_sport_sis,
		<athletic_recruit_sport> AS athletic_recruit_sport,

		to_boolean(crm_ug.eab_athletic_recruit_ind) AS eab_athletic_recruit_ind_crm,
		to_boolean(sis_fao.eab_athletic_recruit_ind) AS eab_athletic_recruit_ind_sis,
		to_boolean(<eab_athletic_recruit_ind>) AS eab_athletic_recruit_ind,

		crm_ug.years_employed AS years_employed_crm,

/*2025-07-07: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473; corrected where statement - ccreekman*/

WITH 
student_term_crm_ug AS 
(
	SELECT
  		coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id, stu_term.partnercontact_id) as join_partnercontact_id,
		coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name, stu_term.partner_system_name) as join_partner_system_name,
		stu_term.*

  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term].[Last Validated].{final}> as stu_term

  LEFT JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> id_xwalk
	on (stu_term.partnercontact_id = id_xwalk.target_partnercontact_id
	and stu_term.partner_system_name = id_xwalk.target_partner_system_name)
)

, student_term_sis_fao as (
  SELECT
  	coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id, stu_term.partnercontact_id) as join_partnercontact_id,
	coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name, stu_term.partner_system_name) as join_partner_system_name,
	stu_term.*

  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stu_term

  LEFT JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> id_xwalk
	on (stu_term.partnercontact_id = id_xwalk.target_partnercontact_id
	and stu_term.partner_system_name = id_xwalk.target_partner_system_name)
)

SELECT 
	crm_ug.primary_student_id,

	crm_ug.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_crm,
    sis_fao.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_sis,
    <eab_student_id> AS eab_student_id,
	
    crm_ug.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_crm,
	sis_fao.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
    <eab_student_id_type> AS eab_student_id_type,
	
    crm_ug.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_crm,
	sis_fao.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_sis,
	<partnercontact_id> AS partnercontact_id,

    crm_ug.partner_system_name as partner_system_name_crm,
	sis_fao.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_sis,
	<partner_system_name> AS partner_system_name,
	
	sis_fao.alternative_academic_rank,
	to_number(sis_fao.eab_alternative_academic_rank) AS eab_alternative_academic_rank,

	crm_ug.eab_entry_year_academic AS eab_entry_year_academic_crm,
	sis_fao.eab_entry_year_academic AS eab_entry_year_academic_sis,
	<eab_entry_year_academic> AS eab_entry_year_academic, /*matching on this so is this necessary as variable or is plain coalesce enough?*/
	
	crm_ug.eab_entry_term AS eab_entry_term_crm,
	sis_fao.eab_entry_term AS eab_entry_term_sis,
	<eab_entry_term> AS eab_entry_term, /*matching on this so is this necessary as variable or is plain coalesce enough?*/

	sis_fao.curr_entry_year_academic AS curr_entry_year_academic_sis,

	crm_ug.student_type AS student_type_crm,

	crm_ug.inquiry_ind AS inquiry_ind_crm,

	to_boolean(crm_ug.eab_inquiry_ind) AS eab_inquiry_ind_crm,
	to_boolean(sis_fao.eab_inquiry_ind) AS eab_inquiry_ind_sis,
	to_boolean(<eab_inquiry_ind>) AS eab_inquiry_ind,
	
	crm_ug.recruitment_status AS recruitment_status_crm,
	sis_fao.recruitment_status AS recruitment_status_sis,
	<recruitment_status> AS recruitment_status,
	
	crm_ug.state_resident AS state_resident_crm,
	sis_fao.state_resident AS state_resident_sis,

	sis_fao.athletic_recruit_sport AS athletic_recruit_sport_sis,
	<athletic_recruit_sport> AS athletic_recruit_sport,
	
	to_boolean(crm_ug.eab_athletic_recruit_ind) AS eab_athletic_recruit_ind_crm,
	to_boolean(sis_fao.eab_athletic_recruit_ind) AS eab_athletic_recruit_ind_sis,
	to_boolean(<eab_athletic_recruit_ind>) AS eab_athletic_recruit_ind,

	crm_ug.years_employed AS years_employed_crm,
	sis_fao.years_employed AS years_employed_sis,
	<years_employed> AS years_employed,

	sis_fao.academic_rating AS academic_rating_sis,

	crm_ug.interest_rating AS interest_rating_crm,
	sis_fao.interest_rating AS interest_rating_sis,

	crm_ug.student_level AS student_level_crm,
	sis_fao.student_level AS student_level_sis,
	<student_level> AS student_level,
	
	crm_ug.curr_entry_year_calendar AS curr_entry_year_calendar_crm,
	sis_fao.curr_entry_year_calendar AS curr_entry_year_calendar_sis,
	<curr_entry_year_calendar> AS curr_entry_year_calendar,
		
	crm_ug.eab_current_funnel_status AS eab_current_funnel_status_crm,
	sis_fao.eab_current_funnel_status AS eab_current_funnel_status_sis,
	<eab_current_funnel_status> AS eab_current_funnel_status,
	
	to_timestamp(crm_ug.intake_dt) AS intake_dt_crm,
	to_timestamp(sis_fao.intake_dt) AS intake_dt_sis,
	to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt
	
FROM student_term_sis_fao as sis_fao

FULL OUTER JOIN student_term_crm_ug AS crm_ug
			ON COALESCE(sis_fao.eab_entry_year_academic, 0) = COALESCE(crm_ug.eab_entry_year_academic, 0)
			AND COALESCE(sis_fao.eab_student_type, '') = COALESCE(crm_ug.eab_student_type, '')
			AND COALESCE(sis_fao.eab_entry_term, '') = COALESCE(crm_ug.eab_entry_term, '')
AND (
/*first join option - if sis_fao and crm_ug use same ID system*/
  (sis_fao.join_partnercontact_id = crm_ug.join_partnercontact_id AND sis_fao.join_partner_system_name = crm_ug.join_partner_system_name)
/*second join option - if sis_fao and crm_ug use different ID system*/
	OR (
	  EXISTS (
  		SELECT 1 FROM <[Enroll360].[Partner ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> id_xwalk
    	WHERE (crm_ug.join_partnercontact_id = id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id 
		   	AND crm_ug.join_partner_system_name = id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name 
		   	AND sis_fao.join_partnercontact_id = id_xwalk.target_partnercontact_id 
		   	AND sis_fao.join_partner_system_name = id_xwalk.target_partner_system_name)
      	OR (crm_ug.join_partnercontact_id = id_xwalk.target_partnercontact_id 
			AND crm_ug.join_partner_system_name = id_xwalk.target_partner_system_name
        	AND sis_fao.join_partnercontact_id = id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id 
		  	AND sis_fao.join_partner_system_name = id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name)
	  		)
		)
	)

WHERE 
(coalesce(crm_ug.partnercontact_id,'') || coalesce(crm_ug.partner_system_name,'') <> '')
or (coalesce(sis_fao.partnercontact_id,'') || coalesce(sis_fao.partner_system_name,'') <> '')

queryResults.querySql:
WITH student_term_crm AS 
(
	SELECT
		COALESCE(ps_xwalk.eab_student_id, stu_term.primary_student_id) AS eab_student_id_crm,
		COALESCE(ps_xwalk.eab_student_id_type, 'primary') AS eab_student_id_type_crm,
		eab_entry_year_academic	AS eab_entry_year_academic_crm,
		eab_entry_term AS eab_entry_term_crm,
		curr_entry_term	AS curr_entry_term_crm,
		curr_entry_year_academic AS	curr_entry_year_academic_crm,
		student_type AS student_type_crm,
		inquiry_ind	AS inquiry_ind_crm,
		recruitment_status AS recruitment_status_crm,
		state_resident AS state_resident_crm,
		first_source AS	first_source_crm,
		first_source_dt AS first_source_dt_crm,
		athletic_recruit_ind AS athletic_recruit_ind_crm,
		athletic_recruit_sport AS athletic_recruit_sport_crm,
		years_employed AS years_employed_crm,
		academic_rating AS academic_rating_crm,
		interest_rating AS interest_rating_crm,
		student_level AS student_level_crm,
		curr_entry_year_calendar AS curr_entry_year_calendar_crm,
		eab_inquiry_ind AS eab_inquiry_ind_crm,
		eab_athletic_recruit_ind AS eab_athletic_recruit_ind_crm,
		eab_current_funnel_status AS eab_current_funnel_status_crm,
		eab_first_source AS eab_first_source_crm,
		eab_student_type AS eab_student_type_crm,
		stu_term.intake_dt AS intake_dt_crm,
		stu_term.primary_student_id
	FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term].[Last Validated].{final}> as stu_term
  left join <[Enroll360].[Student ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> AS ps_xwalk
		on ps_xwalk.primary_student_id = stu_term.primary_student_id
)

select * from (
  SELECT 
	stu_term_sis.eab_student_id,
	stu_term_sis.eab_student_id_type,
	stud_term_crm.primary_student_id,
	stu_term_sis.alternative_academic_rank,
	to_number(stu_term_sis.eab_alternative_academic_rank) AS eab_alternative_academic_rank,

	stud_term_crm.eab_entry_year_academic_crm AS eab_entry_year_academic_crm,
	stu_term_sis.eab_entry_year_academic AS eab_entry_year_academic_sis,
	--<eab_entry_year_academic> AS eab_entry_year_academic,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.eab_entry_year_academic,stud_term_crm.eab_entry_year_academic_crm) as eab_entry_year_academic,
	
	stud_term_crm.eab_entry_term_crm,
	stu_term_sis.eab_entry_term AS eab_entry_term_sis,
	--<eab_entry_term> AS eab_entry_term,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.eab_entry_term,stud_term_crm.eab_entry_term_crm) as eab_entry_term,
	
	stud_term_crm.curr_entry_term_crm,
	stu_term_sis.curr_entry_term AS curr_entry_term_sis,
	--<curr_entry_term> AS curr_entry_term,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.curr_entry_term,stud_term_crm.curr_entry_term_crm) as curr_entry_term,
	
	stud_term_crm.curr_entry_year_academic_crm,
	stu_term_sis.curr_entry_year_academic AS curr_entry_year_academic_sis,
	--<curr_entry_year_academic> AS curr_entry_year_academic,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.curr_entry_year_academic,stud_term_crm.curr_entry_year_academic_crm) as curr_entry_year_academic,
	
	stud_term_crm.student_type_crm,
	stu_term_sis.student_type AS student_type_sis,
	--<student_type> AS student_type,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.student_type,stud_term_crm.student_type_crm) as student_type,
	
	stud_term_crm.inquiry_ind_crm,
	stu_term_sis.inquiry_ind AS inquiry_ind_sis,
	--<inquiry_ind> AS inquiry_ind,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.inquiry_ind,stud_term_crm.inquiry_ind_crm) as inquiry_ind,
	
	stud_term_crm.recruitment_status_crm,
	stu_term_sis.recruitment_status AS recruitment_status_sis,
	--<recruitment_status> AS recruitment_status,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.recruitment_status,stud_term_crm.recruitment_status_crm) as recruitment_status,
	
	stud_term_crm.state_resident_crm,
	stu_term_sis.state_resident AS state_resident_sis,
	--<state_resident> AS state_resident,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.state_resident,stud_term_crm.state_resident_crm) as state_resident,
	
	stud_term_crm.first_source_crm,
	stu_term_sis.first_source AS first_source_sis,
	--<first_source> AS first_source,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.first_source,stud_term_crm.first_source_crm) as first_source,
	
	to_date(stud_term_crm.first_source_dt_crm) AS first_source_dt_crm,
	to_date(stu_term_sis.first_source_dt) AS first_source_dt_sis,
	--to_date(<first_source_dt>) AS first_source_dt,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.first_source_dt,stud_term_crm.first_source_dt_crm) as first_source_dt,
	
	stud_term_crm.athletic_recruit_ind_crm,
	stu_term_sis.athletic_recruit_ind AS athletic_recruit_ind_sis,
	--<athletic_recruit_ind> AS athletic_recruit_ind,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.athletic_recruit_ind,stud_term_crm.athletic_recruit_ind_crm) as athletic_recruit_ind,
	
	stud_term_crm.athletic_recruit_sport_crm,
	stu_term_sis.athletic_recruit_sport AS athletic_recruit_sport_sis,
	--<athletic_recruit_sport> AS athletic_recruit_sport,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.athletic_recruit_sport,stud_term_crm.athletic_recruit_sport_crm) as athletic_recruit_sport,
	
	stud_term_crm.years_employed_crm,
	stu_term_sis.years_employed AS years_employed_sis,
	--<years_employed> AS years_employed,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.years_employed,stud_term_crm.years_employed_crm) as years_employed,
	
	stud_term_crm.academic_rating_crm,
	stu_term_sis.academic_rating AS academic_rating_sis,
	--<academic_rating> AS academic_rating,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.academic_rating,stud_term_crm.academic_rating_crm) as academic_rating,
	
	stud_term_crm.interest_rating_crm,
	stu_term_sis.interest_rating AS interest_rating_sis,
	--<interest_rating> AS interest_rating,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.interest_rating,stud_term_crm.interest_rating_crm) as interest_rating,
	
	stud_term_crm.student_level_crm,
	stu_term_sis.student_level AS student_level_sis,
	--<student_level> AS student_level,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.student_level,stud_term_crm.student_level_crm) as student_level,
	
	stud_term_crm.curr_entry_year_calendar_crm,
	stu_term_sis.curr_entry_year_calendar AS curr_entry_year_calendar_sis,
	--<curr_entry_year_calendar> AS curr_entry_year_calendar,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.curr_entry_year_calendar,stud_term_crm.curr_entry_year_calendar_crm) as curr_entry_year_calendar,
	
	to_boolean(stud_term_crm.eab_inquiry_ind_crm) AS eab_inquiry_ind_crm,
	to_boolean(stu_term_sis.eab_inquiry_ind) AS eab_inquiry_ind_sis,
	--to_boolean(<eab_inquiry_ind>) AS eab_inquiry_ind,
	to_boolean(coalesce(stu_term_sis.eab_inquiry_ind,stud_term_crm.eab_inquiry_ind_crm)) as eab_inquiry_ind,
	
	to_boolean(stud_term_crm.eab_athletic_recruit_ind_crm) AS eab_athletic_recruit_ind_crm,
	to_boolean(stu_term_sis.eab_athletic_recruit_ind) AS eab_athletic_recruit_ind_sis,
	--to_boolean(<eab_athletic_recruit_ind>) AS eab_athletic_recruit_ind,
	to_boolean(coalesce(stu_term_sis.eab_athletic_recruit_ind,stud_term_crm.eab_athletic_recruit_ind_crm)) as eab_athletic_recruit_ind,
	
	stud_term_crm.eab_current_funnel_status_crm,
	stu_term_sis.eab_current_funnel_status AS eab_current_funnel_status_sis,
	--<eab_current_funnel_status> AS eab_current_funnel_status,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.eab_current_funnel_status,stud_term_crm.eab_current_funnel_status_crm) as eab_current_funnel_status,
	
	stud_term_crm.eab_first_source_crm,
	stu_term_sis.eab_first_source AS eab_first_source_sis,
	--<eab_first_source> AS eab_first_source,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.eab_first_source,stud_term_crm.eab_first_source_crm) as eab_first_source,
	
	stud_term_crm.eab_student_type_crm,
	stu_term_sis.eab_student_type AS eab_student_type_sis,
	--<eab_student_type> AS eab_student_type,
	coalesce(stu_term_sis.eab_student_type,stud_term_crm.eab_student_type_crm) as eab_student_type,
	
	to_timestamp(stud_term_crm.intake_dt_crm) AS intake_dt_crm ,
	to_timestamp(stu_term_sis.intake_dt) AS intake_dt_sis,
	--to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt
	to_timestamp(coalesce(stu_term_sis.intake_dt,stud_term_crm.intake_dt_crm)) as intake_dt
	
FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stu_term_sis
FULL OUTER JOIN student_term_crm AS stud_term_crm
			ON stud_term_crm.eab_student_id_crm = stu_term_sis.eab_student_id
			AND stud_term_crm.eab_student_id_type_crm = stu_term_sis.eab_student_id_type
			AND COALESCE(to_varchar(stud_term_crm.eab_entry_year_academic_crm), '') = COALESCE(to_varchar(stu_term_sis.eab_entry_year_academic), '')
			AND stud_term_crm.eab_entry_term_crm = stu_term_sis.eab_entry_term
) agg						  
where 1=1
--and EAB_STUDENT_ID is not null and PRIMARY_STUDENT_ID is not null
--and EAB_STUDENT_TYPE_CRM <> EAB_STUDENT_TYPE_SIS
--and eab_student_type = 'Freshman'
--and eab_entry_term = 'Fall'
--and eab_entry_year_academic = 2023
--and coalesce(eab_current_funnel_status,'') in ('Net Deposit','Enrolled')
--order by EAB_STUDENT_ID nulls first, PRIMARY_STUDENT_ID
--limit 3000

FULL OUTER JOIN student_term_crm AS stud_term_crm

queryResults.sqlPreview: /*2025-07-08: added variables: <join_extension.Student Term SIS>, <where_statement.eab_student_type>, set student type limits in <where_statement.eab_student_ty…
queryResults.querySql:
/*2025-07-08: added variables: <join_extension.Student Term SIS>, <where_statement.eab_student_type>, 
set student type limits in <where_statement.eab_student_type> - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-03: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-04-24: main differences are criteria on student type and eab_alternative_academic_rank as variable here, not in PCM*/

select * from (

select distinct 
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,
agg2.student_type,
agg2.curr_entry_term,
agg2.curr_entry_year_academic,
agg2.inquiry_ind,
agg2.recruitment_status,
agg2.state_resident,
nullif(regexp_replace(agg2.first_source,'[^[:ascii:]]|"|[\\0]|[\\000-\\037\\177]',''),'') as first_source,
agg2.first_source_dt,
agg2.athletic_recruit_ind,
agg2.athletic_recruit_sport,
agg2.years_employed,
agg2.academic_rating,
agg2.interest_rating,
agg2.student_level,
agg2.curr_entry_year_calendar,
agg2.eab_athletic_recruit_ind,
agg2.eab_entry_term,
agg2.eab_entry_year_academic,
agg2.eab_first_source,
agg2.eab_inquiry_ind,
agg2.eab_student_type,
agg2.eab_current_funnel_status,
agg2.intake_dt,

agg2.alternative_academic_rank,
agg2.eab_alternative_academic_rank

from (

select agg.*,

case 
	when stud_term_app.eab_enroll_ind = 'true' then 'Enrolled'
	when stud_term_app.eab_deny_ind = 'true' then 'Deny'
	when stud_term_app.eab_deferral_future_ind = 'true' then 'Future Defer'
	when stud_term_app.eab_deferral_prev_ind = 'true' then 'Previous Defer'
	when stud_term_app.eab_deposit_ind = 'true' and stud_term_app.eab_withdrawal_ind = 'true' and (IFNULL(stud_term_app.deposit_dt,'1/1/1800') <= IFNULL(stud_term_app.withdrawal_dt,'12/31/9999')) then 'Melt'
	/* field is not present in new data spec - cancel_dt*/
	--when stud_term_app.eab_deposit_ind = 'true' and stud_term_app.cancel_dt is not null and (IFNULL(stud_term_app.deposit_dt,'1/1/1800') <= IFNULL(stud_term_app.cancel_dt,'12/31/9999')) then 'Melt'
	when stud_term_app.eab_deposit_ind  = 'true' and IFNULL(stud_term_app.eab_withdrawal_ind,'false') = 'false' then 'Net Deposit'
	when stud_term_app.eab_withdrawal_ind = 'true' then 'Withdraw'  
	--when stud_term_app.cancel_dt is not null then 'Withdraw'
	when stud_term_app.eab_readmit_ind = 'true' then 'Readmit'
	when stud_term_app.eab_admit_ind = 'true' then 'Uncommitted Admit'
	when stud_term_app.eab_cond_admit_ind = 'true' then 'Conditional Admit'
	when stud_term_app.eab_waitlist_ind = 'true' then 'Waitlist'
	when stud_term_app.eab_app_complete_ind = 'true' then 'Completed Applicant'
	when stud_term_app.eab_app_submit_ind = 'true' then 'Incomplete Applicant'  /*commented in and corrected reference*/
	when stud_term_app.eab_app_start_ind = 'true' then 'Started Applicant'
	when agg.eab_inquiry_ind = 'true' then 'Inquiry'
	else 'Prospect'
end eab_current_funnel_status,

row_number() over (partition by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.partner_system_name, agg.eab_student_type, agg.eab_entry_term, agg.eab_entry_year_academic 
				   order by stud_term_app.eab_enroll_ind desc nulls last,
				   stud_term_app.eab_deny_ind desc nulls last,
				   stud_term_app.eab_deferral_future_ind desc nulls last,
				   stud_term_app.eab_deferral_prev_ind desc nulls last,
				   stud_term_app.eab_deposit_ind desc nulls last,
				   stud_term_app.eab_withdrawal_ind desc nulls last,
				   stud_term_app.eab_admit_ind desc nulls last,
				   stud_term_app.eab_cond_admit_ind desc nulls last,
				   stud_term_app.eab_waitlist_ind desc nulls last,
				   stud_term_app.eab_app_complete_ind desc nulls last,
				   stud_term_app.eab_app_submit_ind desc nulls last,  /*commented in and corrected reference*/
				   stud_term_app.eab_app_start_ind desc nulls last,  
				   agg.eab_inquiry_ind desc nulls last) rn

from 

(select distinct
stud_term.eab_student_id,
stud_term.eab_student_id_type,
stud_term.student_type,
stud_term.current_entry_term as curr_entry_term,
stud_term.current_entry_year_as_academic_year as curr_entry_year_academic,
stud_term.inquiry_indicator as inquiry_ind,
stud_term.recruitment_status,
stud_term.state_of_residence_for_tuition_purposes as state_resident,
stud_term.first_source as first_source,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_term.first_source_date,1,19)) as first_source_dt,
stud_term.athletic_recruit_indicator as athletic_recruit_ind,
stud_term.athletic_recruit_sport as athletic_recruit_sport,
stud_term.years_employed as years_employed,
stud_term.academic_rating as academic_rating,
stud_term.interest_rating as interest_rating,
stud_term.student_level,
stud_term.current_entry_year_as_calendar_year as curr_entry_year_calendar,

case when pcm_athletic_rec.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_athletic_rec.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_athletic_recruit_ind,

case when pcm_entry_term.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then 'Unknown'
else pcm_entry_term.eab_standard_value
end as eab_entry_term,

case when pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_number(pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_entry_year_academic,

case when pcm_first_source.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then 'Unknown'
else pcm_first_source.eab_standard_value
end as eab_first_source,

case when pcm_inquiry_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_inquiry_ind.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_inquiry_ind,
 
case when pcm_stud_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then 'Unknown'
else pcm_stud_type.eab_standard_value
end as eab_student_type,

stud_term.intake_dt as intake_dt,


stud_term.alternative_academic_rank as alternative_academic_rank,

<eab_alternative_academic_rank> as eab_alternative_academic_rank
 
from <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].{fulfillment}> as stud_term

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_isolate_first_source_sis}> pcm_first_source
on (pcm_first_source.field_name = 'eab_first_source'
and coalesce(stud_term.first_source,'') = coalesce(pcm_first_source.partner_value,''))
 
left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_athletic_rec
on (pcm_athletic_rec.field_name = 'eab_athletic_recruit_ind'
and coalesce(stud_term.athletic_recruit_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_athletic_rec.partner_value,''))
 
left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_entry_term
on (pcm_entry_term.field_name = 'eab_entry_term'
and coalesce(stud_term.current_entry_term,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_term.partner_value,''))
  
left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_entry_year
on (pcm_entry_year.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic'
and coalesce(stud_term.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_year.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_inquiry_ind
on (pcm_inquiry_ind.field_name = 'eab_inquiry_ind'
and coalesce(stud_term.inquiry_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_inquiry_ind.partner_value,''))
 
left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_stud_type
on (pcm_stud_type.field_name = 'eab_student_type'
and coalesce(stud_term.student_type,'') = coalesce(pcm_stud_type.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_alternative_academic_rank
on (pcm_alternative_academic_rank.field_name = 'eab_alternative_academic_rank'
and coalesce(stud_term.alternative_academic_rank,'') = coalesce(pcm_alternative_academic_rank.partner_value,''))

<join_extension.Student Term SIS>

where <where_statement>

) agg


left outer join 
(select stud_term_app.*,
row_number () over (partition by stud_term_app.eab_student_id, stud_term_app.eab_student_id_type,
coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_term,''),
coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_year_academic,0)
order by stud_term_app.eab_enroll_ind desc nulls last,
		 stud_term_app.eab_deny_ind desc nulls last,
		 stud_term_app.eab_deferral_future_ind desc nulls last,
		 stud_term_app.eab_deferral_prev_ind desc nulls last,
		 stud_term_app.eab_deposit_ind desc nulls last,
		 stud_term_app.eab_withdrawal_ind desc nulls last,
		 stud_term_app.eab_admit_ind desc nulls last,
		 stud_term_app.eab_cond_admit_ind desc nulls last,
		 stud_term_app.eab_waitlist_ind desc nulls last,
		 stud_term_app.eab_app_complete_ind desc nulls last,
		 stud_term_app.eab_app_submit_ind desc nulls last,  /*commented in and corrected reference*/
		 stud_term_app.eab_app_start_ind desc nulls last) rn


from <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application SIS].{final}> as stud_term_app) as stud_term_app
on (agg.partnercontact_id = stud_term_app.partnercontact_id
    and	coalesce(agg.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(stud_term_app.partner_system_name,'')
	and coalesce(agg.eab_entry_term,'') = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_term,'')
	and coalesce(agg.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_year_academic,0)
	and coalesce(agg.eab_student_type,'') = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_student_type,'') 
   )
and stud_term_app.rn = 1

) agg2

where agg2.rn = 1
and coalesce(agg2.eab_entry_term,'') <> ''
and <where_statement.eab_student_type>

) agg3
where coalesce(agg3.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(agg3.partner_system_name,'') <> ''

queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-03-03: <partnercontact_id>,<partner_system_name> master bundle updated to choose ID in this order: crm ID from merged record > join ID from SIS record, SIS ID 
join fields are in merge query, null placecholder fields added to this query
updates made to ID fields to pull all from final tables in alignment with current standards - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-07: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473; corrected where statement - ccreekman*/
/*2024-11-08: error on exam_date has been corrected - vshah*/ 
/*2024-11-08: mismatched field being referenced for sis.exam_dt, SIS.final.blank query outputs exam_dt but SIS.final query outputs exam_date, this query will fail on populated SIS.final table - ccreekman*/

WITH source_data AS (
SELECT 
	stud_scores.primary_student_id,
	stud_scores.eab_student_id,
	stud_scores.eab_student_id_type,
	stud_scores.partnercontact_id,
	stud_scores.partner_system_name,

	stud_scores.exam_code, 
	stud_scores.exam_date, 
	stud_scores.exam_score, 
	stud_scores.intake_dt,
	stud_scores.eab_exam_type,
	null as join_partnercontact_id,
	null as join_partner_system_name

FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Test Scores].[Last Validated].{final}> AS stud_scores
) 

SELECT 
	crm.primary_student_id,
    sis.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_sis,
    crm.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_crm,
    <eab_student_id> AS eab_student_id, /*default: sis > crm*/
	
    sis.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
    crm.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_crm,
    <eab_student_id_type> AS eab_student_id_type, /*default: sis > crm*/
	
	crm.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_crm,
	sis.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_sis,
	<partnercontact_id> AS partnercontact_id, /*default: crm > join > sis*/	
	
	crm.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_crm,
	sis.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_sis, 
	<partner_system_name> AS partner_system_name, /*default: crm > join > sis*/

    sis.eab_exam_code AS eab_exam_code_sis,
    crm.eab_exam_type AS eab_exam_code_crm,
    <eab_exam_code> AS eab_exam_type,
    to_number(sis.eab_exam_score) AS eab_exam_score,
    sis.self_reported_score,
    to_number(sis.eab_self_reported_score) AS eab_self_reported_score,

	sis.exam_code AS exam_code_sis,
	crm.exam_code AS exam_code_crm,
	<exam_code> AS exam_code,
	
	to_date(sis.exam_date) AS exam_dt_sis, 
	to_date(crm.exam_date) AS exam_dt_crm,
	to_date(<exam_dt>) AS exam_date, 
	
	sis.exam_score AS exam_score_sis,
	crm.exam_score AS exam_score_crm,
	<exam_score> AS exam_score, 
	
	to_timestamp(sis.intake_dt) AS intake_dt_sis,
	to_timestamp(crm.intake_dt) AS intake_dt_crm,
	to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt
--select *
FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Test Scores SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> AS sis
FULL OUTER JOIN source_data AS crm 
ON crm.eab_student_id = sis.eab_student_id
AND crm.eab_student_id_type = sis.eab_student_id_type
AND COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(crm.eab_exam_type)),'') = COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(sis.eab_exam_code)),'')
AND COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(to_varchar(crm.exam_date))),'') = COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(to_varchar(sis.exam_date))),'')
WHERE (sis.eab_student_id IS NOT NULL AND sis.eab_student_id_type IS NOT NULL) OR (crm.eab_student_id IS NOT NULL AND crm.eab_student_id_type IS NOT NULL)
