queryResults.sqlPreview: /*2026-06-19: added <where_statement.Student Test Scores PDP Delivery> variable for filtering prior to ranking and deduping - ccreekman*/ /*2026-03-04: crm psna…
queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-06-19: added <where_statement.Student Test Scores PDP Delivery> variable for filtering prior to ranking and deduping - ccreekman*/
/*2026-03-04: crm psname crossjoin now checks STerm to ensure we are populating pcID even if crm table does not have data, 
<partnercontact_id>,<partner_system_name> master bundle updated to choose ID in this order: crm ID from merged record > join ID from SIS record, SIS ID - ccreekman*/
/*2026-02-09: removed to_date on exam_date to allow any timestamps to persist - ccreekman*/
/*2026-01-13: merge query notes - ccreekman
student_ts_sis_fao cte: takes all SIS data, appends any partner_system_name(s) that are present in CRM_UG Student Test Scores.final
	Expectation is for one partner_system_name in CRM_UG Student Test Scores.final, but set up to account for crm changes, other scenarios where there may be a mix of ID types
	Uses this to pull in only IDs from Xwalk that align with CRM_UG Student Test Scores.final partner_system_name(s), excluding any irrelevant matching ID pairs
	if there are multiple CRM_UG Student Test Scores.final partner_system_name(s), multiple rows per SIS record will be created
	deduping logic will exclude records with null join_partnercontact_id only if there is not a record with a populated join_partnercontact_id
	multiple records per student may still persist if they have unique populated join_partnercontact_id/join_partner_system_name values
	in that scenario resulting counts on this table may be inflated, need further examples to determine if we need to build in variables to allow customization here
main query: takes results from student_ts_sis_fao cte and does a full outer join to CRM_UG Student Test Scores.final using the join ID / ID type / exam_date / eab_exam_code (if populated)
	crm join currently in variables - unclear if we need that level of customization available
*/

WITH 
student_ts_sis_fao as (
    SELECT * from (
  SELECT distinct
  	id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id as join_partnercontact_id,
	id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name as join_partner_system_name,
	stud_ts.*,
  row_number() over(partition by stud_ts.partnercontact_id, stud_ts.partner_system_name, stud_ts.eab_exam_code, stud_ts.exam_date
		order by id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id) as merge_rn

  FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Test Scores SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> as stud_ts

  /*cross join below will associate current crm_ug partner_system_name(s) with SIS record to limit the IDs pulled from xwalk to relevent psnames
  join parcontID/psname will later only be populated when Xwalk has records where one ID pair is the parcontID/psname from this SIS data 
  and the other set has a psname that matches what we appended here
  eg: partner xwalk includes psnames of sis_01, sis_02, primary, crm_01 but crm tables only have ID psns of primary, crm_01 so only those are appended to the records*/ 
  CROSS JOIN (
  		select distinct partner_system_name as crm_ug_partner_system_name
		FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Test Scores].[Last Validated].{final}> stud_crm
		union
		select distinct partner_system_name as crm_ug_partner_system_name
		FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Term].[Last Validated].{final}> stud_crm
  		) crm_psn

  LEFT JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> id_xwalk
	on (stud_ts.partnercontact_id = id_xwalk.target_partnercontact_id
	and coalesce(stud_ts.partner_system_name,'') = coalesce(id_xwalk.target_partner_system_name,'')
	and coalesce(crm_psn.CRM_UG_PARTNER_SYSTEM_NAME,'') = coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name,''))
)agg
where 1=1
/*xwalk may have multiple id pairs which meet join criteria
	this criteria limits the result set to only allow necessary dupes
	[rn = 1]: to ensure at least one copy of the SIS record is retained regardless if there is a match in ID Xwalk
	[agg.join_partnercontact_id is not null]: any dupes with distinct partnercontact_id/partner_system_name*/

and (agg.join_partnercontact_id is not null or merge_rn = 1) 
--and agg.join_partnercontact_id is null /*for troubleshooting - SIS records with no xwalk match*/
)

select * from (
select distinct *
, row_number() over (partition by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.partner_system_name, agg.eab_exam_type, agg.exam_date
				   order by coalesce(agg.eab_exam_score,try_to_number(agg.exam_score)) desc nulls last, agg.intake_dt desc nulls last) merge_rn
from (
SELECT
	crm_ug.primary_student_id,

	sis_fao.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_sis,
    sis_fao.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
    crm_ug.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_crm,
    crm_ug.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_crm,
    <eab_student_id> AS eab_student_id, /*default: sis > crm*/
    <eab_student_id_type> AS eab_student_id_type, /*default: sis > crm*/

    sis_fao.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_sis,
    sis_fao.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_sis,
    crm_ug.partnercontact_id AS partnercontact_id_crm,
    crm_ug.partner_system_name AS partner_system_name_crm,
    <partnercontact_id> AS partnercontact_id, /*default: crm > join > sis*/
    <partner_system_name> AS partner_system_name, /*default: crm > join > sis*/
    
    sis_fao.eab_exam_code AS eab_exam_code_sis,
    crm_ug.eab_exam_type AS eab_exam_code_crm,
    <eab_exam_code> AS eab_exam_type,
    to_number(sis_fao.eab_exam_score) AS eab_exam_score,
    sis_fao.self_reported_score,
    to_number(sis_fao.eab_self_reported_score) AS eab_self_reported_score,

	sis_fao.exam_code AS exam_code_sis,
	crm_ug.exam_code AS exam_code_crm,
	<exam_code> AS exam_code,
	
	sis_fao.exam_date AS exam_dt_sis, 
	crm_ug.exam_date AS exam_dt_crm,
	<exam_dt> AS exam_date, 
	
	sis_fao.exam_score AS exam_score_sis,
	crm_ug.exam_score AS exam_score_crm,
	<exam_score> AS exam_score, 
	
	to_timestamp(sis_fao.intake_dt) AS intake_dt_sis,
	to_timestamp(crm_ug.intake_dt) AS intake_dt_crm,
	to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt
FROM student_ts_sis_fao as sis_fao

<join_extension.Student Test Scores PDP Delivery>

WHERE <where_statement.Student Test Scores PDP Delivery>
and (coalesce(crm_ug.partnercontact_id,'') <> '' and coalesce(crm_ug.partner_system_name,'') <> '')
or (coalesce(sis_fao.partnercontact_id,'') <> '' and coalesce(sis_fao.partner_system_name,'') <> '')

) agg

) agg2
where agg2.merge_rn = 1

order by 
	(agg2.partnercontact_id_crm||agg2.partnercontact_id_sis) nulls last, /*null in either field will return null, merged records (both fields populated) will come before non-merged records in results*/
	agg2.partnercontact_id_crm, agg2.intake_dt_crm, /*most recent non-merged UG records next*/
	agg2.partnercontact_id_sis, agg2.intake_dt_sis /*most recent non-merged FAO records next*/

SELECT

	exam_date, 
	exam_score, 
	intake_dt,
	primary_student_id,
    eab_exam_type
FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Test Scores].[Last Validated].{final}> AS stud_scores
) 

, source_data_sis as (
 select 
 coalesce(xw.primary_student_id,sis.eab_student_id) as eab_student_id,
 case when xw.primary_student_id is not null then 'primary' else sis.eab_student_id_type end as eab_student_id_type,
 sis.eab_student_id as eab_student_id_sis,
 sis.eab_student_id_type as eab_student_id_type_sis,
 sis.exam_code, 
 sis.eab_exam_code,
 sis.exam_date, 
 sis.exam_score, 
 sis.eab_exam_score,
 sis.self_reported_score,
 sis.eab_self_reported_score,
 sis.intake_dt
FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Test Scores SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> AS sis
LEFT JOIN <[Enroll360].[Student ID Xwalk].[Last Validated].{final}> as xw
	ON sis.eab_student_id = xw.eab_student_id
	AND sis.eab_student_id_type = xw.eab_student_id_type) 

SELECT distinct
	crm.primary_student_id,
    crm.eab_exam_type,
    sis.eab_student_id_sis as eab_student_id,
    sis.eab_student_id_type_sis as eab_student_id_type,
    to_number(sis.eab_exam_score) AS eab_exam_score,
    sis.self_reported_score,
    to_number(sis.eab_self_reported_score) AS eab_self_reported_score,
    sis.eab_exam_code,

	sis.exam_code AS exam_code_sis,
	crm.exam_code AS exam_code_crm,
	<exam_code> AS exam_code,
	
	to_date(sis.exam_date) AS exam_dt_sis,
	to_date(crm.exam_date) AS exam_dt_crm,
	to_date(<exam_dt>) AS exam_dt, 
	
	sis.exam_score AS exam_score_sis,
	crm.exam_score AS exam_score_crm,
	<exam_score> AS exam_score, 
	
	to_timestamp(sis.intake_dt) AS intake_dt_sis,
	to_timestamp(crm.intake_dt) AS intake_dt_crm,
	to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt
FROM 
	source_data_sis as sis

FULL OUTER JOIN source_data AS crm 
ON crm.eab_student_id = sis.eab_student_id
AND crm.eab_student_id_type = sis.eab_student_id_type
AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(crm.eab_exam_type,''))) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(sis.eab_exam_code,'')))
AND LOWER(TRIM(coalesce(to_varchar(crm.exam_date),''))) = LOWER(TRIM(coalesce(to_varchar(sis.exam_date),'')))

queryResults.querySql:
/*2025-03-11: where statement is missing condition specification for sis.eab_student_id_type so defaults to evaluating for boolean and failing feed, correcting this issue in this tenant query - ccreekman*/
/*2024-11-08: mismatched field being referenced for sis.exam_dt, SIS.final.blank query outputs exam_dt but SIS.final query outputs exam_date, this query will fail on populated SIS.final table - ccreekman*/
/*2024-11-08: error on exam_date has been corrected - vshah*/ 

WITH source_data AS (
SELECT 
	stud_scores.primary_student_id AS eab_student_id,
	'primary' AS eab_student_id_type,
	stud_scores.exam_code, 
	stud_scores.exam_date, 
	stud_scores.exam_score, 
	stud_scores.intake_dt,
	stud_scores.primary_student_id,
    stud_scores.eab_exam_type
FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Test Scores].[Last Validated].{final}> AS stud_scores
) 

SELECT 
	crm.primary_student_id,
    sis.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_sis,
    crm.eab_student_id AS eab_student_id_crm,
    <eab_student_id> AS eab_student_id,

    sis.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_sis,
    crm.eab_student_id_type AS eab_student_id_type_crm,
    <eab_student_id_type> AS eab_student_id_type,
    
    sis.eab_exam_code AS eab_exam_code_sis,
    crm.eab_exam_type AS eab_exam_code_crm,
    <eab_exam_code> AS eab_exam_type,
    to_number(sis.eab_exam_score) AS eab_exam_score,
    sis.self_reported_score,
    to_number(sis.eab_self_reported_score) AS eab_self_reported_score,

	sis.exam_code AS exam_code_sis,
	crm.exam_code AS exam_code_crm,
	<exam_code> AS exam_code,
	
	to_date(sis.exam_date) AS exam_dt_sis, 
	to_date(crm.exam_date) AS exam_dt_crm,
	to_date(<exam_dt>) AS exam_date, 
	
	sis.exam_score AS exam_score_sis,
	crm.exam_score AS exam_score_crm,
	<exam_score> AS exam_score, 
	
	to_timestamp(sis.intake_dt) AS intake_dt_sis,
	to_timestamp(crm.intake_dt) AS intake_dt_crm,
	to_timestamp(<intake_dt>) AS intake_dt
--select *
FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Test Scores SIS].[Last Validated].{final}> AS sis
FULL OUTER JOIN source_data AS crm 
ON crm.eab_student_id = sis.eab_student_id
AND crm.eab_student_id_type = sis.eab_student_id_type
AND COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(crm.eab_exam_type)),'') = COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(sis.eab_exam_code)),'')
AND COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(to_varchar(crm.exam_date))),'') = COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(to_varchar(sis.exam_date))),'')
WHERE (sis.eab_student_id IS NOT NULL AND sis.eab_student_id_type IS NOT NULL) OR (crm.eab_student_id IS NOT NULL AND crm.eab_student_id_type IS NOT NULL)

queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-07-31: archived for reference. New Master uses Student Term as base.*/
/*2026-02-09: added normalization to row_number() fields, added eab_student_type to row_number() partition - ccreekman*/
/*2025-12-01: please note new variables <fao_calc.*> in bundle plus update to default <join_extension.Student Year Finaid Application> variable
ti_grant, tgrant have been added as fields in final but are not being sent to PDP at this time*/
/*2025-11-12: added new attributes for student_type, aid_application_indicator, expense_group_key (not being sent to PDP)
added logic and join for eab_student_type, updated partnercontact_id and partner_system_name references
updated left join to PCM for fafsa dependence to join on fafsa_dependency_status rather than eab_fafsa_dependency - ccreekman*/
/*2025-06-24: removed conversion case logic for eab_expense_group_key, switched to variable; added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-06-02: switched eab_financial_sai and eab_financial_need from try_to_numbers to CAST as DECIMAL*/
/*2025-04-25: changes from engineering master:
- eab_aid_app_ind: due to logic needs, changed to <eab_aid_app_ind> variable, rather than using fulfillment eab_aid_application_indicator field directly
- removed conversion case logic for eab_financial_sai, eab_financial_need. switched to relevant variables
- added case logic and left join to PCM for eab_expense_group_key 1:1 conversions
- added <join_extension.Student Year Finaid Application> join extension variable to allow for complex logic that pulls from other entity attributes (eg: <eab_aid_app_ind>)
*/

select * from
    (
	select distinct
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,
	agg2.curr_entry_year_academic,
	agg2.eab_entry_year_academic,
	agg2.student_type, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
	agg2.eab_student_type, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
	agg2.fin_aid_intent_ind,
	agg2.FAFSA_submitted_ind,
	agg2.eab_fafsa_submitted_ind,
	agg2.FAFSA_submitted_dt,
	agg2.first_FAFSA_submitted_dt,
	agg2.current_FAFSA_submitted_dt,
	agg2.fin_aid_award_sent_ind,
	agg2.eab_fin_aid_award_sent_ind,
	agg2.fin_aid_award_sent_dt,
	agg2.css_profile_submitted_ind,
	agg2.eab_css_profile_submitted_ind,
	agg2.css_profile_submitted_dt,
	agg2.total_attend_cost,
	agg2.cost_of_attendance,
	agg2.tuition,
	agg2.tuition_and_fees,
	agg2.fafsa_sai,
	agg2.fafsa_need,
	agg2.fafsa_student_sai,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_sai,
	agg2.fafsa_dependency_status,
	agg2.eab_fafsa_dependency,
	agg2.fafsa_student_net_worth,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_net_worth,
	agg2.fafsa_student_agi,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_agi,
	agg2.aid_package_status,
	agg2.aid_package_complete_ind,
	agg2.eab_aid_package_complete_ind,
	agg2.aid_review_status,
	agg2.fin_aid_app_status,
	agg2.fin_aid_app_complete_ind,
	agg2.eab_fin_aid_app_complete_ind,
	agg2.fin_aid_complete_dt,
	agg2.fafsa_student_farm,
	agg2.fafsa_student_bus,
	agg2.fafsa_student_cash,
	agg2.fafsa_student_invest,
	agg2.fafsa_student_bus_farm,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_farm,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_bus,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_cash,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_invest,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_bus_farm,
	agg2.verification_ind,
	agg2.eab_verification_ind,
	agg2.verification_status,
	agg2.eab_verification_status,
	agg2.current_fin_aid_award_sent_dt,
	agg2.number_of_award_letters,
	agg2.number_in_college,
	agg2.number_in_family,
	agg2.parent_marital_status,
	agg2.eab_single_parent_ind,
	agg2.fafsa_student_wages,
	agg2.fafsa_student_salary,
	agg2.fafsa_student_income,
	agg2.fafsa_student_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_wages,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_salary,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_income,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,
	agg2.par1_grade_level,
	agg2.par2_grade_level,
	agg2.fafsa_change_dt,
	agg2.housing_app_status,
	agg2.tuition_residency,
	agg2.professional_judgement_ind,
	agg2.eab_professional_judgement_ind,
	agg2.pell_eligible_ind,
	agg2.eab_pell_eligible_ind,
	agg2.appeal_ind,
	agg2.eab_appeal_ind,
	agg2.css_profile_sai,
	agg2.css_profile_need,
	agg2.css_profile_stu_sai,
	agg2.css_profile_par_sai,
	agg2.aid_app_ind, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
	agg2.ti_grant, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
	agg2.tgrant, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
	agg2.eab_aid_app_ind,
	agg2.eab_financial_sai,
	agg2.eab_financial_need,
	agg2.expense_group_key, /*not passed to PDP currently*/

	agg2.eab_expense_group_key,
	agg2.eab_independent_ind,
	agg2.intake_dt

 from (
	select agg.*,
	row_number() over (partition by 
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''), 
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''), 
	agg.eab_entry_year_academic
	order by agg.intake_dt desc nulls last, agg.eab_student_type
	) rn

from (
				select distinct
				stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_student_id,
				lower(regexp_replace(stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_student_id_type,'[\\s]','')) as eab_student_id_type,
				<partnercontact_id.sis_fao.Student Year Finaid Application> as partnercontact_id,
				lower(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.sis_fao.Student Year Finaid Application>,'[\\s]','')) as partner_system_name,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.current_entry_year_as_academic_year as curr_entry_year_academic,
			  	stud_yr_fin_aid.student_type,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.intent_to_file_for_financial_aid_indicator as fin_aid_intent_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_submitted as FAFSA_submitted_ind,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_submitted_date,1,19)) as FAFSA_submitted_dt,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.first_fafsa_submitted_date,1,19)) as first_FAFSA_submitted_dt,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.most_recent_fafsa_submitted_date,1,19)) as current_FAFSA_submitted_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_award_sent_indicator as fin_aid_award_sent_ind,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_award_sent_date,1,19)) as fin_aid_award_sent_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_submitted_indicator as css_profile_submitted_ind,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_submitted_date,1,19)) as css_profile_submitted_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.cost_of_attendance as cost_of_attendance,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.total_attend_cost,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.tuition,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.tuition_and_fees,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_need,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_sai,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_sai,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_dependency_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_net_worth,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_net_worth,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_agi,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_agi,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.aid_package_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.aid_package_complete_indicator as aid_package_complete_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.aid_review_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_application_status as fin_aid_app_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_application_complete_indicator as fin_aid_app_complete_ind,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_complete_date,1,19)) as fin_aid_complete_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_farm,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_business as fafsa_student_bus,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_cash,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_invest,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_business_farm as fafsa_student_bus_farm,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_farm,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_business as fafsa_parent_bus,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_cash,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_invest,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_business_farm as fafsa_parent_bus_farm,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.verification_indicator as verification_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.verification_status,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.current_financial_aid_award_sent_date,1,19)) as current_fin_aid_award_sent_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.number_of_award_letters,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.number_in_college,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.number_in_family,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.parent_marital_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_wages,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_salary,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_income,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_adjusted_business_farm_equity as fafsa_student_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_wages,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_salary,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_income,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_adjusted_business_farm_equity as fafsa_parent_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.parent_1_grade_level as par1_grade_level,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.parent_2_grade_level as par2_grade_level,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_change_date,1,19)) as fafsa_change_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.housing_application_status as housing_app_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.tuition_residency,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.professional_judgement_indicator as professional_judgement_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.pell_eligible_indicator as pell_eligible_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.appeal_indicator as appeal_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_appeal_indicator as eab_appeal_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_sai,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_need,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_student_sai css_profile_stu_sai,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_parent_sai as css_profile_par_sai,	
				calc_grants.ti_grant,
				calc_grants.tgrant,

				case when pcm_fin_aid_app_complete_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_fin_aid_app_complete_ind.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_fin_aid_app_complete_ind,

				case when pcm_verification_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_verification_ind.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_verification_ind,

				case when pcm_verification_status.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else pcm_verification_status.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_verification_status,
				
				case when pcm_professional_judgement_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else pcm_professional_judgement_ind.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_professional_judgement_ind,

				<fao_calc.eab_pell_eligible_ind> as eab_pell_eligible_ind,

				/*case when pcm_pell_eligible_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_pell_eligible_ind.eab_standard_value)
				end*/

				case when pcm_aid_package_complete_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_aid_package_complete_ind.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_aid_package_complete_ind,

				stud_yr_fin_aid.aid_application_indicator as aid_app_ind,
				<eab_aid_app_ind> as eab_aid_app_ind,

				/*edited logic to convert fulfillment value directly*/														 
				CAST(<eab_financial_sai> as DECIMAL (12,2)) as eab_financial_sai,

				/*edited logic to convert fulfillment value directly*/	
				CAST(<eab_financial_need>  as DECIMAL (12,2)) as eab_financial_need,
				
				stud_yr_fin_aid.expense_group_key,
				<eab_expense_group_key> as eab_expense_group_key,						 

				case when pcm_independent_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_independent_ind.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_independent_ind,

				case when pcm_fafsa_dependency.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else pcm_fafsa_dependency.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_fafsa_dependency,

				case when pcm_css_profile.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_css_profile.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_css_profile_submitted_ind,

				case when pcm_fafsa_sub.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_fafsa_sub.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_FAFSA_submitted_ind,

				case when pcm_fa_award_sent.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_fa_award_sent.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_fin_aid_award_sent_ind,

				case when pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_number(pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_entry_year_academic,

				case when pcm_stud_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then 'Unknown'
				else pcm_stud_type.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_student_type,

				case when pcm_single_parent.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then try_to_boolean(false)
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_single_parent.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_single_parent_ind,

				stud_yr_fin_aid.intake_dt

				from <[Enroll360].[Student Year Finaid Application].{fulfillment}> as stud_yr_fin_aid

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_css_profile

queryResults.sqlPreview: /*2025-11-03: note: uses bundle "Enroll360.imputed_funds" - ccreekman*/ /*query pulls SYFA data and creates calculated fields used to determine if a student sho…
queryResults.querySql:
/*2025-11-03: note: uses bundle "Enroll360.imputed_funds" - ccreekman*/

/*query pulls SYFA data and creates calculated fields used to determine if a student should receive an imputed pell award and the amount.
this query returns a calculated pell award even if the student has pell awards in Student Year Funds
redundant imputed awards are filtered out in later query: DataOrgPilot.Enroll360.Student Year Funds.final.pell_impute - ccreekman*/

select * from (

select distinct stud_yr_fin_aid.*,
  case when coalesce(to_decimal(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,18,2),0)>= peb.budget then true else false end as im_waiver,
  <pell_calc.impute_pell_switch> as impute_pell_switch,
  to_decimal(<pell_calc.poverty_guideline>,18,2) as poverty_guideline,

  to_decimal(pell_amt.max_value,18,2) as pell_max,
  to_decimal(pell_amt.min_value,18,2) as pell_min,

  case when stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_single_parent_ind = true 
  	then to_decimal(pell_single_par_perc.max_value,3,2)
  	else to_decimal(pell_not_single_par_perc.max_value,3,2) end as pell_perc_max,
  case when stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_single_parent_ind = true 
  	then to_decimal(pell_single_par_perc.min_value,3,2)
  	else to_decimal(pell_not_single_par_perc.min_value,3,2) end as pell_perc_min,

  case when coalesce(poverty_guideline,0) = 0
	or coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_sai,0) = 1
	or coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_agi,'') = ''
	then false
	when to_decimal(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_agi,18,2) between 0.01 and (poverty_guideline * pell_perc_max) then true else false end as eligible_for_max_pell_ind, 
  case when coalesce(poverty_guideline,0) = 0
	or coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_sai,0) = 1
  	or eligible_for_max_pell_ind = true
	or coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_agi,'') = ''
	then false
	when try_to_decimal(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_agi,18,2) <= (poverty_guideline * pell_perc_min) then true else false end as eligible_for_min_pell_ind,

  case when to_decimal(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,18,2) = to_decimal(min_sai.min_value,18,2) then pell_max
  	when impute_pell_switch = 'AGI' and eligible_for_max_pell_ind = true then pell_max
  	else 0 end as eligible_pell_amount_max,
  case when eligible_pell_amount_max > 0 then 0
  	when impute_pell_switch = 'AGI' and eligible_for_min_pell_ind = true then pell_min
  	else 0 end as eligible_pell_amount_min,

  case when (im_waiver = false and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_sai,'') = '') OR coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,'') = ''  then 0
  	when (eligible_pell_amount_max + eligible_pell_amount_min) > 0 then (eligible_pell_amount_max + eligible_pell_amount_min)
	when (pell_max - greatest(0,to_decimal(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,18,2))) <= pell_min then 0 
	else (pell_max - greatest(0,to_decimal(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,18,2))) end as calculated_pell,

<pell_calc.state_impute_amount> as state_impute,

  row_number() over(partition by stud_yr_fin_aid.partnercontact_id, stud_yr_fin_aid.partner_system_name, stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_student_type,  stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_entry_year_academic
	order by stud_yr_fin_aid.intake_dt desc nulls last) rn
																																		

from <[Enroll360].[Student Year Finaid Application].{final}> as stud_yr_fin_aid

<pell_calc.join_extension>
										   
where <pell_calc.where_statement>

)agg
where agg.rn = 1 
							  
order by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.rn, agg.intake_dt

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-02-09: added normalization to row_number() fields, added eab_student_type to row_number() partition - ccreekman*/
/*2025-12-01: please note new variables <fao_calc.*> in bundle plus update to default <join_extension.Student Year Finaid Application> variable
ti_grant, tgrant have been added as fields in final but are not being sent to PDP at this time*/
/*2025-11-12: added new attributes for student_type, aid_application_indicator, expense_group_key (not being sent to PDP)
added logic and join for eab_student_type, updated partnercontact_id and partner_system_name references
updated left join to PCM for fafsa dependence to join on fafsa_dependency_status rather than eab_fafsa_dependency - ccreekman*/
/*2025-06-24: removed conversion case logic for eab_expense_group_key, switched to variable; added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-06-02: switched eab_financial_sai and eab_financial_need from try_to_numbers to CAST as DECIMAL*/
/*2025-04-25: changes from engineering master:
- eab_aid_app_ind: due to logic needs, changed to <eab_aid_app_ind> variable, rather than using fulfillment eab_aid_application_indicator field directly
- removed conversion case logic for eab_financial_sai, eab_financial_need. switched to relevant variables
- added case logic and left join to PCM for eab_expense_group_key 1:1 conversions
- added <join_extension.Student Year Finaid Application> join extension variable to allow for complex logic that pulls from other entity attributes (eg: <eab_aid_app_ind>)
*/

select * from
    (
	select distinct
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,
	agg2.curr_entry_year_academic,
	agg2.eab_entry_year_academic,
	agg2.student_type, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
	agg2.eab_student_type, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
	agg2.fin_aid_intent_ind,
	agg2.FAFSA_submitted_ind,
	agg2.eab_fafsa_submitted_ind,
	agg2.FAFSA_submitted_dt,
	agg2.first_FAFSA_submitted_dt,
	agg2.current_FAFSA_submitted_dt,
	agg2.fin_aid_award_sent_ind,
	agg2.eab_fin_aid_award_sent_ind,
	agg2.fin_aid_award_sent_dt,
	agg2.css_profile_submitted_ind,
	agg2.eab_css_profile_submitted_ind,
	agg2.css_profile_submitted_dt,
	agg2.total_attend_cost,
	agg2.cost_of_attendance,
	agg2.tuition,
	agg2.tuition_and_fees,
	agg2.fafsa_sai,
	agg2.fafsa_need,
	agg2.fafsa_student_sai,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_sai,
	agg2.fafsa_dependency_status,
	agg2.eab_fafsa_dependency,
	agg2.fafsa_student_net_worth,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_net_worth,
	agg2.fafsa_student_agi,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_agi,
	agg2.aid_package_status,
	agg2.aid_package_complete_ind,
	agg2.eab_aid_package_complete_ind,
	agg2.aid_review_status,
	agg2.fin_aid_app_status,
	agg2.fin_aid_app_complete_ind,
	agg2.eab_fin_aid_app_complete_ind,
	agg2.fin_aid_complete_dt,
	agg2.fafsa_student_farm,
	agg2.fafsa_student_bus,
	agg2.fafsa_student_cash,
	agg2.fafsa_student_invest,
	agg2.fafsa_student_bus_farm,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_farm,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_bus,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_cash,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_invest,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_bus_farm,
	agg2.verification_ind,
	agg2.eab_verification_ind,
	agg2.verification_status,
	agg2.eab_verification_status,
	agg2.current_fin_aid_award_sent_dt,
	agg2.number_of_award_letters,
	agg2.number_in_college,
	agg2.number_in_family,
	agg2.parent_marital_status,
	agg2.eab_single_parent_ind,
	agg2.fafsa_student_wages,
	agg2.fafsa_student_salary,
	agg2.fafsa_student_income,
	agg2.fafsa_student_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_wages,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_salary,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_income,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,
	agg2.par1_grade_level,
	agg2.par2_grade_level,
	agg2.fafsa_change_dt,
	agg2.housing_app_status,
	agg2.tuition_residency,
	agg2.professional_judgement_ind,
	agg2.eab_professional_judgement_ind,
	agg2.pell_eligible_ind,
	agg2.eab_pell_eligible_ind,
	agg2.appeal_ind,
	agg2.eab_appeal_ind,
	agg2.css_profile_sai,
	agg2.css_profile_need,
	agg2.css_profile_stu_sai,
	agg2.css_profile_par_sai,
	agg2.aid_app_ind, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
	agg2.ti_grant, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
	agg2.tgrant, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
	agg2.eab_aid_app_ind,
	agg2.eab_financial_sai,
	agg2.eab_financial_need,
	agg2.expense_group_key, /*not passed to PDP currently*/

	agg2.eab_expense_group_key,
	agg2.eab_independent_ind,
	agg2.intake_dt

 from (
	select agg.*,
	row_number() over (partition by 
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''), 
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''), 
	agg.eab_entry_year_academic
	order by agg.intake_dt desc nulls last, agg.eab_student_type
	) rn

from (
				select distinct
				stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_student_id,
				lower(regexp_replace(stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_student_id_type,'[\\s]','')) as eab_student_id_type,
				<partnercontact_id.sis_fao.Student Year Finaid Application> as partnercontact_id,
				lower(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.sis_fao.Student Year Finaid Application>,'[\\s]','')) as partner_system_name,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.current_entry_year_as_academic_year as curr_entry_year_academic,
			  	stud_yr_fin_aid.student_type,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.intent_to_file_for_financial_aid_indicator as fin_aid_intent_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_submitted as FAFSA_submitted_ind,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_submitted_date,1,19)) as FAFSA_submitted_dt,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.first_fafsa_submitted_date,1,19)) as first_FAFSA_submitted_dt,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.most_recent_fafsa_submitted_date,1,19)) as current_FAFSA_submitted_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_award_sent_indicator as fin_aid_award_sent_ind,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_award_sent_date,1,19)) as fin_aid_award_sent_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_submitted_indicator as css_profile_submitted_ind,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_submitted_date,1,19)) as css_profile_submitted_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.cost_of_attendance as cost_of_attendance,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.total_attend_cost,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.tuition,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.tuition_and_fees,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_need,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_sai,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_sai,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_dependency_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_net_worth,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_net_worth,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_agi,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_agi,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.aid_package_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.aid_package_complete_indicator as aid_package_complete_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.aid_review_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_application_status as fin_aid_app_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_application_complete_indicator as fin_aid_app_complete_ind,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_complete_date,1,19)) as fin_aid_complete_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_farm,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_business as fafsa_student_bus,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_cash,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_invest,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_business_farm as fafsa_student_bus_farm,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_farm,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_business as fafsa_parent_bus,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_cash,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_invest,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_business_farm as fafsa_parent_bus_farm,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.verification_indicator as verification_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.verification_status,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.current_financial_aid_award_sent_date,1,19)) as current_fin_aid_award_sent_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.number_of_award_letters,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.number_in_college,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.number_in_family,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.parent_marital_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_wages,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_salary,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_income,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_adjusted_business_farm_equity as fafsa_student_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_wages,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_salary,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_income,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_adjusted_business_farm_equity as fafsa_parent_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.parent_1_grade_level as par1_grade_level,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.parent_2_grade_level as par2_grade_level,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_change_date,1,19)) as fafsa_change_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.housing_application_status as housing_app_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.tuition_residency,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.professional_judgement_indicator as professional_judgement_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.pell_eligible_indicator as pell_eligible_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.appeal_indicator as appeal_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_appeal_indicator as eab_appeal_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_sai,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_need,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_student_sai css_profile_stu_sai,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_parent_sai as css_profile_par_sai,	
				calc_grants.ti_grant,
				calc_grants.tgrant,

				case when pcm_fin_aid_app_complete_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_fin_aid_app_complete_ind.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_fin_aid_app_complete_ind,

				case when pcm_verification_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_verification_ind.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_verification_ind,

				case when pcm_verification_status.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else pcm_verification_status.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_verification_status,
				
				case when pcm_professional_judgement_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else pcm_professional_judgement_ind.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_professional_judgement_ind,

				<fao_calc.eab_pell_eligible_ind> as eab_pell_eligible_ind,

				/*case when pcm_pell_eligible_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_pell_eligible_ind.eab_standard_value)
				end*/

				case when pcm_aid_package_complete_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_aid_package_complete_ind.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_aid_package_complete_ind,

				stud_yr_fin_aid.aid_application_indicator as aid_app_ind,
				<eab_aid_app_ind> as eab_aid_app_ind,

				/*edited logic to convert fulfillment value directly*/														 
				CAST(<eab_financial_sai> as DECIMAL (12,2)) as eab_financial_sai,

				/*edited logic to convert fulfillment value directly*/	
				CAST(<eab_financial_need>  as DECIMAL (12,2)) as eab_financial_need,
				
				stud_yr_fin_aid.expense_group_key,
				<eab_expense_group_key> as eab_expense_group_key,						 

				case when pcm_independent_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_independent_ind.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_independent_ind,

				case when pcm_fafsa_dependency.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else pcm_fafsa_dependency.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_fafsa_dependency,

				case when pcm_css_profile.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_css_profile.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_css_profile_submitted_ind,

				case when pcm_fafsa_sub.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_fafsa_sub.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_FAFSA_submitted_ind,

				case when pcm_fa_award_sent.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_fa_award_sent.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_fin_aid_award_sent_ind,

				case when pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_number(pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_entry_year_academic,

				case when pcm_stud_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then 'Unknown'
				else pcm_stud_type.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_student_type,

				case when pcm_single_parent.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then try_to_boolean(false)
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_single_parent.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_single_parent_ind,

				stud_yr_fin_aid.intake_dt

				from <[Enroll360].[Student Year Finaid Application].{fulfillment}> as stud_yr_fin_aid

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_css_profile
				on (pcm_css_profile.field_name = 'eab_css_profile_submitted_ind'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_submitted_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_css_profile.partner_value,''))

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_fafsa_sub
				on (pcm_fafsa_sub.field_name = 'eab_FAFSA_submitted_ind'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_submitted,'') = coalesce(pcm_fafsa_sub.partner_value,''))

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_fa_award_sent
				on (pcm_fa_award_sent.field_name = 'eab_fin_aid_award_sent_ind'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_award_sent_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_fa_award_sent.partner_value,''))

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_entry_year
				on (pcm_entry_year.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_year.partner_value,''))

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_stud_type
				on (pcm_stud_type.field_name = 'eab_student_type'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.student_type,'') = coalesce(pcm_stud_type.partner_value,''))
				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_fin_aid_app_complete_ind
				on (pcm_fin_aid_app_complete_ind.field_name = 'eab_fin_aid_app_complete_ind'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_application_complete_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_fin_aid_app_complete_ind.partner_value,''))

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_verification_ind
				on (pcm_verification_ind.field_name = 'eab_verification_ind'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.verification_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_verification_ind.partner_value,''))

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_verification_status
				on (pcm_verification_status.field_name = 'eab_verification_status'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.verification_status,'') = coalesce(pcm_verification_status.partner_value,''))

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_professional_judgement_ind
				on (pcm_professional_judgement_ind.field_name = 'eab_professional_judgement_ind'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.professional_judgement_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_professional_judgement_ind.partner_value,''))

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_pell_eligible_ind
				on (pcm_pell_eligible_ind.field_name = 'eab_pell_eligible_ind'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.pell_eligible_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_pell_eligible_ind.partner_value,''))

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_aid_package_complete_ind
				on (pcm_aid_package_complete_ind.field_name = 'eab_aid_package_complete_ind'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.aid_package_complete_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_aid_package_complete_ind.partner_value,''))

				/*left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_financial_sai
				on (pcm_financial_sai.field_name = 'eab_financial_sai'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,'') = coalesce(pcm_financial_sai.partner_value,''))

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_financial_need
				on (pcm_financial_need.field_name = 'eab_financial_need'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_need,'') = coalesce(pcm_financial_need.partner_value,''))*/

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_independent_ind
				on (pcm_independent_ind.field_name = 'eab_independent_ind'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_independent_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_independent_ind.partner_value,''))

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_fafsa_dependency
				on (pcm_fafsa_dependency.field_name = 'eab_fafsa_dependency'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_dependency_status,'') = coalesce(pcm_fafsa_dependency.partner_value,''))

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_expense_group
				on (pcm_expense_group.field_name = 'eab_expense_group_key'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.expense_group_key,'') = coalesce(pcm_expense_group.partner_value,''))

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_single_parent
				on (pcm_single_parent.field_name = 'eab_single_parent_ind'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.parent_marital_status,'') = coalesce(pcm_single_parent.partner_value,''))
																								
				<join_extension.Student Year Finaid Application>																	
																								
			) agg

		) agg2

		where agg2.rn = 1
		and <where_statement.eab_student_type>
		and coalesce(agg2.curr_entry_year_academic,'') ||
		coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.eab_fafsa_submitted_ind),'') ||
		coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.eab_fin_aid_award_sent_ind),'') ||
		coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.eab_css_profile_submitted_ind),'') ||
		coalesce(agg2.cost_of_attendance,'') ||
		coalesce(agg2.tuition,'') ||
		coalesce(agg2.tuition_and_fees,'') ||
		coalesce(agg2.fafsa_sai,'') ||

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-02-09: added normalization to row_number() fields, added eab_student_type to row_number() partition - ccreekman*/
/*2025-12-01: please note new variables <fao_calc.*> in bundle plus update to default <join_extension.Student Year Finaid Application> variable
ti_grant, tgrant have been added as fields in final but are not being sent to PDP at this time*/
/*2025-11-12: added new attributes for student_type, aid_application_indicator, expense_group_key (not being sent to PDP)
added logic and join for eab_student_type, updated partnercontact_id and partner_system_name references
updated left join to PCM for fafsa dependence to join on fafsa_dependency_status rather than eab_fafsa_dependency - ccreekman*/
/*2025-06-24: removed conversion case logic for eab_expense_group_key, switched to variable; added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-06-02: switched eab_financial_sai and eab_financial_need from try_to_numbers to CAST as DECIMAL*/
/*2025-04-25: changes from engineering master:
- eab_aid_app_ind: due to logic needs, changed to <eab_aid_app_ind> variable, rather than using fulfillment eab_aid_application_indicator field directly
- removed conversion case logic for eab_financial_sai, eab_financial_need. switched to relevant variables
- added case logic and left join to PCM for eab_expense_group_key 1:1 conversions
- added <join_extension.Student Year Finaid Application> join extension variable to allow for complex logic that pulls from other entity attributes (eg: <eab_aid_app_ind>)
*/

select * from
    (
	select distinct
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,

	agg2.fin_aid_award_sent_dt,

	agg2.total_attend_cost,
	agg2.cost_of_attendance,
	agg2.tuition,
	agg2.tuition_and_fees,
	agg2.fafsa_sai,
	agg2.fafsa_need,
	agg2.fafsa_student_sai,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_sai,
	agg2.fafsa_dependency_status,
	agg2.eab_fafsa_dependency,
	agg2.fafsa_student_net_worth,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_net_worth,
	agg2.fafsa_student_agi,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_agi,
	agg2.aid_package_status,
	agg2.aid_package_complete_ind,
	agg2.eab_aid_package_complete_ind,
	agg2.aid_review_status,
	agg2.fin_aid_app_status,
	agg2.fin_aid_app_complete_ind,
	agg2.eab_fin_aid_app_complete_ind,
	agg2.fin_aid_complete_dt,
	agg2.fafsa_student_farm,
	agg2.fafsa_student_bus,
	agg2.fafsa_student_cash,
	agg2.fafsa_student_invest,
	agg2.fafsa_student_bus_farm,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_farm,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_bus,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_cash,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_invest,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_bus_farm,
	agg2.verification_ind,
	agg2.eab_verification_ind,
	agg2.verification_status,
	agg2.eab_verification_status,
	agg2.current_fin_aid_award_sent_dt,
	agg2.number_of_award_letters,
	agg2.number_in_college,
	agg2.number_in_family,
	agg2.parent_marital_status,
	agg2.eab_single_parent_ind,
	agg2.fafsa_student_wages,
	agg2.fafsa_student_salary,
	agg2.fafsa_student_income,
	agg2.fafsa_student_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_wages,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_salary,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_income,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,
	agg2.par1_grade_level,
	agg2.par2_grade_level,
	agg2.fafsa_change_dt,
	agg2.housing_app_status,
	agg2.tuition_residency,
	agg2.professional_judgement_ind,
	agg2.eab_professional_judgement_ind,
	agg2.pell_eligible_ind,
	agg2.eab_pell_eligible_ind,
	agg2.appeal_ind,
	agg2.eab_appeal_ind,
	agg2.css_profile_sai,
	agg2.css_profile_need,
	agg2.css_profile_stu_sai,
	agg2.css_profile_par_sai,
	agg2.aid_app_ind, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
	agg2.ti_grant, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
	agg2.tgrant, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
	agg2.eab_aid_app_ind,
	agg2.eab_financial_sai,
	agg2.eab_financial_need,
	agg2.expense_group_key, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
	agg2.eab_expense_group_key,
	agg2.eab_independent_ind,
	agg2.intake_dt

        from (
			select agg.*,
			row_number() over (partition by 
				nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''), 
				nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''), 
				agg.eab_student_type, agg.eab_entry_year_academic
			order by agg.partnercontact_id nulls last, agg.partner_system_name nulls last, agg.intake_dt desc nulls last --not present in new data specs
            ) rn

			from (

				select distinct
				stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_student_id,
				lower(regexp_replace(stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_student_id_type,'[\\s]','')) as eab_student_id_type,
				<partnercontact_id.sis_fao.Student Year Finaid Application> as partnercontact_id,
				lower(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.sis_fao.Student Year Finaid Application>,'[\\s]','')) as partner_system_name,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.current_entry_year_as_academic_year as curr_entry_year_academic,
			  	stud_yr_fin_aid.student_type,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.intent_to_file_for_financial_aid_indicator as fin_aid_intent_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_submitted as FAFSA_submitted_ind,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_submitted_date,1,19)) as FAFSA_submitted_dt,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.first_fafsa_submitted_date,1,19)) as first_FAFSA_submitted_dt,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.most_recent_fafsa_submitted_date,1,19)) as current_FAFSA_submitted_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_award_sent_indicator as fin_aid_award_sent_ind,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_award_sent_date,1,19)) as fin_aid_award_sent_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_submitted_indicator as css_profile_submitted_ind,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_submitted_date,1,19)) as css_profile_submitted_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.cost_of_attendance as cost_of_attendance,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.total_attend_cost,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.tuition,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.tuition_and_fees,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_need,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_sai,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_sai,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_dependency_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_net_worth,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_net_worth,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_agi,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_agi,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.aid_package_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.aid_package_complete_indicator as aid_package_complete_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.aid_review_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_application_status as fin_aid_app_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_application_complete_indicator as fin_aid_app_complete_ind,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_complete_date,1,19)) as fin_aid_complete_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_farm,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_business as fafsa_student_bus,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_cash,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_invest,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_business_farm as fafsa_student_bus_farm,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_farm,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_business as fafsa_parent_bus,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_cash,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_invest,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_business_farm as fafsa_parent_bus_farm,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.verification_indicator as verification_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.verification_status,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.current_financial_aid_award_sent_date,1,19)) as current_fin_aid_award_sent_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.number_of_award_letters,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.number_in_college,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.number_in_family,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.parent_marital_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_wages,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_salary,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_income,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_adjusted_business_farm_equity as fafsa_student_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_wages,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_salary,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_income,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_adjusted_business_farm_equity as fafsa_parent_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.parent_1_grade_level as par1_grade_level,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.parent_2_grade_level as par2_grade_level,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_change_date,1,19)) as fafsa_change_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.housing_application_status as housing_app_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.tuition_residency,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.professional_judgement_indicator as professional_judgement_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.pell_eligible_indicator as pell_eligible_ind,

				stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_parent_sai as css_profile_par_sai,	
				calc_grants.ti_grant,

				case when pcm_fin_aid_app_complete_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'

				end as eab_fin_aid_app_complete_ind,

				case when pcm_verification_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_verification_ind.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_verification_ind,

				case when pcm_verification_status.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else pcm_verification_status.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_verification_status,
				
				case when pcm_professional_judgement_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else pcm_professional_judgement_ind.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_professional_judgement_ind,

				<fao_calc.eab_pell_eligible_ind> as eab_pell_eligible_ind,

				/*case when pcm_pell_eligible_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_pell_eligible_ind.eab_standard_value)
				end*/

				case when pcm_aid_package_complete_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_aid_package_complete_ind.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_aid_package_complete_ind,

				stud_yr_fin_aid.aid_application_indicator as aid_app_ind,
				<eab_aid_app_ind> as eab_aid_app_ind,

				/*edited logic to convert fulfillment value directly*/														 
				CAST(<eab_financial_sai> as DECIMAL (12,2)) as eab_financial_sai,

				/*edited logic to convert fulfillment value directly*/	
				CAST(<eab_financial_need>  as DECIMAL (12,2)) as eab_financial_need,
				
				stud_yr_fin_aid.expense_group_key,

				case when pcm_independent_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'

				else try_to_boolean(pcm_independent_ind.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_independent_ind,

				case when pcm_fafsa_dependency.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else pcm_fafsa_dependency.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_fafsa_dependency,

				case when pcm_css_profile.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'

				case when pcm_stud_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then 'Unknown'
				else pcm_stud_type.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_student_type,

				case when pcm_single_parent.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then try_to_boolean(false)
				else try_to_boolean(pcm_single_parent.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_single_parent_ind,

				stud_yr_fin_aid.intake_dt

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_verification_status

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_professional_judgement_ind

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_pell_eligible_ind

				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.pell_eligible_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_pell_eligible_ind.partner_value,''))

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_aid_package_complete_ind

				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.aid_package_complete_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_aid_package_complete_ind.partner_value,''))

				/*left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_financial_sai
				on (pcm_financial_sai.field_name = 'eab_financial_sai'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,'') = coalesce(pcm_financial_sai.partner_value,''))

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_financial_need

				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_need,'') = coalesce(pcm_financial_need.partner_value,''))*/

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_independent_ind
				on (pcm_independent_ind.field_name = 'eab_independent_ind'
				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_independent_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_independent_ind.partner_value,''))

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_fafsa_dependency

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_expense_group

				<join_extension.Student Year Finaid Application>																	
																								
			) agg

		where agg2.rn = 1

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
/*2025-07-16: updated partnercontact fields to pull primary ID - ccreekman*/
/*2025-06-24: removed conversion case logic for eab_expense_group_key, switched to variable; added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-06-02: switched eab_financial_sai and eab_financial_need from try_to_numbers to CAST as DECIMAL*/
/*2025-04-25: changes from engineering master:
- eab_aid_app_ind: due to logic needs, changed to <eab_aid_app_ind> variable, rather than using fulfillment eab_aid_application_indicator field directly
- removed conversion case logic for eab_financial_sai, eab_financial_need. switched to relevant variables
- added case logic and left join to PCM for eab_expense_group_key 1:1 conversions
- added <join_extension.Student Year Finaid Application> join extension variable to allow for complex logic that pulls from other entity attributes (eg: <eab_aid_app_ind>)
*/

select * from
    (
	select distinct
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id,syf.eab_student_id),'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name,syf.eab_student_id_type),'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,
	agg2.eab_entry_year_academic,
	agg2.curr_entry_year_academic,
	agg2.fin_aid_intent_ind,
	agg2.FAFSA_submitted_ind,
	agg2.eab_fafsa_submitted_ind,

	agg2.css_profile_submitted_dt,
	agg2.total_attend_cost,
	agg2.cost_of_attendance,
	agg2.tuition,
	agg2.tuition_and_fees,
	agg2.fafsa_sai,
	agg2.fafsa_need,
	agg2.fafsa_student_sai,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_sai,
	agg2.fafsa_dependency_status,
	agg2.eab_fafsa_dependency,
	agg2.fafsa_student_net_worth,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_net_worth,
	agg2.fafsa_student_agi,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_agi,
	agg2.aid_package_status,
	agg2.aid_package_complete_ind,
	agg2.eab_aid_package_complete_ind,
	agg2.aid_review_status,
	agg2.fin_aid_app_status,
	agg2.fin_aid_app_complete_ind,
	agg2.eab_fin_aid_app_complete_ind,
	agg2.fin_aid_complete_dt,
	agg2.fafsa_student_farm,
	agg2.fafsa_student_bus,
	agg2.fafsa_student_cash,
	agg2.fafsa_student_invest,
	agg2.fafsa_student_bus_farm,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_farm,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_bus,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_cash,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_invest,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_bus_farm,
	agg2.verification_ind,
	agg2.eab_verification_ind,
	agg2.verification_status,
	agg2.eab_verification_status,
	agg2.current_fin_aid_award_sent_dt,
	agg2.number_of_award_letters,
	agg2.number_in_college,
	agg2.number_in_family,
	agg2.parent_marital_status,
	agg2.fafsa_student_wages,
	agg2.fafsa_student_salary,
	agg2.fafsa_student_income,
	agg2.fafsa_student_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_wages,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_salary,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_income,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,
	agg2.par1_grade_level,
	agg2.par2_grade_level,
	agg2.fafsa_change_dt,
	agg2.housing_app_status,
	agg2.tuition_residency,
	agg2.professional_judgement_ind,
	agg2.eab_professional_judgement_ind,
	agg2.pell_eligible_ind,
	agg2.eab_pell_eligible_ind,
	agg2.appeal_ind,
	agg2.eab_appeal_ind,
	agg2.css_profile_sai,
	agg2.css_profile_need,
	agg2.css_profile_stu_sai,

	agg2.eab_financial_sai,
	agg2.eab_financial_need,
	agg2.eab_expense_group_key,
	agg2.eab_independent_ind,
	agg2.intake_dt

        from (
			select agg.*,
			row_number() over (partition by agg.eab_student_id,
			agg.eab_student_id_type,
			agg.eab_entry_year_academic
			order by agg.eab_student_id nulls last, agg.eab_student_id_type nulls last --not present in new data specs
            ) rn

			from (

				select distinct

				stud_yr_fin_aid.intent_to_file_for_financial_aid_indicator as fin_aid_intent_ind,

				stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_award_sent_indicator as fin_aid_award_sent_ind,

				stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_submitted_indicator as css_profile_submitted_ind,

				stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_student_id as eab_student_id,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_student_id_type as eab_student_id_type,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.tuition,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.tuition_and_fees,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_need,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_sai,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_sai,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_dependency_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_net_worth,

				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_agi,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.aid_package_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.aid_package_complete_indicator as aid_package_complete_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.aid_review_status,

				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_complete_date,1,19)) as fin_aid_complete_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_farm,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_business as fafsa_student_bus,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_cash,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_invest,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_business_farm as fafsa_student_bus_farm,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_farm,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_business as fafsa_parent_bus,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_cash,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_invest,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_business_farm as fafsa_parent_bus_farm,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.verification_indicator as verification_ind,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.verification_status,
				try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.current_financial_aid_award_sent_date,1,19)) as current_fin_aid_award_sent_dt,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.number_of_award_letters,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.number_in_college,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.number_in_family,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.parent_marital_status,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_wages,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_salary,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_income,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_student_adjusted_business_farm_equity as fafsa_student_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_wages,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_salary,

				stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_adjusted_business_farm_equity as fafsa_parent_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,

				left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_aid_package_complete_ind

				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,'') = coalesce(pcm_financial_sai.partner_value,''))

				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_fafsa_dependency,'') = coalesce(pcm_fafsa_dependency.partner_value,''))

				/*left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_expense_group

				and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_expense_group_key,'') = coalesce(pcm_expense_group.partner_value,''))*/
																								
				<join_extension.Student Year Finaid Application>																	
																								
			) agg

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
/*2025-07-17: testing id xwalk edits - ccreekman*/
/*2025-06-24: removed conversion case logic for eab_expense_group_key, switched to variable; added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-06-02: switched eab_financial_sai and eab_financial_need from try_to_numbers to CAST as DECIMAL*/
/*2025-04-25: changes from engineering master:
- eab_aid_app_ind: due to logic needs, changed to <eab_aid_app_ind> variable, rather than using fulfillment eab_aid_application_indicator field directly
- removed conversion case logic for eab_financial_sai, eab_financial_need. switched to relevant variables
- added case logic and left join to PCM for eab_expense_group_key 1:1 conversions
- added <join_extension.Student Year Finaid Application> join extension variable to allow for complex logic that pulls from other entity attributes (eg: <eab_aid_app_ind>)
*/

select * from
    (
	select distinct
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,
	agg2.eab_entry_year_academic,
	agg2.curr_entry_year_academic,
	agg2.fin_aid_intent_ind,
	agg2.FAFSA_submitted_ind,
	agg2.eab_fafsa_submitted_ind,
	agg2.FAFSA_submitted_dt,
	agg2.first_FAFSA_submitted_dt,
	agg2.current_FAFSA_submitted_dt,
	agg2.fin_aid_award_sent_ind,
	agg2.eab_fin_aid_award_sent_ind,
	agg2.fin_aid_award_sent_dt,
	agg2.css_profile_submitted_ind,
	agg2.eab_css_profile_submitted_ind,
	agg2.css_profile_submitted_dt,
	agg2.total_attend_cost,
	agg2.cost_of_attendance,
	agg2.tuition,
	agg2.tuition_and_fees,
	agg2.fafsa_sai,
	agg2.fafsa_need,
	agg2.fafsa_student_sai,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_sai,
	agg2.fafsa_dependency_status,
	agg2.eab_fafsa_dependency,
	agg2.fafsa_student_net_worth,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_net_worth,
	agg2.fafsa_student_agi,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_agi,
	agg2.aid_package_status,
	agg2.aid_package_complete_ind,
	agg2.eab_aid_package_complete_ind,
	agg2.aid_review_status,
	agg2.fin_aid_app_status,
	agg2.fin_aid_app_complete_ind,
	agg2.eab_fin_aid_app_complete_ind,
	agg2.fin_aid_complete_dt,
	agg2.fafsa_student_farm,
	agg2.fafsa_student_bus,
	agg2.fafsa_student_cash,
	agg2.fafsa_student_invest,
	agg2.fafsa_student_bus_farm,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_farm,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_bus,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_cash,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_invest,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_bus_farm,
	agg2.verification_ind,
	agg2.eab_verification_ind,
	agg2.verification_status,
	agg2.eab_verification_status,
	agg2.current_fin_aid_award_sent_dt,
	agg2.number_of_award_letters,
	agg2.number_in_college,
	agg2.number_in_family,
	agg2.parent_marital_status,
	agg2.fafsa_student_wages,
	agg2.fafsa_student_salary,
	agg2.fafsa_student_income,
	agg2.fafsa_student_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_wages,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_salary,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_income,
	agg2.fafsa_parent_adjusted_bus_farm_eqty,
	agg2.par1_grade_level,
	agg2.par2_grade_level,
	agg2.fafsa_change_dt,
	agg2.housing_app_status,
	agg2.tuition_residency,
	agg2.professional_judgement_ind,
	agg2.eab_professional_judgement_ind,
	agg2.pell_eligible_ind,
	agg2.eab_pell_eligible_ind,
	agg2.appeal_ind,
	agg2.eab_appeal_ind,
	agg2.css_profile_sai,
	agg2.css_profile_need,
	agg2.css_profile_stu_sai,
	agg2.css_profile_par_sai,
	agg2.eab_aid_app_ind,
	agg2.eab_financial_sai,
	agg2.eab_financial_need,
	agg2.eab_expense_group_key,
	agg2.eab_independent_ind,
	agg2.intake_dt

        from (
			select agg.*,
			row_number() over (partition by agg.eab_student_id,
			agg.eab_student_id_type,
			agg.eab_entry_year_academic
			order by agg.eab_student_id nulls last, agg.eab_student_id_type nulls last --not present in new data specs
            ) rn

			from (

				select distinct
				stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_student_id as eab_student_id,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_student_id_type as eab_student_id_type,
				coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id,stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_student_id) as partnercontact_id,
				case when id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id is not null 
			  		then id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name
			  		else stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_student_id_type 
			  		end as partner_system_name,
			    stud_yr_fin_aid.current_entry_year_as_academic_year as curr_entry_year_academic,
				stud_yr_fin_aid.intent_to_file_for_financial_aid_indicator as fin_aid_intent_ind,

		coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.total_attend_cost),'') <> ''
	) agg3
where coalesce(agg3.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(agg3.partner_system_name,'') <> ''
