queryResults.queryKey: Enroll360/Student Year Finaid Application/INACTIVE_DataOrgPilot.Enroll360.Student Year Finaid Application.pell_calculations
queryResults.sqlPreview: /*2025-11-17: master created, switched to master - ccreekman*/ /*2025-09-22: not set up for 2023 and prior, validated on U of Denver 2024, 2025 data - ccreekman…
queryResults.querySql:
/*2025-11-17: master created, switched to master - ccreekman*/
/*2025-09-22: not set up for 2023 and prior, validated on U of Denver 2024, 2025 data - ccreekman*/
/*query pulls SYFA data and creates calculated fields used to determine if a student should receive an imputed pell award and the amount.
this query returns a calculated pell award even if the student has pell awards in Student Year Funds
redundant imputed awards are filtered out in later query: DataOrgPilot.Enroll360.Student Year Funds.final.pell_impute 
for U of Denver, this table is referenced to calculate negative adjustment awards for special fund category NBGiftInstOnly - ccreekman*/

select * from (

select distinct stud_yr_fin_aid.*,
  case when coalesce(to_decimal(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,18,2),0)>= peb.budget then true else false end as im_waiver,
  <pell_calc.impute_pell_switch> as impute_pell_switch,
  to_decimal(<pell_calc.poverty_guideline>,18,2) as poverty_guideline,

  to_decimal(pell_amt.max_value,18,2) as pell_max,
  to_decimal(pell_amt.min_value,18,2) as pell_min,

  case when stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_single_parent_ind = true 
  	then to_decimal(pell_single_par_perc.max_value,3,2)
  	else to_decimal(pell_not_single_par_perc.max_value,3,2) end as pell_perc_max,
  case when stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_single_parent_ind = true 
  	then to_decimal(pell_single_par_perc.min_value,3,2)
  	else to_decimal(pell_not_single_par_perc.min_value,3,2) end as pell_perc_min,

  case when coalesce(poverty_guideline,0) = 0
	or coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_sai,0) = 1
	or coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_agi,'') = ''
	then false
	when to_decimal(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_agi,18,2) between 0.01 and (poverty_guideline * pell_perc_max) then true else false end as eligible_for_max_pell_ind, 
  case when coalesce(poverty_guideline,0) = 0
	or coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_sai,0) = 1
  	or eligible_for_max_pell_ind = true
	or coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_agi,'') = ''
	then false
	when try_to_decimal(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_parent_agi,18,2) <= (poverty_guideline * pell_perc_min) then true else false end as eligible_for_min_pell_ind,

  case when to_decimal(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,18,2) = to_decimal(min_sai.min_value,18,2) then pell_max
  	when impute_pell_switch = 'AGI' and eligible_for_max_pell_ind = true then pell_max
  	else 0 end as eligible_pell_amount_max,
  case when eligible_pell_amount_max > 0 then 0
  	when impute_pell_switch = 'AGI' and eligible_for_min_pell_ind = true then pell_min
  	else 0 end as eligible_pell_amount_min,

  case when (im_waiver = false and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_sai,'') = '') OR coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,'') = ''  then 0
  	when (eligible_pell_amount_max + eligible_pell_amount_min) > 0 then (eligible_pell_amount_max + eligible_pell_amount_min)
	when (pell_max - greatest(0,to_decimal(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,18,2))) <= pell_min then 0 
	else (pell_max - greatest(0,to_decimal(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,18,2))) end as calculated_pell,

  case when co_stud.eab_student_id is not null
	and stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_entry_year_academic = 2025
	and nbgifts.total_award_amount > 0
	and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_sai,'') <> ''
	and least(try_to_number(fafsa_sai),999999) <5712
	then 5000 else 0 end as state_impute,

  row_number() over(partition by stud_yr_fin_aid.partnercontact_id, stud_yr_fin_aid.partner_system_name, stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_student_type,  stud_yr_fin_aid.eab_entry_year_academic
	order by stud_yr_fin_aid.intake_dt desc nulls last) rn
																																		

from <[Enroll360].[Student Year Finaid Application].{final}> as stud_yr_fin_aid

<pell_calc.join_extension>
										   
where <pell_calc.where_statement>

)agg
where agg.rn = 1 
--and eab_student_id = '873730668'							  
order by agg.partnercontact_id, agg.rn, agg.intake_dt

queryResults.sqlPreview: WITH latest_applications AS ( SELECT app_ranked.id AS id, app_ranked.prospect_id AS prospect_id, app_ranked.updated_at AS updated_at, app_ranked.created_at AS c…
queryResults.querySql:
WITH
latest_applications AS (
    SELECT
        app_ranked.id AS id,
        app_ranked.prospect_id AS prospect_id,
        app_ranked.updated_at AS updated_at,
        app_ranked.created_at AS created_at,
        app_ranked.student_type AS student_type,
        app_ranked.entry_year AS entry_year,
        app_ranked.sis_student_id AS sis_student_id,
        app_ranked.financial_aid_intent_indicator AS financial_aid_intent_indicator
    FROM (
        SELECT
            app_src.id AS id,
            app_src.prospect_id AS prospect_id,
            app_src.updated_at AS updated_at,
            app_src.created_at AS created_at,
            app_src.student_type AS student_type,
            app_src.entry_year AS entry_year,
            app_src.sis_student_id AS sis_student_id,
            app_src.financial_aid_intent_indicator AS financial_aid_intent_indicator,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY app_src.prospect_id
                ORDER BY TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(app_src.updated_at) DESC NULLS LAST,
                TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(app_src.created_at) DESC NULLS LAST,
                TO_VARCHAR(app_src.id) DESC
            ) AS application_row_num
        FROM <[ECRM].[Applications].{fulfillment}> AS app_src
    ) AS app_ranked
    WHERE app_ranked.application_row_num = 1
)
SELECT
	null as CSS_PROFILE_SUBMITTED_DATE,
	null as CSS_PROFILE_SUBMITTED_EAB,
	null as CSS_PROFILE_SUBMITTED_INDICATOR,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_1,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_2,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_3,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_4,
	null as CALCULATED_FIELD_5,
	null as CALCULATED_ID_FIELD,
	null as COST_OF_ATTENDANCE,
	COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.entry_year)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.entry_year)), '')) as CURRENT_ENTRY_YEAR_AS_ACADEMIC_YEAR,
	null as ENTRY_YEAR_AS_ACADEMIC_YEAR_EAB,
	null as FAFSA_SUBMITTED,
	null as FAFSA_SUBMITTED_DATE,
	null as FAFSA_SUBMITTED_EAB,
	null as FINANCIAL_AID_AWARD_SENT_DATE,
	null as FINANCIAL_AID_AWARD_SENT_INDICATOR,
	null as FINANCIAL_AID_AWARD_SENT_INDICATOR_EAB,
	COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.sis_student_id)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.sis_student_id)), '')) as FINANCIAL_AID_STUDENT_ID,
	null as FIRST_FAFSA_SUBMITTED_DATE,
	p.intake_date as INTAKE_DATE,
	COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.financial_aid_intent_indicator)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.scholarships_financial_aid_info_ind)), '')) as INTENT_TO_FILE_FOR_FINANCIAL_AID_INDICATOR,
	null as MERIT_AWARDS,
	null as MOST_RECENT_FAFSA_SUBMITTED_DATE,
	null as NEED_AWARDS,
	'navigate_crm_1' as PARTNER_SYSTEM_NAME,
	null as POPULATION_NAME,
	COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.prospect_id)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.id)), '')) as PRIMARY_STUDENT_ID,
	COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(la.student_type)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(TO_VARCHAR(p.prospect_type)), '')) as STUDENT_TYPE,
	null as STUDENT_TYPE_EAB,
	null as TOTAL_AWARD_AMOUNT,
	null as UNMET_NEED_AMOUNT,
	null as WORK_STUDY_AMOUNT
FROM <[ECRM].[Prospects].{fulfillment}> AS p
LEFT JOIN latest_applications AS la
    ON la.prospect_id = p.id
<student_year_financial_aid_join_extension>

/*2026-02-10: normalization added to ID fields in row_number() deduping logic, adding partner system name functionality, variables 
custom joins move to <join_extension.Student Year Financial Aid> - ccreekman*/
/*2025-08-04: tenant audit - left join to Student to bring in FA ID + inner join to limit population
added variables: <join_extension.Student Year Financial Aid>, <where_statement.eab_student_type>, 
default Freshman criteria moved to <where_statement.eab_student_type>
added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-05-16: added eab_student_id, eab_student_id_type*/
/*2024-02-01: mixed 13 file + object set up*/

select distinct * from (

select distinct
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.primary_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as primary_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id,
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg2.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name,
agg2.student_type,
agg2.curr_entry_year_academic,
agg2.fin_aid_student_id,
agg2.fin_aid_intent_ind,
agg2.FAFSA_submitted_ind,
agg2.FAFSA_submitted_dt,
agg2.first_FAFSA_submitted_dt,
agg2.current_FAFSA_submitted_dt,
agg2.fin_aid_award_sent_ind,
agg2.fin_aid_award_sent_dt,
agg2.css_profile_submitted_ind,
agg2.css_profile_submitted_dt,
agg2.merit_awards,
agg2.need_awards,
agg2.total_award_amt,
agg2.total_attend_cost,
agg2.unmet_need_amt,
agg2.work_study_amt,
agg2.eab_css_profile_submitted_ind,
agg2.eab_FAFSA_submitted_ind,
agg2.eab_fin_aid_award_sent_ind,
agg2.eab_entry_year_academic,
agg2.eab_student_type,
agg2.intake_dt

from (

select agg.*,
row_number() over (partition by 
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''),  
		nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''),
		agg.eab_student_type, agg.eab_entry_year_academic
	order by agg.fin_aid_student_id nulls last, agg.intake_dt desc nulls last) rn

from (

select distinct 
stud_yr_fin_aid.primary_student_id,
stud_yr_fin_aid.primary_student_id as eab_student_id,
lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.partner_system_name,'primary'),'[\\s]','')) as eab_student_id_type,
<partnercontact_id.crm_ug> as partnercontact_id,
lower(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.crm_ug>,'[\\s]','')) as partner_system_name,

stud_yr_fin_aid.student_type,
stud_yr_fin_aid.current_entry_year_as_academic_year as curr_entry_year_academic,
f1.SIS_STUDENT_ID as fin_aid_student_id,

stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_submitted as FAFSA_submitted_ind,

try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.most_recent_fafsa_submitted_date,1,19)) as current_FAFSA_submitted_dt,
stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_award_sent_indicator as fin_aid_award_sent_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_award_sent_date,1,19)) as fin_aid_award_sent_dt,
stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_submitted_indicator as css_profile_submitted_ind,
try_to_timestamp(substring(stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_submitted_date,1,19)) as css_profile_submitted_dt,
stud_yr_fin_aid.merit_awards,
stud_yr_fin_aid.need_awards,
try_to_decimal(stud_yr_fin_aid.total_award_amount,10,2) as total_award_amt,
try_to_decimal(stud_yr_fin_aid.cost_of_attendance,10,2) as total_attend_cost,
try_to_decimal(stud_yr_fin_aid.unmet_need_amount,10,2) as unmet_need_amt,
stud_yr_fin_aid.work_study_amount as work_study_amt,

case when pcm_css_profile.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_css_profile.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_css_profile_submitted_ind,

case when pcm_fafsa_sub.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null

end as eab_FAFSA_submitted_ind,

case when pcm_fa_award_sent.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_boolean(pcm_fa_award_sent.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_fin_aid_award_sent_ind,

case when pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then null
else try_to_number(pcm_entry_year.eab_standard_value)
end as eab_entry_year_academic,

case when pcm_stud_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
then 'Unknown'
else pcm_stud_type.eab_standard_value
end as eab_student_type,

stud_yr_fin_aid.intake_date as intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student Year Financial Aid].{fulfillment}> as stud_yr_fin_aid

--custom joins moved to join extension						   
						   
left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_css_profile
on (pcm_css_profile.field_name = 'eab_css_profile_submitted_ind'
and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.css_profile_submitted_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_css_profile.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_fafsa_sub
on (pcm_fafsa_sub.field_name = 'eab_FAFSA_submitted_ind'
and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.fafsa_submitted,'') = coalesce(pcm_fafsa_sub.partner_value,''))

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_fa_award_sent
on (pcm_fa_award_sent.field_name = 'eab_fin_aid_award_sent_ind'
and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.financial_aid_award_sent_indicator,'') = coalesce(pcm_fa_award_sent.partner_value,''))

/*moved to join extension for correct order of operations*/
/*left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_entry_year
on (pcm_entry_year.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic'
and substring(pt.calculated_field_11,1,4) = coalesce(pcm_entry_year.partner_value,''))*/
													
left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert}> pcm_stud_type
on (pcm_stud_type.field_name = 'eab_student_type'
and coalesce(stud_yr_fin_aid.student_type,'') = coalesce(pcm_stud_type.partner_value,''))

<join_extension.Student Year Financial Aid>

where <where_statement>

) agg

) agg2

where agg2.rn = 1

and <where_statement.eab_student_type>

and coalesce(agg2.fin_aid_student_id,'') ||
coalesce(agg2.fin_aid_intent_ind,'') ||
coalesce(agg2.FAFSA_submitted_ind,'') ||
coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.FAFSA_submitted_dt),'') ||
coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.first_FAFSA_submitted_dt),'') ||
coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.current_FAFSA_submitted_dt),'') ||
coalesce(agg2.fin_aid_award_sent_ind,'') ||
coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.fin_aid_award_sent_dt),'') ||
coalesce(agg2.css_profile_submitted_ind,'') ||
coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.css_profile_submitted_dt),'') ||
coalesce(agg2.merit_awards,'') ||
coalesce(agg2.need_awards,'') ||
coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.total_award_amt),'') ||
coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.total_attend_cost),'') ||
coalesce(to_varchar(agg2.unmet_need_amt),'') ||
coalesce(agg2.work_study_amt,'') <> ''

) agg3
where coalesce(agg3.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
and coalesce(agg3.partner_system_name,'') <> ''

Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. queryResults.sqlPreview: /*2026-07-31: archived for reference. New Master uses Student Term as base.*/ /*2025-11-14: testing partner system name functionality, variables - ccreekman*/ /…
queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-07-31: archived for reference. New Master uses Student Term as base.*/
/*2025-11-14: testing partner system name functionality, variables - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-07: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-04-25: all changes from engineering master:
- eab_entry_year_academic: added standard case logic for year conversion
- eab_fund_amount: updated to be populated by variable which will contain custom partner logic
- eab_fund_date: updated to be populated by variable which will contain custom partner logic
- eab_discount_ind: updated per engineering instruction that 'Unknown' is not acceptable value as field needs to be boolean
- fund left joins: edited to connect unconverted fund_type field instead of eab_fund_type
- added left join for eab_entry_year_academic conversions
- added <join_extension.Student Year Funds> for any additional custom partner joins*/

/*2025-03-14: corrected case logic for eab_discount_ind to output null instead of 'Unknown' to work with boolean values - ccreekman*/
/*2025-01-14: edited master code for eab_fund_amount, eab_fund_date, and eab_entry_year_academic as they were pulling
from fulfillment rather than standardizing relevant data. 
Also changed predicand for eab_fund_date, as written in Master, SQL could not execute*/

WITH funds_data AS (
    SELECT distinct * FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
			nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id
		  , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id_type,'[\\s]','')),'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type
		  , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(<partnercontact_id.sis_fao.Student Year Funds>,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id
		  , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(lower(regexp_replace(<partner_system_name.sis_fao.Student Year Funds>,'[\\s]','')),'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name

          , case when pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else to_number(pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value)
				end as eab_entry_year_academic

          , syf.current_entry_year_academic AS curr_entry_year_academic

		  , case when pcm_stud_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
			then 'Unknown'
			else pcm_stud_type.eab_standard_value
			end as eab_student_type  /*not passed to PDP currently*/

		  , syf.student_type /*not passed to PDP currently*/
 
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.fund_code,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS fund_code
          , syf.offered_amount AS offered_amt
          , CAST(syf.offered_date AS timestamp) AS offered_dt
          , syf.accept_amount AS accept_amt
          , CAST(syf.accept_date AS timestamp) AS accept_dt
          , syf.cancel_amount AS cancel_amt
          , CAST(syf.cancel_date AS timestamp) AS cancel_dt
          , syf.declined_amount AS declined_amt
          , CAST(syf.declined_date AS timestamp) AS declined_dt
          , syf.fund_name AS fund_name
          , syf.fund_type AS fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value
				END AS eab_fund_type      					
		  , CAST(<eab_fund_amount> AS decimal (10,2)) as eab_fund_amount		
          , CAST(<eab_fund_date> AS date) AS eab_fund_date
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.eab_standard_value 
				END AS eab_simulation_fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.eab_standard_value 
				END AS eab_cohort_fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.eab_standard_value
				END AS eab_summary_fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN null
				ELSE CAST(pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value AS Boolean)
				END AS eab_discount_ind
          , CAST(syf.intake_dt AS timestamp) AS intake_dt
        FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{fulfillment}> AS syf   
											   
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_simulation_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_cohort_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_summary_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_summary_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_discount_ind
                     ON (pcm_eab_discount_ind.field_name = 'eab_discount_ind'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_discount_ind.partner_value,''))
		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_entry_year_academic
					on (pcm_entry_year_academic.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic'
					and coalesce(syf.current_entry_year_academic,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_year_academic.partner_value,''))
		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_stud_type
					on (pcm_stud_type.field_name = 'eab_student_type'
					and coalesce(syf.student_type,'') = coalesce(pcm_stud_type.partner_value,''))


		<join_extension.Student Year Funds>
    ) sq
	where coalesce(sq.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
	and coalesce(sq.partner_system_name,'') <> ''
	AND COALESCE(sq.eab_fund_type,'')<>''
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    eab_student_id
  , eab_student_id_type
  , partnercontact_id
  , partner_system_name
  , eab_entry_year_academic
  , curr_entry_year_academic
  , eab_student_type /*not passed to PDP currently*/
  , student_type /*not passed to PDP currently*/
  , fund_code  
  , offered_amt
  , offered_dt
  , accept_amt
  , accept_dt
  , cancel_amt
  , cancel_dt
  , declined_amt
  , declined_dt
  , fund_name
  , fund_type
  , eab_fund_type
  , eab_fund_amount
  , eab_fund_date
  , eab_simulation_fund_type
  , eab_cohort_fund_type
  , eab_summary_fund_type
  , eab_discount_ind
  , intake_dt
FROM funds_data
where 1=1

/*2026-08-04: v1 DataOrgPilot version is archived in University of Denver-FAO Pilot space
this and Enroll360.Student Year Funds.final are aligned at this time
note several output fields do not pass to pdp_ug at this time*/

SELECT 
agg2.eab_student_id,
agg2.eab_student_id_type,
agg2.partnercontact_id,
agg2.partner_system_name,
agg2.eab_entry_year_academic,
agg2.curr_entry_year_academic,
agg2.eab_student_type, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
agg2.student_type, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
agg2.fund_code,
agg2.offered_amt,
agg2.offered_dt,
agg2.accept_amt,
agg2.accept_dt,
agg2.cancel_amt,
agg2.cancel_dt,
agg2.declined_amt,
agg2.declined_dt,
agg2.fund_name,
agg2.fund_type,
agg2.eab_fund_type,
agg2.eab_fund_amount,
agg2.eab_fund_date,
agg2.eab_simulation_fund_type,
agg2.eab_cohort_fund_type,
agg2.eab_summary_fund_type,
agg2.eab_discount_ind,
agg2.intake_dt
from (
	select agg.*,
	row_number() over (partition by 
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''), 
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''), 
	agg.eab_entry_year_academic, agg.fund_code
	order by agg.intake_dt desc nulls last, agg.eab_fund_amount desc nulls last, agg.eab_student_type
	) rn

from (
select distinct 
/*Student Term Fields*/
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_term.eab_student_id, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as eab_student_id,  
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_term.eab_student_id_type, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as eab_student_id_type, 
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_term.partnercontact_id, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as partnercontact_id,  
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_term.partner_system_name, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as partner_system_name, 
stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,
stud_term.curr_entry_year_academic,
stud_term.eab_student_type,/*not passed to PDP currently*/
stud_term.student_type,/*not passed to PDP currently*/

nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.fund_code,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS fund_code,
syf.offered_amount AS offered_amt,
CAST(syf.offered_date AS timestamp) AS offered_dt,
syf.accept_amount AS accept_amt,
CAST(syf.accept_date AS timestamp) AS accept_dt,
syf.cancel_amount AS cancel_amt,
CAST(syf.cancel_date AS timestamp) AS cancel_dt,
syf.declined_amount AS declined_amt,
CAST(syf.declined_date AS timestamp) AS declined_dt,
syf.fund_name AS fund_name,
syf.fund_type AS fund_type,

CASE WHEN pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
ELSE pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value
END AS eab_fund_type,

CAST(<eab_fund_amount> as DECIMAL (18,2)) AS eab_fund_amount,
CAST(<eab_fund_date> as DATE) AS eab_fund_date,

CASE WHEN pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' 
THEN 'Unknown'
ELSE pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.eab_standard_value
END AS eab_simulation_fund_type,

CASE WHEN pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' 
THEN 'Unknown'
ELSE pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.eab_standard_value
END AS eab_cohort_fund_type,

CASE WHEN pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' 
THEN 'Unknown'
ELSE pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.eab_standard_value
END AS eab_summary_fund_type,

CASE WHEN pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN null
ELSE try_to_boolean(pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value)
END AS eab_discount_ind,

syf.intake_dt AS intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].{final}> stud_term

<join_extension.Student Year Funds>

) agg
WHERE COALESCE(agg.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
AND COALESCE(agg.partner_system_name,'') <> ''
AND COALESCE(agg.eab_fund_type,'') <> ''

) agg2
where rn = 1

/*2025-07-16: updated partnercontact fields to pull primary ID - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-07: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-04-25: all changes from engineering master:
- eab_entry_year_academic: added standard case logic for year conversion
- eab_fund_amount: updated to be populated by variable which will contain custom partner logic
- eab_fund_date: updated to be populated by variable which will contain custom partner logic
- eab_discount_ind: updated per engineering instruction that 'Unknown' is not acceptable value as field needs to be boolean
- fund left joins: edited to connect unconverted fund_type field instead of eab_fund_type
- added left join for eab_entry_year_academic conversions
- added <join_extension.Student Year Funds> for any additional custom partner joins*/

/*2025-03-14: corrected case logic for eab_discount_ind to output null instead of 'Unknown' to work with boolean values - ccreekman*/
/*2025-01-14: edited master code for eab_fund_amount, eab_fund_date, and eab_entry_year_academic as they were pulling
from fulfillment rather than standardizing relevant data. 
Removed cast to integer on eab_entry_year_academic as pdp feed is already set to do that
Also changed predicand for eab_fund_date, as written in Master, SQL could not execute*/

WITH funds_data AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
			nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id
		  , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type
		  , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partnercontact_id,syf.eab_student_id),'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id
		  , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(coalesce(id_xwalk.source_partner_system_name,syf.eab_student_id_type),'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name
          , case when pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_entry_year_academic
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.fund_code,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS fund_code
          , syf.current_entry_year_academic AS curr_entry_year_academic
          , syf.offered_amount AS offered_amt
          , CAST(syf.offered_date AS timestamp) AS offered_dt
          , syf.accept_amount AS accept_amt
          , CAST(syf.accept_date AS timestamp) AS accept_dt
          , syf.cancel_amount AS cancel_amt
          , CAST(syf.cancel_date AS timestamp) AS cancel_dt
          , syf.declined_amount AS declined_amt
          , CAST(syf.declined_date AS timestamp) AS declined_dt
          , syf.fund_name AS fund_name
          , syf.fund_type AS fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value
				END AS eab_fund_type      					
		  , CAST(<eab_fund_amount> AS decimal (10,2)) as eab_fund_amount		
          , CAST(<eab_fund_date> AS date) AS eab_fund_date
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.eab_standard_value 
				END AS eab_simulation_fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.eab_standard_value 
				END AS eab_cohort_fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.eab_standard_value
				END AS eab_summary_fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN null
				ELSE CAST(pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value AS Boolean)
				END AS eab_discount_ind
          , CAST(syf.intake_dt AS timestamp) AS intake_dt
        FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{fulfillment}> AS syf   
											   
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_simulation_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_cohort_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_summary_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_summary_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_discount_ind
                     ON (pcm_eab_discount_ind.field_name = 'eab_discount_ind'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_discount_ind.partner_value,''))
		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_entry_year_academic
					on (pcm_entry_year_academic.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic'
					and coalesce(syf.current_entry_year_academic,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_year_academic.partner_value,''))

		<join_extension.Student Year Funds>
    ) sq
	where coalesce(sq.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
	and coalesce(sq.partner_system_name,'') <> ''
	AND COALESCE(sq.eab_fund_type,'')<>''
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    eab_student_id
  , eab_student_id_type
  , partnercontact_id
  , partner_system_name
  , eab_entry_year_academic
  , fund_code
  , curr_entry_year_academic
  , offered_amt
  , offered_dt
  , accept_amt
  , accept_dt
  , cancel_amt
  , cancel_dt
  , declined_amt
  , declined_dt
  , fund_name
  , fund_type
  , eab_fund_type
  , eab_fund_amount
  , eab_fund_date
  , eab_simulation_fund_type
  , eab_cohort_fund_type
  , eab_summary_fund_type
  , eab_discount_ind
  , intake_dt
FROM funds_data
where 1=1

/*Student Year Funds query but with eab_fund_amount and syf_join_extension variables replaced with bundle code
purpose of eab_fund_amount logic is to ensure final Fund totals include or exclude award amounts per partner logic
	- if award should be included in fund totals - return the row's award amount 
	- if award should not be included - set it to 0

General Set Up Instructions:
1. Review legacy logic and identify all data points necessary for calculations and note which Entity tables contain this data
2. If necessary data points are bound to tables other than Student Year Funds:
	- To start: Update "<join_extension.Student Year Funds> bundle code" section with simple left joins to these Entity fulfillment tables
3. Build custom case statement in "<eab_fund_amount>" section, replicating legacy logic
4. Adjust "<join_extension.Student Year Funds> bundle code" section as needed 
5. Validate counts using queries at end
6. When all counts are validated: update <eab_fund_amount> and <join_extension.Student Year Funds> with your code

*/

WITH funds_data AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_student_id
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_student_id_type
          , case when pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_entry_year_academic
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.fund_code,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS fund_code
          , syf.current_entry_year_academic AS curr_entry_year_academic
          , syf.offered_amount AS offered_amt
          , CAST(syf.offered_date AS timestamp) AS offered_dt
          , syf.accept_amount AS accept_amt
          , CAST(syf.accept_date AS timestamp) AS accept_dt
          , syf.cancel_amount AS cancel_amt
          , CAST(syf.cancel_date AS timestamp) AS cancel_dt
          , syf.declined_amount AS declined_amt
          , CAST(syf.declined_date AS timestamp) AS declined_dt
          , syf.fund_name AS fund_name
          , syf.fund_type AS fund_type						
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value
				END AS eab_fund_type
		  , CAST(case when accept_dt IS NOT NULL then accept_dt 
				 when offered_dt IS NOT NULL then offered_dt 
				 when declined_dt IS NOT NULL then declined_dt

/*Student Year Funds query but with eab_fund_amount and syf_join_extension variables replaced with bundle code
purpose of eab_fund_amount logic is to ensure final Fund totals include or exclude award amounts per partner logic
	- if award should be included in fund totals - return the row's award amount 
	- if award should not be included - set it to 0

General Set Up Instructions:
1. Review legacy logic and identify all data points necessary for calculations and note which Entity tables contain this data
2. If necessary data points are bound to tables other than Student Year Funds:
	- To start: Update "<join_extension.Student Year Funds> bundle code" section with simple left joins to these Entity fulfillment tables
3. Build custom case statement in "<eab_fund_amount>" section, replicating legacy logic
4. Adjust "<join_extension.Student Year Funds> bundle code" section as needed 
5. Validate counts using queries at end
6. When all counts are validated: update <eab_fund_amount> and <join_extension.Student Year Funds> with your code

*/

WITH funds_data AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_student_id
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_student_id_type
          , case when pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_entry_year_academic
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.fund_code,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS fund_code
          , syf.current_entry_year_academic AS curr_entry_year_academic
          , syf.offered_amount AS offered_amt
          , CAST(syf.offered_date AS timestamp) AS offered_dt
          , syf.accept_amount AS accept_amt
          , CAST(syf.accept_date AS timestamp) AS accept_dt
          , syf.cancel_amount AS cancel_amt
          , CAST(syf.cancel_date AS timestamp) AS cancel_dt
          , syf.declined_amount AS declined_amt
          , CAST(syf.declined_date AS timestamp) AS declined_dt
          , syf.fund_name AS fund_name
          , syf.fund_type AS fund_type						
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value
				END AS eab_fund_type
		  , CAST(case when accept_dt IS NOT NULL then accept_dt 
				 when offered_dt IS NOT NULL then offered_dt 
				 when declined_dt IS NOT NULL then declined_dt 
				 else cancel_dt end AS date) AS eab_fund_date
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE CAST(pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value AS Boolean)
				END AS eab_discount_ind
          , CAST(syf.intake_dt AS timestamp) AS intake_dt								
          --, case when coalesce(syf.calculated_field_1,'') in ('E') then syf.calculated_field_2 else null end AS estimated_amt
          --, case when coalesce(syf.calculated_field_1,'') in ('NA') then syf.calculated_field_2 else null end as na_amt		


						
/***************************************************************************************************
eab_fund_amount - customize per partner logic
***************************************************************************************************/
		  , CAST(case
				 when syf.CALCULATED_FIELD_1 in ('A','O')
				 	and acceptinstid.eab_student_id is not null
				 	and pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value in ('Endowed Award', 'Institutional Merit', 'Institutional Need', 'Institutional Award', 'Institutional Stack', 'Tuition Waiver', 'Athletic Scholarship')
				 then CALCULATED_FIELD_2
				 when acceptinstid.eab_student_id is null
				 	and pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value in ('Endowed Award', 'Institutional Merit', 'Institutional Need', 'Institutional Award', 'Institutional Stack', 'Tuition Waiver', 'Athletic Scholarship', 'Federal Grant', 'Pell Grant', 'State Grant')
				 	and acceptgovtid.eab_student_id is null
				 then CALCULATED_FIELD_2
				 when syf.CALCULATED_FIELD_1 in ('A','O')
				 	and pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value in ('Federal Grant', 'Pell Grant', 'State Grant')
				 	and acceptgovtid.eab_student_id is not null
				 then CALCULATED_FIELD_2
				 when pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value in ('Need Loan', 'No Need Loan', 'Work Study', 'Outside Scholarship')
				 then CALCULATED_FIELD_2
				 else '0'
			
/*				case when accept_amt IS NOT NULL AND accept_amt > 0 
				then TRY_CAST(accept_amt AS number)
				when offered_amt IS NOT NULL AND offered_amt > 0 
				then TRY_CAST(offered_amt AS number)
				when declined_amt IS NOT NULL AND declined_amt > 0 
				then TRY_CAST(declined_amt AS number)
				else TRY_CAST(cancel_amt AS number)
					*/
			end AS decimal (10,2)) as eab_fund_amount		
			
/*************************************************************************************************/

        FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{fulfillment}> AS syf   
											   
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_discount_ind
                     ON (pcm_eab_discount_ind.field_name = 'eab_discount_ind'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_discount_ind.partner_value,''))
		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_entry_year_academic
					on (pcm_entry_year_academic.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic'
					and coalesce(syf.current_entry_year_academic,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_year_academic.partner_value,''))

/***************************************************************************************************************************
<join_extension.Student Year Funds> bundle code 
- add joins to other fulfillment tables here
***************************************************************************************************************************/

left join (
  select distinct *
  from (
	select distinct eab_student_id, CALCULATED_FIELD_1, FUND_TYPE,
  
	CASE WHEN pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value
				END AS eab_fund_type
  
	from <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{fulfillment}> syf
	LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_fund_type.partner_value,''))
	) acceptinstid
	where 1=1
	and CALCULATED_FIELD_1 = 'A'
	and EAB_FUND_TYPE in ('Endowed Award', 'Institutional Merit', 'Institutional Need', 'Institutional Award', 'Institutional Stack', 'Tuition Waiver', 'Athletic Scholarship')
			  
  ) acceptinstid
  on syf.eab_student_id = acceptinstid.eab_student_id
	
left join (
  select distinct *
  from (
	select distinct eab_student_id, CALCULATED_FIELD_1, FUND_TYPE,
  
	CASE WHEN pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value
				END AS eab_fund_type
  
	from <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{fulfillment}> syf
	LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_fund_type.partner_value,''))
	) acceptgovtid
	where 1=1
	and CALCULATED_FIELD_1 = 'A'
	and EAB_FUND_TYPE in ('Federal Grant', 'Pell Grant', 'State Grant')

  ) acceptgovtid
  on syf.eab_student_id = acceptgovtid.eab_student_id  


/**************************************************************************************************************************/
		
    ) sq
    WHERE COALESCE(sq.eab_student_id,'')<>''
      AND COALESCE(sq.eab_student_id_type,'')<>''
      AND COALESCE(sq.eab_fund_type,'')<>''

, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then DECLINED_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_declined_calc
, sum(ACCEPT_AMT) as total_accepted
, sum(OFFERED_AMT) as total_offer
, sum(CANCEL_AMT) as total_canceled
, sum(DECLINED_AMT) as total_declined
													  
from funds_data syf

join  <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].{final}> stud_term
on (syf.eab_student_id = stud_term.eab_student_id)

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application SIS].{final}> stud_term_app
	on (stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_term_app.eab_student_id
	and coalesce(stud_term.eab_student_type,'') = 'Freshman'
	and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_term,'') = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_term,'')
	and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_year_academic,0))
													  
where 1=1
and stud_term.eab_student_type = 'Freshman'
--and eab_fund_type  = 'Institutional Award'

group by syf.EAB_FUND_TYPE, syf.EAB_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC
, stud_term.eab_student_type, fund_code
, syf.eab_student_id
, stud_term_app.eab_admit_ind, stud_term_app.eab_deposit_ind
, stud_term.eab_current_funnel_status
order by syf.EAB_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC desc, syf.eab_student_id, syf.eab_fund_type
, stud_term.eab_student_type, syf.EAB_FUND_TYPE, stud_term.eab_current_funnel_status
, fund_code

limit 5000*/

queryResults.querySql:
/*2025-07-23: added join_extension variable <join_extension.Student Year Funds> per ESANALYTIC-50998 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-07: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2026-05-28: added <join_extension.Student Term SIS> to exclude cancelled funds for enrolled students*/
WITH funds_data AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
                nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id
                , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as eab_student_id_type
                , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partnercontact_id
                , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') as partner_system_name
				, case when pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' then null else pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value end as eab_entry_year_academic
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.fund_code,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS fund_code
          , syf.current_entry_year_academic AS curr_entry_year_academic
          , syf.offered_amount AS offered_amt
          , TRY_CAST(syf.offered_date AS timestamp) AS offered_dt
          , syf.accept_amount AS accept_amt
          , TRY_CAST(syf.accept_date AS timestamp) AS accept_dt
          , syf.cancel_amount AS cancel_amt
          , TRY_CAST(syf.cancel_date AS timestamp) AS cancel_dt
          , syf.declined_amount AS declined_amt
          , TRY_CAST(syf.declined_date AS timestamp) AS declined_dt
          , syf.fund_name AS fund_name
          , syf.fund_type AS fund_type
          , CASE WHEN partnercontact_id IS NOT NULL and syf.cancel_amount IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
                 ELSE pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value
            END END AS eab_fund_type
          , TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN pcm_eab_fund_amount.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN NULL
                 ELSE pcm_eab_fund_amount.eab_standard_value
            END AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS eab_fund_amount
          , TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN pcm_eab_fund_date.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN NULL
                 ELSE pcm_eab_fund_date.eab_standard_value
            END AS DATE) as eab_fund_date
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
                 ELSE pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.eab_standard_value 
            END AS eab_simulation_fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
                 ELSE pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.eab_standard_value 
            END AS eab_cohort_fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
                 ELSE pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.eab_standard_value
            END AS eab_summary_fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
                 ELSE CAST(pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value AS Boolean)
            END AS eab_discount_ind
          , CAST(syf.intake_dt AS timestamp) AS intake_dt
        --select *
        FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{fulfillment}> AS syf
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_entry_year_academic
                     ON (pcm_entry_year_academic.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.current_entry_year_academic,'') = COALESCE(pcm_entry_year_academic.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_simulation_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.eab_simulation_fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_cohort_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.eab_cohort_fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_summary_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_summary_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.eab_summary_fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_discount_ind
                     ON (pcm_eab_discount_ind.field_name = 'eab_discount_ind'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.eab_discount_ind,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_discount_ind.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_fund_amount
                     ON (pcm_eab_fund_amount.field_name = 'eab_fund_amount'
                    AND COALESCE(accept_amount, offered_amount, declined_amount, cancel_amount, '') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_fund_amount.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_fund_date
                     ON (pcm_eab_fund_date.field_name = 'eab_fund_date'
                    AND COALESCE(accept_date, offered_date, declined_date, cancel_date, '') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_fund_date.partner_value,''))
    
        <join_extension.Student Term SIS.Year Funds>
    ) sq
       where coalesce(sq.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
       and coalesce(sq.partner_system_name,'') <> ''
    AND COALESCE(sq.eab_fund_type,'')<>''
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    funds_data.eab_student_id
  , funds_data.eab_student_id_type
  , funds_data.partnercontact_id
  , funds_data.partner_system_name
  , funds_data.eab_entry_year_academic
  , funds_data.fund_code
  , funds_data.curr_entry_year_academic
  , funds_data.offered_amt
  , funds_data.offered_dt
  , funds_data.accept_amt
  , funds_data.accept_dt
  , funds_data.cancel_amt
  , funds_data.cancel_dt
  , funds_data.declined_amt
  , funds_data.declined_dt
  , funds_data.fund_name
  , funds_data.fund_type
  , funds_data.eab_fund_type
  , funds_data.eab_fund_amount
  , funds_data.eab_fund_date
  , funds_data.eab_simulation_fund_type
  , funds_data.eab_cohort_fund_type
  , funds_data.eab_summary_fund_type
  , funds_data.eab_discount_ind
  , funds_data.intake_dt
FROM funds_data

queryResults.sqlPreview: /*2026-08-04: v1 version is archived in University of Denver-FAO Pilot space this and DataOrgPilot.Enroll360.Student Year Funds.final are aligned at this time n…
queryResults.querySql:
/*2026-08-04: v1 version is archived in University of Denver-FAO Pilot space
this and DataOrgPilot.Enroll360.Student Year Funds.final are aligned at this time
note several output fields do not pass to pdp_ug at this time
Change log: Enroll360.Student Year Funds.final -> NEW Enroll360.Student Year Funds.final
- new query uses Student Term SIS as core table and left joins to Student Year Funds fulfillment via <join_extension.Student Year Funds> in bundle
- eab_fund_amount changes from DECIMAL(10,2) to DECIMAL(18,2); eab_discount_ind uses try_to_boolean.
- Adds deduplication: latest intake_dt, then eab_fund_amount, then eab_student_type wins.*/

SELECT 
agg2.eab_student_id,
agg2.eab_student_id_type,
agg2.partnercontact_id,
agg2.partner_system_name,
agg2.eab_entry_year_academic,
agg2.curr_entry_year_academic,
agg2.eab_student_type, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
agg2.student_type, /*not passed to PDP currently*/
agg2.fund_code,
agg2.offered_amt,
agg2.offered_dt,
agg2.accept_amt,
agg2.accept_dt,
agg2.cancel_amt,
agg2.cancel_dt,
agg2.declined_amt,
agg2.declined_dt,
agg2.fund_name,
agg2.fund_type,
agg2.eab_fund_type,
agg2.eab_fund_amount,
agg2.eab_fund_date,
agg2.eab_simulation_fund_type,
agg2.eab_cohort_fund_type,
agg2.eab_summary_fund_type,
agg2.eab_discount_ind,
agg2.intake_dt
from (
	select agg.*,
	row_number() over (partition by 
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partnercontact_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''), 
	nullif(trim(regexp_replace(agg.partner_system_name,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),''), 
	agg.eab_entry_year_academic, agg.fund_code
	order by agg.intake_dt desc nulls last, agg.eab_fund_amount desc nulls last, agg.eab_student_type
	) rn

from (
select distinct 
/*Student Term Fields*/
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_term.eab_student_id, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as eab_student_id,  
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_term.eab_student_id_type, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as eab_student_id_type, 
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_term.partnercontact_id, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as partnercontact_id,  
nullif(trim(regexp_replace(stud_term.partner_system_name, '"|[\\000-\\037\\177]', '')), '') as partner_system_name, 
stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,
stud_term.curr_entry_year_academic,
stud_term.eab_student_type,/*not passed to PDP currently*/
stud_term.student_type,/*not passed to PDP currently*/

nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.fund_code,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS fund_code,
syf.offered_amount AS offered_amt,
CAST(syf.offered_date AS timestamp) AS offered_dt,
syf.accept_amount AS accept_amt,
CAST(syf.accept_date AS timestamp) AS accept_dt,
syf.cancel_amount AS cancel_amt,
CAST(syf.cancel_date AS timestamp) AS cancel_dt,
syf.declined_amount AS declined_amt,
CAST(syf.declined_date AS timestamp) AS declined_dt,
syf.fund_name AS fund_name,
syf.fund_type AS fund_type,

CASE WHEN pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
ELSE pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value
END AS eab_fund_type,

CAST(<eab_fund_amount> as DECIMAL (18,2)) AS eab_fund_amount,
CAST(<eab_fund_date> as DATE) AS eab_fund_date,

CASE WHEN pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' 
THEN 'Unknown'
ELSE pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.eab_standard_value
END AS eab_simulation_fund_type,

CASE WHEN pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' 
THEN 'Unknown'
ELSE pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.eab_standard_value
END AS eab_cohort_fund_type,

CASE WHEN pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' 
THEN 'Unknown'
ELSE pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.eab_standard_value
END AS eab_summary_fund_type,

CASE WHEN pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN null
ELSE try_to_boolean(pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value)
END AS eab_discount_ind,

syf.intake_dt AS intake_dt

from <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].{final}> stud_term

<join_extension.Student Year Funds>

) agg
WHERE COALESCE(agg.partnercontact_id,'') <> ''
AND COALESCE(agg.partner_system_name,'') <> ''
AND COALESCE(agg.eab_fund_type,'') <> ''

) agg2
where rn = 1

/*2025-11-14: testing partner system name functionality, variables - ccreekman*/
/*2025-07-07: added partnercontact_id, partner_system_name per ESANALYTIC-50473 - ccreekman*/
/*2025-04-25: all changes from engineering master:
- eab_entry_year_academic: added standard case logic for year conversion
- eab_fund_amount: updated to be populated by variable which will contain custom partner logic
- eab_fund_date: updated to be populated by variable which will contain custom partner logic
- eab_discount_ind: updated per engineering instruction that 'Unknown' is not acceptable value as field needs to be boolean
- fund left joins: edited to connect unconverted fund_type field instead of eab_fund_type
- added left join for eab_entry_year_academic conversions
- added <join_extension.Student Year Funds> for any additional custom partner joins*/

/*2025-03-14: corrected case logic for eab_discount_ind to output null instead of 'Unknown' to work with boolean values - ccreekman*/
/*2025-01-14: edited master code for eab_fund_amount, eab_fund_date, and eab_entry_year_academic as they were pulling
from fulfillment rather than standardizing relevant data. 
Also changed predicand for eab_fund_date, as written in Master, SQL could not execute*/


SELECT 
agg2.eab_student_id,
agg2.eab_student_id_type,
agg2.partnercontact_id,
agg2.partner_system_name,

Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. queryResults.sqlPreview: /*Denver Student Year Funds query but with eab_fund_amount and syf_join_extension variables replaced with bundle code adjust code in those two variable sections…
queryResults.querySql:
/*Denver Student Year Funds query but with eab_fund_amount and syf_join_extension variables replaced with bundle code
adjust code in those two variable sections to tweak eab_fund_amount results
additional fields created for investigation purposes: 
estimated_amt = award amount if code = 'E'
na_amt = award amount if code = 'NA'
acc_eab_fund_type = aggregate of all accepted award eab_fund_types per student in the acceptawds table 
	(eg. student 12345 has acc_eab_fund_type value of Institutional Merit|Endowed Award|Athletic Scholarship)
*/

WITH funds_data AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_student_id
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_student_id_type
		, acceptawds.eab_fund_type as acc_eab_fund_type
          , case when pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_entry_year_academic
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.fund_code,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS fund_code
          , syf.current_entry_year_academic AS curr_entry_year_academic
          , syf.offered_amount AS offered_amt
          , CAST(syf.offered_date AS timestamp) AS offered_dt
          , syf.accept_amount AS accept_amt
          , CAST(syf.accept_date AS timestamp) AS accept_dt
          , syf.cancel_amount AS cancel_amt
          , CAST(syf.cancel_date AS timestamp) AS cancel_dt
          , syf.declined_amount AS declined_amt
          , CAST(syf.declined_date AS timestamp) AS declined_dt
          , case when coalesce(syf.calculated_field_1,'') in ('E') then syf.calculated_field_2 else null end AS estimated_amt
          , case when coalesce(syf.calculated_field_1,'') in ('NA') then syf.calculated_field_2 else null end as na_amt						
          , syf.fund_name AS fund_name
          , syf.fund_type AS fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value
				END AS eab_fund_type

						
/********************
eab_fund_amount logic
calculated_field_1 = raw award type (A,C,O,NA,E,D)
calculated_field_2 = raw award amount
********************/
		  , CAST(case 
					when grid_merit.eab_student_id is not null then '0'
					when estgft.eab_student_id is not null then '0'
				 	when coalesce(syf.calculated_field_1,'') = 'A' 
						then syf.calculated_field_2
					when coalesce(syf.calculated_field_1,'') <> 'C' 
				 		and acceptawds.eab_student_id is not null
						then syf.calculated_field_2
					when (coalesce(syf.calculated_field_1,'') in ('A','C','NA','O','D')	and acceptawds.eab_student_id is null)
						then syf.calculated_field_2
					else '0'
					end AS decimal (10,2)) as eab_fund_amount		
/******************************************************************/

          , CAST(case when accept_dt IS NOT NULL then accept_dt when offered_dt IS NOT NULL then offered_dt when declined_dt IS NOT NULL then declined_dt else cancel_dt end AS date) AS eab_fund_date
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.eab_standard_value 
				END AS eab_simulation_fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.eab_standard_value 
				END AS eab_cohort_fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.eab_standard_value
				END AS eab_summary_fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE CAST(pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value AS Boolean)
				END AS eab_discount_ind
          , CAST(syf.intake_dt AS timestamp) AS intake_dt
        FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{fulfillment}> AS syf   
											   
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_simulation_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_cohort_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_summary_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_summary_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_discount_ind
                     ON (pcm_eab_discount_ind.field_name = 'eab_discount_ind'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_discount_ind.partner_value,''))
		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_entry_year_academic
					on (pcm_entry_year_academic.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic'
					and coalesce(syf.current_entry_year_academic,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_year_academic.partner_value,''))

/*****************************************************
syf_join_extension bundle code - join to acceptawds table
*****************************************************/
/*Student Year Funds - partner specific*/
LEFT JOIN ( 
	SELECT distinct eab_student_id, eab_student_id_type, listagg(eab_fund_type,'|') as eab_fund_type from
		(select distinct eab_student_id, eab_student_id_type, pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value as eab_fund_type
  		from <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{fulfillment}> AS syf
		LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_fund_type
		ON (pcm_eab_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_fund_type'
		AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_fund_type.partner_value,''))
		where 1=1
		and fund_type not in ('8812FS', '8701FS')
		and calculated_field_1 = 'A'
		) syf
	where 1=1
	GROUP BY eab_student_id, eab_student_id_type
  	
  	) acceptawds
on (syf.eab_student_id = acceptawds.eab_student_id
and syf.eab_student_id_type = acceptawds.eab_student_id_type)

		 
/*Grid Merit - awards that should not be included in counts*/
LEFT JOIN ( 
	select * from (
SELECT 
    distinct eab_student_id, eab_student_id_type, fund_code, calculated_field_1, calculated_field_2
  	, row_number() over (partition by eab_student_id order by cast(calculated_field_2 as number) desc) as rn
	from <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{fulfillment}> AS syf
	where 1=1
	and fund_type in ('0846FS', '0858FS', '0859FS', '7008FS', '7009FS', '7010FS', '7011FS',
					  '8150FS','8151FS', '8152FS', '8153FS','8158FS','8548FS')
order by eab_student_id, rn )agg
where 1=1
and rn > 1
) grid_merit
on (syf.eab_student_id = grid_merit.eab_student_id
and syf.eab_student_id_type = grid_merit.eab_student_id_type
and syf.fund_code = grid_merit.fund_code
and syf.calculated_field_1 = grid_merit.calculated_field_1
and syf.calculated_field_2 =  grid_merit.calculated_field_2)
		 
		 
/*If student has both fund code 7000FS and ESTGFT, exclude ESTGFT and only include fund code 7000FS
selects ESTGFTs which should be excluded*/
LEFT JOIN ( 
	select * from (
SELECT 
    distinct eab_student_id, eab_student_id_type, fund_code, calculated_field_1, calculated_field_2
  	, row_number() over (partition by eab_student_id order by fund_type) as rn
	from <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{fulfillment}> AS syf
	where 1=1
	and fund_type in ('7000FS', 'ESTGFT')
order by eab_student_id, rn )agg
where 1=1
and rn > 1
) estgft
on (syf.eab_student_id = estgft.eab_student_id
and syf.eab_student_id_type = estgft.eab_student_id_type
and syf.fund_code = estgft.fund_code
and syf.calculated_field_1 = estgft.calculated_field_1
and syf.calculated_field_2 =  estgft.calculated_field_2)
/*****************************************************/
		

    ) sq
    WHERE COALESCE(sq.eab_student_id,'')<>''
      AND COALESCE(sq.eab_student_id_type,'')<>''
      AND COALESCE(sq.eab_fund_type,'')<>''
)
/**********************************************************************************************
above cte produces funds_data table which replicates <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{final}>
query below to pull final table data as desired
**********************************************************************************************/

/*Total Funds per EAB_Fund_Type rollup
comment out 125-162 to run other query*/
select 
EAB_FUND_TYPE, syf.EAB_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC
, sum(EAB_FUND_AMOUNT) as total_aid_calc
, to_number(sum(coalesce(ACCEPT_AMT,0)+coalesce(OFFERED_AMT,0)+coalesce(CANCEL_AMT,0)+coalesce(DECLINED_AMT,0)),13,2) as total_aid_raw
--, to_number(sum(coalesce(ACCEPT_AMT,0)+coalesce(OFFERED_AMT,0)+coalesce(CANCEL_AMT,0)+coalesce(DECLINED_AMT,0)+coalesce(estimated_AMT,0)+coalesce(na_AMT,0)),13,2) as total_aid_raw_with_na_e
, count(distinct syf.eab_student_id) as total_unique_stud
, cast((total_aid_calc/total_unique_stud) as decimal (10,2)) as avg_aid_per_unique_stud
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then ACCEPT_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_accepted_calc
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then OFFERED_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_offer_calc
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then CANCEL_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_cancelled_calc
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then DECLINED_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_declined_calc
, sum(ACCEPT_AMT) as total_accepted
, sum(OFFERED_AMT) as total_offer
, sum(CANCEL_AMT) as total_canceled
, sum(DECLINED_AMT) as total_declined
, sum(estimated_AMT) as total_est
, sum(na_AMT) as total_na
													  
from funds_data syf

join  <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].{final}> stud_term
on (syf.eab_student_id = stud_term.eab_student_id
   )


left outer join <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application SIS].{final}> stud_term_app
	on (stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_term_app.eab_student_id
	and coalesce(stud_term.eab_student_type,'') = 'Freshman'
	and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_term,'') = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_term,'')

where 1=1
and stud_term.eab_student_type = 'Freshman'
and eab_fund_type  in ('Insitutional Award')


group by syf.EAB_FUND_TYPE, syf.EAB_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC
order by syf.EAB_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC desc, syf.eab_fund_type

queryResults.sqlPreview: /*Student Year Funds query but with eab_fund_amount and syf_join_extension variables replaced with bundle code purpose of eab_fund_amount logic is to ensure fin…
queryResults.querySql:
/*Student Year Funds query but with eab_fund_amount and syf_join_extension variables replaced with bundle code
purpose of eab_fund_amount logic is to ensure final Fund totals include or exclude award amounts per partner logic
	- if award should be included in fund totals - return the row's award amount 
	- if award should not be included - set it to 0

General Set Up Instructions:
1. Review legacy logic and identify all data points necessary for calculations and note which Entity tables contain this data
2. If necessary data points are bound to tables other than Student Year Funds:
	- To start: Update "<join_extension.Student Year Funds> bundle code" section with simple left joins to these Entity fulfillment tables
3. Build custom case statement in "<eab_fund_amount>" section, replicating legacy logic
4. Adjust "<join_extension.Student Year Funds> bundle code" section as needed 
5. Validate counts using queries at end
6. When all counts are validated: update <eab_fund_amount> and <join_extension.Student Year Funds> with your code

*/

WITH funds_data AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_student_id
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_student_id_type
          , case when pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_entry_year_academic
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.fund_code,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS fund_code
          , syf.current_entry_year_academic AS curr_entry_year_academic
          , syf.offered_amount AS offered_amt
          , CAST(syf.offered_date AS timestamp) AS offered_dt
          , syf.accept_amount AS accept_amt
          , CAST(syf.accept_date AS timestamp) AS accept_dt
          , syf.cancel_amount AS cancel_amt
          , CAST(syf.cancel_date AS timestamp) AS cancel_dt
          , syf.declined_amount AS declined_amt
          , CAST(syf.declined_date AS timestamp) AS declined_dt
          , syf.fund_name AS fund_name
          , syf.fund_type AS fund_type						
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value
				END AS eab_fund_type
		  , CAST(case when accept_dt IS NOT NULL then accept_dt 
				 when offered_dt IS NOT NULL then offered_dt 
				 when declined_dt IS NOT NULL then declined_dt 
				 else cancel_dt end AS date) AS eab_fund_date
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE CAST(pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value AS Boolean)
				END AS eab_discount_ind
          , CAST(syf.intake_dt AS timestamp) AS intake_dt								
          --, case when coalesce(syf.calculated_field_1,'') in ('E') then syf.calculated_field_2 else null end AS estimated_amt
          --, case when coalesce(syf.calculated_field_1,'') in ('NA') then syf.calculated_field_2 else null end as na_amt		


						
/***************************************************************************************************
eab_fund_amount - customize per partner logic
***************************************************************************************************/
		  , CAST(
				case when accept_amt IS NOT NULL AND accept_amt > 0 
				then TRY_CAST(accept_amt AS number)
				when offered_amt IS NOT NULL AND offered_amt > 0 
				then TRY_CAST(offered_amt AS number)
				when declined_amt IS NOT NULL AND declined_amt > 0 
				then TRY_CAST(declined_amt AS number)
				else TRY_CAST(cancel_amt AS number)
					
			end AS decimal (10,2)) as eab_fund_amount		
/*************************************************************************************************/


        FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{fulfillment}> AS syf   
											   
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_discount_ind
                     ON (pcm_eab_discount_ind.field_name = 'eab_discount_ind'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_discount_ind.partner_value,''))
		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_entry_year_academic
					on (pcm_entry_year_academic.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic'
					and coalesce(syf.current_entry_year_academic,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_year_academic.partner_value,''))

/***************************************************************************************************************************
<join_extension.Student Year Funds> bundle code 
- add joins to other fulfillment tables here
***************************************************************************************************************************/

left join (select null as default_value) d
on 1=1


/**************************************************************************************************************************/
		
    ) sq
    WHERE COALESCE(sq.eab_student_id,'')<>''
      AND COALESCE(sq.eab_student_id_type,'')<>''
      AND COALESCE(sq.eab_fund_type,'')<>''
)

																				
/**********************************************************************************************
above cte produces funds_data table which replicates <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{final}>
use queries below to pull final table data as desired
**********************************************************************************************/

/*Total Funds per EAB_Fund_Type rollup*/
--comment out this section before trying to run other query
--edit criteria to select desired Fund category
select 
EAB_FUND_TYPE, syf.EAB_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC
, sum(EAB_FUND_AMOUNT) as total_aid_calc
, to_number(sum(coalesce(ACCEPT_AMT,0)+coalesce(OFFERED_AMT,0)+coalesce(CANCEL_AMT,0)+coalesce(DECLINED_AMT,0)),13,2) as total_aid_raw
--, to_number(sum(coalesce(ACCEPT_AMT,0)+coalesce(OFFERED_AMT,0)+coalesce(CANCEL_AMT,0)+coalesce(DECLINED_AMT,0)+coalesce(estimated_AMT,0)+coalesce(na_AMT,0)),13,2) as total_aid_raw_with_na_e
, count(distinct syf.eab_student_id) as total_unique_stud
, cast((total_aid_calc/total_unique_stud) as decimal (10,2)) as avg_aid_per_unique_stud
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then ACCEPT_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_accepted_calc
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then OFFERED_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_offer_calc
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then CANCEL_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_cancelled_calc
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then DECLINED_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_declined_calc
, sum(ACCEPT_AMT) as total_accepted
, sum(OFFERED_AMT) as total_offer
, sum(CANCEL_AMT) as total_canceled
, sum(DECLINED_AMT) as total_declined
--, sum(estimated_AMT) as total_est
--, sum(na_AMT) as total_na
													  
from funds_data syf

join  <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].{final}> stud_term
on (syf.eab_student_id = stud_term.eab_student_id
	--and coalesce(syf.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,0)
   )

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application SIS].{final}> stud_term_app
	on (stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_term_app.eab_student_id
	and coalesce(stud_term.eab_student_type,'') = 'Freshman'
	and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_term,'') = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_term,'')
	and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_year_academic,0))
													  
where 1=1
and stud_term.eab_student_type = 'Freshman'

--and eab_fund_type  in ('Insitutional Award')

group by syf.EAB_FUND_TYPE, syf.EAB_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC
order by syf.EAB_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC desc, syf.eab_fund_type

/*Student Level data per fund*/
--comment in this query and comment out above Total Funds per EAB_Fund_Type rollup query to run this query*/


/*select 
syf.eab_student_id, EAB_FUND_TYPE, syf.EAB_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC
, stud_term.eab_student_type, fund_code, stud_term_app.eab_admit_ind, stud_term_app.eab_deposit_ind, stud_term.eab_current_funnel_status,acc_eab_fund_type
, sum(EAB_FUND_AMOUNT) as total_aid_calc
, to_number(sum(coalesce(ACCEPT_AMT,0)+coalesce(OFFERED_AMT,0)+coalesce(CANCEL_AMT,0)+coalesce(DECLINED_AMT,0)),13,2) as total_aid_raw
--, to_number(sum(coalesce(ACCEPT_AMT,0)+coalesce(OFFERED_AMT,0)+coalesce(CANCEL_AMT,0)+coalesce(DECLINED_AMT,0)+coalesce(estimated_AMT,0)+coalesce(na_AMT,0)),13,2) as total_aid_raw_w_na_e
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then ACCEPT_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_accepted_calc
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then OFFERED_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_offer_calc
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then CANCEL_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_cancelled_calc
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then DECLINED_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_declined_calc
, sum(ACCEPT_AMT) as total_accepted
, sum(OFFERED_AMT) as total_offer
, sum(CANCEL_AMT) as total_canceled
, sum(DECLINED_AMT) as total_declined
, sum(estimated_AMT) as total_est
, sum(na_AMT) as total_na
													  
from funds_data syf

join  <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].{final}> stud_term
on (syf.eab_student_id = stud_term.eab_student_id)

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application SIS].{final}> stud_term_app
	on (stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_term_app.eab_student_id
	and coalesce(stud_term.eab_student_type,'') = 'Freshman'
	and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_term,'') = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_term,'')
	and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_year_academic,0))
													  
where 1=1
and stud_term.eab_student_type = 'Freshman'
and eab_fund_type  = 'Institutional Award'
--and acc_eab_fund_type ilike '%Tuition Waiver%'

group by syf.EAB_FUND_TYPE, syf.EAB_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC
, stud_term.eab_student_type, fund_code
, syf.eab_student_id, acc_eab_fund_type, stud_term_app.eab_admit_ind, stud_term_app.eab_deposit_ind
, stud_term.eab_current_funnel_status
order by syf.EAB_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC desc, syf.eab_student_id, syf.eab_fund_type
, stud_term.eab_student_type, syf.EAB_FUND_TYPE, stud_term.eab_current_funnel_status--, syf.eab_student_id
, fund_code

limit 5000	*/
