queryResults.sqlPreview: /*1-14-2025: edited master code for eab_fund_amount, eab_fund_date, and eab_entry_year_academic as they were pulling from fulfillment rather than standardizing …
queryResults.querySql:
/*1-14-2025: edited master code for eab_fund_amount, eab_fund_date, and eab_entry_year_academic as they were pulling
from fulfillment rather than standardizing relevant data. 
Removed cast to integer on eab_entry_year_academic as pdp feed is already set to do that
Also changed predicand for eab_fund_date, as written in Master, SQL could not execute*/

WITH funds_data AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_student_id
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_student_id_type
          , case when pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_entry_year_academic
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.fund_code,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS fund_code
          , syf.current_entry_year_academic AS curr_entry_year_academic
          , syf.offered_amount AS offered_amt
          , CAST(syf.offered_date AS timestamp) AS offered_dt
          , syf.accept_amount AS accept_amt
          , CAST(syf.accept_date AS timestamp) AS accept_dt
          , syf.cancel_amount AS cancel_amt
          , CAST(syf.cancel_date AS timestamp) AS cancel_dt
          , syf.declined_amount AS declined_amt
          , CAST(syf.declined_date AS timestamp) AS declined_dt
          , syf.fund_name AS fund_name
          , syf.fund_type AS fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
                 ELSE pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value
            END AS eab_fund_type
          , CAST(<eab_fund_amount> AS decimal (10,2)) AS eab_fund_amount
          , CAST(<eab_fund_date> AS date) AS eab_fund_date
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
                 ELSE pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.eab_standard_value 
            END AS eab_simulation_fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
                 ELSE pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.eab_standard_value 
            END AS eab_cohort_fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
                 ELSE pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.eab_standard_value
            END AS eab_summary_fund_type
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
                 ELSE CAST(pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value AS Boolean)
            END AS eab_discount_ind
          , CAST(syf.intake_dt AS timestamp) AS intake_dt
        FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{fulfillment}> AS syf
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_simulation_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_simulation_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_cohort_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_cohort_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_summary_fund_type
                     ON (pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.field_name = 'eab_summary_fund_type'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_summary_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_discount_ind
                     ON (pcm_eab_discount_ind.field_name = 'eab_discount_ind'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_discount_ind.partner_value,''))
		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_entry_year_academic
					on (pcm_entry_year_academic.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic'
					and coalesce(syf.current_entry_year_academic,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_year_academic.partner_value,''))
    ) sq
    WHERE COALESCE(sq.eab_student_id,'')<>''
      AND COALESCE(sq.eab_student_id_type,'')<>''
      AND COALESCE(sq.eab_fund_type,'')<>''
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    eab_student_id
  , eab_student_id_type
  , eab_entry_year_academic
  , fund_code
  , curr_entry_year_academic
  , offered_amt
  , offered_dt
  , accept_amt
  , accept_dt
  , cancel_amt
  , cancel_dt
  , declined_amt
  , declined_dt
  , fund_name
  , fund_type
  , eab_fund_type
  , eab_fund_amount
  , eab_fund_date
  , eab_simulation_fund_type
  , eab_cohort_fund_type
  , eab_summary_fund_type
  , eab_discount_ind
  , intake_dt
FROM funds_data

/*Student Year Funds query but with eab_fund_amount and syf_join_extension variables replaced with bundle code
purpose of eab_fund_amount logic is to ensure final Fund totals include or exclude award amounts per partner logic
	- if award should be included in fund totals - return the row's award amount 
	- if award should not be included - set it to 0

General Set Up Instructions:
1. Review legacy logic and identify all data points necessary for calculations and note which Entity tables contain this data
2. If necessary data points are bound to tables other than Student Year Funds:
	- To start: Update "<join_extension.Student Year Funds> bundle code" section with simple left joins to these Entity fulfillment tables
3. Build custom case statement in "<eab_fund_amount>" section, replicating legacy logic
4. Adjust "<join_extension.Student Year Funds> bundle code" section as needed 
5. Validate counts using queries at end
6. When all counts are validated: update <eab_fund_amount> and <join_extension.Student Year Funds> with your code

*/

WITH funds_data AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_student_id
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.eab_student_id_type,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS eab_student_id_type
          , case when pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value'
				then null
				else pcm_entry_year_academic.eab_standard_value
				end as eab_entry_year_academic
          , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(syf.fund_code,'"|[\\000-\\037\\177]','')),'') AS fund_code
          , syf.current_entry_year_academic AS curr_entry_year_academic
          , syf.offered_amount AS offered_amt
          , CAST(syf.offered_date AS timestamp) AS offered_dt
          , syf.accept_amount AS accept_amt
          , CAST(syf.accept_date AS timestamp) AS accept_dt
          , syf.cancel_amount AS cancel_amt
          , CAST(syf.cancel_date AS timestamp) AS cancel_dt
          , syf.declined_amount AS declined_amt
          , CAST(syf.declined_date AS timestamp) AS declined_dt
          , syf.fund_name AS fund_name
          , syf.fund_type AS fund_type						
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE pcm_eab_fund_type.eab_standard_value
				END AS eab_fund_type
		  , CAST(case when accept_dt IS NOT NULL then accept_dt 
				 when offered_dt IS NOT NULL then offered_dt 
				 when declined_dt IS NOT NULL then declined_dt 
				 else cancel_dt end AS date) AS eab_fund_date
          , CASE WHEN pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value = 'Unmapped Value' THEN 'Unknown'
				ELSE CAST(pcm_eab_discount_ind.eab_standard_value AS Boolean)
				END AS eab_discount_ind
          , CAST(syf.intake_dt AS timestamp) AS intake_dt
		  -- pull in the calculated 1 and 2 fields
		  , calculated_field_1 as status_code
		  , calculated_field_2 as awd_amt
          --, case when coalesce(syf.calculated_field_1,'') in ('E') then syf.calculated_field_2 else null end AS estimated_amt
          --, case when coalesce(syf.calculated_field_1,'') in ('NA') then syf.calculated_field_2 else null end as na_amt		


						
/***************************************************************************************************
eab_fund_amount - customize per partner logic
***************************************************************************************************/
		  , CAST(
				case when fund_type='ZZPJ' and calculated_field_1 not in ('C', 'X') then Offered_amount
--					 when fund_type='PELL' and calculated_field_1='A' and calculated_field_2='0' and calculated_field_1 not in ('C', 'X') then Offered_amount
					 when fund_type='PELL' and calculated_field_1='A' then Offered_amount			
					 when calculated_field_1 not in ('C', 'X') then calculated_field_2
				else '0'
					
			end AS decimal (10,2)) as eab_fund_amount		
/*************************************************************************************************/


        FROM <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{fulfillment}> AS syf

                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_fund_type.partner_value,''))
        LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_eab_discount_ind
                     ON (pcm_eab_discount_ind.field_name = 'eab_discount_ind'
                    AND COALESCE(syf.fund_type,'') = COALESCE(pcm_eab_discount_ind.partner_value,''))
		left outer join <[Enroll360].[Partner Code Mapping].{convert_sis}> pcm_entry_year_academic
					on (pcm_entry_year_academic.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic'
					and coalesce(syf.current_entry_year_academic,'') = coalesce(pcm_entry_year_academic.partner_value,''))

/***************************************************************************************************************************
<join_extension.Student Year Funds> bundle code 
- add joins to other fulfillment tables here
***************************************************************************************************************************/

left join (select null as default_value) d
on 1=1


/**************************************************************************************************************************/
		
    ) sq
    WHERE COALESCE(sq.eab_student_id,'')<>''
      AND COALESCE(sq.eab_student_id_type,'')<>''
      AND COALESCE(sq.eab_fund_type,'')<>''
)

--select * from funds_data where eab_fund_amount <> awd_amt																				
/**********************************************************************************************
above cte produces funds_data table which replicates <[Enroll360].[Student Year Funds].{final}>
use queries below to pull final table data as desired
**********************************************************************************************/

/*Total Funds per EAB_Fund_Type rollup*/
--comment out this section before trying to run other query
--edit criteria to select desired Fund category
select 
EAB_FUND_TYPE, syf.EAB_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC
, sum(EAB_FUND_AMOUNT) as total_aid_calc
, to_number(sum(coalesce(ACCEPT_AMT,0)+coalesce(OFFERED_AMT,0)+coalesce(CANCEL_AMT,0)+coalesce(DECLINED_AMT,0)),13,2) as total_aid_raw
--, to_number(sum(coalesce(ACCEPT_AMT,0)+coalesce(OFFERED_AMT,0)+coalesce(CANCEL_AMT,0)+coalesce(DECLINED_AMT,0)+coalesce(estimated_AMT,0)+coalesce(na_AMT,0)),13,2) as total_aid_raw_with_na_e
, count(distinct syf.eab_student_id) as total_unique_stud
, cast((total_aid_calc/total_unique_stud) as decimal (10,2)) as avg_aid_per_unique_stud
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then ACCEPT_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_accepted_calc
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then OFFERED_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_offer_calc
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then CANCEL_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_cancelled_calc
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then DECLINED_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_declined_calc
, sum(ACCEPT_AMT) as total_accepted
, sum(OFFERED_AMT) as total_offer
, sum(CANCEL_AMT) as total_canceled
, sum(DECLINED_AMT) as total_declined
--, sum(estimated_AMT) as total_est
--, sum(na_AMT) as total_na
													  
from funds_data syf

left join <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].{final}> stud_term
on (syf.eab_student_id = stud_term.eab_student_id
	--and coalesce(syf.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,0)
   )

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application SIS].{final}> stud_term_app
	on (stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_term_app.eab_student_id
	and coalesce(stud_term.eab_student_type,'') = 'Freshman'
	and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_term,'') = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_term,'')
	and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_year_academic,0))
													  
where 1=1
--and stud_term.eab_student_type = 'Freshman'

--and eab_fund_type  in ('Insitutional Award')

group by syf.EAB_FUND_TYPE, syf.EAB_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC
order by syf.EAB_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC desc, syf.eab_fund_type

/*Student Level data per fund*/
--comment in this query and comment out above Total Funds per EAB_Fund_Type rollup query to run this query*/


/*select 
syf.eab_student_id, EAB_FUND_TYPE, syf.EAB_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC
, stud_term.eab_student_type, fund_code, stud_term_app.eab_admit_ind, stud_term_app.eab_deposit_ind, stud_term.eab_current_funnel_status
, sum(EAB_FUND_AMOUNT) as total_aid_calc
, to_number(sum(coalesce(ACCEPT_AMT,0)+coalesce(OFFERED_AMT,0)+coalesce(CANCEL_AMT,0)+coalesce(DECLINED_AMT,0)),13,2) as total_aid_raw

, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then ACCEPT_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_accepted_calc
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then OFFERED_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_offer_calc
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then CANCEL_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_cancelled_calc
, to_number(sum(case when EAB_FUND_AMOUNT <> 0 then DECLINED_AMT else 0 end),13,2) as total_declined_calc
, sum(ACCEPT_AMT) as total_accepted
, sum(OFFERED_AMT) as total_offer
, sum(CANCEL_AMT) as total_canceled
, sum(DECLINED_AMT) as total_declined
													  
from funds_data syf

join  <[Enroll360].[Student Term SIS].{final}> stud_term
on (syf.eab_student_id = stud_term.eab_student_id)

left outer join <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application SIS].{final}> stud_term_app
	on (stud_term.eab_student_id = stud_term_app.eab_student_id
	and coalesce(stud_term.eab_student_type,'') = 'Freshman'
	and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_term,'') = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_term,'')
	and coalesce(stud_term.eab_entry_year_academic,0) = coalesce(stud_term_app.eab_entry_year_academic,0))
													  
where 1=1
and stud_term.eab_student_type = 'Freshman'
--and eab_fund_type  = 'Institutional Award'

group by syf.EAB_FUND_TYPE, syf.EAB_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC
, stud_term.eab_student_type, fund_code
, syf.eab_student_id
, stud_term_app.eab_admit_ind, stud_term_app.eab_deposit_ind
, stud_term.eab_current_funnel_status
order by syf.EAB_ENTRY_YEAR_ACADEMIC desc, syf.eab_student_id, syf.eab_fund_type
, stud_term.eab_student_type, syf.EAB_FUND_TYPE, stud_term.eab_current_funnel_status
, fund_code

limit 5000*/										 
/***********************************************************************/

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

/*******************************************************************************
Check 1 - Fulfillment Feed Review
*******************************************************************************/

/**************************************
Check 1 - 2. Fulfillment counts
a. Check count of primary keys across
entities in comparison to the core entity
***************************************/

select 
count(distinct pd_core.primary_student_id || pd_core.student_type || pd_core.current_entry_term || pd_core.current_entry_year_as_academic_year) as total_record_count,
count(distinct pd_acad.primary_student_id || pd_acad.student_type || pd_acad.current_entry_term || pd_acad.current_entry_year_as_academic_year) as pd_acad_count,
count(distinct pd_addr.primary_student_id || pd_addr.student_type || pd_addr.current_entry_term || pd_addr.current_entry_year_as_academic_year) as pd_addr_count,
count(distinct pd_app_funn.primary_student_id || pd_app_funn.student_type || pd_app_funn.current_entry_term || pd_app_funn.current_entry_year_as_academic_year) as pd_app_funn_count,
count(distinct pd_cont.primary_student_id || pd_cont.student_type || pd_cont.current_entry_term || pd_cont.current_entry_year_as_academic_year) as pd_cont_count,
count(distinct pd_fin_aid.primary_student_id || pd_fin_aid.student_type || pd_fin_aid.current_entry_term || pd_fin_aid.current_entry_year_as_academic_year) as pd_fin_aid_count,
count(distinct pd_int.primary_student_id || pd_int.student_type || pd_int.current_entry_term || pd_int.current_entry_year_as_academic_year) as pd_int_count,
count(distinct pd_race.primary_student_id || pd_race.student_type || pd_race.current_entry_term || pd_race.current_entry_year_as_academic_year) as pd_race_count,
count(distinct pd_rship.primary_student_id || pd_rship.student_type || pd_rship.current_entry_term || pd_rship.current_entry_year_as_academic_year) as pd_rship_count,
count(distinct pd_test.primary_student_id || pd_test.student_type || pd_test.current_entry_term || pd_test.current_entry_year_as_academic_year) as pd_test_count
from <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Core Record]> as pd_core
left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Academic]> as pd_acad
on (coalesce(pd_core.primary_student_id,'') = coalesce(pd_acad.primary_student_id,'')
    	and	coalesce(pd_core.student_type,'') = coalesce(pd_acad.student_type,'')
	and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_term,'') = coalesce(pd_acad.current_entry_term,'')
and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,'') = 
coalesce(pd_acad.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,''))
left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Address]> as pd_addr
on (coalesce(pd_core.primary_student_id,'') = coalesce(pd_addr.primary_student_id,'')
and coalesce(pd_core.student_type,'') = coalesce(pd_addr.student_type,'')
and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_term,'') = coalesce(pd_addr.current_entry_term,'')
and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,'') = 
coalesce(pd_addr.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,''))
left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Application Funnel]> as pd_app_funn
on (coalesce(pd_core.primary_student_id,'') = coalesce(pd_app_funn.primary_student_id,'')
    	and coalesce(pd_core.student_type,'') = coalesce(pd_app_funn.student_type,'')
	and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_term,'') = coalesce(pd_app_funn.current_entry_term,'')
	and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,'') = 
coalesce(pd_app_funn.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,''))
left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Contact]> as pd_cont
on (coalesce(pd_core.primary_student_id,'') = coalesce(pd_cont.primary_student_id,'')
    	and coalesce(pd_core.student_type,'') = coalesce(pd_cont.student_type,'')
	and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_term,'') = coalesce(pd_cont.current_entry_term,'')
	and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,'') = 
coalesce(pd_cont.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,''))
left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Financial Aid]> as pd_fin_aid
on (coalesce(pd_core.primary_student_id,'') = coalesce(pd_fin_aid.primary_student_id,'')
    	and coalesce(pd_core.student_type,'') = coalesce(pd_fin_aid.student_type,'')
	and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_term,'') = coalesce(pd_fin_aid.current_entry_term,'')
	and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,'') = 
coalesce(pd_fin_aid.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,''))
left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Interaction]> as pd_int
on (coalesce(pd_core.primary_student_id,'') = coalesce(pd_int.primary_student_id,'')
    	and coalesce(pd_core.student_type,'') = coalesce(pd_int.student_type,'')
	and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_term,'') = coalesce(pd_int.current_entry_term,'')
	and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,'') = 
coalesce(pd_int.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,''))
left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Race and Ethnicity]> as pd_race
on (coalesce(pd_core.primary_student_id,'') = coalesce(pd_race.primary_student_id,'')
    	and coalesce(pd_core.student_type,'') = coalesce(pd_race.student_type,'')
	and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_term,'') = coalesce(pd_race.current_entry_term,'')
	and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,'') = 
coalesce(pd_race.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,''))
left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Relationship]> as pd_rship
on (coalesce(pd_core.primary_student_id,'') = coalesce(pd_rship.primary_student_id,'')
    	and coalesce(pd_core.student_type,'') = coalesce(pd_rship.student_type,'')
	and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_term,'') = coalesce(pd_rship.current_entry_term,'')
	and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,'') = 
coalesce(pd_rship.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,''))
left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Test Scores]> as pd_test
on (coalesce(pd_core.primary_student_id,'') = coalesce(pd_test.primary_student_id,'')
    	and coalesce(pd_core.student_type,'') = coalesce(pd_test.student_type,'')
	and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_term,'') = coalesce(pd_test.current_entry_term,'')
	and coalesce(pd_core.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,'') = 
coalesce(pd_test.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,''))

sum(case when pd_core.inquiry_indicator_eab <> 'Unmapped Value'

sum(case when pd_core.prospect_indicator is not null then 1 else 0 end) as prospect_indicator,
sum(case when pd_core.inquiry_indicator_eab <> 'Unmapped Value' then to_number(pd_core.inquiry_indicator_eab) else null end) as inquiry_indicator_eab,

sum(case when pd_app_funn.deposit_confirmed_indicator_eab <> 'Unmapped Value' then to_number(pd_app_funn.deposit_confirmed_indicator_eab) else null end) as deposit_confirmed_indicator_eab,
sum(case when pd_app_funn.enrollment_indicator_eab <> 'Unmapped Value' then to_number(pd_app_funn.enrollment_indicator_eab) else null end) as enrollment_indicator_eab

	and coalesce(pd_core.entry_year_as_academic_year_eab,'') = coalesce(pd_app_funn.entry_year_as_academic_year_eab,''))
where pd_core.student_type_eab = 'Freshman'
and pd_core.entry_term_eab = 'Fall'
and pd_core.entry_year_as_academic_year_eab = '2021'

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
SELECT DISTINCT agg.*, 
CASE WHEN 
TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_1_adm,0)) + TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_2_adm,0)) + TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_3_adm,0)) + TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_4_adm,0)) > 0 
THEN '1'
ELSE '0' END AS admit_indicator_eab, 

CASE WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_4 LIKE '%Admit%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_4
WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_3 LIKE '%Admit%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_3
WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_2 LIKE '%Admit%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_2
WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_1 LIKE '%Admit%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_1
ELSE NULL END AS admit_date,

CASE WHEN 
TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_1_cond_adm,0)) + TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_2_cond_adm,0)) + TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_3_cond_adm,0)) + TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_4_cond_adm,0)) > 0 
THEN '1'
ELSE '0' END AS conditional_admit_indicator_eab, 

CASE WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_4 LIKE '%/Conditional%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_4
WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_3 LIKE '%/Conditional%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_3
WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_2 LIKE '%/Conditional%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_2
WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_1 LIKE '%/Conditional%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_1
ELSE NULL END AS conditional_admit_date,

CASE WHEN 
TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_1_deny,0)) + TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_2_deny,0)) + TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_3_deny,0)) + TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_4_deny,0)) > 0 
THEN '1'
ELSE '0' END AS deny_indicator_eab, 

CASE WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_4 LIKE '%Den%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_4
WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_3 LIKE '%Den%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_3
WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_2 LIKE '%Den%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_2
WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_1 LIKE '%Den%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_1
ELSE NULL END AS deny_date,

CASE WHEN 
TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_1_waitlist,0)) + TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_2_waitlist,0)) + TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_3_waitlist,0)) + TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_4_waitlist,0)) > 0 
THEN '1'
ELSE '0' END AS waitlisted_indicator_eab,

CASE WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_4 LIKE '%Waitlist%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_4
WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_3 LIKE '%Waitlist%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_3
WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_2 LIKE '%Waitlist%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_2
WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_1 LIKE '%Waitlist%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_1
ELSE NULL END AS waitlist_date,

CASE WHEN 
TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_1_withdraw,0)) + TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_2_withdraw,0)) + TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_3_withdraw,0)) + TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(agg.decision_status_4_withdraw,0)) > 0 
THEN '1'
ELSE '0' END AS withdrawal_indicator_eab,

CASE WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_4 LIKE '%Withdrawn%' OR agg.DECISION_STATUS_4 LIKE '%Decline%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_4
WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_3 LIKE '%Withdrawn%' OR agg.DECISION_STATUS_3 LIKE '%Decline%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_3
WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_2 LIKE '%Withdrawn%' OR agg.DECISION_STATUS_2 LIKE '%Decline%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_2
WHEN agg.DECISION_STATUS_1 LIKE '%Withdrawn%' OR agg.DECISION_STATUS_1 LIKE '%Decline%' THEN agg.DECISION_DATE_1
ELSE NULL END AS withdrawal_date

 --Withdraw Status Custom Logic

queryResults.querySql:
select agg.*,
case 
	when pd_app_funn.enrollment_indicator_eab = '1' then 'Enrolled'
	when pd_app_funn.deny_indicator_eab = '1' then 'Deny'
	when pd_app_funn.future_deferral_indicator_eab = '1' then 'Future Defer'
	when pd_app_funn.previous_deferral_indicator_eab = '1' then 'Previous Defer'
	when pd_app_funn.deposit_confirmed_indicator_eab = '1' and pd_app_funn.withdrawal_indicator_eab = '1' and (IFNULL(pd_app_funn.DEPOSIT_CONFIRMED_DATE,'1/1/1800') <= IFNULL(pd_app_funn.WITHDRAWAL_DATE,'12/31/9999')) then 'Melt'
	when pd_app_funn.deposit_confirmed_indicator_eab = '1' and pd_app_funn.CANCEL_DATE is not null and (IFNULL(pd_app_funn.DEPOSIT_CONFIRMED_DATE,'1/1/1800') <= IFNULL(pd_app_funn.CANCEL_DATE,'12/31/9999')) then 'Melt'
	when pd_app_funn.deposit_confirmed_indicator_eab  = '1' and IFNULL(pd_app_funn.withdrawal_indicator_eab,'0') = '0' then 'Net Deposit'
	when pd_app_funn.withdrawal_indicator_eab = '1' then 'Withdraw'  
	when pd_app_funn.CANCEL_DATE is not null then 'Withdraw'  	
	when pd_app_funn.readmit_indicator_eab = '1' then 'Readmit'
	when pd_app_funn.admit_indicator_eab = '1' then 'Uncommitted Admit'
	when pd_app_funn.conditional_admit_indicator_eab = '1' then 'Conditional Admit'
	when pd_app_funn.waitlisted_indicator_eab = '1' then 'Waitlist'
	when pd_app_funn.application_completed_indicator_eab = '1' then 'Completed Applicant'
	when pd_app_funn.application_incomplete_indicator_eab = '1' then 'Incomplete Applicant' 
	when pd_app_funn.application_started_indicator_eab = '1' then 'Started Applicant'
	when agg.inquiry_indicator_eab = '1' then 'Inquiry'
	else 'Prospect'
end as funnel_status_eab

from (
select distinct calculated_field_3, pd_core_rec.primary_student_id,

pd_core_rec.student_type,
case when pd_core_rec.student_type is null then 'Other' 
else coalesce(pcm_stud_type.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end student_type_eab,

pd_core_rec.current_entry_term,
case when pd_core_rec.current_entry_term is null then 'Fall' 
else coalesce(pcm_curr_entry_term.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end entry_term_eab,

pd_core_rec.current_entry_year_as_academic_year,
case when pd_core_rec.current_entry_year_as_academic_year is null then null
else coalesce(pcm_curr_entry_yr_acad.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end entry_year_as_academic_year_eab,

pd_core_rec.sis_student_id,
pd_core_rec.eab_student_id,
pd_core_rec.crm_student_id,
pd_core_rec.other_student_id,

pd_core_rec.first_name,
pd_core_rec.middle_name,
pd_core_rec.last_name,
pd_core_rec.preferred_first_name,

pd_core_rec.us_citizenship_status,
pd_core_rec.international_indicator_code,
case when pd_core_rec.international_indicator_code is null then null 
else coalesce(pcm_intl.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end international_indicator_eab,

substring(pd_core_rec.birth_date,0,10) as birth_date,
pd_core_rec.gender,
pd_core_rec.preferred_gender,
case when pd_core_rec.gender is null then 'Unknown' 
else coalesce(pcm_pref_gender.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end preferred_gender_eab,
pd_core_rec.religious_affiliation,

pd_core_rec.prospect_indicator,
substring(pd_core_rec.prospect_indicator_date,0,10) as prospect_indicator_date,
pd_core_rec.inquiry_indicator,
case when pd_core_rec.inquiry_indicator is null then '0' 
else coalesce(pcm_inq.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end inquiry_indicator_eab,
pd_core_rec.recruitment_status,

pd_core_rec.state_of_residence_for_tuition_purposes,
pd_core_rec.work_or_study_amount,
pd_core_rec.origin_source_code,
pd_core_rec.origin_source_date,

pd_core_rec.inquiry_first_source_code,
case when pd_core_rec.inquiry_first_source_code like 'Whiteboard%' then 'Marketed Search'
when pd_core_rec.inquiry_first_source_code is null then 'Unknown' 
else coalesce(pcm_first_src.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end inquiry_first_source_code_eab,
substring(pd_core_rec.inquiry_first_source_date,0,10) as inquiry_first_source_date,

pd_core_rec.athletic_recruit,
case when pd_core_rec.athletic_recruit is null then null
else coalesce(pcm_athletic_rec.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end athletic_recruit_eab,
pd_core_rec.athletic_recruit_primary_sport_description,

pd_core_rec.alumni_relationship,
case when pd_core_rec.alumni_relationship is null then null
else coalesce(pcm_alum.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end alumni_relationship_eab,

pd_core_rec.first_generation,
case when pd_core_rec.first_generation is null then null
else coalesce(pcm_first_gen.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end first_generation_indicator_eab,

pd_core_rec.years_of_work_experience,

pd_core_rec.military_service_or_veteran_status,
pd_core_rec.military_service_or_veteran_indicator_eab,
  
pd_core_rec.opt_out_indicator_general,
case when pd_core_rec.opt_out_indicator_general is null then null
else coalesce(pcm_opt_out.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end opt_out_indicator_general_eab,

pd_core_rec.academic_rating,
pd_core_rec.interest_rating,
pd_core_rec.student_level,
pd_core_rec.current_entry_year_as_calendar_year

from <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Core Record]> pd_core_rec

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_stud_type
on (pcm_stud_type.field_name = 'eab_student_type' and pcm_stud_type.partner_value = pd_core_rec.student_type)

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_curr_entry_term
on (pcm_curr_entry_term.field_name = 'eab_entry_term' and pcm_curr_entry_term.partner_value = pd_core_rec.current_entry_term)

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_curr_entry_yr_acad
on (pcm_curr_entry_yr_acad.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic' and pcm_curr_entry_yr_acad.partner_value = pd_core_rec.current_entry_year_as_academic_year)

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_intl
on (pcm_intl.field_name = 'eab_international_ind' and pcm_intl.partner_value = pd_core_rec.international_indicator_code)

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_pref_gender
on (pcm_pref_gender.field_name = 'eab_pref_gender' and pcm_pref_gender.partner_value = pd_core_rec.gender)

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_inq
on (pcm_inq.field_name = 'eab_inquiry_ind' and pcm_inq.partner_value = pd_core_rec.inquiry_indicator)

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_first_src
on (pcm_first_src.field_name = 'eab_first_source' and pcm_first_src.partner_value = pd_core_rec.inquiry_first_source_code)

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_athletic_rec
on (pcm_athletic_rec.field_name = 'eab_athletic_recruit_ind' and pcm_athletic_rec.partner_value = pd_core_rec.athletic_recruit)

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_alum
on (pcm_alum.field_name = 'eab_alumni_relation_ind' and pcm_alum.partner_value = pd_core_rec.alumni_relationship)

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_first_gen
on (pcm_first_gen.field_name = 'eab_first_gen_ind' and pcm_first_gen.partner_value = pd_core_rec.first_generation)
  
left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_opt_out
on (pcm_opt_out.field_name = 'eab_opt_out_ind' and pcm_opt_out.partner_value = pd_core_rec.opt_out_indicator_general)

) agg

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Application Funnel].{final}> pd_app_funn
on (agg.primary_student_id = pd_app_funn.primary_student_id
    and	coalesce(agg.student_type_eab,'') = coalesce(pd_app_funn.student_type_eab,'')
	and coalesce(agg.entry_term_eab,'') = coalesce(pd_app_funn.entry_term_eab,'')
	and coalesce(agg.entry_year_as_academic_year_eab,'') = coalesce(pd_app_funn.entry_year_as_academic_year_eab,''))
																	
where coalesce(agg.calculated_field_3,'') = 'H'
AND agg.primary_student_id NOT IN ('659639850', '813705685', '135722493', '611850754', '550236554', '975378693')

queryResults.querySql:
select agg.*
from (select distinct calculated_field_3, pd_fin_aid.primary_student_id,

case when pd_fin_aid.student_type is null then 'Other' 
else coalesce(pcm_stud_type.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end student_type_eab,

case when pd_fin_aid.current_entry_term is null then 'Fall' 
else coalesce(pcm_curr_entry_term.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end entry_term_eab,

case when pd_fin_aid.current_entry_year_as_academic_year is null then null
else coalesce(pcm_curr_entry_yr_acad.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end entry_year_as_academic_year_eab,

pd_fin_aid.financial_aid_student_id,
pd_fin_aid.intent_to_file_for_financial_aid,
pd_fin_aid.fafsa_submitted,
case when pd_fin_aid.fafsa_submitted is null then null
else coalesce(pcm_fafsa_sub.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end fafsa_submitted_eab,

/****8-15-22: pd_fin_aid.fafsa_submitted_date contains a handful of raw values from the partner that are Excel decimal formats or have extra characters after a space after the date but not a full timestamp. 
The regexp formula strips any characters after a space, including the space, and the try_to_timestamp will null out any dates that are not recognized as a timestamp including the Excel decimal dates.
This should prevent any downstream issues in PANTO. If decimal dates become more prevalent in partner data, may want to revisit this formula - ccreekman *****/
try_to_timestamp(regexp_replace(pd_fin_aid.fafsa_submitted_date,'[\\s].*','')) as fafsa_submitted_date,

substring(pd_fin_aid.first_fafsa_submitted_date,0,10) as first_fafsa_submitted_date,
substring(pd_fin_aid.most_recent_fafsa_submitted_date,0,10) as most_recent_fafsa_submitted_date,

pd_fin_aid.financial_aid_award_sent_status,
case when pd_fin_aid.financial_aid_award_sent_status is null then null
else coalesce(pcm_fa_award.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end financial_aid_award_sent_indicator_eab,
substring(pd_fin_aid.financial_aid_award_sent_date,0,10) as financial_aid_award_sent_date,

pd_fin_aid.css_profile_submitted,
substring(pd_fin_aid.css_profile_submitted_date,0,10) as css_profile_submitted_date,
case when pd_fin_aid.css_profile_submitted is null then null
else coalesce(pcm_css.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end css_profile_submitted_eab,

pd_fin_aid.merit_awards,
pd_fin_aid.need_awards,
pd_fin_aid.total_award_amount,
pd_fin_aid.cost_of_attendance,
pd_fin_aid.unmet_need_amount

from <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Financial Aid]> pd_fin_aid

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_stud_type
on (pcm_stud_type.field_name = 'eab_student_type' and pcm_stud_type.partner_value = pd_fin_aid.student_type)

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_curr_entry_term
on (pcm_curr_entry_term.field_name = 'eab_entry_term' and pcm_curr_entry_term.partner_value = pd_fin_aid.current_entry_term)

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_curr_entry_yr_acad
on (pcm_curr_entry_yr_acad.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic' and pcm_curr_entry_yr_acad.partner_value = pd_fin_aid.current_entry_year_as_academic_year)

queryResults.queryKey: enrollment_services/Partner Data Race and Ethnicity/Migration checks race ethnicity
queryResults.sqlPreview: /**** The first query is driven by the rollups. Counts may add up to higher than the number of students in the inquiry pool, if students have multiple races/eth…
queryResults.querySql:
/**** 
The first query is driven by the rollups. 
Counts may add up to higher than the number of students in the inquiry pool, if students have multiple races/ethnicities marked.
****/
select 
	pd_race_eth.entry_year_as_academic_year_eab, 
	pd_race_eth.entry_term_eab, 
	pd_race_eth.student_type_eab, 
	sum(case when pd_race_eth.ethnicity_eab = 'Hispanic or Latino/a/e/x' then 1 else 0 end) as hispanic,
	sum(cast(pd_race_eth.american_indian_or_alaska_native_eab as int)) as native_american,
	sum(cast(pd_race_eth.asian_eab as int)) as asian,
	sum(cast(pd_race_eth.black_or_african_american_eab as int)) as black,
	sum(cast(pd_race_eth.native_hawaiian_or_other_pacific_islander_eab as int)) as hawaiian_pacific,
	sum(cast(pd_race_eth.middle_eastern_eab as int)) as middle_eastern,
	sum(cast(pd_race_eth.white_eab as int)) as white,
	sum(cast(pd_race_eth.multiracial_eab as int)) as multiracial,
	sum(cast(pd_race_eth.prefer_not_to_respond_eab as int)) as prefer_not_to_respond,
	sum(cast(pd_race_eth.other_race_eab as int)) as other,
	sum(cast(pd_race_eth.unknown_eab as int)) as unknown
from <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Race and Ethnicity]> pd_race_eth
inner join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Core Record]> pd_core
	on pd_race_eth.primary_student_id = pd_core.primary_student_id
	and coalesce(pd_race_eth.student_type_eab,'') = coalesce(pd_core.student_type_eab,'')
	and coalesce(pd_race_eth.entry_year_as_academic_year_eab,'') = coalesce(pd_core.entry_year_as_academic_year_eab,'')
	and coalesce(pd_race_eth.entry_term_eab,'') = coalesce(pd_core.entry_term_eab,'')
where pd_core.funnel_status_eab <> 'Prospect'
group by 	
	pd_race_eth.entry_year_as_academic_year_eab, 
	pd_race_eth.entry_term_eab, 
	pd_race_eth.student_type_eab
having pd_race_eth.entry_year_as_academic_year_eab = 2021
	and pd_race_eth.entry_term_eab = 'Fall' 
	and pd_race_eth.student_type_eab = 'Freshman'
order by 1,2,3,4,5
;

/**** 
The second query is driven by the rollups. 
Good for checking that breakouts match rollup values, 
but will yield separate rows for each combination of ethnicities that a student could have.
****/

select 
	pd_race_eth.entry_year_as_academic_year_eab, 
	pd_race_eth.entry_term_eab, 
	pd_race_eth.student_type_eab, 
	pd_race_eth.race, -- ACU is not populating a race_eab field
	pd_race_eth.black_or_african_american,
	pd_race_eth.black_or_african_american_eab,
	pd_race_eth.ethnicity, 
	pd_race_eth.ethnicity_eab, 
	pd_race_eth.american_indian_or_alaska_native,
	pd_race_eth.american_indian_or_alaska_native_eab,
	pd_race_eth.asian,
	pd_race_eth.asian_eab,
	pd_race_eth.middle_eastern,
	pd_race_eth.middle_eastern_eab,
	pd_race_eth.native_hawaiian_or_other_pacific_islander,
	pd_race_eth.native_hawaiian_or_other_pacific_islander_eab,
	pd_race_eth.white,
	pd_race_eth.white_eab,
	pd_race_eth.multiracial,
	pd_race_eth.multiracial_eab,
	pd_race_eth.prefer_not_to_respond,
	pd_race_eth.prefer_not_to_respond_eab,
	pd_race_eth.other_race,
	pd_race_eth.other_race_eab,
	pd_race_eth.unknown,
	pd_race_eth.unknown_eab,
	pd_race_eth.race as race2, -- race is repeated just for ease of viewing rollup next to the counts
	count(*) as total_count,
	count(distinct pd_race_eth.primary_student_id) as distinct_count 
from <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Race and Ethnicity]> pd_race_eth
left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Core Record]> pd_core
	on coalesce(pd_race_eth.primary_student_id,'') = coalesce(pd_core.primary_student_id,'')
	and coalesce(pd_race_eth.student_type_eab,'') = coalesce(pd_core.student_type_eab,'')
	and coalesce(pd_race_eth.entry_year_as_academic_year_eab,'') = coalesce(pd_core.entry_year_as_academic_year_eab,'')
	and coalesce(pd_race_eth.entry_term_eab,'') = coalesce(pd_core.entry_term_eab,'')
where pd_core.funnel_status_eab <> 'Prospect'
group by 	
	pd_race_eth.entry_year_as_academic_year_eab, 
	pd_race_eth.entry_term_eab, 
	pd_race_eth.student_type_eab, 
	pd_race_eth.race, 
	pd_race_eth.black_or_african_american,
	pd_race_eth.black_or_african_american_eab,
	pd_race_eth.ethnicity, 
	pd_race_eth.ethnicity_eab, 
	pd_race_eth.american_indian_or_alaska_native,
	pd_race_eth.american_indian_or_alaska_native_eab,
	pd_race_eth.asian,
	pd_race_eth.asian_eab,
	pd_race_eth.middle_eastern,
	pd_race_eth.middle_eastern_eab,
	pd_race_eth.native_hawaiian_or_other_pacific_islander,
	pd_race_eth.native_hawaiian_or_other_pacific_islander_eab,
	pd_race_eth.white,
	pd_race_eth.white_eab,
	pd_race_eth.multiracial,
	pd_race_eth.multiracial_eab,
	pd_race_eth.prefer_not_to_respond,
	pd_race_eth.prefer_not_to_respond_eab,
	pd_race_eth.other_race,
	pd_race_eth.other_race_eab,
	pd_race_eth.unknown,
	pd_race_eth.unknown_eab
having pd_race_eth.entry_year_as_academic_year_eab > 2020
order by 1,2,3,4,5
;

queryResults.sqlPreview: select agg.* from ( select distinct calculated_field_3, pd_race_eth.primary_student_id, case when pd_race_eth.student_type is null then 'Other' else coalesce(pc…
queryResults.querySql:
select agg.*
from (
select distinct calculated_field_3, pd_race_eth.primary_student_id,

case when pd_race_eth.student_type is null then 'Other' 
else coalesce(pcm_stud_type.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end student_type_eab,

case when pd_race_eth.current_entry_term is null then 'Fall' 
else coalesce(pcm_curr_entry_term.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end entry_term_eab,

case when pd_race_eth.current_entry_year_as_academic_year is null then null
else coalesce(pcm_curr_entry_yr_acad.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
end entry_year_as_academic_year_eab,
 
case when pd_race_eth.race like '%Alaska Native%' then '1'
when pd_race_eth.race like '%Alaskan Native%' then '1'
when pd_race_eth.race like '%American Indian%' then '1'
when pd_race_eth.race like '%Native American%' then '1'
else null
end as american_indian_or_alaska_native_eab,
  
case when pd_race_eth.race like '%Asian%' then '1'
when pd_race_eth.race like '%Indian subcontinent%' then '1'
else null
end as asian_eab,

case when pd_race_eth.race like '%African%' then '1'
when pd_race_eth.race like '%Black%' then '1'
else null
end as black_or_african_american_eab,

case when pd_race_eth.race like '%Middle Eastern%' then '1'
else null
end as middle_eastern_eab,

case when pd_race_eth.race like '%More than one race%' then '1'
when pd_race_eth.race like '%Multiracial%' then '1'
when pd_race_eth.race like '%Two or More%' then '1'
else null
end as multiracial_eab,

case when pd_race_eth.race like '%not to answer%' then '1'
when pd_race_eth.race like '%Not to Respond%' then '1'
when pd_race_eth.race like '%not respond%' then '1'
else null
end as prefer_not_to_respond_eab,

case when pd_race_eth.race like '%Non resident Alien%' then '1'
when pd_race_eth.race like '%Other Ethnicity%' then '1'
when pd_race_eth.race = 'Other' then '1'
else null
end as other_race_eab,

case when pd_race_eth.race like '%Pacific Islander%' then '1'
when pd_race_eth.race like '%Hawaiian%' then '1'
else null
end as native_hawaiian_or_other_pacific_islander_eab,

case when pd_race_eth.race = 'Unknown' then '1'
else null
end as unknown_eab,

case when pd_race_eth.race like '%White%' then '1'
when pd_race_eth.race like '%Caucasian%' then '1'
else null
end as white_eab,

--Old ethnicity_eab Logic
--case when pd_race_eth.ethnicity is null then null 
--else coalesce(pcm_eth.eab_standard_value,'Unmapped Value')
--end ethnicity_eab,
  
--New ethnicity_eab Logic to correct 'Unmapped Value' issue
case when pd_race_eth.ethnicity like '%Hispanic%' then 'Hispanic or Latino/a/e/x'
when pd_race_eth.ethnicity like '%Latino%' then 'Hispanic or Latino/a/e/x'
when pd_race_eth.ethnicity is null then 'Unknown'
else 'Not Hispanic or Latino/a/e/x'
end as ethnicity_eab,

pd_race_eth.american_indian_or_alaska_native,
pd_race_eth.asian,
pd_race_eth.black_or_african_american,
pd_race_eth.middle_eastern,
pd_race_eth.multiracial,
pd_race_eth.prefer_not_to_respond,
pd_race_eth.other_race,
pd_race_eth.native_hawaiian_or_other_pacific_islander,
pd_race_eth.unknown,
pd_race_eth.white,
pd_race_eth.hispanic,
pd_race_eth.ethnicity,
pd_race_eth.race

from <[enrollment_services].[Partner Data Race and Ethnicity]> pd_race_eth

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_stud_type
on (pcm_stud_type.field_name = 'eab_student_type' and pcm_stud_type.partner_value = pd_race_eth.student_type)

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_curr_entry_term
on (pcm_curr_entry_term.field_name = 'eab_entry_term' and pcm_curr_entry_term.partner_value = pd_race_eth.current_entry_term)

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_curr_entry_yr_acad
on (pcm_curr_entry_yr_acad.field_name = 'eab_entry_year_academic' and pcm_curr_entry_yr_acad.partner_value = pd_race_eth.current_entry_year_as_academic_year)

left outer join <[enrollment_services].[Partner Code Mapping]> pcm_eth
on (pcm_eth.field_name = 'eab_ethnicity' AND pd_race_eth.ethnicity LIKE pcm_eth.partner_value)
  ) agg
  where coalesce(agg.calculated_field_3,'') = 'H'
  AND agg.primary_student_id NOT IN ('659639850', '813705685', '135722493', '611850754', '550236554', '975378693')

queryResults.sqlPreview: SELECT DISTINCT con.contact_key AS EAB_ID , csc2.source_label as LIST_NAME , con.first_name as FIRST_NAME , con.last_name as LAST_NAME , CASE WHEN con.email_add…
queryResults.querySql:
SELECT DISTINCT
con.contact_key AS EAB_ID
, csc2.source_label as LIST_NAME
, con.first_name as FIRST_NAME 
, con.last_name as LAST_NAME
, CASE 
	WHEN con.email_address like '%test.eab' THEN NULL 
	else con.email_address 
	END AS EMAIL_ADDRESS
, CASE 
	WHEN len(ceeb_data.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB) = '5' then CONCAT('0', ceeb_data.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB) 
	ELSE ceeb_data.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB 
	END as HS_CEEB
, con.current_grade_level AS CURRENT_GRADE_LEVEL
, con.grad_year as GRAD_YEAR
, to_char(to_date(ACON.create_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy') as FIRST_CONTACT_DATE
, case 
	when ACON.eng_cul_stu_inq_acsl ='TRUE' OR ACON.eng_cul_stu_reen_acsl='TRUE' OR ACON.eng_cul_stu_j_reen_acsl='TRUE' OR ACON.engaged_inq_cmpgn_acsl='TRUE' OR ACON.eng_cul_stu_paper_acsl ='TRUE' THEN 'TRUE' 
	ELSE NULL 
	END as ENGAGED_IN_CULTIVATE_INQUIRY_GENERATION_CAMPAIGN
, to_char(to_date(dnc1.email_optout_date),'mm/dd/yyyy') as EMAIL_OPTOUT_DATE
, to_char(to_date(current_timestamp()),'mm/dd/yyyy') as DATE_OF_FILE

from PDP.con__contact_assigned con 
inner join PDP.prc__partner_details as PD 
inner join PDP.prc__contact_acquia_xwalk xwalk on con.contact_key = xwalk.contact_key
inner join (
	SELECT DISTINCT acs_contact_id
	FROM PDP.acs__contact_activity as act
	INNER JOIN PDP.acs__emails as em on act.stat__email_id  = em.email_id
	INNER JOIN PDP.acs__categories as categ ON em.category_id = categ.category_id
	WHERE act.event = 'email.sent' 
	AND lower(categ.title) LIKE '%inquiry%generation%' 
  	--and  ( act.hit__dateHit > (dateadd(day,-10,current_timestamp())) or act.submission__datesubmitted > (dateadd(day,-10,current_timestamp())) )
	) atem on atem.acs_contact_id=xwalk.acs_contact_id
inner join PDP.acs__contacts ACON on atem.acs_contact_id = ACON.acs_contact_id
left join  PDP.add__sourcecontact_clean_addr adr on con.CLEAN_ADDR_KEY=adr.CLEAN_ADDR_KEY 
left join PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts csc on con.contact_key=csc.contact_key 
left join (
	select csc1.source_label,csc1.contact_key 
	from (
		select ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY csc.contact_key ORDER BY src.create_dt, csc.sourcecontact_id) as rn
		, src.source_label as source_label
	    , csc.contact_key
		FROM PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts as csc
		INNER JOIN pdp.crf__source as src on csc.source_key = src.source_key	
		) csc1 
		where rn = 1
		) csc2 on con.contact_key=csc2.contact_key

left join (
	select min(dnc.create_dt) as email_optout_date
	,dnc.acs_contact_id 
	from PDP.acs__contact_dnc dnc
 	where dnc.channel='email' 
 	group by acs_contact_id
 	) dnc1 on dnc1.acs_contact_id=xwalk.acs_contact_id
 
left join (
    SELECT DISTINCT con.CONTACT_KEY
    , MAX(ccf.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB) As HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB
    FROM PDP.con__contact_assigned con
    INNER JOIN PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts csc3 ON con.CONTACT_KEY = csc3.CONTACT_KEY
    INNER JOIN <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Contact].{combined_common_format}> ccf ON csc3.sourcecontact_id = ccf.sourcecontact_id
    WHERE ccf.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY con.CONTACT_KEY
	) ceeb_data ON con.CONTACT_KEY = ceeb_data.CONTACT_KEY

where 1=1
and con.contact_type_calc ='Student'

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

with CTE as (
  SELECT 
		con.first_name as parent_first_name,
		con.last_name as parent_last_name,
		con.email_address as parent_email,
		con.contact_key as parent_contact_key,

  --Bobby: to discuss on decision for priority
	FROM PDP.con__contact_assigned as con
	INNER JOIN PDP.con__contact_relations as rel
		on con.contact_key = rel.parent_contact_key
  )

DISTINCT con.contact_key as ROYALL_ID,
csc2.source_label as LIST_NAME,
'' AS ED_ID, -- oartner ID if available
'' as LETTER_CD,
CASE WHEN (con.gender) = 'Female' THEN 'Ms.'
	 WHEN (con.gender) = 'Male' THEN 'Mr.'else null END as NAME_PREFIX,
con.first_name as NAME_FIRST,
con.middle_name as NAME_MIDDLE,
con.last_name as NAME_LAST,
'' as NAME_PREFERRED,
con.suffix as NAME_SUFFIX,
adr.addr_2 as ADDRESS_LINE2,
adr.addr_1 as ADDRESS_LINE1,
adr.city as ADDRESS_CITY,
adr.state AS ADDRESS_STATE,
adr.zip5 AS ADDRESS_ZIPCODE,
CASE WHEN adr.country = 'United States' THEN Null else adr.postal_cd END as ADDRESS_POSTALCODE, -- Added case statement to address domestic records
adr.country as ADDRESS_COUNTRY,
--CASE WHEN to_char(to_date(con.birth_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy') like '%/1970' THEN NULL else to_char(to_date(con.birth_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy') END as BIRTH_DATE,
CASE WHEN to_char(to_date(con.birth_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy') like '%/1970' THEN NULL else right(to_char(to_date(con.birth_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy'),4) END AS DOB_YEAR,
CASE WHEN to_char(to_date(con.birth_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy') like '%/1970' THEN NULL else left(to_char(to_date(con.birth_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy'),2) END AS DOB_MONTH,
CASE WHEN to_char(to_date(con.birth_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy') like '%/1970' THEN NULL else substr(to_char(to_date(con.birth_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy'),4,2) END AS DOB_DAY,
con.gender AS GENDER,
'' AS GPA_LETTER,
CASE WHEN con.email_address like '%test.eab' THEN NULL else con.email_address END as EMAIL_ADDRESS,
case when lower(phn.<Phone Type>)='home' then phn.<Phone Number> else null end as PHONE_HOME,
CASE WHEN len(ceeb_data.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB) = '5' then CONCAT('0', ceeb_data.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB) ELSE ceeb_data.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB END as CEEB_CODE,
raw.hs_name AS HS_NAME,
CASE WHEN (raw.hs_address_2) = 'NULL' then Null else raw.hs_address_2 end as HS_ADDRESS_LINE2,
CASE WHEN (raw.hs_address_1) = 'NULL' then Null else raw.hs_address_1 end as HS_ADDRESS_LINE1,
CASE WHEN (raw.hs_city) = 'NULL' then Null else raw.hs_city end as HS_ADDRESS_CITY,
CASE WHEN (raw.hs_state) = 'NULL' then Null else raw.hs_state end as HS_ADDRESS_STATE, 
CASE WHEN (raw.hs_country) = 'NULL' then Null else raw.hs_country end as HS_ADDRESS_COUNTRY, 
CASE WHEN raw.hs_zip = '-9999' then NULL
	WHEN len(raw.hs_zip) = '4' then CONCAT('0', raw.hs_zip) ELSE raw.hs_zip END as HS_ADDRESS_ZIPCODE, 
raw.hs_foreign_postal AS HS_ADDRESS_POSTALCODE,
con.grad_year AS GRADUATION_YEAR,
CASE WHEN (att2.major_1) = 'Unmapped Value' then Null ELSE att2.major_1 END as MAJOR1,
CASE WHEN (att2.major_2) = 'Unmapped Value' then Null ELSE att2.major_2 END as MAJOR2,
'' AS MAJOR3,
'' AS MAJOR4,
'' AS MAJOR5,
'' AS ETHNICITY,
'' AS BLANK1,
'' AS BLANK2,
'' AS BLANK3,
'' AS BLANK4,
'' AS BLANK5,
'' AS BLANK6,
'' AS BLANK7,
'' AS PARENT1_NAME_PREFIX,
par1.parent1_first_name AS PARENT1_NAME_FIRST,
par1.parent1_last_name AS Parent1_NAME_LAST,
'' AS PARENT1_RELATIONSHIP,
par1.parent1_email AS PARENT1_EMAIL_ADDRESS,
'' AS PARENT2_NAME_PREFIX,
'' AS PARENT2_NAME_FIRST,
'' AS PARENT2_NAME_LAST,
'' AS PARENT2_NAME_RELATIONSHIP,
'' AS PARENT2_EMAIL_ADDRESS,
case when ACON.eng_cul_stu_inq_acsl ='TRUE' OR ACON.eng_cul_stu_reen_acsl='TRUE' OR ACON.eng_cul_stu_j_reen_acsl='TRUE' OR ACON.engaged_inq_cmpgn_acsl='TRUE' THEN 'EMAIL'
when ACON.eng_cul_stu_paper_acsl ='TRUE' THEN 'PAPER' ELSE NULL END AS REPLY_METHOD_ID,
'' AS REPLY_METHOD_DATE,
to_char(to_date(current_timestamp()),'mm/dd/yyyy') as CLIENT_EXPORT_DATE,
'' AS BLANK8,
case when lower(phn.<Phone Type>)='mobile' then phn.<Phone Number> else null end as PHONE_CELL,
'' AS FLAG_NAME,
'' AS FLAG_ADDRESS,
case when con.ethnicity = 'Hispanic or Latino/a/e/x' then 'Y' else null end AS FLAG_HISPANIC,
case when att1.race_1 = 'Black/African American' then 'AA' 
		when att1.race_2 = 'Black/African American' then 'AA' 
		when att1.race_3 = 'Black/African American' then 'AA'
		when att1.race_4 = 'Black/African American' then 'AA'
		when att1.race_5 = 'Black/African American' then 'AA' else null end as RACE1,
case when att1.race_1 = 'American Indian/Alaska Native' then 'AM' 
		when att1.race_2 = 'American Indian/Alaska Native' then 'AM' 
		when att1.race_3 = 'American Indian/Alaska Native' then 'AM'
		when att1.race_4 = 'American Indian/Alaska Native' then 'AM'
		when att1.race_5 = 'American Indian/Alaska Native' then 'AM' else null end as RACE2,

		when att1.race_2 = 'Asian' then 'AS' 
		when att1.race_3 = 'Asian' then 'AS'
		when att1.race_4 = 'Asian' then 'AS'
		when att1.race_5 = 'Asian' then 'AS' else null end as RACE3,
'' as RACE4,
case when att1.race_1 = 'White' then 'WH' 
		when att1.race_2 = 'White' then 'WH' 
		when att1.race_3 = 'White' then 'WH'
		when att1.race_2 = 'White' then 'WH' 
		when att1.race_4 = 'White' then 'WH'
		when att1.race_5 = 'White' then 'WH' else null end as RACE5,
case when ACON.eng_cul_stu_inq_acsl ='TRUE' OR ACON.eng_cul_stu_reen_acsl='TRUE' OR ACON.eng_cul_stu_j_reen_acsl='TRUE' OR ACON.engaged_inq_cmpgn_acsl='TRUE' OR
ACON.eng_cul_stu_paper_acsl ='TRUE' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE NULL END AS engaged_in_cultivate_inquiry_generation_camapaign,
to_char(to_date(dnc1.email_optout_date),'mm/dd/yyyy') as EMAIL_OPTOUT_DATE

FROM PDP.con__contact_assigned con inner join PDP.prc__partner_details as PD 

INNER join PDP.prc__contact_acquia_xwalk xwalk
on con.contact_key = xwalk.contact_key
		
INNER JOIN(
  SELECT DISTINCT acs_contact_id

INNER JOIN PDP.acs__emails as em on act.stat__email_id  = em.email_id
  
INNER JOIN PDP.acs__categories as categ ON em.category_id = categ.category_id
WHERE act.event = 'email.sent' 
AND lower(categ.title) LIKE '%inquiry%generation%' 
  --and  ( act.hit__dateHit > (dateadd(day,-10,current_timestamp())) or act.submission__datesubmitted > (dateadd(day,-10,current_timestamp())) )
    		UNION
  select DISTINCT acs_contact_id
from PDP.ACS__CONTACTS
where st_dt_cul_stu_inq_acsl is not null

		   )atem on atem.acs_contact_id=xwalk.acs_contact_id

		
Left join  PDP.add__sourcecontact_clean_addr adr 
 on con.CLEAN_ADDR_KEY=adr.CLEAN_ADDR_KEY 
		
LEFT JOIN  <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Phone]> as phn
ON phn.phone_number=con.phone_number
		
left join PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts csc on con.contact_key=csc.contact_key left join (
	select d.contact_key as cont_key,d.sourcecontact_id as src_contact_id,max(CASE WHEN d.ranc=1 THEN d.race else null END) as race_1,
max(CASE WHEN d.ranc=2 THEN d.race else null END) as race_2,
max(CASE WHEN d.ranc=3 THEN d.race else null END) as race_3 ,
max(CASE WHEN d.ranc=4 THEN d.race else null END) as race_4,
max(CASE WHEN d.ranc=5 THEN d.race else null END) as race_5 from

	  from PDP.con__contact_attributes_combined att where att.attribute_type='academic_interest') d group by 1)att2  on att2.cont_key=con.contact_key


LEFT JOIN
(select csc1.source_label,csc1.contact_key from (

INNER JOIN pdp.crf__source as src on csc.source_key = src.source_key

on con.contact_key=csc2.contact_key

		
	left join
(select min(act.stat__dateSent) as first_contact_date,act.acs_contact_id as acs_contact_id from  PDP.acs__contact_activity act 
 where act.eventType = 'Email sent' and  ( act.hit__dateHit > (dateadd(day,-10,current_timestamp())) or 
 act.submission__datesubmitted > (dateadd(day,-10,current_timestamp()))) group by act.acs_contact_id)act1 on act1.acs_contact_id=xwalk.acs_contact_id
left join
(
select act.acs_contact_id, act.hit__dateHit as min_date, act.stat__dateSent as reply_date

from PDP.acs__contact_activity act 
where act.eventType in('Page hit','Form submitted') and ( act.hit__dateHit > (dateadd(day,-10,current_timestamp())) or 
 act.submission__datesubmitted > (dateadd(day,-10,current_timestamp())))
)act2 on act2.acs_contact_id=xwalk.acs_contact_id and act2.rn = 1

		
	left join (
	select min(dnc.create_dt) as email_optout_date
	,dnc.acs_contact_id 
	from PDP.acs__contact_dnc dnc
 	where dnc.channel='email' 
 	group by acs_contact_id
 	) dnc1 on dnc1.acs_contact_id=xwalk.acs_contact_id							  
								  
--(select min(dnc.create_dt) as email_optout_date,dnc.acs_contact_id from PDP.acs__contact_dnc dnc
 --where dnc.channel='email' and dnc.create_dt > (dateadd(day,-10,current_timestamp())) group by acs_contact_id)dnc1 on dnc1.acs_contact_id=xwalk.acs_contact_id

		/*left join
(SELECT 
		tst.<Contact Key> as contact_key ,
		tst.<Test Type> as test_type,
		CAST(tst.<Score Range Maximum> as varchar)||'-'|| CAST(tst.<Score Range Minimum> as varchar) as score_band
	FROM <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Contact Test Scores]> tst
) as tst1 on con.contact_key = tst1.contact_key 
	AND CASE WHEN csc2.source_label LIKE '%ACT%' THEN 'ACT' ELSE 'SAT' END = tst1.test_type */
	
inner join PDP.acs__contacts ACON
		on atem.acs_contact_id = ACON.acs_contact_id		
		
		
left join
(select pr1.parent1_first_name,pr1.parent1_last_name,pr1.parent1_email,pr1.student_contact_key from 
(select
ct.parent_first_name as parent1_first_name,
ct.parent_last_name as parent1_last_name ,
ct.parent_email as parent1_email,
 ct.student_contact_key as student_contact_key,
 ct.rn as rank from CTE ct)pr1 where pr1.rank=1)par1 on 
con.contact_key = par1.student_contact_key
left join
(select pr2.parent2_first_name,pr2.parent2_last_name,pr2.parent2_email,pr2.student_contact_key from 
(select
ct.parent_first_name as parent2_first_name,
ct.parent_last_name as parent2_last_name ,
ct.parent_email as parent2_email,
 ct.student_contact_key as student_contact_key,
 ct.rn as rank from CTE ct)pr2 where pr2.rank=1)par2 on 
con.contact_key = par2.student_contact_key

left join
(select 
 ceeb_cd ,
high_school_name as hs_name,
addr1 as HS_ADDRESS_1,
addr2 as HS_ADDRESS_2,
city as hs_city,
state as hs_state,
zip5 as hs_zip,
null as hs_country,
null as HS_FOREIGN_POSTAL
from es_pdp_common.common.hs_ceeb_raw) raw
 on raw.ceeb_cd=con.hs_ceeb
 
 left join 
 (
    SELECT DISTINCT con.CONTACT_KEY, MAX(ccf.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB) As HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB
    FROM PDP.con__contact_assigned con
    INNER JOIN PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts csc3 ON con.CONTACT_KEY = csc3.CONTACT_KEY
    INNER JOIN <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Contact].{combined_common_format}> ccf ON csc3.sourcecontact_id = ccf.sourcecontact_id
    WHERE ccf.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY con.CONTACT_KEY

SELECT distinct con.contact_key AS EAB_ID
, '' AS PARTNER_ID
, con.contact_type_calc AS CONTACT_TYPE
, csc2.source_label as LIST_NAME
, con.first_name as FIRST_NAME 
, con.last_name as LAST_NAME
, con.suffix AS SUFFIX
,CASE WHEN to_char(to_date(con.birth_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy') like '%/1970' THEN NULL else to_char(to_date(con.birth_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy') END as birth_date
, CASE 
	WHEN con.email_address like '%test.eab' THEN NULL 
	else con.email_address 
	END AS EMAIL_ADDRESS
, CASE 
	WHEN len(ceeb_data.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB) = '5' then CONCAT('0', ceeb_data.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB) 
	ELSE ceeb_data.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB 
	END as HS_CEEB
, con.current_grade_level AS CURRENT_GRADE_LEVEL
, con.grad_year as GRAD_YEAR
, to_char(to_date(ACON.create_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy') as FIRST_CONTACT_DATE
, case 
	when ACON.eng_cul_stu_inq_acsl ='TRUE' OR ACON.eng_cul_stu_reen_acsl='TRUE' OR ACON.eng_cul_stu_j_reen_acsl='TRUE' OR ACON.engaged_inq_cmpgn_acsl='TRUE' OR ACON.eng_cul_stu_paper_acsl ='TRUE' THEN 'TRUE' 
	ELSE NULL 
	END as ENGAGED_IN_CULTIVATE_INQUIRY_GENERATION_CAMPAIGN
, to_char(to_date(dnc1.email_optout_date),'mm/dd/yyyy') as EMAIL_OPTOUT_DATE
, to_char(to_date(current_timestamp()),'mm/dd/yyyy') as DATE_OF_FILE

from PDP.con__contact_assigned con 
inner join PDP.prc__contact_acquia_xwalk xwalk on con.contact_key = xwalk.contact_key
inner join (
	SELECT DISTINCT acs_contact_id
	FROM PDP.acs__contact_activity as act
	INNER JOIN PDP.acs__emails as em on act.stat__email_id  = em.email_id
	INNER JOIN PDP.acs__categories as categ ON em.category_id = categ.category_id
	WHERE act.event = 'email.sent' 
	AND lower(categ.title) LIKE '%inquiry%generation%' 
  	--and  ( act.hit__dateHit > (dateadd(day,-10,current_timestamp())) or act.submission__datesubmitted > (dateadd(day,-10,current_timestamp())) )
	) atem on atem.acs_contact_id=xwalk.acs_contact_id
inner join PDP.acs__contacts ACON on xwalk.acs_contact_id = ACON.acs_contact_id
left join (
	select csc1.source_label,csc1.contact_key 
	from (
		select ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY csc.contact_key ORDER BY src.create_dt, csc.sourcecontact_id) as rn
		, src.source_label as source_label
	    , csc.contact_key
		FROM PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts as csc
		INNER JOIN pdp.crf__source as src on csc.source_key = src.source_key	
		) csc1 
		where rn = 1
		) csc2 on con.contact_key=csc2.contact_key
left join (
	select min(dnc.create_dt) as email_optout_date
	,dnc.acs_contact_id 
	from PDP.acs__contact_dnc dnc
 	where dnc.channel='email' 
 	group by acs_contact_id
 	) dnc1 on dnc1.acs_contact_id=xwalk.acs_contact_id
left join (
    SELECT DISTINCT con.CONTACT_KEY
    , MAX(ccf.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB) As HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB
    FROM PDP.con__contact_assigned con
    INNER JOIN PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts csc3 ON con.CONTACT_KEY = csc3.CONTACT_KEY
    INNER JOIN <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Contact].{combined_common_format}> ccf ON csc3.sourcecontact_id = ccf.sourcecontact_id
    WHERE ccf.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY con.CONTACT_KEY
	) ceeb_data ON con.CONTACT_KEY = ceeb_data.CONTACT_KEY
where 1=1
and con.contact_type_calc ='Student'

queryResults.querySql:
with CTE as (
  SELECT 
		con.first_name as parent_first_name,
		con.last_name as parent_last_name,
		con.email_address as parent_email,
		con.contact_key as parent_contact_key,
		rel.student_contact_key as student_contact_key,
 con.contact_type_calc as contact_type,
row_number() over (partition by rel.student_contact_key order by con.contact_key) as rn
  --Bobby: to discuss on decision for priority
	FROM PDP.con__contact_assigned as con
	INNER JOIN PDP.con__contact_relations as rel
		on con.contact_key = rel.parent_contact_key
  )
SELECT DISTINCT
con.contact_key as eab_id,
null as partner_id,
 con.contact_type_calc as contact_type,
csc2.source_label as list_name,
null as letter_cd, -- would like to return some version of 'EVENTLABEL_LABEL' from the contact activity table
--null as letter_code, -- need the description of the response
CASE WHEN (con.gender) = 'Female' THEN 'Ms.'
	 WHEN (con.gender) = 'Male' THEN 'Mr.'else null END as prefix,
con.first_name,
con.middle_name,
con.last_name,
null as preferred_name,
con.suffix,
adr.addr_1 as address_1, -- does not return with punctuation
adr.addr_2 as address_2,
adr.city,
adr.state, -- description (not an abbreviation)
adr.zip5 as zip, -- updated from zip5 to include the additional zip4 in the postal_cd
CASE WHEN adr.country = 'United States' THEN Null else adr.postal_cd END as foreign_postal_code, -- Added case statement to address domestic records
adr.country as country,

CASE WHEN to_char(to_date(con.birth_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy') like '%/1970' THEN NULL else to_char(to_date(con.birth_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy') END as birth_date, -- updated with case statement to eliminate bad birth dates like 1970 -- 09/30/2021 S. Beasley
--to_char(to_date(con.birth_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy') as birth_date_bad, -- format needs to be updated to MM/DD/YYYY
con.gender,
null as gpa,
CASE WHEN con.email_address like '%test.eab' THEN NULL else con.email_address END as email_address, -- updated with case statement to eliminate test email addresses for mailin -- 09/30/2021 S. Beasley
case when lower(phn.<Phone Type>)='home' then phn.<Phone Number> else null end as home_phone,
--case when lower(phn.<Phone Type>)='home' then insert(to_varchar(phn.<Phone Number>),'-',4,0) else null end as home_phone_converted,
case when lower(phn.<Phone Type>)='mobile' then phn.<Phone Number> else null end as cell_phone,
--case when lower(phn.<Phone Type>)='mobile' then insert(to_varchar(phn.<Phone Number>),'-',4,0) else null end as cell_phone_converted,
phn.<Optin Sms Indicator> as text_message_opt_in,
--con.<High School CEEB> as hs_ceeb, -- do not use, returns with missing leading zero
CASE WHEN len(ceeb_data.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB) = '5' then CONCAT('0', ceeb_data.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB) ELSE ceeb_data.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB END as hs_ceeb,
--len(con.<High School CEEB>) as hs_ceeb_length,
raw.hs_name,
CASE WHEN (raw.hs_address_1) = 'NULL' then Null else raw.hs_address_1 end as hs_address_1, -- updated to remove the word NULL in the data return -- 09/30/2021 S. Beasley
CASE WHEN (raw.hs_address_2) = 'NULL' then Null else raw.hs_address_2 end as hs_address_2, -- updated to remove the word NULL in the data return -- 09/30/2021 S. Beasley
CASE WHEN (raw.hs_city) = 'NULL' then Null else raw.hs_city end as hs_city, -- updated to remove the word NULL in the data return -- 09/30/2021 S. Beasley
CASE WHEN (raw.hs_state) = 'NULL' then Null else raw.hs_state end as hs_state, -- updated to remove the word NULL in the data return -- 09/30/2021 S. Beasley
CASE WHEN (raw.hs_country) = 'NULL' then Null else raw.hs_country end as hs_country, -- updated to remove the word NULL in the data return -- 09/30/2021 S. Beasley
CASE WHEN raw.hs_zip = '-9999' then NULL
	WHEN len(raw.hs_zip) = '4' then CONCAT('0', raw.hs_zip) ELSE raw.hs_zip END as hs_zip, -- updated to remove '-9999' and add in leading zeros being dropped -- 09/30/2021 S. Beasley
raw.hs_foreign_postal,

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

  SELECT

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.
