queryResults.sqlPreview: SELECT distinct con.contact_key AS EAB_ID , '' AS PARTNER_ID , con.contact_type_calc AS CONTACT_TYPE , csc2.source_label as LIST_NAME , con.first_name as FIRST_…
queryResults.querySql:
SELECT distinct con.contact_key AS EAB_ID
, '' AS PARTNER_ID
, con.contact_type_calc AS CONTACT_TYPE
, csc2.source_label as LIST_NAME
, con.first_name as FIRST_NAME 
, con.last_name as LAST_NAME
, con.suffix AS SUFFIX
,CASE WHEN to_char(to_date(con.birth_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy') like '%/1970' THEN NULL else to_char(to_date(con.birth_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy') END as birth_date
, CASE 
	WHEN con.email_address like '%test.eab' THEN NULL 
	else con.email_address 
	END AS EMAIL_ADDRESS
, CASE 
	WHEN len(ceeb_data.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB) = '5' then CONCAT('0', ceeb_data.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB) 
	ELSE ceeb_data.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB 
	END as HS_CEEB
, con.current_grade_level AS CURRENT_GRADE_LEVEL
, con.grad_year as GRAD_YEAR
, to_char(to_date(ACON.create_dt),'mm/dd/yyyy') as FIRST_CONTACT_DATE
, case 
	when acon.eng_app_stu_gen_acsl = 'TRUE'
		or acon.ENG_APP_STU_PAPER_ACSL = 'TRUE'
		or acon.ENG_APP_STU_SUB_ACSL = 'TRUE'
		THEN 'TRUE' 
	ELSE NULL 
	END as ENGAGED_IN_APPLY_CAMPAIGN
, to_char(to_date(dnc1.email_optout_date),'mm/dd/yyyy') as EMAIL_OPTOUT_DATE
, to_char(to_date(current_timestamp()),'mm/dd/yyyy') as DATE_OF_FILE

from PDP.con__contact_assigned con 
inner join PDP.prc__contact_acquia_xwalk xwalk on con.contact_key = xwalk.contact_key
inner join (
	SELECT DISTINCT acs_contact_id
	FROM PDP.acs__contact_activity as act
	INNER JOIN PDP.acs__emails as em on act.stat__email_id  = em.email_id
	INNER JOIN PDP.acs__categories as categ ON em.category_id = categ.category_id
	WHERE act.event = 'email.sent' 
	AND lower(categ.title) LIKE '%apply%' 
  	--and  ( act.hit__dateHit > (dateadd(day,-10,current_timestamp())) or act.submission__datesubmitted > (dateadd(day,-10,current_timestamp())) )
	) atem on atem.acs_contact_id=xwalk.acs_contact_id
inner join PDP.acs__contacts ACON on xwalk.acs_contact_id = ACON.acs_contact_id
left join (
	select csc1.source_label,csc1.contact_key 
	from (
		select ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY csc.contact_key ORDER BY src.create_dt, csc.sourcecontact_id) as rn
		, src.source_label as source_label
	    , csc.contact_key
		FROM PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts as csc
		INNER JOIN pdp.crf__source as src on csc.source_key = src.source_key	
		) csc1 
		where rn = 1
		) csc2 on con.contact_key=csc2.contact_key
left join (
	select min(dnc.create_dt) as email_optout_date
	,dnc.acs_contact_id 
	from PDP.acs__contact_dnc dnc
 	where dnc.channel='email' 
 	group by acs_contact_id
 	) dnc1 on dnc1.acs_contact_id=xwalk.acs_contact_id
left join (
    SELECT DISTINCT con.CONTACT_KEY
    , MAX(ccf.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB) As HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB
    FROM PDP.con__contact_assigned con
    INNER JOIN PDP.crf__contact_sourcecontacts csc3 ON con.CONTACT_KEY = csc3.CONTACT_KEY
    INNER JOIN <[Partner_Data_Platform].[Contact].{combined_common_format}> ccf ON csc3.sourcecontact_id = ccf.sourcecontact_id
    WHERE ccf.HIGH_SCHOOL_CEEB IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY con.CONTACT_KEY
	) ceeb_data ON con.CONTACT_KEY = ceeb_data.CONTACT_KEY
where 1=1
and con.contact_type_calc ='Student'

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
WITH a_student_term AS
(
         SELECT   student_classification_code          AS student_classification_cd ,
                  campus_code                          AS campus_cd ,
                  department_code                      AS department_cd ,
                  student_time_status_code             AS student_time_status_cd ,
                  residency_code                       AS residency_cd ,
                  financial_aid_applicant_indicator    AS fin_aid_applicant_ind ,
                  housing_indicator                    AS housing_ind ,
                  institution_aid_recipient_indicator  AS inst_aid_recipient_ind ,
                  deans_list_indicator                 AS deans_list_ind ,
                  registered_indicator                 AS registered_ind ,
                  admitted_indicator                   AS admit_ind ,
                  transfer_student_indicator           AS transfer_student_ind ,
                  applied_for_graduation_indicator     AS applied_for_graduation_ind ,
                  graduated_indicator                  AS graduated_ind ,
                  total_registered_credits             AS total_registered_credits ,
                  earned_credits_cml_by_transfer       AS transfer_credits ,
                  attempted_credits_institution        AS attempted_credits ,
                  earned_credits_cml_by_transfer       AS earned_credits ,
                  passed_credits                       AS passed_credits ,
                  cumulative_gpa                       AS cumulative_gpa ,
                  gpa_type                             AS gpa_type ,
                  official_gpa_indicator               AS official_gpa_ind ,
                  major_code_1                         AS major_cd_1 ,
                  major_code_2                         AS major_cd_2 ,
                  major_code_3                         AS major_cd_3 ,
                  major_code_4                         AS major_cd_4 ,
                  concentration_code_1                 AS concentration_cd_1 ,
                  concentration_code_2                 AS concentration_cd_2 ,
                  concentration_code_3                 AS concentration_cd_3 ,
                  concentration_code_4                 AS concentration_cd_4 ,
                  intended_year_of_graduation          AS intended_year_of_graduation ,
                  transferred_out_indicator            AS transferred_out_of_inst_ind ,
                  withdrawal_indicator                 AS withdrawal_ind ,
                  withdrawal_reason                    AS withdrawal_reason ,
                  registration_start_date              AS registration_start_date ,
                  registration_end_date                AS registration_end_date ,
                  exploratory_major_code               AS exploratory_major_cd ,
                  degree_code_1                        AS degree_cd_1 ,
                  degree_code_2                        AS degree_cd_2 ,
                  degree_code_3                        AS degree_cd_3 ,
                  degree_code_4                        AS degree_cd_4 ,
                  major_gpa                            AS major_gpa ,
                  lifetime_transfer_credits            AS lifetime_transfer_credits ,
                  lifetime_overall_credits             AS lifetime_earned_credits ,
                  lifetime_credits_at_institution      AS lifetime_credits_at_inst ,
                  lifetime_attempted_credits           AS lifetime_attempted_credits ,
                  academic_standing                    AS academic_standing ,
                  college_code_2                       AS college_cd_2 ,
                  college_code_3                       AS college_cd_3 ,
                  college_code_4                       AS college_cd_4 ,
                  registered_indicator                 AS i_quality_points ,
                  registered_indicator                 AS i_gpa_hours ,
                  student_identifier                   AS student_id ,
                  academic_period                      AS academic_period ,
                  college_code                         AS college_cd ,
                  Row_number() OVER (ORDER BY 1 ASC )  AS rownumber
         FROM     <[HEDGSS].[GLBEXTR].[Current Batch]> AS st_16
         WHERE    NOT (
                           st_16.student_identifier IS NULL
                  OR       (
                                    length(st_16.student_identifier) > 0
                           AND      trim(st_16.student_identifier) = '' )
                  OR       st_16.academic_period IS NULL
                  OR       (
                                    length(st_16.academic_period) > 0
                           AND      trim(st_16.academic_period) = '' ) ) ) ,bf_df_values AS
(
         SELECT   student_id ,
                  academic_period,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             campus_cd IS NULL
                                    OR       trim(campus_cd)='') THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period) AS campus_partition_downfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             campus_cd IS NULL
                                    OR       trim(campus_cd)='') THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period DESC) AS campus_partition_backfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             department_cd IS NULL
                                    OR       trim(department_cd)='') THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period) AS department_partition_downfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             department_cd IS NULL
                                    OR       trim(department_cd)='') THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period DESC) AS department_partition_backfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             residency_cd IS NULL
                                    OR       trim(residency_cd)='') THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period) AS residency_partition_downfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             residency_cd IS NULL
                                    OR       trim(residency_cd)='') THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period DESC) AS residency_partition_backfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             student_classification_cd IS NULL
                                    OR       trim(student_classification_cd)='') THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period) AS student_classification_partition_downfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             student_classification_cd IS NULL
                                    OR       trim(student_classification_cd)='') THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period DESC) AS student_classification_partition_backfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             academic_standing IS NULL
                                    OR       trim(academic_standing)='') THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period) AS acad_standing_partition_downfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                    OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='') THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period) AS major_code_1_downfill,
                  sum(

                                             major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                    OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='') THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period DESC) AS major_code_1_backfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      major_cd_2 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_2) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period) AS major_code_2_downfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_2 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_2) ='') ) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period DESC) AS major_code_2_backfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      major_cd_3 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_3) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_2 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_2) ='') ) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period DESC) AS major_code_3_backfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      major_cd_3 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_3) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_2 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_2) ='') ) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period) AS major_code_3_downfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      major_cd_4 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_4) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_2 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_2) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_3 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_3) ='') ) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period DESC) AS major_code_4_backfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      major_cd_4 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_4) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_2 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_2) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_3 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_3) ='')) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period) AS major_code_4_downfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      concentration_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(concentration_cd_1) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period) AS concentration_code_1_downfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      concentration_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(concentration_cd_1) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period DESC) AS concentration_code_1_backfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      concentration_cd_2 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(concentration_cd_2) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period) AS concentration_code_2_downfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      concentration_cd_2 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(concentration_cd_2) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period DESC) AS concentration_code_2_backfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      concentration_cd_3 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(concentration_cd_3) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_2 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_2) ='')) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period) AS concentration_code_3_downfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      concentration_cd_3 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(concentration_cd_3) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_2 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_2) ='')) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period DESC) AS concentration_code_3_backfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      degree_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(degree_cd_1) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period) AS degree_code_1_downfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      degree_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(degree_cd_1) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period DESC) AS degree_code_1_backfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      degree_cd_2 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(degree_cd_2) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period) AS degree_code_2_downfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      degree_cd_2 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(degree_cd_2) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period DESC) AS degree_code_2_backfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      degree_cd_3 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(degree_cd_3) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_2 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_2) ='')) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period) AS degree_code_3_downfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             (
                                                      degree_cd_3 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(degree_cd_3) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_1 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_1) ='')
                                    AND      (
                                                      major_cd_2 IS NULL
                                             OR       trim(major_cd_2) ='')) THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period DESC) AS degree_code_3_backfill,
                  sum(
                  CASE
                           WHEN (
                                             college_cd IS NULL
                                    OR       trim(college_cd)='') THEN 0
                           ELSE 1
                  END) OVER (ORDER BY student_id, academic_period) AS coll1_partition_downfill,

                                    AND      (

SELECT st_sweep.student_time_status_cd        AS student_time_status_cd,

       st_sweep.intended_year_of_graduation   AS intended_year_of_graduation,
       st_sweep.deans_list_ind                AS deans_list_ind,
       st_sweep.applied_for_graduation_ind    AS applied_for_graduation_ind,
       st_sweep.inst_aid_recipient_ind        AS inst_aid_recipient_ind,
       st_sweep.campus_cd_new                 AS campus_cd,
       st_sweep.department_cd_new             AS department_cd,
       st_sweep.residency_cd_new              AS residency_cd,
       st_sweep.student_classification_cd_new AS student_classification_cd,
       st_sweep.academic_standing_new         AS academic_standing,
       st_sweep.major_cd_1_new                AS major_cd_1,
       st_sweep.major_cd_2_new                AS major_cd_2,
       st_sweep.major_cd_3_new                AS major_cd_3,
       st_sweep.major_cd_4_new                AS major_cd_4,
       st_sweep.concentration_cd_2_new        AS concentration_cd_2,
       st_sweep.concentration_cd_3_new        AS concentration_cd_3,
       st_sweep.concentration_cd_4            AS concentration_cd_4,
       st_sweep.degree_cd_1_new               AS degree_cd_1,
       st_sweep.degree_cd_2_new               AS degree_cd_2,
       st_sweep.degree_cd_3_new               AS degree_cd_3,
       st_sweep.degree_cd_4                   AS degree_cd_4,
       st_sweep.college_cd_1_new              AS college_cd,

       st_sweep.college_cd_3_new              AS college_cd_3,
       st_sweep.college_cd_4                  AS college_cd_4

                SELECT   st.*,

                  <degree_code_1_downfill> AS degree_code_1_downfill,

       st_sweep.college_cd_4                  AS college_cd_4

                SELECT   st.*,
                         <major_cd_1_new> AS major_cd_1_new ,

                         <major_cd_3_new> AS major_cd_3_new ,
                         <major_cd_4_new> AS major_cd_4_new,
                         <college_cd_1_new> AS college_cd_1_new ,

                         <concentration_cd_2_new> AS concentration_cd_2_new ,
                         <concentration_cd_3_new> AS concentration_cd_3_new ,
                         <campus_cd_new> AS campus_cd_new ,
                         <department_cd_new> AS department_cd_new ,

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.sqlPreview: select s.primary_student_id AS primary_student_id , st.current_entry_year_as_academic_year AS curr_entry_year_academic , st.current_entry_term AS curr_entry_ter…
queryResults.querySql:
select 
s.primary_student_id AS primary_student_id
, st.current_entry_year_as_academic_year AS curr_entry_year_academic
, st.current_entry_term AS curr_entry_term
, st.student_type AS student_type
, sa.zip_code AS zip
, sa.state_or_province AS state
, sa.country AS country
, coalesce(international_indicator,'FALSE') AS international_ind
, st.inquiry_indicator AS inquiry_ind
, sta.application_incomplete_indicator AS app_submit_ind
, sta.application_completed_indicator AS app_complete_ind
, sta.admit_indicator AS admit_ind
, sta.deposit_confirmed_indicator AS deposit_ind
, case
	when sta.enrollment_indicator like '2%' then 'TRUE'
	else sta.enrollment_indicator 
	end AS enroll_ind

from <[Enroll360].[Student]> as s
join <[Enroll360].[Student Term]> as st on s.primary_student_id = st.primary_student_id
left outer join 
(
select s.*, row_number() over (partition by primary_student_id order by address_type) rn
from <[Enroll360].[Student Address]> as s
  ) sa on s.primary_student_id = sa.primary_student_id and sa.rn = 1
left outer join <[Enroll360].[Student Term Application]> sta
	on s.primary_student_id = sta.primary_student_id
	and st.current_entry_term = sta.current_entry_term
	and st.current_entry_year_as_academic_year = sta.current_entry_year_as_academic_year
	and st.student_type = sta.student_type
where 1=1
--and s.international_indicator = 'TRUE'
order by s.primary_student_id
, st.current_entry_year_as_academic_year
, st.current_entry_term

WITH nums10 AS (
  SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
  UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
seq AS (
  SELECT
    (a.n - 1) * 1000
    + (b.n - 1) * 100
    + (c.n - 1) * 10
    + d.n AS rn
  FROM nums10 a
  CROSS JOIN nums10 b
  CROSS JOIN nums10 c
  CROSS JOIN nums10 d
),

  UNION ALL SELECT 3, '811 7th Ave',                 'New York',      'NY', '10019'
  UNION ALL SELECT 4, '350 5th Ave',                 'New York',      'NY', '10118'

queryResults.querySql:
WITH SOURCE AS
(SELECT
<Address 1> AS AddressLine1,
<Address 2> AS AddressLine2,
<City> AS City,
<Country> AS Country,
NULL AS FirstName,
NULL AS FullName,
NULL AS LastName,
<Zip5> AS PostalCode,
<State> AS State,
CONCAT(COALESCE(<Sourcecontact ID>, ''),'|',COALESCE(<Contact Key ACS>, ''),'|',COALESCE(<Raw Address Hash>, '')) AS RecordID
FROM <Source Data> AS source)
SELECT 
s.AddressLine1,
s.AddressLine2,
s.City,
s.Country,
s.FirstName,
s.FullName,
s.LastName,
s.PostalCode,
s.State,
s.RecordID
FROM SOURCE AS s
LEFT JOIN PDP_UG.log__cass_transactions AS log_cass
ON s.RecordID = log_cass.raw_addr_key
AND log_cass.action_type = 'Sent to CASS'
WHERE s.AddressLine1 IS NOT NULL
  AND s.State IS NOT NULL
  AND s.PostalCode IS NOT NULL
  AND log_cass.raw_addr_key IS NULL

queryResults.sqlPreview: select subject_code, course_number, term_code_eff, course_title, department_code, college_code from( select distinct C.CRS_SUBJECT as subject_code , C.CRS_NO as…
queryResults.querySql:
select
subject_code,
course_number,
term_code_eff,
course_title,
department_code,
college_code

from(
select distinct
C.CRS_SUBJECT as subject_code
, C.CRS_NO as course_number
, '2020SP' as term_code_eff
, CAST(REPLACE(CRS_TITLE,'ý',' ') as varchar(240))  as course_title

, COALESCE(d.SEC_DEPTS,'NA') as department_code
, DEPTS.DEPTS_DIVISION as college_code
, row_number() over(partition by C.crs_subject,C.crs_no order by C.courses_id desc) as cn
from 
(select * from
(select *,row_number() over (partition by courses_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[COURSES]> as C
where C.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and C.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)C where C.rn=1
)C
 JOIN
(
	SELECT *
	FROM (
		SELECT DISTINCT
		CRS_SUBJECT
		, c.CRS_NO
		, d.SEC_DEPTS
		, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY CRS_SUBJECT, CRS_NO ORDER BY cs.SEC_TERM desc, d.SEC_DEPTS) rn

		FROM (select * from
						(select *,row_number() over (partition by courses_id order by observation_tm desc) as c_dup_rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[COURSES]> as C
						where C.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and C.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
						)C where C.c_dup_rn=1
			)C
		
		left JOIN (select * from 
					(select *,row_number() over (partition by course_sections_id order by observation_tm desc) as cs_dup_rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[COURSE_SECTIONS]> as CS 
					where CS.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and CS.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
					) cs where cs.cs_dup_rn=1 
				  )cs ON C.CRS_SUBJECT = cs.SEC_SUBJECT AND C.CRS_NO = cs.SEC_COURSE_NO
		
		LEFT OUTER JOIN (select * from 
						(select *,row_number() over (partition by course_sections_id,pos order by observation_tm desc) as d_dup_rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[SEC_DEPARTMENTS]> as d
						where d.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and d.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
						)d where d.d_dup_rn=1
						)d ON cs.COURSE_SECTIONS_ID = d.COURSE_SECTIONS_ID AND d.POS = 1 ---- changed to left join because this was filtering courses without a dept code
		
		WHERE 1=1 
	) x
	WHERE rn = 1
) d ON C.CRS_SUBJECT = d.CRS_SUBJECT AND C.CRS_NO = d.CRS_NO

LEFT OUTER JOIN (select * from
				(select * ,row_number() over (partition by depts_id order by observation_tm desc) as depts_dup_rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[DEPTS]> as DEPTS 
				where DEPTS.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and DEPTS.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
				)DEPTS where DEPTS.depts_dup_rn=1
				)DEPTS ON d.SEC_DEPTS = DEPTS.DEPTS_ID

--LEFT OUTER JOIN APPROVAL_STATUS aps ON C.COURSES_ID = aps.COURSES_ID AND aps.POS = 1

WHERE 1=1
--and C.CRS_ACAD_LEVEL = 'UG'
AND COALESCE(C.CRS_START_DATE,'1990-01-01') = (
												SELECT MAX(COALESCE(CRS_START_DATE,'1990-01-01'))
												FROM (select * from  
																	(select *,row_number() over (partition by courses_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[COURSES]> as COURSES
													 				where COURSES.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and COURSES.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
													 				)COURSES where COURSES.rn=1
													)COURSES
												WHERE CRS_SUBJECT = C.CRS_SUBJECT
												AND CRS_NO = C.CRS_NO
												)
)courses
where cn = 1

UNION ALL
select  distinct
'TR' as subject_code
, '001' as course_number
, '2019FA' as term_code_eff
, 'Transfer Course' as course_title
, '' as department_code
, '' as college_code
 FROM (select * from  
					(select *,row_number() over (partition by courses_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[COURSES]> as COURSES
					where COURSES.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and COURSES.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
					)COURSES where COURSES.rn=1
	  )COURSES;

queryResults.sqlPreview: WITH dates AS ( SELECT DISTINCT course_id as crse_id, effective_date as effdt FROM (select *,row_number() over (partition by course_id,effective_date,course_off…
queryResults.querySql:
WITH dates AS
(
   SELECT DISTINCT course_id as crse_id, effective_date as effdt
   FROM (select *,row_number() over (partition by course_id,effective_date,course_offering_nbr order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
   from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_CRSE_OFFER]> co
   where co.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and co.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
   )co where co.dup_rn=1
   
   UNION
   SELECT DISTINCT course_id as crse_id, effective_date as effdt
   FROM (select *,row_number() over (partition by course_id,effective_date order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
   from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_CRSE_CATALOG]> as crse_catalog
   where crse_catalog.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and crse_catalog.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
   )crse_catalog where crse_catalog.dup_rn=1
)
SELECT  subject_code, course_number, term_code_eff, course_title,  department_code, college_code
FROM 
(
SELECT *
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY crses_terms.subject_code, crses_terms.course_number, crses_terms.term_code_eff
                                 ORDER BY crses_terms.effdt DESC, crses_terms.crse_id DESC) AS course_rn  --this will filter to max effdt per EAB-style course per term
      FROM (
	  SELECT courses.subject                                      AS subject_code
                   , courses.catalog_nbr                                AS course_number
                   , eab_tt.term                                        AS term_code_eff
                   , courses.course_title_long                          AS course_title
                   , courses.acad_org                                   AS department_code
                   , courses.acad_group                                 AS college_code
--                 , courses.eff_status                                 AS course_status_code
                   , courses.effdt
                   , courses.crse_id
                   , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY courses.crse_id   --this will filter to min term after effdt
                                       ORDER BY eab_tt.term) AS terms_rn
            FROM (SELECT dates.effdt
						, eab_cc.course_id as crse_id
						, eab_co.subject_area as subject
						, TRIM(eab_co.catalog_nbr) AS catalog_nbr
                        , eab_cc.long_course_title as course_title_long
						, eab_co.academic_organization as acad_org
						, eab_co.acad_group as acad_group
						, eab_co.institution as institution
				        , eab_co.career as acad_career
                  FROM dates
                  JOIN (select * from 
									(select *,row_number() over (partition by course_id,effective_date order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
									from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_CRSE_CATALOG]> eab_cc
									where eab_cc.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and eab_cc.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
									)eab_cc where eab_cc.dup_rn=1
						)eab_cc
                     ON eab_cc.course_id = dates.crse_id
                       AND eab_cc.effective_date = (SELECT MAX(sub_cc.effective_date)
													FROM (select *,row_number() over (partition by course_id,effective_date order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
														 from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_CRSE_CATALOG]> sub_cc
														 where sub_cc.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sub_cc.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
														)sub_cc where 1=1 AND sub_cc.dup_rn=1
                                                                  AND sub_cc.course_id = eab_cc.course_id
																  AND sub_cc.effective_date <= dates.effdt
											  )
                  
				  
				  LEFT JOIN (select * from (select *,row_number() over (partition by course_id,effective_date,course_offering_nbr order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
							from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_CRSE_OFFER]> eab_co
							where eab_co.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and eab_co.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
							)eab_co where eab_co.dup_rn=1
							)eab_co
                     ON eab_co.course_id = dates.crse_id
                       AND eab_co.course_offering_nbr = '1'
                       AND eab_co.effective_date = (SELECT MAX(sub_co.effective_date)
													FROM (select *,row_number() over (partition by course_id,effective_date,course_offering_nbr order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_CRSE_OFFER]> sub_co
														where sub_co.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sub_co.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>										   
														)sub_co 
														LEFT JOIN dates on dates.crse_id = sub_co.course_id and sub_co.course_offering_nbr='1' -- and sub_co.effective_date<= dates.effdt
														WHERE 1=1 AND sub_co.dup_rn=1 
															 AND sub_co.course_id = eab_co.course_id
															 AND sub_co.course_offering_nbr = '1'
															 AND sub_co.effective_date <= dates.effdt
														
														 
													)
                  WHERE 1=1
				  ) courses
				  
            JOIN 
			(
			select * from 
						(select *,row_number() over (partition by term,academic_career,academic_institution order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
						from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TERM_TBL]> eab_tt
						where eab_tt.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and eab_tt.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
						)eab_tt where eab_tt.dup_rn=1
			)eab_tt
               ON eab_tt.term_begin_date >= courses.effdt
                 AND eab_tt.academic_career = courses.acad_career
                 AND eab_tt.academic_institution = courses.institution
            
			WHERE 1=1
			
			) crses_terms
      WHERE 1=1
         AND crses_terms.terms_rn = 1
		 ) crses_eff_term
WHERE 1=1 AND crses_eff_term.course_rn = 1

--ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 DESC
;

queryResults.sqlPreview: WITH dates AS ( SELECT DISTINCT course_id as crse_id, effective_date as effdt FROM (select *,row_number() over (partition by course_id,effective_date,course_off…
queryResults.querySql:
WITH dates AS
(
   SELECT DISTINCT course_id as crse_id, effective_date as effdt
   FROM (select *,row_number() over (partition by course_id,effective_date,course_offering_nbr order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
   from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_CRSE_OFFER]> co
   where co.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and co.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
   )co where co.dup_rn=1
   
   UNION
   SELECT DISTINCT course_id as crse_id, effective_date as effdt
   FROM (select *,row_number() over (partition by course_id,effective_date order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
   from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_CRSE_CATALOG]> as crse_catalog
   where crse_catalog.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and crse_catalog.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
   )crse_catalog where crse_catalog.dup_rn=1
)
SELECT  subject_code, course_number, term_code_eff, course_title,  department_code, college_code
FROM 
(
SELECT *
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY crses_terms.subject_code, crses_terms.course_number, crses_terms.term_code_eff
                                 ORDER BY crses_terms.effdt DESC, crses_terms.crse_id DESC) AS course_rn  --this will filter to max effdt per EAB-style course per term
      FROM (
	  SELECT courses.subject                                      AS subject_code
                   , courses.catalog_nbr                                AS course_number
                   , eab_tt.term                                        AS term_code_eff
                   , courses.course_title_long                          AS course_title
                   , courses.acad_org                                   AS department_code
                   , courses.acad_group                                 AS college_code
--                 , courses.eff_status                                 AS course_status_code
                   , courses.effdt
                   , courses.crse_id
                   , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY courses.crse_id   --this will filter to min term after effdt
                                       ORDER BY eab_tt.term desc,courses.effdt desc) AS terms_rn
            FROM (SELECT dates.effdt
						, eab_cc.course_id as crse_id
						, eab_co.subject_area as subject
						, TRIM(eab_co.catalog_nbr) AS catalog_nbr
                        , eab_cc.long_course_title as course_title_long
						, eab_co.academic_organization as acad_org
						, eab_co.acad_group as acad_group
						, eab_co.institution as institution
				        , eab_co.career as acad_career
                  FROM dates
                  JOIN (select * from 
									(select *,row_number() over (partition by course_id,effective_date order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
									from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_CRSE_CATALOG]> eab_cc
									where eab_cc.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and eab_cc.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
									)eab_cc where eab_cc.dup_rn=1
						)eab_cc
                     ON eab_cc.course_id = dates.crse_id
                       AND eab_cc.effective_date = (SELECT MAX(sub_cc.effective_date)
													FROM (select *,row_number() over (partition by course_id,effective_date order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
														 from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_CRSE_CATALOG]> sub_cc
														 where sub_cc.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sub_cc.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
														)sub_cc where 1=1 AND sub_cc.dup_rn=1
                                                                  AND sub_cc.course_id = eab_cc.course_id
																  AND sub_cc.effective_date <= dates.effdt
											  )
                  
				  
				  LEFT JOIN (select * from (select *,row_number() over (partition by course_id,effective_date,course_offering_nbr order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
							from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_CRSE_OFFER]> eab_co
							where eab_co.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and eab_co.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
							)eab_co where eab_co.dup_rn=1
							)eab_co
                     ON eab_co.course_id = dates.crse_id
                       AND eab_co.course_offering_nbr = '1'
                       AND eab_co.effective_date = (SELECT MAX(sub_co.effective_date)
													FROM (select *,row_number() over (partition by course_id,effective_date,course_offering_nbr order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_CRSE_OFFER]> sub_co
														where sub_co.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sub_co.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>										   
														)sub_co 
														LEFT JOIN dates on dates.crse_id = sub_co.course_id and sub_co.course_offering_nbr='1' -- and sub_co.effective_date<= dates.effdt
														WHERE 1=1 AND sub_co.dup_rn=1 
															 AND sub_co.course_id = eab_co.course_id
															 AND sub_co.course_offering_nbr = '1'
															 AND sub_co.effective_date <= dates.effdt
														
														 
													)
                  WHERE 1=1
				  ) courses
				  
            JOIN 
			(
			select * from 
						(select *,row_number() over (partition by term,academic_career,academic_institution order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
						from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TERM_TBL]> eab_tt
						where eab_tt.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and eab_tt.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
						)eab_tt where eab_tt.dup_rn=1
			)eab_tt
               ON eab_tt.term_begin_date >= courses.effdt
                 AND eab_tt.academic_career = courses.acad_career
                 AND eab_tt.academic_institution = courses.institution
            
			WHERE 1=1
			
			) crses_terms
      WHERE 1=1
         AND crses_terms.terms_rn = 1
		 ) crses_eff_term
WHERE 1=1 AND crses_eff_term.course_rn = 1
--group by 1,2,3 having count(*)>1
--ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 DESC
;

queryResults.sqlPreview: SELECT grade_code AS grade_code , grade_abbreviation AS grade_desc , level_code AS level_code , CAST(attempted_indicator AS BOOLEAN) AS attempt_include_ind , CA…
queryResults.querySql:
SELECT
grade_code AS grade_code
, grade_abbreviation AS grade_desc
, level_code AS level_code
, CAST(attempted_indicator AS BOOLEAN) AS attempt_include_ind
, CAST(completed_indicator AS BOOLEAN) AS earned_include_ind
, CAST(gpa_indicator AS BOOLEAN) AS shrgrde_gpa_ind
, CAST(quality_points AS NUMERIC) AS quality_points
, current_date AS create_date
, current_date AS update_date
, 'T' AS active_ind
FROM 
(
select * from 
(select *,row_number() over (partition by grade_code,grade_abbreviation,level_code,effective_term order by observation_tm desc) as rn  from <passthrough.[Banner].[Grading Code Maintenance SHRGRDE]> as a where a.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and a.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)a where a.rn=1
)a
WHERE 1=1
AND a.effective_term = (
	SELECT MAX(b.effective_term)
	FROM 
	(select *,row_number() over (partition by grade_code,grade_abbreviation,level_code,effective_term order by observation_tm desc) as rn
	from
	<passthrough.[Banner].[Grading Code Maintenance SHRGRDE]> a
	where a.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and a.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
	) b WHERE b.rn=1 
	AND b.grade_code = a.grade_code
	AND b.level_code = a.level_code
	)
AND a.level_code = 'UG'

queryResults.sqlPreview: select spriden.student_id as student_id, shrtckn.term_code AS term_code, shrtckn.campus_code AS campus_code, shrtckn.college_code AS college_code, shrtckn.depar…
queryResults.querySql:
select
    spriden.student_id                                        as student_id,
    shrtckn.term_code                                         AS term_code,
    shrtckn.campus_code                                       AS campus_code,
    shrtckn.college_code                                      AS college_code,
    shrtckn.department_code                                   AS department_code,
    CAST(shrtckg.credit_hours AS NUMERIC)                     AS course_credits,
    shrtckn.subject_code                                      AS subject_code,
    shrtckn.course_number                                     AS course_number,
    shrtckn.course_reference_number                           AS course_reference_number,
    shrtckn.repeat_course_indicator                           AS repeat_code,
    CAST(shrtckg.credit_hours AS NUMERIC)                     AS attempted_credits,
    CAST(shrtckg.credit_hours AS NUMERIC)
        *
        CASE
            WHEN a.completed_indicator = 'Y'
                THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
        *
        CASE
            WHEN shrtckn.repeat_course_indicator IN ('E','A')
                THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END                                                   AS earned_credits,
    sfrstcr.mid_term_grade                                    AS midterm_grade,
    shrtckg.final_grade                                       AS final_grade,
    CAST(shrtckg.final_grade_date AS DATE)                    AS final_grade_date,
    ssbsect.type_code                                         AS course_type_code,
    g.level_code                                              AS level_code,
    CASE
        WHEN ssbsect.gradable_indicator = 'Y'
            THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END                                                       AS gradable_ind,
    current_date                                              AS create_date,
    current_date                                              AS update_date,
    't'                                                       AS active_ind
from 
    (
    select
        *
    from
        (
        select
            *,
            row_number() over
                (
                partition by
                    banner_pidm,
                    subject_code,
                    course_number,
                    course_reference_number,
                    term_code,
                    sequence_number
                order by
                    observation_tm desc
                ) as rn
        from
            <passthrough.[Banner].[Institutional Course Term Maintenance SHRTCKN]> as shrtckn
        where
            shrtckn.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME>
            and shrtckn.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
        )
        shrtckn
    where
        shrtckn.rn = 1
    )
    shrtckn
    join 
        (
        select
            *
        from
            (
            select
                *,
                row_number() over
                    (
                    partition by
                        banner_pidm
                    order by
                        observation_tm desc
                    ) as rn
            from
                <passthrough.[Banner].[Person Identification Name SPRIDEN]> as spriden
            where
                spriden.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME>
                and spriden.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
            )
            spriden
        where
            spriden.rn = 1
        )
        spriden
        on shrtckn.banner_pidm = spriden.banner_pidm
    left outer join
        (
        select
            *
        from
            (
            select
                *,
                row_number() over
                    (
                    partition by
                        banner_pidm,
                        course_reference_number,
                        term_code
                    order by
                        observation_tm desc
                    ) as rn
            from
                <passthrough.[Banner].[Student Course Registration SFRSTCR]> sfrstcr
            where
                sfrstcr.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME>
                and sfrstcr.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
            )
            sfrstcr
        where
            sfrstcr.rn = 1
        )
        sfrstcr
        ON shrtckn.banner_pidm = sfrstcr.banner_pidm
        AND shrtckn.term_code = sfrstcr.term_code
        AND shrtckn.course_reference_number = sfrstcr.course_reference_number
    left outer join
        (
        select
            *
        from
            (
            select
                *
            from
                (
                select
                    *,
                    row_number() over
                        (
                        partition by
                            banner_pidm,
                            term_code,
                            sequence_number,
                            tckn_sequence_number
                        order by
                            observation_tm desc
                        ) as rn
                from
                    <passthrough.[Banner].[Institutional Course Grades SHRTCKG]> as shrtckg 
                where
                    shrtckg.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME>
                    and shrtckg.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
                )
                a
            where
                a.rn = 1
            )
            a
        where
            sequence_number =
                (
                select
                    max(sequence_number)
                from 
                    (
                    select
                        *,
                        row_number() over
                            (
                            partition by
                                banner_pidm,
                                term_code,
                                sequence_number,
                                tckn_sequence_number
                            order by
                                observation_tm desc
                            ) as rn
                    from
                        <passthrough.[Banner].[Institutional Course Grades SHRTCKG]> as shrtckg
                    where
                        shrtckg.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME>
                        and shrtckg.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
                    )
                    shrtckg
                where
                    shrtckg.rn = 1
                    and shrtckg.banner_pidm = a.banner_pidm
                    and shrtckg.term_code = a.term_code
                    and shrtckg.tckn_sequence_number = a.tckn_sequence_number
                )
        )
        shrtckg
        on shrtckn.banner_pidm = shrtckg.banner_pidm
        and shrtckn.term_code = shrtckg.term_code
        and shrtckn.sequence_number = shrtckg.tckn_sequence_number
    left outer join
        (
        select
            *,
            row_number() over
                (
                partition by
                    banner_pidm,
                    term_code,
                    course_sequence_number
                order by
                    level_code desc
                ) as rn2
        from
            (
            select
                *,
                row_number() over
                    (
                    partition by
                        banner_pidm,
                        course_sequence_number,
                        level_code,
                        term_code
                    order by
                        observation_tm desc
                    ) as rn
            from
                <passthrough.[Banner].[Institutional Course Maintenance Levels SHRTCKL]> as r 
            where
                r.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME>
                and r.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
            )
            r
        where
            r.rn = 1
        )
        g
        on shrtckn.banner_pidm = g.banner_pidm
        and shrtckn.term_code = g.term_code
        and shrtckn.sequence_number = g.course_sequence_number
        and g.rn2 = 1
    left outer join
        (
        select * from
            (
            select
                *,
                row_number() over
                    (
                    partition by
                        term_code,
                        crn
                    order by
                        observation_tm desc
                    ) as rn
            from
                <passthrough.[Banner].[Section General Information SSBSECT]> ssbsect
            where
                ssbsect.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME>
                and ssbsect.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
            )
            ssbsect
        where
            ssbsect.rn = 1
        )
        ssbsect
        on ssbsect.term_code = shrtckn.term_code
        and ssbsect.crn = shrtckn.course_reference_number
    left outer join
        (
        select * from 
            (
            select
                *,
                row_number() over
                    (
                    partition by
                        grade_code,
                        grade_abbreviation,
                        level_code,
                        effective_term
                    order by
                        observation_tm desc
                    ) as rn
            from
                <passthrough.[Banner].[Grading Code Maintenance SHRGRDE]> as shrgrde
            where
                shrgrde.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME>
                and shrgrde.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
            )
            a
        where
            a.rn = 1
        )
        a
        on shrtckg.final_grade = a.grade_code
        and g.level_code = a.level_code
        and a.effective_term =
            (
            select
                max(effective_term)
            from 
                (
                select
                    *,
                    row_number() over
                        (
                        partition by
                            grade_code,
                            grade_abbreviation,
                            level_code,
                            effective_term
                        order by
                            observation_tm desc
                        ) as rn
                from
                    <passthrough.[Banner].[Grading Code Maintenance SHRGRDE]> as shrgrde
                where
                    shrgrde.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME>
                    and shrgrde.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
                )shrgrde 
            where
                shrgrde.rn = 1
                and shrgrde.grade_code = a.grade_code
                and shrgrde.level_code = a.level_code
            )

select 
spriden.student_id as student_id
, shrtckn.term_code AS term_code
, shrtckn.campus_code AS campus_code
, shrtckn.college_code AS college_code
, shrtckn.department_code AS department_code
, CAST(shrtckg.credit_hours AS NUMERIC) AS course_credits
, shrtckn.subject_code AS subject_code
, shrtckn.course_number AS course_number
, shrtckn.course_reference_number AS course_reference_number
, shrtckn.repeat_course_indicator AS repeat_code
, CAST(shrtckg.credit_hours AS NUMERIC) AS attempted_credits
, CAST(shrtckg.credit_hours AS NUMERIC) *
	CASE
		WHEN a.completed_indicator = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0
		END
	*
	CASE
		WHEN shrtckn.repeat_course_indicator IN ('E','A') THEN 0 ELSE 1
		END
		AS earned_credits
, sfrstcr.mid_term_grade AS midterm_grade
, shrtckg.final_grade AS final_grade
, CAST(shrtckg.final_grade_date AS DATE) AS final_grade_date
, ssbsect.type_code AS course_type_code
, shrtckl.level_code AS level_code
, CASE
    WHEN ssbsect.gradable_indicator = 'Y' THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
    END AS gradable_ind
, current_date AS create_date
, current_date AS update_date
, 't' AS active_ind
from 
(
select * from
(
select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm,subject_code,course_number,course_reference_number,term_code,sequence_number order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Institutional Course Term Maintenance SHRTCKN]> as shrtckn where shrtckn.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME> and shrtckn.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
) shrtckn where shrtckn.rn=1
) shrtckn

join 
(
select * from
(
select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm order by observation_tm desc) as rn  from  <passthrough.[Banner].[Person Identification Name SPRIDEN]> as spriden where spriden.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME> and spriden.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)spriden where spriden.rn=1
)spriden on shrtckn.banner_pidm = spriden.banner_pidm

LEFT OUTER JOIN 
(
select * from
(
select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm,course_reference_number,term_code order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Student Course Registration SFRSTCR]> sfrstcr where sfrstcr.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME> and sfrstcr.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)sfrstcr where sfrstcr.rn=1 
)sfrstcr ON shrtckn.banner_pidm = sfrstcr.banner_pidm AND shrtckn.term_code = sfrstcr.term_code AND shrtckn.course_reference_number = sfrstcr.course_reference_number

LEFT OUTER JOIN (
	SELECT *
	FROM (select * from
			(
			select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm,term_code,sequence_number,tckn_sequence_number order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Institutional Course Grades SHRTCKG]> as shrtckg 
			where shrtckg.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME> and shrtckg.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
			) a where a.rn=1
			)a
	WHERE sequence_number = (
		SELECT MAX(sequence_number)
		FROM 
		(select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm,term_code,sequence_number,tckn_sequence_number order by observation_tm desc) as rn from 
		<passthrough.[Banner].[Institutional Course Grades SHRTCKG]> as shrtckg
		where shrtckg.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME> and shrtckg.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)shrtckg
		WHERE shrtckg.rn=1
		AND shrtckg.banner_pidm = a.banner_pidm
		AND shrtckg.term_code = a.term_code
		AND shrtckg.tckn_sequence_number = a.tckn_sequence_number
		)
	) shrtckg
	ON shrtckn.banner_pidm = shrtckg.banner_pidm
	AND shrtckn.term_code = shrtckg.term_code
	AND shrtckn.sequence_number = shrtckg.tckn_sequence_number
	
LEFT OUTER JOIN 
(
select * from
(select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm,course_sequence_number,level_code,term_code order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Institutional Course Maintenance Levels SHRTCKL]> as shrtckl 
 where shrtckl.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME> and shrtckl.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
) as shrtckl where shrtckl.rn=1
) as shrtckl
	ON shrtckn.banner_pidm = shrtckl.banner_pidm
	AND shrtckn.term_code = shrtckl.term_code
	AND shrtckn.sequence_number = shrtckl.course_sequence_number
	
LEFT OUTER JOIN 
(select * from
(select *,row_number() over (partition by term_code,crn order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Section General Information SSBSECT]> ssbsect where ssbsect.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME> and ssbsect.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)ssbsect where ssbsect.rn=1
)ssbsect
 ON ssbsect.term_code = shrtckn.term_code AND ssbsect.crn = shrtckn.course_reference_number and ssbsect.part_of_term_code not in ('C','AFR','AFS')

LEFT OUTER JOIN
(select * from 
(select *,row_number() over (partition by grade_code,grade_abbreviation,level_code,effective_term order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Grading Code Maintenance SHRGRDE]> as shrgrde where shrgrde.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME> and shrgrde.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
) a where a.rn=1
) a ON shrtckg.final_grade = a.grade_code AND shrtckl.level_code = a.level_code AND a.effective_term = (
	SELECT MAX(effective_term)
	FROM 
	(select *,row_number() over (partition by grade_code,grade_abbreviation,level_code,effective_term order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Grading Code Maintenance SHRGRDE]> as shrgrde
	where shrgrde.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME> and shrgrde.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
	)shrgrde 
	WHERE shrgrde.rn=1
	AND shrgrde.grade_code = a.grade_code
	AND shrgrde.level_code = a.level_code
	)
