queryResults.sqlPreview: select spriden.student_id as student_id, first_terms.first_term as inst_first_term_code, prim_level.sgbstdn_levl_code as primary_level_code, case when spbpers.d…
queryResults.querySql:
select 
	spriden.student_id                           as student_id,
	first_terms.first_term                       as inst_first_term_code,
	prim_level.sgbstdn_levl_code                 as primary_level_code,
	case
		when spbpers.deceased_indicator = 'Y'
			then false
		when prim_level.sgbstdn_stst_code = 'AS'
			then true
    	else false
    end                                          as active_ind,
	'success'                                    as module
from
	(
	select 
		pidm,
		max(term) as max_term
	from
		(
		select
			banner_pidm as pidm,
			term_code   as term
		from 
			(
			select
				*
			from 
				(
				select
					*,
					row_number() over
						(
						partition by
							banner_pidm,
							level_code,
							gpa_type,
							term_code
						order by
							observation_tm desc
						) as rn
				from
					<passthrough.[Banner].[Term GPA SHRTGPA]> as shrtgpa
				where
					shrtgpa.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
					and shrtgpa.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
				)
				shrtgpa
			where
				shrtgpa.rn = 1
			)
			shrtgpa
		union
		select
			banner_pidm    as pidm,
			effective_term as term
		from 
			(
			select
				*
			from
				(
				select
					*,
					row_number() over
						(
						partition by
							banner_pidm,
							effective_term,
							subject_code,
							course_number
						order by
							observation_tm desc
						) as rn
				from
					<passthrough.[Banner].[Transfer Course Equivalents SHRTRCE]> as shrtrce
				where
					shrtrce.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
					and shrtrce.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
				)
				shrtrce
			where
				shrtrce.rn = 1
			)
			shrtrce
		union
		select
			sfrstca.banner_pidm as pidm,
			sfrstca.term_code   as term
		from 
			(
			select
				*
			from
				(
				select
					*,
					row_number() over
						(
						partition by
							banner_pidm,
							term_code,
							sequence_number,
							course_reference_number
						order by
							observation_tm desc
						) as rn
				from
					<passthrough.[Banner].[Student Course Registration Archive SFRSTCA]> as sfrstca
				where
					sfrstca.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
					and sfrstca.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
				)
				sfrstca
			where
				sfrstca.rn = 1
			)
			sfrstca
			join
				(
				select
					*
				from
					(
					select
						*,
						row_number() over
							(
							partition by
								term_code
							order by
								observation_tm desc
							) as rn
					from
						<passthrough.[Banner].[Term Code Lookup STVTERM]> as stvterm
					where
						stvterm.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
						and stvterm.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
					)
					stvterm
				where
					stvterm.rn = 1
				)
				stvterm
				on stvterm.term_code = sfrstca.term_code
		where
			1 = 1
			and stvterm.term_end_date > current_date - 365
		union
		select 
			banner_pidm    as pidm,
			effective_term as term
		from 
			(
			select
				*
			from
				(
				select
					*,
					row_number() over
						(
						partition by
							banner_pidm,
							effective_term
						order by
							observation_tm desc
						) as rn
				from
					<passthrough.[Banner].[Student Program SGBSTDN]> as sgbstdn
				where
					sgbstdn.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
					and sgbstdn.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
				)
				sgbstdn
			where
				sgbstdn.rn = 1
			)
			sgbstdn
		)
		x
	group by
		pidm
	)
	max_terms
	join
		(
		select
			*
		from
			(
			select
				*,
				row_number() over
					(
					partition by
						term_code
					order by
						observation_tm desc
					) as rn
			from
				<passthrough.[Banner].[Term Code Lookup STVTERM]> as stvterm
			where
				stvterm.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
				and stvterm.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
			)
			stvterm
		where
			stvterm.rn = 1
		)
		term_dates
		on term_dates.term_code = max_terms.max_term
      	and term_dates.term_end_date >= current_date - (365 * 2)
	left join 
		(
		select
 			banner_pidm    as sfrstcr_pidm,
 			min(term_code) as first_term
 		from
 			(
 			select
 				*
 			from 
 				(
 				select
 					*,
 					row_number() over
 						(
 						partition by
 							banner_pidm,
 							term_code,
 							course_reference_number
 						order by
 							observation_tm desc
 						) as rn
				from
					<passthrough.[Banner].[Student Course Registration SFRSTCR]> as sfrstcr
 				where
 					sfrstcr.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
 					and sfrstcr.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
 				)
 				sfrstcr
 			where
 				sfrstcr.rn = 1
 			)
 			sfrstcr
 			join 
	 			(
	 			select
	 				*
	 			from 
	 				(
	 				select
	 					*,
	 					row_number() over
	 						(
	 						partition by
	 							registration_status_code
	 						order by
	 							observation_tm desc
	 						) as rn
	 				from
	 					<passthrough.[Banner].[Course Registration Status Validation STVRSTS]> as lkp
					where
						lkp.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
						and lkp.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME> 
	 				)
	 				lkp
	 			where
	 				lkp.rn = 1
	 			)
	 			lkp
	 			on sfrstcr.registration_status_code = lkp.registration_status_code
	 			and lkp.voice_type = 'R'
		group by
			banner_pidm
 		)
 		first_terms
 		on max_terms.pidm = first_terms.sfrstcr_pidm
 	left join
		(
		select 
			s.banner_pidm as pidm, 
			s.level_code as sgbstdn_levl_code,
			s.student_status as sgbstdn_stst_code
		from 
			(
			select
				*
			from 
				(
				select
					*,
					row_number() over
						(
						partition by
							banner_pidm,
							effective_term
						order by
							observation_tm desc
						) as rn
				from
					<passthrough.[Banner].[Student Program SGBSTDN]> as s
				where
					s.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
					and s.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME> 
				)
				s
			where
				s.rn = 1
			)
			s
		where
			s.effective_term =
				(
				select
					max(effective_term)
				from 
					(
					select
						*
					from
						(
						select
							*,
							row_number() over
								(
								partition by
									banner_pidm,
									effective_term
								order by
									observation_tm desc
								) as rn
						from
							<passthrough.[Banner].[Student Program SGBSTDN]> as sgbstdn
						where
							sgbstdn.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
							and sgbstdn.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME> 
						)
						sgbstdn
					where
						sgbstdn.rn = 1
					)
					sgbstdn 
				where
					sgbstdn.banner_pidm = s.banner_pidm
				) 
		)
		prim_level
		on prim_level.pidm = max_terms.pidm
	join 
		(
		select
			*
		from
			(
			select
				*,
				row_number() over
					(
					partition by
						banner_pidm
					order by
						observation_tm desc
					) as rn
			from
				<passthrough.[Banner].[Person Identification Name SPRIDEN]> as spriden
			where
				spriden.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
				and spriden.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
			)
			spriden
		where
			spriden.rn = 1
		)
		spriden
		on spriden.banner_pidm = max_terms.pidm
	left join
		(
		select 
			*
		from 
			(
			select
				*
			from 
				(
				select
					*,
					row_number() over
						(
						partition by
							banner_pidm
						order by
							observation_tm desc
						) as rn
				from
					<passthrough.[Banner].[Person Demographics SPBPERS]> as spbpers
				where
					spbpers.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
					and spbpers.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME> 
				)
				spbpers
			where
				spbpers.rn = 1
			)
			spbpers
		)
		spbpers
		on spbpers.banner_pidm = max_terms.pidm
where
	1 = 1

queryResults.sqlPreview: WITH population AS ( -- enrollees SELECT DISTINCT STC_PERSON_ID as ID FROM (select * from (select *, row_number() over (partition by student_acad_cred_id order …
queryResults.querySql:
WITH population AS (
	-- enrollees
	SELECT DISTINCT STC_PERSON_ID as ID
	FROM (select * from 
		(select *, row_number() over (partition by student_acad_cred_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[STUDENT_ACAD_CRED]> as sac
		where sac.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sac.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)sac where sac.rn=1
		)sac
	JOIN (select * from 
		(select *, row_number() over (partition by terms_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[TERMS]> as t
		where t.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and t.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)t where t.rn=1
		)t ON STC_TERM = t.TERMS_ID AND t.TERM_START_DATE >= CURRENT_DATE - 1095
	WHERE 1=1

	UNION

	-- applicants
	SELECT DISTINCT APPL_APPLICANT
	FROM (select * from 
		(select *, row_number() over (partition by applications_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[APPLICATIONS]> as a
		where a.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and a.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)a where a.rn=1
		)a
	JOIN (select * from 
		(select *, row_number() over (partition by terms_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[TERMS]> as t
		where t.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and t.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)t where t.rn=1
		)t ON a.APPL_START_TERM = t.TERMS_ID AND t.TERM_START_DATE >= CURRENT_DATE - 365
)

select distinct
'success' AS module
, population.ID AS student_id
, term.min_term AS inst_first_term_code
, COALESCE(level.stc_acad_level,'UG') AS primary_level_code
, TRUE AS active_ind

from population

LEFT JOIN (select STC_PERSON_ID,min(STC_TERM) as min_term
            from (select *, row_number() over (partition by student_acad_cred_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[STUDENT_ACAD_CRED]> as sac
				  where sac.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sac.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
				  )sac where sac.rn=1
           group by STC_PERSON_ID
           )term
    on population.ID=term.stc_person_id

LEFT JOIN (select * from 
		(select *, row_number() over (partition by student_acad_cred_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[STUDENT_ACAD_CRED]> as sac
		where sac.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sac.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)level where level.rn=1
		)level 
   on level.stc_person_id=term.stc_person_id and level.stc_term=term.min_term
WHERE 1=1

queryResults.sqlPreview: select * from ( SELECT a.EMPLID AS student_id , 'success' AS module , acad_career AS primary_level_code , MIN_STRM AS inst_first_term_code , CASE WHEN pp.dt_of_…
queryResults.querySql:
select * 
from (
SELECT a.EMPLID           AS student_id
       , 'success'        AS module
       , acad_career      AS primary_level_code
       , MIN_STRM         AS inst_first_term_code
       , CASE
           WHEN pp.dt_of_death IS NOT NULL THEN FALSE
           WHEN active.emplid IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
           ELSE FALSE
         END              AS active_ind
FROM (SELECT a.EMPLID as EMPLID
            -- , c.acad_career
            , a.acad_career as acad_career
             , MAX(CAST(a.STRM AS INT)) AS MAX_STRM
             , MIN(CAST(a.STRM AS INT)) AS MIN_STRM 
                        ,MAX(b.TERM_END_DT) as max_dt
      --FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_STDNT_CAR_TERM]> a
      FROM (
      select   * 
      from   (
      select  student_id as EMPLID, career as acad_career , term as STRM, academic_institution as INSTITUTION, row_number() over (partition by student_id,academic_institution,career,term order by  observation_tm   desc )   as   dup_rn
      FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_STDNT_CAR_TERM]> as psct
      where  psct.observation_tm >  <PIT_START_TIME>  and psct.observation_tm <=  <PIT_END_TIME>
      ) as psct 
      where  psct.dup_rn = 1
      ) as a
      --JOIN <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TERM_TBL]> b
      JOIN (
                                select   * 
                              from   (
                              select   term as STRM, academic_career as ACAD_CAREER , academic_institution as INSTITUTION, ending_date as TERM_END_DT, row_number() over (partition by academic_institution,academic_career,term order by  observation_tm   desc )   as   dup_rn
                              FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TERM_TBL]> as ptt
                              where  ptt.observation_tm >  <PIT_START_TIME>  and ptt.observation_tm <=  <PIT_END_TIME> 
                              ) as ptt 
                              where  ptt.dup_rn = 1
      ) as b
        ON b.STRM = a.STRM
           AND a.ACAD_CAREER = b.ACAD_CAREER
           AND a.INSTITUTION = b.INSTITUTION
      -- LEFT JOIN <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_STDNT_CAREER]> c
         -- ON a.emplid = c.emplid
      WHERE 1=1
      GROUP BY a.EMPLID, a.acad_career --,c.acad_career
      HAVING MAX(CAST(b.TERM_END_DT as DATETIME)) >= CURRENT_DATE-(365*2)) a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT emplid
           FROM (SELECT emplid, acad_career, stdnt_car_nbr, acad_prog, prog_status, effdt
                            , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY emplid, acad_career, institution, stdnt_car_nbr
                                                ORDER BY effdt DESC, effseq DESC) AS rn
                  --FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_ACAD_PROG]>
                 FROM (
                      select   * 
                        from   (
                          -- Pick up from here - Modify the field names
                            select   student_id as emplid, academic_career as acad_career, student_career_nbr as stdnt_car_nbr, academic_program as acad_prog, status as prog_status, effective_date as effdt, institution_id as institution, effective_sequence as effseq, row_number() over (partition by effective_date,student_career_nbr,effective_sequence,student_id,academic_career order by  observation_tm   desc )   as   dup_rn
                            FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_ACAD_PROG]> as pap
                            where  pap.observation_tm >  <PIT_START_TIME>  and pap.observation_tm <=  <PIT_END_TIME>   
                        ) as pap 
                        where  pap.dup_rn = 1
                 ) as PS_ACAD_PROG
                  WHERE 1=1) sub_ap
           WHERE 1=1
             AND sub_ap.rn = 1
             AND sub_ap.prog_status = 'AC') active
    ON active.emplid = a.emplid
--LEFT JOIN <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_PERSON]> pp
LEFT JOIN (
select   * 
from   (
select   student_id as emplid , date_of_death as dt_of_death, row_number() over (partition by student_id order by  observation_tm   desc )   as   dup_rn
FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_PERSON]> as pp
where  pp.observation_tm >  <PIT_START_TIME>  and pp.observation_tm <=  <PIT_END_TIME>
) as pp 
where  pp.dup_rn = 1
) as pp                                              
   ON pp.emplid = a.emplid
   )sub
where 1=1

queryResults.sqlPreview: select spriden.student_id as student_id , first_terms.first_term AS inst_first_term_code , prim_level.sgbstdn_levl_code AS primary_level_code , CASE WHEN prim_l…
queryResults.querySql:
select 
spriden.student_id as student_id
, first_terms.first_term AS inst_first_term_code
, prim_level.sgbstdn_levl_code AS primary_level_code
, CASE
    WHEN prim_level.sgbstdn_stst_code = 'AS' THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
    END AS active_ind
, 'success' AS module
from
(
 select 
pidm,
max(term) as max_term
from(
select
banner_pidm as pidm,
term_code as term
from 
(
select * from 
(select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm,level_code,gpa_type,term_code order by observation_tm desc) as rn  from <passthrough.[Banner].[Term GPA SHRTGPA]> as shrtgpa 
where shrtgpa.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and shrtgpa.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)shrtgpa where shrtgpa.rn=1
)shrtgpa where shrtgpa.level_code = 'UG' 

UNION 

select
banner_pidm as pidm,
effective_term as term
from 
(
select * from
(
select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm,effective_term,subject_code,course_number order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Transfer Course Equivalents SHRTRCE]> as shrtrce
where shrtrce.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and shrtrce.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)shrtrce where shrtrce.rn=1
)shrtrce where shrtrce.level_code='UG' 

UNION

select
sfrstca.banner_pidm as pidm,
term_code as term
from 
(
select * from
(select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm,term_code,sequence_number,course_reference_number order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Student Course Registration Archive SFRSTCA]> as sfrstca
where sfrstca.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sfrstca.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)sfrstca where sfrstca.rn=1
)sfrstca where sfrstca.level_code='UG' 

UNION 

select 
banner_pidm as pidm,
effective_term as term
from 
(
select * from
(select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm,effective_term order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Student Program SGBSTDN]> as sgbstdn
where sgbstdn.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sgbstdn.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)sgbstdn where sgbstdn.rn=1
)sgbstdn where sgbstdn.level_code='UG'
)x
group by pidm
)max_terms

left join 
(select
 banner_pidm as sfrstcr_pidm,
 min(term_code) as first_term
 from
 (
 select * from 
 (select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm,term_code,course_reference_number order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Student Course Registration SFRSTCR]> as sfrstcr
 where sfrstcr.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sfrstcr.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
 )sfrstcr where sfrstcr.rn=1
 )sfrstcr
 
 join 
 (select * from 
 (select *,row_number() over (partition by registration_status_code order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Course Registration Status Validation STVRSTS]> as lkp
  where lkp.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and lkp.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME> 
 )lkp where lkp.rn=1
 )lkp
 on sfrstcr.registration_status_code = lkp.registration_status_code and lkp.voice_type='R'
 GROUP BY banner_pidm
 )first_terms on first_terms.sfrstcr_pidm = max_terms.pidm
 
join 
(select * from
(select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Person Identification Name SPRIDEN]> as spriden where spriden.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and spriden.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)spriden where spriden.rn=1
)spriden on spriden.banner_pidm = max_terms.pidm

join (
select 
s.banner_pidm as pidm, 
s.level_code as sgbstdn_levl_code,
s.student_status as sgbstdn_stst_code
from 
(select * from 
(
select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm,effective_term order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Student Program SGBSTDN]> as s
where s.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and s.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME> 
)s where s.rn=1
)s
where s.effective_term = (
select max(effective_term) from 
(select * from
(select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm,effective_term order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Student Program SGBSTDN]> as sgbstdn
where sgbstdn.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sgbstdn.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME> 
)sgbstdn where sgbstdn.rn=1
)sgbstdn 
where sgbstdn.banner_pidm = s.banner_pidm
) 
)prim_level on prim_level.pidm = max_terms.pidm

join (select 
term_code as stvterm_code,
min(cast(term_start_date as date)) as sorrtrm_start_date,
min(cast(term_end_date as date)) as sorrtrm_end_date	
from 
(select * from 
(select *,row_number() over (partition by term_code order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Term Code Lookup STVTERM]> as stvterm
where stvterm.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and stvterm.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME> 
)stvterm where stvterm.rn=1
)stvterm 
group by term_code
having max(cast(term_end_date as date)) >= current_date-(365*12))sorrtrm on max_terms.max_term=sorrtrm.stvterm_code
where 1=1

queryResults.sqlPreview: SELECT a.student_id AS student_id , 'success' AS module , acad_career AS primary_level_code , MIN_STRM AS inst_first_term_code , CASE WHEN pp.date_of_death IS N…
queryResults.querySql:
SELECT a.student_id           AS student_id
       , 'success'        AS module
       , acad_career      AS primary_level_code
       , MIN_STRM         AS inst_first_term_code
       , CASE
           WHEN pp.date_of_death IS NOT NULL THEN FALSE
           WHEN active.student_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
           ELSE FALSE
         END              AS active_ind
FROM 
(
SELECT a.student_id
	, c.career as acad_career
    , MAX(a.term) AS MAX_STRM
    , MIN(a.term) AS MIN_STRM
FROM 
(select * from
(select *, row_number() over (partition by student_id,term,academic_institution,career order by observation_tm desc) as rn from
 <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_STDNT_CAR_TERM]> as a
 where a.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and a.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)a where a.rn=1
)a

JOIN 
(select * from 
(select *,row_number() over (partition by term,academic_career,academic_institution order by observation_tm desc) as rn 
from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TERM_TBL]> as b
where b.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and b.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
) b	where b.rn=1		
) b ON b.term = a.term AND a.career = b.academic_career AND a.academic_institution = b.academic_institution
      
LEFT JOIN 
(select * from 
(select *,row_number() over (partition by id,career order by observation_tm desc) as rn 
from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_STDNT_CAREER]> as c
where c.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and c.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
) c where c.rn=1
) c ON a.student_id = c.id

WHERE 1=1

GROUP BY a.student_id, c.career HAVING MAX(b.ending_date) >= CURRENT_DATE-(365*2)

) a
	  
LEFT JOIN 
(SELECT DISTINCT student_id
FROM 
(
SELECT student_id, academic_career, student_career_nbr, academic_program, status, effective_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY student_id, academic_career, institution_id, student_career_nbr ORDER BY effective_date DESC, effective_sequence DESC) AS rn
FROM 
(select *,row_number() over (partition by student_id,effective_date,student_career_nbr,effective_sequence,academic_career order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_ACAD_PROG]> as ps_acad_prog
where ps_acad_prog.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and ps_acad_prog.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)ps_acad_prog where ps_acad_prog.dup_rn=1
)ps_acad_prog WHERE 1=1 AND ps_acad_prog.rn = 1 AND ps_acad_prog.status = 'AC'
)active ON active.student_id = a.student_id
	
LEFT JOIN 
(select * from 
(select *,row_number() over (partition by student_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn 
from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_PERSON]> as pp
where pp.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and pp.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)pp where pp.rn=1
)pp ON pp.student_id = a.student_id

queryResults.sqlPreview: SELECT emplid, dt_of_death FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_PERSON]> AS a WHERE 1=1 WITH dnu_names AS ( SELECT eab_pn.emplid, eab_pn.last_name --identifies al…
queryResults.querySql:
SELECT emplid, dt_of_death
FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_PERSON]> AS a
WHERE 1=1


WITH dnu_names AS
(
SELECT eab_pn.emplid, eab_pn.last_name   --identifies all primary names that have been set to DONOTUSE%% in order to deactivate them
FROM (SELECT pn.*
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY pn.emplid, pn.name_type
                                 ORDER BY pn.effdt DESC) AS rn
      FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_NAMES]> AS pn
      WHERE 1=1
         AND pn.name_type = 'PRI') eab_pn
WHERE 1=1
   AND eab_pn.rn = 1
   AND eab_pn.last_name iLIKE 'donotuse%%'
)
SELECT a.student_id, a.term_code, sc.acad_career AS levl_code
       , a.create_date, a.update_date
       , CASE
           WHEN dod_check.dt_of_death IS NULL AND eab_dn.emplid IS NULL AND active.student_id IS NOT NULL --no dod, not set to DNU, active
               THEN TRUE
           WHEN dod_check.dt_of_death IS NULL AND eab_dn.emplid IS NULL AND eab_rads.emplid IS NOT NULL   --no dod, not set to DNU, readmit
               THEN TRUE
           ELSE FALSE
         END AS active_ind
FROM ( SELECT sct.emplid         AS student_id
               , MAX(sct.STRM)   AS term_code
               , sct.acad_career AS levl_code
               , NOW()           AS create_date
               , NOW()           AS update_date
        FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_STDNT_CAR_TERM]> AS sct
        JOIN <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TERM_TBL]> AS tt
             ON tt.strm = sct.strm
                AND tt.institution = sct.institution
                AND tt.acad_career = sct.acad_career
        WHERE 1=1
           AND tt.term_end_dt >= current_date - 365*1
        GROUP BY sct.emplid, sct.acad_career) a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT st.emplid AS student_id
           FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_STDNT_CAR_TERM]> AS st
           JOIN <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TERM_TBL]> AS ct1
              ON ct1.strm = st.strm
                AND ct1.acad_career = st.acad_career
           LEFT JOIN <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_STDNT_ENRL]> AS cr
              ON st.emplid = cr.emplid
                AND st.acad_career = cr.acad_career
           LEFT JOIN <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TERM_TBL]> AS ct2
              ON ct2.strm = cr.strm
                AND ct2.acad_career = cr.acad_career
           WHERE 1=1
              AND ((ct1.term_end_dt >= CURRENT_DATE - 270
                    AND cr.emplid IS NULL)
                   OR (ct1.term_end_dt >= CURRENT_DATE - (270)
                       AND ct2.term_end_dt >=CURRENT_DATE - (1095)))) active
   ON active.student_id = a.student_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT eab_readmits.emplid             --distinct used here in case there are multiple term activations that qualify (current and future terms)
           FROM (SELECT DISTINCT emplid, acad_career       --distinct used in case there are multiple credit-level program stacks with readmit admit type
                 FROM (SELECT emplid, acad_career, stdnt_car_nbr, adm_appl_nbr, admit_type
                              , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY emplid, acad_career, stdnt_car_nbr
                                                  ORDER BY adm_appl_nbr DESC, adm_appl_dt DESC, adm_updated_dt DESC) AS inner_rn
                       FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_ADM_APPL_DATA]> AS a
                       WHERE 1=1) eab_aad
                 WHERE 1=1
                    AND eab_aad.inner_rn = 1
                    AND eab_aad.acad_career = 'CRED'       --readmits should only be there for credit careers, per VCCS on 7/10/2020
                    AND eab_aad.admit_type = 'RAD') eab_readmits
           JOIN (SELECT emplid, acad_career, strm          --check for latest term activation for readmit students
                        , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY emplid, acad_career
                                            ORDER BY strm DESC) AS sct_rn
                 FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_STDNT_CAR_TERM]> AS a
                 WHERE 1=1) eab_sct
              ON eab_sct.emplid = eab_readmits.emplid
                AND eab_sct.acad_career = eab_readmits.acad_career
                AND eab_sct.sct_rn = 1
           JOIN (SELECT strm, acad_career                  --check that latest term activation is for current/future term
                        , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acad_career
                                             ORDER BY strm ASC) AS term_rn
                 FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TERM_TBL]> AS t
                 WHERE 1=1
                    AND term_end_dt >= CURRENT_DATE) eab_terms
              ON eab_sct.strm >= eab_terms.strm            -- >= used to account for a future term activation
                AND eab_terms.acad_career = eab_sct.acad_career
                AND eab_terms.term_rn = 1
           WHERE 1=1) eab_rads
   ON eab_rads.emplid = a.student_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT emplid, dt_of_death
           FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_PERSON]> AS a
           WHERE 1=1) dod_check
   ON dod_check.emplid = a.student_id
LEFT JOIN dnu_names eab_dn
   ON eab_dn.emplid = a.student_id

queryResults.querySql:
select 
student_id
,module
,primary_level_code
,inst_first_term_code
,active_ind
from
(
SELECT a.student_id           AS student_id
       , 'success'        AS module
       , acad_career      AS primary_level_code
       , MIN_STRM         AS inst_first_term_code
       , CASE
           --WHEN pp.date_of_death IS NOT NULL THEN FALSE
           WHEN active.student_id IS NOT NULL OR admitted_students.emplid is not null THEN TRUE
           ELSE FALSE
         END              AS active_ind
	   , row_number() over(partition by a.student_id order by acad_career) AS rn	 
FROM 
(
SELECT a.student_id
	, c.career as acad_career
    , MAX(a.term) AS MAX_STRM
    , MIN(a.term) AS MIN_STRM
FROM 
(select * from
(select *, row_number() over (partition by student_id,term,academic_institution,career order by observation_tm desc) as rn from
 <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_STDNT_CAR_TERM]> as a
 where a.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and a.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)a where a.rn=1
)a

JOIN 
(select * from 
(select *,row_number() over (partition by term,academic_career,academic_institution order by observation_tm desc) as rn 
from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TERM_TBL]> as b
where b.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and b.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
) b	where b.rn=1		
) b ON b.term = a.term AND a.career = b.academic_career AND a.academic_institution = b.academic_institution
      
LEFT JOIN 
(select * from 
(select *,row_number() over (partition by id,career order by observation_tm desc) as rn 
from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_STDNT_CAREER]> as c
where c.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and c.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
) c where c.rn=1
) c ON a.student_id = c.id

WHERE 1=1

GROUP BY a.student_id, c.career HAVING MAX(b.ending_date) >= CURRENT_DATE-(365*2)

) a
	  
LEFT JOIN 
(SELECT DISTINCT student_id
FROM 
(
SELECT student_id, academic_career, student_career_nbr, academic_program, status, effective_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY student_id, academic_career, institution_id, student_career_nbr ORDER BY effective_date DESC, effective_sequence DESC) AS rn
FROM 
(select *,row_number() over (partition by student_id,effective_date,student_career_nbr,effective_sequence,academic_career order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_ACAD_PROG]> as ps_acad_prog
where ps_acad_prog.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and ps_acad_prog.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)ps_acad_prog where ps_acad_prog.dup_rn=1
)ps_acad_prog WHERE 1=1 AND ps_acad_prog.rn = 1 AND ps_acad_prog.status = 'AC'
)active ON active.student_id = a.student_id
	
/*LEFT JOIN 
(select * from 
(select *,row_number() over (partition by student_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn 
from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_PERSON]> as pp
where pp.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and pp.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)pp where pp.rn=1
)pp ON pp.student_id = a.student_id*/

LEFT JOIN 
(
select distinct emplid from (
							select *,row_number() over (partition by emplid order by effdt desc) as rn
							from
							(select *,row_number() over (partition by emplid,acad_career,stdnt_car_nbr,adm_appl_nbr,effdt,effseq,appl_prog_nbr order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_ADM_APPL_PROG]> as ps_adm_appl_prog
							where ps_adm_appl_prog.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and ps_adm_appl_prog.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
							)ps_adm_appl_prog where ps_adm_appl_prog.dup_rn=1
							)ps_adm_appl_prog where ps_adm_appl_prog.rn=1 and prog_status in ('AD')
)admitted_students on admitted_students.emplid = a.student_id
)eab_module_student_population where eab_module_student_population.rn=1

queryResults.sqlPreview: select spriden.student_id as user_id, first_name as first_name, last_name as last_name, birthdate as birth_date, null as first_generation_ind, CAST ( CASE WHEN …
queryResults.querySql:
select 
	spriden.student_id                         as user_id,
	first_name                                 as first_name,
	last_name                                  as last_name,
	birthdate                                  as birth_date,
	null                                       as first_generation_ind,
	CAST
		(
		CASE
			WHEN nation_code NOT IN ('', 'US')
				THEN 't'
			ELSE 'f'
		END
		AS BOOLEAN
		)                                      as international_ind,
	null                                       as sis_properties,
	null                                       as veteran_ind,
	null                                       as student_class_code
from 
	(
	select
		*
	from
		(
		select
			*,
			row_number() over
				(
				partition by
					banner_pidm
				order by
					observation_tm desc
				) as rn 
		from
			<passthrough.[Banner].[Person Identification Name SPRIDEN]> as spriden
		where
			spriden.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
			and spriden.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)
		spriden
	where
		spriden.rn = 1
	)
	spriden
	LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Pagoda].[MODULE_STUDENT_POPULATION].[Current Batch]> student
		ON student.student_id = spriden.student_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
		(
		select
			*
		from 
			(
			select
				*,
				row_number() over
					(
					partition by
						banner_pidm
					order by
						observation_tm desc
					) as rn
			from
				<passthrough.[Banner].[Person Demographics SPBPERS]> as spbpers
			where
				spbpers.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
				and spbpers.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
			)
			spbpers
		where
			spbpers.rn = 1
		)
		spbpers
		ON spriden.banner_pidm = spbpers.banner_pidm
	LEFT OUTER JOIN 
		(
		select
			*
		from
			(
			select
				*,
				row_number() over
					(
					partition by
						banner_pidm
					order by
						observation_tm desc
					) as rn
			from
				<passthrough.[Banner].[Citizenship GOBINTL]> as gobintl
			where
				gobintl.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
				and gobintl.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
			)
			gobintl
		where
			gobintl.rn = 1
		)
		gobintl
		ON spriden.banner_pidm = gobintl.banner_pidm

queryResults.querySql:
with population AS (
	--SELECT ID, active FROM students
select * from(
select *,RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY active DESC) AS rn 
from(
	SELECT DISTINCT STC_PERSON_ID as ID
	, CASE
			WHEN t.TERM_START_DATE >=CURRENT_DATE-730 then 'y'

		ELSE 'n'
		END AS active
	
	FROM(select * from 
		(select *,row_number() over (partition by student_acad_cred_id order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[STUDENT_ACAD_CRED]> as sac
		where sac.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sac.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		) sac where sac.dup_rn=1
		)sac

	JOIN (select * from 
		(select *,row_number() over (partition by terms_id order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[TERMS]> as t
		where t.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and t.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)t where t.dup_rn=1
		)t ON sac.STC_TERM = t.TERMS_ID AND t.TERM_START_DATE >= CURRENT_DATE - 1095
	
	WHERE 1=1

	UNION

	-- applicants
	SELECT DISTINCT APPL_APPLICANT as ID
	, CASE
			WHEN t.TERM_START_DATE >= CURRENT_DATE - 365 then 'y'
 		ELSE 'n'
		END AS active
	
	FROM (select * from 
		(select *,row_number() over (partition by applications_id order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[APPLICATIONS]> as a
		where a.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and a.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)a where a.dup_rn=1
		)a
	
	JOIN (select * from 
		(select *,row_number() over (partition by terms_id order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[TERMS]> as t
		where t.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and t.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)t where t.dup_rn=1
		)t ON a.APPL_START_TERM = t.TERMS_ID AND t.TERM_START_DATE >= CURRENT_DATE - 365

	UNION

	SELECT DISTINCT
	STAD_FACULTY as ID
	, 'y' AS active
	FROM (select * from 
		(select *,row_number() over (partition by student_advisement_id order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[STUDENT_ADVISEMENT]> as a
		where a.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and a.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)a where a.dup_rn=1
		)a
	--JOIN students ON STAD_STUDENT = students.ID
	WHERE STAD_START_DATE <= CURRENT_DATE AND (CURRENT_DATE <= STAD_END_DATE OR STAD_END_DATE IS NULL)

	UNION
	SELECT DISTINCT
	CSF_FACULTY as ID
	, 'y' AS active
	FROM (select * from 
		(select *,row_number() over (partition by course_sec_faculty_id order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[COURSE_SEC_FACULTY]> as a
		where a.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and a.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)a where a.dup_rn=1
		)a

  UNION
  select distinct
  faculty_id as ID
  ,'y' AS active
  from (select * from 
		(select *,row_number() over (partition by faculty_id order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[FACULTY]> as a
		where a.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and a.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)a where a.dup_rn=1
		)a where fac_advise_flag = 'Y'

	UNION
    -----------customize per member or remove if not needed
	SELECT DISTINCT
	oer_person as ID
	, 'y' as active
	FROM (select * from 
		(select *,row_number() over (partition by org_entity_role_id order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[ORG_ENTITY_ROLE]> as a
		where a.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and a.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)a where a.dup_rn=1
		)a where oer_org_role = '000'
	)pop2
	)population where rn=1 
)
/*, pop2 AS (
	SELECT *
	, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pop.ID ORDER BY active DESC) AS rn
	from pop
)
, population AS (
	SELECT *
	FROM pop2
	WHERE rn = 1
)*/

select DISTINCT
  P.ID as  user_id
, P.FIRST_NAME as first_name
, P.LAST_NAME as last_name
, CAST(P.BIRTH_DATE AS date) as birth_date
, P.GENDER as gender
, p.ethnic as ethnicity_code
, CASE
	WHEN P.PERSON_STATUS = 'D' THEN TRUE
	ELSE FALSE
	END as deceased_ind
, CASE
	WHEN fp.FPER_ALIEN_STATUS = 'N' THEN TRUE -- non-resident alien
	ELSE FALSE
	END as international_ind
, '' as legacy_code
, NULL as first_generation_ind
, CASE WHEN vet.MILITARY_STATUSES is null then FALSE else TRUE END as veteran_ind -- not tracked
, '' as student_class_code
, current_date as create_date
, current_date as update_date


FROM (select * from 
		(select *,row_number() over (partition by id order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[PERSON]> as P
		where P.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and P.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)P where P.dup_rn=1
		)P

JOIN population ON P.ID = population.ID

LEFT OUTER JOIN (select * from 
		(select *,row_number() over (partition by foreign_person_id order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[FOREIGN_PERSON]> as fp
		where fp.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and fp.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)fp where fp.dup_rn=1
		)fp ON P.ID = fp.FOREIGN_PERSON_ID

LEFT OUTER JOIN (select * from 
		(select *,row_number() over (partition by id order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[MILITARY_ASSOC]> as vet
		where vet.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and vet.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)vet where vet.dup_rn=1
		)vet on P.ID = vet.ID

WHERE 1=1

queryResults.sqlPreview: SELECT pp.student_id AS user_id , COALESCE(pn1.first_name, pn.first_name) AS first_name , COALESCE(pn1.last_name, pn.last_name) AS last_name , CAST(pp.birthdate…
queryResults.querySql:
SELECT pp.student_id                           AS user_id
    , COALESCE(pn1.first_name, pn.first_name)           AS first_name
    , COALESCE(pn1.last_name, pn.last_name)            AS last_name
    , CAST(pp.birthdate AS DATE)                  AS birth_date
    , CASE
      WHEN int_check.student_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
     END                             AS international_ind
    , NULL                             AS first_generation_ind

    , CASE
      WHEN pd.militart_status NOT IN ('1', '2', 'X', ' ', '') THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
     END AS veteran_ind
	, NULL AS student_class_code
	, NULL AS sis_properties

FROM 
(
select * from
(select *,row_number() over (partition by student_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_PERSON]> as pp
 where pp.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and pp.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
) pp where pp.rn=1
) pp
   
JOIN 
(
select * from 
(
SELECT pn.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY pn.student_id, pn.name_type ORDER BY pn.effective_date DESC) AS rn
	FROM 
		(select *,row_number() over (partition by effective_date,student_id,name_type order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
		  from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_NAMES]> pn
		   where pn.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and pn.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		 )pn where pn.dup_rn=1
		 )pn WHERE 1=1 AND pn.name_type = 'PRI'
) pn ON pn.student_id = pp.student_id AND pn.rn = 1

LEFT JOIN 
(
select * from 
(
SELECT pn.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY pn.student_id, pn.name_type ORDER BY pn.effective_date DESC) AS rn
	FROM 
		(select *,row_number() over (partition by effective_date,student_id,name_type order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
		  from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_NAMES]> pn
		   where pn.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and pn.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		 )pn where pn.dup_rn=1
		 )pn WHERE 1=1 AND pn.name_type = 'PRF'
) pn1 ON pn1.student_id = pp.student_id AND pn1.rn = 1
   
LEFT JOIN 
(select * from 
(select *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY observation_tm DESC) AS rn from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_PERSONAL_DATA]> as pd
where pd.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and pd.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
) pd where pd.rn=1
) pd ON pd.student_id = pp.student_id

LEFT JOIN 
(select * from
(SELECT DISTINCT p.student_id FROM 
(select *,row_number() over (partition by student_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_PERSON]> as p
where p.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and p.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
) p where p.rn=1
) p
WHERE NOT EXISTS
(
SELECT TRUE FROM --'X' 
(select *,row_number() over (partition by student_id,dependent_id,country order by observation_tm desc) as rn 
from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_CITIZENSHIP]> as ps_citizenship
where ps_citizenship.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and ps_citizenship.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)ps_citizenship where ps_citizenship.rn=1 and country = 'USA' AND citizenship_status IN ('1','2')
)--ps_citizenship WHERE country = 'USA' AND citizenship_status IN ('1','2')
) int_check ON int_check.student_id = pp.student_id

WHERE 1=1;

queryResults.sqlPreview: WITH enroll AS ( SELECT DISTINCT student_id FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_STDNT_ENRL]> AS e ) SELECT student_id AS user_id , email_type AS email_type_code …
queryResults.querySql:
WITH enroll AS
(
   SELECT DISTINCT student_id 
   FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_STDNT_ENRL]> AS e
)
SELECT student_id                      AS user_id
       , email_type                    AS email_type_code
       , ea.RN                         AS email_number
       , CASE
           WHEN email_address = 'goesnowhere@vccs.edu' THEN student_id || '@vccs.edu'
           ELSE email_address
         END                           AS email_address
       , NULL                          AS email_status
       , CASE
           WHEN preferred_email_indicator = 'Y' THEN TRUE
           ELSE FALSE
         END                           AS preferred_ind
       , CURRENT_DATE                  AS create_date
       , CURRENT_DATE                  AS update_date
       , TRUE                          AS active_ind
FROM (SELECT ea.*
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY student_id, email_type
                                  ORDER BY email_address) AS rn
      FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_EMAIL_ADDRESSES]> AS ea
      WHERE 1 = 1) ea
WHERE 1 = 1
   AND rn = 1
UNION
SELECT student_id                      AS user_id
       , 'PREF'                        AS email_type_code
       , ea.RN                         AS email_number
       , CASE
           WHEN email_address = 'goesnowhere@vccs.edu' THEN student_id || '@vccs.edu'
           ELSE email_address
         END                           AS email_address
       , NULL                          AS email_status
       , CASE
           WHEN preferred_email_indicator = 'Y' THEN TRUE
           ELSE FALSE
         END                           AS preferred_ind
       , CURRENT_DATE                  AS create_date
       , CURRENT_DATE                  AS update_date
       , TRUE                          AS active_ind
FROM (SELECT ea.*
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY student_id
                                  ORDER BY email_address) AS rn
      FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_EMAIL_ADDRESSES]> AS ea
      WHERE 1 = 1
         AND student_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM enroll)
         AND email_type IN ('OTHR')) ea
WHERE 1 = 1
   AND rn = 1

queryResults.sqlPreview: SELECT majors.EMPLID AS student_id , majors.EFFDT AS effective_date , programs.PROG_STATUS AS prog_status , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY majors.EMPLID, majors…
queryResults.querySql:
SELECT majors.EMPLID                                AS student_id
       , majors.EFFDT                               AS effective_date
       , programs.PROG_STATUS                       AS prog_status
       , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY majors.EMPLID, majors.EFFDT, majors.STDNT_CAR_NBR
                           ORDER BY MAJORS.RANKNO)  AS sequence
       , programs.ACAD_GROUP                        AS college_code
       , programs.CAMPUS                            AS campus_code
       , programs.acad_org                          AS department_code
       , majors.ACAD_PLAN                           AS major_code
       , concentrations1.acad_sub_plan              AS concentration_code_1
       , concentrations2.acad_sub_plan              AS concentration_code_2
       , concentrations3.acad_sub_plan              AS concentration_code_3
       , majors.DEGREE                              AS degree_code
       , majors.STDNT_CAR_NBR                       AS scn
       , programs.acad_career                       AS acad_career
       , programs.acad_prog                         AS program_code
       , programs.req_term                          AS prog_req_term
       , majors.req_term                            AS plan_req_term
FROM <[Pagoda].[PROGRAM].[Current Batch]> as programs
JOIN <[Pagoda].[MAJOR].[Current Batch]> as majors
  ON programs.emplid = majors.emplid
     AND majors.acad_career = programs.acad_career
     AND majors.stdnt_car_nbr = programs.stdnt_car_nbr
     AND majors.effdt = programs.effdt
LEFT JOIN <[Pagoda].[CONCENTRATION].[Current Batch]> as concentrations1
   ON concentrations1.EMPLID = programs.EMPLID
     AND concentrations1.EMPLID = majors.EMPLID
     AND CAST(concentrations1.STDNT_CAR_NBR AS INT) = programs.STDNT_CAR_NBR
     AND CAST(concentrations1.STDNT_CAR_NBR AS INT) = majors.STDNT_CAR_NBR
     AND concentrations1.EFFDT = programs.EFFDT
     AND concentrations1.RANKNO = 1
     AND concentrations1.ACAD_PLAN = majors.ACAD_PLAN
LEFT JOIN <[Pagoda].[CONCENTRATION].[Current Batch]> as concentrations2
   ON concentrations2.EMPLID = programs.EMPLID
     AND concentrations2.EMPLID = majors.EMPLID
     AND CAST(concentrations2.STDNT_CAR_NBR AS INT)= programs.STDNT_CAR_NBR
     AND CAST(concentrations2.STDNT_CAR_NBR AS INT) = majors.STDNT_CAR_NBR
     AND concentrations2.EFFDT = programs.EFFDT
     AND concentrations2.RANKNO = 2
     AND concentrations2.ACAD_PLAN = majors.acad_plan
LEFT JOIN <[Pagoda].[CONCENTRATION].[Current Batch]> as concentrations3
   ON concentrations3.EMPLID = programs.EMPLID
     AND concentrations3.EMPLID = majors.EMPLID
     AND CAST(concentrations3.STDNT_CAR_NBR AS INT) = programs.STDNT_CAR_NBR
     AND CAST(concentrations3.STDNT_CAR_NBR AS INT) = majors.STDNT_CAR_NBR
     AND concentrations3.EFFDT = programs.EFFDT
     AND concentrations3.RANKNO = 3
     AND concentrations3.ACAD_PLAN = majors.ACAD_PLAN
WHERE 1=1

queryResults.sqlPreview: SELECT a.student_id, a.acad_career, a.effective_date2 as effective_date, a.strm FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ms2.student_id, ms2.acad_career, ms2.effective_date2, tt.…
queryResults.querySql:
SELECT a.student_id, a.acad_career, a.effective_date2 as effective_date, a.strm
FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ms2.student_id, ms2.acad_career, ms2.effective_date2, tt.term AS strm
                        , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ms2.student_id, tt.term, ms2.acad_career
                                            ORDER BY effective_date2 DESC) AS rn   --rank in order to only pull latest record per term
        FROM (select * , CAST(ms2.effective_date AS DATE) as effective_date2
              --from im_prog_maj_stack as ms2) as ms2
           from <[Pagoda].[PROG].[Current Batch]> as ms2) as ms2
        --JOIN <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TERM_TBL]> tt
      JOIN (
      select   * 
        from   (
        select   term , ending_date, row_number() over (partition by academic_institution,academic_career,term order by  observation_tm   desc )   as   dup_rn
        FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TERM_TBL]> as ptt
        where  ptt.observation_tm >  <PIT_START_TIME>  and ptt.observation_tm <=  <PIT_END_TIME>  
        ) as ptt 
        where  ptt.dup_rn = 1
      ) as tt
          ON tt.ending_date >= effective_date2
             AND tt.term = (SELECT MIN(tt1.term)                          --minimum term where end date is greater than effective date
                            --FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TERM_TBL]> tt1
                            FROM (
                            select   * 
                              from   (
                              select   term ,term_begin_date,  row_number() over (partition by academic_institution,academic_career,term order by  observation_tm   desc )   as   dup_rn
                              FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TERM_TBL]> as ptt
                              where  ptt.observation_tm >  <PIT_START_TIME>  and ptt.observation_tm <=  <PIT_END_TIME>  
                              ) as ptt 
                              where  ptt.dup_rn = 1
                            ) as tt1
                            --JOIN <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_STDNT_CAR_TERM]> sct1
                            JOIN (
                            select   * 
                              from   (
                              select   student_id , term, academic_career_first,career, row_number() over (partition by student_id,academic_institution,academic_career_first,term order by  observation_tm   desc )   as   dup_rn
                              FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_STDNT_CAR_TERM]> as psct

select 
	spriden.student_id                       as student_id,
	term_code                                as term_code,
	course_reference_number                  as course_reference_number,
	sequence_number                          as sequence_number,
	case
		when message like 'Record deleted%%'
			then 'DW'
		else registration_status_code
	end                                      as registration_status_code,
	cast(registration_status_date as date)   as registration_status_date,
	cast(registration_status_date as date)   as activity_date,
	current_date                             as create_date,
	current_date                             as update_date,
	'T'                                      as active_ind
from 
	(
	select
		*
	from
		(
		select
			*,
			row_number() over
				(
				partition by
					banner_pidm,
					term_code,
					course_reference_number,
					sequence_number
				order by
					observation_tm desc
				) as rn
		from
			<passthrough.[Banner].[Student Course Registration Archive SFRSTCA]> as sfrstca
		where
			sfrstca.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
			and sfrstca.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)
		sfrstca
	where
		sfrstca.rn = 1
	)
	sfrstca
	join
		(
		select * from
			(
			select
				*,
				row_number() over
					(
					partition by
						banner_pidm
					order by
						observation_tm desc
					) as rn
			from
				<passthrough.[Banner].[Person Identification Name SPRIDEN]> spriden
			where
				spriden.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
				and spriden.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
			)
			spriden where spriden.rn=1
		)
		spriden
		on spriden.banner_pidm = sfrstca.banner_pidm

queryResults.querySql:
select 
	ssbsect.term_code                             as term_code,
	ssbsect.part_of_term_code                     as session_code,
	ssbsect.crn                                   as course_reference_number,
	nvl(ssbsect.campus_code,'NA')                 as campus_code,
	ssbsect.subject_code                          as subject_code,
	ssbsect.course_number                         as course_number,
	ssbsect.type_code                             as course_type_code,
	ssbsect.course_title                          as section_title,
	ssbsect.section_number                        as section_name,
	ssbsect.maximum_enrollment                    as seats_offered,
	ssbsect.current_waitlist_size                 as waitlist_capacity,
	ssbsect.available_seats                       as current_capacity,
	cast
		(
		case
			when ssbsect.gradable_indicator = 'Y'
				then 't'
			else 'f'
		end
		as boolean
		)                                         as gradable_ind,
	ssbsect.instructional_method_code             as instructional_method_code,
	ssbsect.current_enrollment                    as enrollment_census,
	null                                          as enrollment_census_date,
	null                                          as crosslist_group,
	student_id                                    as primary_instructor_id,
	'{"CRN":"' || ssbsect.crn || '"}'             as sis_properties,
	null                                          as hidden_ind,
	current_date                                  as create_date,
	current_date                                  as update_date,
	CASE
    	WHEN ssbsect.status_code IN ('X','I','C')
    		THEN FALSE
    	ELSE TRUE
	END                                           as active_ind,
	drop_dates.start_date                         as drop_start_date,
	drop_dates.end_date                           as drop_end_date,
	wd_dates.end_date                             as withdrawal_end_date
from 
	(
	select
		*
	from 
		(
		select
			*,
			row_number() over
				(
				partition by
					term_code,
					crn
				order by
					observation_tm desc
				) as rn
		from
			<passthrough.[Banner].[Section General Information SSBSECT]> as ssbsect
		where
			ssbsect.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
			and ssbsect.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)
		ssbsect
	where
		ssbsect.rn = 1
	)
	ssbsect
	left join
		(
		select
			*,
			row_number() over
				(
				partition by
					term_code,
					crn
				order by
					case
						when primary_instructor = 'Y'
							then 1
						else 2
					end
				) as rn2
		from
			(
			select
				*,
				row_number() over
					(
					partition by
						term_code,
						crn,
						banner_pidm,
						category
					order by
						observation_tm desc
					) as rn
			from
				<passthrough.[Banner].[Faculty Member Instructional Assignment SIRASGN]> as sirasgn
			where
				sirasgn.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
				and sirasgn.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
			)
			sirasgn
		where
			sirasgn.rn = 1
		)
		sirasgn
		on sirasgn.term_code = ssbsect.term_code
		and sirasgn.crn = ssbsect.crn
		and sirasgn.rn2 = 1  
	left join
		(
		select
			*
		from
			(
			select
				*,
				row_number() over
					(
					partition by
						banner_pidm
					order by
						observation_tm
					) as rn
			from
				<passthrough.[Banner].[Person Identification Name SPRIDEN]> as spriden
			where
				spriden.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
				and spriden.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
			)
			spriden
		where
			spriden.rn = 1
		)
		spriden
		on spriden.banner_pidm = sirasgn.banner_pidm
	left join
		(
		select
			*
		from
			(
			select
				*,
				row_number() over
					(
					partition by
						term_code
					order by
						observation_tm
					) as rn
			from
				<passthrough.[Banner].[Term Code Lookup STVTERM]> as stvterm
			where
				stvterm.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
				and stvterm.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
			)
			stvterm
		where
			stvterm.rn = 1
		)
		stvterm
		on stvterm.term_code = ssbsect.term_code
	left join
		(
		select
			sfrrsts_term_code,
			sfrrsts_ptrm_code,
			MIN(sfrrsts_start_date) AS start_date,
			MAX(sfrrsts_end_date)   AS end_date
		from
			(
			select
				*,
				row_number() over
					(
					partition by
						sfrrsts_term_code,
						sfrrsts_ptrm_code,
						sfrrsts_rsts_code,
						sfrrsts_eff_by_enrl_stat,
						sfrrsts_end_date,
						sfrrsts_start_date
					order by
						observation_tm
					) as rn
			from
				<passthrough.[Banner].[Registration Status Table By Term SFRRSTS]> as sfrrsts
			where
				sfrrsts.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
				and sfrrsts.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
			)
			sfrrsts
			join
				(
				select
					*
				from
					(
					select
						*,
						row_number() over
							(
							partition by
								registration_status_code
							order by
								observation_tm
							) as rn
					from
						<passthrough.[Banner].[Course Registration Status Validation STVRSTS]> as stvrsts
					where
						stvrsts.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
						and stvrsts.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
					)
					stvrsts
				where
					stvrsts.rn = 1
				)
				stvrsts
				on registration_status_code = sfrrsts_rsts_code
				and voice_type = 'D'
		where
			sfrrsts.rn = 1
		group by
			sfrrsts_term_code,
			sfrrsts_ptrm_code
		)
		drop_dates 
		on drop_dates.sfrrsts_term_code = ssbsect.term_code
		and drop_dates.sfrrsts_ptrm_code = ssbsect.part_of_term_code
	left join
		(
		select
			sfrrsts_term_code,
			sfrrsts_ptrm_code,
			MIN(sfrrsts_start_date) AS start_date,
			MAX(sfrrsts_end_date)   AS end_date
		from
			(
			select
				*,
				row_number() over
					(
					partition by
						sfrrsts_term_code,
						sfrrsts_ptrm_code,
						sfrrsts_rsts_code,
						sfrrsts_eff_by_enrl_stat,
						sfrrsts_end_date,
						sfrrsts_start_date
					order by
						observation_tm
					) as rn
			from
				<passthrough.[Banner].[Registration Status Table By Term SFRRSTS]> as sfrrsts
			where
				sfrrsts.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
				and sfrrsts.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
			)
			sfrrsts
			join
				(
				select
					*
				from
					(
					select
						*,
						row_number() over
							(
							partition by
								registration_status_code
							order by
								observation_tm
							) as rn
					from
						<passthrough.[Banner].[Course Registration Status Validation STVRSTS]> as stvrsts
					where
						stvrsts.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
						and stvrsts.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
					)
					stvrsts
				where
					stvrsts.rn = 1
				)
				stvrsts
				on registration_status_code = sfrrsts_rsts_code
				and voice_type = 'W'
		where
			sfrrsts.rn = 1
		group by
			sfrrsts_term_code,
			sfrrsts_ptrm_code
		)
		wd_dates
		on wd_dates.sfrrsts_term_code = ssbsect.term_code
 		and wd_dates.sfrrsts_ptrm_code = ssbsect.part_of_term_code
where
	1 = 1

select 
 cat_section.term_code as term_code
,cat_section.part_of_term_code as session_code
,cat_section.crn as course_reference_number
,NVL(cat_section.campus_code,'NA') as campus_code
,cat_section.subject_code as subject_code
,cat_section.course_number as course_number
,cat_section.type_code as course_type_code
,cat_section.course_title as section_title
,cat_section.section_number as section_name
,cat_section.maximum_enrollment as seats_offered
,cat_section.current_waitlist_size as waitlist_capacity
,cat_section.available_seats as current_capacity
,cast(case when cat_section.gradable_indicator='Y' then 't' else 'f' end as boolean) as gradable_ind
,cat_section.instructional_method_code as instructional_method_code
,cat_section.current_enrollment as enrollment_census
,NULL as enrollment_census_date
,ssrxlst.cross_list_group AS crosslist_group
,student_id as primary_instructor_id
, '{"CRN":"' || cat_section.crn || '"}' as sis_properties
, drop_dates.start_date AS drop_start_date
, drop_dates.end_date AS drop_end_date
, wd_dates.end_date AS withdrawal_end_date
, CAST(CASE WHEN hidden.end_date <= current_date THEN 'T' ELSE 'N' END AS BOOLEAN) AS hidden_ind
, current_date AS create_date
, current_date AS update_date
, CASE
    WHEN cat_section.status_code IN ('X','I','C') THEN FALSE
    ELSE TRUE
  END AS active_ind
from 
<[Banner].[Section General Information SSBSECT]> as cat_section

left join (select *,row_number() over (partition by term_code, crn order by primary_instructor desc) as RN 
		   from <[Banner].[Faculty Member Instructional Assignment SIRASGN]> as sirasgn
	  ) sirasgn on sirasgn.term_code=cat_section.term_code and sirasgn.crn=cat_section.crn and sirasgn.RN=1
		  
left join <[Banner].[Person Identification Name SPRIDEN]> as spriden on spriden.banner_pidm = sirasgn.banner_pidm	  

left join <[Banner].[Term Code Lookup STVTERM]> as stvterm on cat_section.term_code = stvterm.term_code

left join (select sfrrsts_term_code,sfrrsts_ptrm_code,min(sfrrsts_start_date) as start_date,min(sfrrsts_end_date) as end_date
		   from 
  			<[Banner].[Registration Status Table By Term SFRRSTS]> as sfrrsts
		   join <[Banner].[Course Registration Status Validation STVRSTS]> as stvrsts

queryResults.querySql:
select 
 cat_section.term_code as term_code
,NULL as session_code
,cat_section.crn as course_reference_number
,NVL(cat_section.campus_code,'NA') as campus_code
,cat_section.subject_code as subject_code
,cat_section.course_number as course_number
,cat_section.type_code as course_type_code
,cat_section.course_title as section_title
,cat_section.section_number as section_name
,cat_section.maximum_enrollment as seats_offered
,cat_section.current_waitlist_size as waitlist_capacity
,cat_section.available_seats as current_capacity
,cast(case when cat_section.gradable_indicator='Y' then 't' else 'f' end as boolean) as gradable_ind
,cat_section.instructional_method_code as instructional_method_code
,cat_section.current_enrollment as enrollment_census
,NULL as enrollment_census_date
,NULL AS crosslist_group
,student_id as primary_instructor_id
, NULL as sis_properties
, NULL AS hidden_ind
, current_date AS create_date
, current_date AS update_date
, CASE
    WHEN cat_section.status_code IN ('X','I','C') THEN FALSE
    ELSE TRUE
  END AS active_ind
,dd.sfrrsts_start_date as drop_start_date
,dd.sfrrsts_end_date as drop_end_date
,wd.sfrrsts_end_date as withdrawal_end_date
,case when cast(cat_section.credits as INT) >= 1 then 'All Credit Courses' else NULL end as section_note


from 
(select * from 
(select *,row_number() over (partition by term_code,crn order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Section General Information SSBSECT]> as ssbsect where ssbsect.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and ssbsect.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>)cat_section
where cat_section.rn=1)cat_section

left join (select *,row_number() over (partition by term_code, crn order by primary_instructor desc) as RN 
		   from (select *,row_number() over (partition by term_code, crn, banner_pidm,category order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Faculty Member Instructional Assignment SIRASGN]> as sirasgn
		   where sirasgn.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sirasgn.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>)sirasgn where sirasgn.dup_rn=1
	  ) sirasgn on sirasgn.term_code=cat_section.term_code and sirasgn.crn=cat_section.crn and sirasgn.RN=1
		  
left join (
select * from(
select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm order by observation_tm) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Person Identification Name SPRIDEN]> as spriden where spriden.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and spriden.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)spriden where spriden.rn=1
)spriden on spriden.banner_pidm = sirasgn.banner_pidm

left join (
select * from (
select *,row_number() over (partition by sfrrsts_term_code,sfrrsts_ptrm_code,sfrrsts_rsts_code,sfrrsts_eff_by_enrl_stat,sfrrsts_end_date,sfrrsts_start_date order by observation_tm) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Registration Status Table By Term SFRRSTS]> as sfrrsts where sfrrsts.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sfrrsts.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)dd where dd.rn=1 
) as dd 

on (cat_section.term_code = dd.sfrrsts_term_code 
 and dd.sfrrsts_rsts_code = 'DD'
 and cat_section.part_of_term_code = dd.sfrrsts_ptrm_code)
 
 left join (
select * from (
select *,row_number() over (partition by sfrrsts_term_code,sfrrsts_ptrm_code,sfrrsts_rsts_code,sfrrsts_eff_by_enrl_stat,sfrrsts_end_date,sfrrsts_start_date order by observation_tm) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Registration Status Table By Term SFRRSTS]> as sfrrsts where sfrrsts.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sfrrsts.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)wd where wd.rn=1 
) as wd 

on (cat_section.term_code = wd.sfrrsts_term_code 
 and wd.sfrrsts_rsts_code = 'W'
 and cat_section.part_of_term_code = wd.sfrrsts_ptrm_code)
 
 --left join (select * from <passthrough.[Banner].[Registration Status Table By Term SFRRSTS]> as sfrrsts where sfrrsts.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sfrrsts.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>) as wd on (cat_section.term_code = wd.sfrrsts_term_code 
 --and wd.sfrrsts_rsts_code = 'W'
 --and cat_section.part_of_term_code = wd.sfrrsts_ptrm_code)
 
--where cat_section.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and cat_section.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
--and spriden.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and spriden.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
--and dd.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and dd.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
--and wd.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and wd.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>

queryResults.sqlPreview: SELECT SEC_TERM AS term_code , '' AS session_code , SEC_SYNONYM AS course_reference_number , COALESCE(SEC_LOCATION,'NA') AS campus_code , SEC_SUBJECT AS subject…
queryResults.querySql:
SELECT 
SEC_TERM AS term_code
, '' AS session_code
, SEC_SYNONYM AS course_reference_number
, COALESCE(SEC_LOCATION,'NA') AS campus_code
, SEC_SUBJECT AS subject_code
, SEC_COURSE_NO AS course_number
, SEC_CRED_TYPE AS course_type_code
, REPLACE(SEC_SHORT_TITLE,'ý',' ') AS section_title
, SEC_NO AS section_name
, CAST(COALESCE(SEC_SCHED_CAPACITY,0) as INTEGER) AS seats_offered
, NULL AS waitlist_capacity
, COALESCE(SEC_CAPACITY,0)  AS current_capacity
, NULL AS gradable_ind
, SEC_CRED_TYPE AS instructional_method_code
, NULL AS enrollment_census
, NULL AS enrollment_census_date
, '' AS crosslist_group
, '' AS section_tag
, CSF.CSF_FACULTY AS primary_instructor_id
, '{"SectionId":"' || CS.COURSE_SECTIONS_ID || '", "CourseId":"' || CS.SEC_COURSE || '"}' AS sis_properties
, CAST(COALESCE(SEC_OVR_REG_START_DATE,T.TERM_REG_START_DATE) as DATE) AS drop_start_date
, CAST(COALESCE(CS.SEC_OVR_DROP_END_DATE,T.TERM_DROP_END_DATE)as DATE) AS drop_end_date
, CAST(SEC_OVR_DROP_END_DATE as DATE) AS withdrawal_end_date
, '' AS section_attribute
, '' AS credit_hours
, NULL AS hidden_ind
, current_date AS create_date
, current_date  AS update_date
, CASE
	WHEN s.SEC_STATUS = 'A' THEN TRUE
	ELSE FALSE
	END AS active_ind 

FROM (select * from 
	(select *,row_number() over (partition by COURSE_SECTIONS_ID order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[COURSE_SECTIONS]> as COURSE_SECTIONS
	where COURSE_SECTIONS.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and COURSE_SECTIONS.observation_tm<= <PIT_END_TIME>
	) CS where CS.rn=1
	)CS 

LEFT JOIN (select * from 
		(select *,row_number() over (partition by COURSE_SECTIONS_ID,POS order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[SEC_STATUSES]> as s
		where s.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and s.observation_tm<= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)s where s.rn=1  
		)s on CS.COURSE_SECTIONS_ID = s.COURSE_SECTIONS_ID and s.POS = 1

LEFT OUTER JOIN (
	SELECT *
	, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CSF_COURSE_SECTION ORDER BY CSF_FACULTY_LOAD DESC) rn
	FROM (select *,row_number() over (partition by COURSE_SEC_FACULTY_ID order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[COURSE_SEC_FACULTY]> as CSF
		where CSF.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and CSF.observation_tm<= <PIT_END_TIME>
	) CSF where CSF.dup_rn=1
	)CSF ON CSF.CSF_COURSE_SECTION=CS.COURSE_SECTIONS_ID AND CSF.rn = 1

LEFT JOIN (select * from 
		  (select *,row_number() over (partition by TERMS_ID order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[TERMS]> as T
		  where T.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and T.observation_tm<= <PIT_END_TIME>
		  )T where T.rn=1
		  ) T ON CS.SEC_TERM = T.TERMS_ID 

WHERE 1=1
AND CS.SEC_TERM IS NOT NULL
--and CS.SEC_ACAD_LEVEL = 'UG'
and s.SEC_STATUS = 'A'

ORDER BY 1 DESC, 2

queryResults.sqlPreview: select term_code, course_reference_number, meet_room_code, meet_building_code, meet_number, meet_monday, meet_tuesday, meet_wednesday, meet_thursday, meet_frida…
queryResults.querySql:
select term_code,
       course_reference_number,
	   meet_room_code,
	   meet_building_code,
	   meet_number,
       meet_monday,
       meet_tuesday,
       meet_wednesday,
       meet_thursday,
       meet_friday,
       meet_saturday,
       meet_sunday,
       meet_start_time,
       meet_end_time,
       meet_start_date,
       meet_end_date,
       active_ind,
       current_date AS create_date,
       current_date AS update_date
from (select *, row_number() over (partition by term_code, course_reference_number, meet_monday, meet_tuesday, meet_wednesday, meet_thursday, meet_friday,
		meet_saturday, meet_sunday, coalesce(meet_start_time, '0000'), coalesce(meet_end_time,'0000') order by meet_id desc) as rn
      from (select b.SEC_TERM                                                                      as term_code,
                   b.SEC_SYNONYM                                                                   as course_reference_number,
                   a.COURSE_SEC_MEETING_ID                                                         as meet_id,
                   a.CSM_ROOM                                                                      as meet_room_code,
                   a.CSM_BLDG                                                                      as meet_building_code,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.SEC_TERM, b.SEC_NAME ORDER BY CSM_MONDAY)     as meet_number,
                   CASE
                     WHEN a.CSM_MONDAY = 'Y' THEN TRUE
                     ELSE FALSE
                       END                                                                         as meet_monday,
                   CASE
                     WHEN a.CSM_TUESDAY = 'Y' THEN TRUE
                     ELSE FALSE
                       END                                                                         AS meet_tuesday,
                   CASE
                     WHEN a.CSM_WEDNESDAY = 'Y' THEN TRUE
                     ELSE FALSE
                       END                                                                         AS meet_wednesday,
                   CASE
                     WHEN a.CSM_THURSDAY = 'Y' THEN TRUE
                     ELSE FALSE
                       END                                                                         AS meet_thursday,
                   CASE
                     WHEN a.CSM_FRIDAY = 'Y' THEN TRUE
                     ELSE FALSE
                       END                                                                         AS meet_friday,
                   CASE
                     WHEN a.CSM_SATURDAY = 'Y' THEN TRUE
                     ELSE FALSE
                       END                                                                         AS meet_saturday,
                   CASE
                     WHEN a.CSM_SUNDAY = 'Y' THEN TRUE
                     ELSE FALSE
                       END                                                                         AS meet_sunday,
                   REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CAST(a.CSM_START_TIME as VARCHAR), 12, 5), ':', '') AS meet_start_time,
                   REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CAST(a.CSM_END_TIME as VARCHAR), 12, 5), ':', '')   AS meet_end_time,
                   CAST(a.CSM_START_DATE as DATE)                                     AS meet_start_date,
                   CAST(a.CSM_END_DATE as DATE)                                       AS meet_end_date,
                   TRUE                                                                          AS active_ind
               FROM (select * from 
               					(select *,row_number() over (partition by COURSE_SEC_MEETING_ID order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[COURSE_SEC_MEETING]> as COURSE_SEC_MEETING
               					where COURSE_SEC_MEETING.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and COURSE_SEC_MEETING.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
               					)COURSE_SEC_MEETING  
               		where COURSE_SEC_MEETING.rn=1 and (CSM_MONDAY IS NOT NULL OR CSM_TUESDAY IS NOT NULL OR CSM_WEDNESDAY IS NOT NULL OR CSM_THURSDAY IS NOT NULL OR CSM_FRIDAY IS NOT NULL OR CSM_SATURDAY IS NOT NULL OR CSM_SUNDAY IS NOT NULL) 
               		) a
                   JOIN (select * from
                   		(select *,row_number() over (partition by COURSE_SECTIONS_ID order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[COURSE_SECTIONS]> as b
                   		where b.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and b.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
                   		)b where b.rn=1
                   		) b ON a.CSM_COURSE_SECTION = b.COURSE_SECTIONS_ID
            WHERE 1 = 1
             AND b.SEC_TERM IS NOT NULL
              --and b.SEC_ACAD_LEVEL = 'UG'
	)x
)y
where y.rn = 1
