    COALESCE(eab_ic.level_code, eab_cr.level_code)                           AS student_level_code,
    COALESCE(eab_ic.course_type_code, eab_cr.course_type_code, 'NA')         AS course_type_code,
    COALESCE(eab_ic.course_credits, eab_cr.attempted_credits, 0)             AS course_credits,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(stvrsts.voice_type,'R') = 'R'
            THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END                                                                      AS registered_ind,
    COALESCE(eab_cr.registration_status_code,'RE')                           AS registration_status_code,
    COALESCE(eab_ic.final_grade_date, eab_cr.registration_status_date)       AS registration_status_date,
    COALESCE(eab_ic.attempted_credits, eab_cr.attempted_credits, 0)          AS attempted_credits,
    COALESCE(eab_ic.earned_credits, 0)                                       AS earned_credits,
    NULL                                                                     AS gpa_credits,
    NULL                                                                     AS passed_credits,
    COALESCE(eab_ic.gradable_ind, eab_s.gradable_ind)                        AS gradable_ind,
    COALESCE(eab_ic.midterm_grade, eab_cr.midterm_grade)                     AS midterm_grade,
    eab_ic.final_grade                                                       AS final_grade,
    eab_ic.earned_credits *
        eab_g.quality_points                                                 AS grade_points,
    NULL                                                                     AS gpa_include_ind,
    coalesce(eab_ic.final_grade_date,current_timestamp)                      AS final_grade_date,
    CASE
        WHEN eab_ic.student_id IS NOT NULL
            THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END                                                                      AS final_grade_official_ind,
    FALSE                                                                    AS transfer_course_ind,
    NULL                                                                     AS transfer_inst_code,
    CASE
        WHEN eab_ic.student_id IS NOT NULL
            THEN FALSE
        ELSE TRUE
    END                                                                      AS in_progress_ind,
    eab_s.instructional_method_code                                          AS instruction_method,
    CASE
        WHEN eab_ic.repeat_code IN ('E','A')
            THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END                                                                      AS repeat_ind,
    NULL                                                                     AS core_ind,
    NULL                                                                     AS honors_ind,
    NULL                                                                     AS section_attribute,
    CASE
        WHEN stvrsts.voice_type = 'R'
            AND COALESCE
                (
                sp.sobptrm_start_date,
                eab_ct.term_start_date
                ) <= CURRENT_DATE
            AND COALESCE
                (
                sp.sobptrm_end_date,
                eab_ct.term_end_date
                ) >= CURRENT_DATE
            THEN 'IN_PROGRESS'
        WHEN
            stvrsts.voice_type = 'R'
            AND COALESCE
                (
                sp.sobptrm_start_date,
                eab_ct.term_start_date
                ) > CURRENT_DATE
            THEN 'REGISTERED'
        WHEN
            stvrsts.voice_type = 'L'
            AND COALESCE
                (
                sp.sobptrm_start_date,
                eab_ct.term_start_date
                ) >= CURRENT_DATE
            THEN 'WAITLISTED'
        WHEN stvrsts.voice_type = 'W'
            THEN 'WITHDRAWN'
        WHEN stvrsts.voice_type = 'R'
            AND COALESCE
                (
                sp.sobptrm_end_date,
                eab_ct.term_end_date
                ) < CURRENT_DATE
            AND
                (
                    (
                    eab_ic.final_grade IS NULL
                    OR
                    eab_ic.final_grade IN ('', ' ')
                    )
                OR
                COALESCE(eab_ic.earned_credits, 0) > 0
                )
            THEN 'COMPLETED'
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END                                                                      AS calculated_naviguide_status,
    current_date                                                             AS create_date,
    current_date                                                             AS update_date,
    TRUE                                                                     AS active_ind
FROM
    <[Pagoda].[INSTITUTIONAL_COURSEWORK].[Current Batch]> eab_ic
    FULL JOIN <[Pagoda].[COURSE_REGISTRATION].[Current Batch]> eab_cr
        ON eab_ic.student_id = eab_cr.student_id
        AND eab_ic.term_code = eab_cr.term_code
        AND eab_ic.course_reference_number = eab_cr.course_reference_number
    LEFT JOIN <[Pagoda].[SECTION].[Current Batch]> eab_s
        ON eab_cr.term_code = eab_s.term_code
        AND eab_cr.course_reference_number = eab_s.course_reference_number
    LEFT JOIN <[Pagoda].[COURSE].[Current Batch]> eab_c
        ON eab_s.subject_code = eab_c.subject_code
        AND eab_s.course_number = eab_c.course_number
        AND eab_c.term_code_eff =
            (
            SELECT
                MAX(term_code_eff)
            FROM
                <[Pagoda].[COURSE].[Current Batch]> cat_course
            WHERE
                subject_code = eab_c.subject_code
                AND course_number = eab_c.course_number
            )
    LEFT JOIN
        (
        select
            *
        from
            (
            select
                *,
                row_number() over
                    (
                    partition by
                        registration_status_code
                    order by
                        observation_tm desc
                    ) as dup_rn
            from
                <passthrough.[Banner].[Course Registration Status Validation STVRSTS]> as stvrsts
            where
                stvrsts.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
                and stvrsts.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
            )
            stvrsts
        where
            stvrsts.dup_rn = 1
        )
        stvrsts
        ON COALESCE(eab_cr.registration_status_code,'RE') = stvrsts.registration_status_code
    LEFT JOIN <[Pagoda].[GRADE].[Current Batch]> eab_g
        ON eab_ic.final_grade = eab_g.grade_code
    LEFT JOIN <[Pagoda].[TERM].[Current Batch]> eab_ct
        on eab_ct.term_code = COALESCE(eab_ic.term_code, eab_cr.term_code)
    LEFT JOIN
        (
        select
            *
        from
            (
            select
                *,
                row_number() over
                    (
                    partition by
                        sobptrm_ptrm_code,
                        sobptrm_term_code
                    order by
                        observation_tm desc
                    ) as rn
            from
                <passthrough.[Banner].[sobptrm]> as sobptrm
            where
                sobptrm.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
                and sobptrm.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
            )
            sobptrm
        where
            sobptrm.rn = 1
        )
        sobptrm
        ON eab_s.session_code = sobptrm.sobptrm_ptrm_code
        and eab_s.term_code = sobptrm.sobptrm_term_code
UNION ALL
SELECT
    eab_tc.student_id                as student_id,
    eab_tc.term_code                 as term_id,
    NULL                             as campus_code,
    NULL                             as college_code,
    NULL                             as department_code,
    concat
        (
        eab_tc.subject_code,
        eab_tc.course_number
        )                            as course_code,
    concat
        (
        'T',
        cast
            (
            eab_tc.sequence_number
            as varchar
            )
        )                            as course_ref_no,
    eab_tc.level_code                as student_level_code,
    COALESCE
        (
        eab_tc.course_type_code,
        'NA'
        )                            as course_type_code,
    COALESCE
        (
        CAST
            (
            eab_tc.course_credits
            as numeric
            ),
        0
        )                            as course_credits,
    TRUE                             as registered_ind,
    'RE'                             as registration_status_code,
    eab_tc.final_grade_date          as registration_status_date,
    COALESCE
        (
        CAST
            (
            eab_tc.attempted_credits
            as numeric
            ),
        0
        )                            as attempted_credits,
    COALESCE
        (
        CAST
            (
            eab_tc.earned_credits
            as numeric
            ),
        0
        )                            as earned_credits,
    NULL                             as gpa_credits,
    NULL                             as passed_credits,
    NULL                             as gradable_ind,
    eab_tc.midterm_grade             as midterm_grade,
    eab_tc.final_grade               as final_grade,
    NULL                             as grade_points,
    NULL                             as gpa_include_ind,
    eab_tc.final_grade_date          as final_grade_date,
    TRUE                             as final_grade_official_ind,
    TRUE                             as transfer_course_ind,
    eab_tc.transferring_institution  as transfer_inst_code,
    FALSE                            as in_progress_ind,
    NULL                             as instruction_method,
    eab_tc.repeat_ind                as repeat_ind,
    NULL                             as core_ind,
    NULL                             as honors_ind,
    NULL                             as section_attribute,
    'COMPLETED'                      as calculated_naviguide_status,
    current_date                     as create_date,
    current_date                     as update_date,
    TRUE                             as active_ind
from
    <[Pagoda].[TRANSFER_COURSEWORK].[Current Batch]> eab_tc
union all
select
    eab_ra.student_id               as student_id,
    eab_ra.term_code                as term_id,
    eab_s.campus_code               as campus_code,
    eab_c.college_code              as college_code,
    eab_c.department_code           as department_code,
    concat
        (
        eab_s.subject_code,
        eab_s.course_number
        )                           as course_code,
    eab_ra.course_reference_number  as course_ref_no,
    NULL                            as student_level_code,
    eab_s.course_type_code          as course_type_code,
    NULL                            as course_credits,
    FALSE                           as registered_ind,
    eab_ra.registration_status_code as registration_status_code,
    eab_ra.registration_status_date as registration_status_date,
    0                               as attempted_credits,
    0                               as earned_credits,
    NULL                            as gpa_credits,
    NULL                            as passed_credits,
    eab_s.gradable_ind              as gradable_ind,
    NULL                            as midterm_grade,
    NULL                            as final_grade,
    NULL                            as grade_points,
    FALSE                           as gpa_include_ind,
    NULL                            as final_grade_date,
    FALSE                           as final_grade_official_ind,
    FALSE                           as transfer_course_ind,
    NULL                            as transfer_inst_code,
    FALSE                           as in_progress_ind,
    eab_s.instructional_method_code as instruction_method,
    FALSE                           as repeat_ind,
    NULL                            as core_ind,
    NULL                            as honors_ind,
    NULL                            as section_attribute,
    'UNKNOWN'                       as calculated_naviguide_status,
    current_date                    as create_date,
    current_date                    as update_date,
    TRUE                            as active_ind
FROM
    (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER
            (
            PARTITION BY
                student_id,
                term_code,
                course_reference_number
            ORDER BY
                sequence_number DESC
            ) AS rn
    FROM
        <[Pagoda].[REGISTRATION_AUDIT].[Current Batch]> eab_ra
    )
    eab_ra
    JOIN 
        (
        select
            *
        from
            (
            select
                *,
                row_number() over
                    (
                    partition by
                        registration_status_code
                    order by
                        observation_tm desc
                    ) as dup_rn
            from
                <passthrough.[Banner].[Course Registration Status Validation STVRSTS]> as stvrsts
            where
                stvrsts.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
                and stvrsts.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
            )
            stvrsts
        where
            stvrsts.dup_rn = 1
        )
        stvrsts
        ON eab_ra.registration_status_code = stvrsts.registration_status_code
        AND stvrsts.voice_type = 'D'
    LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Pagoda].[SECTION].[Current Batch]> eab_s
        ON eab_ra.term_code = eab_s.term_code
        AND eab_ra.course_reference_number = eab_s.course_reference_number
    LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Pagoda].[COURSE].[Current Batch]> eab_c
        ON eab_s.subject_code = eab_c.subject_code
        AND eab_s.course_number = eab_c.course_number
        AND eab_c.term_code_eff =
            (
            SELECT
                MAX(term_code_eff)
            FROM
                <[Pagoda].[COURSE].[Current Batch]> cat_course
            WHERE
                subject_code = eab_c.subject_code
                AND course_number = eab_c.course_number
            )
WHERE
    rn = 1
    AND NOT EXISTS
        (
        SELECT
            1
        FROM
            <[Pagoda].[COURSE_REGISTRATION].[Current Batch]> eab_cr
        WHERE
            1 = 1
            AND eab_cr.student_id = eab_ra.student_id
            AND eab_cr.term_code = eab_ra.term_code
            AND eab_cr.course_reference_number = eab_ra.course_reference_number
        )
    AND NOT EXISTS
        (
        SELECT
            1
        FROM
            <[Pagoda].[INSTITUTIONAL_COURSEWORK].[Current Batch]> eab_ic
        WHERE
            1 = 1
            AND eab_ic.student_id = eab_ra.student_id
            AND eab_ic.term_code = eab_ra.term_code
            AND eab_ic.course_reference_number = eab_ra.course_reference_number
        )

setOpInterfaceDistinctness.authorGuidance: PSS 5.1.4 builds a per-branch output interface from select-list output names. Each UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / EXCEPT branch must expose the same number of distinct interface columns with pairwise-compatible types. Repeating the same unaliased column reference (for example `t.col` twice) produces duplicate interface names; the parser deduplicates them to one key, which can trigger SET_OPERATION_INTERFACE_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH even when the raw SELECT list looks wider. Fix: add a unique `AS alias` on every select item in every set-op branch so each output column has a distinct interface name. When the author asks for help, propose concrete aliases for every duplicate occurrence after the first.

queryResults.querySql:
SELECT
sac.STC_PERSON_ID AS student_id
, CASE
	WHEN sac.STC_TERM IS NOT NULL THEN sac.STC_TERM
	/*ELSE (
		SELECT TOP 1 x.TERMS_ID
		FROM (
			SELECT t2.TERMS_ID
			, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sac.STC_PERSON_ID ORDER BY t2.TERM_START_DATE ASC) rn
			FROM STUDENT_ACAD_CRED sac2
			JOIN TERMS t2 ON sac2.STC_TERM = t2.TERMS_ID
			WHERE 1=1
			AND t2.TERMS_ID IS NOT NULL
			AND sac2.STC_PERSON_ID = sac.STC_PERSON_ID
		) x
		WHERE x.rn = 1
	) */
	else '00/TR'
	END AS term_id
, COALESCE(cs.SEC_LOCATION,'NA') AS campus_code
--, COALESCE(DEPTS.DEPTS_DIVISION,'NA') AS college_code
--, COALESCE(d.SEC_DEPTS,'NA') AS department_code
, NULL as college_code
, NULL as department_code
, COALESCE(sac.STC_COURSE_NAME,'TR*001') AS course_code
, COALESCE(cs.SEC_SYNONYM,sac.STUDENT_ACAD_CRED_ID) AS course_ref_no
, sac.STC_ACAD_LEVEL AS student_level_code
, sac.STC_CRED_TYPE AS course_type_code
, COALESCE(sac.STC_CRED,0) AS course_credits
, CASE
	WHEN s.STC_STATUS IN ('N','A','TR') THEN TRUE               -------modify per member
	ELSE FALSE
	END AS registered_ind
, CASE when g.GRD_GRADE = 'W' and s.STC_STATUS = 'D' then 'WD'  -------modify per member
	else s.STC_STATUS END AS registration_status_code
, CAST(s.STC_STATUS_DATE as DATE) AS registration_status_date
, COALESCE(sac.STC_ATT_CRED,0) AS attempted_credits
, CASE
	WHEN sac.STC_REPL_CODE = 'R' then 0                           -------modify per member
	ELSE COALESCE(sac.STC_CMPL_CRED,0)
	END AS earned_credits
, 0 AS gpa_credits
, 0 AS passed_credits
, CASE
	WHEN g.GRD_ATT_CRED_FLAG = 'Y' OR g.GRD_CMPL_CRED_FLAG = 'Y' THEN TRUE
	ELSE FALSE
	END AS gradable_ind
, mg.GRD_GRADE AS midterm_grade
, g.GRD_GRADE AS final_grade
, COALESCE(sac.STC_GRADE_PTS,0) AS grade_points
, CASE
	WHEN g.GRD_GPA_CRED_FLAG = 'Y' THEN TRUE
	ELSE FALSE
	END AS gpa_include_ind
, CAST(sac.STC_VERIFIED_GRADE_DATE as DATE) AS final_grade_date
, CASE
	WHEN sac.STC_VERIFIED_GRADE IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
	ELSE FALSE
	END AS final_grade_official_ind
, CASE
	WHEN sac.STC_CRED_TYPE = 'T' THEN TRUE
	WHEN sac.STC_TERM is null then TRUE
	ELSE FALSE
	END AS transfer_course_ind
, '' AS transfer_inst_code -- inst.LAST_NAME
, CASE
	WHEN sac.STC_ATT_CRED IS NULL THEN TRUE
	ELSE FALSE
	END AS in_progress_ind
, '' AS instruction_method
, CASE
	WHEN sac.STC_REPL_CODE = 'R'  THEN TRUE              -------modify per member
	ELSE FALSE
	END AS repeat_ind
, NULL AS core_ind
, NULL AS honors_ind
, NULL AS section_attribute
, CASE
	WHEN sac.STC_VERIFIED_GRADE IS NOT NULL OR current_date > t.TERM_END_DATE OR sac.STC_TERM is NULL THEN 'COMPLETED'
	WHEN s.STC_STATUS IN ('N','A','TR') AND current_date < t.TERM_START_DATE THEN 'REGISTERED'
	WHEN s.STC_STATUS IN ('N','A','TR') AND current_date >= t.TERM_START_DATE AND current_date <= t.TERM_END_DATE THEN 'IN_PROGRESS'
	ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
	END AS calculated_naviguide_status                      -------modify per member
, current_date         AS create_date
, current_date          AS update_date
, TRUE AS active_ind
FROM (select * from 
	(select *, row_number() over (partition by student_acad_cred_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[STUDENT_ACAD_CRED]> as sac
	where sac.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sac.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
	)sac where sac.rn=1
	)sac

JOIN (select * from  
	(select *,row_number() over (partition by student_acad_cred_id, pos order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[STC_STATUSES]> as s
	where s.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and s.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
	)s where s.rn=1
	)s ON sac.STUDENT_ACAD_CRED_ID = s.STUDENT_ACAD_CRED_ID AND s.POS = '1'

LEFT OUTER JOIN (select * from 
				(select *, row_number() over (partition by terms_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[TERMS]> as t
				where t.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and t.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
				)t where t.rn=1
				)t ON sac.STC_TERM = t.TERMS_ID

LEFT OUTER JOIN (select * from 
				(select *, row_number() over (partition by student_course_sec_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[STUDENT_COURSE_SEC]> as scs
				where scs.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and scs.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
				)scs where scs.rn=1
				)scs ON sac.STUDENT_ACAD_CRED_ID = scs.SCS_STUDENT_ACAD_CRED

LEFT OUTER JOIN (select * from 
				(select *, row_number() over (partition by grades_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[GRADES]> as g
				where g.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and g.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
				)g where g.rn=1
				)g ON sac.STC_VERIFIED_GRADE = g.GRADES_ID

LEFT OUTER JOIN (select * from 
				(select *, row_number() over (partition by grades_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[GRADES]> as mg
				where mg.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and mg.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
				)mg where mg.rn=1
				)mg ON COALESCE(scs.SCS_MID_TERM_GRADE1,scs.SCS_MID_TERM_GRADE2,scs.SCS_MID_TERM_GRADE3,scs.SCS_MID_TERM_GRADE4,scs.SCS_MID_TERM_GRADE5,scs.SCS_MID_TERM_GRADE6) = mg.GRADES_ID

LEFT OUTER JOIN (select * from 
				(select *, row_number() over (partition by course_sections_id order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Colleague].[COURSE_SECTIONS]> as cs
				where cs.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and cs.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
				)cs where cs.rn=1
				)cs ON sac.STC_TERM = cs.SEC_TERM
					AND sac.STC_SUBJECT = cs.SEC_SUBJECT
					AND sac.STC_SECTION_NO = cs.SEC_NO
					AND RIGHT(RTRIM(STC_COURSE_NAME),4) = cs.SEC_COURSE_NO

--LEFT OUTER JOIN SEC_DEPARTMENTS d ON cs.COURSE_SECTIONS_ID = d.COURSE_SECTIONS_ID AND d.POS = 1

--LEFT OUTER JOIN DEPTS  ON d.SEC_DEPTS = DEPTS.DEPTS_ID

WHERE 1=1

queryResults.querySql:
SELECT
COALESCE(eab_ic.student_id, eab_cr.student_id) AS student_id
, COALESCE(eab_ic.term_code, eab_cr.term_code) AS term_id
, COALESCE(eab_ic.campus_code, eab_s.campus_code, 'NA') AS campus_code
, COALESCE(eab_ic.college_code, eab_c.college_code,'00') AS college_code
, COALESCE(eab_ic.department_code, eab_c.department_code,'0000') AS department_code
, COALESCE(eab_ic.subject_code, eab_c.subject_code) || coalesce(eab_ic.course_number, eab_c.course_number) AS course_code
, COALESCE(eab_ic.course_reference_number, eab_cr.course_reference_number) AS course_ref_no
, COALESCE(eab_ic.level_code, eab_cr.level_code) AS student_level_code
, COALESCE(eab_ic.course_type_code, eab_cr.course_type_code, 'NA') AS course_type_code
, COALESCE(eab_ic.course_credits, eab_cr.attempted_credits, 0) AS course_credits
, CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(eab_cr.registration_status_code,'E') = 'E' THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
    END AS registered_ind
, COALESCE(eab_cr.registration_status_code,'RE') AS registration_status_code
, COALESCE(eab_ic.final_grade_date, eab_cr.registration_status_date) AS registration_status_date
, COALESCE(eab_ic.attempted_credits, eab_cr.attempted_credits, 0) AS attempted_credits
, COALESCE(eab_ic.earned_credits, 0) AS earned_credits
, NULL AS gpa_credits
, NULL AS passed_credits
, NULL AS gradable_ind
--, COALESCE(eab_ic.gradable_ind, eab_s.gradable_ind) AS gradable_ind
, COALESCE(eab_ic.midterm_grade, eab_cr.midterm_grade) AS midterm_grade
, eab_ic.final_grade AS final_grade
,NULL as grade_points
--, eab_ic.earned_credits*eab_g.quality_points AS grade_points
, NULL AS gpa_include_ind
, coalesce(eab_ic.final_grade_date,current_timestamp) AS final_grade_date
, CASE
    WHEN eab_ic.student_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
    END AS final_grade_official_ind
, FALSE AS transfer_course_ind
, NULL AS transfer_inst_code
, CASE
    WHEN eab_ic.student_id IS NOT NULL THEN FALSE
    ELSE TRUE
    END AS in_progress_ind
, eab_s.instructional_method_code AS instruction_method
, CASE
    WHEN eab_ic.repeat_code IN ('E','A') THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
    END AS repeat_ind
, NULL AS core_ind
, NULL AS honors_ind
, NULL AS section_attribute
, CASE
    WHEN eab_cr.registration_status_code = 'E' AND COALESCE(eab_st.sess_begin_dt, eab_ct.term_start_date) <= CURRENT_DATE AND COALESCE(eab_st.sess_end_dt, eab_ct.term_end_date) >= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'IN_PROGRESS'
    WHEN eab_cr.registration_status_code  = 'E' AND COALESCE(eab_st.sess_begin_dt, eab_ct.term_start_date)> CURRENT_DATE THEN 'REGISTERED'
    WHEN eab_cr.registration_status_code  = 'W' AND COALESCE(eab_st.sess_begin_dt, eab_ct.term_start_date) >= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'WAITLISTED'
    WHEN eab_cr.registration_status_code  = 'WD' THEN 'WITHDRAWN'
    WHEN eab_cr.registration_status_code  = 'E' AND COALESCE(eab_st.sess_end_dt, eab_ct.term_end_date) < CURRENT_DATE AND ((eab_ic.final_grade IS NULL OR eab_ic.final_grade IN ('', ' ')) OR COALESCE(eab_ic.earned_credits, 0) > 0) THEN 'COMPLETED'
    ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
  END AS calculated_naviguide_status
/*
, CASE
    WHEN stvrsts.voice_type = 'R' AND eab_ct.term_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND eab_ct.term_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'IN_PROGRESS'
    WHEN stvrsts.voice_type = 'R' AND eab_ct.term_start_date> CURRENT_DATE THEN 'REGISTERED'
    WHEN stvrsts.voice_type = 'L' AND eab_ct.term_start_date >= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'WAITLISTED'
    WHEN stvrsts.voice_type = 'W' THEN 'WITHDRAWN'
    WHEN stvrsts.voice_type = 'R' AND eab_ct.term_end_date < CURRENT_DATE AND ((eab_ic.final_grade IS NULL OR eab_ic.final_grade IN ('', ' ')) OR COALESCE(eab_ic.earned_credits, 0) > 0) THEN 'COMPLETED'
    ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
  END AS calculated_naviguide_status
*/ 
, current_date AS create_date
, current_date AS update_date
, TRUE AS active_ind
FROM <[Pagoda].[INSTITUTIONAL_COURSEWORK].[Current Batch]> eab_ic
FULL JOIN <[Pagoda].[COURSE_REGISTRATION].[Current Batch]> eab_cr ON eab_ic.student_id = eab_cr.student_id AND eab_ic.term_code = eab_cr.term_code AND eab_ic.course_reference_number = eab_cr.course_reference_number
LEFT JOIN <[Pagoda].[SECTION].[Current Batch]> eab_s ON eab_cr.term_code = eab_s.term_code AND eab_cr.course_reference_number = eab_s.course_reference_number
LEFT JOIN <[Pagoda].[COURSE].[Current Batch]> eab_c ON eab_s.subject_code = eab_c.subject_code AND eab_s.course_number = eab_c.course_number AND eab_c.term_code_eff = (
    SELECT MAX(term_code_eff)
    FROM <[Pagoda].[COURSE].[Current Batch]> cat_course
    WHERE subject_code = eab_c.subject_code
    AND course_number = eab_c.course_number
    )

/*LEFT JOIN 
(select * from
(select *,row_number() over (partition by registration_status_code order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Course Registration Status Validation STVRSTS]> as stvrsts where stvrsts.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and stvrsts.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)stvrsts where stvrsts.dup_rn=1
)stvrsts ON COALESCE(eab_cr.registration_status_code,'RE') = stvrsts.registration_status_code
*/

LEFT JOIN <[Pagoda].[GRADE].[Current Batch]> eab_g ON eab_ic.final_grade = eab_g.grade_code
LEFT JOIN <[Pagoda].[TERM].[Current Batch]> eab_ct on eab_ct.term_code = COALESCE(eab_ic.term_code, eab_cr.term_code)

LEFT JOIN (SELECT institution, term, session
                  , MIN(begin_date)  AS sess_begin_dt
                  , MAX(end_date)    AS sess_end_dt
                  , MIN(first_date_to_enroll)  AS first_enrl_dt
                  , MAX(last_date_to_enroll)   AS last_enrl_dt
                  , MIN(open_enrollment_date) AS enroll_open_dt
                  , MIN(census_dt)      AS census_dt
                  , MAX(last_date_for_wait_list)   AS last_wait_dt
                  --, MIN(sixty_pct_dt)   AS sixty_pct_dt
           FROM (select *,row_number() over (partition by career,institution,term,session order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
				from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_SESSION_TBL]> eab_s
				where eab_s.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and eab_s.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
				)eab_s where 1=1 and eab_s.dup_rn=1
           
           GROUP BY institution, term, session
		   ) eab_st 
    ON eab_st.term = eab_s.term_code 
      AND eab_st.session = eab_s.session_code


UNION ALL

SELECT
eab_tc.student_id  student_id
,eab_tc.term_code term_id
,NULL campus_code
,NULL college_code
,NULL department_code
,CONCAT(eab_tc.subject_code,eab_tc.course_number) AS course_code
, CONCAT('T',cast(eab_tc.sequence_number as varchar)) AS course_ref_no
,eab_tc.level_code student_level_code
,COALESCE(eab_tc.course_type_code, 'NA') course_type_code
,COALESCE(CAST(eab_tc.course_credits AS numeric),0) course_credits
,TRUE registered_ind
,'RE' registration_status_code
,eab_tc.final_grade_date registration_status_date
,COALESCE(CAST(eab_tc.attempted_credits AS numeric),0) attempted_credits
,COALESCE(CAST(eab_tc.earned_credits AS numeric),0) earned_credits
,NULL gpa_credits
,NULL passed_credits
,NULL gradable_ind
,eab_tc.midterm_grade midterm_grade
,eab_tc.final_grade final_grade
,NULL grade_points
,NULL gpa_include_ind
,eab_tc.final_grade_date final_grade_date
,TRUE final_grade_official_ind
,TRUE transfer_course_ind
,eab_tc.transferring_institution transfer_inst_code
,FALSE in_progress_ind
,NULL instruction_method
,eab_tc.repeat_ind repeat_ind
,NULL core_ind
,NULL honors_ind
,NULL section_attribute
,'COMPLETED' calculated_naviguide_status
,current_date create_date
,current_date update_date
,TRUE active_ind
FROM <[Pagoda].[TRANSFER_COURSEWORK].[Current Batch]> eab_tc

UNION ALL 

SELECT
eab_ra.student_id student_id
, eab_ra.term_code term_id
, eab_s.campus_code campus_code
, eab_c.college_code college_code
, eab_c.department_code department_code
, CONCAT(eab_s.subject_code,eab_s.course_number) AS course_code
, eab_ra.course_reference_number course_ref_no
, NULL student_level_code
, eab_s.course_type_code course_type_code
, NULL course_credits
, FALSE registered_ind
, eab_ra.registration_status_code registration_status_code
, eab_ra.registration_status_date registration_status_date
, 0 attempted_credits
, 0 earned_credits
, NULL gpa_credits
, NULL passed_credits
, NULL as gradable_ind
--, eab_s.gradable_ind AS gradable_ind
, NULL midterm_grade
, NULL final_grade
, NULL grade_points
, FALSE gpa_include_ind
, NULL final_grade_date
, FALSE final_grade_official_ind
, FALSE transfer_course_ind
, NULL transfer_inst_code
, FALSE in_progress_ind
, eab_s.instructional_method_code AS instruction_method
, FALSE repeat_ind
, NULL core_ind
, NULL honors_ind
, NULL section_attribute
, 'UNKNOWN' calculated_naviguide_status
,current_date create_date
, current_date update_date
, TRUE active_ind
FROM (
  SELECT
    *,
    RANK()
    OVER (
      PARTITION BY student_id, term_code, course_reference_number
      ORDER BY sequence_number DESC ) AS rn
  FROM <[Pagoda].[REGISTRATION_AUDIT].[Current Batch]> eab_ra
) eab_ra


LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Pagoda].[SECTION].[Current Batch]> eab_s ON eab_ra.term_code = eab_s.term_code AND eab_ra.course_reference_number = eab_s.course_reference_number

LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Pagoda].[COURSE].[Current Batch]> eab_c ON eab_s.subject_code = eab_c.subject_code AND eab_s.course_number = eab_c.course_number AND eab_c.term_code_eff = (
    SELECT MAX(term_code_eff)
    FROM <[Pagoda].[COURSE].[Current Batch]> cat_course
    WHERE subject_code = eab_c.subject_code
    AND course_number = eab_c.course_number
    )

WHERE rn = 1 and eab_ra.registration_status_code='D'

AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM <[Pagoda].[COURSE_REGISTRATION].[Current Batch]> eab_cr
  WHERE 1=1
  AND eab_cr.student_id = eab_ra.student_id
  AND eab_cr.term_code = eab_ra.term_code
  AND eab_cr.course_reference_number = eab_ra.course_reference_number
)
  /*AND NOT EXISTS(
          SELECT 1
      FROM <[Pagoda].[INSTITUTIONAL_COURSEWORK].[Current Batch]> eab_ic
      WHERE 1 = 1
            AND eab_ic.student_id = eab_ra.student_id
            AND eab_ic.term_code = eab_ra.term_code
            AND eab_ic.course_reference_number = eab_ra.course_reference_number
  )*/

queryResults.sqlPreview: SELECT COALESCE(eab_ic.student_id, eab_cr.student_id) AS student_id , COALESCE(eab_ic.term_code, eab_cr.term_code) AS term_id , COALESCE(eab_ic.campus_code, eab…
queryResults.querySql:
SELECT
COALESCE(eab_ic.student_id, eab_cr.student_id) AS student_id
, COALESCE(eab_ic.term_code, eab_cr.term_code) AS term_id
, COALESCE(eab_ic.campus_code, eab_s.campus_code, 'NA') AS campus_code
, COALESCE(eab_ic.college_code, eab_c.college_code,'00') AS college_code
, COALESCE(eab_ic.department_code, eab_c.department_code,'0000') AS department_code
, COALESCE(eab_ic.subject_code, eab_c.subject_code) || coalesce(eab_ic.course_number, eab_c.course_number) AS course_code
, COALESCE(eab_ic.course_reference_number, eab_cr.course_reference_number) AS course_ref_no
, COALESCE(eab_ic.level_code, eab_cr.level_code) AS student_level_code
, COALESCE(eab_ic.course_type_code, eab_cr.course_type_code, 'NA') AS course_type_code
, COALESCE(eab_ic.course_credits, eab_cr.attempted_credits, 0) AS course_credits
, CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(eab_cr.registration_status_code,'E') = 'E' THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
    END AS registered_ind
--, COALESCE(eab_cr.registration_status_code,'RE') AS registration_status_code
, case when eab_cr.registration_status_code in ('E') then 'EN' else eab_cr.registration_status_code end as registration_status_code
, COALESCE(eab_ic.final_grade_date, eab_cr.registration_status_date) AS registration_status_date
, COALESCE(eab_ic.attempted_credits, eab_cr.attempted_credits, 0) AS attempted_credits
, COALESCE(eab_ic.earned_credits, 0) AS earned_credits
, NULL AS gpa_credits
, NULL AS passed_credits
, NULL as gradable_ind
--, COALESCE(eab_ic.gradable_ind, eab_s.gradable_ind) AS gradable_ind
, COALESCE(eab_ic.midterm_grade, eab_cr.midterm_grade) AS midterm_grade
, eab_ic.final_grade AS final_grade
,NULL as grade_points
--, eab_ic.earned_credits*eab_g.quality_points AS grade_points
, NULL AS gpa_include_ind
, coalesce(eab_ic.final_grade_date,current_timestamp) AS final_grade_date
, CASE
    WHEN eab_ic.student_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
    END AS final_grade_official_ind
, FALSE AS transfer_course_ind
, NULL AS transfer_inst_code
, CASE
    WHEN eab_ic.student_id IS NOT NULL THEN FALSE
    ELSE TRUE
    END AS in_progress_ind
, eab_s.instructional_method_code AS instruction_method
, CASE
    WHEN eab_ic.repeat_code IN ('E','A') THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
    END AS repeat_ind
, NULL AS core_ind
, NULL AS honors_ind
, NULL AS section_attribute
, CASE
    WHEN eab_cr.registration_status_code = 'E' AND COALESCE(eab_st.sess_begin_dt, eab_ct.term_start_date) <= CURRENT_DATE AND COALESCE(eab_st.sess_end_dt, eab_ct.term_end_date) >= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'IN_PROGRESS'
    WHEN eab_cr.registration_status_code  = 'E' AND COALESCE(eab_st.sess_begin_dt, eab_ct.term_start_date)> CURRENT_DATE THEN 'REGISTERED'
    WHEN eab_cr.registration_status_code  = 'W' AND COALESCE(eab_st.sess_begin_dt, eab_ct.term_start_date) >= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'WAITLISTED'
    WHEN eab_cr.registration_status_code  = 'WD' THEN 'WITHDRAWN'
    WHEN eab_cr.registration_status_code  = 'E' AND COALESCE(eab_st.sess_end_dt, eab_ct.term_end_date) < CURRENT_DATE AND ((eab_ic.final_grade IS NULL OR eab_ic.final_grade IN ('', ' ')) OR COALESCE(eab_ic.earned_credits, 0) > 0) THEN 'COMPLETED'
    ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
  END AS calculated_naviguide_status
/*
, CASE
    WHEN stvrsts.voice_type = 'R' AND eab_ct.term_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND eab_ct.term_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'IN_PROGRESS'
    WHEN stvrsts.voice_type = 'R' AND eab_ct.term_start_date> CURRENT_DATE THEN 'REGISTERED'
    WHEN stvrsts.voice_type = 'L' AND eab_ct.term_start_date >= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'WAITLISTED'
    WHEN stvrsts.voice_type = 'W' THEN 'WITHDRAWN'
    WHEN stvrsts.voice_type = 'R' AND eab_ct.term_end_date < CURRENT_DATE AND ((eab_ic.final_grade IS NULL OR eab_ic.final_grade IN ('', ' ')) OR COALESCE(eab_ic.earned_credits, 0) > 0) THEN 'COMPLETED'
    ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
  END AS calculated_naviguide_status
*/ 
, current_date AS create_date
, current_date AS update_date
, TRUE AS active_ind
FROM <[Pagoda].[INSTITUTIONAL_COURSEWORK].[Current Batch]> eab_ic
FULL JOIN <[Pagoda].[COURSE_REGISTRATION].[Current Batch]> eab_cr ON eab_ic.student_id = eab_cr.student_id AND eab_ic.term_code = eab_cr.term_code AND eab_ic.course_reference_number = eab_cr.course_reference_number
LEFT JOIN <[Pagoda].[SECTION].[Current Batch]> eab_s ON eab_cr.term_code = eab_s.term_code AND eab_cr.course_reference_number = eab_s.course_reference_number
LEFT JOIN <[Pagoda].[COURSE].[Current Batch]> eab_c ON eab_s.subject_code = eab_c.subject_code AND eab_s.course_number = eab_c.course_number AND eab_c.term_code_eff = (
    SELECT MAX(term_code_eff)
    FROM <[Pagoda].[COURSE].[Current Batch]> cat_course
    WHERE subject_code = eab_c.subject_code
    AND course_number = eab_c.course_number
    )

/*LEFT JOIN 
(select * from
(select *,row_number() over (partition by registration_status_code order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Course Registration Status Validation STVRSTS]> as stvrsts where stvrsts.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and stvrsts.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)stvrsts where stvrsts.dup_rn=1
)stvrsts ON COALESCE(eab_cr.registration_status_code,'RE') = stvrsts.registration_status_code
*/

LEFT JOIN <[Pagoda].[GRADE].[Current Batch]> eab_g ON eab_ic.final_grade = eab_g.grade_code
LEFT JOIN <[Pagoda].[TERM].[Current Batch]> eab_ct on eab_ct.term_code = COALESCE(eab_ic.term_code, eab_cr.term_code)

LEFT JOIN (SELECT institution, term, session
                  , MIN(begin_date)  AS sess_begin_dt
                  , MAX(end_date)    AS sess_end_dt
                  , MIN(first_date_to_enroll)  AS first_enrl_dt
                  , MAX(last_date_to_enroll)   AS last_enrl_dt
                  , MIN(open_enrollment_date) AS enroll_open_dt
                  , MIN(census_dt)      AS census_dt
                  , MAX(last_date_for_wait_list)   AS last_wait_dt
                  --, MIN(sixty_pct_dt)   AS sixty_pct_dt
           FROM (select *,row_number() over (partition by career,institution,term,session order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
				from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_SESSION_TBL]> eab_s
				where eab_s.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and eab_s.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
				)eab_s where 1=1 and eab_s.dup_rn=1
           GROUP BY institution, term, session
		   ) eab_st 
    ON eab_st.term = eab_s.term_code 
      AND eab_st.session = eab_s.session_code


UNION ALL

SELECT
eab_tc.student_id  student_id
,eab_tc.term_code term_id
,NULL campus_code
,NULL college_code
,NULL department_code
,CONCAT(eab_tc.subject_code,eab_tc.course_number) AS course_code
, CONCAT('T',cast(eab_tc.sequence_number as varchar)) AS course_ref_no
,eab_tc.level_code student_level_code
,COALESCE(eab_tc.course_type_code, 'NA') course_type_code
,COALESCE(CAST(eab_tc.course_credits AS numeric),0) course_credits
,FALSE registered_ind
--,'RE' registration_status_code
, 'EN' as registration_status_code
,eab_tc.final_grade_date registration_status_date
,COALESCE(CAST(eab_tc.attempted_credits AS numeric),0) attempted_credits
,COALESCE(CAST(eab_tc.earned_credits AS numeric),0) earned_credits
,NULL gpa_credits
,NULL passed_credits
,NULL gradable_ind
,eab_tc.midterm_grade midterm_grade
,eab_tc.final_grade final_grade
,NULL grade_points
,NULL gpa_include_ind
,eab_tc.final_grade_date final_grade_date
,TRUE final_grade_official_ind
,TRUE transfer_course_ind
,eab_tc.transferring_institution transfer_inst_code
,FALSE in_progress_ind
,NULL instruction_method
,eab_tc.repeat_ind repeat_ind
,NULL core_ind
,NULL honors_ind
,NULL section_attribute
,'COMPLETED' calculated_naviguide_status
,current_date create_date
,current_date update_date
,TRUE active_ind
FROM <[Pagoda].[TRANSFER_COURSEWORK].[Current Batch]> eab_tc

UNION ALL 

SELECT
eab_ra.student_id student_id
, eab_ra.term_code term_id
, eab_s.campus_code campus_code
, eab_c.college_code college_code
, eab_c.department_code department_code
, CONCAT(eab_s.subject_code,eab_s.course_number) AS course_code
, eab_ra.course_reference_number course_ref_no
, NULL student_level_code
, eab_s.course_type_code course_type_code
, NULL course_credits
, FALSE registered_ind
, eab_ra.registration_status_code registration_status_code
, eab_ra.registration_status_date registration_status_date
, 0 attempted_credits
, 0 earned_credits
, NULL gpa_credits
, NULL passed_credits
,NULL as gradable_ind
--, eab_s.gradable_ind AS gradable_ind
, NULL midterm_grade
, NULL final_grade
, NULL grade_points
, FALSE gpa_include_ind
, NULL final_grade_date
, FALSE final_grade_official_ind
, FALSE transfer_course_ind
, NULL transfer_inst_code
, FALSE in_progress_ind
, eab_s.instructional_method_code AS instruction_method
, FALSE repeat_ind
, NULL core_ind
, NULL honors_ind
, NULL section_attribute
, 'UNKNOWN' calculated_naviguide_status
,current_date create_date
, current_date update_date
, TRUE active_ind
FROM (
  SELECT
    *,
    RANK()
    OVER (
      PARTITION BY student_id, term_code, course_reference_number
      ORDER BY sequence_number DESC ) AS rn
  FROM <[Pagoda].[REGISTRATION_AUDIT].[Current Batch]> eab_ra
) eab_ra


LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Pagoda].[SECTION].[Current Batch]> eab_s ON eab_ra.term_code = eab_s.term_code AND eab_ra.course_reference_number = eab_s.course_reference_number

LEFT OUTER JOIN <[Pagoda].[COURSE].[Current Batch]> eab_c ON eab_s.subject_code = eab_c.subject_code AND eab_s.course_number = eab_c.course_number AND eab_c.term_code_eff = (
    SELECT MAX(term_code_eff)
    FROM <[Pagoda].[COURSE].[Current Batch]> cat_course
    WHERE subject_code = eab_c.subject_code
    AND course_number = eab_c.course_number
    )

WHERE rn = 1 and eab_ra.registration_status_code='D'

AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM <[Pagoda].[COURSE_REGISTRATION].[Current Batch]> eab_cr
  WHERE 1=1
  AND eab_cr.student_id = eab_ra.student_id
  AND eab_cr.term_code = eab_ra.term_code
  AND eab_cr.course_reference_number = eab_ra.course_reference_number
)
  /*AND NOT EXISTS(
          SELECT 1
      FROM <[Pagoda].[INSTITUTIONAL_COURSEWORK].[Current Batch]> eab_ic
      WHERE 1 = 1
            AND eab_ic.student_id = eab_ra.student_id
            AND eab_ic.term_code = eab_ra.term_code
            AND eab_ic.course_reference_number = eab_ra.course_reference_number
  )*/

queryResults.sqlPreview: select distinct spriden.student_id as student_id, sprhold.hold_code as hold_code, to_char ( to_date ( hold_from_date, 'dd-MON-yy' ), 'yyyy-mm-dd' ) as start_dat…
queryResults.querySql:
select distinct
    spriden.student_id                       as student_id,
    sprhold.hold_code                        as hold_code,
    to_char
        (
        to_date
            (
            hold_from_date,
            'dd-MON-yy'
            ),
        'yyyy-mm-dd'
        )                                    as start_date,
    to_char
        (
        to_date
            (
            hold_to_date,
            'dd-MON-yy'
            ),
        'yyyy-mm-dd'
        )                                    as end_date,
    amount_owed                              as amount_owed,
    hold_reason                              as hold_reason,
    CAST
        (
        CASE
            WHEN hold_to_date > current_date
                or hold_to_date is null
                THEN 'T'
            ELSE 'F'
        END
        AS BOOLEAN
        )                                    AS active_ind
from
    (
    select
        *
    from
        (
        select
            *,
            row_number() over
                (
                partition by
                    banner_pidm,
                    hold_code,
                    hold_from_date
                order by
                    observation_tm desc
                ) as rn
        from
            <passthrough.[Banner].[Person Related Holds SPRHOLD]> as sprhold
        where
            sprhold.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
            and sprhold.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
        )
        sprhold
    where
        sprhold.rn = 1
    )
    sprhold
    join
        (
        select
            *
        from
            (
            select
                *,
                row_number() over
                    (
                    partition by
                        banner_pidm
                    order by
                        observation_tm desc
                    ) as rn
            from
                <passthrough.[Banner].[Person Identification Name SPRIDEN]> as spriden
            where
                spriden.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME>
                and spriden.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
            )
            spriden
        where
            spriden.rn = 1
        )
        spriden
        on sprhold.banner_pidm = spriden.banner_pidm

queryResults.querySql:
select 
student_id
,hold_code
,start_date
,end_date
,amount_owed
,hold_reason 
,NULL as responsible_code
,current_date AS create_date
,current_date AS update_date
,active_ind
from(
select 
 spriden.student_id as student_id
,sprhold.hold_code as hold_code
--,hold_from_date as start_date
,to_char(to_date(hold_from_date, 'dd-MON-yy'), 'yyyy-mm-dd') as start_date
--,hold_to_date as end_date
,to_char(to_date(hold_to_date, 'dd-MON-yy'), 'yyyy-mm-dd') as end_date
,amount_owed as amount_owed
,hold_reason as hold_reason 
,CAST(CASE WHEN hold_to_date =  '31-DEC-99' THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END AS BOOLEAN) AS active_ind
,row_number() over (partition by spriden.student_id,sprhold.hold_code,to_char(to_date(hold_from_date, 'dd-MON-yy'), 'yyyy-mm-dd'),amount_owed order by to_char(to_date(hold_to_date, 'dd-MON-yy'), 'yyyy-mm-dd') desc) as rn
from 
(
select * from(
select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm,hold_code,hold_from_date order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Person Related Holds SPRHOLD]> as sprhold where sprhold.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and sprhold.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)sprhold where sprhold.rn=1
)sprhold
join 
(
select * from
(select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Person Identification Name SPRIDEN]> as spriden where spriden.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and spriden.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)spriden where spriden.rn=1
)spriden on spriden.banner_pidm = sprhold.banner_pidm
where sprhold.hold_code in ('AB','AD','AM','AP','AR','AS','AW','BC','BF','BI','BN','BW','CA','DE','DN','DO','DP','EF','HP','IN','NR','PC','PF','PR','PS','RS','SI','SS')
)sar_student_hold where sar_student_hold.rn=1

queryResults.sqlPreview: SELECT student_id , effective_date , term_code_eff , level_code , rank_number , catalog_year , college_code , campus_code , department_code , program_code , deg…
queryResults.querySql:
SELECT student_id
       , effective_date
       , term_code_eff
       , level_code
       , rank_number
       , catalog_year
       , college_code
       , campus_code
       , department_code
       , program_code
       , degree_code
       , major_code
       , concentration_code_1
       , concentration_code_2
       , concentration_code_3
       --, create_date
       --, update_date
       , active_ind
FROM (
SELECT ms1.student_id                                      AS student_id
       , ms1.effective_date                                AS effective_date
       , relevant_dates.strm                               AS term_code_eff
       , ms1.acad_career                                   AS level_code
       , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ms1.student_id, relevant_dates.effective_date
                           ORDER BY ms1.scn, ms1.sequence) AS rank_number
       , t.academic_year                                       AS catalog_year --added, using plan_req_term
       , ms1.college_code                                  AS college_code
       , ms1.campus_code                                   AS campus_code
       , CASE
           WHEN ms1.department_code IN ('  ',' ', '') THEN 'NA'
           ELSE ms1.department_code
         END                                               AS department_code
       , ms1.program_code                                  AS program_code
       , CASE
           WHEN ms1.degree_code = '' THEN 'NA'
           WHEN ms1.degree_code = ' ' THEN 'NA'
           WHEN ms1.degree_code = '  ' THEN 'NA'
           ELSE COALESCE(ms1.degree_code, 'NA')
          END                                              AS degree_code
       , ms1.major_code                                    AS major_code
       , ms1.concentration_code_1                          AS concentration_code_1
       , ms1.concentration_code_2                          AS concentration_code_2
       , ms1.concentration_code_3                          AS concentration_code_3
       --, NOW()                                             AS create_date
       --, NOW()                                             AS update_date
       , CASE
           WHEN ms1.prog_status = 'AC' THEN TRUE
           ELSE FALSE
         END                                               AS active_ind
FROM <[Pagoda].[PROG].[Current Batch]> as ms1
JOIN <[Pagoda].[PROGRAM_SLOT].[Current Batch]> as relevant_dates
  ON relevant_dates.student_id = ms1.student_id
    AND relevant_dates.acad_career = ms1.acad_career
--JOIN <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TERM_TBL]> t
JOIN (
      select   * 
        from   (
        select   * ,  row_number() over (partition by academic_institution,academic_career,term order by  observation_tm   desc )   as   dup_rn
        FROM <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TERM_TBL]> as ptt
        where  ptt.observation_tm >  <PIT_START_TIME>  and ptt.observation_tm <=  <PIT_END_TIME> 
        ) as ptt 
        where  ptt.dup_rn = 1
) as t
  ON t.term = ms1.plan_req_term
    AND t.academic_career = ms1.acad_career
WHERE 1=1
   AND ms1.effective_date <= relevant_dates.effective_date
   AND 'AC' = (SELECT Max(MS1a.prog_status)
               FROM <[Pagoda].[PROG].[Current Batch]> as ms1a
               WHERE ms1a.student_id = ms1.student_id
                  AND ms1a.scn = ms1.scn
                  AND ms1a.major_code = ms1.major_code
                  AND ms1a.effective_date = ms1.effective_date)
   AND ms1.effective_date = (SELECT Max(MS1b.effective_date)
                             FROM <[Pagoda].[PROG].[Current Batch]> as  ms1b
                             WHERE ms1b.student_id = ms1.student_id
                                AND ms1b.scn = ms1.scn
                                AND ms1b.effective_date <= relevant_dates.effective_date)) ms1
WHERE 1=1

queryResults.sqlPreview: select stvterm.term_code as term_code ,stvterm.term_description as term_desc ,stvterm.academic_year_code as academic_year_code ,stvterm.academic_year_code as ac…
queryResults.querySql:
select 
stvterm.term_code as term_code
,stvterm.term_description as term_desc
,stvterm.academic_year_code as academic_year_code
,stvterm.academic_year_code as academic_year_desc
, CASE
    WHEN term_description LIKE '%%Fall%%' THEN 'Fall'
    WHEN term_description LIKE '%%Spring%%' THEN 'Spring'
    WHEN term_description LIKE '%%Summer%%' THEN 'Summer'
    WHEN term_description LIKE '%%Winter%%' THEN 'Winter'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS term_type
,stvterm.term_start_date as term_start_date
,stvterm.term_end_date as term_end_date
,ftvactv.effective_date as registration_start_date
,ftvactv.next_change_date as registration_end_date
,current_date as create_date
,current_date as update_date
,TRUE as active_ind

from
(
select * from
(
select *,ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by term_code order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Term Code Lookup STVTERM]> as stvterm where stvterm.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME> and stvterm.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)stvterm where stvterm.rn=1
) stvterm

LEFT OUTER JOIN 
(
				 select * from (
				 select *,ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by effective_date,next_change_date, activity_code,coas_code order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Activity Lookup FTVACTV]> as ftvactv
				 where ftvactv.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and ftvactv.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
				 )ftvactv where ftvactv.rn=1 and coas_code = 'EL' 

	) ftvactv
	ON stvterm.term_code = ftvactv.activity_code

where 1=1 and stvterm.term_description not like '%%Non-Credit%%'

	, MAX(CAST(sorrtrm.term_end_date AS DATE)) AS sorrtrm_end_date

	terms_id 														AS term_code

	  where terms.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and terms.observation_tm<= <PIT_END_TIME>

queryResults.sqlPreview: select spriden.student_id as student_id, shrtrce.effective_term as term_code, cast ( left ( shrtrce.trit_sequence_number || shrtrce.tram_sequence_number || shrt…
queryResults.querySql:
select 
    spriden.student_id                                 as student_id,
    shrtrce.effective_term                             as term_code,
    cast
        (
        left
            (
            shrtrce.trit_sequence_number ||
                shrtrce.tram_sequence_number ||
                shrtrce.sequence_number ||
                shrtrce.trcr_sequence_number,
            9
            )
        as int
        )                                              as sequence_number,
    shrtrcr.term_code                                  as orig_term_code,
    ''                                                 as campus_code,
    ''                                                 as college_code,
    ''                                                 as department_code,
    cast(shrtrce.credit_hours as numeric)              as course_credits,
    shrtrce.subject_code                               as subject_code,
    shrtrce.course_number                              as course_number,
    case
        when shrtrce.repeat_course_flag is not null
            then true
        else false
    end                                                as repeat_ind,
    case
        when g.attempted_indicator = 'Y'
            then cast(shrtrce.credit_hours as numeric)
        else 0
    end                                                as attempted_credits,
    case
        when g.completed_indicator = 'Y'
            then cast(shrtrce.credit_hours as numeric)
        else 0
    end                                                as earned_credits,
    institution_name                                   as transferring_institution,
    ''                                                 as midterm_grade,
    g.grade_code                                       as final_grade,
    null                                               as final_grade_date,
    'NA'                                               as course_type_code,
    shrtrce.level_code                                 as level_code,
    current_date                                       as create_date,
    current_date                                       as update_date,
    't'                                                as active_ind
from 
    (
    select
        *
    from
        (
        select
            *,
            row_number() over
                (
                partition by
                    banner_pidm
                order by]
                    observation_tm desc
                ) as rn
        from
            <passthrough.[Banner].[Person Identification Name SPRIDEN]> as spriden
        where
            spriden.observation_tm > '2020-01-08'--<PIT_START_TIME>
            and spriden.observation_tm <= '2020-01-10'--<PIT_END_TIME>
        )
        spriden
    where
        spriden.rn = 1
    )
    spriden
    join
        ( 
        select
            *
        from
            (
            select
                *,
                row_number() over
                    (
                    partition by
                        banner_pidm,
                        course_number,
                        subject_code,
                        effective_term
                    order by
                        observation_tm desc
                    ) as rn
            from
                <passthrough.[Banner].[Transfer Course Equivalents SHRTRCE]> as shrtrce
            where
                shrtrce.observation_tm > '2020-01-08'--<PIT_START_TIME>
                and shrtrce.observation_tm <= '2020-01-10'--<PIT_END_TIME>
            )
            shrtrce
        where
            shrtrce.rn = 1
        )
        shrtrce
        on spriden.banner_pidm = shrtrce.banner_pidm
    left join
        (
        select
            *
        from
            (
            select
                *,
                row_number() over
                    (
                    partition by
                        banner_pidm,
                        transfer_institution_sequence_number
                    order by
                        observation_tm desc
                    ) as rn
            from
                <passthrough.[Banner].[Transfer Institution Records SHRTRIT]> as shrtrit
            where
                shrtrit.observation_tm > '2020-01-08'--<PIT_START_TIME>
                and shrtrit.observation_tm <= '2020-01-10'--<PIT_END_TIME>
            )
            shrtrit
        where
            shrtrit.rn = 1
        )
        shrtrit
        on shrtrce.banner_pidm = shrtrit.banner_pidm
        and shrtrce.trit_sequence_number = shrtrit.transfer_institution_sequence_number
    left join
        (
        select
            *
        from
            (
            select
                *,
                row_number() over
                    (
                    partition by
                        institution_code
                    order by
                        observation_tm desc
                    ) as rn
            from
                <passthrough.[Banner].[Source Background Institution Lookup STVSBGI]> as stvsbgi
            where
                stvsbgi.observation_tm > '2020-01-08'--<PIT_START_TIME>
                and stvsbgi.observation_tm <= '2020-01-10'--<PIT_END_TIME>
            )
            stvsbgi
        where
            stvsbgi.rn = 1
        )
        stvsbgi
        on shrtrit.transfer_institution_code = stvsbgi.institution_code
    left join
        (
        select
            *,
            row_number() over
                (
                partition by
                    banner_pidm,
                    transfer_institution_sequence_number,
                    transfer_period_sequence_number,
                    transfer_course_sequence_number
                order by
                    term_code desc
                ) as rn2
        from
            (
            select
                *,
                row_number() over
                    (
                    partition by
                        banner_pidm,
                        term_code,
                        transfer_course_sequence_number,
                        transfer_institution_sequence_number,
                        transfer_period_sequence_number
                    order by
                        observation_tm desc
                    ) as rn
            from
                <passthrough.[Banner].[Transfer Course Details SHRTRCR]> as shrtrcr
            where
                shrtrcr.observation_tm> '2020-01-08'--<PIT_START_TIME>
                and shrtrcr.observation_tm <= '2020-01-10'--<PIT_END_TIME>
            )
            shrtrcr
        where
            shrtrcr.rn = 1
        )
        shrtrcr
        on shrtrcr.banner_pidm = shrtrce.banner_pidm
        and shrtrcr.transfer_institution_sequence_number = shrtrce.trit_sequence_number
        and shrtrcr.transfer_period_sequence_number = shrtrce.tram_sequence_number
        and shrtrcr.transfer_course_sequence_number = shrtrce.trcr_sequence_number
        and shrtrcr.course_level_code = shrtrce.level_code
        and shrtrcr.rn2 = 1
    left join
        (
        select
            *
        from
            (
            select
                *,
                row_number() over
                    (
                    partition by
                        grade_code,
                        grade_abbreviation,
                        level_code,
                        effective_term
                    order by
                        observation_tm desc
                    ) as rn
            from
                <passthrough.[Banner].[Grading Code Maintenance SHRGRDE]> as shrgrde
            where
                shrgrde.observation_tm > '2020-01-08'--<PIT_START_TIME>
                and shrgrde.observation_tm <= '2020-01-10'--<PIT_END_TIME>
            )
            g
        where
            g.rn = 1
        )
        g
        on shrtrce.level_code = g.level_code
        and shrtrce.final_grade = g.grade_code
        and g.effective_term =
            (
            select
                max(effective_term)
            from
                (
                select
                    *,
                    row_number() over
                        (
                        partition by
                            grade_code,
                            grade_abbreviation,
                            level_code,
                            effective_term
                        order by
                            observation_tm desc) as rn
                from
                    <passthrough.[Banner].[Grading Code Maintenance SHRGRDE]> as shrgrde
                where
                    shrgrde.observation_tm> '2020-01-08'--<PIT_START_TIME>
                    and shrgrde.observation_tm <= '2020-01-10'--<PIT_END_TIME>
                )
                shrgrde 
            where
                shrgrde.rn = 1
                and shrgrde.grade_code = g.grade_code
                and shrgrde.level_code = g.level_code
            )

queryResults.sqlPreview: SELECT tcd.student_id AS student_id , tcd.articulation_term AS term_code , CAST(tcd.transfer_equivalency_group || tcd.sequence_number || tcd.model_number || tcd…
queryResults.querySql:
SELECT tcd.student_id                                                                AS student_id
       , tcd.articulation_term                                                   AS term_code
       , CAST(tcd.transfer_equivalency_group || tcd.sequence_number || tcd.model_number || tcd.offer_nbr AS INTEGER) AS sequence_number
       , COALESCE(tcd.src_term, tcd.articulation_term, '')                       AS orig_term_code
       , 'Transfer'                                                              AS campus_code
       , 'Transfer'                                                              AS college_code
       , 'Transfer'                                                              AS department_code
       , CAST(tcd.unt_taken AS NUMERIC)                                          AS course_credits
       , COALESCE(transConvert.subject_area, Replace(tcd.subject, ' ', ''))    AS subject_code
       , COALESCE(TRIM(transConvert.catalog_nbr), '9999')                        AS course_number
       , CAST(CASE
                WHEN tcd.repeat_code IN ('', ' ') THEN 'f'
                ELSE 't'
              END AS BOOLEAN)                                                    AS repeat_ind  --update to match inst
       , CAST(tcd.unt_taken AS DECIMAL)                                          AS attempted_credits
       , CASE
           WHEN ( tcd.earn_credit = 'Y' AND tcd.repeat_code IN ( 'INCL', '', ' ' )) THEN CAST(tcd.units_transferred AS DECIMAL)
           ELSE 0
         END                                                                     AS earned_credits
       , COALESCE(school.description, school.src_org_name)                           AS transferring_institution
       , NULL                                                                    AS midterm_grade
       , CASE
            WHEN tcd.official_grade != ' ' THEN tcd.official_grade
            ELSE tcd.crse_grade_input
         END 																     AS final_grade
       , NULL                                                                    AS final_grade_date
       , 'NA'                                                                    AS course_type_code
       , tcd.academic_career                                                         AS level_code
       , current_date                                                                   AS create_date
       , current_date                                                                   AS update_date
       , CAST(CASE
                WHEN (tcd.reject_reason = ' ' OR tcd.reject_reason IS NULL) THEN 'T'
                ELSE 'F'
              END AS BOOLEAN)                                                    AS active_ind
FROM (SELECT a.*
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY student_id, articulation_term, academic_career, course_id, offer_nbr
                                               , transfer_equivalency_group, sequence_number, model_number
                                  ORDER BY source_table) AS src_rn
      FROM (SELECT student_id, atriculation_term as articulation_term, institution_id, academic_career, course_id, subject
             , offer_nbr, transfer_equivalency_group, equiv_seq as sequence_number, model_name as model_number, source_term as src_term
             , units_taken as unt_taken, units_transferred, repeat_code, earn_credit, official_grade
             , grade_input as crse_grade_input, reject_reason, include_in_gpa, valid_attempt, grading_basis
             , '1' AS source_table
      FROM 
			(select *, row_number() over (partition by student_id,atriculation_term,institution_id,academic_career,model_name,transfer_equivalency_group,equiv_seq order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
			from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TRNS_CRSE_DTL]> as ps_trns_crse_dtl
			where ps_trns_crse_dtl.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and ps_trns_crse_dtl.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
			)ps_trns_crse_dtl where 1=1 and ps_trns_crse_dtl.dup_rn=1 AND (reject_reason IS NULL OR reject_reason = ' ') --normal transfer records
			
           UNION
           
		   SELECT student_id, articulation_term, institution_id, academic_career, course_id, NULL AS school_subject
                  , course_offer_number, transfer_equivalency_group, sequence_number, model_number, NULL AS src_term
                  , units_transferred AS unt_taken, units_transferred, repeat_code, earn_credit, official_grade
                  , NULL AS crse_grade_input, reject_reason, include_in_gpa, valid_attempt, grading_basis
                  , '2' AS source_table
           FROM (select *, row_number() over (partition by student_id,articulation_term,transfer_equivalency_group,academic_career,model_number,institution_id,sequence_number order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
		   from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TRNS_TEST_DTL]> as ps_trns_test_dtl
		   where ps_trns_test_dtl.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and ps_trns_test_dtl.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
			)ps_trns_test_dtl  --transfer credits from tests
           WHERE 1=1 and ps_trns_test_dtl.dup_rn=1 AND (reject_reason IS NULL OR reject_reason = ' ') AND valid_attempt = 'Y'   --added because lots of records were missing CRSE_IDs and seemed to be junk records
           
		   UNION
		   
           SELECT student_id, articulation_term, institution_id, academic_career, course_id, NULL AS school_subject
                  , offer_nbr, transfer_equivalency_group, sequence_number, model_number, NULL AS src_term
                  , units_transferred AS unt_taken, units_transferred, repeat_code, earn_credit, official_grade
                  , NULL AS crse_grade_input, reject_reason, include_in_gpa, valid_attempt, grading_basis
                  , '3' AS source_table
           FROM (select * , row_number() over (partition by student_id,articulation_term,transfer_equivalency_group,academic_career,model_number,institution_id,sequence_number order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
		   from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TRNS_OTHR_DTL]> as ps_trns_othr_dtl
		   where ps_trns_othr_dtl.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and ps_trns_othr_dtl.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		   )ps_trns_othr_dtl    --other kinds of transfer credits (i.e. internships, work-study, etc.)
           WHERE 1=1 and ps_trns_othr_dtl.dup_rn=1 AND (reject_reason IS NULL OR reject_reason = ' ')
			) a
     ) tcd
--Transferring institution
LEFT JOIN (select tcs.student_id, tcs.academic_institution, tcs.model_nbr , tcs.academic_career, eot.external_org_id, eot.description, tcs.src_org_name from 
			(SELECT *
           FROM 
		   (select *, row_number() over (partition by academic_career,student_id,model_nbr,academic_institution order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
		   from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_TRNS_CRSE_SCH]> as tcs
		   where tcs.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and tcs.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		   ) tcs where tcs.dup_rn=1
		   )tcs
           LEFT JOIN (SELECT eot.external_org_id, eot.description, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY external_org_id ORDER BY effective_date DESC) AS RN
                      FROM 
					  (select *,row_number() over (partition by external_org_id,effective_date order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
					  from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_EXT_ORG_TBL]> as eot
					  where eot.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and eot.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
					  )eot where eot.dup_rn=1
					  ) eot
                  ON eot.external_org_id = tcs.external_org_id AND eot.RN = 1
           WHERE 1=1
          ) school
       ON school.student_id = tcd.student_id
          AND school.academic_institution = tcd.institution_id
          AND school.model_nbr = tcd.model_number
          AND school.academic_career = tcd.academic_career
		  
--Transfer Equivalency Information
LEFT JOIN (SELECT co.subject_area, co.catalog_nbr, co.course_id, co.course_offering_nbr
                  , co.acad_group, co.career, institution
           FROM (select *,row_number() over (partition by course_id,effective_date,course_offering_nbr order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn
		   from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_CRSE_OFFER]> as co
	       where co.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and co.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>		   
		   )co where 1=1 and co.dup_rn=1
           AND co.effective_date = (SELECT MAX(co1.effective_date)
                              FROM (select *,row_number() over (partition by course_id,effective_date,course_offering_nbr order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn 
							  from <passthrough.[Peoplesoft].[PS_CRSE_OFFER]> as co1
							  where co1.observation_tm > <PIT_START_TIME> and co1.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>		 
							  )co1
                              WHERE co.course_id = co1.course_id AND co1.effective_date < current_date
						  )
		) transConvert
       ON transConvert.course_id = tcd.course_id
          AND transConvert.course_offering_nbr = tcd.offer_nbr
          AND transConvert.institution = tcd.institution_id
          AND transConvert.career = tcd.academic_career
WHERE 1=1
   AND tcd.src_rn = 1

queryResults.sqlPreview: select spriden.student_id as student_id , shrtrce.effective_term AS term_code , CAST(LEFT((shrtrce.trit_sequence_number || shrtrce.tram_sequence_number || shrtr…
queryResults.querySql:
select 
spriden.student_id as student_id
, shrtrce.effective_term AS term_code
, CAST(LEFT((shrtrce.trit_sequence_number || shrtrce.tram_sequence_number || shrtrce.sequence_number || shrtrce.trcr_sequence_number),9) AS INT) AS sequence_number
, shrtrcr.term_code AS orig_term_code
, '' AS campus_code -- blank for transfers
, '' AS college_code -- blank for transfers
, '' AS department_code -- blank for transfers
, CAST(shrtrce.credit_hours AS NUMERIC) AS course_credits
, shrtrce.subject_code AS subject_code
, shrtrce.course_number AS course_number
, CASE
    WHEN shrtrce.repeat_course_flag IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
    END AS repeat_ind
, CASE
	WHEN g.attempted_indicator = 'Y' THEN CAST(shrtrce.credit_hours AS NUMERIC)
	ELSE 0
	END AS attempted_credits
, CASE
	WHEN g.completed_indicator = 'Y' THEN CAST(shrtrce.credit_hours AS NUMERIC)
	ELSE 0
	END AS earned_credits
, institution_name AS transferring_institution
, '' AS midterm_grade
, g.grade_code AS final_grade
, NULL AS final_grade_date -- shrtrce_activity_date
, 'NA' AS course_type_code -- blank for transfers
, shrtrce.level_code AS level_code
, current_date AS create_date
, current_date AS update_date
, 't' AS active_ind	
from 
(
select * from
(
select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Person Identification Name SPRIDEN]> as spriden where  spriden.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME> and spriden.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
) spriden where spriden.rn=1
) spriden

join
( 
select * from
(
select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm,course_number,subject_code,effective_term order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Transfer Course Equivalents SHRTRCE]> as shrtrce where shrtrce.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME> and shrtrce.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
) shrtrce where shrtrce.rn=1
) shrtrce on shrtrce.banner_pidm = spriden.banner_pidm

left join 
(
select * from
(select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm,transfer_institution_sequence_number order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Transfer Institution Records SHRTRIT]> as shrtrit where shrtrit.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME> and shrtrit.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
) shrtrit where shrtrit.rn=1
) shrtrit on shrtrit.banner_pidm = shrtrce.banner_pidm and shrtrce.trit_sequence_number = shrtrit.transfer_institution_sequence_number

left join 
(select * from
(select *,row_number() over (partition by institution_code order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Source Background Institution Lookup STVSBGI]> as stvsbgi where stvsbgi.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME> and stvsbgi.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
)stvsbgi where stvsbgi.rn=1
)stvsbgi on shrtrit.transfer_institution_code = stvsbgi.institution_code

LEFT OUTER JOIN 
(select *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY banner_pidm,transfer_institution_sequence_number, transfer_period_sequence_number, transfer_course_sequence_number order by term_code desc) as RN
                  from (select *,row_number() over (partition by banner_pidm,term_code,transfer_course_sequence_number,transfer_institution_sequence_number,transfer_period_sequence_number order by observation_tm desc) as dup_rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Transfer Course Details SHRTRCR]> as shrtrcr where shrtrcr.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME> and shrtrcr.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
						) shrtrcr where shrtrcr.dup_rn=1
) shrtrcr
	ON shrtrcr.banner_pidm = shrtrce.banner_pidm
	AND shrtrcr.transfer_institution_sequence_number = shrtrce.trit_sequence_number
	AND shrtrcr.transfer_period_sequence_number = shrtrce.tram_sequence_number
	AND shrtrcr.transfer_course_sequence_number = shrtrce.trcr_sequence_number
	AND shrtrcr.course_level_code = shrtrce.level_code
  AND shrtrcr.RN = 1
  
LEFT JOIN 
(select * from
(select *,row_number() over (partition by grade_code,grade_abbreviation,level_code,effective_term order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Grading Code Maintenance SHRGRDE]> as shrgrde where shrgrde.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME> and shrgrde.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
) g where g.rn=1
) g
	ON shrtrce.level_code = g.level_code
	AND shrtrce.final_grade = g.grade_code
	AND g.effective_term = (
		SELECT MAX(effective_term)
		FROM (select *,row_number() over (partition by grade_code,grade_abbreviation,level_code,effective_term order by observation_tm desc) as rn from <passthrough.[Banner].[Grading Code Maintenance SHRGRDE]> as shrgrde
		 where shrgrde.observation_tm> <PIT_START_TIME> and shrgrde.observation_tm <= <PIT_END_TIME>
		)shrgrde 
		WHERE shrgrde.rn=1
		AND shrgrde.grade_code = g.grade_code
		AND shrgrde.level_code = g.level_code
		)
