queryResults.sqlPreview: WITH aa_type_cat AS ( SELECT f.field_field , f.field_record , CASE WHEN f.field_value IS NULL OR f.field_value = '' THEN lp.lookup_prompt_value ELSE f.field_val…
queryResults.querySql:
WITH aa_type_cat AS
         (
             SELECT f.field_field
                  , f.field_record
                  , CASE WHEN f.field_value IS NULL OR f.field_value = '' 
                            THEN lp.lookup_prompt_value ELSE f.field_value END AS value
             FROM <[Slate].[slate_field].[current batch]> f
                      LEFT JOIN <[Slate].[slate_lookup_prompt].[current batch]> lp
                           ON f.field_prompt = lp.lookup_prompt_id
             WHERE f.field_field IN ('org_type', 'org_category')
         )
        ,
     bb_dr_source AS
         (
             SELECT dr.dataset_row_id AS pk
                  , dr.dataset_row_id                        AS dataset_row_id
                  , dr.dataset_row_key                    AS ceeb_code
                  , dr.dataset_row_name                      AS name
                  , dr.dataset_row_created                   AS crm_created_at
                  , dr.dataset_row_updated                   AS crm_updated_at
                  , a.address_street                     AS street
                  , a.address_city                       AS city
                  , a.address_region                     AS region
                  , a.address_postal                     AS postal
                  , a.address_country                    AS country
                  , a.address_county                     AS county
                  , a.address_zip                        AS zip
                  , tcc.value                    AS category
                  , tct.value                    AS type
             FROM <[Slate].[slate_dataset_row].[current batch]> dr
                      JOIN <[Slate].[slate_dataset].[current batch]> d
                           ON d.dataset_id = dr.dataset_row_dataset
                               AND d.dataset_name = 'Organizations'
                      LEFT JOIN <[Slate].[slate_address].[current batch]> a
                                ON a.address_record = dr.dataset_row_id
                                    AND a.address_rank_overall = 1
                      LEFT JOIN aa_type_cat tcc
                                ON dr.dataset_row_id = tcc.field_record
                                    AND tcc.field_field = 'org_category'
                      LEFT JOIN aa_type_cat tct
                                ON dr.dataset_row_id = tct.field_record
                                    AND tct.field_field = 'org_type'
         )
        ,
     cc_s_source AS
         (
             SELECT DISTINCT md5(concat(
                                   coalesce(s.school_name,'NA')
                                 , coalesce(s.school_key,'NA')
                                 , coalesce(s.school_city,'NA')
                                 , coalesce(s.school_region,'NA')
                                 , coalesce(s.school_country,'NA')
                                 , coalesce(s.school_type,'NA')
                                 ))           AS pk
                           , s.school_name    AS name
                           , s.school_key     AS ceeb_code
                           , s.school_city    AS city
                           , s.school_region  AS region
                           , s.school_country AS country
                           , s.school_type    AS type
             FROM <[Slate].[slate_school].[current batch]> s
             left join (
                     SELECT distinct dr.dataset_row_key
                     FROM <[Slate].[slate_dataset_row].[current batch]> dr
                              JOIN <[Slate].[slate_dataset].[current batch]> d
                                   ON d.dataset_id = dr.dataset_row_dataset
                                       AND d.dataset_name = 'Organizations'

                 ) x  on x.dataset_row_key = s.school_key
             where x.dataset_row_key is null

queryResults.querySql:
with
    aa_peeps as
    (select person_id 
        from <[Slate].[slate_person].[current batch]> person
    ),
    bb_apps as 
    (select application_id 
        from <[Slate].[slate_application].[current batch]> application

    cc_crm_statushistorylog as
    (
    select

            , p.person_id as contact_id
            , a.application_id as application_id
            , case when p.person_id is not null then 'Contact Status'

            , s.status_status as status_label
            , '1900-01-01' as crm_created_at
            , s.status_timestamp as crm_updated_at

            left join aa_peeps p
                on s.status_record=p.person_id
            left join bb_apps a
                on s.status_record=a.application_id

    cc_crm_statushistorylog.crm_created_at as crm_created_at,

    where 1=1

queryResults.querySql:
with 
     aa_seconds as 
     (
      select ((3600 * hours) + (60 * minutes) + (1 * aa_seconds)) as duration_seconds
             , ping_identity as ping_identity
      from (
             select ping_identity,
                    substr(duration, 1, 2) as hours,
                    substr(duration, 4, 2) as minutes,
                    substr(duration, 7, 2) as aa_seconds
             from (
                    select ping_duration as duration,
                           ping_identity
                    from <[Slate].[slate_ping].[current batch]> sp1) a
           ) b
      ),
    bb_crm_webactivity as 
	(
	select
	        sp.ping_identity as web_activity_id
	        , sp.ping_record as contact_id
	        , sp.ping_url as url
	        , coalesce(sp.ping_ip, '0.0.0.0') as ip
	        , sp.ping_ua as device
	        , null as campaign_id
	        , sp.ping_referrer as referrer_url
	        , aa_seconds.duration_seconds as duration
	        , sp.ping_utm_campaign as utm_campaign
	        , sp.ping_utm_content as utm_content
	        , sp.ping_utm_medium as utm_medium
	        , sp.ping_utm_source as utm_source
	        , substr(sp.ping_utm_term, 1,100) as utm_term
	        , sp.ping_timestamp as crm_created_at
	        , sp.ping_timestamp as crm_updated_at
	    from <[Slate].[slate_ping].[current batch]> sp
	    	join aa_seconds
	    		on sp.ping_identity=aa_seconds.ping_identity
	)
select
	bb_crm_webactivity.crm_created_at as crm_created_at,
	bb_crm_webactivity.crm_updated_at as crm_updated_at,
	bb_crm_webactivity.web_activity_id as web_activity_id,
	bb_crm_webactivity.contact_id as contact_id,
	null as url,
	bb_crm_webactivity.ip as ip,
	substr(bb_crm_webactivity.device,1,100) as device,
	bb_crm_webactivity.campaign_id as campaign_id,
	null as referrer_url,
	bb_crm_webactivity.duration as duration,
	bb_crm_webactivity.utm_campaign as utm_campaign,
	bb_crm_webactivity.utm_content as utm_content,
	bb_crm_webactivity.utm_medium as utm_medium,
	bb_crm_webactivity.utm_source as utm_source,
	bb_crm_webactivity.utm_term as utm_term
from bb_crm_webactivity
	where 1=1
		and bb_crm_webactivity.web_activity_id is not null;

AND (IP.<International Indicator Code>='0');

with rd as (
select co.course, split_part(co.value,',',1) as term, co.value as full_term from <[Smart Guidance SGD].[Course Offered]> as co union all
select co.course, split_part(co.value,',',2) as term, co.value as full_term from <[Smart Guidance SGD].[Course Offered]> as co union all
select co.course, split_part(co.value,',',3) as term, co.value as full_term from <[Smart Guidance SGD].[Course Offered]> as co union all
select co.course, split_part(co.value,',',4) as term, co.value as full_term from <[Smart Guidance SGD].[Course Offered]> as co
)
, rd2 as (
  select course
  , ltrim(rtrim(upper(term))) as term
  , full_term
  from rd
  where term <> ''
)
				
select 
				rd2.course || '$$' || rd2.term as nk
				, rd2.course as course
				, rd2.term as value
				, 'T' as is_active
from rd2
where rd2.term in ('FALL','SPRING','WINTER','SUMMER')
order by course, term

(
       SELECT record_type ,
              action ,

GF query for declaration WithOut Current Major
Parameters: None
*/

WITH tmp AS
(
       SELECT record_type,
              action,
              primary_user_id,
              major_cd_1,
              major_cd_2,
              major_cd_3,
              major_cd_4
       FROM   (
                       SELECT   a.record_type,
                                a.action,
                                primary_user_id,
                                major_cd_1,
                                major_cd_2,
                                major_cd_3,
                                major_cd_4,
                                Rank() OVER (partition BY primary_user_id ORDER BY b.begin_date DESC ,b.end_date DESC) term_rank
                       FROM     <[Strategic Care STC].[Student_Major].[current batch]> a,
                                <[Strategic Care STC].[Term].[current batch]> b
                       WHERE    a.term_id=b.external_id
                       AND      a.major_cd_1 IS NOT NULL
                       AND      length(trim(a.major_cd_1))>0 ) tbl
       WHERE  term_rank=1)
SELECT record_type     AS record_type,
       action          AS action,
       primary_user_id AS primary_user_id,
		 maj_items.major_id as major_id
FROM   (
              SELECT record_type,
                     action,
                     primary_user_id,
                     major_cd_1 AS major_id
              FROM   tmp
  where major_cd_1 is not null and length(trim(major_cd_1)) > 0 
  union all
  SELECT record_type,
                     action,
                     primary_user_id,
                     major_cd_2 AS major_id
              FROM   tmp
    where major_cd_2 is not null and length(trim(major_cd_2)) > 0 

union all
SELECT record_type,
                     action,
                     primary_user_id,
                     major_cd_3 AS major_id
              FROM   tmp
    where major_cd_3 is not null and length(trim(major_cd_3)) > 0 

union all
SELECT record_type,
                     action,
                     primary_user_id,
                     major_cd_4 AS major_id
              FROM   tmp
  where major_cd_4 is not null and length(trim(major_cd_4)) > 0 
) as maj_items;

queryResults.querySql:
/*
Query -  GF Section Meeting SQL
Parameters:
SECTION_SOURCE_DATE_FORMAT  -  "dd-MMM-yy"
SSCPLUS_DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT - "MM/dd/yyyy"
*/

SELECT sec.record_type                                 AS RECORD_TYPE,
       sec.action                                      AS ACTION,
       sec.term_code                                   AS TERM_ID,
       Concat_ws('-', s.subject_code, s.course_number) AS COURSE_EXTERNAL_ID,
       CASE
         WHEN s.section_name IS NULL OR Length(Trim(s.section_name)) = 0 THEN ''
         ELSE s.section_name
       END                                             AS SECTION_NAME,
       CASE
         WHEN sec.meet_start_date IS NOT NULL THEN
     to_char(to_date(sec.meet_start_date,'dd-MON-yy'),'MM/dd/yyyy')
         ELSE ''
       END                                             AS BEGIN_DATE,
       CASE
         WHEN sec.meet_end_date IS NOT NULL THEN
     to_char(to_date(sec.meet_end_date,'dd-MON-yy'),'MM/dd/yyyy')
         ELSE ''
       END                                             AS END_DATE,
       CASE
         WHEN sec.meet_start_time IS NULL
               OR Length(Trim(sec.meet_start_time)) = 0
               OR Length(Trim(sec.meet_start_time)) < 4 THEN ''
         ELSE Concat_ws(':', Substr(sec.meet_start_time, 1, 2), Substr(sec.meet_start_time, 3, 2))
       END                                             AS START_TIME,
       CASE
         WHEN sec.meet_end_time IS NULL
               OR Length(Trim(sec.meet_end_time)) = 0
               OR Length(Trim(sec.meet_end_time)) < 4 THEN ''
         ELSE Concat_ws(':', Substr(sec.meet_end_time, 1, 2),Substr(sec.meet_end_time, 3, 2))
       END                                             AS END_TIME,
       Concat(COALESCE(meet_sunday,''),COALESCE(meet_monday,''),COALESCE(meet_tuesday,''),COALESCE(meet_wednesday,''),COALESCE(meet_thursday,''),COALESCE(meet_friday,''),COALESCE(meet_saturday,'')) AS MEETING_DAYS,
       CASE
         WHEN ( meet_building_code IS NULL
                 OR Length(Trim(meet_building_code)) = 0 )
              AND ( meet_room_code IS NULL
                     OR Length(Trim(meet_room_code)) = 0 ) THEN ''
         WHEN ( meet_building_code IS NULL
                 OR Length(Trim(meet_building_code)) = 0 )
               OR ( meet_room_code IS NULL
                     OR Length(Trim(meet_room_code)) = 0 ) THEN Trim(Concat(COALESCE(meet_building_code,''), COALESCE(meet_room_code,'')))
         ELSE Concat_ws('-', meet_building_code, meet_room_code)
       END                                             AS LOCATION
FROM   <[Strategic Care STC].[section_meeting].[Current Batch]> sec
       INNER JOIN <[Strategic Care STC].[GF_Term_Filter_Entity].[Current Batch]> tf
               ON sec.term_code = tf.term_id
     INNER JOIN <[Strategic Care STC].[section].[Current Batch]> s
         ON (sec.course_ref_no=s.course_ref_no and sec.term_code=s.term_code);

       sec.term_code                                   AS TERM_ID,
       Concat_ws('-', s.subject_code, s.course_number) AS COURSE_EXTERNAL_ID,
       CASE
         WHEN s.section_name IS NULL OR Length(Trim(s.section_name)) = 0 THEN ''
         ELSE s.section_name

       CASE

         WHEN sec.meet_start_date IS NOT NULL and regexp_like(sec.meet_start_date, '.*[A-Za-z].*') THEN to_char(to_date(sec.meet_start_date,'dd-MON-yy'),'MM/dd/yyyy')

         WHEN sec.meet_end_date IS NOT NULL and regexp_like(sec.meet_end_date, '.*[A-Za-z].*')  THEN to_char(to_date(sec.meet_end_date,'dd-MON-yy'),'MM/dd/yyyy')
         ELSE ''
       END                                             AS END_DATE,
       CASE
         WHEN sec.meet_start_time IS NULL

       CASE

                 OR Length(Trim(meet_building_code)) = 0 )
              AND ( meet_room_code IS NULL
                     OR Length(Trim(meet_room_code)) = 0 ) THEN ''
         WHEN ( meet_building_code IS NULL
                 OR Length(Trim(meet_building_code)) = 0 )

         ELSE Concat_ws('-', meet_building_code, meet_room_code)
       END                                             AS LOCATION
FROM   <[Strategic Care STC].[section_meeting].[Current Batch]> sec
       INNER JOIN <[Strategic Care STC].[GF_Term_Filter_Entity].[Current Batch]> tf

     INNER JOIN <[Strategic Care STC].[section].[Current Batch]> s

/*
Query -  GF Get User With Authorization and Instructor
Parameters: None
*/

select RECORD_TYPE as RECORD_TYPE, ACTION as ACTION, USER_ID as PRIMARY_USER_ID, 
authn.is_active as IS_ACTIVE, authn.can_login as CAN_LOGIN, authn.send_activation as SEND_ACTIVATION, 
FIRST_NAME as FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME as LAST_NAME, 
authn.alt_user_id as ALT_USER_ID, 
ROLE_ID as ROLE_ID, EMAIL as EMAIL, ALT_EMAIL as ALT_EMAIL, ADDRESS_1 as ADDRESS_1, ADDRESS_2 as ADDRESS_2, CITY as CITY, STATE as STATE, 
POSTAL_CODE as POSTAL_CODE, HOME_PHONE as HOME_PHONE, CELL_PHONE as CELL_PHONE, WORK_PHONE as WORK_PHONE, GENDER as GENDER, ETHNICITY as ETHNICITY, DATE_OF_BIRTH as DATE_OF_BIRTH, 
TOTAL_CREDIT_HOURS as TOTAL_CREDIT_HOURS, CREDIT_HOURS_ATTEMPTED as CREDIT_HOURS_ATTEMPTED, MAJOR_ID as MAJOR_ID, STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_STATUS as STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_STATUS, 
STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_GOAL as STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_GOAL, 
authn.pin as PIN, authn.sso_id as SSO_ID, 
'' as ACT_TOTAL, '' as ACT_ENGLISH,  '' as ACT_READING, '' as ACT_MATH, '' as ACT_SCIENCE, '' as SAT_TOTAL, '' as SAT_VERBAL, '' as SAT_MATH, HIGH_SCHOOL_GPA as HIGH_SCHOOL_GPA, 
FIRST_GENERATION_IND as FIRST_GENERATION_IND, FATHER_EDUCATION as FATHER_EDUCATION, MOTHER_EDUCATION as MOTHER_EDUCATION, HIGH_SCHOOL_ZIP_CODE as HIGH_SCHOOL_ZIP_CODE, HOUSEHOLD_INCOME as HOUSEHOLD_INCOME, 
SINGLE_PARENT_FAMILY_IND as SINGLE_PARENT_FAMILY_IND, '' as TRANSFER_GPA, HOME_COLLEGE as HOME_COLLEGE, RECEIVE_TXT_MESSAGE_IND as RECEIVE_TXT_MESSAGE_IND, EXCHANGE_EMAIL as EXCHANGE_EMAIL,  
authn.card_swipe_id as CARD_SWIPE_ID ,
pronouns,
LAST_FAFSA_YEAR_SUBMITTED as last_fafsa_year,
legal_first_name,
unmet_need,
pell_eligible

from 
(select a.record_type as RECORD_TYPE, a.action as ACTION, a.primary_user_id as USER_ID, first_name as FIRST_NAME, last_name as LAST_NAME, a.is_active as IS_ACTIVE, a.login_ind AS CAN_LOGIN, 
 a.activate_email_ind as SEND_ACTIVATION, role_id as ROLE_ID, '' as MAJOR_ID,total_credit_hours as TOTAL_CREDIT_HOURS, attempted_credit_hours as CREDIT_HOURS_ATTEMPTED, 
  email as EMAIL, '' as ALT_EMAIL, address_1 as ADDRESS_1, address_2 as ADDRESS_2, city as CITY, state as STATE, postal_code as POSTAL_CODE, home_phone as HOME_PHONE, cell_phone as CELL_PHONE, 
 '' as WORK_PHONE, gender as GENDER, ethnicity as ETHNICITY, date_of_birth as DATE_OF_BIRTH, receive_txt_message_ind as RECEIVE_TXT_MESSAGE_IND, 
student_enrollment_status as STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_STATUS, student_enrollment_goal as STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_GOAL, EXCHANGE_EMAIL as EXCHANGE_EMAIL, 
high_school_gpa as HIGH_SCHOOL_GPA, first_generation_ind as FIRST_GENERATION_IND, father_education as FATHER_EDUCATION, mother_education as MOTHER_EDUCATION, 
high_school_zip_code as HIGH_SCHOOL_ZIP_CODE, household_income as HOUSEHOLD_INCOME, single_parent_family_ind as SINGLE_PARENT_FAMILY_IND, home_college as HOME_COLLEGE,
a.pronouns,
a.LAST_FAFSA_YEAR_SUBMITTED,
a.legal_first_name,
a.unmet_need,
a.pell_eligible
from 
<[Strategic Care STC].[student].[Current Batch]> a left join  
(select primary_user_id, total_credit_hours,attempted_credit_hours from (select primary_user_id, total_credit_hours,attempted_credit_hours,
																		 rank() over (partition by primary_user_id order by b.begin_date desc ,b.end_date desc) term_rank from 
																		 <[Strategic Care STC].[student_major].[Current Batch]> a join <[Strategic Care STC].[term].[Current Batch]> b
																		 on a.term_id=b.external_id
																		 where a.total_credit_hours is not null and a.attempted_credit_hours is not null 
																		 and length(trim(a.total_credit_hours)) > 0 and length(trim(a.attempted_credit_hours)) > 0) tbl where term_rank =1)
																		b on (a.primary_user_id = b.primary_user_id) 
																						 
												union all 
													 select record_type as RECORD_TYPE, action as ACTION, primary_user_id as USER_ID, first_name as FIRST_NAME, last_name as LAST_NAME,
																						 is_active as IS_ACTIVE, login_ind AS CAN_LOGIN, 
													activate_email_ind as SEND_ACTIVATION,  role_id as ROLE_ID, '' as MAJOR_ID,'' as TOTAL_CREDIT_HOURS, '' as CREDIT_HOURS_ATTEMPTED, 
																						 email as EMAIL, alt_email as ALT_EMAIL, '' as ADDRESS_1, 	
													'' as ADDRESS_2, '' as CITY, '' as STATE, '' as POSTAL_CODE, home_phone as HOME_PHONE, cell_phone as CELL_PHONE, work_phone as WORK_PHONE, 
																						 '' as GENDER, '' as ETHNICITY, '' as DATE_OF_BIRTH, 									 
													'' as RECEIVE_TXT_MESSAGE_IND, '' as STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_STATUS, '' as STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_GOAL, EXCHANGE_EMAIL as EXCHANGE_EMAIL, 
													'' as HIGH_SCHOOL_GPA, '' as FIRST_GENERATION_IND, '' as FATHER_EDUCATION, '' as MOTHER_EDUCATION, 
													'' as HIGH_SCHOOL_ZIP_CODE, '' as HOUSEHOLD_INCOME, '' as SINGLE_PARENT_FAMILY_IND, '' as HOME_COLLEGE ,
													pronouns,
													'' AS LAST_FAFSA_YEAR_SUBMITTED
													, '' AS legal_first_name
													, '' AS unmet_need
													, '' AS pell_eligible
													from 
													<[Strategic Care STC].[instructor].[Current Batch]> inst

STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_GOAL as STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_GOAL, 
authn.pin as PIN, authn.sso_id as SSO_ID, 
'' as ACT_TOTAL, '' as ACT_ENGLISH,  '' as ACT_READING, '' as ACT_MATH, '' as ACT_SCIENCE, '' as SAT_TOTAL, '' as SAT_VERBAL, '' as SAT_MATH, HIGH_SCHOOL_GPA as HIGH_SCHOOL_GPA,

authn.card_swipe_id as CARD_SWIPE_ID 
from 
(select a.record_type as RECORD_TYPE, a.action as ACTION, a.primary_user_id as USER_ID, first_name as FIRST_NAME, last_name as LAST_NAME, a.is_active as IS_ACTIVE, a.login_ind AS CAN_LOGIN, 
 a.activate_email_ind as SEND_ACTIVATION, role_id as ROLE_ID, '' as MAJOR_ID,total_credit_hours as TOTAL_CREDIT_HOURS, attempted_credit_hours as CREDIT_HOURS_ATTEMPTED,

 work_phone as WORK_PHONE, gender as GENDER, ethnicity as ETHNICITY, date_of_birth as DATE_OF_BIRTH, receive_txt_message_ind as RECEIVE_TXT_MESSAGE_IND,

																						 email as EMAIL, alt_email as ALT_EMAIL, '' as ADDRESS_1, 	
													'' as ADDRESS_2, '' as CITY, '' as STATE, '' as POSTAL_CODE, home_phone as HOME_PHONE, cell_phone as CELL_PHONE, work_phone as WORK_PHONE, 
																						 '' as GENDER, '' as ETHNICITY, '' as DATE_OF_BIRTH, 									 
													'' as RECEIVE_TXT_MESSAGE_IND, '' as STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_STATUS, '' as STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_GOAL, EXCHANGE_EMAIL as EXCHANGE_EMAIL, 
													'' as HIGH_SCHOOL_GPA, '' as FIRST_GENERATION_IND, '' as FATHER_EDUCATION, '' as MOTHER_EDUCATION, 
													'' as HIGH_SCHOOL_ZIP_CODE, '' as HOUSEHOLD_INCOME, '' as SINGLE_PARENT_FAMILY_IND, '' as HOME_COLLEGE 
													from 
													<[Strategic Care STC].[instructor].[Current Batch]> inst						 
) user_sub 
 left join <[Strategic Care STC].[authorization].[Current Batch]> authn on user_sub.USER_ID = authn.primary_user_id
where user_sub.USER_ID is not null and length(trim(user_sub.USER_ID)) > 0;

select DISTINCT a.action
 ,c.attempted_credit_hours --using latest term that has not completed
 --,a.attempted_credit_hours
 ,a.major_cd_1
 ,a.major_cd_2
 ,a.major_cd_3

 ,a.primary_user_id

 ,b.term_id as total_credit_hours --using latest term that has not completed

queryResults.querySql:
WITH smm as 
  (select d.primary_user_id, max(d.term_id) as maxterm
   from <[Strategic Care STC].[student_major]> as d
   left join <[Strategic Care STC].[term]> as t
     on t.external_id = d.term_id
   where t.end_date < current_date
   group by d.primary_user_id
  )

select c.primary_user_id as primary_user_id
, c.maxterm as term_id
,'OVERALL_CML_GPA' AS key_column
, coalesce(b.key_value,'-') as key_value
from smm as c --only pulling max completed term record
join <[Strategic Care STC].[student_term]> as b
  on b.primary_user_id = c.primary_user_id

UNION ALL
  
select e.primary_user_id as primary_user_id
, e.maxterm as term_id
,'INST_TERM_GPA' AS key_column
, coalesce(f.program_cd,'-') as key_value
from smm as e --only pulling max completed term record
join <[Strategic Care STC].[student_major]> as f
  on f.primary_user_id = e.primary_user_id
  and f.term_id = e.maxterm
